税收与公共财政

人们对所得税、财富税和稽查政策的行为反应，利用改革和实验在全体人口的税务记录上识别。

Taxing Top Wealth: Migration Responses and Their Aggregate Economic Implications

Katrine Jakobsen, Henrik Kleven, Jonas Kolsrud, Camille Landais and Mathilde Muñoz · American Economic Review, 2026 · 个人

估计富人的国际迁移对财富税的反应，主要依据 2007 年瑞典废除财富税这一事件，并用丹麦的两次财富税改革（1989 年和 1997 年）来验证迁出弹性、估计迁入反应。最高财富税率每提高一个百分点，富裕纳税人的存量约减少 2%。瑞典的事件研究显示，富有的所有者移居国外后其企业会收缩，但对就业、投资和增加值的总体影响很小。

数据
Denmark (validation and in-migration analysis only): wealth and income registers based on Danish Tax Agency (SKAT) tax returns, with year-end third-party and self-reported wealth components, Denmark: CPR-based citizenship and migration records with daily dates of entry and exit, Denmark: longitudinal register data on earnings, transfers and demographics, 1989–2006, Sweden (main analysis, not Danish): wealth tax register (Förmögenhetsregistret) 1993–2007, LISA, RAMS employer-employee data, K10 closely-held firm ownership files, firm financial accounts and migration registers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：按财富排名划分的迁出率和迁入率
  • 处理（丹麦）：1989 年财富税率由 2.2% 降至 1%，1997 年废除财富税；财富最高 1% 与最高 5–2.5% 的比较
  • 处理（瑞典）：2007 年废除财富税
  • 估计对象：迁移率对财富税后留存率的半弹性
  • 结果变量（仅瑞典）：迁出的富有所有者所持企业的就业、投资、增加值和税收
时期
丹麦：迁出序列为 1980–2006 年，财富税年份为 1989–1996 年；瑞典：1993–2007 年的财富登记库，与截至 2017–2019 年的各登记库相链接
样本
所查资料中未注明 丹麦部分为 1989 年和 1997 年财富税改革前后财富分布最高 1% 的纳税人（处理组）以及介于最高 5% 与最高 2.5% 之间的纳税人（对照组）；主样本为全体瑞典家庭，重点关注财富最高的 2%。 来源
变量如何定义（4）
  • Danish wealth-tax reforms: treatment and control groups 样本界定与时间
    Out-of-sample validation of the Swedish estimates. In 1989 the marginal tax rate on wealth above the exemption threshold was reduced from 2.2% to 1%, phased in over three years; in 1997 the wealth tax was abolished. Individuals in the top 1% of the wealth distribution form the treatment group and individuals between the top 5% and top 2.5% form the control group; out-migration rates of the two groups are compared over 1980-2006 and semi-elasticities are estimated with the same specification (4) as for Sweden.
    登记库： Wealth tax register (SKAT tax returns), CPR migration records
    代码： Treated: top 1% of wealth; controls: top 5% to top 2.5%; reforms 1989 and 1997
    工作论文 · Section 5.3 and footnote 32; Appendix V.2 and Figure V.6
  • Danish wealth data 财富、负债与消费
    Wealth and income registries are based on tax return data from the Danish Tax Agency (SKAT), stated at the end of the year. Most components are third-party reported (cash value of real estate, deposits, bonds, shares). Until 1997 self-reported components subject to auditing are also observed: value of listed and non-listed stocks, durables (cars, boats, caravans), share certificates for housing cooperatives, premium bonds and cash holdings. Liabilities include debt in financial institutions, mortgage credit debt, credit and debit card debt, student debt and other liabilities. After 1997 the asset statement is based solely on third-party reporting. Closely-held businesses and unlisted shares are not observed, so firm outcomes of migrants cannot be tracked in Denmark.
    登记库： Wealth tax register (SKAT tax returns)
    工作论文 · Appendix II.3 and Appendix Table II.1; footnote 24
  • Out-migration and in-migration rates by wealth 移民身份与来源地
    Citizenship and migration information with daily dates of entry and exit comes from the CPR; individuals must register their move to the CPR office to stop paying taxes in Denmark. For out-migration rates, individuals are ranked by household net wealth in year t and the fraction who out-migrate in t+1 is computed for each wealth fractile; for in-migration rates, individuals are ranked by household net wealth in year t and the fraction who in-migrated in t-1 is computed. Descriptive statistics for Denmark cover 1989-1996, when the wealth tax was still in place. Wealth of arrivals is measured consistently before and after the reforms, which is why in-migration elasticities are estimated on Danish data.
    登记库： CPR migration records, Wealth tax register (SKAT tax returns)
    代码： Denmark: 1989-1996
    工作论文 · Section 3.2 and notes to Figure 2; Section 5.4; Appendix II.3
  • Danish wealth tax 税收与税率
    Annual progressive wealth tax levied from 1903 to 1997 on Danish tax residents with net taxable wealth above an exemption threshold, which was always above the 98th percentile of the wealth distribution in the study period. Taxable wealth was total household net wealth excluding pension wealth: cash, deposits, bonds, equities, housing, large durables and business assets, net of debts. Wealth above the threshold was taxed at a flat 2.2% until the rate was cut to 1% after 1989; the tax was repealed in 1997. Unlike in Sweden, business assets were included in the base (with valuation reliefs for physical business assets), and a tax ceiling capped the wealth tax as a fraction of taxable income.
    代码： 2.2% above the exemption threshold; 1% after 1989; repealed 1997
    工作论文 · Section 2.2; Appendix I.2 and Appendix Table II.1

Fertility and Family Labor Supply

Katrine Jakobsen, Thomas H. Jørgensen and Hamish Low · American Economic Review (forthcoming), 2026 · 个人

利用 2009 年丹麦税制改革，表明女性税后净工资提高会降低生育，而男性工资提高则会提高生育。基于登记数据估计的一个夫妻选择生育时点和子女数量的生命周期模型表明，允许生育作出调整会大幅提高女性劳动供给的反应程度，而生育前后的人力资本折旧在很大程度上造成了长期的性别工资差距。

数据
Monthly payroll records (BFL/eIndkomst), Annual income tax data (IND), Population and family register (BEF), family definitions and parent links, Education register (UDDA), Labour market experience from ATP payments, Parental leave spell register (OF)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：生育（出生）
  • 处理：2009–2018 年税制改革带来的边际税后净工资率变化
  • 结果变量：劳动力市场参与、兼职与全职工作（根据工资单工时）
  • 结果变量：年度劳动收入
  • 控制变量：教育（高技能对较低技能）、劳动力市场经验
时期
2004–2018 年（税收样本 2004–2018 年；估计样本 2010–2018 年）
样本
10,851,444 个个人—年份观测值（估计样本）；2,531,181 个（税收样本） 25–60 岁、有异性伴侣的丹麦个人，不含学生、自雇者、退休者和领取残疾养老金者；税收样本限于 25–40 岁的同居或已婚女性。 来源
变量如何定义（11）
  • Labour market participation, part-time and full-time work 就业与劳动力状态
    Participation means at least 481 annual hours (e.g. 37 hours for 13 weeks) on BFL pay slips together with annual income of at least 50,000 DKK; part time is 481-1,664 annual hours; full time is more than 1,664 hours. Monthly hours and income are scaled down by the share of the month registered on parental leave in the OF register.
    登记库： BFL (eIndkomst), OF
    代码： thresholds 481 and 1,664 annual hours; 50,000 DKK
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Annual labour income (BFL) 劳动收入与收入
    12-month sum of monthly labour income from BFL pay slips, by calendar year for age profiles and centred on the birth month for event-study moments (e.g. income from January-February before a March birth counts as year -1); excludes income registered while on parental leave; deflated by CPI, in 1000 DKK. Estimation sample 2010-2018.
    登记库： BFL (eIndkomst), OF
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Personal income (tax sample) 劳动收入与收入
    Personal income from annual tax data: labour income from wage work, profits from own firms and labour market transfers; deflated by CPI.
    登记库： IND
    代码： PERINDKP
    工作论文 · Supplemental Material A
  • Couples / partners 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Partners follow Statistics Denmark's family definition, including married and cohabiting couples; cohabitants are two adults at the same address registered as parents to a child, or two opposite-sex adults with an age difference under 15 years at the same address. Constructed from EFALLE in BEF; couple age is the woman's age. Estimation sample keeps couples with at most five years age difference.
    登记库： BEF
    代码： EFALLE; FOED_DAG; KOEN
    工作论文 · Section 2, footnote 8; Supplemental Material A
  • High skilled vs less skilled 教育与考试成绩
    High skilled if at least 180 months of education (at least a bachelor's degree), measured as the highest degree earned in the sample period; less skilled otherwise.
    登记库： UDDA
    代码： HFPRIA >= 180 months
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Labour market experience 就业与劳动力状态
    Statistics Denmark's experience measure based on accumulated mandatory ATP pension payments, which depend on hours worked; part-time employment counts as 2/3 of full time.
    登记库： IDAP
    代码： ERHVER, ERHVER79
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Sample exclusions by main activity 样本界定与时间
    Individuals aged 25-60 with an opposite-sex partner; observations dropped if mainly student, self-employed, retired or on disability pension, based on main activity at end of November.
    登记库： IDAP/AKM (socio-economic status)
    代码： SOCSTIL, SOCSTIL_KODE
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Mechanical net-of-tax rate change (instrument) 税收与税率
    Four-year mechanical change log(1 - tau_{t+4}(z_t)) - log(1 - tau_t(z_t)) in the marginal net-of-tax rate, holding income and characteristics at year-t values, computed with a Danish tax simulator; used to instrument own and partner net-of-tax rate changes and virtual income. Restricted to couples where both have personal income of 50,000-600,000 DKK in the base year. Outcome is the 4-year difference in number of children born.
    登记库： IND
    工作论文 · Section 3; Supplemental Material A.1
  • Household wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Bank deposits, bonds, stocks and property net of loans and mortgages at end of year; registered property values raised by 10% (following Leth-Petersen 2010); deflated by CPI, in 1000 DKK.
    登记库： IND
    代码： FORM; FORMREST_NY05 (after 1996)
    工作论文 · Supplemental Material A
  • Child linkage and age of children 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Children and their ages are linked to parents through the parent identifiers in BEF; almost all children can be linked to a mother.
    登记库： BEF
    在线附录 · Supplemental Material, Data Appendix (p. S2)
  • Estimation sample vs tax sample 样本界定与时间
    Two samples: the BFL estimation sample of all individuals aged 25-60 with partners, 2010-2018; and the tax sample of women aged 25-40 with partners, 2004-2018 (used with personal income PERINDKP). Both split by less skilled vs high skilled.
    登记库： BFL (eIndkomst), IND, BEF
    在线附录 · Supplemental Material, Table A.1

Taxing the Wealth of the Poor: Evidence from the Danish Old-Age Support Asset Test

Niels Johannesen, Johan Sæverud and Emmanuel Saez · AER: Insights, 2026 · 个人

丹麦老年补助的资产审查使符合条件者的流动资产在略低于门槛处形成分散但规模很大的超额质量（相对于可比的不符合条件群体而言）。出生队列分析表明，这一审查使门槛附近的流动资产减少约 20%；高频银行数据显示，这些反应是永久性的，而非围绕审查日期所作的时点调整。

数据
Administrative registers on assets, income and demographics (Statistics Denmark): third-party reported and self-reported liquid wealth, Danske Bank customer data: monthly spending, cash withdrawals and account balances (2014–2016)
关键变量
  • 驱动变量：流动财富相对于老年补助（old-age check）资产审查门槛的位置
  • 结果变量：流动财富在门槛下方的聚束 / 超额质量
  • 结果变量：年末支出与现金提取（银行数据）
  • 资格条件：65 岁及以上且低收入
时期
2014–2018 年（主要截面）；银行数据为 2014–2016 年
样本
60 岁及以上单身者 2,526,421 个观测值（65 岁及以上 2,054,987 个；低收入 65 岁及以上 1,283,721 个），为 2014–2018 年混合数据；银行样本 461,471 个观测值，2014–2016 年 丹麦 60 岁及以上的单身者，其中链接的 Danske Bank 子样本约占老年人口的 20%。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Default liquid wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Third-party-reported year-end value of current accounts, savings accounts and securities accounts (bank deposits and listed securities); excludes durables, real estate and pension accounts and does not net out debt. Available for the full population; mirrors the 'default wealth' the authorities use for the old-age check asset test.
    登记库： IND, Statistics Denmark administrative wealth registers
    论文正文 · Section I.A and I.C; Table 1 notes; Figure 1 notes
  • Reported liquid wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Default liquid wealth plus self-reported corrections submitted via the government website (e.g. adding cash, reducing account balances); available only for individuals above the statutory retirement age. The variable available to the authors does not capture corrections made close to year-end.
    登记库： SOCP, IND
    论文正文 · Section I.A and I.C; Table 1 notes
  • Total wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Default liquid wealth plus pension wealth and housing wealth, net of liabilities (approximates total net wealth for the low-income elderly).
    登记库： IND, PENSFORM
    论文正文 · Figure 1 notes (panel B)
  • Old-age check eligibility (age and income) 退休与养老金
    Age-eligible = aged 65 or older (statutory retirement age in the sample period). Low-income (income-eligible) = income, net of social security and before self-reported corrections, below the threshold at which the old-age check is fully phased out (disregard DKK 42,000, phase-out rate 34% for singles in 2020). Asset test: check lost entirely when liquid wealth at end of t-1 exceeds DKK 90,000 (2020 value; threshold raised 15% in 2010). For the 2001-2007 reform analysis the 2003 income threshold is applied throughout.
    登记库： IND, SOCP, BEF
    论文正文 · Section I.A; Figure 1 and 2 notes; Supplemental Appendix Figure A.4 notes
  • Treatment and control groups for bunching 样本界定与时间
    Treated: low-income singles aged 65+. Controls: low-income singles aged 60-64 (age-ineligible) and singles aged 65+ with incomes between 150% and 200% of the full phase-out income threshold. Sample restricted to singles; main cross-section pools 2014-2018 (2014-2016 for bank data).
    登记库： BEF, IND
    论文正文 · Section I.C (Sample); Figure 1 notes (panel C)
  • Excess mass below asset-test threshold 财富、负债与消费
    Panel version: dummy for default liquid wealth between 50% and 100% of the asset-test threshold regressed on age dummies and individual fixed effects for low-income elderly born 1941-1945, coefficients relative to age 64; bunching jumps by 2.5 points at eligibility age 65 and keeps rising with age. Liquid wealth inflated to 2020 values with the growth rate of the asset-test threshold; DKK 5,000 bins.
    登记库： IND, BEF
    代码： 50%-100% of threshold window; reference age 64
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix, Figure A.3 notes
  • Cohort-approach counterfactual 样本界定与时间
    For single income-eligible individuals born 1941-1945, compare the indexed liquid wealth distribution at ages 70-74 (five to nine years into eligibility) with ages 60-64 (before eligibility); only those income-eligible in a given year are included (unbalanced panel).
    登记库： IND, BEF
    论文正文 · Section II (Cohort Approach); Table 1 Panel B2 notes
  • Bank liquid wealth, spending and cash withdrawals 财富、负债与消费
    Bank data 2014-2016 used to compare spending and changes in consumer debt in December, January and other months by bank liquid wealth (DKK 5,000 bins), for age-eligible (65+) low-income singles vs age-ineligible (60-64) low-income singles.
    登记库： Danske Bank customer data
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix, Figure A.4 notes
  • Old-age check parameters and indexation 退休与养老金
    Old-age check (created 2003) parameters expressed in 2020 values by inflating with the index used to adjust tax and transfer parameters (tied to average wage earnings per worker; $1 = 6.53 DKK in 2020). Maximum check raised above indexation in 2005, 2007, 2009 and 2013; asset-test threshold raised about 15% above indexation in 2010; income test (phase-out start and end thresholds) very strict initially but unchanged in real terms since 2005 except a small increase in 2019.
    登记库： Tax-transfer rules
    代码： $1 = 6.53 DKK (2020)
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix, Figure A.1 notes

Micro versus Macro Labor Supply Elasticities: The Role of Dynamic Returns to Effort

Henrik Kleven, Claus Thustrup Kreiner, Kristian Larsen and Jakob Egholt Søgaard · American Economic Review, 2025 · 个人

构建一个今天的努力会提高明天劳动收入的模型，因此对税收的反应存在滞后，并通过工作转换来传导。丹麦行政数据证实了模型关于劳动收入和工时的生命周期预测；基于工作转换者的准实验设计发现，长期劳动收入弹性约为 0.5，而短期弹性约为 0.2。

数据
Linked administrative registers on earnings, occupation (DISCO), firm and demographics, full population, Employer-employee matched data (firm x occupation job cells), ATP pension contribution-based hours measure (1980–2018), Monthly uncapped hours measure (from 2008), Income tax records (2009 tax reform variation)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：劳动收入（对数劳动收入的变化）
  • 处理：2009 年税制改革带来的边际税后留存率变化
  • 工具变量：按基期收入模拟的税后留存率变化
  • 中介变量：工作转换（企业 × 职业单元），包括大规模裁员引致的转换
  • 结果变量：工作小时数
时期
1980–2018
样本
主要弹性回归中 N = 2,501,126 和 2,428,411（表 1） 丹麦全体人口；税制改革分析使用基期收入在 250,000 至 1,000,000 DKK 之间的纳税人。 来源
变量如何定义（12）
  • ATP-based hours (1980-2018) 工作时间
    Hours inferred from mandatory ATP pension contributions, which employers pay based on a binned measure of hours; for monthly-paid workers annual contributions depend on monthly hours in four bins, giving 37 annual hours bins. Capped at full time in all 12 months.
    登记库： ATP pension contributions
    工作论文 · Section 3, footnotes 17-18
  • Monthly uncapped hours (from 2008) 工作时间
    Uncapped hours worked for all workers at monthly level, available from 2008; used where precise hours variation is needed (aggregated to quarters in the promotion event study).
    登记库： Monthly payroll records
    工作论文 · Section 3; Section 4 Fact 3
  • Job (firm x occupation cell) and job switch 职业与职位层级
    Job is a firm x occupation cell; a switcher moves between firm x occupation cells after the reform. Occupations use DISCO-08 from 2010 (563 occupations), DISCO-88 1991-2009 (372) bridged with the Humlum (2021) crosswalk, and an older Danish classification before 1991 (299). Switches where more than 50% of an individual's coworkers move to the same job cell in the same year are dropped.
    登记库： Employer-employee matched data
    代码： DISCO-08; DISCO-88; pre-1991 Danish occupation codes
    工作论文 · Section 3, footnote 15; Section 5.1
  • Mass layoff switchers 企业特征与生产率
    Mass layoffs are layoffs in which firms with at least 20 employees reduce their workforce by at least 30% in a single year; switchers are workers who move firm following such a layoff. Used in an event study of log earnings vs a linear pre-layoff trend.
    登记库： Employer-employee matched data
    代码： firm size >= 20 employees; workforce reduction >= 30% within one year
    在线附录 · Online Appendix, Figure A.8 notes
  • Labour earnings outcome 劳动收入与收入
    Total labour compensation, including contributions to employer-administered retirement savings plans; outcome is the log change between 2008 and 2010 (placebo 2006-2008).
    登记库： Income tax records
    工作论文 · Section 5.1, footnote 26
  • Reform treatment and simulated net-of-tax rate instrument 税收与税率
    Treatment assigned by pre-reform baseline taxable income (labour income, transfers, pensions, alimony and certain capital income) in bins relative to the 2009 reform threshold (around the 70th percentile). The instrument is the simulated log change in the marginal net-of-tax rate from tax code changes, holding income at baseline (Gruber-Saez). Baseline sample: taxpayers with baseline income 250,000-1,000,000 DKK.
    登记库： Income tax records
    工作论文 · Section 5.1, footnote 27; Table 2 notes
  • Promotion 职业与职位层级
    Within-firm switch to an occupation cell whose median earnings are at least 10% higher (robustness 5% and 20%); promoted workers matched to unpromoted co-workers in the same firm.
    登记库： Employer-employee matched data, Monthly payroll records
    工作论文 · Section 4, Fact 3
  • Occupational rank / top vs bottom occupations 职业与职位层级
    Occupation cells (6-digit occupation codes) ranked by mean wage earnings; for top/bottom occupations the ranking is computed among workers aged 45-50 (mean, P10 and P90 of wage earnings reported per cell). Occupational rank used in balance checks orders occupation cells by their mean earnings.
    登记库： Employer-employee matched data (DISCO occupation codes)
    代码： 6-digit DISCO occupation codes
    在线附录 · Online Appendix, Table A.1 and Figure A.6 notes
  • AKM firm wage premium 企业特征与生产率
    Firm fixed effects from an AKM model log z_it = alpha_i + psi_J(i,t) + X_it beta + nu_it, with controls for year, age and tenure-in-current-firm dummies, estimated on pre-reform data 2002-2005 for firms with at least 10 employees; estimated firm effects merged onto the 2009 tax-reform sample to measure changes in firm premia for firm switchers.
    登记库： Employer-employee matched data, Income tax records
    代码： firms >= 10 employees; estimation window 2002-2005
    在线附录 · Online Appendix, Section C and Figure A.9
  • Survey hours (LFS validation) 工作时间
    Validation measure of hours: actual, uncapped hours worked from the Danish component of the EU Labour Force Survey, compared with the administrative ATP pension-based hours measure; the survey measure is much noisier, especially at the top.
    登记库： Danish Labour Force Survey (AKU), ATP pension contributions
    在线附录 · Online Appendix, Figure A.1 notes
  • Number of job switches (ages 20-50) 职业与职位层级
    Count of job (firm x occupation cell) switches between ages 20 and 50 in a balanced panel of workers observed at every age 20-50, split by earnings percentile at age 50 (top 10%, top 1%, bottom 50%).
    登记库： Employer-employee matched data
    在线附录 · Online Appendix, Figure A.3 notes

The Division of Parental Leave: Empirical Evidence and Policy Design

Thomas Høgholm Jørgensen and Jakob Egholt Søgaard · Journal of Public Economics, 2024 · 个人

利用丹麦育儿假津贴制度中的强激励和约 190,000 例生育的数据，估计父母对休假的支付意愿。父母在拐点处聚束，并且愿意为父亲休假很少的传统分工付出代价；模拟表明，专属假期与高替代率相结合时效果要好得多。

数据
Parental leave benefit spell data (parents of children born 2008–2015), incl. benefits paid to parent or employer, Monthly earnings records for all employees (BFL/eIndkomst), from 2008, Danish administrative registers on demographics, family links and firm links (population and labour market registers)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：出生后三年内母亲和父亲各自休的育儿假周数
  • 激励：个人津贴替代率和津贴上限在家庭预算集上形成的拐点
  • 激励：雇主提供的全额工资补偿（根据支付给雇主的津贴识别）
  • 政策：结构模型中关于专属假期（父亲配额）和替代率的反事实模拟
时期
2008–2015 年的生育
样本
189,974 例生育 2008–2015 年的生育，父母就业稳定且在生育前三个月内未领取与生育无关的公共福利，不含 15 个月内又生育下一个孩子的情形。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Weeks of parental leave 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Total number of parental leave weeks computed from start and end dates of benefit spells in the parental leave spell data (children born 2008-2015); includes all full-time leave taken at most three years after childbirth, separately for mother and father.
    登记库： Parental leave benefit spell data, BFL/eIndkomst
    工作论文 · Section 3.2 (Data)
  • Individual benefit replacement rate 失业与福利金
    Computed from total parental leave benefits paid out per parent-child spell relative to weeks of leave; statutory benefits replace 100% of pre-birth earnings for a full-time (37 hours/week) employee up to a cap of EUR 580 per week (2019 level), scaled down proportionally for part-time.
    登记库： Parental leave benefit spell data
    工作论文 · Sections 2 and 3.2, footnote 11
  • Weeks with full wage compensation 失业与福利金
    Weeks of leave with employer-provided full wage compensation, computed from the amount of parental leave benefits paid to the employer (benefits are paid to the employer as reimbursement when it pays full wage) using the individual replacement rate.
    登记库： Parental leave benefit spell data
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Imputed individual right to wage compensation 失业与福利金
    Public sector: imputed from collective-agreement rules (6-6-6 model, Apr 2008-Apr 2015: 6 weeks each parent plus 6 shared weeks if both parents work in the same public sub-sector, otherwise the shared 6 accrue to the public-sector parent) using both parents' employment sector. Private sector: equals observed compensated weeks for parents who also take uncompensated leave (exhausters); otherwise the mode of compensated weeks among exhausting co-workers with weakly higher compensation, with co-worker groups defined as firm-year cells, or 6-digit then 5-digit industry-year cells when fewer than two exhausting co-workers exist.
    登记库： Parental leave benefit spell data, employer-employee links
    工作论文 · Section 3.3, eq. (11), Table 3
  • Birth sample 样本界定与时间
    Births 2008-2015; parents must be continuously employed in the same firm in the 3 months before birth and not on non-birth-related public benefits during those 3 months; births are excluded if parents have a subsequent child within 15 months; parents must appear in the parental leave data (final sample 189,974 births).
    登记库： BEF, BFL/eIndkomst, Parental leave benefit spell data
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, Table 1 and notes

Dynamic effects of tax audits and the role of intentions

Tobias Gabel Christiansen · Journal of Public Economics, 2024 · 个人

研究针对自雇者的随机税务稽查如何改变其后的纳税遵从，以及这是否取决于被查出的错报是否出于故意。文章采用交错双重差分设计，把已被稽查的纳税人与尚未被稽查的纳税人相比较。非故意的不遵从者此后缴纳更多税款，五年后累计达到稽查调整额的 340%，而故意逃税者没有反应；若根据稽查前预测反应程度的风险评分来选择稽查对象，税收收益将提高 87%。

数据
Danish Tax Agency random audit programme for the self-employed, audit waves 2006–2017 (more than 17,000 audited tax returns), Auditors' (compliance officers') recorded assessments of the severity of non-compliance and the taxpayer's perceived willingness to comply, Administrative tax records on tax payments before and after the audit (registers not named in the abstract or the author's summary)
关键变量
  • 处理：随机税务稽查（已被稽查与尚未被稽查的纳税人对比）
  • 异质性：非故意与故意的不遵从，依据稽查人员的评估
  • 结果变量：其后的纳税额，五年累计值相对于稽查调整额
  • 稽查对象选择：基于稽查前信息的风险评分（用 2006–2012 年的稽查训练，在 2014–2017 年的稽查上检验）
时期
随机稽查实施于 2006–2017 年；在围绕稽查时点的 10 年窗口内追踪纳税额
样本
超过 17,000 份被随机稽查的纳税申报表（据摘要所述；确切数目未经核实） 被丹麦税务局（Danish Tax Agency）选中接受随机稽查的丹麦自雇者。 来源（摘要）
变量如何定义（2）
  • Unintentional versus intentional non-compliers 税收与税率
    Taxpayers are classified using information provided by the auditors on their perceived willingness to comply. Unintentional non-compliers are those whose misreporting is driven by inattention or misunderstandings of the tax rules; intentional non-compliers deliberately evade taxes and are the group typically targeted for operational audits.
    登记库： Danish Tax Agency random audit records
    已发表论文 · Abstract (full text not accessible; abstract read on the University of Copenhagen research portal)
  • Random audit sample of the self-employed 样本界定与时间
    A random audit program covering more than 17,000 tax returns of self-employed taxpayers; the effect of an audit on subsequent compliance is followed for five years after the audit.
    登记库： Danish Tax Agency random audit records

Estimating Labor Supply Responses to Danish Tax Reforms

Hans Schytte Sigaard · Journal of Public Economics, 2023 · 个人

把应税收入弹性的估计方法应用于实际工作小时的登记数据。集约边际上的劳动供给弹性约为 0.08，与劳动收入弹性和应税收入弹性接近；这一反应来自合同工时和带薪缺勤的变化，以及主业与副业之间的转换。

数据
Wage Statistics Register (Lønstatistikken, LON) for performed hours of work, Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDAN) for workplace controls, Income registers (IND, INDK, INPI) for marginal tax rate simulation, Population register (BEF) and family income register (FAIN), Family register (FAMILIE), Education register (UDDA), Danish tax simulation programs (Kleven and Schultz 2014, extended by the Ministry of Finance)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：年实际工作小时数的三年对数变化
  • 处理：劳动收入边际税后留存率的三年对数变化
  • 工具变量：税制改革引起的边际税率的机械（模拟）变化，用滞后收入计算
  • 次要结果变量：劳动收入和应税收入
  • 控制变量：收入样条、社会经济特征和市镇控制变量
时期
2002–2016
样本
10,755,733 个观测值 被 Wage Statistics Register（工资统计登记库）覆盖的 25–65 岁受雇工薪者，在每个三年差分的两个年份工时均为正，且基年劳动收入高于 DKK 250,000。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Performed hours of work 工作时间
    Contract hours plus paid overtime, minus paid absence, vacation and weekday holiday hours, summed over all employments in a year per individual (including secondary jobs). Contract hours are available from 2002, so the sample covers 2002-2016. LON covers all public firms and private firms with 100+ employees, plus a sample of private firms with 10-99 employees (about 50% of main employments).
    登记库： LON (Lønstatistikken)
    论文正文 · Section 4 (Data), eq. (5); Appendix A.1
  • Three-year log change in performed hours 工作时间
    Main outcome: log change in annual performed hours between base year t and t+3. Strictly positive hours are required in both years. Decompositions condition on staying in the same job versus switching jobs between t and t+3.
    登记库： LON
    论文正文 · Section 3, eq. (1); Section 5.1, Tables 3-4
  • Marginal tax rate on labour income 税收与税率
    Simulated using tax programs from Kleven and Schultz (2014), extended by the Danish Ministry of Finance (available 1984-2016), as [T_t(z+100) - T_t(z)]/100, with income information mainly from IND, INDK and INPI. The treatment is the three-year log change in the marginal net-of-tax rate.
    登记库： IND, INDK, INPI
    论文正文 · Section 4 (Data)
  • Predicted (mechanical) change in net-of-tax rate instrument 税收与税率
    ln(1 - T'_{t+s}(z_{i,t-k})) - ln(1 - T'_t(z_{i,t-k})): marginal rates under the period t+s and t tax systems evaluated at income lagged k periods, following Weber (2014). The main specification uses k = 2, with lags 2-4 used for overidentification tests.
    登记库： IND, INDK, INPI
    论文正文 · Section 3.1.1, eq. (2); Section 3.2
  • Lagged income controls 劳动收入与收入
    Ten-piece spline with breakpoints at the deciles of log labour income lagged twice, to control for mean reversion and heterogeneous income trends.
    登记库： IND, INDK
    论文正文 · Section 3.1
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Individuals aged 25-65 with all information needed to simulate marginal taxes, who are neither jobless nor outside the labour force as primary occupation at end of November in year t, and have strictly positive hours at t and t+3. Base-year labour income must exceed DKK 250,000 (2015 prices, CPI-deflated) and all controls must be non-missing.
    登记库： LON, IDAN, BEF, IND
    论文正文 · Section 4 (Data), Table A.1
  • Workplace, socioeconomic and family controls 企业特征与生产率
    Workplace controls from IDAN, socioeconomic and municipal controls from BEF and FAIN, children from FAMILIE, and education from UDDA; industry groups follow Statistics Denmark's standard groupings.
    登记库： IDAN, BEF, FAIN, FAMILIE, UDDA
    论文正文 · Section 4 (Data); Section 3.1 footnote 6

The Disparate Effects of Information Provision: A Field Experiment on the Work Incentives of Social Welfare

Sofie Cairo and Robert Mahlstedt · Journal of Public Economics, 2023 · 个人

丹麦的一项田野实验向福利金领取者告知最低工作要求，方式或是提供其已累计工时的个性化动态统计，或是只说明一般性规则。个性化信息提高了工时尚未达标者的就业，而一般性通知则降低了近期受制裁风险较低者的劳动供给。

数据
Field experiment assignment and messaging data (Danish public employment service, jobnet.dk online tool), Population registers (socio-demographic background), Benefit payment records (DREAM), Monthly income and employment records (eIndkomst/BFL), Public employment service data on sanctions, exemptions, collected working hours, click data and registered job applications
关键变量
  • 处理：随机分配使用个性化在线信息工具，该工具提示在工作要求下福利金被削减的风险（三个实验组）
  • 结果变量：就业和劳动收入
  • 结果变量：福利金领取以及转向其他收入支持
  • 结果变量：为满足要求而累计的工作小时数以及求职申请
  • 异质性：求职活动和受制裁风险
时期
干预自 2018 年 8 月 15 日开始，最多发送五次月度提醒
样本
47,294 人 2018 年 8 月 15 日适用 225 小时工作要求、且已收到官方通知信的全部丹麦福利金领取者。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • 225-hour work requirement / sanction 失业与福利金
    After 12 months on welfare benefits within the last three years, recipients keep the full benefit only if they worked at least 225 hours in regular non-subsidised jobs in the previous 12 months. Otherwise the benefit is reduced by about DKK 500-1,000 per month depending on family status; after a sanction the hour count resets to zero. Caseworkers may grant exemptions to those unable to work at least five hours a week.
    登记库： Public employment service data (sanctions, exemptions, collected hours)
    工作论文 · Section 2
  • Experimental sample and treatment arms 样本界定与时间
    All welfare benefit recipients in stock on 15 August 2018 who were subject to the work requirement and had received the official notification letter (N = 47,294), randomised into three arms. Treated: up to six monthly messages plus access to the personalised online tool on jobnet.dk. Control I: general reminders only. Control II: neither.
    登记库： Experimental data (jobnet.dk)
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1-3.2, Table 1 notes
  • Cumulated job finding rate, hours and earnings 就业与劳动力状态
    Cumulated job finding rates by month since the intervention (extensive margin), and total working hours and labour earnings accumulated over the first 12 months after the start (intensive margin), from monthly income and employment records.
    登记库： E-income (eIndkomst)
    工作论文 · Section 4.2, Figure 3, Table 3
  • Full-time vs part-time job 工作时间
    Full-time jobs have average weekly working hours at or above 90% of the full-time equivalent (37 hours per week); part-time jobs are below that.
    登记库： E-income (eIndkomst)
    工作论文 · Section 4.2, Table 3 note (a)
  • Entering other transfer program 失业与福利金
    Indicator that the individual receives any other benefit not subject to the work requirement, such as educational support, sickness or disability benefits.
    登记库： DREAM
    工作论文 · Section 4.3
  • Active vs inactive job seeker 失业与福利金
    Active job seekers have a positive number of collected working hours at the onset of the intervention, or at least one job application registered in the public employment service portal in the last four weeks; all others are inactive.
    登记库： Public employment service data (collected hours, job applications)
    工作论文 · Section 4.4
  • Local counselling intensity 地理与社区
    Average number of caseworker meetings per recipient in the municipality in the six months before the intervention, split at the median. A residualised version conditions on observable characteristics.
    登记库： Public employment service data

Externalities in International Tax Enforcement: Theory and Evidence

Thomas Tørsløv, Ludvig Wier and Gabriel Zucman · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2023 · 企业

作者认为，高税率国家的税务机关打击向避税地转移利润的激励较弱，转而去调整与其他高税率国家之间的交易，因为这类案件更容易胜诉。丹麦税务机关全部转让定价调整的案件层面数据显示，约 82% 的调整金额涉及其他高税率国家，因此这些调整增加了丹麦的税收，同时略微降低了企业的全球税负。跨国调查和争议统计数据显示出同样的规律，一个税收执法模型可以解释这一规律。

数据
Danish tax authority internal confidential micro-data: universe of transfer price corrections initiated in 2009, 2014 and 2015, with the demanded increase in the tax base and the counterpart countries, Danish data on completed Mutual Agreement Procedures, 2008–2015 (cannot be linked to the corrections at case level), Danish court appeals of transfer price corrections, 2011–2016, ORBIS (Bureau van Dijk) links between Danish multinational entities and their foreign related parties, used as a random-audit benchmark, Cross-country aggregates (not Danish): EY 2014 transfer pricing tax authority survey of 26 economies, EU Joint Transfer Pricing Forum and OECD Mutual Agreement Procedure statistics, Statutory tax rates (KPMG) and effective tax rates and profit-shifting estimates from Tørsløv et al. (2020)
关键变量
  • 单位：转让定价调整案件（要求调增的税基、对方国家）
  • 关键指标：税率差，即丹麦公司税率减去对方国家公司税率
  • 结果变量：涉及避税地与涉及其他高税率国家的调整所占份额（按件数和按欧元金额计）
  • 结果变量：隐含的丹麦及国外税收收入变动
  • 结果变量：企业就哪些调整向法院提起上诉
  • 异质性：总部设在丹麦的跨国公司与外国跨国公司的丹麦子公司
时期
2009 年和 2014–2015 年（调整）；2008–2015 年（相互协商程序，Mutual Agreement Procedures）；2011–2016 年（法院上诉）
样本
2009 年、2014 年和 2015 年启动的 185 项转让定价调整，平均每年 62 项（第 4.1 节和表 1） 丹麦税务机关在 2009 年、2014 年和 2015 年对跨国公司启动的全部转让定价调整；未导致调整的稽查无法观测到。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Universe of Danish transfer price corrections 样本界定与时间
    Internal confidential micro-data on the universe of transfer price corrections undertaken by the Danish tax authority for 2009 and 2014-15, the only years for which comprehensive data are available. Corrections involve transfer prices of goods and services, debt shifting, intra-group sales of intangibles and abuses of double-tax treaties. The data include the increase in the tax base demanded and the names of the counterpart countries. The ultimate outcome of cases is not tracked, and audits that did not result in any correction are not observed.
    登记库： Danish tax authority internal transfer pricing case data
    代码： Years 2009, 2014 and 2015; 185 corrections in total
    工作论文 · Section 4.1 and footnote 6
  • Auxiliary Mutual Agreement Procedure and court-appeal data 样本界定与时间
    Because final outcomes are not tracked in the corrections data, it is supplemented with data on completed Mutual Agreement Procedures covering 2008-15 and data on court appeals covering 2011-16. These sources could not be linked at the micro level, so a case cannot be followed from start to finish. The final outcome of court appeals is not observed.
    登记库： Danish tax authority internal transfer pricing case data
    代码： Mutual Agreement Procedures 2008-2015; court appeals 2011-2016
    工作论文 · Sections 4.1 and 4.1.3
  • Tax rate differential 税收与税率
    Danish corporate tax rate less the counterpart country's tax rate, using statutory rates from KPMG (2018); robustness versions use effective tax rates from Tørsløv et al. (2020). The benchmark for random audits is the distribution of tax differentials between all Danish multinational entities (parents or subsidiaries) and their foreign related parties, built from ORBIS.
    登记库： Danish tax authority internal transfer pricing case data, ORBIS (Bureau van Dijk)
    工作论文 · Section 4.1.1; Figure 2 notes
  • Implied tax revenue impact of corrections 税收与税率
    Effect of the corrections on tax collection in Denmark and abroad if the corrections are fully realised, i.e. assuming they are not overturned in court or reduced in a Mutual Agreement Procedure and that profit increases in Denmark are matched by corresponding declines abroad. The decline in tax revenue abroad is computed with statutory tax rates for non-havens (KPMG 2018) and effective tax rates for havens (Tørsløv et al. 2020). Figures are averages for 2009, 2014 and 2015.
    登记库： Danish tax authority internal transfer pricing case data
    工作论文 · Table 1 notes
  • Tax haven 税收与税率
    Counterpart countries are classified as tax havens using the list in Tørsløv et al. (2020).
    代码： Belgium, Cyprus, Ireland, Netherlands, Hong Kong, Luxembourg, Malta, Marshall Islands, Puerto Rico, Switzerland, Singapore; smaller havens: Andorra, Anguilla, Antigua and Barbuda, Aruba, The Bahamas, Bahrain, Barbados, Belize, Bermuda, the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, Gibraltar, Grenada, Guernsey, the Isle of Man, Jersey, Lebanon, Liechtenstein, Macao, Mauritius, Monaco, the Netherlands Antilles, Panama, Samoa, Seychelles, St. Kitts and Nevis, St. Lucia, St. Vincent & Grenadines, Turks and Caicos, Vanuatu
    工作论文 · Footnote 7

Constraints on Hours within the Firm

Claudio Labanca and Dario Pozzoli · Journal of Labor Economics, 2022 · 个人 + 企业

利用含工时信息的丹麦雇主—雇员匹配数据，以及 2010 年丹麦税制改革带来的税率变化。在工时约束较紧的企业中，雇员在税负变化时并不调整工时；而在更灵活的企业中，雇员既直接作出反应，也通过同事的溢出效应作出反应。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Wage statistics with annual regular and overtime hours (Lønstatistikken, LON), Firm Statistics Register (Firmstat), Danish Foreign Trade Statistics Register, Firm-Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (FIDA), Danish Tax Register (income tax records), O*NET occupational data
关键变量
  • 结果变量：年工作小时数（正常工时加加班工时）
  • 处理：2010 年丹麦税制改革引起的模拟边际税率变化（2008–2011 年区间）
  • 调节变量：企业层面的工时约束／协调，以企业内部工时的离散程度衡量
  • 小时工资：年劳动收入除以总工时
  • 溢出效应：同事的税收变化
时期
2003–2011
样本
超过 400,000 名雇员和约 8,300 家企业（787,683 个个人—年观测值） 2003–2011 年私营企业中年龄 15–65 岁的全职雇员，所在企业至少 95% 的员工有工时报告（工作论文版本“Coordination of Hours within the Firm”，IZA DP 12062）。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Annual hours worked 工作时间
    Annual hours of regular plus overtime work from Lønstatistikken (LON), reported by employers whose pension contributions depend on hours. Only firms where hours are observed for at least 95 percent of the workforce are kept; for spells in week 48 shorter than a year, hours and earnings are annualized.
    登记库： LON, IDA, FIDA
    工作论文 · Section 3 (The data)
  • Hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Annual earnings divided by the sum of regular and overtime hours.
    登记库： IDA, LON
    工作论文 · Section 3
  • Employer link and full-time sample 样本界定与时间
    Each employee is matched to the highest-paying employer in the employment spell of week 48 (FIDA). Sample: full-time employees aged 15-65 in 2003-2011, full-time defined (official definition) as working more than an average of 26 weekly hours over a year, in private firms covered by Firmstat.
    登记库： FIDA, Firmstat, IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3
  • Hours coordination (dispersion of hours across skill groups) 工作时间
    Standard deviation across skill groups in a firm-year of the average annual (regular plus overtime) hours of each skill group; firm measure is its average over 2003-2011. Lower dispersion means greater coordination. Skill groups are deciles of the sum of the fixed and time-varying individual components of an AKM hourly-wage model; alternative: education (primary/secondary/tertiary) x occupation (manager/middle manager/blue collar) cells.
    登记库： LON, IDA
    工作论文 · Section 4.3, equation (9)
  • Simulated marginal tax rate 税收与税率
    Marginal tax rate on labour income simulated from the Danish Tax Register with an extension of the Kleven-Schultz (2014) tax simulator to 2006-2011: increase in tax liability from raising labour income by 100 DKK, holding other income components fixed. Changes are taken over the 2008-2011 interval.
    登记库： Danish Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 5.2
  • Mechanical net-of-tax rate change (instrument) 税收与税率
    Post-reform (2011) marginal tax rate simulated using pre-reform (2008) income adjusted for inflation; the log change in the marginal net-of-tax rate from this mechanical rate instruments the observed change. For spillovers, the firm average of mechanical changes among high-income workers instruments the change in their average hours.
    登记库： Danish Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 5.5
  • High- vs low-income workers 税收与税率
    Low-income: tax-exempt or in the bottom tax bracket in 2008. High-income: in the middle or top bracket in 2008, excluding a residual group in the top bracket in 2008 predicted (from 2008 real income and the post-reform schedule) to fall into the bottom bracket in 2011.
    登记库： Danish Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 5.1
  • Firm productivity 企业特征与生产率
    Value added per employee and TFP from Firmstat accounting data; in some specifications value added per employee is instrumented with TFP. Construction details are in an online appendix not included in the WP.
    登记库： Firmstat
    工作论文 · Section 4.1, footnote 15; Figure notes

Katrine Jakobsen and Jakob Egholt Søgaard · Journal of Public Economics, 2022 · 个人

指出利用税制改革估计应税收入弹性的标准做法会因均值回归以及收入分布不同位置上收入趋势的分化而产生偏误，并提出一种利用改革时点把行为反应与这些趋势区分开来的方法，应用于丹麦的税制改革。

数据
Danish administrative registers for the full population since 1980 (labour market history, education, earnings, demographics), Third-party reported income tax records, Simulated marginal tax rates from an extended Danish tax simulator (Kleven and Schultz 2014 model)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：四年期内应税收入（宽口径收入、个人收入、劳动收入）的变化
  • 处理：2004 年和 2009–10 年丹麦税制改革带来的对数税后留存率（net-of-tax rate）的预测变化
  • 收入区间虚拟变量，用于刻画收入分布不同位置上的趋势差异
  • 验证：收入分布中未受改革影响部分的收入趋势
时期
数据自 1980 年起；主要分析为 1999–2012 年（2004 年改革：改革前时期 1999–2003 年，改革时期 2003–2007 年；2009–10 年改革：改革前时期 2004–2008 年，改革时期 2008–2012 年）；1987 年和 1994 年改革见附录
样本
每个时期超过 2,000,000 人（2004 年改革的改革前时期和改革时期分别为 2,240,332 人和 2,295,922 人；2009–10 年改革分别为 2,097,862 人和 2,240,833 人） 在每个四年期内出现在税收数据中且收入为正、期初个人收入高于 DKK 200,000（2004 年改革）或 DKK 250,000（2009–10 年改革）的个人，约占丹麦成年人口的一半。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Labour market income (LI) 劳动收入与收入
    Salary, wages, honoraria, fees, bonuses, fringe benefits and business earnings, as defined in the Danish income tax system.
    登记库： Danish tax records
    论文正文 · Section 3.1, Table 1
  • Broad income (BI) 劳动收入与收入
    Labour market income plus transfers, certain pension payouts and received alimony; it equals personal income before deductions.
    登记库： Danish tax records
    论文正文 · Table 1; Fig. 3 notes
  • Personal income (PI) 劳动收入与收入
    Broad income minus the labour market contribution and certain pension contributions (employer-administered annuity pension contributions were fully deductible until 2010, then capped at DKK 100,000 for expiring annuities). PI is the main outcome and initial-income concept, and responses are also shown with and without pension contributions.
    登记库： Danish tax records
    论文正文 · Table 1; Section 3.1; footnote 21
  • Taxable income (TI) 劳动收入与收入
    Personal income plus capital income (interest, rental and business capital income minus interest on debt) minus itemized deductions (commuting, union fees, unemployment insurance contributions, other work expenses, charitable donations, paid alimony). Stock income is taxed separately.
    登记库： Danish tax records
    论文正文 · Table 1
  • Simulated marginal tax rate / predicted change in log net-of-tax rate 税收与税率
    Marginal tax rates are imputed with an extension of the Kleven and Schultz (2014) Danish tax simulator, as the increase in total household taxes from an incremental increase in labour income. The predicted change compares rates under the period-t and t-1 tax systems, holding income and characteristics fixed at their t-k levels (k = 1 baseline).
    登记库： Danish tax records
    论文正文 · Section 2 (eq. 5); Section 3.3
  • Reform and pre-reform period samples 样本界定与时间
    Four-year periods: 2004-08 (pre) and 2008-12 (reform) for the 2009-10 reform; initial years 1999 and 2003 for the 2004 reform. Individuals present in tax data with positive income over the period, and initial personal income above DKK 250,000 (2009-10 reform) or DKK 200,000 (2004 reform) at 2019 levels deflated by tax-code wage indexes.
    登记库： Danish tax records
    论文正文 · Section 3.3, Table 3
  • Initial income bin dummies 劳动收入与收入
    Fifty dummies for initial personal income measured at the start of each period (e.g. 2004 or 2008). The DKK 300,000 bin is omitted, so coefficients measure income-growth trend differentials relative to that bin.
    登记库： Danish tax records
    论文正文 · Section 4, eq. (11)

  • 结果变量：应税财富和第三方报送财富的对数
  • 处理：1989 年财富税下调（未受税收上限约束者与受约束者对比：上限 DD）
  • 处理：夫妻免税门槛翻倍（夫妻 DD）
  • 聚束分析的驱动变量：免税门槛附近的应税财富
  • 控制变量：改革前的资产组合份额和收入十分位
时期
财富数据始于 1980 年；准实验面板为 1985–1996 年
样本
138,384 个观测值（上限 DD）和 520,452 个观测值（夫妻 DD，夫妻与夫妻比较） 1989 年改革前处于财富分布前 1% 的丹麦家庭（上限 DD）或处于前 5% 的已婚夫妻（夫妻 DD）构成的平衡面板。 来源

  • Household (tax unit) and married status 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Household id is the family id when the person's spouse id equals the cohabitation partner id and civil status is in the married range (up to 2007, from FAIN); from 2008 from BEF using spouse id = partner id and civil status G or P.     Household net taxable wealth = sum over household members aged 20+ of the wealth variable FORM from the income-tax register (INDH); outcome is log(FORM). Portfolio shares use INDK components: equity share = listed stocks / total assets, housing share = (mortgage deeds + real estate value) / total assets.

  • Wealth tax exemption threshold and marginal wealth tax 税收与税率
    Annual exemption threshold (allowance) by year; for couples it equals 2 x single allowance, except 1989-1992 when couples' allowance uses a separate married allowance x 2. Household marginal wealth tax rate tau_it = statutory rate if FORM exceeds the household allowance, else 0. Bunching analysis uses distance b = FORM - allowance, deflated, in DKK 20,000 bins from -540,000 to 540,000.

Treatment: household in top 1% of the wealth distribution with X > 0.99 in every pre-reform year of the window (e.g. 1982-1988), i.e. not bound by the tax ceiling; control: top 1% with X < 0.80 (bound by ceiling). The Welfare Magnet Hypothesis: Evidence from an Immigrant Welfare Scheme in Denmark

Ole Agersnap, Amalie Sofie Jensen and Henrik Kleven · AER: Insights, 2020 · 个人

2002 年对非欧盟移民福利的削减及其废除和重新实施，为检验福利磁石假说提供了多次准实验。削减使净移民每年减少约 5,000 人，废除则几乎完全逆转了这一变化，这意味着移民对福利水平的弹性为 1.3。

数据
Danish administrative registers on the full population 1980–2017 (immigrant status, country of origin, demographics, family links), Residence permit data by permit type (asylum, family, work/study; available from 1997), Central Person Register (CPR) migration records, National statistics bureaus of other Nordic countries and OECD International Migration Database (1991–2017)
关键变量
  • 处理：非欧盟移民的每月最高福利金（移民福利方案 2002 年出台、2012 年废除、2015 年重新实施）
  • 结果变量：按福利金组别划分的净移民流量，以方案实施前的存量标准化
  • 结果变量：按居留许可类型划分的总流入
  • 比较：欧盟移民与非欧盟移民；丹麦与其他北欧国家
时期
1980–2017
样本
444 个组别—年份观测值（12 个福利金组别） 流入丹麦的 30 岁及以上移民（基准设定），按欧盟/非欧盟来源、婚姻状况和子女数量归并为 12 个福利资格组别。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Treated (non-EU) immigrants 移民身份与来源地
    First-generation immigrants from outside the EU and the four EFTA countries (Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, Switzerland), who are subject to the immigrant welfare scheme. 'Inside the EU' is defined by member countries in the pre-scheme year 2001, to avoid confounding from later EU enlargements.
    登记库： CPR, BEF
    代码： EU membership as of 2001 + EFTA
    工作论文 · Section 2.1 and footnote 6
  • Net immigration flow 移民身份与来源地
    Year-to-year change in the stock of first-generation immigrants residing in Denmark according to the Central Person Register, by group, scaled by the group's pre-scheme (2001) immigrant stock and residualized on a linear group-specific trend estimated on 1980-2001.
    登记库： CPR
    工作论文 · Section 3, footnote 11 and eq. (1)
  • Inflow by residence permit type 移民身份与来源地
    Immigration flows by type of residence permit granted (asylum, family, work, study; available from 1997). Asylum and family permit holders are treated as potentially welfare-eligible; work/study permit holders as untreated. Asylum applications are used as a supplementary measure.
    登记库： Residence permit data (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 3, Figure 3, footnote 12
  • Welfare benefit groups and maximum monthly benefit 失业与福利金
    Maximum monthly cash benefits (2018 USD) for non-employed households at age 40 out of work for three months; with children, the first child is aged 10 and the second aged 8. Danish scheme benefits from STAR (Danish Agency for Labour Market and Recruitment) website; other benefits computed with the OECD tax-benefit calculator. Only cash welfare, excluding UI and in-kind benefits such as housing support.
    登记库： STAR scheme rules, OECD tax-benefit calculator
    在线附录 · Online Appendix, Figure A.II notes
  • Age restriction (24-Year Rule) 样本界定与时间
    Main within-country specification restricts to immigrants at least 30 years old, to avoid confounding from the 2002 '24-Year Rule' requiring both spouses to be at least 24 for marriage-based residency. The cross-country analysis has no age restriction.
    登记库： CPR, BEF
    工作论文 · Section 2.1 and footnote 7
  • Synthetic Denmark (cross-country control) 移民身份与来源地
    Weighted average of Finland (0.468), Norway (0.361) and Sweden (0.171), chosen to match 1991-2001 non-EU/EFTA net immigration flows normalized by each country's 2001 non-EU/EFTA immigrant stock. Immigrants from the former Yugoslavia are dropped throughout to remove the Bosnia shock.
    登记库： Nordic national statistics bureaus, OECD International Migration Database
    工作论文 · Section 3 (cross-country strategy), footnote 18; Appendix Figure A.IV notes
  • First- and second-generation immigrant 移民身份与来源地
    Official Statistics Denmark definitions: a first-generation immigrant is born outside Denmark with neither parent being both a Danish citizen and born in Denmark; a second-generation immigrant (descendant) is born in Denmark with neither parent being both a Danish citizen and born in Denmark.
    登记库： CPR, BEF
    在线附录 · Online Appendix, Figure A.III notes
  • Asylum applications 移民身份与来源地
    Asylum applications to Denmark from outside the EU at annual and quarterly frequency: applications submitted (available from 2000), applications registered for administrative review, and residence permits granted to asylum seekers; asylum seekers from Bosnia dropped. An inflow measure without a control group, used to validate timing of responses.

Tax Evasion and Inequality

Annette Alstadsæter, Niels Johannesen and Gabriel Zucman · American Economic Review, 2019 · 个人

将泄露的离岸账户数据（HSBC Switzerland、Panama Papers）和税收特赦记录与斯堪的纳维亚的财富登记库相匹配。逃税随财富急剧上升：最富有的 0.01% 逃掉了约四分之一的应纳税款，这使测得的顶层财富份额明显上升。

数据
Leaked HSBC Switzerland client list (Swiss Leaks, 2007) matched to tax records in Denmark, Norway and Sweden, Panama Papers / Mossack Fonseca leak matched to Norwegian and Swedish wealth data (not Denmark), Tax amnesty voluntary disclosures in Norway and Sweden, Population-wide administrative wealth and income tax records for Norway, Sweden and Denmark, Danish stratified random tax audits by SKAT (tax years 2008, 2010, 2012), National accounts household wealth totals
关键变量
  • 结果变量：按财富组别划分的逃税额（占应纳税款的比重）
  • 排序变量：家庭净财富，含推算的养老金财富
  • 指示变量：持有未申报的 HSBC 账户／Panama Papers 空壳公司／参加税收特赦
  • 结果变量（事件研究）：特赦后的申报财富和申报收入
  • 随机稽查查出的逃税（境内逃税）
时期
HSBC 泄露数据为 2006–2007 年；税收特赦自 2006 年起；丹麦随机稽查针对 2008、2010、2012 纳税年度
样本
520 个 HSBC 家庭；165 个 Panama Papers 家庭；挪威 1,422 名、瑞典 6,811 名参加特赦的纳税人；18,985 名被随机稽查的丹麦纳税人 出现在离岸泄露数据或税收特赦中的斯堪的纳维亚家庭，按其在全体人口财富分布中的位置排序，并结合丹麦的随机稽查数据。 来源
变量如何定义（4）
  • Household (unit of analysis) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    A household is either a single person aged 20 or above or a married couple, in both cases with dependent children if any; fractiles are defined relative to the total number of households, including those not liable to wealth tax.
    登记库： Administrative wealth and income records
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.1.2
  • Household net wealth (ranking variable) 财富、负债与消费
    100% of national-accounts household wealth at market value distributed to households: all non-financial and financial assets minus debts, including funded pensions, excluding durables and valuables. Pension wealth imputed (40% to wage earners pro rata wage income, 60% to retirees pro rata pension income); unlisted equity imputed by capitalizing unlisted dividends and non-corporate business assets by capitalizing business income. Danish distribution taken from Jakobsen et al. (2018), based on individual wealth records.
    登记库： Danish individual wealth records, National accounts
    工作论文 · Section 3.2; Online Appendix A and D
  • HSBC undeclared account holder 税收与税率
    Households who owned at least one account at HSBC Switzerland (including via shell companies with identified beneficial owners), declared themselves taxable in Scandinavia in 2006 and could be matched to a tax return (2006/2007 records); non-residents excluded; for Denmark all matched households are treated as evaders (about 95% of matched Danish accounts were undeclared).
    登记库： Leaked HSBC list (Danish tax authority version), Tax returns
    工作论文 · Section 3.1.1, footnotes 13-16; Online Appendix E
  • Random-audit detected evasion 税收与税率
    SKAT stratified random audits for tax years 2008, 2010 and 2012 (18,985 taxpayers; self-employed and complex returns oversampled), every line item examined; main results include all errors; deliberate evaders are those rated 0-2 on SKAT's 0-6 compliance scale. Evasion rate = taxes evaded / (taxes paid + taxes evaded) by wealth group, weighted by audit weights.
    登记库： SKAT random audit data

2009 年特别养老金（Special Pension）储蓄的发放起到了财政刺激的作用。以家庭支付的边际利率衡量约束的松紧程度，面临高边际利率的家庭支出反应最大，其余家庭反应很小，这支持把刺激政策瞄准受信贷约束的人群。

Labor Supply and Optimization Frictions: Evidence from the Danish Student Labor Market

Jakob Egholt Søgaard · Journal of Public Economics, 2019 · 个人

丹麦学生的年劳动收入一旦超过某一门槛，就会失去部分助学金。登记数据显示，门槛下方存在聚束，而且随着学生对这一规则的经验增加而加强；可见优化摩擦掩盖了一个远高于观测到的反应的结构弹性。

数据
Danish administrative registers for the full population (education, earnings, benefits, demographics), Annual income tax returns, Monthly student benefit (SU) take-up records from the Student Benefit Administration, Monthly payroll records of earnings and hours (BFL/eIndkomst), from 2008
关键变量
  • 结果变量：年劳动收入相对于学生补助收入上限的位置（聚束）
  • 激励：超过个人收入上限后助学金逐步取消（退还）所形成的拐点/缺口
  • 模拟的个人边际税率和补助递减率
  • 月度劳动收入和补助领取（调整的时点）
时期
2006–2011 年（月度劳动收入自 2008 年起）
样本
每年约 75,000 个观测值（核心样本平均每年 75,500 人） 18–35 岁、在高等教育阶段注册就读、完全有资格领取学生补助且劳动收入为正（每年高于 DKK 8,000）的个人。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Core student sample 样本界定与时间
    Individuals aged 18-35 enrolled in tertiary education, fully eligible for student benefits (SU), and with positive labour earnings, defined as earned income above DKK 8,000 per year. This gives about 75,500 observations per year, 2006-2011.
    登记库： Danish administrative registers (education, tax returns), Student Benefit Administration records
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, Table 2
  • Income counted against the SU income limit 劳动收入与收入
    Labour income (net of labour market contribution), transfers other than student benefits, and capital income, except certain types of stock income. All amounts are scaled to 2018 levels using the official wage indexation of student benefits.
    登记库： Tax returns
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, footnote 4
  • Individual income limit 失业与福利金
    The baseline income limit is 12 times the monthly basic amount (DKK 7,700, 2018 levels; about DKK 93,000 annually) and rises by DKK 11,600 for each month of benefits not taken up. It is computed from monthly benefit take-up records of the Student Benefit Administration.
    登记库： Student Benefit Administration records
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, Figure 1 notes; Appendix C
  • Effective marginal tax / phase-out rate 税收与税率
    Marginal income tax of 42% above a personal allowance of DKK 49,900. Benefits are phased out at 50% for the first DKK 11,600 above the individual income limit and at 100% beyond that, so the effective marginal rate jumps from 42% to 72% at the baseline limit under optimal take-up. If the payback exceeds DKK 9,200, the whole payback rises by 7% (a notch). The 2009 reform raised the baseline limit by 24% and the phase-out rate from 52% to 62%.
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, footnotes 5 and 11, Figure 2
  • Excess income and predicted payback 劳动收入与收入
    Total earned income from tax records minus the individual income limit; positive amounts translate into payback of benefits. Predicted end-of-year benefits (initial payout minus predicted payback) match reported benefits within DKK 2 for 97.9% of the core sample.
    登记库： Tax returns, Student Benefit Administration records
    工作论文 · Section 4.3; Appendix C, Table C.I
  • Study-related job 部门与行业
    All jobs not in wholesale (NACE 46), retail (47), postal service (53), hotels and restaurants (55, 56), cleaning (81), elderly, social and childcare (87, 88), or sports and amusement facilities (93).
    登记库： Monthly earnings records (employer/firm link)

Transfer Pricing by Multinational Firms: New Evidence from Foreign Firm Ownerships

Anca D. Cristea and Daniel X. Nguyen · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2016 · 企业

检验丹麦跨国公司是否通过压低对其拥有关联企业且公司税较低的国家的出口价格来转移利润。三重差分设计比较企业在某一目的地收购多数控股的关联企业前后的出口单位价值，并在相对丹麦税率不同的目的地之间进行比较，以没有关联企业的出口商为对照组。在税率较低的国家收购关联企业后，丹麦跨国公司对当地的出口单位价值平均下降 5.7% 至 9.1%。

数据
Firm Statistics Register (Statistics Denmark): employment, sales and industry for the universe of private-sector firms, Customs statistics on export transactions by firm, product and destination country (Statistics Denmark), Experian data on foreign ownership shares of Danish firms (from annual reports, supplemented with transaction records of the National Bank of Denmark), linked by the Statistics Denmark firm identifier, Statutory corporate tax rates: OECD Tax Database and World Tax Database (University of Michigan), Penn World Tables (population, per-capita GDP, exchange rate)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：按企业、产品、目的地和年份计的出口单位价值对数
  • 处理：企业在目的地国拥有多数控股的关联企业
  • 处理强度：丹麦与目的地之间公司税率差的绝对值，对低税率和高税率目的地分别计算
  • 对照组：在目的地没有关联企业的出口商
  • 控制变量：企业就业人数和销售额；目的地人口、人均 GDP、汇率
  • 异质性：差异化产品（Rauch 分类）；新设立的关联企业与存续的关联企业
时期
1999–2006
样本
1,203,111 个企业—产品—国家—年度观测值（工作论文表 1） 1999–2006 年经营的丹麦制造业出口商；跨国公司对其拥有多数控股关联企业的国家的出口占观测值的 11.4%。 来源
变量如何定义（4）
  • Export unit value 贸易与离岸外包
    Average unit values are computed by dividing annual export values by the quantities shipped (weight) at the firm-product-destination level. Observations with negative or missing export values, or with zero or missing weight, are dropped (about 4 percent of the data), and the top and bottom 1 percent of prices are dropped to remove measurement or keying errors.
    登记库： Customs statistics (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： Drop top and bottom 1 percent of prices
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Data), footnote 34
  • Majority-owned foreign affiliate (Affiliate) 企业特征与生产率
    Indicator equal to 1 if the Danish exporter has majority ownership of a local establishment in the destination market, built from Experian data on foreign firm ownership shares and merged with the customs data by the firm identifier used by Statistics Denmark. Holdings below the 50 percent majority break point are disregarded. For firms that establish an affiliate during the sample period, the observation for the year of acquisition is removed. The data do not show whether a given export transaction goes to an affiliated or an unrelated buyer.
    登记库： Experian foreign ownership data, Firm Statistics Register
    代码： Majority ownership (50 percent break point; FDI statistics use a 10 percent threshold)
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Data), footnotes 35-37; Table 3 notes
  • Tax wedge and low-/high-tax destination 税收与税率
    Absolute difference between the statutory corporate tax rate of the foreign country and that of Denmark, with indicator variables for countries with tax rates below (Low Tax) or above (High Tax) Denmark's rate. Tax rates are from the OECD Tax Database and, for non-OECD countries, the World Tax Database of the Office of Tax Policy Research at the University of Michigan.
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Data); Table 3 notes
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Manufacturing exporters operating during 1999-2006, drawn from the Firm Statistics Register, which covers the universe of private-sector Danish firms. The unit of observation is a firm-product-country-year quadruplet. Almost 3 percent of observations belong to Danish multinationals that establish their first majority-owned affiliate in a country during the sample period.
    登记库： Firm Statistics Register, Customs statistics (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： Years 1999-2006; manufacturing exporters; 1,203,111 observations

Claus Thustrup Kreiner, Søren Leth-Petersen and Peer Ebbesen Skov · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2016 · 个人 + 企业

2010 年最高边际税率的下调是提前公布的，月度工资记录显示高收入者把工资收入从 2009 年 12 月转移到 2010 年 1 月。这种转移集中在管理人员和小企业雇员中，并会抬高短期弹性的估计值。

数据
Monthly payroll records (eIndkomst / eIncome register) from the tax agency SKAT, Background registers on individuals and firms at Statistics Denmark (incl. firm size, liquid assets), Telephone survey on awareness of income-shifting opportunity (January 2011), merged to eIncome register
关键变量

  • 异质性：企业规模、流动性资产、劳动收入百分位
  • 含与不含转移成分的应税收入弹性
时期
2008 年 1 月–2011 年 12 月（月度）
样本
328,679 人，其中 219,179 人属于处理组；问卷调查样本为 878 名纳税人 2008 年每个月都有工资记录、各年收入均为正，且 2008 年月劳动收入高于 DKK 30,000 的私营部门雇员。 来源
调查
Income-shifting survey
变量如何定义（8）
  • Monthly wage change relative to 2008 劳动收入与收入
    Percentage change in individual monthly gross wage income (year t, month m) relative to the individual's average monthly gross earnings in 2008; percentage changes are used instead of logs because monthly earnings may be zero or near zero.
    登记库： eIncome register (SKAT)
    工作论文 · Section II, eq. (1)
  • Treatment and control groups (top-tax incentive) 样本界定与时间
    Robustness variants of the control group by average monthly 2008 earnings: narrow C-group DKK 32,000-35,000, wide C-group DKK 24,000-35,000; doughnut sample excludes individuals with average monthly 2008 earnings DKK 33,000-37,000; alternative baseline year 2009 (groups and income differences relative to 2009); alternative post-reform year 2011. T-group by percentile bins of average monthly earnings: [P80,P90), [P90,P95), [P95,P99), [P99,+].
    登记库： eIncome monthly payroll register (SKAT)
    代码： Narrow C: 32,000-35,000 DKK/month; wide C: 24,000-35,000 DKK/month; doughnut excl. 33,000-37,000 DKK/month (2008)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Table A2 notes; Figure A1
  • Analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    Individuals employed throughout 2008 (a wage record in every month of 2008) with positive income in all years, observed January 2008 - December 2011; includes people who are both wage earners and self-employed. Sensitivity: excluding employees with any exit to unemployment during 2009-2010.

  • Income-shifting indicator 劳动收入与收入
    Equals one if income in a month is high (more than 50 percent above) relative to its level in the same month of 2008 and income in the preceding month is low (more than 50 percent below) relative to its 2008 level; zero otherwise. Robustness with 25%-25% and 75%-75% cutoffs; a stricter version also requires November 2009 income to be unusually low.
    登记库： eIncome register (SKAT)
    工作论文 · Section III.A, eq. (3) and footnote 6
  • Financial capacity (liquidity) 财富、负债与消费
    Financial assets (money in bank accounts and value of shares and bonds) at end of 2008 relative to 2008 annual disposable income; groups below one month, between one and two months, and above two months of disposable income.
    登记库： Background registers at Statistics Denmark
    工作论文 · Section III.B, Figure 8
  • Firm size groups and top-five paid 企业特征与生产率
    Firm size groups: fewer than 25, 25-99, 100-499 and 500+ employees; large firms defined as more than 100 employees (top decile by number of employees); top-five paid employees within each firm used to isolate top management.

Taxation and the Long Run Allocation of Labor: Theory and Danish Evidence

Claus Thustrup Kreiner, Jakob Roland Munch and Hans Jørgen Whitta-Jacobsen · Journal of Public Economics, 2015 · 个人 + 企业

在覆盖 2004 至 2006 年丹麦全部工人和工作场所的雇主—雇员登记数据上，估计一个含非线性税收的搜寻模型，模型中工人会不断寻找报酬更高的工作。丹麦的税收通过影响劳动力在不同工作之间的配置，使总收入减少约 12%；若降至 OECD 低税国家的水平，可挽回五分之四的损失。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Wage Statistics Register (Lønstatistikken) for hours-adjusted wages (robustness), Empirical effective marginal tax rate schedule for 2006 from Kleven and Kreiner (2006)
关键变量
  • 工作场所平均小时工资率（年劳动收入/年工作小时数）
  • 工作场所规模、留任者人数和新雇人数（工作间流动）
  • 来自非就业状态的新雇人员
  • 按收入水平划分的有效边际税率（用于估计结构搜寻模型和效率损失）
时期
2004–2006 年（基年为 2005 年）
样本
126,400 个工作场所，雇用 140 万名工人 2005 年丹麦私营部门的全部工作场所及其 18–65 岁的工人，小时工资介于 DKK 90 与 DKK 714 之间。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Workers aged 18-65 employed in private-sector workplaces in 2005, drawn from IDA for 2004-2006; employment at each workplace is observed in a specific week in each year. Workers with hourly wage rates in the top percentile (above DKK 714) or below DKK 90 are excluded.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1 (Data)
  • Workplace 企业特征与生产率
    A workplace is an IDA establishment defined by a geographical location; most firms have one workplace but some larger firms have several.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, footnote 9
  • Hourly wage rate (IDA) 劳动收入与收入
    Annual labour income (including mandatory pension fund payments) divided by annual hours; annual hours are based on the mandatory ATP pension contributions, so overtime is not counted and part-time hours are imprecise.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; Section 5 (robustness)
  • Workplace average wage 劳动收入与收入
    Each worker is assigned the average hourly wage rate of employees at his/her workplace in 2005 (following Christensen et al. 2005), after trimming wages below DKK 90 and above DKK 714.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1
  • Workplace size and stayers 企业特征与生产率
    Size is the number of employees at the workplace in 2005; stayers are workers employed at the workplace in 2005 who are still employed there in 2006.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, Table 1
  • New hires / new hires from non-employment 就业与劳动力状态
    New hires are workers employed at the workplace in 2005 who were not employed there in 2004; new hires from non-employment are workers employed at the workplace in 2005 who were not employed at any workplace in 2004 (non-employment or non-participation).
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1
  • Wage offer distribution 劳动收入与收入
    Distribution of firm-specific average wages for persons entering firms in 2005 from non-employment in 2004, weighting each firm's wage by its share of all hires from non-employment.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1
  • Effective marginal tax rate 税收与税率
    Effective marginal tax rates by annual labour income from the Kleven and Kreiner (2006) empirical tax function for 2006 (income taxes, indirect taxes and benefit claw-back), deflated to 2005 by average labour income growth; hourly wages are converted to annual income using median annual hours of 1,660. The participation tax rate m0 is 0.59 at baseline (0.82 in a robustness check).
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, Figure 1; Section 5
  • Hours-adjusted wage rate (WSR imputation) 劳动收入与收入
    Robustness check: the employer-reported hourly wage from the Wage Statistics Register (Lønstatistikken) is regressed on the IDA wage rate after dropping the top and bottom 1% and IDA wages flagged as low quality by Statistics Denmark.
