Estimating Taxable Income Responses Using Danish Tax Reforms

Henrik Jacobsen Kleven and Esben Anton Schultz · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2014 · 个人

利用 1984 至 2005 年间丹麦的一系列税制改革和全体人口的税收记录，估计应税收入弹性。劳动收入的弹性很小（约 0.05），资本收入和高收入者的弹性较大，且大幅度改革下的弹性大于小幅度改革。

数据
Income Tax Register (tax return information), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Authors' own tax simulator of the Danish tax system, 1984–2005
关键变量
  • 结果变量：应税劳动收入和资本收入（正的与负的）的三年变化
  • 处理：模拟的边际税后留存率（net-of-tax rate）的变化
  • 工具变量：税制改革带来的边际税率的机械性（预测）变化
  • 控制变量：改革前（基年 s−1）的收入水平
  • 关键改革：1987 年和 1994 年丹麦税制改革
时期
数据始于 1980 年；税收模拟器和估计为 1984–2005 年（三年区间，从 1984–1987 年到 2002–2005 年）
样本
约 3700 万个观测值（堆叠的三年差分；施加样本限制前约 4900 万个） 1984–2005 年间 15–70 岁、负有完全纳税义务且基年收入不以福利给付为主的丹麦全体人口。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Labor income (LI) 劳动收入与收入
    Tax-code labor income: salary, wages, honoraria, fees, bonuses, fringe benefits and business earnings. Main outcome is the three-year growth rate (s to s+3) in real labor/wage earnings; regressions weighted by labor income and restricted to positive labor income.
    登记库： Income Tax Register, IDA
    论文正文 · Table 1; Section II; Table notes for labor income elasticity tables
  • Capital income (CI), positive and negative 劳动收入与收入
    Interest income, rental income and business capital income minus interest on debt (mortgage, bank loans, credit cards, student loans), excluding stock income; analysed separately as positive and negative capital income because they are taxed very differently.
    登记库： Income Tax Register
    论文正文 · Table 1; Section I; footnote 6
  • Personal, stock and taxable income (PI, SI, TI) 劳动收入与收入
    Personal income PI = LI + transfers, grants, awards, gifts, received alimony minus labour market contribution and certain pension contributions; stock income SI = dividends and realized capital gains on shares; deductions D = commuting, union fees, UI contributions, other work expenses, charity, paid alimony; taxable income TI = PI + CI + SI - D (differs from the tax-code label, which excludes SI).
    登记库： Income Tax Register
    论文正文 · Table 1
  • Simulated marginal tax rate 税收与税率
    Marginal tax rate on income component j computed with the authors' own Danish tax simulator (1984-2005) as [T(z_j + 100) - T(z)]/100, i.e. by raising that component by DKK 100; accounts for spousal jointness of exemptions and the marginal tax ceiling.
    登记库： Income Tax Register
    论文正文 · Section II; footnote 9
  • Mechanical change in net-of-tax rate (instrument) 税收与税率
    log(1 - tau_{s+3}(z_s)) - log(1 - tau_s(z_s)): change in the marginal net-of-tax rate simulated by applying year s+3 tax law to base-year s incomes; analogous mechanical change in virtual income instruments for the change in log virtual income.
    登记库： Income Tax Register
    论文正文 · Section III.B
  • Stacked three-year difference sample 样本界定与时间
    Stacked three-year intervals 1984-1987 to 2002-2005, keeping taxpayers also observed in year s-1 (used for pre-reform income controls: splines of log s-1 income and the log deviation between s-1 and s incomes); restricted to ages 15-70, fully tax liable in Denmark, excluding those whose base-year income comes primarily from welfare benefits (about 37 million observations).
    登记库： Income Tax Register, IDA
    论文正文 · Section II; Section V table notes
  • Taxpayers close to kink points 税收与税率
    Taxpayers with income within DKK 5,000 of the top kink, DKK 3,000 of the middle kink or DKK 2,000 of the bottom kink (excluded in robustness checks).
    登记库： Income Tax Register
    论文正文 · Notes to labor income elasticity table (Section V)
  • 1987 reform DD treatment/control groups 样本界定与时间
    Treatment group: taxpayers experiencing an increase in the marginal net-of-tax rate on labor income (or on positive capital income) due to the 1987 reform over 1986-1989; control group: those experiencing a reduction; large-treatment group has net-of-tax rate increases of at least 15 percent.
    登记库： Income Tax Register
    论文正文 · Section IV, Figure 4 discussion

Migration and Wage Effects of Taxing Top Earners: Evidence from the Foreigners' Tax Scheme in Denmark

Henrik Jacobsen Kleven, Camille Landais, Emmanuel Saez and Esben Schultz · Quarterly Journal of Economics, 2014 · 个人

1991 年针对高收入外国人的税收优惠方案使丹麦的高薪外国人数量大约翻了一番。由此推算的迁移对税后留存率（net-of-tax rate）的弹性大于 1，远高于国内劳动供给弹性；该方案还产生了幅度不大的工资溢出效应。

数据
Administrative tax and payroll records for all residents (income tax register), Civil registration (CPR) citizenship and migration records with dates of entry and exit, Foreigners' tax scheme beneficiary records (contract start and end dates), Employer links at firm and establishment level with industry
关键变量
  • 处理：是否符合外国人优惠税制的资格（劳动收入高于门槛）
  • 结果变量：劳动收入门槛以上与以下的外国人数量（迁移反应）
  • 结果变量：方案受益者的劳动收入（工资效应／在门槛处的聚束）
  • 结果变量：对本国出生的高收入者就业和劳动收入的溢出效应
  • 关键变量：国籍和在丹麦居留的年数
时期
1980–2010 年（税收数据始于 1980 年；该方案于 1992 年推出）
样本
所查资料中未注明 居住在丹麦的全部外国人和本国出生者，重点关注劳动收入在方案资格门槛附近的外国人（不含研究人员）。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Scheme earnings eligibility threshold 税收与税率
    Foreigners' scheme requires annual wage earnings with the requesting employer above a threshold that grows roughly with average earnings and lies between the 99.2th and 99.4th percentile of the Danish wage earnings distribution (DKK 765,600 in 2009); it must be met on an annualized basis (e.g. a 6-month contract needs half the annual threshold). For pre-1991 years the threshold is imputed by holding the threshold-to-average-earnings ratio at its 1991 value, with average earnings computed over all workers with positive earnings.
    登记库： Administrative tax and payroll records
    工作论文 · Section 2.1 and footnote 14
  • Scheme eligibility (prior tax liability) 税收与税率
    To be eligible the taxpayer must have been recruited abroad and not have been tax liable in Denmark in the 3 years before going on the scheme (applied to each scheme spell separately; prior scheme time not counted); citizenship plays no formal role, so Danish citizens tax-resident abroad for 3+ years qualify. Scheme lasts at most 36 months.
    登记库： Foreigners' tax scheme beneficiary records
    工作论文 · Section 2.1 and footnote 12
  • Annualized earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Earnings of part-year residents are annualized based on duration of stay in the year, with duration of stay measured from the migration database (daily dates of entry and exit from CPR records).
    登记库： Administrative tax records, CPR migration records
    工作论文 · Section 4.1, footnote 23
  • Treatment and control groups of foreigners (migration DiD) 移民身份与来源地
    Treatment: foreigners with (annualized) earnings above the eligibility threshold; controls: foreigners with earnings between 80% and 90% (control 1) and between 90% and 99.5% (control 2) of the threshold, series normalized to 1990. In the elasticity regressions controls are foreigners between 80% and 99% of the threshold; an alternative uses the 99.5-100th percentile vs the 95-97th and 97-99th percentiles of the full earnings distribution.
    登记库： Administrative tax records, CPR citizenship records
    工作论文 · Section 4.1, Figures 4-5, Table 2
  • Citizenship groups and expatriates 移民身份与来源地
    Nordic foreigners: citizens of Finland, Iceland, Norway, Sweden; English-speaking: Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, South Africa, UK, US. Expatriates are Danish citizens returning after a spell of at least three years abroad.
    登记库： CPR citizenship records
    工作论文 · Section 4.1, Table 2 Panels A5-A7
  • Wage-effect repeated cross-section sample 样本界定与时间
    For year t, foreigners who arrived in Denmark in year t-1 and stayed the full calendar year t; earnings between 70-95% (below) and 105-400% (above) of the threshold, excluding 95-105% (bunchers) and above 400%; years 1991-1994 excluded because scheme earnings are not computerized.
    登记库： Administrative tax records, CPR migration records, Scheme beneficiary records
    工作论文 · Section 4.2, Figure 8, Table 3, footnote 30
  • Top natives and top foreign employees (spillovers) 劳动收入与收入
    Top natives: native workers with earnings above 75% of the scheme eligibility threshold (about the top 3% of native earnings). Top foreign employees: foreign employees with less than 3 years of presence in Denmark and annualized earnings above the threshold; industry scheme use = growth in top foreign employees between 1980-1990 and 1991-2000 divided by top native employees in 1980-1990.
    登记库： Administrative tax and payroll records, Employer links with 2-digit industry
    工作论文 · Section 4.3 (industry-level spillovers), footnote 35

Active vs. Passive Decisions and Crowd-Out in Retirement Savings Accounts: Evidence from Denmark

Raj Chetty, John N. Friedman, Søren Leth-Petersen, Torben Heien Nielsen and Tore Olsen · Quarterly Journal of Economics, 2014 · 个人

利用丹麦全部储蓄记录表明，对退休账户的税收补贴主要只是让储蓄在不同账户之间转移：每 1 克朗补贴仅使总储蓄增加约 1 øre。相比之下，雇主的自动缴款几乎一比一地提高总储蓄，因为约 85% 的人是不会重新优化的被动储蓄者。

数据
Income tax register with third-party reported earnings and pension contributions (IND), Third-party reported wealth: end-of-year assets and liabilities in taxable accounts, Population register (BEF), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：向雇主退休账户和个人退休账户的缴款
  • 结果变量：应税储蓄（应税资产的变动），总额与净额
  • 处理：换工作时雇主养老金缴款的变化（自动缴款）
  • 处理：1999 年下调最高税档纳税人资本养老金的税收补贴（价格补贴）
  • 处理：政府强制储蓄计划（SP）的缴款
时期
1995–2009
样本
约 4100 万个观测值，涉及约 400 万人 18–60 岁的丹麦人口，剔除有自雇收入的观测值（非平衡面板）。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Primary analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    Danish population 1995-2009 from merged income tax register, population register and IDA, excluding observations below age 18 or above 60 and observations with self-employment income (about 41 million observations on 4 million individuals).
    登记库： IND (income tax register), BEF, IDA
    工作论文 · Section III (Sample and Variable Definitions)
  • Taxable saving (gross and net) 财富、负债与消费
    Gross taxable saving = change in third-party reported end-of-year assets in taxable accounts; net saving = gross saving minus change in liabilities, where liabilities cover secured and unsecured debt except home mortgages. Saving measures and rates below the 1st or above the 99th percentile in the estimation sample are set to missing.
    登记库： Third-party reported wealth data (tax authority)
    工作论文 · Section III
  • Pension contributions by account 退休与养老金
    Annual employer and individual contributions to capital pension (lump-sum) and annuity pension accounts as reported by employers and pension funds; contributions above the 99th percentile are top-coded at the 99th percentile in each account and year.
    登记库： IND (income tax register)
    工作论文 · Section III
  • Income concepts 劳动收入与收入
    Labor income = labor earnings before taxes excluding contributions to employer-administered pensions; total compensation = labor earnings plus employer and employee contributions to employer-administered accounts; taxable income = labor income plus other income (e.g., UI) affecting tax liability. Measured at the individual level, with joint-account balances split equally.
    登记库： IND (income tax register)
    工作论文 · Section III
  • Firm switch 就业与劳动力状态
    Individual switches firms in year t if he has earnings from two distinct firms in t and t-1 (primary job for multiple jobholders); switches where earnings fell by more than half or more than doubled are excluded; set missing in 2003, 2005 and 2007 when firm identifiers changed. Event studies require at least 4 years of data before and after.
    登记库： IDA, IND
    工作论文 · Section IV.A, footnotes 9-10
  • Mandatory Savings Plan (MSP) contribution 退休与养老金
    From 1998 individuals with labor income at or above DKr 34,500 were required to contribute 1% of earnings (DKr 345 at the cutoff); RD on changes in pension contributions/saving from 1997 to 1998 for individuals within DKr 25,000 of the cutoff.
    登记库： IND (income tax register)
    代码： cutoff Y >= DKr 34,500; bandwidth DKr 25,000
    工作论文 · Section IV.B, equation (6)
  • 1999 capital pension subsidy reduction 税收与税率
    From 1999 the deduction for capital pension contributions fell from 59 to 45 cents per DKr for individuals in the top income tax bracket (cutoff DKr 251,200 in 1998); treatment group: taxable income DKr 25,000-75,000 above the top-tax cutoff; control: DKr 25,000-75,000 below.
    登记库： IND (income tax register)
    工作论文 · Section V, V.A (Estimator 1)

Tax Bunching, Income Shifting and Self-Employment

Daniel le Maire and Bertel Schjerning · Journal of Public Economics, 2013 · 个人

丹麦的自雇者在最高税率拐点处明显聚束，但其中很大一部分反映的是通过企业留存收益进行的收入跨期转移，而非努力程度的真实变化。把收入转移考虑进来之后，真实收入的弹性要小得多。

数据
Tax records of Danish self-employed individuals (taxable income, retained earnings)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：应税收入在税率表拐点处的聚束
  • 机制：通过企业税收方案中的留存收益进行跨期收入转移
  • 估计值：应税收入弹性（忽略收入转移时为 0.43–0.53；结构估计为 0.14–0.20）
时期
所查资料中未注明
样本
所查资料中未注明 丹麦的自雇纳税人。 来源（摘要）
变量如何定义（8）
  • Self-employed (main occupation) 就业与劳动力状态
    Persons whose primary occupation is self-employment, classified with the Statistics Denmark occupation variables pstill2 (primary) and sstill2 (secondary); narrower than Chetty et al. (2011), excluding wage earners with self-employment as secondary occupation.
    登记库： IDA, Income Tax Register
    代码： pstill2, sstill2
    工作论文 · Section 2.1, Table 1 notes
  • Analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    Entire population panel 1994-2009, aged 25-59, main occupation self-employment; restricted to self-employed whose spouse's primary or secondary occupation is not self-employment (because transfers to assisting spouses are only observed 1994-2001).
    登记库： Income Tax Register, IDA
    工作论文 · Section 2 'Data and Institutional Background'
  • Personal income 劳动收入与收入
    Sum of wage earnings, declared firm profits (net of retained earnings), remunerations, provisions, alimony etc. minus deductions; interest income is capital income and not part of personal income.
    登记库： Income Tax Register
    工作论文 · Figure 1 notes; Section 2.1
  • Taxable income relative to the effective kink 税收与税率
    For each individual, the difference between actual taxable income and the taxable income needed to reach the middle or top tax bracket, computed with the authors' own tax simulator accounting for special deductions and joint taxation of couples (simulated tax within +/-5 DKK of actual for 95% of the sample); distributions plotted in 1,000 DKK bins.
    登记库： Income Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 2 and Figure 2
  • Tax schedule kinks 税收与税率
    Piecewise-linear personal income tax with five brackets before 1996 and four from 1996; e.g. 2001: about 8% below 33,400 DKK, about 44% up to 179,900 DKK (bottom tax), 49% above (middle tax) and 63% above 279,900 DKK (top tax). Top-tax base is mainly individual; middle-tax base depends on household income; middle cutoff raised to the top cutoff in 2009.
    登记库： Income Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 2
  • Business tax scheme and retained earnings 企业特征与生产率
    Self-employed choose the personal income tax scheme, the capital returns scheme (from 1993) or the firm tax scheme (from 1987); the latter two are treated as one and allow retaining profits in the firm, taxed provisionally at the firm tax rate (34% in 1994 falling to 25% in 2009), with withdrawals taxed as personal income. Retained earnings = profits retained under these schemes.
    登记库： Income Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 2.1 'Three Tax Schemes for the Self-employed'; Table 2
  • Earned income 劳动收入与收入
    Income before shifting: personal income plus retained earnings plus income shifted along other margins such as pension contributions and transfers to assisting spouses; used (adjusted for income shocks) to estimate the real bunching response.
    登记库： Income Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 4 discussion of Figures 11-12
  • Excess mass at kink (bunching) 税收与税率
    Excess mass at the tax cutoff estimated following Saez (2010) within a bandwidth around the kink, applied to taxable income and to adjusted earned income; the dynamic extension separates bunching from intertemporal shifting via retained earnings.
    登记库： Income Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 3-4, equation (3)

Unwilling or Unable to Cheat? Evidence from a Tax Audit Experiment in Denmark

Henrik Jacobsen Kleven, Martin B. Knudsen, Claus Thustrup Kreiner, Søren Pedersen and Emmanuel Saez · Econometrica, 2011 · 个人

与丹麦税务机关合作、针对约 40,000 名纳税人开展的随机田野实验。第三方报送的收入几乎不存在逃税，而自行申报的收入逃税相当严重；稽查威胁信会提高自行申报收入的申报额。现代税制得以运转，靠的是信息，而不是道德。

数据
Randomized tax audit experiment implemented by the Danish tax authority (SKAT), SKAT Business Object Database: third-party information reports, pre-populated returns, filed returns and after-audit returns, item by item, SKAT computer-generated audit flags, Basic socio-economic variables and employer industry/size from SKAT records
关键变量
  • 处理：随机分配到 100% 稽查组或 0% 稽查组，稽查事先不通知（2007 年申报季）
  • 处理：在 2008 年申报截止日前随机寄送稽查威胁信（100%、50%、不寄信）
  • 结果变量：查出的逃税（稽查对净收入和税额的调整）
  • 结果变量：次年申报收入的变化
  • 异质性：自行申报收入与第三方报送收入
时期
2006–2007 收入年度（2007 和 2008 年申报季）
样本
25,020 名雇员和 17,764 名自雇者 由 SKAT 为稽查实验抽取的丹麦纳税人分层随机样本（雇员，含转移支付领取者，以及自雇者）。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Audit treatment (stage 1) 税收与税率
    Stratified random sample of 25,020 employees and 17,764 self-employed (strata: employee/self-employed, light/heavy return complexity, 30 regional tax centres) randomly split into a 100% group subjected to unannounced comprehensive audits of returns filed in 2007 (2006 income) and a 0% group never audited; effects are intent-to-treat (actual audit rates 98.7% employees, 92% self-employed).
    登记库： SKAT Business Object Database
    工作论文 · Section 4.2
  • Threat-of-audit letters (stage 2) 税收与税率
    Employees in both audit groups randomly assigned (thirds) to receive a letter one month before the 1 May 2008 filing deadline stating that the return would certainly be audited (100% letter), that half of the group would be audited (50% letter), or no letter. Outcome is the probability of self-reported adjustments (upward/downward) relative to the latest return at the time the letter was received.
    登记库： SKAT Business Object Database
    工作论文 · Section 4.2; Section 7 and footnote 38; Table 8
  • Detected tax evasion (audit adjustments) 税收与税率
    Net audit adjustment = after-audit return (A) minus filed return (F), split into under-reporting (upward adjustments raising tax liability) and over-reporting (downward adjustments), for net income, total tax and income components.
    登记库： SKAT Business Object Database
    代码： Returns: information report (I), pre-populated (P), filed (F), after-audit (A)
    工作论文 · Section 4.3; Section 5.1; Table 2 notes
  • Third-party vs self-reported income and evasion 税收与税率
    Third-party income comes from information reports; self-reported income = total reported income minus third-party income. For always-positive line items, third-party under-reporting = A-F if F<A<I, = I-F if F<I<=A, zero otherwise; self-reported under-reporting is total upward adjustment net of third-party under-reporting. Third-party under-reporting is defined only for positive items.
    登记库： SKAT Business Object Database
    代码： F<A<I: A-F; F<I<=A: I-F; else 0
    工作论文 · Section 5.2; Table 2 notes
  • Net income and components 劳动收入与收入
    Net income = personal income + capital income + stock income + self-employment income + foreign income - deductions. Personal income: earnings, pensions, alimony minus some retirement contributions; capital income: interest income, bond returns, net rents minus interest payments; stock income: dividends and realised capital gains on stocks; self-employment income: net profits of unincorporated businesses.
    登记库： SKAT Business Object Database
    工作论文 · Table 2 notes; Table 1
  • Audit flags 税收与税率
    Presence and number of computer-generated audit flags, a deterministic function of the return characteristics that SKAT normally uses to select returns for examiner review.
    登记库： SKAT audit flag system
    工作论文 · Section 4.1; Section 4.3

Adjustment Costs, Firm Responses, and Micro vs. Macro Labor Supply Elasticities: Evidence from Danish Tax Records

Raj Chetty, John N. Friedman, Tore Olsen and Luigi Pistaferri · Quarterly Journal of Economics, 2011 · 个人 + 企业

利用丹麦税率表拐点处的聚束现象，说明观测到的劳动收入反应受到搜寻成本以及企业围绕税收门槛协调工时的影响。一旦考虑调整摩擦，结构性劳动供给弹性约为 0.3，远高于个体层面微观研究得到的很小的弹性，这有助于调和微观与宏观估计。

数据
Income tax register / Income Statistics Register (IND), Population register (BEF), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA) with firm ID and occupation
关键变量
  • 结果变量：应税收入在最高税率拐点处的聚束（超额质量）
  • 处理：税级分界点处的边际税率变化（税收模拟器）
  • 关键变量：企业层面和职业层面的聚束（工时约束 / 企业反应）
  • 关键变量：各拐点处税率变化的幅度
  • 比较：工薪劳动者与自雇者
时期
1994–2001
样本
工薪劳动者 1790 万个观测值（其中 680 万个位于最高税率分界点上下 DKr 50,000 以内；自雇者观测值 180 万个） 15–70 岁的丹麦工薪劳动者，不含自雇者和养老金领取者，自雇者另行研究。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Wage earner sample 就业与劳动力状态
    Individuals aged 15-70 in the tax register 1994-2001 classified as wage earners by IDA employment status, excluding self-employed, pensioners, wage earners with self-employment income and wage earners with unemployment; much of the analysis uses wage earners within DKr 50,000 of the top tax cutoff. Self-employed analysed separately.
    登记库： IND (tax register), IDA
    代码： BESKST=4 (robustness: BESKST in 4, 5, 7, 8)
    工作论文 · Section 4; Appendix B
  • Tax simulator and marginal tax rates 税收与税率
    Authors' tax simulator computing tax liabilities and marginal tax rates from own and spouse's tax variables and previous-year municipality of residence; it matches actual municipal, regional, bottom, middle and top taxes within DKr 5 for 95% of observations.
    登记库： IND (tax register)
    代码： pnr, henv (spouse), glskkmnr (municipality), pfrdst, berfrdst (personal exemption), perindkp, berpi (personal income), kapindkp, berkap (capital income), lignfrdp (special deductions), kappens, fosfufrd (individual pension contributions), arbpen14, arbpen15 (employer capital pension contributions), underhol (alimony)
    工作论文 · Appendix B
  • Wage earnings and net deductions 劳动收入与收入
    Wage earnings from the tax register; net deductions = deductions minus non-wage income (accounting for spousal deductions), equivalently wage earnings minus taxable income; in the top-tax base, net deductions = wage earnings needed to start paying top tax minus the statutory top tax cutoff. Small-deduction group: net deductions below DKr 7,500 in magnitude.
    登记库： IND (tax register)
    代码： wage earnings qlontmp2; self-employment profits qovskvir, virkordind
    工作论文 · Section 4; Appendix B
  • Bunching (excess mass) at kinks 税收与税率
    Excess mass b = number of individuals in a window around the kink in excess of a counterfactual density, relative to the average counterfactual density in the window; the counterfactual is a seventh-degree polynomial fitted to binned counts of the earnings distribution excluding a DKr 15,000 window centred on the kink (q=7, R=7).
    登记库： IND (tax register)
    代码： q=7 (polynomial degree), R=7 (bins on each side), excluded window DKr 15,000
    工作论文 · Section 4, equations (15)-(16)
  • Firm bunching and occupation earnings modes 职业与职位层级
    Occupation-year modes = DKr 5,000 wage-earnings bin with most workers in each 4-digit ISCO occupation-year (occupation-years with under 7,000 workers excluded). Firm bunching b_F = excess mass at the statutory top-tax cutoff for workers with more than DKr 20,000 in deductions; individual bunching b_I = excess mass at the pension kink for the same group; compared across 2-digit ISCO occupations.
    登记库： IDA, IND
    代码： occupation discok (ISCO 4-digit; 2-digit for Figure 18); deductions > DKr 20,000
    工作论文 · Section 6 (Predictions 2 and 3); Appendix B; Figures 14, 18
  • Pension-driven kink 退休与养老金
    Cap on tax-deductible pension contributions (about DKr 33,000 on average) means workers contributing up to the cap enter the top bracket at wage earnings about DKr 33,000 above the statutory cutoff; bunching there is used to measure individual (job-search) bunching.
    登记库： IND (tax register)
    工作论文 · Introduction; Section 6

Subjective Earnings Risk

Andrew Caplin, Victoria Gregory, Eungik Lee, Søren Leth-Petersen and Johan Sæverud · Review of Economic Studies, 2026 · 个人

提出一种把辞职和被解雇的可能性考虑在内的劳动收入风险调查工具，面向丹麦劳动者实施，并与其登记库中的劳动收入历史相链接。工作转换是主观风险的主要来源；即使在控制人口特征和工作履历之后，主观风险仍比传统的基于登记数据的估计小许多倍，这有助于解释为什么许多人只持有很少的流动资产。

数据
Copenhagen Life Panel (CLP) survey, January 2021 wave, linked on CPR number, Income-tax register earnings (IND), Monthly employer-employee match and earnings data (BFL/eIndkomst), Demographic, education, household composition and household wealth registers
关键变量
  • 调查：留任、辞职和被裁员的主观概率
  • 调查：以每种工作转换为条件的主观劳动收入分布
  • 基准：2021 年实际发生的工作转换、未就业时间和劳动收入增长（行政数据）
  • 权重：基于 2020 年行政数据的调查参与模型得到的总体权重
时期
调查于 2021 年 1 月进行；行政数据截至 2022 年
样本
10,942 名在职受访者（总样本为 14,683 名 20–65 岁受访者） Copenhagen Life Panel 中在 2021 年 1 月调查时处于就业状态的 20–65 岁受访者。 来源
调查
Copenhagen Life Panel
变量如何定义（10）
  • Main monthly employer (BFL) 就业与劳动力状态
    From monthly eIndkomst job records (BFL), each person-month is assigned the job with the most paid hours (AJO_LOENTIMER) as the primary employer; its CVR number, wage and hours are kept. Month and year come from the job start date field AJO_JOB_START_DATO.
    登记库： BFL
    代码： AJO_CVR_NR_FRA_PROD_JOB, AJO_SMALT_LOENBELOEB, AJO_LOENTIMER, AJO_JOB_START_DATO; primary job = max(AJO_LOENTIMER) within pnr-year-month
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_c_monthly_data.R
  • Stayer (same employer Dec 2020 to Dec 2021) 就业与劳动力状态
    Among workers with an employer and monthly wage above 2,000 DKK in December 2020, stay=1 if the main employer in December 2021 is the same as in December 2020, else 0. Sample restricted to ages 20-65 and 2020 annual BFL earnings of at least 24,000 DKK.
    登记库： BFL
    代码： wage>2000 in Dec 2020; employer_g == F12.employer_g; sum_earnings>=24000
    复制代码 · script/analysis/fig4/preprocess_fig4a.do; paper Figure 4 note
  • Months out of work after separation 失业与福利金
    A separation is a month in which the worker has a main employer with monthly wage above 2,000 DKK and next month's employer differs; only the first separation per person is used. Time out of work = months until a different non-missing employer appears (capped at 24) minus one, so job-to-job moves count as 0 and returns to the same employer are not reemployment. The paper describes separations in 2020; the posted do-file's window (date<=24 from Dec 2018) covers Dec 2018-Dec 2019.
    登记库： BFL
    代码： jan_sep = employer_g != F1employer_g; reemp = first k with F`k'employer_g != employer_g & non-missing; gap = reemp-1; cap 24
    复制代码 · script/analysis/fig4/preprocess_fig4b.do; paper Section 3.2 and Figure 4 note
  • Annual earnings (register) 劳动收入与收入
    Annual earnings are wage income LOENMV_13 from the income register (IND); self-employment income is NETOVSKUD_13 kept separately. Realized earnings growth 2020-2021 is ln(earnings_2021*100/102) - ln(earnings_2020), dropping observations with earnings below 24,000 DKK in either year and trimming at the 1st/99th percentile.
    登记库： IND
    代码： LOENMV_13 (earnings), NETOVSKUD_13 (self-employment income); threshold 24,000 DKK; deflator 100/102; winsor2 trim 1/99
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_b_annual_data.R; script/analysis/fig7/preprocess_fig7.do; paper Figure 6 note
  • Net wealth and liquid wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Net wealth = (KOEJD + BANKAKT + KURSAKT + OBLAKT + PANTAKT) - (BANKGAELD + GAELD_TIL_OFF + OBLGAELD + PANTGAELD), missing public debt set to 0. Liquid wealth = BANKAKT + KURSAKT + OBLAKT + PANTAKT. Pension wealth is the sum of PF_FORMUE across contracts in PENSFORM.
    登记库： IND, PENSFORM
    代码： KOEJD, BANKAKT, KURSAKT, OBLAKT, PANTAKT, BANKGAELD, GAELD_TIL_OFF, OBLGAELD, PANTGAELD; PF_FORMUE
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_b_annual_data.R
  • Monthly UI, cash benefits and retirement transfers 失业与福利金
    From ILME monthly non-employee e-income records, amounts across A/B income fields are summed per person-month and classified by the income-type code of the largest payment: UI if VMO_INDK_ART codes 2,5,8,16,104; cash benefits if type code 6 or art codes 40,41,43,84,87; retirement if art codes 6,9,10,13,20,24,25,44,45,74,83,86,113,115.
    登记库： ILME
    代码： VMO_INDKOMST_ART_KODE UI: 2,5,8,16,104; CB: VMO_INDKOMST_TYPE_KODE 6 or ART 40,41,43,84,87; Retirement ART: 6,9,10,13,20,24,25,44,45,74,83,86,113,115
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_c_monthly_data.R
  • Public vs private sector 部门与行业
    Main job (highest LOENTIMER in IDAN per year) is public if ARB_SEKTORKODE is non-missing and not 99, and recoded private if ARB_SEKTORKODE is in 18, 28, 89, 81, 58, 48, 42, 52. Industry groups come from DB07 ranges of ARB_HOVED_BRA_DB07 (e.g. >=840000 public services, 850000 teaching, 860000 health).
    登记库： IDAN
    代码： ARB_SEKTORKODE private: 18,28,89,81,58,48,42,52; ARB_HOVED_BRA_DB07 6-digit DB07 ranges
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_b_annual_data.R
  • Occupation group 职业与职位层级
    Main job's DISCO_KODE first digit mapped to 9 groups (1 management, 2 high knowledge, 3 medium knowledge, 4 office, 5 sales/services, 6 farming, 7 craft, 8 skilled, 9 unskilled); military (DISCO below 100000) dropped. Tenure = year - ANSAAR.
    登记库： IDAN
    代码： DISCO_KODE first digit 1-9; DISCO_KODE<100000 excluded; ANSAAR
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_b_annual_data.R
  • Education level 教育与考试成绩
    Highest completed education HFAUDD (latest available year) mapped through the audd format's H1 level: 10 elementary; 20, 25 high school; 30, 35 vocational; 40, 50, 60 bachelor; 65, 70 master.
    登记库： UDDA
    代码： HFAUDD via uddan_2014_audd H1: 10; 20,25; 30,35; 40,50,60; 65,70
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_b_annual_data.R
  • Population survey weights 样本界定与时间
    Inverse predicted propensity scores from a probability model of survey participation estimated on 2020 administrative data on the demographics of Danes active in the labour market.

Beliefs About the Economy Are Excessively Sensitive to Household-Level Shocks: Evidence from Linked Survey and Administrative Data

Dmitry Taubinsky, Luigi Butera, Matteo Saccarola and Chen Lian · Quarterly Journal of Economics, 2026 · 个人

将丹麦统计局（Statistics Denmark）的消费者预期调查与登记库相链接，表明人们对通货膨胀的预测和回溯估计会随其自身近期和预期的收入变化强烈地反向变动，幅度远大于实际通货膨胀的相应变动。这一模式偏离了贝叶斯理性预期，而与情感线索回忆（affect-cued recall）相一致，即个人遭遇的坏事会引发悲观的回忆。

数据
Danish Consumer Expectations Survey (Statistics Denmark Omnibus), linked on CPR, Tax registers from SKAT: income, liquid assets, net wealth, taxes (IND, formue), Civil Registration System / Population register (CPR/BEF), Education register (UDDA), National Patient Register (LPR), emergency room visits 1994–2018
关键变量
  • 结果变量：通货膨胀的预测与回溯估计（定性和定量）
  • 解释变量：家庭对数名义收入的近期变化（t-1 对 t-2）
  • 解释变量：未来家庭收入变化及预期的家庭财务状况
  • 冲击：调查当月家庭成员急诊就诊
  • 基准：已实现的通货膨胀
时期
2012–2019 年（稳健性检验自 2008 年起；人口登记库自 1991 年起）
样本
35050 份可用答卷（来自 55171 名 25–60 岁调查受访者） 2012–2019 年 Danish Consumer Expectations Survey 中 25–60 岁、没有大额自雇收入且回答完整的受访者，与行政数据相链接。 来源
调查
Consumer Expectations Survey
变量如何定义（8）
  • Household total income 劳动收入与收入
    Yearly total income before taxes and labour market contributions, including labour income, public transfers, property income and most other taxable income attributable to the individual (excludes imputed rental value, pension contributions to employer schemes and lottery winnings). Household value is the average of the two spouses' values if a spouse is present in CPR, otherwise the individual value.
    登记库： IND, BEF
    代码： PERINDKIALT_13 (income); spouse via E_FAELLE_ID
    复制代码 · code_dstserver/code_epinion/2_build_registries.do; NBER WP w32664 Section 1.2 and footnote 6
  • Household labour income 劳动收入与收入

    复制代码 · code_dstserver/code_epinion/2_build_registries.do; NBER WP w32664 Section 1.2
  • Recent and future household income change 劳动收入与收入
    For a respondent interviewed in any month of year t, recent change = log nominal household income in t-1 minus t-2; future change = log income in t+1 minus t-1. Changes are trimmed at the 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles.
    登记库： IND
    代码： Log_Income_HH_L1L2, Log_Income_HH_F1L1; winsor2 cut(2.5 97.5) trim
    复制代码 · code_dstserver/analysis/A1c_sample_restrictions.do; NBER WP w32664 Section 1.3
  • Liquid assets and net wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Liquid assets follow Andersen et al. (2020): total value of bank deposits, stocks and bonds reported by financial institutions to SKAT. Net wealth is SKAT's tax-purpose measure of net household assets excluding non-deposited cash and foreign assets, with real estate at tax-assessed values; both averaged across spouses and used as asinh changes.
    登记库： IND
    工作论文 · Section 1.2 and footnote 7
  • Self-employment exclusion 样本界定与时间

An ER visit is an acute outpatient hospital contact in the NPR (recorded as patient type ER before 2014, acute outpatient from 2014). Survivors' Mental Health and the Protective Role of Income Stability

Itzik Fadlon, Astrid Sophie Fugleholm and Torben Heien Nielsen · AER: Insights, 2026 · 个人

基于丹麦全部家庭，记录了配偶去世后心理健康药物使用立即、大幅且持久的上升。这一激增有很大一部分可由配偶死亡造成的收入损失来解释，因此安全网提供的流动性保护了遗属的心理健康。

数据
Population Registry (BEF) with family linkages, Death Registry, National Patient Registry (LPR), Income Registry (earnings, transfers, pension payouts, capital income), Education Registry, Pharmaceutical Database / prescription register (LMDB), Health Insurance Registry (psychiatrist visits)
关键变量
  • 处理：配偶发生致命的心脏病发作或中风（12 个月内死亡），处理组对比事件发生较晚的对照组
  • 结果变量：心理健康药物的使用（ATC N05、N06）
  • 机制：配偶死亡造成的家庭收入损失（以去世配偶的劳动收入份额作为工具变量）
  • 异质性：基期收入、净财富和保险（DI/OAP、病假工资）
时期
1995–2018
样本
12,637 个处理组家庭和 15,212 个对照组家庭 45–80 岁的丹麦夫妇，其中一方在 1999 年至 2018 年间发生心脏病发作或中风并在 12 个月内死亡，不含自雇者，事件前后各四年为平衡面板。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Fatal heart attack or stroke (death event) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Robustness version requires the spouse to die from the same cause as the index health event within 12 months.
    登记库： LPR, Death Registry
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix, Figures B.2-B.3 notes
  • Mental health medication take-up 医疗服务利用
    Indicator for redeeming a prescription for psychotropic drugs classified as psycholeptics (ATC N05) or psychoanaleptics (ATC N06) by the surviving spouse, measured at monthly and annual frequency (extensive margin).
    登记库： LMDB
    代码： ATC N05, N06
    工作论文 · Section I (Variable definitions)
  • Household income loss 劳动收入与收入
    Household income decomposed into seven sources for each spouse: earnings, sick pay, DI + old-age pension (OAP), other government benefits, private pensions, capital income and other income, compared between the year before (period -1) and the year after (period 1) the index event. In 2SLS the household income loss is normalized at the treatment-group mean and winsorized at the top and bottom 1 percent.
    登记库： Income Registry (IND)
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix, Tables B.4-B.7 notes
  • Deceased's income share (instrument) 劳动收入与收入
    Household income loss is instrumented with an indicator for whether the deceased spouse had earnings and a quadratic in the share of household income earned by the deceased spouse in the year before the event; 2SLS uses observations for years -1 and 0 with household FE, calendar-year FE and a quadratic in the survivor's age; SEs clustered by household.
    登记库： Income Registry (IND)
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix, Table B.7 notes
  • Treatment/control by event timing 样本界定与时间
    Households where one spouse has a health event 1999-2018 and dies within 12 months; treatment = event in 1999-2013, control = similar event in 2004-2018 with placebo event assigned five years earlier; both spouses aged 45-80 at baseline; balanced from four years before to four years after. Specifications include household FE, calendar-year FE and a quadratic in the surviving spouse's age. For Delta = 3-7 robustness the calendar interval of treated spousal deaths is held fixed so only the control group changes. Variables are measured in the year before the actual or placebo event.
    登记库： BEF, LPR, Death Registry, IND
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix, Table B.1-B.3 and Figure B.8 notes
  • Baseline psychiatric treatment 医疗服务利用
    Indicator for whether the surviving spouse had psychiatric treatment (visits to psychiatrists recorded in the Health Insurance Registry from 1990), used as a heterogeneity/control variable.
    登记库： SSSY, SYSI
    工作论文 · Section I (Data); Section III.B robustness
  • Deceased earner status 劳动收入与收入
    Indicator for whether the deceased spouse had labour market earnings in the year before the health event; used to split households (earner vs non-earner) and as an instrument.
    登记库： Income Registry (IND)

OAP for all residents from full retirement age, rising from 65 to 67 for cohorts born after 1954; both means-tested against own and partner income and independent of earnings history.

Taxing the Wealth of the Poor: Evidence from the Danish Old-Age Support Asset Test

Niels Johannesen, Johan Sæverud and Emmanuel Saez · AER: Insights, 2026 · 个人

丹麦老年补助的资产审查使符合条件者的流动资产在略低于门槛处形成分散但规模很大的超额质量（相对于可比的不符合条件群体而言）。出生队列分析表明，这一审查使门槛附近的流动资产减少约 20%；高频银行数据显示，这些反应是永久性的，而非围绕审查日期所作的时点调整。

数据
Administrative registers on assets, income and demographics (Statistics Denmark): third-party reported and self-reported liquid wealth, Danske Bank customer data: monthly spending, cash withdrawals and account balances (2014–2016)
关键变量
  • 驱动变量：流动财富相对于老年补助（old-age check）资产审查门槛的位置
  • 结果变量：流动财富在门槛下方的聚束 / 超额质量
  • 结果变量：年末支出与现金提取（银行数据）
  • 资格条件：65 岁及以上且低收入
时期
2014–2018 年（主要截面）；银行数据为 2014–2016 年
样本
60 岁及以上单身者 2,526,421 个观测值（65 岁及以上 2,054,987 个；低收入 65 岁及以上 1,283,721 个），为 2014–2018 年混合数据；银行样本 461,471 个观测值，2014–2016 年 丹麦 60 岁及以上的单身者，其中链接的 Danske Bank 子样本约占老年人口的 20%。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Default liquid wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Third-party-reported year-end value of current accounts, savings accounts and securities accounts (bank deposits and listed securities); excludes durables, real estate and pension accounts and does not net out debt. Available for the full population; mirrors the 'default wealth' the authorities use for the old-age check asset test.
    登记库： IND, Statistics Denmark administrative wealth registers
    论文正文 · Section I.A and I.C; Table 1 notes; Figure 1 notes
  • Reported liquid wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Default liquid wealth plus self-reported corrections submitted via the government website (e.g. adding cash, reducing account balances); available only for individuals above the statutory retirement age. The variable available to the authors does not capture corrections made close to year-end.
    登记库： SOCP, IND
    论文正文 · Section I.A and I.C; Table 1 notes
  • Total wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Default liquid wealth plus pension wealth and housing wealth, net of liabilities (approximates total net wealth for the low-income elderly).
    登记库： IND, PENSFORM
    论文正文 · Figure 1 notes (panel B)
  • Old-age check eligibility (age and income) 退休与养老金
    Age-eligible = aged 65 or older (statutory retirement age in the sample period). Low-income (income-eligible) = income, net of social security and before self-reported corrections, below the threshold at which the old-age check is fully phased out (disregard DKK 42,000, phase-out rate 34% for singles in 2020). Asset test: check lost entirely when liquid wealth at end of t-1 exceeds DKK 90,000 (2020 value; threshold raised 15% in 2010). For the 2001-2007 reform analysis the 2003 income threshold is applied throughout.
    登记库： IND, SOCP, BEF
    论文正文 · Section I.A; Figure 1 and 2 notes; Supplemental Appendix Figure A.4 notes
  • Treatment and control groups for bunching 样本界定与时间
    Treated: low-income singles aged 65+. Controls: low-income singles aged 60-64 (age-ineligible) and singles aged 65+ with incomes between 150% and 200% of the full phase-out income threshold. Sample restricted to singles; main cross-section pools 2014-2018 (2014-2016 for bank data).
    登记库： BEF, IND
    论文正文 · Section I.C (Sample); Figure 1 notes (panel C)
  • Excess mass below asset-test threshold 财富、负债与消费
    Panel version: dummy for default liquid wealth between 50% and 100% of the asset-test threshold regressed on age dummies and individual fixed effects for low-income elderly born 1941-1945, coefficients relative to age 64; bunching jumps by 2.5 points at eligibility age 65 and keeps rising with age. Liquid wealth inflated to 2020 values with the growth rate of the asset-test threshold; DKK 5,000 bins.
    登记库： IND, BEF
    代码： 50%-100% of threshold window; reference age 64
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix, Figure A.3 notes
  • Cohort-approach counterfactual 样本界定与时间
    For single income-eligible individuals born 1941-1945, compare the indexed liquid wealth distribution at ages 70-74 (five to nine years into eligibility) with ages 60-64 (before eligibility); only those income-eligible in a given year are included (unbalanced panel).
    登记库： IND, BEF
    论文正文 · Section II (Cohort Approach); Table 1 Panel B2 notes
  • Bank liquid wealth, spending and cash withdrawals 财富、负债与消费
    Bank data 2014-2016 used to compare spending and changes in consumer debt in December, January and other months by bank liquid wealth (DKK 5,000 bins), for age-eligible (65+) low-income singles vs age-ineligible (60-64) low-income singles.

Maximum check raised above indexation in 2005, 2007, 2009 and 2013; asset-test threshold raised about 15% above indexation in 2010; income test (phase-out start and end thresholds) very strict initially but unchanged in real terms since 2005 except a small increase in 2019.

Financial Frictions: Micro versus Macro Volatility

Renato Faccini, Seungcheol Lee, Ralph Luetticke, Morten O. Ravn and Tobias Renkin · American Economic Review, 2026 · 个人

把丹麦家庭与其主要往来银行的利率相链接，度量家庭层面的消费信贷利差，并将其与推算的消费和财富动态联系起来。利差越高，负债家庭和低财富家庭的消费越低，消费对收入也越敏感，因此消费对收入的平均反应是逆周期的。一个按丹麦数据校准、含银行部门的 HANK 模型表明，银行杠杆率较低会降低总体波动，但可能在家庭层面提高波动并降低福利。

数据
Statistics Denmark annual register data, 2003–2018: age, sex, education, household characteristics, income and wealth compiled from administrative and income tax return data, Tax-return reports of end-of-year balances on every bank account (deposits and bank loans), linking households to their banks, Danmarks Nationalbank MFI statistics microdata: bank-reported average loan and deposit interest rates, merged at Statistics Denmark, Danish National Accounts and aggregate MFI balance-sheet data (model calibration targets)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：推算的家庭消费（收入减养老金缴费再减净资产变化）
  • 结果变量：转入零净财富状态
  • 核心解释变量：家庭层面的消费信贷利差（主要贷款银行的贷款利率减去主要存款银行的存款利率）
  • 核心解释变量：残差化的家庭税后收入
  • 异质性：以中位数收入的周数计的净财富分组
时期
2003–2018
样本
17,984,847 个家庭—年份观测值（表 1）；2007 年 2,145,397 个家庭，2012 年 2,316,459 个，2017 年 2,395,008 个（附录表 A1） 2003–2018 年的丹麦家庭，剔除有自雇成员或有大额经营收入的家庭、当年或上一年发生住房交易的家庭、推算消费为负的家庭，以及处于财富或收入分布最高和最低 1% 的家庭。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Imputed household consumption 财富、负债与消费
    Following Crawley and Kuchler (2023): C_it = Y^L_it + Y^F_it - P_it - (A_i,t+1 - A_it), where Y^L is after-tax labor income net of transfers, Y^F is after-tax financial income, P is contributions to privately administered pension schemes and A_it is beginning-of-period net assets. The net worth measure used for imputation includes portfolio wealth, bank deposits and bank debt reported in tax return data (and some large durables such as cars) but excludes net housing wealth, pension wealth and business wealth. Capital income excludes unrealized capital gains but includes realized gains on certain securities. Deflated by the consumer price index.
    登记库： Income and wealth tax return data (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： C = Y^L + Y^F - P - (A_t+1 - A_t)
    工作论文 · Empirical section, subsection A 'Data and Measurements' (headed I.A in the accepted manuscript, cited as Section II in its text), equation (1) and footnote 4
  • Household-specific consumer credit spread (RS_it) 财富、负债与消费
    Households report end-of-calendar-year balances on all bank accounts to the tax authorities. A household's primary bank connections for loans and for deposits are the banks in which it has the largest end-of-year balance. The spread is the loan rate at the primary loan bank minus the return on deposits at the primary deposit bank, using the averages of the rates the banks applied during year t; for households without loans the loan rate of the primary deposit bank is used. Bank loans include credit card debt, overdrafts, bank loans and student loans. Rates of Mortgage Credit Institutions are not in the MFI data, so the spread refers to non-mortgage debt.
    登记库： Tax-reported bank account balances, Danmarks Nationalbank MFI statistics microdata
    工作论文 · Empirical section, subsection A 'Data and Measurements' (headed I.A in the accepted manuscript, cited as Section II in its text)
  • Net wealth and the zero-net-wealth state 财富、负债与消费
    Net wealth is the value of assets (housing, bank deposits, financial investments such as shares and bonds) minus liabilities (any form of bank or mortgage debt), excluding business and pension assets. Net wealth bins are defined in weeks of median income. A household is in the zero-net-wealth state when its net assets are within plus/minus two weeks of median household income (in 2007); 8.7 percent of households are in this state.
    登记库： Wealth tax return data (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： |net wealth| <= 2 weeks of median household income
    工作论文 · Empirical section, subsections A-B (headed I in the accepted manuscript); notes to Figures 2-3 and Table 1
  • Household sample selection 样本界定与时间
    Annual register data for 2003-2018. Excluded: households with self-employed members or with substantial income from private businesses; households involved in a housing transaction in the current or previous year; households with negative imputed consumption; households in the bottom and top one percent of the wealth or income distribution; and the first observation for each household. About 18 million household-year observations remain.
    代码： Top and bottom 1% of wealth or income dropped; housing transaction in t or t-1 dropped
    工作论文 · Empirical section, subsection A 'Data and Measurements' (headed I.A in the accepted manuscript, cited as Section II in its text)
  • Residualised household income 劳动收入与收入
    Real household after-tax income; consumption and income are residualised by regressing the log on household and time fixed effects and on household characteristics: age of household head, household size, number and age of children, and household head education.
    登记库： Income tax return data (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Empirical section, subsection B (headed I.B in the accepted manuscript), equations (2) and (3)

  • Decline in 5-year survival probability due to cancer 健康结果、诊断与死亡

    Percentage change in labour income plus transfers in post-diagnosis years relative to the five-year pre-diagnosis average, regressed on municipality fixed effects, age fixed effects, a cubic in pre-diagnosis income rank and year effects, separately pre-reform (1987-2006) and post-reform (2007-2018).   • Monthly household consumer spending 财富、负债与消费

Spending Response to a Predictable Increase in Mortgage Repayments: Evidence from Expiring Interest-Only Loans

Henrik Yde Andersen, Stine Ludvig Bech and Alessia De Stefani · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2024 · 个人

将丹麦全部住房抵押贷款与借款人的登记数据相匹配，研究只付息贷款上完全可预期的本金摊还的开始。当分期还款额的增幅相当于收入的 9% 时，消费下降相当于收入的 3% 并维持在低位；未能平滑消费的情况集中在杠杆率高、很可能申请不到新的只付息贷款的借款人中。

数据
Mortgage registry: loan-level data on the universe of Danish mortgages reported by mortgage institutions to Danmarks Nationalbank (from 2009), Income and wealth registers (IND/FORMUE): household income, bank deposits, stocks, bonds, pensions, debts, Population/household registers (BEF): family composition, residence, Imputed household consumption from income and wealth registers
关键变量
  • 处理：只付息期届满（开始摊还本金）
  • 结果变量：推算的家庭消费相对于收入的比例
  • 分期还款额增幅相对于收入的比例
  • 异质性：贷款价值比和流动性储蓄
时期
抵押贷款登记库 2009–2018 年；只付息（IO）贷款发放于 2003–2007 年、到期于 2013–2017 年
样本
46,025 个家庭—年度观测值（基准回归）；8,813 个开始摊还本金的家庭 持有 2003–2007 年发放、只付息（IO）期在 2013–2017 年届满的只付息住房抵押贷款并保留原贷款的丹麦家庭，不包括自雇者和住房买卖者。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Expiring interest-only loan sample / treatment year 样本界定与时间
    Households with a mortgage loan taken in year t-10 that started with an interest-only (IO) period lasting at least 9 years (IO length = years between IO start and end dates in REAL) and that survives from t-1 to t; treatment year is when the IO period expires; event time = year - treatment year. Households with any self-employed member, non-tax-liable members, or a property purchase/sale/ownership change in event years -1 to 1 are dropped.
    登记库： REAL, BEF, EJER
    代码： y_laanoptag = t-10 & l_afdragsfrihed_aar >= 9; drop if selvst, ikkeskattepligtig, or koebt/solgt/ejerskift in t_count -1..1
    复制代码 · 1_Extractdata.sas macro 'sample' lines ~119-135; 4_VarDefinition.do section 1
  • Imputed household consumption 财富、负债与消费
    Family disposable income (excluding imputed rent of own home) plus one-off pension payouts (ATP, SP, LD, withdrawn pensions) net of their tax, minus savings in bank deposits, minus stock savings corrected for price changes (change in stock holdings less lagged holdings x stock index return), minus foreign asset savings, minus repayments (afdrag) on mortgage, bank, mortgage-deed and foreign debt, minus private pension contributions. From 2010 the mortgage repayment uses loan-level REAL repayments (version 3).
    登记库： IND, FORMUE, REAL
    代码： famforbrug1a / famforbrug3 = famdispindk + (famatp_engang+famsp_pension+famld_udbetal+famhaevpen) - taxes on these - op_famindestpi - (op_famkursakt - famkursakt_lag*makro_aktie/100) - op_famudlakt - af_famoblgaeld (or af_famrealgaeld) - af_fambankgaeld - af_fampantgaeld - af_famudprigael - fampripensindbetal
    复制代码 · 0c_Familydata.sas lines ~1586-1695
  • Outcomes scaled by lagged disposable income 财富、负债与消费
    Annual changes in household consumption, bank deposits, financial assets, bank debt and mortgage debt, and levels of installments and interest payments, divided by previous-year family disposable income (DISPON_13); all censored at the 1st and 99th percentile by year.
    登记库： IND, FORMUE, REAL
    代码： rdiffconsump = (famforbrug - L.famforbrug) / L.famdispon_13; rfamafdrag_for = famafdrag_for / L.famdispon_13
    复制代码 · 4_VarDefinition.do section 4
  • Liquid assets, debt-to-income, mortgage payment 财富、负债与消费
    Liquid assets = bank deposits + bonds + stocks (market value); total assets add housing value; liabilities = bank debt + mortgage outstanding; debt-to-income = total liabilities (QPASSIVN) / gross income (PERINDKIALT_13); total mortgage payment (ydelse) = installments + interest paid + administration fee (bidrag).
    登记库： FORMUE, IND, REAL
    代码： liq_assets = fambankakt + famoblakt + famkursakt; dti = famqpassivn/famperindkialt_13; ydelse = famafdrag_for + famrente_bet_nu + fambidrag
    复制代码 · 4_VarDefinition.do section 2
  • Refinancing behaviour at IO expiry 财富、负债与消费
    At the expiry year: loan stays (survives, no new loan in t-1, t, t+1); new IO loan taken in t-1, t or t+1; new amortising loan (no IO); or pays out the loan (none of the above).
    登记库： REAL
    代码： out_loan_stays, out_newloan_io, out_newloan_noio, out_paysout
    复制代码 · 4_VarDefinition.do section 3

How Do Households Respond to Job Loss? Lessons from Multiple High-Frequency Datasets

Asger Lau Andersen, Amalie Sofie Jensen, Niels Johannesen, Claus Thustrup Kreiner, Søren Leth-Petersen and Adam Sheridan · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2023 · 个人

将银行交易数据与政府登记库相结合，度量失业后家庭自我保险的每一个调整边际。两年内，家庭削减的支出相当于收入损失的 30%，约一半的收入损失靠动用流动性余额弥补；配偶劳动供给、私人转移、房屋净值提取和消费信贷的贡献较小。

数据
Danske Bank customer transaction and account records (spending, income inflows, balances, loans), Monthly payroll and income transfer records (BFL/eIndkomst) from the Danish Tax Agency, Population register (BEF) household structure and spouse links, End-of-year account-level bank loan and deposit records from the Danish Tax Agency, Loan-level mortgage data from mortgage banks (via Statistics Denmark), Mass layoff notifications to the Danish Agency for Labour Market and Recruitment, Annual income and wealth, education, home ownership and occupation registers
关键变量
  • 处理：失业事件（主要雇主停止发放工资，随后领取失业救济金）
  • 结果变量：家庭支出（银行卡、移动支付、账单、ATM 取现）
  • 结果变量：流动资产净储蓄、非住房抵押贷款债务的偿还、住房抵押贷款再融资与房屋净值提取
  • 结果变量：配偶劳动收入、私人转移、政府转移
  • 设计：自失业前 18 个月至失业后 24 个月的月度事件研究
  • 子样本：大规模裁员造成的非自愿失业
时期
2009 年 1 月–2016 年 12 月（失业发生于 2010 年 7 月–2015 年 12 月）
样本
10,002 人（由活跃银行客户构成的基准样本）；失业者总样本为 66,844 人 1950–1979 年出生、在至少 18 个月的稳定劳动收入之后于 2010 年 7 月至 2015 年 12 月间失去工作的丹麦人，其所在家庭结构稳定且为 Danske Bank 的活跃客户。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Job loss event 失业与福利金
    Month in which wage payments from the individual's main employer cease and total gross wage income drops below DKr 1,000; the individual must receive unemployment benefits or social insurance in months -1 to 3 and no early retirement, sickness or parental leave benefits then, must have had gross wage income of at least DKr 10,000 for at least 18 consecutive months before, and must not return to the same employer within three months.
    登记库： Monthly payroll and income transfer records (Danish Tax Agency, via Statistics Denmark)
    论文正文 · Section III
  • Analysis sample and event window 样本界定与时间
    Baseline sample of active customers: at least five outgoing spending transactions in each month of the event window, with the partner (if any) meeting the same criterion. Exclusive-customer subsample: active customers (and partners) with no deposits or loans at other retail banks. Characteristics measured in month -6 relative to job loss (annual income over the calendar year containing month -6; shares held at other banks and mortgage debt at end of previous calendar year).
    登记库： Danske Bank; tax records; mortgage data
    代码： >= 5 spending transactions per month
    在线附录 · Table A1 notes
  • Mass layoff subsample 样本界定与时间
    Mass layoff notifications from the Ministry of Employment (firms with >20 employees must report planned large-scale layoffs; 'large scale' ranges from 10 workers for firms with 20-100 employees to 30 workers for firms with >300 employees), linked by firm ID to Tax Agency payroll data; individuals whose employer's report date falls in months -7 to -1 relative to the observed layoff month; 1,156 individuals.
    登记库： Ministry of Employment mass layoff notifications; BFL/eIndkomst
    代码： report in months -7 to -1
    在线附录 · Appendix E
  • Household disposable income (bank inflows) and components 劳动收入与收入
    Disposable income = sum of monthly incoming direct deposits, person-to-person transfers from outside the household and cash deposits into Danske Bank accounts owned by the affected person and/or spouse (excluding transfers between own accounts). Wage income: inflow coded as wage if sender's bank registration number (4-digit Danish bank code) is the one mapped to the recipient's employer in that month (mapping = registration number from which the highest share of the employer's payroll employees, per Tax Agency payroll data, received payments; second-ranked used if top is the central-government number and employer is not central government), or if transaction type code is e.g. 'salary transfers'. Joint-account wage payments go to the spouse if from the spouse's employer, otherwise to the affected person. Government transfers: sender registration number linked to a paying agency per payroll data, or the central-government registration number when person does not work for central government. Private transfers and other income = residual.
    登记库： Danske Bank transactions; BFL/eIndkomst monthly payroll and transfer records
    在线附录 · Appendix A (Income variables) and Appendix C
  • Total spending (transaction based) 财富、负债与消费
    Sum of outgoing card payments (incl. mobile-phone payments), bill payments and cash withdrawals from the household's bank accounts, excluding outflows identified via recipient MCC as tax or debt payments; excludes bank fees, securities purchases and uncategorized transfers. Bank aggregates raw transactions to daily totals per account x transaction type x recipient category. Household = affected person + spouse; joint-account outflows split evenly between owners.
    登记库： Danske Bank transactions
    代码： MCC-based exclusion of tax/debt payments
    在线附录 · Appendix A (Spending) and Appendix B
  • Spending subcategories (MCC-based) 财富、负债与消费
    Utilities: MCC 4900, 4812, 4814, 4821, 4899 or bill-payment label utilities/elec/gas/water/heating/internet/cable TV/telephone/TV license. Restaurants and bars: MCC 5813, 5462, 5811, 5812, 5814. Groceries: MCC 5411, 5422, 5441, 5499, 5921 or bill-payment label groceries.
    登记库： Danske Bank transactions
    代码： Utilities MCC 4900,4812,4814,4821,4899; Restaurants MCC 5813,5462,5811,5812,5814; Groceries MCC 5411,5422,5441,5499,5921
    在线附录 · Appendix A (Spending)
  • Net saving in liquid assets 财富、负债与消费
    Change in end-of-month balances on Danske Bank deposit accounts owned by the affected person or spouse plus outflows minus inflows of transactions with type code 'securities trade'.
    登记库： Danske Bank account records
    在线附录 · Appendix A
  • Net repayments on non-mortgage loans 财富、负债与消费
    Change in end-of-month balances on loan accounts (amounts owed coded as negative balances) owned by the affected person or spouse.
    登记库： Danske Bank account records
    在线附录 · Appendix A
  • Mortgage equity extraction and loan types (monthly) 财富、负债与消费
    Monthly mortgage portfolio reconstructed from annual end-of-year loan-level snapshots: loans tracked by unique loan ID; loans appearing/disappearing dated by origination of new loans, and, if ambiguous, termination month inferred by comparing interest implied by rate and balance with mortgage interest reported in annual tax returns. Adjustable-rate and interest-only indicators from loan type; average monthly payment imputed from remaining balance, time to maturity, interest rate and amortization profile; mortgage repayments = sum of average monthly payments over loans held at end of month.
    登记库： Mortgage bank loan-level data (end-of-year); tax returns (interest)
    在线附录 · Appendix A and Appendix D

Consumption Heterogeneity: Micro Drivers and Macro Implications

Edmund Crawley and Andreas Kuchler · AEJ: Macroeconomics, 2023 · 个人

采用一种能够修正以往基于登记数据的估计中偏误的方法，估计丹麦各类家庭的边际消费倾向。流动性财富是边际消费倾向（MPC）最主要的预测因素，作者还利用估计出的异质性量化丹麦和美国的货币政策传导。

数据
Tax-authority income records (household after-tax and transfer income), Tax-reported wealth data: bank deposits, loans, bond and stock holdings, mortgages (year-end balances), Private pension contribution records, Civil Registration System (CPR) family/household links, Mortgage reset data (amount resetting over the following year)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：推算的家庭支出（收入减去养老金缴款，再减去非住房净资产的变动）
  • 冲击：户主的税后家庭收入的未预期（残差）变动
  • 异质性：流动性财富（银行存款）五分位
  • 异质性：未对冲利率敞口（Unhedged Interest Rate Exposure，URE）和净名义头寸（Net Nominal Position，NNP）
时期
2003–2015
样本
2004 至 2015 年的 770 万个观测值 2008 年户主年龄在 30–55 岁的丹麦家庭，不包括企业主、有住房交易的家庭，以及收入和收入变动处于最高/最低 1% 的家庭。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Household definition and head 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Households have one or two adults; two cohabiting adults are one household if (i) married or in a registered partnership, (ii) have at least one common child in the Civil Registration System, or (iii) are of opposite sex, age difference of 15 years or less, not closely related and with no other adults present. Children under 25, never married and childless belong to the parents' family. The head is the highest earner over the 13-year sample period.
    登记库： Civil Registration System (CPR) family links
    工作论文 · Section 4.1, footnotes 26-27
  • Imputed household expenditure 财富、负债与消费
    C = Y - P - dNW: after-tax income (all labor and capital income, excluding capital gains) minus contributions to privately administered pension schemes minus the change in non-pension, non-housing net worth between 31 December of t-1 and t. Households in housing-transaction years and with more than trivial business income are excluded; equity holders are assumed to hold a diversified stock index; household-years with negative imputed expenditure (about 3 percent) are discarded.
    登记库： Tax-authority income records, Tax-reported wealth data, Private pension contribution records
    工作论文 · Section 4.2
  • Unexpected income change 劳动收入与收入
    After dropping the top and bottom 1 percent of household after-tax-and-transfer income, income is normalized by average household income over the period and regressed on dummies for age, year, highest education, marital status, homeowner status and number of children plus age interactions with education, marital and homeowner status; the year-to-year change in the residual is the unexpected income change, trimming the top and bottom 1 percent. Expenditure residuals are constructed the same way.
    登记库： Tax-authority income records, Education register, Population register
    工作论文 · Sections 4.1 and 4.2
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Households whose head is aged 30-55 in 2008 (to exclude young/old whose income growth is likely anticipated and whose income variance is non-constant). Out-of-sample exposures allocated to seven bins: young (<30) heads, old (>55) heads, pension funds (incl. children's savings accounts), government, non-financial corporates, financials, rest of the world.
    登记库： CPR household links
    代码： head age 30-55 in 2008
    在线附录 · Online Appendix E and G
  • Liquid wealth quintiles 财富、负债与消费
    Households are assigned to quantiles by their mean level of liquid wealth (or income, etc.) over the sample period (long-term quintiles); liquid wealth is the end-of-year balance, averaged in real terms over 2009-2015 in descriptive comparisons.
    登记库： Tax-reported wealth data
    在线附录 · Online Appendix E.1 and Table F.1 notes
  • Unhedged Interest Rate Exposure (URE) 财富、负债与消费
    Household URE = annual savings (after-tax income minus imputed expenditure) plus maturing assets minus maturing liabilities. Maturing assets: all bank deposits (assumed floating) plus 20% of securities (5-year maturity assumed). Maturing liabilities: all bank debt (assumed floating), mortgage debt contractually due to reset its interest rate in the coming 12 months (counted at half weight since the new rate applies half the year; voluntary refinancing excluded), and other liabilities with an assumed 5-year maturity. Non-household sectors' maturity calibrated to 3.65 years so economy-wide URE sums to zero.
    登记库： Tax-reported wealth data, Mortgage reset data (Danmarks Nationalbank)
    代码： securities 20%; mortgage resets within 12 months
    在线附录 · Online Appendix H.1-H.2
  • Net Nominal Position (NNP) 财富、负债与消费
    Household NNP = financial assets minus liabilities, averaged over 2009-2015 and deflated by CPI. Assets: bank deposits plus market value of securities excluding shares. Liabilities: all debt to financial institutions (including credit card debt), publicly administered student debt, tax debt and other debt to government bodies, as reported to the tax authorities by financial institutions. Other sectors from national financial accounts: net assets in currency and deposits, securities other than shares, loans, and trade credits/other accounts receivable-payable.
    登记库： Tax-reported wealth data, Danmarks Nationalbank financial accounts
    在线附录 · Online Appendix H.1-H.2
  • Nondurable consumption proxy 财富、负债与消费
    Imputed expenditure adjusted using registry data on household car purchases to proxy nondurable consumption (details in online appendix G, not in this file).
    登记库： Car purchase registry data
    工作论文 · Section 7.2

Long-Run Saving Dynamics: Evidence from Unexpected Inheritances

Jeppe Druedahl and Alessandro Martinello · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2022 · 个人

父母猝然离世带来意料之外的遗产。继承人的财富先是跳升，随后在大约十年间回落到继承前的路径，这意味着财富的边际消费倾向处于中等水平，并为缓冲存货储蓄模型的校准提供了依据。

数据
Wealth data from yearly third-party financial institution reports in the income/wealth registers (IND/FORMUE: BANKAKT, KURSANP, etc.), Individual tax returns / Income register (IND) for disposable income, Housing and land registers (property values, number of housing units), Birth registers / parent-child links (BEF), Mortality register / Register of Causes of Death (ICD-10 cause of death)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：以永久收入标准化的净资产
  • 结果变量：流动性资产、住房净值、金融投资、无抵押债务
  • 处理：父母猝死的时点（ICD-10 I21–I22、V、X、Y、R96）
  • 潜在遗产：去世父母的净资产在子女间分配，并扣除遗产税
  • 永久收入：过去五年可支配收入的加权平均
时期
1995–2012
样本
6,286 名继承人 继承时年龄为 25–50 岁、其未婚的父亲或母亲在 1995 至 2012 年间猝死的继承人，潜在遗产超过一年的永久收入，不含最富有的 1%。 来源
变量如何定义（10）
  • Net worth 财富、负债与消费
    Sum of housing equity, liquid assets and financial wealth minus uncollateralized (bank) debt, at year end, CPI-deflated (2010=100) and divided by permanent income; pension funds and durables (cars, boats) excluded. Each component floored at 0 in code; individuals with net worth outside the 1st-99th percentile in any year are dropped.
    登记库： IND/FORMUE (GRUND files)
    代码： totassets = stocks(KURSANP+KURSAKT) + bonds(PANTAKT+OBLAKT) + KOEJD + BANKAKT; totdebts = mortgage(OBLGAELD+PANTGAELD) + BANKGAELD; networth = totassets - totdebts
    复制代码 · data/server/rawbuild.do ('Wealth' block, 'SAMPLE SELECTION'); CEBI WP 02-17 Table D.1
  • Liquid assets 财富、负债与消费
    Sum of cash and savings accounts held in Danish banks (BANKAKT), floored at 0, normalized by permanent income.
    登记库： IND/FORMUE
    代码： BANKAKT
    复制代码 · rawbuild.do; WP Table D.1
  • Housing equity 财富、负债与消费
    Value of owned real estate (KOEJD) minus collateralized debt (mortgage bonds OBLGAELD + other mortgage debt PANTGAELD, at market value of associated bonds at year end), normalized by permanent income.
    登记库： IND/FORMUE
    代码： hequity = KOEJD - (OBLGAELD + PANTGAELD)
    复制代码 · rawbuild.do; WP Table D.1
  • Financial wealth and uncollateralized debt 财富、负债与消费
    Financial wealth = market value of directly held stocks, bonds and mutual funds (KURSANP+KURSAKT plus PANTAKT+OBLAKT in code; WP lists KURSANP+KURSAKT+OBLAKT); uncollateralized debt = bank debts not associated with a bond (BANKGAELD). Both normalized by permanent income.
    登记库： IND/FORMUE
    代码： finw = max(0, KURSANP+KURSAKT + PANTAKT+OBLAKT); liqdebts = BANKGAELD
    复制代码 · rawbuild.do; WP Table D.1
  • Permanent income 劳动收入与收入
    Weighted average of current and four lagged years of disposable income: 0.45, 0.25, 0.15, 0.10, 0.05 for t to t-4; disposable income = BRUTTO + SKATFRIYD + AKTIEINDK - SKATMVIALT_NY, CPI-deflated; floored at DKK 60,000 in code. Inheritance is normalized by permanent income in the year before parental death.
    登记库： IND
    代码： dispinc = brutto + skatfriyd + aktieindk - skatmvialt_ny; perminc = filter(dispinc), coef(45 25 15 10 5) lags(0/4) normalise
    复制代码 · rawbuild.do ('Income'); WP Appendix D
  • Sudden parental death 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Parental death (1996-2012) is sudden if the primary cause of death has the listed ICD-10 codes. The WP states I21*-I22*, V*, X*, Y*, R96*; the replication code additionally includes I23, I24 and I46.
    登记库： Register of Causes of Death (doedsaars1), FTDB (parent-child links)
    代码： WP: ICD-10 I21-I22, V*, X*, Y*, R96; code: substr(doedsaars1,1,3) in I21,I22,I23,I24,I46,R96 or first letter V, X, Y
    复制代码 · rawbuild.do ('DEATHS AND INHERITANCE'); CEBI WP 02-17 fn. 7 and Appendix D
  • Potential inheritance 财富、负债与消费
    Deceased parent's gross bequest (max(0,housing equity) + financial wealth + liquid assets - uncollateralized debt, floored at 0, in the last observed year) split equally among all children (from FTDB), net of inheritance tax: if estate exceeds the exemption bundfr, net = (0.85*(estate - bundfr) + bundfr)/n_heirs. Where both parents die, the largest inheritance is kept. Normalized by heir's permanent income; main sample has potential inheritance > 1 year of permanent income.
    登记库： IND/FORMUE, FTDB2012, Register of Causes of Death
    代码： gross_bequest; n_heirs; bundfr (yearly exemption, e.g. 264,100 DKK in 2010); inhgroup==2 if inheritance>1
    复制代码 · rawbuild.do ('Remove taxes from inheritance'); main_analysis.do line ~96; WP Appendix D, Table D.3
  • Heir sample 样本界定与时间
    Heirs aged 25-59 in observed years, aged under 50 at the parental death (alder_atshock<50), with non-missing inheritance; net-worth outliers (outside p1-p99 in any year) dropped. WP: parents die unmarried between 1995 and 2012.
    登记库： BEF/GRUND, FTDB
    代码： inrange(alder,25,59); alder_atshock<50
    复制代码 · rawbuild.do ('SAMPLE SELECTION'); main_analysis.do lines 14-29; WP Section I
  • Labour income, salary and pension contributions 劳动收入与收入
    Labour income = ERHVERVSINDK (labour-market income incl. bonuses, compensations and self-employment income); salary = LOENMV (salary only); pension contributions = private (qpripen) plus labour-market (qarbpen) pension contributions.
    登记库： IND
    代码： erhv (labor_income), loenmv (salary), pencontr = qarbpen + qpripen
    复制代码 · rawbuild.do ('INCOME UPDATE'); WP Table D.2
  • Number of housing units owned 财富、负债与消费
    Count of distinct properties (ejendom number x municipality) owned by the individual in the ownership register (EJER), plus total ownership share.

Equilibrium Trade in Automobiles

Kenneth Gillingham, Fedor Iskhakov, Anders Munk-Nielsen, John Rust and Bertel Schjerning · Journal of Political Economy, 2022 · 个人

利用丹麦全部汽车保有记录（记录了每辆车的车主、车龄和报废情况），构建并估计了一个包含异质性家庭的新车与二手车市场动态均衡模型。作者用该模型评估丹麦极高的车辆登记税和燃油税，展示税收变动如何通过二手车价格和车队的车龄分布传导。

数据
Car ownership register covering all privately owned cars (Statistics Denmark extract), Odometer readings from mandatory vehicle inspections (driving), Demographic and income registers for all Danish households, Tax deduction for commuting distance (work distance), Fuel prices from eof.dk
关键变量
  • 结果变量：汽车保有状态的转换（保留、置换、购买新车、报废）
  • 汽车类型：按重量和燃油效率分为四类，25 个车龄组
  • 家庭类型：夫妻/单身、高/低收入、通勤距离远/近
  • 结果变量：行驶公里数
  • 政策变量：新车登记税和燃油税
时期
1996–2008 年（估计期为 1997–2008 年）
样本
近 3900 万个汽车保有状态转换观测值 1996–2008 年丹麦全部家庭以及私人拥有的全部汽车。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Car types (green/brown x heavy/light) 其他
    Cars are split by whether weight is above or below the median for the car's vintage cohort, then within each half by whether fuel efficiency is above (green) or below (brown) the median, giving four types; attributes are averaged within type. Cars are grouped into 25 age groups from new to 24+ years (cars over 22 years dropped from estimation).
    登记库： Car ownership register (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Appendix F.1 (Car types); Section 6.2
  • Household types 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Eight household types from couple vs single, high vs low work distance, and high vs low income, where the income split is at the median income within the demographic cell.
    登记库： Demographic and income registers
    工作论文 · Appendix F.1 (Household types); Table 2
  • High work distance 地理与社区
    Based on the Danish tax deduction for travel distance to work, which applies only to full-time workers living more than 12 km (each way) from their workplace; households with the deduction are classed as high work distance (slightly under half of Danes).
    登记库： Tax records (commuting deduction)
    工作论文 · Appendix F.1 (Household types)
  • Kilometres driven 其他
    Driving measured from odometer readings recorded at mandatory vehicle inspections, which occur biannually from car age 4 (ages 4, 6, 8, 10, ...).
    登记库： Vehicle inspection odometer data
    工作论文 · Appendix F.1 and footnote 32
  • Scrappage 其他
    Scrappage is not observed directly: a vehicle is defined as scrapped if an ownership spell ends and no other ownership spell ever begins afterwards (ownership register extract from September 2011, last sample year 2008, so at least about 3 years without an owner). Accidents are not observed.
    登记库： Car ownership register
    工作论文 · Appendix F.1
  • New car registration tax 税收与税率
    T(P) = 1.25 x [tau1 x min(P, K) + tau2 x max(P - K, 0)], with 25% VAT on the price including tax; in 2008 K = DKK 81,000, tau1 = 105% and tau2 = 180%. Fuel prices are country averages from eof.dk.
    登记库： Fuel prices (eof.dk)
    工作论文 · Appendix F.1
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Universe of Danish households and all privately owned cars, 1996-2008 (estimation on holdings 1997-2008, about 39 million household-year observations of car ownership transitions).
    登记库： Demographic registers, Car ownership register
    工作论文 · Appendix F.1; Section 6

Reference Dependence in the Housing Market

Steffen Andersen, Cristian Badarinza, Lu Liu, Julie Marx and Tarun Ramadorai · American Economic Review, 2022 · 个人

将丹麦的住房挂牌与交易数据同业主的登记数据相结合，估计一个包含损失厌恶和融资约束的挂牌与出售决策结构模型。家庭从相对于原始购买价的收益中获得效用，赋予损失的权重约为收益的 2.5 倍，这有助于解释房价与成交量的同向变动。

数据
Property ownership and transaction register from SKAT and the Building and Housing Register (BBR), 1992–2016, Tax-assessed property values (SKAT), Property listings data from RealView, 2008–2016, Loan-level mortgage data from Danmarks Nationalbank, 2009–2016, Civil Registration System (CPR/BEF) for demographics and household links, Income and wealth records from SKAT (IND/formue)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：挂牌决策以及相对于特征价格估值的挂牌溢价
  • 主要解释变量：相对于原始购买价（参照点）的潜在收益或损失
  • 相对于首付约束的潜在房屋净值
  • 由特征价格模型得到的预期房屋价值
  • 结构参数：损失厌恶
时期
2009–2016 年（交易数据自 1992 年起）
样本
214,103 条挂牌（191,507 个不同家庭，178,933 处不同房产）；住房存量为 807,345 处房产的 5,538,052 个观测值 2009 至 2016 年间丹麦自住住房的挂牌记录，包括已售出的和已撤回的，并与住房抵押贷款和家庭财务状况相匹配。 来源
变量如何定义（10）
  • Hedonic expected house value 财富、负债与消费
    ln(P_it) regressed on time x municipality effects, apartment indicator, and property characteristics: ln(lot size), ln(interior size), number of rooms, bathrooms, showers, unoccupied-at-sale dummy, ln(building age), rural dummy, historic-building dummy, ln(distance to nearest major city), all interacted with the apartment indicator, plus a third-order polynomial of the previous-year (biennial) SKAT tax-assessed value. R2 = 0.88 on sold listings (N = 114,303). Variants add repeat-sales residuals and lagged renovation deductions.
    登记库： BBR/BOL, EJVK, EJSA, EJMT
    在线附录 · Online Appendix C.1; Figure L.4 notes; E
  • Listing premium 财富、负债与消费
    l = ln(L) - predicted ln(P), where L is the initial listing price and predicted ln(P) is from the hedonic model.
    登记库： RealView, SKAT, BBR
    论文正文 · Section 4.1
  • Potential gain (vs reference price) 财富、负债与消费
    G = predicted ln(P) - ln(R), where R is the nominal original purchase price of the property; measurable only for properties bought in 1992 or later.
    登记库： SKAT property transactions, BBR
    论文正文 · Sections 3.5 and 4.1
  • Potential home equity 财富、负债与消费
    H = predicted ln(P) - ln(M), where M is the outstanding mortgage balance reported by the household's mortgage bank that year (multiple mortgages on a property summed; LTV and rate weighted); sellers with H < 20% are classed as potentially facing a binding down-payment constraint.
    登记库： Danmarks Nationalbank mortgage data
    论文正文 · Sections 3.3 and 4.1
  • Listings sample 样本界定与时间
    From 615,040 RealView listings of owner-occupied housing (excluding cooperative housing): drop unmatched in registers (-107,679), no reference price i.e. purchased before 1992 (-144,962), owner ID not uniquely determined (-71,876), non-household buyer i.e. government/company/organization (-10,382), foreclosures (-6,416), extreme prices (<100,000 DKK or >20,000,000 DKK in 2015 prices, or flagged extreme by Statistics Denmark; -5,499), owner ID not found, missing lot size or hedonic characteristics, listing date before previous purchase date, intra-family/special-circumstance sales, missing listing price; then drop summer houses (-24,098) and professional investors owning more than 3 properties (-18,312). Final: 214,103 listings 2009-2016 (172,225 with mortgage, 41,878 without), 191,507 households, 178,933 properties; 70.4% sold, 29.6% retracted. Extensive-margin stock sample: 5,538,052 observations of 807,345 properties.
    登记库： RealView listings, EJSA, EJER, EJVK, BBR/BOL, REAL, BEF
    代码： price bounds 100,000-20,000,000 DKK (2015 prices); >3 properties = investor
    在线附录 · Online Appendix C.5 and Table L.1
  • Household 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Households consist of one or two adults and any children below age 25 living at the same address, linked via the CPR family identification number; individual income and wealth are aggregated to the household. Household education = average years of education across all adults in the household; household age = average age in the household. The seller is the owner (CPR) at the beginning of the year of the transaction.
    登记库： CPR/BEF, UDDA, IND, EJER
    代码： children <25
    在线附录 · Online Appendix C.1, C.4 (fn 5), Figure L.29 notes
  • Mortgage balance and loan-to-value 财富、负债与消费
    Danmarks Nationalbank loan-level mortgage data (via Finance Denmark), annual 2009-2016, covering all mortgage banks: principal, outstanding balance, LTV and interest rate, with borrower CPR and property number. Multiple mortgages on a property are summed, with balance-weighted average interest rate and LTV.
    登记库： REAL (Boligfinansiering)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix C.3
  • Renovation tax deductions (BoligJob) 财富、负债与消费
    Proxy for maintenance/renovation: claimed BoligJob ('Boligjobordningen') tax deductions for labour costs of service work in the home, available from 2011, aggregated by household and linked to the seller; maximum 15,000 DKK per adult 2011-2015, then 12,000 DKK for maintenance/renovation and 6,000 DKK for other services (2016-2018). Used as 1-year lag (2012-2016) and 3- and 5-year cumulative lags.
    登记库： INDSLUT (Servicebidragsregister)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix E.3.1
  • Liquid and net financial assets 财富、负债与消费
    Liquid financial assets = cash, stocks and bonds; net financial assets = liquid financial assets minus short-term non-mortgage liabilities (mainly unsecured debt). Used as household controls with age and education length.
    登记库： IND (SKAT income and wealth records)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix K.1
  • Share of apartments and row houses (IV) 地理与社区
    Instrument: share of apartments and row houses (as defined in the BBR) listed in a given sub-market (municipality), capturing homogeneity of the housing stock.
    登记库： BBR
