Do People Respond to the Mortgage Interest Deduction? Quasi-Experimental Evidence from Denmark

Jonathan Gruber, Amalie Sofie Jensen and Henrik Kleven · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2021 · 个人

一项重大改革大幅削减了中高收入家庭的住房抵押贷款利息抵扣，其对住房自有率的影响被精确地估计为零。不过，改革确实降低了所购住房的面积和价格，减少了家庭负债，并压低了均衡房价。

数据
Income tax records (incomes, taxes, deductible interest expenses), Housing register (homeownership, property characteristics, home size), Tax authority property value appraisals (for imputed rent and wealth tax), Population registers with spouse/cohabitant and child links
关键变量
  • 政策：1987 年税制改革，降低了适用最高税率的纳税人的住房抵押贷款利息抵扣价值
  • 处理：最高税级纳税人与最高税级以下／中间税级／最低税级各组的比较（双重差分）
  • 结果变量：住房自有
  • 结果变量：住房面积（平方米）与住房价值
  • 结果变量：可抵扣利息支出总额（债务）
  • 对税后留存率（1−τ）的弹性
时期
1980–2011 年（主面板为 1980–1996 年）
样本
约 4000 万个个人—年份观测值；住房自有主回归中有 34,440,869 个观测值（以最高税级以下群体为对照组） 由 1980–1996 年每年均有观测的 20–80 岁丹麦人构成的半平衡面板，剔除与父母同住的子女。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Homeownership (household-based) 财富、负债与消费
    Baseline measure from housing records (living in an owner-occupied home) validated against the tax-record measure based on housing wealth available from 1987, for the population above age 20; housing-register measure is slightly lower in level because it misses owners not residing in their owned property. A variant uses only 'clean' cases (defined in main text).
    登记库： Housing register (BBR); tax records (housing wealth, from 1987)
    在线附录 · Figure A.I notes
  • Home size 财富、负债与消费
    Area of the house in square metres used for habitation, from the housing register.
    登记库： Housing register
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Home value 财富、负债与消费
    Appraisal of the property by the Danish Tax Authorities made for assessing imputed rental income and taxable wealth.
    登记库： Tax authority property appraisals
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Total deductible interest expenses 财富、负债与消费
    Interest paid on mortgage debt, consumer debt and other loans (all deductible), for homeowners; mortgage interest cannot be separated over the whole period.
    登记库： Income tax records
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Household tax bracket / treatment status 税收与税率
    A taxpayer is assigned to the top bracket if she or her spouse is in the top bracket, to the middle bracket if either is in the middle and neither in the top, and to the bottom bracket if both are in the bottom. Treated are those in the top bracket in every year 1984-1986; controls are in the middle or bottom bracket in every year 1984-1986.
    登记库： Income tax records, Population register spouse links
    工作论文 · Section 4
  • Net-of-tax interest rate 税收与税率
    (1 - tau) R, where tau is the marginal tax rate on negative capital income; the 1987 reform set this rate to 51 percent in all brackets (pre-reform top about 73, middle 62, bottom 48 percent in the average municipality), raising the net-of-tax rate by 81 percent for the top group, 29 percent for the middle and reducing it 6 percent for the bottom.
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, Figure 1
  • Semi-balanced panel 1980-1996 样本界定与时间
    Individuals observed in every year 1980-1996 while aged 20-80 (entering at 20, leaving after 80), giving 7 pre-reform and 10 post-reform years; about 40 million person-years.
    登记库： Population register
    工作论文 · Sections 3.2 and 4
  • Long-run balanced panel 1980-2011 样本界定与时间
    Very-long-run home size analysis uses a balanced panel of individuals observed in all years 1980-2011 (vs. main semi-balanced panel 1980-1996). Pre-trend robustness: group-specific linear trends estimated on 1983-1986 and residualized out.
    登记库： Housing register; population register

Spot Price Biases in Non-Linear Health Insurance Contracts

Marianne Simonsen, Lars Skipper, Niels Skipper and Anne Illemann Christensen · Journal of Public Economics, 2021 · 个人

丹麦处方药报销制度的报销比例随年度支出上升，并且每年重置。消费者在重置时点前后表现出前瞻性，但在年内对当期价格反应过度；解释这种即期价格偏误的是流动性约束，而不是对保险方案的理解能力或认知衰退。

数据
Population-wide individual data on prescription drug purchases and reimbursement under the Danish non-linear drug insurance scheme (registers not named in the abstract)
关键变量
  • 激励：药品的即期价格是年内累计支出的非线性函数
  • 激励：报销（免赔额）年度在年末重置
  • 结果变量：处方药购买的时点和金额
  • 异质性：流动性约束、对保险方案的理解能力、认知衰退
时期
所查资料中未注明
样本
所查资料中未注明 覆盖全体人口的数据，对象为适用非线性报销制度的丹麦处方药消费者（摘要中未提供细节）。 来源（摘要）
调查
Health Interview Survey 2000
变量如何定义（8）
  • Prescription drug spending and purchases 医疗服务利用
    The full history of prescription drug purchases from the Danish Prescription Drug Register (Laegemiddelstatistikregisteret), covering 1995-2014: date, shelf price, government coverage, type of coverage and type of drug. It is aggregated to daily (descriptive) or monthly (estimation) spending within coverage years. Outcomes include spending, number of pharmacy visits, and days until next purchase truncated at 365.
    登记库： Laegemiddelstatistikregisteret (Danish Prescription Drug Register)
    论文正文 · Section 3; Section 4 (outcomes before reset)
  • Coverage year and synthetic pre-reform coverage year 医疗服务利用
    Post-reform coverage years start with the first purchase after the March 2000 reform and reset 365 days after the first purchase, with the next year starting at the next purchase. Synthetic pre-reform coverage years apply the same rule from the first observed purchase, keeping only years that end by December 1999.
    登记库： Laegemiddelstatistikregisteret
    论文正文 · Section 2; Section 3
  • Spot price 医疗服务利用
    Coinsurance rate at the start of coverage month m given year-to-date spending, taking values 1, 0.5, 0.25, 0.15 or 0. Under the 2000 contract: a DKK 500 deductible, 50% coinsurance to DKK 1,200, 25% to DKK 2,800, 15% beyond, and a stop-loss at DKK 18,500 capping out-of-pocket costs at DKK 3,600. The spot price is 1 for the purchase that starts a coverage year.
    登记库： Laegemiddelstatistikregisteret
    论文正文 · Section 2, Figure 1; Section 5 (price definition a)
  • Expected end-of-year (shadow) price 医疗服务利用
    Average realised end-of-year price within cells of 5 age groups x 6 sextiles of predicted health spending x 100 percentiles of year-to-date spending, for each coverage month. Pre-reform counterfactual prices for 1998 are imputed by matching percentiles to pooled coverage years starting in 2000-2001.
    登记库： Laegemiddelstatistikregisteret
    论文正文 · Section 5 (price definitions b-c, steps i-iii)
  • Predicted pharmaceutical spending (health index) 医疗服务利用
    Following Handel (2013), year-t drug spending is regressed on year t-1 gender, age and age squared, number of GP office visits, fee-for-service payments to the physician, drug spending and its square, ATC level-3 drug-type indicators (88 categories), and hospital ICD-10 level-2 diagnosis indicators (215 categories). The model is then used to predict next year's spending; for coverage-reset analyses, covariates are measured in the 365 days before the coverage year starts.
    登记库： Laegemiddelstatistikregisteret, National Patient Register (hospital diagnoses), Health insurance (GP) records
    代码： ATC level 3 (88 categories); ICD-10 level 2 (215 categories)
    论文正文 · Appendix D
  • Chronic drug 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Following Alpert (2016), a drug at ATC level 3 (pharmacological subgroup) is chronic if its median consumer buys it in at least three calendar months of a year (more than twice).
    登记库： Laegemiddelstatistikregisteret
    代码： ATC level 3
    论文正文 · Section 3 footnote 5; Appendix C
  • Self-reported liquidity constraint 财富、负债与消费
    From the 2000 Danish National Health Interview Survey (DNHIS) question 'During the last 12 months, how often have you had trouble paying your bills'. Respondents answering at least 'some months' are coded as liquidity constrained (12%).
    登记库： DNHIS 2000 (survey linked by personal ID)
    论文正文 · Section 6 (mechanisms), Table 5
  • Plan literacy groups 教育与考试成绩
    'Economic literates' are individuals with a master-level degree in economics or business (ISCED level 7); medical professionals hold a university degree in medicine or pharmacology (ISCED levels 7-8). Cognitive decline is proxied by age 65 and above versus below 65.
    登记库： Education register
    代码： ISCED 7 (economics/business); ISCED 7-8 (medicine/pharmacology)
    论文正文 · Section 6, Table 5 notes

Financial Trouble Across Generations: Evidence from the Universe of Personal Loans in Denmark

Claus Thustrup Kreiner, Søren Leth-Petersen and Louise Charlotte Willerslev-Olsen · Economic Journal, 2020 · 个人

覆盖全部个人贷款的逐笔贷款记录显示，财务困境具有很强的代际持续性：父母违约的子女自身违约的可能性要高得多，这一相关性在成年早期就已出现，且不能由收入或教育来解释。

数据
Loan register from the Danish Tax Agency (SKAT): all personal loan accounts with default status (60+ days late), Population register (BEF) for parent-child links, Income-tax register and other administrative registers on labour market history, income and wealth, Credit bureau bad-payer files (Experian, Debitor Registret), 2009 snapshot, Survey of 1,748 individuals on risk willingness, patience and impulsivity (2014)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：子女个人贷款违约（逾期 60 天以上）
  • 关键解释变量：父母的违约状态
  • 来自问卷调查的偏好度量（风险承担意愿、耐心、冲动性）
  • 控制变量：收入、财富、教育、GPA
时期
2004–2011
样本
28,027,610 个父母—子女—年份观测值，涉及 2,501,088 人 2004–2011 年间所有 18–45 岁且至少有一位父母在世的丹麦人，按父母—子女—年份单元组织。 来源
调查
Preferences survey 2014
变量如何定义（9）
  • Loan default (financial trouble) 财富、负债与消费
    An individual is in default if at least one interest-bearing personal loan is at least 60 days late with payments at the end of the year, as reported by banks and other financial intermediaries to the Danish Tax Agency (SKAT); annual data 2004-2011 covering all loan accounts. Mortgage loans are supplied in separate files; loan type is otherwise not observed.
    登记库： SKAT loan register
    工作论文 · Section 3.1 and footnote 2; Figure 1 notes

    Alternative severity measures defining default at defaulted loan levels exceeding DKK 0, 10,000, 50,000 and 100,000 (the defaulted amount may reflect several smaller loans).
    登记库： SKAT loan register
    工作论文 · Figure notes (Panel B, defaulting at loan levels)
  • Bad-payer file registration 财富、负债与消费
    Recorded in the bad-payer files of credit bureaus Experian or Debitor Registret (snapshot of persons registered in 2009); people can be recorded after at least three reminders and a warning letter, for at most five years per missing payment.
    登记库： Experian bad-payer file, Debitor Registret
    工作论文 · Section 3.1 and footnote 3
  • Parent-child sample 样本界定与时间

  • Unemployment shock (event study) 失业与福利金

    登记库： Income register, Unemployment histories (Statistics Denmark)

  • Liquidity constraint indicator / financial wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Financial wealth = stocks + bonds + bank deposits; indicator for having financial assets at end of year below one month's worth of average disposable income over the five years preceding the shock year.
    登记库： Income and wealth registers (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Figure 8 notes
  • Historical parental asset path (instrument) 财富、负债与消费
    Ratio of parental financial assets to average disposable income for each year 1987-1996; parents are assigned to behavioural types by within-cohort decile of the average asset-income ratio over the ten years, used to instrument parental default in 2011.

Risk Attitudes, Sample Selection, and Attrition in a Longitudinal Field Experiment

Glenn W. Harrison, Morten I. Lau and Hong Il Yoo · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2020 · 个人

通过一项两轮田野实验检验风险偏好是否随时间保持稳定，样本为从民事登记系统（Civil Registry）中抽取的丹麦成年人。由于登记系统提供了拒绝邀请者的基本人口统计信息，且招募费是随机设定的，作者可以把风险选择与进入第一轮的选择以及第二轮之前的样本流失联合起来估计。忽略选择和流失会改变估计出的风险态度；对二者加以修正后，证据与风险偏好稳定相一致。

数据
Danish Civil Registration Office (CPR) random sample of 50,000 adults aged 18–75, with sex, age, residential location, marital status and immigrant status; 1,996 of them invited, Artefactual field experiment on risk attitudes: wave 1 in September–October 2009, wave 2 in April–October 2010 (collected by the authors), Post-experiment questionnaire for participants (self-reported household income)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：每位受试者每轮 40 次二元彩票选择，用于估计 EUT 和 RDU 下的风险偏好
  • 选择方程：全体受邀者是否参加第 1 轮，解释变量为登记系统中的年龄和性别、住所到酒店的距离以及招募费
  • 流失方程：是否参加第 2 轮，解释变量为年龄、性别、自报收入以及第 1 轮中的所得
  • 排除性约束：随机设定的固定招募费，300 或 500 克朗
时期
样本对 2009 年 1 月 1 日的成年人口具有代表性；实验于 2009 年 9 月 28 日–10 月 22 日和 2010 年 4 月–10 月进行
样本
第 1 轮 1,996 名受邀者（413 名参与者，1,583 名未参与者）；第 2 轮再次邀请 354 人（182 名参与者，172 名未参与者）；25,555 个选择观测值（表 1 和表 2 的注释） 从 Civil Registration Office 随机抽取并按地理区域分层的 18–75 岁丹麦人，受邀参加彩票选择实验；估计样本为全体受邀者，无论其是否参加。 来源
变量如何定义（4）
  • Invited sample from the Civil Registration Office 样本界定与时间
    A random sample of 50,000 Danes aged between 18 and 75, inclusive, was obtained from the Danish Civil Registration Office, with information on sex, age, residential location, marital status and whether the individual is an immigrant; the sample was drawn to be representative of the adult population as of 1 January 2009. It was stratified by geographic area and 1,996 invitations were sent; 413 took part between 28 September and 22 October 2009. The estimation sample is all 1,996 invitees. The authors note that the list of characteristics could be extended by merging at Statistics Denmark, which they did not do.
    登记库： Danish Civil Registration Office (CPR) extract
    代码： Age 18-75 inclusive; 50,000 drawn, 1,996 invited
    工作论文 · Section 2.A (Field Sampling Procedures) and footnote 14; Section 3.B (estimation sample)
  • Selection and attrition equation covariates 样本界定与时间
    The selection equation for wave 1 includes the recruitment fee indicator, home-to-hotel distance in miles and its square, and the subject's age and gender. The attrition equation for wave 2 includes actual earnings from the first experiment, age and gender, and self-reported income, which is only available for those who took part in the first experiment. Age groups: young = aged less than 30, middle = aged between 40 and 50, old = aged over 50; the omitted group is 30-39.
    登记库： Danish Civil Registration Office (CPR) extract
    代码： young < 30; middle 40-50; old > 50; omitted 30-39
    工作论文 · Section 3.B (discussion of Xn1 and Xn2); Table 1 panel B and notes; Table 2
  • Home-to-hotel distance 地理与社区
    Distance in miles between the invitee's home and the hotel meeting room where the wave 1 session was held, computed from geographical coordinates downloaded from Google Maps with a Stata command that measures the shortest curve between two locations on the earth's surface. Average distance was 10.2 miles for the 1,583 non-participants and 8.1 miles for the 413 participants.
    工作论文 · Section 2.A and footnote 16
  • Income groups (self-reported, participants only) 劳动收入与收入
    IncLow = household income in 2008 below 300,000 kroner; IncHigh = household income of 500,000 kroner or more. Self-reported in the experiment's questionnaire, not taken from registers.
    代码： IncLow: < 300,000 DKK; IncHigh: >= 500,000 DKK (household income, 2008)

Katrine Jakobsen, Kristian Jakobsen, Henrik Kleven and Gabriel Zucman · Quarterly Journal of Economics, 2020 · 个人

利用 1989 年丹麦财富税改革（大幅下调富人的税率）估计财富税对财富积累的长期影响。极富裕人群（前 1%）的反应相当可观，中等富裕人群的反应较小，而且效应在十年间持续扩大。

数据
Administrative wealth registry (third-party reported assets and debts, since 1980), Income registers and socio-economic registers (occupation, family composition)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：应税财富和第三方报送财富的对数

  • 处理：夫妻免税门槛翻倍（夫妻 DD）
  • 聚束分析的驱动变量：免税门槛附近的应税财富
  • 控制变量：改革前的资产组合份额和收入十分位
时期
财富数据始于 1980 年；准实验面板为 1985–1996 年
样本
138,384 个观测值（上限 DD）和 520,452 个观测值（夫妻 DD，夫妻与夫妻比较） 1989 年改革前处于财富分布前 1% 的丹麦家庭（上限 DD）或处于前 5% 的已婚夫妻（夫妻 DD）构成的平衡面板。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Household (tax unit) and married status 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Household id is the family id when the person's spouse id equals the cohabitation partner id and civil status is in the married range (up to 2007, from FAIN); from 2008 from BEF using spouse id = partner id and civil status G or P. Persons not so linked form their own household. Only persons aged 20+ are kept and wealth is summed within household.
    登记库： FAIN, BEF
    代码： FAIN (<=2007): aegtefaelle_id == c_faelle_id, c_status 2-5, hhid = c_familie_id; BEF (>=2008): aegte_id == efalle, civst in {G, P}; alder >= 20
    复制代码 · Empirical Analysis/DD_make_hh_ids.do
  • Household taxable wealth (outcome) 财富、负债与消费
    Household net taxable wealth = sum over household members aged 20+ of the wealth variable FORM from the income-tax register (INDH); outcome is log(FORM). Portfolio shares use INDK components: equity share = listed stocks / total assets, housing share = (mortgage deeds + real estate value) / total assets.
    登记库： INDH, INDK
    代码： FORM (INDH); share_tx_equities = KURSAKT/QAKTIVF; share_tx_housing = (KURSPANT+KOEJD)/QAKTIVF; other INDK fields: FORMSK, LOFTFORM, QPASSIV, PRIGALD, KONTANT, KURSOBL, INDESTPI

  • Wealth tax exemption threshold and marginal wealth tax 税收与税率
    Annual exemption threshold (allowance) by year; for couples it equals 2 x single allowance, except 1989-1992 when couples' allowance uses a separate married allowance x 2. Household marginal wealth tax rate tau_it = statutory rate if FORM exceeds the household allowance, else 0. Bunching analysis uses distance b = FORM - allowance, deflated, in DKK 20,000 bins from -540,000 to 540,000.

  • Ceiling DD treatment (unbound by tax ceiling) 税收与税率
    X = wealth tax actually paid (FORMSK) / theoretical wealth tax ((FORM - allowance) x tax rate). Treatment: household in top 1% of the wealth distribution with X > 0.99 in every pre-reform year of the window (e.g. 1982-1988), i.e. not bound by the tax ceiling; control: top 1% with X < 0.80 (bound by ceiling).     Treatment: married households with wealth between the (single) allowance and 2 x allowance in each pre-reform year (1988 and earlier years depending on window), which became exempt when the couples' threshold doubled in 1989; controls: (c1) singles with wealth in the same band, (c4) married couples in the top 5% with wealth below the allowance, or (c5) singles with wealth between allowance/2 and allowance.

Sources of Inaction in Household Finance: Evidence from the Danish Mortgage Market

Steffen Andersen, John Y. Campbell, Kasper Meisner Nielsen and Tarun Ramadorai · American Economic Review, 2020 · 个人

许多丹麦家庭在再融资明显有利可图时，仍未对固定利率住房抵押贷款进行再融资。一个包含疏忽（inattention）和心理再融资成本的模型能够拟合数据；教育程度、收入和金融财富较低的家庭，这两种摩擦都更强。

数据
Loan-level mortgage data for all Danish mortgages from Danmarks Nationalbank (via mortgage bank associations), Civil Registration System / population register (CPR/BEF) for demographics and household links, Income and wealth data from the Danish Tax Authority (SKAT) (IND/formue), Education register (UDDA)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：某一季度内对固定利率住房抵押贷款进行再融资
  • 激励：给定票面利率和市场利率下再融资的财务收益
  • 结构参数：疏忽的概率和心理再融资成本
  • 家庭特征：年龄、教育、收入、住房财富和金融财富
时期
2009–2017
样本
2,376,815 个家庭观测值（9,351,183 个家庭—季度）；378,421 次再融资 2009–2017 年间在连续年份被观测到、持有单笔固定利率住房抵押贷款的丹麦家庭。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Refinancing event 财富、负债与消费
    A refinancing occurs when a household changes from one fixed-rate mortgage to another mortgage (fixed- or adjustable-rate) on the same property; terminations from moves, death or divorce are handled separately as mortgage termination. Annual loan data are expanded to quarters using mortgage issue dates.
    登记库： Danmarks Nationalbank mortgage data, CPR
    工作论文 · Section 2.2.B Sample selection
  • Cash-out refinancing 财富、负债与消费
    A refinancing associated with an increase in mortgage principal of 10% or more.
    登记库： Danmarks Nationalbank mortgage data
    工作论文 · Section 2.1
  • Refinancing incentive (ADL threshold) 财富、负债与消费
    Interest rate spread = coupon rate on old mortgage minus yield on a newly available mortgage of roughly the same maturity. Threshold from the Agarwal, Driscoll and Laibson (2013) closed form with baseline interest-rate volatility 0.0074 and discount rate 5%; incentive = spread minus threshold. Household-specific mortgage termination probability (from a probit on moves/death/divorce terminations) enters the threshold. Robustness: volatility 0.0037, discount rate 2.5%, constant 10% termination probability, Chen and Ling (1989) thresholds.
    登记库： Danmarks Nationalbank loan-level mortgage data
    代码： sigma=0.0074 (baseline); discount rate 0.05 (baseline)
    在线附录 · Table B2; Appendices F-I, K-L
  • Household 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    'Single' households have only one adult living at the address (~13% of sample); 'Married' households have two legally bound adults, including registered same-sex partnerships. 'Children in family' = children in household; 'Immigrant' = an immigrant in the household; 'Getting married' = change in marital status over the sample; 'Having children' = child born within the last 12 months.
    登记库： Population register (CPR/BEF)
    在线附录 · Table B3 notes
  • Single fixed-rate mortgage sample 样本界定与时间
    All Danish households with an unchanging number of household members and a single fixed-rate mortgage at the beginning of each year 2010-2017; refinancing measured as a quarterly dummy. Robustness samples exclude cash-out and maturity-extension refinancings, exclude FRM-to-ARM refinancers, or restrict to mortgages over DKK 250,000 with horizon of at least 20 years.
    登记库： Danmarks Nationalbank loan-level mortgage data
    代码： mortgage > DKK 250,000 and horizon >= 20 (robustness)
    在线附录 · Appendices C-E
  • Financial literacy 教育与考试成绩
    'Financially literate' = a household member has a degree in finance or professional financial-industry training. 'Family financially literate' = non-resident parents, siblings, in-laws or children of the household are financially literate.
    登记库： Education register (UDDA), Population register
    在线附录 · Table B3 notes
  • Ranked household characteristics 财富、负债与消费
    Ranks computed each year across all sample households, normalized to [-0.5, 0.5]: age = age of oldest household member; education = years needed to reach the highest education of any household member (12 = high school, 16 = Bachelor's, 18 = Master's, 20 = PhD); income = total taxable household income; financial wealth = cash, bonds, stocks and mutual funds less non-mortgage debt; housing assets = value of properties. Specifications add a nonlinear transform f(x) of each rank.
    登记库： Tax register (income, wealth), Education register (UDDA), Population register
    代码： education years: 12/16/18/20
    在线附录 · Tables B3, B5 notes
  • Mortgage termination probability 财富、负债与消费
    Probit of a monthly dummy for full prepayment/termination (moving, death, divorce, etc.) on household demographic dummies and rank variables (with nonlinear transforms), fitted on all households with unchanging membership and a fixed-rate mortgage 2010-2017; fitted values feed the ADL threshold.

将有真实激励的时间贴现实验与登记库中一大批丹麦中年人样本的财富状况相链接。有耐心的人在财富分布中的位置明显更高，在控制教育、收入轨迹、学校成绩、初始财富和父母财富、信贷约束以及风险偏好之后，这一关联依然存在，表明储蓄行为是其中的渠道。

2009 年特别养老金（Special Pension）储蓄的发放起到了财政刺激的作用。以家庭支付的边际利率衡量约束的松紧程度，面临高边际利率的家庭支出反应最大，其余家庭反应很小，这支持把刺激政策瞄准受信贷约束的人群。

    Survey (Epinion) question: considering the increase in disposable funds from the SP payout, how did you allocate it: 1) increase spending, 2) increase free savings, 3) reduce debt, 4) increase pension savings; spending share in [0,1] (96% of answers 0 or 1). Main sample includes only respondents who withdrew the SP balance (N = 5,037); extended sample adds 215 non-withdrawers coded as zero spending. Probit robustness codes share >= 0.5 as 1.

  • Register net savings 财富、负债与消费

  • Imputed spending 财富、负债与消费

  • Low liquid assets dummy 财富、负债与消费

  • High debt service dummy 财富、负债与消费

Consumption Network Effects

Giacomo De Giorgi, Anders Frederiksen and Luigi Pistaferri · Review of Economic Studies, 2019 · 个人 + 企业

利用丹麦税务记录中的收入和资产信息测算家庭消费，并借助雇主—雇员匹配数据按工作场所界定同伴群体。作者以同伴自身不重叠的网络和企业所受的冲击作为同伴消费的工具变量，发现存在相当可观的消费溢出效应，足以产生宏观乘数，并且同时通过跨期和期内两种渠道起作用。

数据
Administrative income and wealth tax records (tax registry incl. wealth tax data), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA) for plant IDs and coworker networks, Danish Expenditure Survey (DES) 1994–1996
关键变量
  • 结果变量：根据收入和资产变动推算的家庭消费
  • 内生解释变量：同事家庭的平均消费（同伴消费）
  • 工具变量：距离为 3 的（不重叠）网络成员所受的企业层面冲击
  • 网络定义：同一工作场所（plant）的同事
  • 机制：可见性商品的预算份额（DES）
时期
1980–1996
样本
757,439 个家庭 户主年龄在 18–65 岁、夫妻双方均为在职雇员的丹麦家庭，并与夫妻双方的同事相关联。 来源
调查
Expenditure Survey
变量如何定义（6）
  • Imputed household consumption 财富、负债与消费
    Annual household consumption (spending) imputed from the budget constraint as C = Y - T - dA, where Y = gross income from all sources (labour and capital) + housing support + child support - implicit tax on the consumption value of owned housing, T = total taxes paid, and dA = change in assets (cash, bank deposits, stocks and shares, property value, cars and other vehicles, minus liabilities). Values in 2000 DKr.
    登记库： Tax records (income and wealth tax data)
    工作论文 · Section 2.1, eq. (1)
  • Co-worker network (weighted) 企业特征与生产率
    Co-workers are individuals working in the same plant (for public employees, the physical address of the workplace) from IDA. Baseline weights favour similar workers: with five education groups and three occupation groups (blue collar, white collar, manager), degree of separation d = |E_i - E_j| + |O_i - O_j| and weight (d+1)^-2; peers' consumption is the weighted average of co-workers' household log consumption.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 2.1; Section 5.1, eq. (11)
  • Distance-3 peers 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Starting from households where both spouses work, distance-1 peers are co-workers, distance-2 peers are the working spouses of co-workers, and distance-3 peers are the co-workers of the spouses of co-workers. Couples working in the same plant are excluded and feedback cases (where own household would serve as instrument for the peer) are discarded.
    登记库： IDA, Tax records
    工作论文 · Sections 4.1.2 and 5.1
  • Firm instruments (distance-3 firm shocks) 企业特征与生产率
    Weighted averages over distance-3 peers of their firm's size, firm-specific change in employment, firm type dummies (publicly traded, limited liability, other) and a public-sector dummy, all expressed in first differences. A separate set uses distance-3 peers' demographics (age, age squared, years of schooling, share women, occupation shares, kids 0-6 and 7-13).
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 5.2 (text before Table 4); Table 1
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Households 1980-1996 whose head is aged 18-65 and where both spouses work as employees (not self-employed); households are dropped from the year one or both members stop working or become self-employed. Peers' consumption is computed using all workers, including singles and one-earner households.
    登记库： Tax records, IDA
    工作论文 · Section 2.1; Online Appendix Table A1 (selection steps)
  • Visible / neutral / non-visible spending (DES) 财富、负债与消费
    Spending in the Danish Expenditure Survey is split using the Heffetz (2011) visibility index: visible = tobacco and alcohol, food away from home, clothing, furniture and home goods, electrics/appliances, vehicles, entertainment, books, education, personal care; neutral = food at home; everything else (insurance, rent, etc.) non-visible.
    登记库： DES (Danish Expenditure Survey)
    工作论文 · Section 2.2; Table A6

Born with a Silver Spoon? Danish Evidence on Wealth Inequality in Childhood

Simon Halphen Boserup, Wojciech Kopczuk and Claus Thustrup Kreiner · Economic Journal, 2018 · 个人

第三方报送的儿童财富记录显示，童年时期的财富不平等程度与成年人中一样高，顶端份额主要由父母和祖父母的转移所推动。18 岁时的财富能够预测成年后的财富，代际财富相关性在很小的年龄就已存在。

数据
Individual wealth data from tax return records (Danish Tax Agency SKAT, via Statistics Denmark), Population register with parent identifiers (BEF), Education and income registers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：子女成年后（45 岁）的财富及财富排名
  • 关键解释变量：童年财富（18 岁）与父母财富排名
  • 推断的生前赠与和遗产（在赠与税免税额处的聚束）
  • 资产组合构成（存款、证券、房地产、债务）
时期
1983–2011
样本
混合截面：每个一岁年龄组平均接近 65 万个观测值；面板回归：36,102 个观测值 2000–2011 年间所有 1–40 岁且父母在世的个人（混合截面），以及 1965 年出生队列中父母双方在 2011 年均在世者构成的面板，追踪期为 1983–2011 年。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Net wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Value of assets minus liabilities measured on the last day of the year from administrative tax return records (SKAT), 1983-2011; mostly third-party reported by banks and financial institutions. Assets include deposits, stocks, bonds, real estate and deposited mortgages; liabilities include bank debt, mortgage credit debt, card debt, student debt, debt to municipalities, unpaid taxes, etc. Pension funds are not included; self-reported items (cars, boats, etc.) are excluded after the 1996 abolition of the wealth tax.
    登记库： SKAT wealth records (via Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 2 (Data)
  • Real estate valuation 财富、负债与消费
    Public (tax-assessed) values of real estate are adjusted upwards each year using the average relative difference between selling price and public value of real estate traded that year, following Leth-Petersen (2010).
    登记库： SKAT wealth records
    工作论文 · Section 2, footnote 6
  • Portfolio components 财富、负债与消费
    From 1995 onwards complete portfolio information on bonds, stocks, cash in banks, real estate, mortgage loans and the sum of other loans; childhood holdings summarised as bank deposits, securities and real estate.
    登记库： SKAT wealth records
    工作论文 · Sections 2 and 3.1
  • Wealth percentile rank 财富、负债与消费
    Percentile rank computed within child age-year specific wealth distributions (parents ranked on total parental wealth observed at the same time); ties, notably zero wealth among young children, are randomly broken. Adult outcome is the child's rank at age 45 (27 years after age 18).
    登记库： SKAT wealth records, Population register (parent links)
    工作论文 · Section 3.3, footnote 11; Section 3.4
  • Inferred wealth transfers (residual) 财富、负债与消费
    For each child, wealth at a given age minus the present value of earnings up to that age (real interest rates 0%, 3%, 6%), censored at zero, as a lower bound on transfers received.
    登记库： SKAT wealth records, Income registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, Table 1
  • Gift-tax bunching measure 税收与税率
    First time an individual (ages 1-12) has positive wealth, wealth at that point treated as the transfer; distance to the gift-tax basic allowance (DKK 58,700 in 2011) and to twice that amount (two donors) is plotted to look for bunching.
    登记库： SKAT wealth records
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, Figure 6
  • PCD and PD samples 样本界定与时间
    PCD: pooled cross-section of all individuals aged 1-40 in 2000-2011 with parents alive (parent IDs registered for Danes born from 1960). PD: panel of the 1965 birth cohort with both parents alive in 2011, followed 1983-2011 (ages 18-46). Monetary values deflated by CPI (2011 prices).
    登记库： Population register (parent links), SKAT wealth records
    工作论文 · Section 2; Tables A1-A2

Asset Integration and Attitudes toward Risk: Theory and Evidence

Steffen Andersen, James C. Cox, Glenn W. Harrison, Morten I. Lau, E. Elisabet Rutström and Vjollca Sadiraj · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2018 · 个人

考察人们在实验中选择彩票时，是否会把个人财富与所提供的奖金合并考虑。作者将丹麦成年人的彩票选择与每位受试者在登记库中的净财富相匹配，并在期望效用和等级依赖效用下估计允许部分资产整合的结构模型。完全资产整合被拒绝，并且在混合估计中赋予财富的权重接近于零，由此得到合理的风险溢价，也为收益校准悖论提供了一条出路。

数据
Statistics Denmark register data matched to the experimental subjects on CPR number (analysed remotely at Statistics Denmark), Danish Tax Authorities (SKAT) income and wealth records: third-party reported assets, liabilities and pensions as of 31 December 2014, Danish Civil Registration records: gender, date of birth, family links and marital history, Artefactual field experiment with binary lottery choices, February–March 2015 (collected by the authors)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：每位受试者对 60 组二元彩票对的选择（收益域）
  • 关键协变量：基于登记库的个人净财富，在零处截断
  • 估计对象：EUT 和 RDU 下的风险厌恶、财富的权重（资产整合程度）以及财富与实验收入之间的替代
  • 简约式检验中的控制变量：性别、年龄、婚姻状况、家庭规模、净收入、净财富的各组成部分
时期
实验于 2015 年 2 月–3 月进行；登记库财富以 2014 年 12 月 31 日为测量时点
样本
442 名实验受试者，共作出 26,520 次彩票选择（第 2 节和表 2）；与登记库中 1,455,772 名可比的丹麦人对照（第 2 节） 截至 2015 年 1 月居住在大哥本哈根地区、参加了彩票选择实验并与其登记记录相匹配的丹麦成年人。 来源
变量如何定义（4）
  • Net individual wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Total assets minus total liabilities of the individual subject. Total assets are the market value of domestic real estate, shares and mutual funds, bonds, assets deposited in domestic and foreign financial institutions, pensions and the value of automobiles. Total liabilities are the value of debt in domestic and foreign financial institutions and mortgages. Shares, bonds and pensions are reported by financial institutions as of 31 December 2014; real estate is estimated by Statistics Denmark as the market value on 31 December 2014; automobiles are valued by Statistics Denmark with a one-year lag. Excludes cash, yachts, paintings, equity in privately held companies and unlisted mutual funds, and human capital. All foreign assets and debt are self-reported to SKAT and are zero for every subject.
    登记库： Danish Tax Authorities (SKAT) income and wealth records, via Statistics Denmark
    代码： Valuation date 31 December 2014; automobiles with a one-year lag; values in 2015 DKK
    工作论文 · Section 2.B (Wealth Data); Table 1 and notes
  • Net wealth truncated at zero 财富、负债与消费
    For 21 of the 442 subjects (4.7%) measured net wealth is negative, reflecting assets that are not fully accounted for; for all calculations wealth is assumed not to be negative and is truncated to zero. Mean net wealth is 3,074,678 kroner (median 2,165,847); mean after truncation is 3,097,435 kroner.
    登记库： Danish Tax Authorities (SKAT) income and wealth records, via Statistics Denmark
    代码： Net wealth < 0 set to 0 (21 of 442 subjects)
    工作论文 · Section 2.B; Table 1
  • Experimental sample matched to registers 样本界定与时间
    442 individuals with experimental choice data and wealth data, representative of the adult Danish population residing in Greater Copenhagen as of January 2015; all experiments were run in February and March 2015. The authors had the CPR number of every subject; matching and all statistical analysis with the register data take place remotely at Statistics Denmark. Compared with 1,455,772 comparable Danes in the registers, the subjects differ significantly only in household size (1.4 vs 1.54) and income (434,085 vs 338,859 kroner per year).
    登记库： Danish Civil Registration records and SKAT tax records, via Statistics Denmark
    工作论文 · Section 2 (Data), opening paragraphs; Section 2.B
  • Individual and family data (demographic controls) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Taken from the Danish Civil Registration records, which cover the entire population. Each record includes the personal identification number (CPR), name, gender, date of birth, the CPR numbers of nuclear family members (parents, siblings and children) and marital history (number of marriages, divorces and widowhoods). Used to identify the experimental subjects and to provide control variables such as age, gender and marital status.
    登记库： Danish Civil Registration records, via Statistics Denmark
    工作论文 · Section 2.B (Wealth Data)

The Consumption Effects of the 2007–2008 Financial Crisis: Evidence from Households in Denmark

Thais Lærkholm Jensen and Niels Johannesen · American Economic Review, 2017 · 个人

在危机中受冲击严重的银行，其客户削减消费的幅度大于较健康银行的客户。传导渠道是信贷可得性下降：受影响的家庭借得更少、花得更少，这说明了银行困境如何通过家庭传导到实体经济。

数据
Tax authority third-party reports of all individuals' loan and deposit account balances, linked to bank identity via branch numbers (Nets lists), Bank balance sheet data from the Danish Central Bank (MFI statistics), Administrative registers on demographics, education, labour market and income, Income and wealth registers (capital income, social transfers, stock portfolios, pension accounts), Motor vehicle register and real estate register
关键变量
  • 处理：主要往来银行 2007 年的贷存比（风险暴露高于与低于中位数）
  • 结果变量：个人借款（分账户的贷款余额）
  • 结果变量：推算支出 = 可支配收入减去净财富变动
  • 结果变量：汽车拥有情况（机动车登记库）
  • 单独分析：2008–2011 年间倒闭银行的客户
时期
2003–2011
样本
约 440,000 人，近 350 万个个人—年份观测值，以及超过 570 万个个人—账户—年份观测值 2007 年年龄为 20–50 岁、非自雇的丹麦居民的 25% 随机样本，其主要往来银行在 2008–2011 年间未倒闭。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Bank-account link (bank identity) 财富、负债与消费
    Year-end loan and deposit account balances reported by financial institutions to the tax authorities; the first four digits of each account number identify the bank branch, mapped to bank identity using hand-collected Nets lists of branch id-numbers for each year 2003-2011.
    登记库： Tax authority third-party account reports, Nets branch lists
    代码： First four digits of account number = branch id
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, footnote 5
  • Primary bank (2007) 财富、负债与消费
    If one bank relation in 2007, that bank; if multiple relations but a loan in only one, that bank; if loans in multiple banks, the bank with the largest loan balance; if no loans, the bank with the largest deposit balance. Always a bank, never a mortgage institution.
    登记库： Tax authority third-party account reports
    工作论文 · Section 3.3 and footnote 6
  • Exposed bank 企业特征与生产率
    Individuals ordered by the 2007 loan-to-deposit ratio of their primary bank and split at the median individual: above-median primary bank = exposed (approximately equal numbers in each group).
    登记库： Danish Central Bank bank balance sheets
    工作论文 · Section 3.3
  • Imputed spending 财富、负债与消费
    Spending = disposable income minus change in net wealth. Disposable income = total realized income - taxes - interest payments + payments from private pension accounts (net of taxes) + imputed capital gains on stocks (start-of-period stock value times growth in stock price index). Net wealth = market value of securities + savings and checking accounts - mortgage loans - bank debt - other loans; real estate excluded (so spending includes real estate purchases). Main regressions exclude stock owners.
    登记库： Income registers, Wealth registers
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Table A1; WP Section 3.2
  • Pension withdrawals (borrowing-constraint indicator) 财富、负债与消费
    Withdrawals (liquidations) from tax-favoured pension savings accounts, which carry a 60% penalty before pension age, used as an indicator of borrowing constraints.
    登记库： Income and wealth registers
    工作论文 · Section 5 (Table 4, col. 3)
  • Car ownership 财富、负债与消费
    Number of cars owned, indicators for owning at least one and at least two cars, and average car weight, from the auto register (weight and production year of each registered automobile).
    登记库： Motor vehicle register
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1 and 6
  • Baseline sample 样本界定与时间
    Residents 2003-2011 aged 20-50 in 2007, excluding self-employed and individuals whose 2007 primary bank failed in 2008-2011 (analysed separately), 25% random sample (about 440,000 individuals); DKK variables winsorized at 1st and 99th percentiles.
    登记库： Tax records, Population registers
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1 and 3.3
  • Unemployment controls/outcome 失业与福利金
    Control: dummy for unemployment spells during 2006-2007; outcome: fraction of the year spent in unemployment.
    登记库： Labour market registers

Itzik Fadlon, Jessica Laird and Torben Heien Nielsen · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2016 · 个人 + 企业

一项改革削减了最高税级劳动者资本养老金账户的补贴，雇主随即减少了对这类账户的缴费，受影响雇员占比越大，减少幅度越大，并把资金转向年金账户。雇主缴费跟随雇员的储蓄偏好而变动。

数据
Income tax register (incl. third-party reported pension contributions), Population register (BEF), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：雇主对资本养老金账户和年金养老金账户的缴费率（工作场所内的中位数）
  • 处理：工作场所中收入高于最高所得税门槛的雇员占比
  • 政策变动：1999 年改革削减了最高税级纳税人资本养老金缴费的税前扣除
  • 单位：工作场所 = 两位数职业 × 企业单元
  • 比较：个人私人（IRA 类）养老金缴费

1996–2001
样本
2,020,705 个劳动者—年份观测值；84,764 个工作场所—年份观测值（26,775 个不同工作场所） 20–60 岁、没有自雇收入的私营部门白领工薪劳动者，所在职业—企业单元至少有五名雇员。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Workplace (occupation-firm cell) 企业特征与生产率
    Workplace = all employees with the same 2-digit occupation code in the same firm; employer default contribution rate measured by the workplace-level median (robustness: workplace-level mode, using only workplaces with a unique mode).
    登记库： IDA; income tax register
    代码： 2-digit occupation code x firm ID

  • Employer contribution rate (default) 退休与养老金
    Employer-sponsored pension contributions divided by taxable labor income, computed separately for capital (lump-sum) and annuity pension accounts; the workplace-level measure is the median contribution rate within the occupation-firm cell in a year (modes used as robustness). Main outcome is the change from t-1 to t.
    登记库： Income tax register (third-party reported pension contributions)
    工作论文 · Section 2.2; Section 3 eq. setup; Appendix A
  • Share of workplace above top tax threshold 税收与税率
    Fraction of employees in the occupation-firm cell with labor income above the top income tax threshold (about 49 percent of workers on average), interacted with year dummies with 1998 as baseline; the 1999 reform cut the deduction value for capital pension contributions from 59 to 45 cents per DKr for top-bracket taxpayers.
    登记库： Income tax register

Active vs. Passive Decisions and Crowd-Out in Retirement Savings Accounts: Evidence from Denmark

Raj Chetty, John N. Friedman, Søren Leth-Petersen, Torben Heien Nielsen and Tore Olsen · Quarterly Journal of Economics, 2014 · 个人

利用丹麦全部储蓄记录表明，对退休账户的税收补贴主要只是让储蓄在不同账户之间转移：每 1 克朗补贴仅使总储蓄增加约 1 øre。相比之下，雇主的自动缴款几乎一比一地提高总储蓄，因为约 85% 的人是不会重新优化的被动储蓄者。

数据
Income tax register with third-party reported earnings and pension contributions (IND), Third-party reported wealth: end-of-year assets and liabilities in taxable accounts, Population register (BEF), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：向雇主退休账户和个人退休账户的缴款
  • 结果变量：应税储蓄（应税资产的变动），总额与净额
  • 处理：换工作时雇主养老金缴款的变化（自动缴款）
  • 处理：1999 年下调最高税档纳税人资本养老金的税收补贴（价格补贴）
  • 处理：政府强制储蓄计划（SP）的缴款
时期
1995–2009
样本
约 4100 万个观测值，涉及约 400 万人 18–60 岁的丹麦人口，剔除有自雇收入的观测值（非平衡面板）。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Primary analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    Danish population 1995-2009 from merged income tax register, population register and IDA, excluding observations below age 18 or above 60 and observations with self-employment income (about 41 million observations on 4 million individuals).
    登记库： IND (income tax register), BEF, IDA
    工作论文 · Section III (Sample and Variable Definitions)
  • Taxable saving (gross and net) 财富、负债与消费
    Gross taxable saving = change in third-party reported end-of-year assets in taxable accounts; net saving = gross saving minus change in liabilities, where liabilities cover secured and unsecured debt except home mortgages. Saving measures and rates below the 1st or above the 99th percentile in the estimation sample are set to missing.
    登记库： Third-party reported wealth data (tax authority)
    工作论文 · Section III
  • Pension contributions by account 退休与养老金
    Annual employer and individual contributions to capital pension (lump-sum) and annuity pension accounts as reported by employers and pension funds; contributions above the 99th percentile are top-coded at the 99th percentile in each account and year.
    登记库： IND (income tax register)
    工作论文 · Section III
  • Income concepts 劳动收入与收入
    Labor income = labor earnings before taxes excluding contributions to employer-administered pensions; total compensation = labor earnings plus employer and employee contributions to employer-administered accounts; taxable income = labor income plus other income (e.g., UI) affecting tax liability. Measured at the individual level, with joint-account balances split equally.
    登记库： IND (income tax register)
    工作论文 · Section III
  • Firm switch 就业与劳动力状态
    Individual switches firms in year t if he has earnings from two distinct firms in t and t-1 (primary job for multiple jobholders); switches where earnings fell by more than half or more than doubled are excluded; set missing in 2003, 2005 and 2007 when firm identifiers changed. Event studies require at least 4 years of data before and after.
    登记库： IDA, IND
    工作论文 · Section IV.A, footnotes 9-10
  • Mandatory Savings Plan (MSP) contribution 退休与养老金
    From 1998 individuals with labor income at or above DKr 34,500 were required to contribute 1% of earnings (DKr 345 at the cutoff); RD on changes in pension contributions/saving from 1997 to 1998 for individuals within DKr 25,000 of the cutoff.
    登记库： IND (income tax register)
    代码： cutoff Y >= DKr 34,500; bandwidth DKr 25,000
    工作论文 · Section IV.B, equation (6)
  • 1999 capital pension subsidy reduction 税收与税率
    From 1999 the deduction for capital pension contributions fell from 59 to 45 cents per DKr for individuals in the top income tax bracket (cutoff DKr 251,200 in 1998); treatment group: taxable income DKr 25,000-75,000 above the top-tax cutoff; control: DKr 25,000-75,000 below.
    登记库： IND (income tax register)
    工作论文 · Section V, V.A (Estimator 1)

Housing Wealth and Consumption: A Micro Panel Study

Martin Browning, Mette Gørtz and Søren Leth-Petersen · Economic Journal, 2013 · 个人

利用基于登记库推算的消费以及 1987 至 1996 年繁荣与萧条期间的房价变化，检验住房财富是否驱动支出。对大多数家庭而言，消费对未预期到的房价变化没有反应；反应仅限于年轻家庭，这与抵押品效应而非财富效应相一致。

数据
Administrative income and wealth (tax) registers for a 10% random sample of the Danish population aged 16+, House price / housing wealth information from registers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：推算的家庭总支出（可支配收入减去净财富变化）
  • 核心解释变量：房价／住房财富的未预期变化
  • 异质性：年龄、自有住房者与租房者、信贷约束（1992–93 年住房抵押贷款改革允许以房屋净值借款）
  • 家庭可支配收入
时期
1987–1996
样本
所查资料中未注明 取自丹麦 16 岁及以上人口的 10% 随机样本、在整个期间内始终为自有住房者或始终为租房者的已婚或同居的稳定伴侣。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Imputed household total expenditure 财富、负债与消费
    Household disposable after-tax income minus the change in net financial wealth from t-1 to t, following Browning and Leth-Petersen (2003); deflated to 1990 prices. Possible only up to 1996 because wealth-tax register data end after the wealth tax was abolished in 1997.
    登记库： Income and wealth tax registers (10% sample)
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Expenditure imputation), eq. (1), footnote 1
  • Household disposable income 劳动收入与收入
    Gross income including interest income, housing transfers and dividends, minus taxes on income, taxes on shares, surplus on owner-occupied housing and tax-exempted interest expenses (labour, transfer and capital income net of personal taxes).
    登记库： Income tax registers
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Expenditure imputation)
  • Net wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Financial assets (market value of shares, bank deposits, market value of bonds and securities) minus debt (mortgage debt, bank debt etc.).
    登记库： Wealth tax registers
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Expenditure imputation)
  • Municipal house prices and house price innovations 地理与社区
    Average sales prices of traded single-family houses by municipality (275 municipalities), 1985-2001, collected by the tax authorities. Log municipal price modelled as an AR process with municipality effects, average house size (square metres, rooms) and year effects, estimated by system GMM; the predicted change is the expected price change and the residual is the house price innovation.
    登记库： Tax authority house sales statistics (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 4 (House prices); Section 5 (house price process); Appendix 1
  • Analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    10% random sample of the Danish population aged 16+, 1987-1996; married or cohabiting stable couples who were either home owners or renters throughout; split before and after the 1992-93 mortgage/collateral and tax reforms.
    登记库： Income and wealth tax registers (10% sample)
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Data); Abstract
  • Liquidity constraint 财富、负债与消费
    Liquidity-constrained households have liquid funds (cash and bonds) below 1.5 months of disposable income; high-liquidity households have liquid funds above half a year's disposable income. Mortgage sensitivity measured by mortgage debt / house value.
    登记库： Income and wealth tax registers
    工作论文 · Section 6 (credit constraints) and robustness section

Intertemporal Consumption and Credit Constraints: Does Total Expenditure Respond to an Exogenous Shock to Credit?

Søren Leth-Petersen · American Economic Review, 2010 · 个人

1992 年的改革允许丹麦房主以住房净值作抵押借款，构成一次外生的信贷冲击。总支出平均而言反应不大，且反应集中在流动性财富很少的年轻家庭，这表明信贷约束只对少数家庭构成紧约束。

数据
Income tax register: taxable income, transfers, final taxes, Wealth tax register: third-party reported assets and liabilities (housing, shares, mortgage deeds, cash, bonds, debt), Administrative registers on family composition and dwelling characteristics, Danish Family Expenditure Survey (DES) 1994–1996, used to validate the expenditure imputation
关键变量
  • 结果变量：家庭总支出，由收入减去财富变动推算
  • 处理：1992 年信贷市场改革，允许以住房净值作为消费贷款的抵押
  • 处理组：房主（以租房者作为比较组／一致性检验）
  • 信贷约束的代理变量：1991 年流动性（非住房）资产相对于月可支配收入偏低
时期
1987–1996
样本
38,486 个家庭，其中 25,275 个居住在自有住房中（工作论文版本） 来自丹麦人口 10% 随机样本的家庭，年龄 18–75 岁，非自雇，1987–1996 年各年均被观测到且未搬迁。 来源
调查
Expenditure Survey
变量如何定义（7）
  • Imputed total household expenditure 财富、负债与消费
    Total expenditure imputed from tax registers as disposable income (taxable income plus some non-taxable components and transfers, minus final taxes) minus the change in net wealth from the end of one tax year to the end of the next, following Browning and Leth-Petersen (2003); capital gains are not netted out except for housing. Households with negative imputed expenditure are dropped.
    登记库： Income tax register, Wealth tax register
    代码： c_t = y_t - dW_t (equation 14), with allowance for housing capital gains
    工作论文 · Section 4.1, equation (14); Section 4.2
  • Wealth components 财富、负债与消费
    Third-party reported assets in six pre-reform categories (housing assets at tax-assessed cash value, shares, deposited mortgage deeds, cash holdings, bonds, other assets incl. self-reported non-deposited bonds, ship shares and high-value objects) and total liabilities; mortgage debt is separately available only up to 1993, so only total liabilities are consistent across years. Employer pension funds are not observed.
    登记库： Wealth tax register
    工作论文 · Section 4.2; Appendix figure A2
  • Credit-constrained (low liquid assets) 财富、负债与消费
    Alternative splits used in robustness: low liquid assets = liquid assets of at most two months of disposable income in 1991; at most one month of disposable income in both 1990 and 1991; at most one month of disposable income in 1991 and subsequently experiencing an unemployment shock.
    登记库： Wealth tax register, Income tax register
    在线附录 · Section 5 (3.1-3.3), alternative sample splits
  • Credit reform exposure 财富、负债与消费
    The 1992 mortgage reform allowed mortgage loans to finance non-housing purposes, up to 60% of the house value, and extended the maximum maturity from 20 to 30 years; homeowners are treated and renters serve as a consistency check.
    登记库： Administrative dwelling registers
    工作论文 · Section 2; Section 4.3
  • Household panel sample 样本界定与时间
    Robustness subsamples: renters (separate analysis) and house owners holding no financial assets (no stocks or bonds).
    登记库： Wealth tax register
    在线附录 · Sections 2-3
  • Propensity-score matching covariates 样本界定与时间
    Probit for low-liquid-asset status in 1991 uses: housing equity/house value and its square, ln(house value) and square (owners), ln(gross income) and square, age and square, single, UI membership, size of house and square, labour supply (male, female), self-employed (male, female), education short/medium/long, number of children dummies (1-4). Monetary values in DKK, 1990 prices. Matching with replacement; SEs per Abadie and Imbens (2006).
    登记库： Income tax register, Wealth tax register, Population registers
    在线附录 · Tables A1, A4
  • Household education level 教育与考试成绩
    Highest level of education in the household, grouped into no/low vs medium/high for heterogeneity analysis.
    登记库： Education register

Imputing Consumption from Income and Wealth Information

Martin Browning and Søren Leth-Petersen · Economic Journal, 2003 · 个人

检验能否利用登记数据把消费推算为收入减去财富变动，方法是将推算值与同一批家庭在支出调查中的回答相比较。对大多数家庭而言推算效果良好，但对有住房交易或持有大量股票的家庭，推算值噪声较大。

数据
Danish Expenditure Survey 1994–96, Administrative income and wealth (tax) records: disposable income and year-end asset holdings
关键变量
  • 结果变量：调查报告的家庭总支出
  • 推算消费：可支配收入减去财富变动
  • 各类资产的年末持有量
时期
1994–1996 年调查年份，与调查年份前后的登记年份相链接
样本
所查资料中未注明 1994–96 年丹麦支出调查（Danish Expenditure Survey）中的家庭，与其行政收入和财富记录相链接。 来源（摘要）
调查
Expenditure Survey
变量如何定义（3）
  • Imputed total household expenditure 财富、负债与消费
    Total expenditure imputed at the household level as disposable after-tax income minus the change in net wealth between end of year t-1 and end of year t (c = y - dW). Validated against total expenditure reported in the 1994-96 Danish Expenditure Survey linked to the households' register records. Relies on wealth-tax register information, which ends after the wealth tax was abolished in 1997.
    登记库： Income and wealth tax registers (Statistics Denmark), Danish Expenditure Survey 1994-96
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Expenditure imputation), eq. (1) and footnote 1 - restatement of the Browning and Leth-Petersen (2003) definition by the same authors
  • Household disposable income 劳动收入与收入
    Sum of gross income including interest income, housing transfers and dividends from share capital, minus taxes on income, taxes on shares, surplus on owner-occupied housing and tax-exempted interest expenses.
    登记库： Income tax registers
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Expenditure imputation) - restatement of Browning and Leth-Petersen (2003)
  • Household net wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Assets minus liabilities measured at year end; assets are the market value of share capital, bank deposits and the market value of bonds and securities; liabilities include mortgage and bank debt.
    登记库： Wealth tax registers
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Expenditure imputation) - restatement of Browning and Leth-Petersen (2003)

Reskilling and Resilience

Anders Humlum and Pernille Plato · AER: Insights (forthcoming), 2026 · 个人

利用丹麦行政数据研究再培训如何影响劳动者抵御劳动力市场冲击的韧性，把作者关于受伤后人力资本投资的研究延伸到如下问题：哪些劳动者会进行技能重塑，以及当工作岗位消失时技能重塑如何保护劳动收入。

数据
Work accident reports from Labour Market Insurance (AES), Education Register (UDDA), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), National Patient Registry (hospitalizations), Health Insurance Registry (primary care and specialist visits), Prescription Drug Database, Population register (BEF) for partner linkages
关键变量
  • 冲击：造成收入能力永久性损失的工伤事故
  • 处理/调节变量：能否获得技能重塑机会（可直接进入高等教育的职业教育学位）
  • 结果变量：抗抑郁药使用及其他心理健康指标
  • 结果变量：伴侣的劳动力市场和健康结果
  • 结果变量：受伤劳动者的劳动收入和就业
时期
1995–2017 年（工伤事故为 1998–2017 年）
样本
2,915 起工伤事件（男性技工）；2,103 名稳定伴侣 持有职业教育学位、在造成收入能力永久性损失的身体性工伤事故发生前三年全职就业的男性技工，及其伴侣。 来源
变量如何定义（18）
  • Work accident with permanent earning-capacity loss 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Work accident reports from Labour Market Insurance (AES) with an estimated earning capacity loss (ECL) > 0, excluding psychological shocks; collapsed to person-year. Earning capacity loss is estimated upfront by AES. Milder accidents without permanent loss serve as placebo.
    登记库： AES
    工作论文 · Section 1.3; footnote 7; Appendix Table A.2
  • Access to reskilling 教育与考试成绩
    Indicator that the worker's vocational degree grants direct entry to relevant higher education programmes (e.g. carpenters, electricians, welders) versus comparable trades that require three years of high school first (e.g. blacksmiths, iron and metal workers, manufacturing technicians). Reskilling = participation in higher education by year +10.
    登记库： UDDA
    工作论文 · Section 2.2; Figure 1 notes
  • Antidepressant use 医疗服务利用
    Dummy indicating a prescription for drugs in ATC class N06A (Antidepressants) in the year.
    登记库： Prescription Drug Database (LMDB)
    代码： ATC N06A
    工作论文 · Appendix Table A.1, row 19
  • Opioid use 医疗服务利用
    Dummy indicating a prescription for drugs in ATC class N02A (Opioids).
    登记库： Prescription Drug Database (LMDB)
    代码： ATC N02A
    工作论文 · Appendix Table A.1, row 25
  • Alcohol diagnoses 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Accumulated number of hospital diagnoses related to alcohol following Browning and Heinesen (2012): alcohol poisoning, addiction syndrome, delirious abstinence, alcohol psychosis, oesophageal varices, alcoholic liver disease, alcoholic pancreatic disease.
    登记库： LPR
    代码： ICD-10 F100, F102, F104, F105, I85, K70, K860, T500, T510
    工作论文 · Appendix Table A.1, row 24
  • Cardiovascular / respiratory diagnoses; suicide attempts 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Accumulated number of hospital diagnoses in ICD-10 chapter I (circulatory) or J (respiratory); accumulated hospitalisations where the reason for contact is registered as a suicide attempt (or accident).
    登记库： LPR
    代码： ICD-10 chapter I; ICD-10 chapter J
    工作论文 · Appendix Table A.1, rows 21-23, 26
  • Full-time and employment 就业与劳动力状态
    Full-time = full-time work according to RAS, defined by normal working hours above 32 hours/week. Employment = full-time work while not enrolled in a post-secondary programme and not receiving DI (DI = any weeks in the year on disability insurance). Stable pre-injury employment = full-time in all three years before the accident.
    登记库： RAS, IDA
    工作论文 · Appendix Table A.1, rows 10, 15-17; Section 1.3
  • Hours worked (FTE) 工作时间
    2008-2017: yearly number of paid hours; 1995-2007: yearly labour income divided by hourly wage rate (November job). Divided by 1,924 full-time-equivalent yearly hours (37 hours/week).
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Appendix Table A.1, rows 11-12
  • Labour income 劳动收入与收入
    Total labour market income including bonuses, fringe benefits, wages paid during sick and parental leave, and employer pension contributions.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Appendix Table A.1, row 9
  • Stable partner / partner retention 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Stable partner = cohabiting (including married) with the same partner for 3 consecutive years; partners are the initial partner in the year before the accident, followed regardless of separation; outcome = share still in the relationship.
    登记库： BEF
    工作论文 · Appendix Table A.1, row 3; Section 2.1; Figure 3 notes
  • Physical-cognitive ability gap 职业与职位层级
    ln(Physical Ability Requirements / Cognitive Ability Requirements) of the occupation, using O*NET importance of strength and stamina items vs. reasoning and idea items; both normalised.
    登记库： IDA, O*NET
    工作论文 · Appendix Table A.1, row 18
  • Union membership 就业与劳动力状态
    Dummy for a positive deductible union-fee amount reported by unions to the tax authorities.
    登记库： IND
    工作论文 · Appendix Table A.1, row 14
  • Education level and years of schooling 教育与考试成绩
    Years of schooling = prescribed years of study of highest completed degree counting from grade 1. Highest completed degree groups: Primary (pre-school, primary, preparatory courses, Danish language courses at language centres); Vocational (VET, qualifying programmes, labour market educations AMU); Secondary (upper secondary); Post-secondary (short-cycle higher, vocational bachelor, bachelor, master, PhD). School = enrolled in a post-secondary programme in the year.
    登记库： UDDA
    在线附录 · Supplementary Appendix, Table A.1 Panel B-C
  • Hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    2008-2017: yearly total labour income divided by yearly hours worked; 1995-2007: average hourly wage rate in the November job, reliable only for individuals working more than 20 hours a week.
    登记库： IDA
    在线附录 · Supplementary Appendix, Table A.1 Panel C
  • Labour market experience and DI receipt 就业与劳动力状态
    Labour market experience measured in years since 1964. DI = any weeks within the year spent receiving disability insurance.
    登记库： IDA
    在线附录 · Supplementary Appendix, Table A.1 Panel C
  • Hospital visits, accidents and mortality 医疗服务利用
    Hospital visits = number of hospital contacts (admissions, outpatient treatment and ER visits). Accidents = accumulated hospitalisations with reason for contact registered as an accident. Mortality = accumulated, individual counted as deceased from the year of death.
    登记库： LPR, Death register
    在线附录 · Supplementary Appendix, Table A.1 Panel E
  • Work accident sample and matched controls 样本界定与时间
    Universe of work accidents causing earning-capacity loss 1998-2017, restricted stepwise: ECL > 0; exclude psychological shock; collapse to person-year; person exists in register data; full-time employed before injury; vocational degrees with (or comparable without) access; male craft workers. Each injured worker matched to a random non-injured worker with the same age, gender, education, occupation, industry and access to higher education in the year before the accident (plus stable partner and parent indicators); controls inherit the year of injury of their match.
    登记库： AES, IDA, BEF, UDDA
    在线附录 · Supplementary Appendix, Table A.1 Panel F and Table A.2
  • Inverse probability weights for access 样本界定与时间
    Logit propensity score for access to higher education estimated on injured workers at year e-1 using age, gender, stable partner, years of schooling, labour income, hours worked, hourly wage, experience, union membership, physical-cognitive ability gap, antidepressant prescription dummy and year of injury; No-Access workers weighted by p/(1-p) (Abadie 2005), and the matched control receives the same weight.
    登记库： IDA, UDDA, LMDB, BEF
    在线附录 · Supplementary Appendix B.1

Subjective Earnings Risk

Andrew Caplin, Victoria Gregory, Eungik Lee, Søren Leth-Petersen and Johan Sæverud · Review of Economic Studies, 2026 · 个人

提出一种把辞职和被解雇的可能性考虑在内的劳动收入风险调查工具，面向丹麦劳动者实施，并与其登记库中的劳动收入历史相链接。工作转换是主观风险的主要来源；即使在控制人口特征和工作履历之后，主观风险仍比传统的基于登记数据的估计小许多倍，这有助于解释为什么许多人只持有很少的流动资产。

数据
Copenhagen Life Panel (CLP) survey, January 2021 wave, linked on CPR number, Income-tax register earnings (IND), Monthly employer-employee match and earnings data (BFL/eIndkomst), Demographic, education, household composition and household wealth registers
关键变量
  • 调查：留任、辞职和被裁员的主观概率
  • 调查：以每种工作转换为条件的主观劳动收入分布
  • 基准：2021 年实际发生的工作转换、未就业时间和劳动收入增长（行政数据）
  • 权重：基于 2020 年行政数据的调查参与模型得到的总体权重
时期
调查于 2021 年 1 月进行；行政数据截至 2022 年
样本
10,942 名在职受访者（总样本为 14,683 名 20–65 岁受访者） Copenhagen Life Panel 中在 2021 年 1 月调查时处于就业状态的 20–65 岁受访者。 来源
调查
Copenhagen Life Panel
变量如何定义（10）
  • Main monthly employer (BFL) 就业与劳动力状态
    From monthly eIndkomst job records (BFL), each person-month is assigned the job with the most paid hours (AJO_LOENTIMER) as the primary employer; its CVR number, wage and hours are kept. Month and year come from the job start date field AJO_JOB_START_DATO.
    登记库： BFL
    代码： AJO_CVR_NR_FRA_PROD_JOB, AJO_SMALT_LOENBELOEB, AJO_LOENTIMER, AJO_JOB_START_DATO; primary job = max(AJO_LOENTIMER) within pnr-year-month
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_c_monthly_data.R
  • Stayer (same employer Dec 2020 to Dec 2021) 就业与劳动力状态
    Among workers with an employer and monthly wage above 2,000 DKK in December 2020, stay=1 if the main employer in December 2021 is the same as in December 2020, else 0. Sample restricted to ages 20-65 and 2020 annual BFL earnings of at least 24,000 DKK.
    登记库： BFL
    代码： wage>2000 in Dec 2020; employer_g == F12.employer_g; sum_earnings>=24000
    复制代码 · script/analysis/fig4/preprocess_fig4a.do; paper Figure 4 note
  • Months out of work after separation 失业与福利金
    A separation is a month in which the worker has a main employer with monthly wage above 2,000 DKK and next month's employer differs; only the first separation per person is used. Time out of work = months until a different non-missing employer appears (capped at 24) minus one, so job-to-job moves count as 0 and returns to the same employer are not reemployment. The paper describes separations in 2020; the posted do-file's window (date<=24 from Dec 2018) covers Dec 2018-Dec 2019.
    登记库： BFL
    代码： jan_sep = employer_g != F1employer_g; reemp = first k with F`k'employer_g != employer_g & non-missing; gap = reemp-1; cap 24
    复制代码 · script/analysis/fig4/preprocess_fig4b.do; paper Section 3.2 and Figure 4 note
  • Annual earnings (register) 劳动收入与收入
    Annual earnings are wage income LOENMV_13 from the income register (IND); self-employment income is NETOVSKUD_13 kept separately. Realized earnings growth 2020-2021 is ln(earnings_2021*100/102) - ln(earnings_2020), dropping observations with earnings below 24,000 DKK in either year and trimming at the 1st/99th percentile.
    登记库： IND
    代码： LOENMV_13 (earnings), NETOVSKUD_13 (self-employment income); threshold 24,000 DKK; deflator 100/102; winsor2 trim 1/99
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_b_annual_data.R; script/analysis/fig7/preprocess_fig7.do; paper Figure 6 note
  • Net wealth and liquid wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Net wealth = (KOEJD + BANKAKT + KURSAKT + OBLAKT + PANTAKT) - (BANKGAELD + GAELD_TIL_OFF + OBLGAELD + PANTGAELD), missing public debt set to 0. Liquid wealth = BANKAKT + KURSAKT + OBLAKT + PANTAKT. Pension wealth is the sum of PF_FORMUE across contracts in PENSFORM.
    登记库： IND, PENSFORM
    代码： KOEJD, BANKAKT, KURSAKT, OBLAKT, PANTAKT, BANKGAELD, GAELD_TIL_OFF, OBLGAELD, PANTGAELD; PF_FORMUE
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_b_annual_data.R
  • Monthly UI, cash benefits and retirement transfers 失业与福利金
    From ILME monthly non-employee e-income records, amounts across A/B income fields are summed per person-month and classified by the income-type code of the largest payment: UI if VMO_INDK_ART codes 2,5,8,16,104; cash benefits if type code 6 or art codes 40,41,43,84,87; retirement if art codes 6,9,10,13,20,24,25,44,45,74,83,86,113,115.
    登记库： ILME
    代码： VMO_INDKOMST_ART_KODE UI: 2,5,8,16,104; CB: VMO_INDKOMST_TYPE_KODE 6 or ART 40,41,43,84,87; Retirement ART: 6,9,10,13,20,24,25,44,45,74,83,86,113,115
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_c_monthly_data.R
  • Public vs private sector 部门与行业
    Main job (highest LOENTIMER in IDAN per year) is public if ARB_SEKTORKODE is non-missing and not 99, and recoded private if ARB_SEKTORKODE is in 18, 28, 89, 81, 58, 48, 42, 52. Industry groups come from DB07 ranges of ARB_HOVED_BRA_DB07 (e.g. >=840000 public services, 850000 teaching, 860000 health).
    登记库： IDAN
    代码： ARB_SEKTORKODE private: 18,28,89,81,58,48,42,52; ARB_HOVED_BRA_DB07 6-digit DB07 ranges
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_b_annual_data.R
  • Occupation group 职业与职位层级
    Main job's DISCO_KODE first digit mapped to 9 groups (1 management, 2 high knowledge, 3 medium knowledge, 4 office, 5 sales/services, 6 farming, 7 craft, 8 skilled, 9 unskilled); military (DISCO below 100000) dropped. Tenure = year - ANSAAR.
    登记库： IDAN
    代码： DISCO_KODE first digit 1-9; DISCO_KODE<100000 excluded; ANSAAR
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_b_annual_data.R
  • Education level 教育与考试成绩
    Highest completed education HFAUDD (latest available year) mapped through the audd format's H1 level: 10 elementary; 20, 25 high school; 30, 35 vocational; 40, 50, 60 bachelor; 65, 70 master.
    登记库： UDDA
    代码： HFAUDD via uddan_2014_audd H1: 10; 20,25; 30,35; 40,50,60; 65,70
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_b_annual_data.R
  • Population survey weights 样本界定与时间
    Inverse predicted propensity scores from a probability model of survey participation estimated on 2020 administrative data on the demographics of Danes active in the labour market.
    论文正文 · Footnote 10 (details in Online Appendix B)

Replication package

Fertility and Family Labor Supply

Katrine Jakobsen, Thomas H. Jørgensen and Hamish Low · American Economic Review (forthcoming), 2026 · 个人

利用 2009 年丹麦税制改革，表明女性税后净工资提高会降低生育，而男性工资提高则会提高生育。基于登记数据估计的一个夫妻选择生育时点和子女数量的生命周期模型表明，允许生育作出调整会大幅提高女性劳动供给的反应程度，而生育前后的人力资本折旧在很大程度上造成了长期的性别工资差距。

数据
Monthly payroll records (BFL/eIndkomst), Annual income tax data (IND), Population and family register (BEF), family definitions and parent links, Education register (UDDA), Labour market experience from ATP payments, Parental leave spell register (OF)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：生育（出生）
  • 处理：2009–2018 年税制改革带来的边际税后净工资率变化
  • 结果变量：劳动力市场参与、兼职与全职工作（根据工资单工时）
  • 结果变量：年度劳动收入
  • 控制变量：教育（高技能对较低技能）、劳动力市场经验
时期
2004–2018 年（税收样本 2004–2018 年；估计样本 2010–2018 年）
样本
10,851,444 个个人—年份观测值（估计样本）；2,531,181 个（税收样本） 25–60 岁、有异性伴侣的丹麦个人，不含学生、自雇者、退休者和领取残疾养老金者；税收样本限于 25–40 岁的同居或已婚女性。 来源
变量如何定义（11）
  • Labour market participation, part-time and full-time work 就业与劳动力状态
    Participation means at least 481 annual hours (e.g. 37 hours for 13 weeks) on BFL pay slips together with annual income of at least 50,000 DKK; part time is 481-1,664 annual hours; full time is more than 1,664 hours. Monthly hours and income are scaled down by the share of the month registered on parental leave in the OF register.
    登记库： BFL (eIndkomst), OF
    代码： thresholds 481 and 1,664 annual hours; 50,000 DKK
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Annual labour income (BFL) 劳动收入与收入
    12-month sum of monthly labour income from BFL pay slips, by calendar year for age profiles and centred on the birth month for event-study moments (e.g. income from January-February before a March birth counts as year -1); excludes income registered while on parental leave; deflated by CPI, in 1000 DKK. Estimation sample 2010-2018.
    登记库： BFL (eIndkomst), OF
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Personal income (tax sample) 劳动收入与收入
    Personal income from annual tax data: labour income from wage work, profits from own firms and labour market transfers; deflated by CPI.
    登记库： IND
    代码： PERINDKP
    工作论文 · Supplemental Material A
  • Couples / partners 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Partners follow Statistics Denmark's family definition, including married and cohabiting couples; cohabitants are two adults at the same address registered as parents to a child, or two opposite-sex adults with an age difference under 15 years at the same address. Constructed from EFALLE in BEF; couple age is the woman's age. Estimation sample keeps couples with at most five years age difference.
    登记库： BEF
    代码： EFALLE; FOED_DAG; KOEN
    工作论文 · Section 2, footnote 8; Supplemental Material A
  • High skilled vs less skilled 教育与考试成绩
    High skilled if at least 180 months of education (at least a bachelor's degree), measured as the highest degree earned in the sample period; less skilled otherwise.
    登记库： UDDA
    代码： HFPRIA >= 180 months
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Labour market experience 就业与劳动力状态
    Statistics Denmark's experience measure based on accumulated mandatory ATP pension payments, which depend on hours worked; part-time employment counts as 2/3 of full time.
    登记库： IDAP
    代码： ERHVER, ERHVER79
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Sample exclusions by main activity 样本界定与时间
    Individuals aged 25-60 with an opposite-sex partner; observations dropped if mainly student, self-employed, retired or on disability pension, based on main activity at end of November.
    登记库： IDAP/AKM (socio-economic status)
    代码： SOCSTIL, SOCSTIL_KODE
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Mechanical net-of-tax rate change (instrument) 税收与税率
    Four-year mechanical change log(1 - tau_{t+4}(z_t)) - log(1 - tau_t(z_t)) in the marginal net-of-tax rate, holding income and characteristics at year-t values, computed with a Danish tax simulator; used to instrument own and partner net-of-tax rate changes and virtual income. Restricted to couples where both have personal income of 50,000-600,000 DKK in the base year. Outcome is the 4-year difference in number of children born.
    登记库： IND
    工作论文 · Section 3; Supplemental Material A.1
  • Household wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Bank deposits, bonds, stocks and property net of loans and mortgages at end of year; registered property values raised by 10% (following Leth-Petersen 2010); deflated by CPI, in 1000 DKK.
    登记库： IND
    代码： FORM; FORMREST_NY05 (after 1996)
    工作论文 · Supplemental Material A
  • Child linkage and age of children 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Children and their ages are linked to parents through the parent identifiers in BEF; almost all children can be linked to a mother.
    登记库： BEF
    在线附录 · Supplemental Material, Data Appendix (p. S2)
  • Estimation sample vs tax sample 样本界定与时间
    Two samples: the BFL estimation sample of all individuals aged 25-60 with partners, 2010-2018; and the tax sample of women aged 25-40 with partners, 2004-2018 (used with personal income PERINDKP). Both split by less skilled vs high skilled.
    登记库： BFL (eIndkomst), IND, BEF
    在线附录 · Supplemental Material, Table A.1

Effects of Parental Death on Labor Market Outcomes

Mathias Fjællegaard Jensen and Ning Zhang · American Economic Review, 2026 · 个人

利用丹麦行政数据中父母里首位去世者突然离世的事件以及匹配的对照组。男性劳动收入下降约 2%，女性下降约 3%，两者的心理健康都变差；有年幼子女的女性损失最大，约为 4%，这与失去祖辈提供的非正式育儿照料的解释相一致。

数据
Cause of death registers (DODSAARS/DODSAARG), Population register with parent-child links (BEF), Income and labour market registers (IND, AKM, IDAS/IDAN/IDAP), ATP-based hours proxy, Health Insurance Register for GP/psychologist/psychiatrist visits (SYSI/SSSY), National Patient Register (LPR_ADM/LPR_DIAG), Psychiatric Central Research Register (PSYK_ADM/PSYK_DIAG), Prescription register (LMDB), Childcare registers (DAGI/BOERNFB)
关键变量
  • 处理：父母中首位去世者为突然死亡（心脏病、脑血管疾病、急性呼吸道感染、意外事故）
  • 结果变量：年劳动收入（以去世前同性别均值为基准作指数化）
  • 结果变量：就业与工时代理变量
  • 结果变量：心理健康服务使用与处方
  • 对照组：匹配的尚未受处理个体
时期
1980–2019 年（父母去世时间为 1985–2014 年）
样本
处理组：母亲先去世的女儿 21919 人、儿子 24354 人；父亲先去世的女儿 74991 人、儿子 85022 人（另有匹配的对照组） 父母双方信息均已知、在 1985 至 2014 年间经历父母中首位去世者突然离世的 25–50 岁丹麦成年人，以及匹配的对照组。 来源
变量如何定义（10）
  • First sudden parental death (treatment) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Sudden deaths = deaths from heart diseases, cerebrovascular diseases, and traffic or other (external) accidents; non-sudden = all remaining causes. Sample: first parental deaths 1985-2014 for children aged 25-50 in the year of the first parental death with two known parents.
    登记库： DODSAARS/DODSAARG, BEF
    代码： cause categories only (no ICD list given in appendix); child age 25-50; deaths 1985-2014
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix Figure B.2 and B.5 notes
  • Matched control group 样本界定与时间
    Alternative control group following Fadlon and Nielsen (2021): individuals treated 6 years later serve as controls. Spillover analysis on in-laws restricts to married/cohabiting individuals matched to married/cohabiting controls who lose no parent-in-law in the window, also matching on whether own parents are alive. SEs clustered at individual-by-match ID.
    登记库： BEF, DODSAARS/DODSAARG
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix A.C, A.F
  • Indexed earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Earnings from employment and self-employment, inflated to 2020 levels and indexed by the average earnings of men (women) one year before the parental death.
    登记库： IND
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix Figure B.5 and B.9 notes
  • Participation and hours proxy (ATP) 工作时间
    Participation = strictly positive ATP pension contributions; intensive margin = amount of ATP contributions (paid proportionally to hours worked), following Kleven, Landais and Sogaard (2019).

The Direct and Indirect Effects of Online Job Search Advice

Steffen Altmann, Anita M. Glenny, Robert Mahlstedt and Alexander Sebald · Review of Economic Studies, 2026 · 个人

在丹麦公共就业服务机构的在线平台上开展了一项大型两阶段随机实验，向求职者提供职位空缺信息和职业推荐，处理强度因地区而异。当接受建议的求职者较少时，建议能提高就业和劳动收入；但在处理强度高时这些收益消失，因为处理组求职者会涌向相同的职业。

数据
Field experiment on jobnet.dk (Danish public employment service platform): treatment assignment and dashboard exposure, Jobnet job search profiles, vacancy information and registered job applications (with occupation codes), Statistics Denmark register data on employment, hours and earnings (12 months after start), Population registers and benefit payment records (UI recipients), Register data on the universe of unemployment-to-job occupational transitions (to build recommendations)
关键变量
  • 处理：职业推荐、职位空缺信息，或两者兼有（个体层面随机化）
  • 处理强度：市镇群组内接受处理的求职者所占比例（两阶段随机化）
  • 结果变量：干预后一年内的工作时数和劳动收入
  • 结果变量：按职业划分的求职申请（搜寻策略）
时期
干预始于 2019 年 3 月 17 日；结果变量取此后 12 个月（2020 年 3 月之前）
样本
92,098 人 2019 年 3 月 17 日在丹麦登记为失业并领取失业保险（UI）给付的全部个人。 来源

Managing Inequality: Manager-Specific Wage Premiums and Selection in the Managerial Labor Market

Alex Xi He and Daniel le Maire · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2025 · 个人 + 企业

构建了覆盖丹麦全体人口的经理—企业—工人匹配数据集，用以估计经理对工资的影响。在企业间工资不平等中，经理特定的工资溢价几乎与企业溢价同样重要，且与生产率无关；支付高工资的经理在企业被收购后更有可能被替换。

数据
Matched employer-employee data covering all Danish workers and firms (IDA), Occupation codes used to identify managers, Firm balance sheet data for private-sector firms (FIRE), Mergers and acquisitions identified from firm and establishment identifiers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：工人的对数工资
  • 关键估计量：经理特定的工资溢价（由工人和经理的流动识别的经理固定效应）
  • 比较：企业特定的工资溢价
  • 事件：企业被收购和经理更换
  • 异质性：行业集中度（HHI）
时期
1995–2011 年（据 2019 年工作论文的幻灯片）
样本
所查资料中未注明 覆盖丹麦全体人口的经理—企业—工人匹配面板；2019 年工作论文版本中的收购样本包含约 3,700 起私营部门收购。 来源（摘要）
变量如何定义（8）
  • Manager identification 职业与职位层级
    A worker is a manager if their ISCO-88 occupation is 1200-1399 or their job position code is top management (pstill 31); a manager status is carried forward within an establishment in years where it has no identified manager. If no manager is found, the top earner (or anyone in the top 5% of earners) is flagged when not in a non-managerial ISCO>=2000 occupation, earns at least 1.6 times the average of co-workers, or earns more than 1.5 times the second-highest earner; further fallbacks assign the top earner with a unique occupation/position earning >1.3 times the second highest.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： isco 1200-1399; PSTILL==31 (top manager), PSTILL 32 exception; ratio = lonind*(n-1)/(wagebill-lonind) >= 1.6; lonind/second-highest > 1.5
    复制代码 · clean_manager.do
  • Top manager per firm-year 职业与职位层级
    Among identified managers, one manager per establishment-year is kept by successively preferring ISCO 1210 (CEOs), then pstill 31, managers with longer tenure in the establishment, and higher within-establishment earnings rank; only managers observed in at least two firms are retained (mobility needed for identification), establishments that were acquisition targets are excluded, and at the firm (CVR) level the manager of the largest establishment is used.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： isco==1210; pstill==31; target_cumu>=1 dropped
    复制代码 · clean_manager.do
  • Log hourly wage (AKM outcome) 劳动收入与收入
    Log of the IDA hourly wage, deflated to constant prices; when the hourly wage is zero it is replaced by annual labour income divided by 1800. Observations with missing firm ID, labour income <=1, missing education or experience, or unemployment degree above 500 are dropped; firms whose maximum employment is 5 or fewer are excluded.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： timelon; lonind; replace timelon=lonind/1800 if timelon==0; arledgr (unemployment degree) >500 dropped; maxemp<=5 dropped
    复制代码 · AKM_merger_cvrnr.do
  • Mergers and acquisitions 企业特征与生产率
    M&As are identified from establishment (workplace) IDs changing firm (CVR) IDs: a firm-year is a merger if its establishments were owned by more than one distinct firm in the previous year (ignoring spurious ownership changes where an establishment's firm ID reverts); the acquirer is the establishment whose firm ID is unchanged, and targets are establishments whose previous-year firm ID differs when the firm also has an acquirer.
    登记库： IDA, IDAS
    代码： lbnr (establishment), cvrnr (firm); merger = nvals(cvrnr_prevyear)>1 within cvrnr-year; acquirer: cvrnr==cvrnr_prevyear; target: cvrnr!=cvrnr_prevyear & nacquirer>0
    复制代码 · clean_merger.do
  • Firm spinouts and exits 企业特征与生产率
    Share of a firm's workers in establishments that move to a different firm ID next year (spinout) or disappear next year before 2011 (exit).
    登记库： IDA
    代码： spinout = cvrnr_nextyear!=cvrnr; exit = cvrnr_nextyear missing & year<2011
    复制代码 · clean_merger.do
  • Education groups 教育与考试成绩
    Four education groups from the first two digits of the highest completed education code: basic (<=25), vocational (35), short/medium higher (40-50), long higher (>=60).
    登记库： IDA, UDDA
    代码： max_educ = int(HFFSP/1e6): <=25 basic; 35 vocational; 40-50; >=60
    复制代码 · AKM_merger_cvrnr.do; clean_merger.do
  • Firm industry 部门与行业
    Establishment industry is the modal worker industry code if held by more than 50% of workers; firm industry (127- and 36-group) is assigned only if at least 70% of the firm's workers share it, otherwise missing.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： persbrc mapped to pb07, ind127, ind36; thresholds 0.5 (establishment) and 0.7 (firm)
    复制代码 · clean_merger.do
  • Hiring and firing rates 企业特征与生产率
    Hiring rate = workers whose firm ID differs from the previous year divided by lagged firm employment; firing rate = workers whose firm ID differs next year divided by current employment.
    登记库： IDA
    复制代码 · AKM_merger_cvrnr.do
