Changing Tracks: Human Capital Investment after Loss of Ability

Anders Humlum, Jakob R. Munch and Pernille Plato · American Economic Review, 2025 · 个人

利用丹麦行政数据中准随机发生的工伤事故，表明受伤劳动者会入读建立在其原有培训基础之上的学士学位项目。利用不同学位可衔接（stackable）程度的差异，研究发现高等教育使受伤劳动者从领取残疾福利转向全职工作，工资比受伤前高 25%，而技能重塑补贴的回报足以四倍覆盖其成本。

数据
Industrial Injury Register (Arbejdsskaderegisteret) / workers' compensation claims from AES, National Patient Register (LPR), Health Insurance Register (Sygesikringsregisteret), Prescription Drug Database (LMDB), Education Register (UDDA), Course Participant Register (VEUV), Danish Register for Evaluation of Marginalization (DREAM), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), linked to O*NET, Population register (BEF/POP)
关键变量
  • 处理：造成收入能力损失的工伤事故（与匹配的未受伤劳动者相比）
  • 结果变量：正规学位及课程的入读与完成情况
  • 结果变量：劳动收入、工时与职业（任务内容）
  • 结果变量：残疾福利及其他社会转移支付
  • 严重程度：评定的收入能力损失与人身损伤程度
时期
1995–2017 年（工伤索赔为 1998–2017 年）
样本
14,481 起工伤事件（14,369 名不同个人）；其中持有职业教育学位且可进入高等教育的劳动者为 4,568 起事件（4,528 人） 遭遇经认定的身体性工伤事故且收入能力损失为正的丹麦全职就业劳动者（不含军人），与匹配的未受伤劳动者相比较。 来源
变量如何定义（22）
  • Work accident causing loss of earning capacity (treatment) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Work accidents recorded by the Labour Market Insurance (AES) that caused a loss of earning capacity, restricted to physical (not psychological) injuries, non-military workers, and workers with full-time employment in each of the three years before the accident. An injury qualifies for compensation if personal impairment exceeds 5% or earning capacity loss exceeds 15%.
    登记库： Industrial Injury Register (Arbejdsskaderegisteret, AES), IDA
    工作论文 · Sections 2.1, 2.2.1 and 3.1
  • Injury severity (earning capacity loss, personal impairment) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Earnings capacity loss = loss of earning capacity in percent as assessed by The Labour Market Insurance (AES); personal impairment = degree of personal impairment in percent based on injury diagnosis. Temporary injuries = accidents AES assesses did not cause permanent loss of earning capacity or personal impairment. Non-injured controls are assigned the injury year of their matched injured worker.
    登记库： AES Industrial Injury Register (Arbejdsskaderegisteret)
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix Table A.1, rows 26-28; temporary-injury figure notes
  • Matched non-injured control workers 样本界定与时间
    Injured workers matched one-to-one to non-injured workers in cells of event year, pre-event occupation, age, gender and level of education (baseline specification 5); occupational earnings premium computed within Year-Occupation-Industry-Education-Age-Gender match cells.
    登记库： IDA; AES; education register
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix Table C.2 and Figure C.1 notes; Table F notes
  • Access to higher education (instrument) 教育与考试成绩
    Direct access to higher education through a high school diploma or a vocational degree. Travel time to higher education = shortest car travel time (minutes) from residence zip code to the zip code of the nearest facility offering a relevant higher degree (as in Harmon 2015), measured separately for Craft, Care and Other educational groups; imputed for non-access workers as a residence-zip weighted average.
    登记库： Education register (UDDA); residence zip code
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix Table A.1, rows 24-25
  • Degree and course enrolment/completion 教育与考试成绩
    Degree courses = formal education programmes in the Education Register (UDDA); non-degree courses = Course Participation Register (VEUV); courses classified as Basic (primary/high school), Vocational, Higher (post-secondary). Training rate = share enrolling in a higher degree within six years after the accident; participation flow = enrollment in higher degrees in the year; stock = accumulated enrollment. Reskilling (2SLS treatment) = pursuing a higher degree within ten years after the accident; completers vs drop-outs defined by completion within ten years.
    登记库： UDDA (Education Register); VEUV (Course Participation Register)
    代码： Within 6 years (training rate); within 10 years (reskilling)
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix Table A.1, rows 31-38; Section D.1; Figure D notes
  • Disability and other social transfers 失业与福利金

Micro versus Macro Labor Supply Elasticities: The Role of Dynamic Returns to Effort

Henrik Kleven, Claus Thustrup Kreiner, Kristian Larsen and Jakob Egholt Søgaard · American Economic Review, 2025 · 个人

构建一个今天的努力会提高明天劳动收入的模型，因此对税收的反应存在滞后，并通过工作转换来传导。丹麦行政数据证实了模型关于劳动收入和工时的生命周期预测；基于工作转换者的准实验设计发现，长期劳动收入弹性约为 0.5，而短期弹性约为 0.2。

数据
Linked administrative registers on earnings, occupation (DISCO), firm and demographics, full population, Employer-employee matched data (firm x occupation job cells), ATP pension contribution-based hours measure (1980–2018), Monthly uncapped hours measure (from 2008), Income tax records (2009 tax reform variation)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：劳动收入（对数劳动收入的变化）
  • 处理：2009 年税制改革带来的边际税后留存率变化
  • 工具变量：按基期收入模拟的税后留存率变化
  • 中介变量：工作转换（企业 × 职业单元），包括大规模裁员引致的转换
  • 结果变量：工作小时数
时期
1980–2018
样本
主要弹性回归中 N = 2,501,126 和 2,428,411（表 1） 丹麦全体人口；税制改革分析使用基期收入在 250,000 至 1,000,000 DKK 之间的纳税人。 来源
变量如何定义（12）
  • ATP-based hours (1980-2018) 工作时间
    Hours inferred from mandatory ATP pension contributions, which employers pay based on a binned measure of hours; for monthly-paid workers annual contributions depend on monthly hours in four bins, giving 37 annual hours bins. Capped at full time in all 12 months.
    登记库： ATP pension contributions
    工作论文 · Section 3, footnotes 17-18
  • Monthly uncapped hours (from 2008) 工作时间
    Uncapped hours worked for all workers at monthly level, available from 2008; used where precise hours variation is needed (aggregated to quarters in the promotion event study).
    登记库： Monthly payroll records
    工作论文 · Section 3; Section 4 Fact 3
  • Job (firm x occupation cell) and job switch 职业与职位层级
    Job is a firm x occupation cell; a switcher moves between firm x occupation cells after the reform. Occupations use DISCO-08 from 2010 (563 occupations), DISCO-88 1991-2009 (372) bridged with the Humlum (2021) crosswalk, and an older Danish classification before 1991 (299). Switches where more than 50% of an individual's coworkers move to the same job cell in the same year are dropped.
    登记库： Employer-employee matched data
    代码： DISCO-08; DISCO-88; pre-1991 Danish occupation codes
    工作论文 · Section 3, footnote 15; Section 5.1
  • Mass layoff switchers 企业特征与生产率
    Mass layoffs are layoffs in which firms with at least 20 employees reduce their workforce by at least 30% in a single year; switchers are workers who move firm following such a layoff. Used in an event study of log earnings vs a linear pre-layoff trend.
    登记库： Employer-employee matched data
    代码： firm size >= 20 employees; workforce reduction >= 30% within one year
    在线附录 · Online Appendix, Figure A.8 notes
  • Labour earnings outcome 劳动收入与收入
    Total labour compensation, including contributions to employer-administered retirement savings plans; outcome is the log change between 2008 and 2010 (placebo 2006-2008).
    登记库： Income tax records
    工作论文 · Section 5.1, footnote 26
  • Reform treatment and simulated net-of-tax rate instrument 税收与税率
    Treatment assigned by pre-reform baseline taxable income (labour income, transfers, pensions, alimony and certain capital income) in bins relative to the 2009 reform threshold (around the 70th percentile). The instrument is the simulated log change in the marginal net-of-tax rate from tax code changes, holding income at baseline (Gruber-Saez). Baseline sample: taxpayers with baseline income 250,000-1,000,000 DKK.
    登记库： Income tax records
    工作论文 · Section 5.1, footnote 27; Table 2 notes
  • Promotion 职业与职位层级
    Within-firm switch to an occupation cell whose median earnings are at least 10% higher (robustness 5% and 20%); promoted workers matched to unpromoted co-workers in the same firm.

    工作论文 · Section 4, Fact 3

    Occupation cells (6-digit occupation codes) ranked by mean wage earnings; for top/bottom occupations the ranking is computed among workers aged 45-50 (mean, P10 and P90 of wage earnings reported per cell). Occupational rank used in balance checks orders occupation cells by their mean earnings.

Permanent Residency and Refugee Immigrants' Skill Investment

Jacob Nielsen Arendt, Christian Dustmann and Hyejin Ku · Journal of Labor Economics, 2025 · 个人

丹麦的一项改革提高了难民获得永久居留权所须满足的就业和语言要求。改革非但没有鼓励投资，反而降低了总体就业，语言水平也几乎没有变化，因为改革前前景较差的难民在要求看似遥不可及时减少了努力。

数据
Population, income, education and immigration registers linked via the Central Person Registry, Danish language test results, Employment in annual full-time equivalents (register data)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：以全职当量计的年就业量
  • 结果变量：通过中级或更高级别的丹麦语考试
  • 处理：2004 年 1–10 月获得临时居留（受 2007 年永久居留改革影响）与 2003 年 1–10 月获得者相比
  • 异质性：改革前的就业或语言表现类型
  • 时间：获得临时居留以来的年数（YSR 1–7）
时期
2003–2004 年居留队列，自获得临时居留起追踪七年（至 2011 年）
样本
767 名不同个人；5,122 个人年观测值 2002 年 2 月 28 日之后申请庇护、并在 2003 年 1–10 月（对照组）或 2004 年 1–10 月（处理组）获得临时居留的 18–64 岁难民。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Annual employment in full-time equivalents 就业与劳动力状态
    Employment in annual full-time equivalents (FTE = 1 for a full year of work), from a register variable recording cumulative employment in a calendar year, observed for everyone in Denmark on 1 January. For YSR = 1 only, FTE can exceed 1 because the cumulative variable includes work in the year residency was granted.
    登记库： Income registers, CPR
    论文正文 · Section 5 'Data on Refugee Immigrants' and footnote 17
  • Danish language proficiency 教育与考试成绩
    Indicator for having passed the standard Danish language test at the intermediate or higher level (test levels: basic, intermediate, high); observed from YSR = 1; passing is treated as absorbing, so the person counts as proficient at that level in all later periods.
    登记库： Danish language test results
    论文正文 · Section 4, footnote 13; Section 5
  • Treatment and control cohorts 样本界定与时间
    Refugees who applied for asylum after 28 February 2002 and were aged 18-64 when granted temporary residency; treatment = temporary residency granted January-October 2004 (exposed to the 1 May 2007 permanent-residency reform), control = January-October 2003.
    登记库： Immigration registers, BEF
    论文正文 · Sections 2, 4 and 5
  • Years since residency (YSR) 样本界定与时间
    For persons granted temporary residency during year y, YSR = 1 is year y+1 (first full calendar year with employment observed as of 1 January), followed for seven years (YSR 1-7).
    登记库： Immigration registers
    论文正文 · Section 4 and Section 5
  • Pre-reform employment performance type 就业与劳动力状态
    HIGH if cumulative employment by YSR = 2 is above 0.75 FTE, otherwise LOW (20% HIGH, 80% LOW). The reform's requirement is 2.5 FTE of cumulative employment.
    登记库： Income registers
    论文正文 · Section 5, 'Classifying workers into performance types'
  • Pre-reform language performance type 教育与考试成绩
    HIGH if the person had passed the Danish language test at the intermediate level or higher by YSR = 2 (about 16%), otherwise LOW; combined with employment type into LOW/LOW, LOW/HIGH, etc.
    登记库： Danish language test results
    论文正文 · Section 5, 'Classifying workers into performance types'
  • Matched native comparison group 样本界定与时间
    Danish natives selected by propensity-score matching to treated (control) refugees on YSR = 1 employment (2005 for treated, 2004 for control), age, gender, being single, having any children and county of residence (initial assignment county for refugees), used in a triple-difference check for the 2009 recession.
    登记库： BEF, Income registers
    论文正文 · Section 6.3 'Comparison with natives'

Healthy at Work? Evidence from a Social Experimental Evaluation of a Firm-Based Wellness Program

Marianne Simonsen and Lars Skipper · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2025 · 个人 + 企业

一项跨工作场所的大型社会实验评估了一个由雇主出资的健康项目，并在登记库中追踪长达十二年。处理组工作场所的雇员在长达七年的时间里看全科医生的次数减少、购买的处方药减少，而住院、缺勤和离职没有变化，并在家庭内部存在一定的溢出效应。

数据
Healthy-at-Work randomised experiment records (work-unit assignment, September 2008), Primary care physician consultation records (Statistics Denmark registers), Prescription drug purchase records, Hospital contact / hospitalisation records, Employment, sickness absence and turnover registers, Socio-economic background registers
关键变量
  • 处理：工作单位被随机分配到 Healthy-at-Work 健康促进项目
  • 结果变量：初级保健医生就诊
  • 结果变量：处方药购买（是否购买、供应月数）
  • 结果变量：住院（躯体疾病、精神疾病）
  • 结果变量：病假缺勤和离职
  • 溢出结果变量：配偶的医疗服务使用
时期
2008 年随机分配；追踪至 2020 年（PCP 就诊和工作结果）、2019 年（处方）、2018 年（住院）
样本
314 个工作单位中的 7,541 名工人（处理组 3,735 人，对照组 3,806 人） 参加 Healthy-at-Work 实验的老年护理卫生工作者，分布在丹麦 11 个市镇 110 家雇主的 314 个工作单位。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Treatment assignment and study population 样本界定与时间
    Work units (314 units of eldercare workers across 110 employers in 11 municipalities) were randomised in September 2008, with 144 units (46%) assigned to Healthy-at-Work. The population is individuals employed at participating work units in the month just before randomisation (7,541 of 7,660 linked to registers). Treatment status is fixed at the initial randomisation month, so post-randomisation moves are ignored and estimates are intention-to-treat.
    登记库： Healthy-at-Work experimental records, Statistics Denmark registers (CPR-linked)
    工作论文 · Sections 2.1, 3 and 4 (treatment assignment)
  • High-risk group 医疗服务利用
    Individuals with an above-median number of primary care physician consultations in the six months before randomisation; the low-risk group is at or below the median.
    登记库： Primary care physician consultation records (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Notes to Tables 2-5
  • Primary care physician consultations 医疗服务利用
    Number of consultations (and any consultation) with the primary care physician, from register data on fee-for-service payments to primary care physicians; follow-up to 2020. The paper does not give the register name or speciality codes.
    登记库： Primary care physician fee-for-service records (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 3; Section 4 results; cost-benefit section
  • Prescription drug purchases 医疗服务利用
    Any prescription drug purchase and months' supply per year (through 2019), covering drugs for hypertension, cholesterol, diabetes, severe pain relief and depression.
    登记库： Prescription drug purchase records (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： ATC C9 (hypertension, as printed), C10, A10, N2, N05A, N05B, N05C, N06A
    工作论文 · Table 3 notes
  • Hospitalisations (psychiatric / somatic) 医疗服务利用
    Any hospital contact and number of days admitted to hospital, separately for contacts with a psychiatric diagnosis and with a somatic diagnosis; follow-up to 2018. Diagnosis code lists are not given.
    登记库： Hospital contact records (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Table 4 panels A-D
  • Sickness absence 就业与劳动力状态
    Any absence and yearly absence rate (share of scheduled hours missed), conditional on hours > 0. Absence data cover about 95% of the sample.
    登记库： Absence register (Statistics Denmark; name not given)
    工作论文 · Table 5 panels A-B; Table 1 notes
  • Hours, employer continuity and earnings 就业与劳动力状态
    Any hours worked, hours worked per year, continued employment with the same employer (turnover measure), and earnings per year.
    登记库： Employment registers (Statistics Denmark; names not given)
    工作论文 · Table 5 panels C-F
  • Spouses (spillover sample) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Individuals married to or cohabiting with individuals employed at participating work units in the month just prior to randomisation.
    登记库： Population register (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Table 6 notes (spillovers to spouses)

Replication package

Do Medical Treatments Work for Work? Evidence from Breast Cancer Patients

N. Meltem Daysal, William N. Evans, Mikkel Hasse Pedersen and Mircea Trandafir · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2025 · 个人

丹麦一项诊疗指南的调整改变了哪些乳腺癌患者接受放射治疗，从而为治疗提供了准实验变异。放疗再现了临床试验中发现的生存获益，并且带来经济回报：确诊十年后，就业提高 37%，劳动收入提高 45%，抵消了确诊后就业下降的大部分。

数据
Danish Breast Cancer Cooperative Group (DBCG) clinical Breast Cancer Database, Register of Causes of Death, Register-Based Labour Force Statistics (RAS), Income Statistics Register, DREAM weekly transfer register, Population Register (BEF), Education Register
关键变量
  • 处理：接受放疗
  • 工具变量：1995 年 1 月 DBCG 指南调整扩大了放疗适用范围（1995 年之后确诊 × 符合条件组）
  • 结果变量：全因死亡率和乳腺癌死亡率
  • 结果变量：就业、年劳动收入、总收入
  • 结果变量：领取病假津贴和残疾津贴
时期
1990–2008 年（确诊时间为 1990–1998 年）
样本
2,823 个观测值（女性） 1990–1998 年在丹麦确诊乳腺癌并参加 DBCG89 临床试验的 55 岁以下高风险绝经前女性。 来源
变量如何定义（10）
  • Radiotherapy receipt 医疗服务利用
    Indicator for receiving adjuvant radiation therapy, from the DBCG clinical Breast Cancer Database, which records treatments administered and dates of diagnosis and major interventions.
    登记库： DBCG clinical Breast Cancer Database
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Data), Treatment Variable
  • T95 group and instrument 样本界定与时间
    Instrument is the interaction between an indicator for belonging to the T95 group and an indicator for diagnosis in or after 1995. The comparison group consists of 'always eligible' and 'never eligible' women (eligible or not eligible for radiotherapy regardless of year of diagnosis); full analysis sample N = 2,823. Robustness drops women diagnosed in 1994, women residing in areas with pilot universal screening programs, or women with breast-conserving surgery.
    登记库： DBCG clinical database
    在线附录 · Notes to Appendix Tables A4, A9 and Figures A4-A5
  • Analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    Female breast cancer patients diagnosed 1990-1998 (26,900), restricted to DBCG89 trial enrollees who are pre-menopausal and high-risk, excluding always-eligible patients whose radiotherapy intensity changed, patients missing radiotherapy, tumour size or micro-radical removal information, and women aged 55+ at diagnosis (final N = 2,823).
    登记库： DBCG clinical Breast Cancer Database
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Analysis Sample); Appendix Table A1
  • All-cause and breast cancer mortality 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicators for death from any cause and from breast cancer, using the exact date and ICD-coded cause of death in the Register of Causes of Death, measured for each year from the date of diagnosis up to 10 years after.
    登记库： Register of Causes of Death
    工作论文 · Section 3, Outcome Variables
  • Employed / unemployed / out of labour force 就业与劳动力状态
    Indicators of labour market status as of November from the Register-Based Labour Force Statistics, for each calendar year from diagnosis up to 10 years later. Non-survivors are assigned one for out of the labour force and zero for all other labour market outcomes.
    登记库： RAS
    工作论文 · Section 3, Outcome Variables
  • Labour earnings and gross income 劳动收入与收入
    Monetary outcomes are expressed in thousands of 2015 DKK; labour-market outcomes are averaged over 1-5 and 6-10 years after diagnosis; pre-diagnosis characteristics (employment status, labour earnings, gross personal income) are averaged over 2-4 years before diagnosis.
    登记库： Income Statistics Register
    在线附录 · Notes to Appendix Table A1 and Figures A4-A5
  • Sickness and disability benefit receipt 失业与福利金
    Transfer outcomes (any government transfer/any welfare, sickness benefits, disability pension) are indicators measured cumulatively within 5 (or 10) years after diagnosis, not as annual averages.
    登记库： DREAM
    在线附录 · Appendix Table A3; Figure A4-A5 notes
  • Clinical eligibility controls 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    All possible interactions among indicators for: mastectomy, age <45 at diagnosis, number of positive nodes (0, 1-3, 4+), tumor larger than 50mm, and tumor removed micro-radically; plus separate indicators for age at diagnosis in full years, tumor size in cm, number of positive nodes (0, 1-3, 4+), micro-radical removal, type of surgery (lumpectomy, mastectomy, or lumpectomy followed by mastectomy), and chemotherapy type (DBCG89 trial arm: CMF, CEF, OA, tamoxifen regimens, pamidronate arms); and year-of-diagnosis fixed effects. Standard errors clustered by hospital.
    登记库： DBCG clinical database
    代码： nodes 0/1-3/4+; tumor >50mm; age <45
    在线附录 · Notes to Appendix Tables A2-A4, A9
  • Radiotherapy eligibility under DBCG89 protocol 医疗服务利用
    DBCG89 protocol (age eligibility <75 years). Low risk (as printed in the appendix protocol table): tumor <=5cm and positive nodes and grade I (if premenopausal); high risk: tumor >5cm or positive nodes or (premenopausal and ductal grade II-III). Radiotherapy indicated after lumpectomy, when the carcinoma was not removed microradically, and additionally for: age <=45 with >=4 positive nodes (until January 1995); premenopausal with positive nodes or tumor >5cm (from January 1995). Positive nodes = cancer spread to at least one lymph node.
    登记库： Danish Breast Cancer Cooperative Group (DBCG) clinical database
    代码： tumor >5cm; >=4 positive nodes; age <=45; age <75
    在线附录 · Appendix Figure A1 (DBCG89 protocol)
  • Cumulative hospital contacts 医疗服务利用
    Cumulative number of inpatient and outpatient hospital contacts from diagnosis until each year after diagnosis (separate outcomes).
    在线附录 · Appendix Figure A8 notes

Grades and Employer Learning

Anne Toft Hansen, Ulrik Hvidman and Hans Henrik Sievertsen · Journal of Labor Economics, 2024 · 个人

利用丹麦大学成绩在全国范围内的一次换算，识别与能力无关的 GPA 回报。改革导致的 GPA 提高使毕业后初期的劳动收入上升，对其他信号较少的毕业生尤其如此，但这一效应在几年内消退，这与雇主很快了解到生产率相一致。

数据
University student records (Aarhus University and University of Copenhagen) with grades before and after the 2007 recoding, Administrative registers from Statistics Denmark (background, parental income and education, earnings)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：毕业后前五个日历年中每一年的税前劳动收入总额的对数
  • 处理：2007 年 8 月 1 日成绩按新评分标准重新编码所引起的 GPA 变化
  • 结果变量：劳动收入为正的指示变量
  • 控制变量：性别、毕业时年龄、高中 GPA、父母的收入、就业和教育
时期
2007 年 8 月 1 日在读且于 2011 年前毕业的学生；毕业后前五年的劳动收入
样本
3,813 名学生 2007 年 8 月 1 日在 Aarhus University 或 University of Copenhagen 注册在读、剩余学分不超过 40 ECTS 且于 2011 年前毕业的硕士生。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Reform-induced GPA (treatment) 教育与考试成绩
    Deviation of a student's recoded (post-1 August 2007, 7-point scale) GPA from a cubic fit of post-recoding GPA on pre-recoding (13-scale) GPA; grades were recoded per the Ministry of Education mapping. Final GPA is a weighted average of recoded grades and grades from exams after the recoding.
    登记库： University student records (Aarhus University, University of Copenhagen)
    代码： 13-scale to 7-point scale mapping (paper Table 1)
    工作论文 · Sections 2 and 3.4; Table 1; Figure 3
  • Master's student sample 样本界定与时间
    Students enrolled in a master's program on 1 August 2007 at Aarhus University (incl. Aarhus School of Business) or University of Copenhagen with at most 40 ECTS points remaining on the recoding date, who graduated before 2011 (3,813 students).
    登记库： University student records
    工作论文 · Section 3.1
  • Log total gross earnings after graduation 劳动收入与收入
    Log total gross earnings in each of the first five calendar years after graduation; individuals with zero earnings excluded. A separate extensive-margin outcome is an indicator for positive earnings. Monetary values in 2015 prices (CPI).
    登记库： Statistics Denmark registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.2; Table 2 notes
  • Other labour market outcomes 劳动收入与收入
    Log disposable income (after transfers and taxes), unemployment, public-sector employment, job changes, annual earnings growth, and earnings growth with the same employer, in each of the first five years after graduation.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark registers
    工作论文 · Section 5; Table 7
  • Parental background controls 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Parental income (mean total disposable income across observed parents, calendar year before graduation/reform), parental unemployment (mean annual unemployment), indicator for at least one parent with a university degree, and parental origin (non-Western vs Western per Statistics Denmark); missing values set to zero with missing dummies.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark registers
    工作论文 · Sections 3.2 and 4; Table 2 notes
  • Earnings while studying (heterogeneity) 劳动收入与收入
    Low earnings while studying used as a proxy for little relevant labour-market experience; Aarhus University attendance used as a further proxy.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark registers
    工作论文 · Section 6; Table 8 panels E-F

Public Pensions and Private Savings

Esteban García-Miralles and Jonathan M. Leganza · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2024 · 个人

丹麦一项改革提高了社会保障养老金的领取资格年龄，本文在行政数据中用断点回归加以研究：领取资格推迟使人们工作更久，个人养老金账户和雇主养老金账户的缴费随之增加。既有储蓄行为的惯性和企业的默认缴费率是关键机制。

数据
Population registers (date of birth, demographics), Labour-market and income/asset registers (tax-reported bank and stock balances, property values, pension contributions), Monthly earnings register (eIncome / eIndkomst), Voluntary early retirement pension (VERP) contribution and benefit records
关键变量
  • 驱动变量：出生日期相对于 1954 年 1 月 1 日这一断点
  • 处理：2011 年改革带来的更高养老金领取资格年龄
  • 结果变量：向雇主提供的养老金账户和个人养老金账户的缴费
  • 结果变量：银行账户和股票账户余额以及房产价值的变化
  • 结果变量：税前劳动收入与以月计的退休年龄
时期
1985–2018 年（年度）；2008–2017 年（月度）
样本
40,042 人（分析样本）；12,020 人（断点回归估计样本） 出生日期在 1954 年 1 月 1 日前后六个月以内、改革前定期向 VERP 提前退休计划缴费的非自雇丹麦人。 来源
变量如何定义（13）
  • Reform treatment (birthdate cutoff) 退休与养老金
    Those born on or after 1 January 1954 learned in 2011 that their early retirement age (ERA), incentivized retirement age and full retirement age (FRA) rose from 60, 62 and 65 to 60.5, 62.5 and 65.5; those born one day earlier were unaffected. Running variable is birth date relative to the cutoff; RD sample is those born within 56 days (8 weeks).
    登记库： Population register (exact date of birth)
    工作论文 · Sections 2.3 and 4.2
  • VERP participant analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    Four cumulative restrictions: (1) Danes born within six months of the cutoff date January 1, 1954 (71,095 individuals); (2) regular participatory VERP contributors, defined as making contributions in 70% of pre-announcement years 2001-2010 (47,047); (3) balanced panel: present in the data in every year 2006-2018 (43,348); (4) drop the self-employed, defined over the pre-announcement period using Statistics Denmark's definition of an individual's main source of income (final analysis sample 40,042).
    登记库： Population register, VERP contribution records, Statistics Denmark main source of income classification
    代码： birthdate within +/-6 months of 1954-01-01; VERP contributions in >=70% of years 2001-2010; balanced 2006-2018
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Table A.1 and notes
  • Contributions to employer-sponsored and personal retirement accounts 退休与养老金
    Annual contribution flows to employer-sponsored DC accounts in levels (winsorized at the 95th percentile by year) and indicators for positive contributions to personal retirement accounts (also indicators for contributions of various sizes).
    登记库： Labour-market/income registers (tax-reported pension contributions)
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Changes in bank, stock and property values 财富、负债与消费
    Year-t minus year-(t-1) year-end values of bank account balances and stock market account balances (reported by financial institutions to tax authorities) and of property cash values as assessed by tax authorities; winsorized at the 5th and 95th percentiles each year (also 10th/90th).
    登记库： Tax-reported asset registers
    工作论文 · Section 4.1, footnote 20
  • Pre-tax earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Income on which individuals pay the 8 percent labor market tax, winsorized by year at the 95th percentile; 2010 prices, 5.56 DKK per USD.
    登记库： Income register
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Monthly retirement age 退休与养老金
    Absorbing-state measure from the monthly eIncome register (2008-2017): age in the last month with positive earnings before earnings permanently fall to zero.
    登记库： eIncome (eIndkomst) monthly earnings register
    工作论文 · Section 4.1, footnote 17
  • VERP benefit claiming 退休与养老金
    Annual Voluntary Early Retirement Pension (VERP) benefit payments.
    登记库： VERP benefit records
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Firm default contribution rate 企业特征与生产率
    All individuals over 18 are assigned to workplaces in 2010; individual contribution rate = employer-sponsored plan contributions divided by earnings; the firm default rate is the median contribution rate among the firm's workers in 2010. Predicted contributions = current earnings times the 2010 firm default rate.
    登记库： Linked employer-employee data, Pension contribution records
    工作论文 · Section 6 (employer defaults), footnote 30
  • VERP participation indicator (qualified UI-fund contributions) 退休与养老金
    Participatory VERP contribution in a year is measured as an indicator for making qualified (VERP) contributions to unemployment insurance (UI) funds in that year; VERP eligibility requires contributions in 25 of the previous 30 years.
    登记库： VERP contribution records
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Table A.7 notes; Appendix C.2
  • RD control variables 其他
    Baseline RD controls: indicator for being male, indicator for being married in 2010, and indicators for region of residence in 2010 (five regions: Hovedstaden, Sjaelland, Syddanmark, Midtjylland, Nordjylland). Regressions use separate linear polynomials in birthdate on each side of the cutoff with triangular weights.
    登记库： Population register
    代码： 5 regions as of 2010
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Table A.2 notes
  • Retirement at eligibility-age spikes 退休与养老金
    Control group (born before cutoff): first spike = retirement age between 60y0m and 60y5m; second spike = 62y0m to 62y5m. Treatment group: first spike = 60y6m to 60y11m; second spike = 62y6m to 62y11m. 15.8% retire at the first spike and 10.6% at the second as defined.
    代码： monthly retirement-age windows 60:00-60:05, 62:00-62:05 (control); 60:06-60:11, 62:06-62:11 (treated)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix B
  • Pre-reform personal retirement plan users 样本界定与时间
    Subsample of individuals who had used personal retirement plans before the reform announcement: those who made contributions to personal plans in two or three of the years 2008-2010.
    登记库： Tax-reported pension contribution records
    代码： contributions in >=2 of 2008, 2009, 2010
    在线附录 · Online Appendix table notes (personal-plan subsample)
  • Outcome winsorization and time windows 样本界定与时间
    Anticipation-period outcomes are averaged over 2011-2013 and pre-announcement placebo outcomes over 2008-2010; robustness uses stricter winsorization at the 10th and 90th percentiles; an additional robustness subsample excludes individuals with real estate transactions.
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Tables A.5-A.6, placebo table notes

Joint Retirement of Couples: Evidence from Discontinuities in Denmark

Esteban García-Miralles and Jonathan M. Leganza · Journal of Public Economics, 2024 · 个人

利用丹麦提前退休和公共养老金领取资格上的年龄断点表明，当伴侣一方获得资格并退休时，另一方也退休的可能性大幅上升；文章由此量化了对评估退休改革十分重要的溢出效应。

数据
Danish administrative registers for the full population 1986–2014 (labour market outcomes, pension benefits, socio-demographics, family/couple links), Annual taxable earnings registers, Monthly earnings records for all employees (eIndkomst/BFL) and monthly pension benefit records, from 2008, Voluntary early retirement pension (VERP) contribution records
关键变量
  • 结果变量：配偶退休（不再有劳动收入）
  • 结果变量：养老金申领（VERP 或 OAP）和年劳动收入
  • 驱动变量（基于年龄的设计）：参照个体的年龄相对于提前退休金领取资格年龄 60 岁的位置
  • 驱动变量（基于改革的设计）：出生日期相对于 1954 年 1 月 1 日这一分界点的位置，2011 年改革以此为界把 VERP 领取资格年龄提高 6 个月
时期
1986–2014 年（基于年龄的设计为 1991–2013 年；基于改革的设计为 2008–2014 年）
样本
367,585 对伴侣、2,206,044 个伴侣—年观测值（基于年龄的样本）；10,321 对伴侣、73,395 个伴侣—年观测值（基于改革的样本） 年龄相差不超过 8 岁的丹麦双职工伴侣（已婚、登记伴侣或同居），参照个体年龄为 57–60 岁，不含自雇者和残疾福利领取者。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Retirement (age-based design) 退休与养老金
    Retirement is ceasing to earn labour market income: the year in which the individual earned labour income for the last time, treated as an absorbing state (1 thereafter). Small positive income up to the equivalent of one month of average earnings is allowed after retirement (holiday pay, delayed wages). A flow definition allowing multiple retirements is used as robustness.
    登记库： Annual labour market/income registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.2 (Key Variables), footnote 10
  • Working past July 1 (reform-based design) 退休与养老金
    Using monthly earnings records (eIncome, from 2008), a dummy equal to one if the individual works past the first half of the year (past July 1) in a given year.
    登记库： eIndkomst (monthly earnings)
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Pension claiming 退休与养老金
    Receiving pension income, either voluntary early retirement pension (VERP) or old-age pension (OAP): annual indicator for any pension income in the year (age-based design), or indicator for receiving pension income before July 1 using monthly pension benefit records (reform-based design).
    登记库： Annual pension benefit registers, Monthly pension benefit records (from 2008)
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Annual labour earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Taxable annual labour market earnings from the annual registers, winsorized at the 1st and 99th percentiles, deflated to 2010 prices and converted at 1 USD = 5.56 DKK.
    登记库： Annual income registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Couples 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Married, registered-partnership or cohabiting couples residing in Denmark 1991-2014, identified when both partners are below age 60 and followed while they remain together; age difference within couple at most 8 years.
    登记库： Population/family registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.3
  • Dual-earner couple restrictions 样本界定与时间
    Reference individual (partner reaching own eligibility age) earned labour income at least once at ages 55-59 and was never self-employed or on disability benefits at ages 50-59; spouse earned labour income at least once at ages 50-59. Age-based sample: 1991-2013, reference individual aged 57-60 (eligibility age 60). Reform-based sample: 2008-2014, reference individuals with qualifying VERP contributions at least once at ages 50-59, born within 3 months either side of 1 January 1954, balanced panel.
    登记库： Annual registers, VERP contribution records
    工作论文 · Section 3.3, footnote 11

The Long-Run Effects of Individual Debt Relief

Gustaf Bruze, Alexander Kjær Hilsløv and Jonas Maibom · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2024 · 个人

将丹麦债务减免项目的法院记录与登记库相关联，并利用申请人被准随机分配给批准率各不相同的法院受托人这一点。债务减免在超过 25 年的时间里提高了劳动所得、就业、资产、住房自有率和财富，其中转入就业解释了收入增幅的三分之二。

数据
Hand-collected debt relief announcements from the official gazette Statstidende (court records), 1984–2005, Central Person Register (CPR) for linkage, Income Tax Register: earned income, taxable assets and debt, real estate ownership, Labour market status registers (employment status in November), Hourly wage measure from Statistics Denmark
关键变量
  • 处理：获准法院裁定的债务减免

利用丹麦登记数据和调查数据估计了一个涵盖家庭劳动供给、家庭生产、储蓄和离婚的动态模型，用以研究婚姻解除后的扶养给付。与子女抚养费相比，配偶赡养费对劳动供给的抑制作用更大，为消费提供保险的效率也更低，因此提高子女抚养费、降低配偶赡养费会使福利上升。

1980–2013

The Gender Application Gap: Do Men and Women Apply for the Same Jobs?

Jonas Fluchtmann, Anita M. Glenny, Nikolaj A. Harmon and Jonas Maibom · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2024 · 个人

利用丹麦每一位失业保险领取者求职申请的行政记录。即使可观测特征相近，男性和女性申请的工作类型也大不相同，这些申请上的差异可以解释残差性别工资差距的 70% 以上。

数据
Joblog job application records from the public employment service platform (Jobnet), Unemployment insurance payment records / DREAM event-history data, Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Employment Statistics for Employees, monthly earnings and hours (BFL)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：所申请工作的特征（职业、行业、AKM 企业工资溢价、通勤、工时）
  • 分组：性别
  • 结果变量：入职一个月后新工作的小时工资
  • 所申请工作的预测“典型工资”
时期
2015 年 9 月–2017 年 9 月
样本
105,879 人，114,375 段失业保险（UI）领取期，2,911,585 份求职申请 2015 年 9 月至 2017 年 9 月开始新一段领取期的丹麦失业保险（UI）领取者，领取期至少持续 8 周，至少有 4 份登记在案的申请，并在一年内找到工作。 来源
变量如何定义（11）
  • New UI spell and analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    UI recipients of Danish nationality entering new UI spells September 2015 to September 2017. A new UI spell starts when a person who received no UI benefits in the previous 4 weeks is observed with at least 4 consecutive weeks of UI payouts. Restrictions: spell lasts at least 8 weeks; at least 4 Joblog applications registered during the spell (counted after dropping the last 4 weeks); exits UI to employment within 52 weeks; applications from the last 4 weeks before the new job starts are dropped (median transition time 6 weeks minus an assumed 2 weeks from application to offer). Observations with an estimated propensity score above 0.99 or below 0.01 are trimmed.
    登记库： DREAM, Joblog (Jobnet), IDA, BFL
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.1 and A.6, Table A.1, fn. 39
  • Job applications (Joblog) 失业与福利金
    Applications self-reported in the Joblog section of Jobnet during the UI spell. Only applications actually sent are kept, using the first saved version of each entry. Other Joblog events (vacancies saved for later, interviews, rejections) are excluded. Mandatory fields include job title, part-time or full-time status, and firm name, zip code and city.
    登记库： Joblog (Jobnet)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.1, fn. 38; A.2
  • Occupation of applied-for job 职业与职位层级
    Self-reported job titles were cleaned and mapped to DISCO (the Danish version of ISCO) in three steps: (1) unique 1:1 occurrences of DISCO occupation names in the title (43.4% of applications); (2) manual mapping of acronyms and common titles, e.g. 'sosu-hjælper' (+27.2%); (3) fuzzy matching with SAS compget, speedist and soundex plus substring matches, keeping only consistently high-ranked matches (+10.9%). In total 81.5% of applications are matched. Occupations are used at the 1-, 2- and 3-digit levels (9, 55 and 153 groups).
    登记库： Joblog (Jobnet)
    代码： DISCO 1-digit (9 groups), 2-digit (55), 3-digit (153)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.2, fn. 41, fn. 43
  • Industry / firm of applied-for job 部门与行业
    The reported firm name, zip code and city are matched to the CVR firm register and then to BFL. Steps: exact 1:1 match on firm name and zip code (66.3%); substring matches closest to the reported address (+13.9%); fuzzy matching on the 50 closest Stata matchit candidates, ranked by 5 scores (bigram similscore, token, tokensound, SAS compget and speedist), keeping the best average rank (+6.2%). Overall firm match rate is 86.4%. Industry comes from BFL using NACE Rev. 2 groupings of 10, 21 or 38 industries. Industry is missing when the firm is too new or small to have an industry recorded in BFL.
    登记库： CVR, BFL
    代码： NACE Rev. 2 aggregations: 10, 21 and 38 industries
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.2, fn. 41, 42, 44
  • Firm wage premium (AKM firm effect) 企业特征与生产率
    AKM model on log hourly wages (BFL monthly earnings divided by monthly paid hours) with worker, firm and calendar-month fixed effects. The panel uses March and September of each year from 2008 to 2017, giving 265,425 connected firms (about 95% of firms). Firm effects are standardised within industry by subtracting the industry mean and dividing by the industry SD. Decile bins are employment-weighted by firm employment in August 2015. Gender-specific AKM effects are used as a robustness check.
    登记库： BFL
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.3
  • Hourly wage in new job 劳动收入与收入
    BFL monthly earnings divided by recorded monthly paid hours in the first full month of employment in the new job. Results are similar using a 4-month average or excluding observations whose hours were imputed by Statistics Denmark.
    登记库： BFL
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.1, fn. 40
  • Typical wage of a job 劳动收入与收入
    Predicted log wage from a Post-LASSO OLS model estimated on new jobs in the analysis sample. Candidate regressors are 1-, 2- and 3-digit industry and occupation dummies, the within-industry standardised AKM firm effect (set to 0 when missing, plus a missing dummy) and all pairwise interactions, 10,407 variables in total. Rigorous LASSO (Belloni et al. 2016, LASSOPACK, clustered by individual) selects 233 variables, of which 117 remain after collinearity. Out-of-sample R2 is 0.201. Alternative models without firm information or without occupation information fill in values for unlinked applications. The model uses no worker characteristics.
    登记库： BFL, Joblog (Jobnet)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.4, Tables A.3-A.4
  • Full-time vs part-time applied-for job 工作时间
    Mandatory Joblog field: full-time is 37 hours per week; part-time is less than full-time.
    登记库： Joblog
    工作论文 · Section 4 (non-wage job characteristics)
  • Implied commute 地理与社区
    Commuting distance or time from the applicant's municipality of residence to the job's postal code, computed with the Google Maps API (following Harmon 2015).
    登记库： Joblog, BEF/IDA residence
    工作论文 · Section 4, footnote 33
  • Firm family-friendliness 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Firm-level average days of parental leave per birth among employees. Built from childbirth-related payouts after 2011 in the sickness/maternity benefit register (SGDP), covering both employer reimbursements and direct payments, for workers who later return to the same pre-birth employer. Births are inferred from a new leave spell or a gap of more than half a year between payments. Leave length is censored at 14 months and demeaned by gender before averaging at the firm. Firms with no births form a separate 'no birth' category.
    登记库： SGDP (sickness/maternity benefit register)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.8.1, fn. 55-57, Figure A.4
  • Conditioning set (double-LASSO observables) 样本界定与时间
    The double-LASSO of Belloni et al. 2014 (PDSLASSO) selects 332 variables from 4,196 candidates, of which 302 remain after collinearity; they enter a logit propensity score for being male, and women are reweighted by p/(1-p). Candidates: years of education, field of study, age, total work experience and experience over the last 5 years, sector/industry/occupation of the previous job, industry- and occupation-specific experience over the last 5 years at 1/2/3-digit levels, and time on UI, social assistance and other transfers over the last 5 years, with interactions and squares of age, education and experience.
    登记库： IDA, DREAM
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.5-A.6, Table A.5

利用丹麦失业保险领取者的求职申请记录，刻画人们所申请的职位在不同求职者之间有何差异、在一段失业期内如何变化，以及这些模式对定向搜寻模型意味着什么。

数据

  • 结果变量：投向公开发布的职位空缺的申请比例
  • 时间变量：失业期的第几个月

2015 年 9 月–2017 年 9 月

127,695 人（失业期）和超过 400 万个所申请的职位 2015 年 9 月至 2017 年 9 月间开始领取失业保险的丹麦裔个人，有资格领取满两年的失业金，失业期至少 8 周且至少有一次登记的申请。 来源

UI recipient survey

    登记库： DREAM, Joblog, IDA

  • Predicted (typical) wage of applied-for jobs 失业与福利金

Income Effects and Labour Supply: Evidence from a Child Benefits Reform

Mathias Fjællegaard Jensen and Jack Blundell · Journal of Public Economics, 2024 · 个人

2011 年丹麦对儿童津贴设置上限，削减了有多个年幼子女的家庭所得到的津贴，而较小的家庭不受影响。削减之后母亲的劳动供给大幅上升，主要体现在广延边际上；文章还利用绝育记录来控制再生育偏好上的差异。

数据
Population register (BEF) for family composition, marital status and cohabitation, Monthly payroll records with hours worked (BFL/eIndkomst), Child benefit payment records (BOBO/BOTI), Register OF (monthly demographics and parental leave status), Sterilisation consultations from the National Patient Register (LPRADM) and health insurance service registers (SYSI, SSSY), Annual income register (IND) for self-employment robustness
关键变量
  • 处理：2011 年儿童津贴上限（DKK 35,000），减少了有年幼子女的较大家庭的非劳动收入
  • 结果变量：每月工作小时数（集约边际和广延边际）
  • 结果变量：年劳动收入（稳健性检验中包括自雇者）
  • 控制/样本限制：改革前家庭有过绝育咨询
  • 设计：双重差分，处理组家庭与未受影响家庭对比
时期
2008 年 9 月至 2014 年 12 月（月度）
样本
28,968 名处理组女性和 22,477 名处理组男性 本国出生的丹麦已婚或同居父母，在整个窗口期内年龄为 25–59 岁，2011 年 1 月有 2–4 个子女（至少两个未满 18 岁），非自雇，在平衡的月度面板中可观测。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Monthly hours worked 工作时间
    Total hours worked per month from employer reports to the tax authorities (BFL, from 2008), summed over all jobs held in the month; for employees on parental leave with fixed contractual hours not adjusted in BFL, hours are adjusted using observed days of leave.

    论文正文 · Section 5.1 and footnote 4
  • Employment indicator (extensive margin) 就业与劳动力状态

  • Treatment group (child benefit cap) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Family experienced a strictly positive reduction in child benefits due to the DKK 35,000 cap in the first and/or second quarter of 2011 (benefits based on number and ages of children in the previous quarter; simulated from population registers and validated with Q4 BOBO/BOTI payments); control group = families not affected in Q1-Q2 2011. Continuous treatment = reduction in child benefits in 2011 in thousand DKK for treated families, zero otherwise.

  • Family sterilisation consultation 医疗服务利用

  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Balanced monthly panel September 2008-December 2014 of individuals aged at least 25 in September 2008 and under 60 in December 2014; excludes immigrants and children of immigrants, parents of children with irregular child benefit payments, and (main analysis) anyone self-employed at any point; in January 2011 must have at least 2 children under 18, no more than 4 children in total, and be married or cohabiting.
    登记库： BEF, OF, BFL, BOBO/BOTI

  • Annual earnings incl. self-employment (robustness) 劳动收入与收入

    登记库： IND

  • 政策 3：起步援助（Start Aid）福利削减（断点回归，断点为接收日期 2002 年 7 月 1 日）

变量如何定义（8）
  • Refugee identification and settlement date 移民身份与来源地

Date of first settlement in Denmark and later out-migration from the migration register (VNDS); refugees followed from first settlement in a municipality (within two months of being granted status), 1986-2008 arrivals.

  • Employment (any in year) 就业与劳动力状态

  • Annual gross labour earnings 劳动收入与收入

  • Initial placement: municipal labour market strength and co-nationals 地理与社区
    For the conditionally random dispersal (refugees granted status 1987-1998): employment rate of non-Western immigrants in the municipality of first placement in the placement year, and share of co-nationals in that municipality's population; both divided by their SD.

  • Start Aid welfare cut RD 失业与福利金

  • Industry Packages ALMP exposure 失业与福利金

  • Linguistically close vs far origin 移民身份与来源地

Language Training and Refugees' Integration

Mette Foged, Linea Hasager, Giovanni Peri, Jacob Nielsen Arendt and Iben Bolvig · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2024 · 个人

将银行交易数据与政府登记库相结合，度量失业后家庭自我保险的每一个调整边际。两年内，家庭削减的支出相当于收入损失的 30%，约一半的收入损失靠动用流动性余额弥补；配偶劳动供给、私人转移、房屋净值提取和消费信贷的贡献较小。

数据

关键变量

变量如何定义（9）
  • Job loss event 失业与福利金
    Month in which wage payments from the individual's main employer cease and total gross wage income drops below DKr 1,000; the individual must receive unemployment benefits or social insurance in months -1 to 3 and no early retirement, sickness or parental leave benefits then, must have had gross wage income of at least DKr 10,000 for at least 18 consecutive months before, and must not return to the same employer within three months.

  • Analysis sample and event window 样本界定与时间
    Baseline sample of active customers: at least five outgoing spending transactions in each month of the event window, with the partner (if any) meeting the same criterion. Exclusive-customer subsample: active customers (and partners) with no deposits or loans at other retail banks. Characteristics measured in month -6 relative to job loss (annual income over the calendar year containing month -6; shares held at other banks and mortgage debt at end of previous calendar year).
    登记库： Danske Bank; tax records; mortgage data
    代码： >= 5 spending transactions per month

    Mass layoff notifications from the Ministry of Employment (firms with >20 employees must report planned large-scale layoffs; 'large scale' ranges from 10 workers for firms with 20-100 employees to 30 workers for firms with >300 employees), linked by firm ID to Tax Agency payroll data; individuals whose employer's report date falls in months -7 to -1 relative to the observed layoff month; 1,156 individuals.
    登记库： Ministry of Employment mass layoff notifications; BFL/eIndkomst
    代码： report in months -7 to -1
    在线附录 · Appendix E
  • Household disposable income (bank inflows) and components 劳动收入与收入
    Disposable income = sum of monthly incoming direct deposits, person-to-person transfers from outside the household and cash deposits into Danske Bank accounts owned by the affected person and/or spouse (excluding transfers between own accounts). Wage income: inflow coded as wage if sender's bank registration number (4-digit Danish bank code) is the one mapped to the recipient's employer in that month (mapping = registration number from which the highest share of the employer's payroll employees, per Tax Agency payroll data, received payments; second-ranked used if top is the central-government number and employer is not central government), or if transaction type code is e.g. 'salary transfers'. Joint-account wage payments go to the spouse if from the spouse's employer, otherwise to the affected person. Government transfers: sender registration number linked to a paying agency per payroll data, or the central-government registration number when person does not work for central government. Private transfers and other income = residual.
    登记库： Danske Bank transactions; BFL/eIndkomst monthly payroll and transfer records
    在线附录 · Appendix A (Income variables) and Appendix C
  • Total spending (transaction based) 财富、负债与消费
    Sum of outgoing card payments (incl. mobile-phone payments), bill payments and cash withdrawals from the household's bank accounts, excluding outflows identified via recipient MCC as tax or debt payments; excludes bank fees, securities purchases and uncategorized transfers. Bank aggregates raw transactions to daily totals per account x transaction type x recipient category. Household = affected person + spouse; joint-account outflows split evenly between owners.
    登记库： Danske Bank transactions

  • Spending subcategories (MCC-based) 财富、负债与消费
    Utilities: MCC 4900, 4812, 4814, 4821, 4899 or bill-payment label utilities/elec/gas/water/heating/internet/cable TV/telephone/TV license. Restaurants and bars: MCC 5813, 5462, 5811, 5812, 5814. Groceries: MCC 5411, 5422, 5441, 5499, 5921 or bill-payment label groceries.
    登记库： Danske Bank transactions

    在线附录 · Appendix A (Spending)
  • Net saving in liquid assets 财富、负债与消费

  • Mortgage equity extraction and loan types (monthly) 财富、负债与消费

  • 网络构成：与大型企业／上市公司、与男性以及与现任监事会成员的联系
时期
1995–2011
样本
所查资料中未注明 1995–2011 年雇主—雇员数据中观测到的丹麦工人，研究其首次获任监事会成员的情况。 来源（摘要）

Estimating Labor Supply Responses to Danish Tax Reforms

Hans Schytte Sigaard · Journal of Public Economics, 2023 · 个人

把应税收入弹性的估计方法应用于实际工作小时的登记数据。集约边际上的劳动供给弹性约为 0.08，与劳动收入弹性和应税收入弹性接近；这一反应来自合同工时和带薪缺勤的变化，以及主业与副业之间的转换。

数据
Wage Statistics Register (Lønstatistikken, LON) for performed hours of work, Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDAN) for workplace controls, Income registers (IND, INDK, INPI) for marginal tax rate simulation, Population register (BEF) and family income register (FAIN), Family register (FAMILIE), Education register (UDDA), Danish tax simulation programs (Kleven and Schultz 2014, extended by the Ministry of Finance)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：年实际工作小时数的三年对数变化
  • 处理：劳动收入边际税后留存率的三年对数变化
  • 工具变量：税制改革引起的边际税率的机械（模拟）变化，用滞后收入计算
  • 次要结果变量：劳动收入和应税收入
  • 控制变量：收入样条、社会经济特征和市镇控制变量
时期
2002–2016
样本
10,755,733 个观测值 被 Wage Statistics Register（工资统计登记库）覆盖的 25–65 岁受雇工薪者，在每个三年差分的两个年份工时均为正，且基年劳动收入高于 DKK 250,000。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Performed hours of work 工作时间
    Contract hours plus paid overtime, minus paid absence, vacation and weekday holiday hours, summed over all employments in a year per individual (including secondary jobs). Contract hours are available from 2002, so the sample covers 2002-2016. LON covers all public firms and private firms with 100+ employees, plus a sample of private firms with 10-99 employees (about 50% of main employments).
    登记库： LON (Lønstatistikken)
    论文正文 · Section 4 (Data), eq. (5); Appendix A.1
  • Three-year log change in performed hours 工作时间
    Main outcome: log change in annual performed hours between base year t and t+3. Strictly positive hours are required in both years. Decompositions condition on staying in the same job versus switching jobs between t and t+3.
    登记库： LON
    论文正文 · Section 3, eq. (1); Section 5.1, Tables 3-4
  • Marginal tax rate on labour income 税收与税率
    Simulated using tax programs from Kleven and Schultz (2014), extended by the Danish Ministry of Finance (available 1984-2016), as [T_t(z+100) - T_t(z)]/100, with income information mainly from IND, INDK and INPI. The treatment is the three-year log change in the marginal net-of-tax rate.
    登记库： IND, INDK, INPI
    论文正文 · Section 4 (Data)
  • Predicted (mechanical) change in net-of-tax rate instrument 税收与税率
    ln(1 - T'_{t+s}(z_{i,t-k})) - ln(1 - T'_t(z_{i,t-k})): marginal rates under the period t+s and t tax systems evaluated at income lagged k periods, following Weber (2014). The main specification uses k = 2, with lags 2-4 used for overidentification tests.
    登记库： IND, INDK, INPI
    论文正文 · Section 3.1.1, eq. (2); Section 3.2
  • Lagged income controls 劳动收入与收入
    Ten-piece spline with breakpoints at the deciles of log labour income lagged twice, to control for mean reversion and heterogeneous income trends.
    登记库： IND, INDK
    论文正文 · Section 3.1
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Individuals aged 25-65 with all information needed to simulate marginal taxes, who are neither jobless nor outside the labour force as primary occupation at end of November in year t, and have strictly positive hours at t and t+3. Base-year labour income must exceed DKK 250,000 (2015 prices, CPI-deflated) and all controls must be non-missing.
    登记库： LON, IDAN, BEF, IND
    论文正文 · Section 4 (Data), Table A.1
  • Workplace, socioeconomic and family controls 企业特征与生产率
    Workplace controls from IDAN, socioeconomic and municipal controls from BEF and FAIN, children from FAMILIE, and education from UDDA; industry groups follow Statistics Denmark's standard groupings.
    登记库： IDAN, BEF, FAIN, FAMILIE, UDDA
    论文正文 · Section 4 (Data); Section 3.1 footnote 6

The Anatomy of Sorting: Evidence from Danish Data

Rasmus Lentz, Suphanit Piyapromdee and Jean-Marc Robin · Econometrica, 2023 · 个人 + 企业

用丹麦雇主—雇员匹配数据估计一个灵活的模型，刻画工资和工作流动中的工人异质性与企业异质性。工人与企业呈正向分选（sorting），这种分选既通过工资也通过非工资福利（amenities）实现，工人异质性解释了工资离散的大部分。

数据
Matched employer-employee register data (IDA) with annual wages, Weekly labour market spell/mobility data built from Statistics Denmark registers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：工资率的对数
  • 工作间流动以及进入和退出非就业状态的转换（按周）
  • 潜在的工人类型和企业类型（有限混合模型，分类 EM 算法）
  • 控制变量：性别、教育、潜在工作经验、任职年限、日历时间
  • 分选渠道：工作偏好、市场分割、解雇、找到工作
时期
1985–2013 年（分析面板始于 1987 年）
样本
所查资料中未注明 完成学业后的丹麦工人，就业时段开始于 50 岁之前，1987 至 2013 年间按周跨雇主跟踪（信息取自 2018 年的工作论文前身版本）。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Log wage rate 劳动收入与收入
    Annual total salary declared by the employer to the tax authorities divided by total hours worked by the worker in that year; assigned to the first week of the year or the first week of a new employment spell starting within the year. Hours are inferred by Statistics Denmark from mandatory pension contributions that depend on weekly hours.
    登记库： Danish matched employer-employee data (MEE)
    工作论文 · Section 2, footnote 7
  • Full-time employment vs non-employment spell 就业与劳动力状态
    Weekly employment and non-employment spells 1985-2013; spells with less than an average of 25 work hours per week are treated as non-employment spells (to keep only full-time workers). Non-employment is coded as firm ID 0.
    登记库： Danish matched employer-employee data (MEE)
    工作论文 · Section 2 and footnote 6; Appendix E.1
  • Analysis panel 样本界定与时间
    Panel starts in 1987 (1985-1986 used to classify tenure of the 1987 stock of jobs); only employment spells starting after the individual finished the highest level of education are kept, and spells starting after age 50 are removed. Workers are drawn from the 1987 working-age population or enter in the first week of the year after their last year of schooling. About 4 million workers and 400,000 firms.
    登记库： Danish matched employer-employee data (MEE)
    工作论文 · Section 2; Appendix E.1
  • Education groups 教育与考试成绩
    Based on normed years of education of the highest completed degree: low is below 12 years, medium is exactly 12 years, high is above 12 years.
    登记库： Education register
    工作论文 · Section 5
  • Tenure and potential experience groups 样本界定与时间
    Short tenure is less than 100 weeks of employment (26 weeks for non-employment spells). Potential experience is time since leaving school (age minus age upon leaving school), grouped as under 5, 5-10, 11-15 and over 15 years; calendar time in 3-year intervals (9 groups 1987-2013), giving 72 covariate cells.
    登记库： Danish matched employer-employee data (MEE)
    工作论文 · Section 2; Section 5
  • Public/private status of firm 部门与行业
    Time-invariant firm characteristic indicating public or private status, used as observed firm covariate.
    登记库： Danish matched employer-employee data (MEE)
    工作论文 · Section 5

The Disparate Effects of Information Provision: A Field Experiment on the Work Incentives of Social Welfare

Sofie Cairo and Robert Mahlstedt · Journal of Public Economics, 2023 · 个人

丹麦的一项田野实验向福利金领取者告知最低工作要求，方式或是提供其已累计工时的个性化动态统计，或是只说明一般性规则。个性化信息提高了工时尚未达标者的就业，而一般性通知则降低了近期受制裁风险较低者的劳动供给。

数据
Field experiment assignment and messaging data (Danish public employment service, jobnet.dk online tool), Population registers (socio-demographic background), Benefit payment records (DREAM), Monthly income and employment records (eIndkomst/BFL), Public employment service data on sanctions, exemptions, collected working hours, click data and registered job applications
关键变量
  • 处理：随机分配使用个性化在线信息工具，该工具提示在工作要求下福利金被削减的风险（三个实验组）
  • 结果变量：就业和劳动收入
  • 结果变量：福利金领取以及转向其他收入支持
  • 结果变量：为满足要求而累计的工作小时数以及求职申请
  • 异质性：求职活动和受制裁风险
时期
干预自 2018 年 8 月 15 日开始，最多发送五次月度提醒
样本
47,294 人 2018 年 8 月 15 日适用 225 小时工作要求、且已收到官方通知信的全部丹麦福利金领取者。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • 225-hour work requirement / sanction 失业与福利金
    After 12 months on welfare benefits within the last three years, recipients keep the full benefit only if they worked at least 225 hours in regular non-subsidised jobs in the previous 12 months. Otherwise the benefit is reduced by about DKK 500-1,000 per month depending on family status; after a sanction the hour count resets to zero. Caseworkers may grant exemptions to those unable to work at least five hours a week.
    登记库： Public employment service data (sanctions, exemptions, collected hours)
    工作论文 · Section 2
  • Experimental sample and treatment arms 样本界定与时间
    All welfare benefit recipients in stock on 15 August 2018 who were subject to the work requirement and had received the official notification letter (N = 47,294), randomised into three arms. Treated: up to six monthly messages plus access to the personalised online tool on jobnet.dk. Control I: general reminders only. Control II: neither.
    登记库： Experimental data (jobnet.dk)
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1-3.2, Table 1 notes
  • Cumulated job finding rate, hours and earnings 就业与劳动力状态
    Cumulated job finding rates by month since the intervention (extensive margin), and total working hours and labour earnings accumulated over the first 12 months after the start (intensive margin), from monthly income and employment records.
    登记库： E-income (eIndkomst)
    工作论文 · Section 4.2, Figure 3, Table 3
  • Full-time vs part-time job 工作时间
    Full-time jobs have average weekly working hours at or above 90% of the full-time equivalent (37 hours per week); part-time jobs are below that.
    登记库： E-income (eIndkomst)
    工作论文 · Section 4.2, Table 3 note (a)
  • Entering other transfer program 失业与福利金
    Indicator that the individual receives any other benefit not subject to the work requirement, such as educational support, sickness or disability benefits.
    登记库： DREAM
    工作论文 · Section 4.3
  • Active vs inactive job seeker 失业与福利金
    Active job seekers have a positive number of collected working hours at the onset of the intervention, or at least one job application registered in the public employment service portal in the last four weeks; all others are inactive.
    登记库： Public employment service data (collected hours, job applications)
    工作论文 · Section 4.4
  • Local counselling intensity 地理与社区
    Average number of caseworker meetings per recipient in the municipality in the six months before the intervention, split at the median. A residualised version conditions on observable characteristics.
    登记库： Public employment service data
    工作论文 · Section 4.4, footnote 20, Appendix Table A.2

Trade Shocks, Firm Hierarchies, and Wage Inequality

Benjamin U. Friedrich · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2022 · 个人 + 企业

利用企业层面的外国需求冲击以及 2006 年漫画危机后穆斯林对丹麦出口产品的抵制，表明贸易冲击通过改变企业层级结构来改变企业内部的工资不平等。增加一个层级会拉大整个企业内的工资差距，而抵制之后的层级削减则通过降薪、降职和人员流动压缩工资差距。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA) with DISCO occupation codes, Firm-Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (FIDA), Danish Business Register / firm statistics (GF): sales, value added, industry, Foreign Trade Statistics Register: firm-level exports by CN8 product and destination (UHDI), UN Comtrade bilateral trade flows (HS6), U.S. Imports of Merchandise, Penn World Tables distances, Brent oil prices (transport cost estimation)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：企业内部工资不平等（对数工资的标准差、90-10 差距）
  • 处理：基于职业划分的层级数
  • 工具变量：企业特定的世界进口需求冲击和运输成本冲击
  • 自然实验：2006 年穆斯林对丹麦出口产品的抵制（漫画危机）
时期
1999–2008
样本
12,470 家企业的 68,090 个企业—年度观测值（企业内部不平等回归） 1999–2008 年丹麦此前已存在的全部私营部门出口企业。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Occupational layer 职业与职位层级
    Workers' DISCO occupation code (DISCOALLE_INDK) harmonised to 3 digits and mapped to four hierarchical layers following Caliendo et al. via a DISCO3-to-PCS layer correspondence; missing layers imputed from the same worker-firm's adjacent years (up to 2 years), then from the layer whose average hourly wage is closest; firm-years with more than 20% of hours requiring imputation are set to missing.
    登记库： IDAP, FIDA
    代码： DISCOALLE_INDK; military code 0110/011000 recoded to 900; file correspondence_DISCO3_pcslayer
    复制代码 · Setup_Workerdata.do
  • Number of hierarchy layers 职业与职位层级
    Number of distinct occupational layers present in the firm-year (layers renumbered consecutively from the lowest present), missing if more than 20% of firm hours had imputed layers; alternative 3-layer versions collapse layers 1-2 or use DISCO 3-digit <200 for layer 3.
    登记库： IDAP, FIDA
    代码： layers = max(layerN); managers: first DISCO digit = 1
    复制代码 · Setup_Firm_Outcomes.do, lines ~72-185
  • Hourly wage and within-firm wage inequality 劳动收入与收入
    Hourly wage TIMELON (job earnings JOBLON / hours) for active November jobs (JOBLON and TIMELON > 0), CPI-deflated to 2000; observations below the 0.25th or above the 99.75th percentile of the yearly hourly wage distribution dropped; firm-year inequality is the s.d. of log hourly wages and percentile gaps 90-10, 75-25, 90-50, 50-10.
    登记库： IDAP
    代码： TIMELON, JOBLON; hours = JOBLON/TIMELON
    复制代码 · Setup_Firm_Outcomes.do, lines ~60-218; Setup_Workerdata.do
  • Private-sector sample 部门与行业
    Worker-level data restricted to IDA sector code 2 (private sector) before building firm outcomes.
    登记库： IDAP
    代码： SEKTOR == "2"
    复制代码 · Setup_Firm_Outcomes.do, line 14
  • Firm sales, value added, industry 企业特征与生产率
    Sales (GF_OMS), value added (GF_BAV) and full-time equivalent employment (GF_AARSV) from firm statistics, CPI-deflated; industry from DB93/DB03 9-, 27- and 53-group aggregations, 2007 industry carried forward to 2008 if missing; firm age = year - start year + 1.
    登记库： FIRM (GF), FIRE
    代码： GF_OMS, GF_BAV, GF_AARSV, GF_gr009_DB93/DB03, GF_gr027_DB93/DB03, GF_gr053_DB93/DB03
    复制代码 · Prepare_firmdata.do
  • Firm-level world import demand shock 贸易与离岸外包
    Firm-level Bartik shock: sum over HS6 product-destination pairs of the firm's pre-sample (first year exported, from 1998) export share times log world import demand, where world import demand is the destination country's total HS6 imports from the world excluding Denmark (Comtrade 1999-2008), aggregated to HS4/HS2 when HS6 unavailable.
    登记库： UHDI, UN Comtrade
    代码： UHDI ie == 2 (exports); vrd (value), vgt (weight); HS1988/92 concordance
    复制代码 · Setup_Tradedata_Bartik.do, sections 'Main Setup' and '(A) WID'
  • Transport cost shock 贸易与离岸外包
    Predicted transport costs per product-destination from US Imports of Merchandise estimates, combining HS2 group coefficients, log Brent oil price, log distance, their interaction and (for one version) new-EU-member accession after 2003, weighted by the firm's pre-sample export shares.
    登记库： UHDI, US Imports of Merchandise, Brent oil prices
    代码： neweumember = CY,CZ,EE,HU,LV,MT,PL,SI,SK & year > 2003
    复制代码 · Setup_Tradedata_Bartik.do, section '(B) Transport Costs'
  • Cartoon-crisis exposure (treatment) 贸易与离岸外包
    Treated firms exported to Muslim-majority countries (>50% Muslim population) in 2003-2005 and had more than 0.5% of 2005 exports going to those countries; control firms had no such exports in 2003-2005.
    登记库： UHDI
    代码： treatment = 1 if Arabpre == 1 & Arabshare > 0.005; 0 if Arabpre == 0; country list by ISO2 (AE, AF, AL, AZ, BD, ...)
    复制代码 · Main_Sample_Cartoon.do, lines ~127-300
  • Offshoring indicator 贸易与离岸外包
    Firm imports (ie == 1) a product at HS4 or HS6 level that it also exports in the same year.
    登记库： UHDI
    代码： offshoring_hs4, offshoring_hs6
    复制代码 · Main_Sample_IV.do, lines ~13-43

Replication package

Constraints on Hours within the Firm

Claudio Labanca and Dario Pozzoli · Journal of Labor Economics, 2022 · 个人 + 企业

利用含工时信息的丹麦雇主—雇员匹配数据，以及 2010 年丹麦税制改革带来的税率变化。在工时约束较紧的企业中，雇员在税负变化时并不调整工时；而在更灵活的企业中，雇员既直接作出反应，也通过同事的溢出效应作出反应。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Wage statistics with annual regular and overtime hours (Lønstatistikken, LON), Firm Statistics Register (Firmstat), Danish Foreign Trade Statistics Register, Firm-Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (FIDA), Danish Tax Register (income tax records), O*NET occupational data
关键变量
  • 结果变量：年工作小时数（正常工时加加班工时）
  • 处理：2010 年丹麦税制改革引起的模拟边际税率变化（2008–2011 年区间）
  • 调节变量：企业层面的工时约束／协调，以企业内部工时的离散程度衡量
  • 小时工资：年劳动收入除以总工时
  • 溢出效应：同事的税收变化
时期
2003–2011
样本
超过 400,000 名雇员和约 8,300 家企业（787,683 个个人—年观测值） 2003–2011 年私营企业中年龄 15–65 岁的全职雇员，所在企业至少 95% 的员工有工时报告（工作论文版本“Coordination of Hours within the Firm”，IZA DP 12062）。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Annual hours worked 工作时间
    Annual hours of regular plus overtime work from Lønstatistikken (LON), reported by employers whose pension contributions depend on hours. Only firms where hours are observed for at least 95 percent of the workforce are kept; for spells in week 48 shorter than a year, hours and earnings are annualized.
    登记库： LON, IDA, FIDA
    工作论文 · Section 3 (The data)
  • Hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Annual earnings divided by the sum of regular and overtime hours.
    登记库： IDA, LON
    工作论文 · Section 3
  • Employer link and full-time sample 样本界定与时间
    Each employee is matched to the highest-paying employer in the employment spell of week 48 (FIDA). Sample: full-time employees aged 15-65 in 2003-2011, full-time defined (official definition) as working more than an average of 26 weekly hours over a year, in private firms covered by Firmstat.
    登记库： FIDA, Firmstat, IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3
  • Hours coordination (dispersion of hours across skill groups) 工作时间
    Standard deviation across skill groups in a firm-year of the average annual (regular plus overtime) hours of each skill group; firm measure is its average over 2003-2011. Lower dispersion means greater coordination. Skill groups are deciles of the sum of the fixed and time-varying individual components of an AKM hourly-wage model; alternative: education (primary/secondary/tertiary) x occupation (manager/middle manager/blue collar) cells.
    登记库： LON, IDA
    工作论文 · Section 4.3, equation (9)
  • Simulated marginal tax rate 税收与税率
    Marginal tax rate on labour income simulated from the Danish Tax Register with an extension of the Kleven-Schultz (2014) tax simulator to 2006-2011: increase in tax liability from raising labour income by 100 DKK, holding other income components fixed. Changes are taken over the 2008-2011 interval.
    登记库： Danish Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 5.2
  • Mechanical net-of-tax rate change (instrument) 税收与税率
    Post-reform (2011) marginal tax rate simulated using pre-reform (2008) income adjusted for inflation; the log change in the marginal net-of-tax rate from this mechanical rate instruments the observed change. For spillovers, the firm average of mechanical changes among high-income workers instruments the change in their average hours.
    登记库： Danish Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 5.5
  • High- vs low-income workers 税收与税率
    Low-income: tax-exempt or in the bottom tax bracket in 2008. High-income: in the middle or top bracket in 2008, excluding a residual group in the top bracket in 2008 predicted (from 2008 real income and the post-reform schedule) to fall into the bottom bracket in 2011.
    登记库： Danish Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 5.1
  • Firm productivity 企业特征与生产率
    Value added per employee and TFP from Firmstat accounting data; in some specifications value added per employee is instrumented with TFP. Construction details are in an online appendix not included in the WP.
    登记库： Firmstat
    工作论文 · Section 4.1, footnote 15; Figure notes

Globalization, Gender, and the Family

Wolfgang Keller and Hale Utar · Review of Economic Studies, 2022 · 个人 + 企业

受到同样的中国进口冲击时，男性和女性的调整方式不同。年近四十而失去工作的女性会以生育作为回应，高收入者和需要重新接受培训者尤其如此，因此一个性别中性的贸易冲击会通过生物钟造成长期的性别差距。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Central Population Register (CPR/BEF) for births, marriages, divorces and cohabitation, Domestic production database by 10-digit product (Industrial commodity statistics, VARS) to identify firms making quota goods, Industry-level imports from China and other advanced countries (instrument), Parental leave records
关键变量
  • 结果变量：新生育、结婚、离婚、育儿假
  • 结果变量：劳动收入、工时、失业
  • 处理：1999 年的雇主所生产的产品属于中国加入 WTO 后取消 MFA 配额的范围
  • 处理（全经济范围）：行业层面来自中国的进口渗透率，以其他国家的进口作为工具变量
  • 异质性：性别和年龄（生物钟）
时期
1999–2007
样本
约 1,600,000 名工人；约 10,000 名纺织和服装业工人 1999 年丹麦私营部门 18–56 岁全职工人队列，追踪至 2007 年。 来源
变量如何定义（11）
  • Exposure to MFA quota removal (treatment) 贸易与离岸外包
    A firm is exposed (treated) if as of 1999 it had domestic production in any 8-digit CN good for which China would no longer face a quota upon WTO entry; quota categories are matched to 8-digit CN goods and firms producing quota goods are identified from the domestic production database reporting establishment sales by 10-digit product. Workers are exposed if employed by such a firm in 1999.

Henrik Kleven, Camille Landais and Jakob Egholt Søgaard · AER: Insights, 2021 · 个人

  • 结果变量：在世／健康配偶的劳动参与和劳动收入

Estimation of a Roy/Search/Compensating Differential Model of the Labor Market

Christopher Taber and Rune Vejlin · Econometrica, 2020 · 个人 + 企业

将 Roy 模型、搜寻摩擦、补偿性差异和在职人力资本积累纳入同一框架，确立了哪些内容可以非参数识别，并用丹麦匹配数据进行估计。进入劳动力市场前的技能解释了大部分工资差异，而对工作非工资属性的偏好和搜寻摩擦对人员流动以及劳动者选择何种工作影响很大。

数据
Weekly labour market spell data built from Statistics Denmark registers (all individuals aged 15–74), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA) with hourly wage measure, Danish Work Environment Cohort Study surveys (1995 and 2000) on reasons for job separation
关键变量
  • 结果变量：对数小时工资（去趋势）
  • 工作场所之间的工作到工作转换（显示性偏好）
  • 就业期和非就业期的持续时间
  • 劳动者技能/教育组别与劳动力市场经验
  • 将工资方差分解为技能、搜寻、补偿性差异和人力资本各部分
时期
1985–2003
样本
2,969,454 名劳动者、25,630,532 个时段和 467,983 个工作场所（估计样本） 进入劳动力市场之后至 55 岁的丹麦劳动者，在 1985–2003 年按周记录的时段数据中跨工作场所追踪。 来源
调查
Work Environment Cohort Study
变量如何定义（7）
  • Weekly labour market state 就业与劳动力状态
    Weekly spell data 1985-2003 for all individuals aged 15-74 with states employed, unemployed, self-employed, retired and non-participation. Unemployment = receiving unemployment insurance benefits or social assistance; non-participation is the residual (not observed in any register). Unemployment and non-participation are aggregated into non-employment.
    登记库： Weekly spell data (built from Statistics Denmark registers), IDA
    工作论文 · IZA DP 9975, Section 6 (Data)
  • Hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Hourly wage measure of Lund and Vejlin (2015), which improves on IDA's annual average hourly wage for the job held in the last week of November; log wages are detrended by gender-education groups conditional on experience.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 6, footnote 21; Section 6.1
  • Establishment (job type) 企业特征与生产率
    Job types are establishments (not firms). Statistics Denmark's establishment identifier is the same across years if one of three criteria is met: same owner and industry; same owner and workforce; or same workforce and either same address or same industry. A job is an employment spell within an establishment.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 6, footnote 22
  • Job-to-job transition 就业与劳动力状态
    Transition between two establishments with a very short intermediate non-employment spell: non-employment spells of 2 weeks or less are allocated to the first employment spell; non-employment spells of 12 weeks or less between jobs at the same establishment are overwritten as employment (recalls). Transitions to/from establishments with missing ID and from closing or mass-layoff establishments are ignored.
    登记库： Weekly spell data, IDA
    工作论文 · Section 6 and 6.1
  • Mass layoff / closing establishment 企业特征与生产率
    Mass layoff: establishment has more than 15 workers in year t and less than 30 percent of them left in year t+1. Closing: establishment no longer observed in the data.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 6.1, footnote 28
  • Involuntary separation (survey) 失业与福利金
    From the Danish Work Environment Cohort Study (1995 and 2000), whether the job spell in November 5 years earlier ended due to the employer or the employee; matched to register data to form a moment identifying the probability of an immediate offer after job destruction.
    登记库： Danish Work Environment Cohort Study, IDA
    工作论文 · Section 6
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Workers censored after age 55 and when entering retirement or self-employment; spells before labour market entry (time of highest completed education, not observed in education later, or age 19) dropped; workers with errors in education information or gaps in spell histories (e.g. missing IDA year) dropped.
    登记库： Weekly spell data, IDA
