Self-selection of Emigrants: Theory and Evidence on Stochastic Dominance in Observable and Unobservable Characteristics

George J. Borjas, Ilpo Kauppinen and Panu Poutvaara · Economic Journal, 2019 · 个人

论文证明，Roy 模型不仅预测迁移者与留居者的平均劳动收入存在差异，还预测二者的劳动收入分布之间存在随机占优的排序。利用全体人口登记数据，比较离开丹麦至少五年的丹麦人在外迁前的劳动收入与留居者的劳动收入，发现外迁者的劳动收入分布几乎随机占优于未迁移者的分布。这种正向选择大部分来自不可观测特征（劳动收入回归的残差），而非教育等可观测特征。

数据
Statistics Denmark administrative registers for the entire Danish population, 1995–2010, merged by personal identification number, Tax records: annual gross labour income and freelance income, Migration register 1995–2010 (date of emigration, destination country, date of return), Population registers 1980–2010 (parents, citizenship and immigrant background), Register information on education, marital status, number of children and work experience gained during the year
关键变量
  • 分组：迁往北欧国家或其他目的地的长期外迁者（在国外至少五年）与未迁移者
  • 结果变量：外迁前的税前年劳动收入，按年龄、性别和年份标准化
  • 结果变量：Mincer 劳动收入回归的残差（不可观测特征）
  • 控制变量：年龄、教育、婚姻状况、子女数量、年份
  • 检验：对累积分布进行的 Kolmogorov-Smirnov 检验和随机占优检验
时期
1995–2010 年（横截面为 1995–2004 年；1996–2005 年的外迁追踪至 2010 年）
样本
未迁移者：男性 6,450,665 个、女性 5,163,129 个人年观测值；长期迁移者：男性 7,323 人、女性 3,436 人（Table 1） 1995–2004 年各年度横截面中，无移民背景、年龄 25–54 岁、整个日历年居住在丹麦且全职工作的丹麦公民；迁移者指在次年离开并在国外停留至少五年的人。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Full-time workers aged 25-54 样本界定与时间
    For each year 1995-2004, all Danish citizens aged 25-54 (age measured as of January 1st of the year after the reference year) who lived in Denmark during the entire calendar year and worked full time. Full time is defined from a register variable measuring work experience gained during the calendar year (maximum 1,000), computed as the current value minus the previous year's value; the sample keeps workers with a value of 900 or above, roughly those who worked full time at least 90 percent of the year. Persons with a missing value in either year are dropped.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark administrative registers (work experience variable; register not named)
    代码： Age 25-54; work experience gained >= 900 of a maximum 1,000; cross-sections 1995-2004
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Data), footnotes 12-13
  • Long-term emigrant 移民身份与来源地
    An individual found in one of the 1995-2004 cross-sections who emigrates from Denmark during the following year to a destination outside Greenland or the Faroe Islands and stays abroad for at least five years, with return migration tracked in the migration register through 2010. Individuals who emigrated for less than five years are removed, and the rest of the population is classified as non-migrants.
    登记库： Migration register
    代码： Migration spell of 1,825 days or longer; destinations exclude Greenland and the Faroe Islands
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Data), footnotes 15-17
  • No immigrant background 移民身份与来源地
    Migrants and non-migrants are restricted to Danish citizens without an immigration background: Statistics Denmark defines a person to have no immigrant background if at least one of the parents was born in Denmark and the person is/was a Danish citizen. The authors searched the population registers from 1980 to 2010 for the parents of sample persons, and a parent who was found was required to be a Dane with no immigrant background as well.
    登记库： Population registers
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Data), footnote 18
  • Annual earnings and standardized earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Annual income is the worker's annual gross labor income plus positive values of freelance income, taken from the tax records for each calendar year. Standardized earnings are the ratio of a worker's annual gross earnings to the mean gross earnings of workers of the same age and gender during the calendar year (migrants, non-migrants and shorter-term migrants are all included in the means).
    登记库： Tax records (income register)
    代码： Negative freelance income excluded; summary statistics in 2010 euros
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Data), footnotes 14 and 19; Table 1
  • Earnings residual (unobserved characteristics) 劳动收入与收入
    Residual from OLS regressions of log annual (non-standardized) earnings, estimated separately for men and women on the whole population of prime-aged full-time workers pooled over 1995-2004, with age fixed effects, educational attainment dummies (high school, vocational school, advanced vocational, Bachelor, Master's, PhD), marital status, number of children and year dummies.
    登记库： Tax records (income register), Statistics Denmark administrative registers (education, family)
    代码： N = 6,470,720 (men) and 5,173,706 (women)
    工作论文 · Section 5, footnote 30; Table 5

Consumption Network Effects

Giacomo De Giorgi, Anders Frederiksen and Luigi Pistaferri · Review of Economic Studies, 2019 · 个人 + 企业

利用丹麦税务记录中的收入和资产信息测算家庭消费，并借助雇主—雇员匹配数据按工作场所界定同伴群体。作者以同伴自身不重叠的网络和企业所受的冲击作为同伴消费的工具变量，发现存在相当可观的消费溢出效应，足以产生宏观乘数，并且同时通过跨期和期内两种渠道起作用。

数据
Administrative income and wealth tax records (tax registry incl. wealth tax data), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA) for plant IDs and coworker networks, Danish Expenditure Survey (DES) 1994–1996
关键变量
  • 结果变量：根据收入和资产变动推算的家庭消费
  • 内生解释变量：同事家庭的平均消费（同伴消费）
  • 工具变量：距离为 3 的（不重叠）网络成员所受的企业层面冲击
  • 网络定义：同一工作场所（plant）的同事
  • 机制：可见性商品的预算份额（DES）
时期
1980–1996
样本
757,439 个家庭 户主年龄在 18–65 岁、夫妻双方均为在职雇员的丹麦家庭，并与夫妻双方的同事相关联。 来源
调查
Expenditure Survey
变量如何定义（6）
  • Imputed household consumption 财富、负债与消费
    Annual household consumption (spending) imputed from the budget constraint as C = Y - T - dA, where Y = gross income from all sources (labour and capital) + housing support + child support - implicit tax on the consumption value of owned housing, T = total taxes paid, and dA = change in assets (cash, bank deposits, stocks and shares, property value, cars and other vehicles, minus liabilities). Values in 2000 DKr.
    登记库： Tax records (income and wealth tax data)
    工作论文 · Section 2.1, eq. (1)
  • Co-worker network (weighted) 企业特征与生产率
    Co-workers are individuals working in the same plant (for public employees, the physical address of the workplace) from IDA. Baseline weights favour similar workers: with five education groups and three occupation groups (blue collar, white collar, manager), degree of separation d = |E_i - E_j| + |O_i - O_j| and weight (d+1)^-2; peers' consumption is the weighted average of co-workers' household log consumption.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 2.1; Section 5.1, eq. (11)
  • Distance-3 peers 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Starting from households where both spouses work, distance-1 peers are co-workers, distance-2 peers are the working spouses of co-workers, and distance-3 peers are the co-workers of the spouses of co-workers. Couples working in the same plant are excluded and feedback cases (where own household would serve as instrument for the peer) are discarded.
    登记库： IDA, Tax records
    工作论文 · Sections 4.1.2 and 5.1
  • Firm instruments (distance-3 firm shocks) 企业特征与生产率
    Weighted averages over distance-3 peers of their firm's size, firm-specific change in employment, firm type dummies (publicly traded, limited liability, other) and a public-sector dummy, all expressed in first differences. A separate set uses distance-3 peers' demographics (age, age squared, years of schooling, share women, occupation shares, kids 0-6 and 7-13).
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 5.2 (text before Table 4); Table 1
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Households 1980-1996 whose head is aged 18-65 and where both spouses work as employees (not self-employed); households are dropped from the year one or both members stop working or become self-employed. Peers' consumption is computed using all workers, including singles and one-earner households.
    登记库： Tax records, IDA
    工作论文 · Section 2.1; Online Appendix Table A1 (selection steps)
  • Visible / neutral / non-visible spending (DES) 财富、负债与消费
    Spending in the Danish Expenditure Survey is split using the Heffetz (2011) visibility index: visible = tobacco and alcohol, food away from home, clothing, furniture and home goods, electrics/appliances, vehicles, entertainment, books, education, personal care; neutral = food at home; everything else (insurance, rent, etc.) non-visible.
    登记库： DES (Danish Expenditure Survey)
    工作论文 · Section 2.2; Table A6

Children and Gender Inequality: Evidence from Denmark

Henrik Kleven, Camille Landais and Jakob Egholt Søgaard · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2019 · 个人

围绕第一个孩子出生的事件研究表明，从长期看母亲的劳动收入相对于父亲下降约 20%，下降来自工作时间、劳动参与和工资率三个方面。这类生育惩罚如今解释了尚存的性别劳动收入差距的大部分，并且通过母亲自身的成长环境在代际间传递。

数据
Full-population Danish administrative registers linked by personal ID (earnings, labour supply, occupation, firm, education), 1980–2013, Family and generational links (population register), ATP pension contributions as third-party measure of hours worked, Additional administrative data back to 1964 for intergenerational analysis, Matched employer-employee data (firm family-friendliness), International Social Survey Program (ISSP) 2002 for gender attitudes
关键变量
  • 处理／事件：第一个孩子出生（相对于首次生育的事件时间）
  • 结果变量：劳动收入、劳动参与、工作时间（ATP）、工资率
  • 结果变量：职业等级、部门、企业的家庭友好程度
  • 生育惩罚：女性劳动收入相对于男性下降的百分比
  • 代际：外祖父母的劳动供给
时期
1980–2013 年（代际传递分析的数据可追溯至 1964 年）；首次生育发生于 1985–2003 年
样本
约 470,000 次生育，即 15,040,000 个个人—年份观测值 第一个孩子出生于 1985–2003 年、且从生育前 5 年到生育后 10 年均在世并居住在丹麦的丹麦父母。 来源
调查
ISSP 2002
变量如何定义（10）
  • ATP hours worked 工作时间
    For the OECD-comparable gender gap series, full-time workers aged 16-64 are identified using the ATP hours measure; earnings and participation gaps use the whole population aged 16-64, hours and wage gaps are conditional on participation.
    登记库： ATP pension contributions
    代码： ages 16-64
    在线附录 · Figure A.I notes
  • Wage rate 劳动收入与收入
    Earnings divided by the ATP hours measure, for those who are working (conditional on participation).
    登记库： ATP pension contributions, Income registers
    工作论文 · Section 2; Section 3.2 footnote 9
  • Child penalty 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Event study around year of first birth (t=0), event time -5 to +10 with t=-1 omitted, separately by gender with age and year dummies, estimated in levels; penalty P_t = (alpha_men_t - alpha_women_t) / E[counterfactual women's outcome | t], the percentage by which women fall behind men due to children.
    登记库： Population register (family links)
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, eqs. (1)-(2)
  • Event-study sample 样本界定与时间
    Treatment = balanced panel of individuals with first child 1985-2003 observed in a 15-year window around the first birth; control = balanced panel of never-parents with a placebo birth in 1985-2003 observed in the same window.
    登记库： Population register
    在线附录 · Appendix B.2
  • Never-parent control group with placebo births 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Separately by sex, a probit for zero lifetime fertility is estimated on non-truncated cohorts 1955-1973 with dummies for own-cohort income quartile, own-cohort wealth quartile, spouse-cohort wealth quartile, education length/degree (8 categories), decade of birth of maternal grandmother and of maternal grandfather, and region. For each cohort born after 1973, among those childless by 2013 the individuals with the highest predicted probability are designated never-parents so that their share equals the 1955-1973 average zero-fertility share. Placebo age at first child is drawn from a log-normal distribution fitted within birth cohort x education cells (for post-1973 cohorts the mean is extrapolated by a linear trend, variance held fixed).
    登记库： Population register (fertility links), Income and wealth registers, Education register
    在线附录 · Appendix B.2
  • Occupational rank and top manager 职业与职位层级
    Occupation ranked in five levels: unskilled labour, skilled labour, white-collar work (low level), white-collar work (high level) and top manager, an ordering consistent with average earnings or wage rates by occupation; separate indicator for being top manager.
    登记库： Occupation (matched employer-employee data)
    工作论文 · Section 3.3, Figure 5 Panels A-B
  • Firm family friendliness 企业特征与生产率

Robustness controls: grandparents' within-generation wealth-rank quintiles, region of residence, length and field of education of grandmother and grandfather (22 dummies), and parents' total number of children measured in 2014.

Jakob Egholt Søgaard · Journal of Public Economics, 2019 · 个人

丹麦学生的年劳动收入一旦超过某一门槛，就会失去部分助学金。登记数据显示，门槛下方存在聚束，而且随着学生对这一规则的经验增加而加强；可见优化摩擦掩盖了一个远高于观测到的反应的结构弹性。

数据
Danish administrative registers for the full population (education, earnings, benefits, demographics), Annual income tax returns, Monthly student benefit (SU) take-up records from the Student Benefit Administration, Monthly payroll records of earnings and hours (BFL/eIndkomst), from 2008
关键变量
  • 结果变量：年劳动收入相对于学生补助收入上限的位置（聚束）
  • 激励：超过个人收入上限后助学金逐步取消（退还）所形成的拐点/缺口
  • 模拟的个人边际税率和补助递减率
  • 月度劳动收入和补助领取（调整的时点）
时期
2006–2011 年（月度劳动收入自 2008 年起）
样本
每年约 75,000 个观测值（核心样本平均每年 75,500 人） 18–35 岁、在高等教育阶段注册就读、完全有资格领取学生补助且劳动收入为正（每年高于 DKK 8,000）的个人。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Core student sample 样本界定与时间
    Individuals aged 18-35 enrolled in tertiary education, fully eligible for student benefits (SU), and with positive labour earnings, defined as earned income above DKK 8,000 per year. This gives about 75,500 observations per year, 2006-2011.
    登记库： Danish administrative registers (education, tax returns), Student Benefit Administration records
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, Table 2
  • Income counted against the SU income limit 劳动收入与收入
    Labour income (net of labour market contribution), transfers other than student benefits, and capital income, except certain types of stock income. All amounts are scaled to 2018 levels using the official wage indexation of student benefits.
    登记库： Tax returns
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, footnote 4
  • Individual income limit 失业与福利金
    The baseline income limit is 12 times the monthly basic amount (DKK 7,700, 2018 levels; about DKK 93,000 annually) and rises by DKK 11,600 for each month of benefits not taken up. It is computed from monthly benefit take-up records of the Student Benefit Administration.
    登记库： Student Benefit Administration records
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, Figure 1 notes; Appendix C
  • Effective marginal tax / phase-out rate 税收与税率
    Marginal income tax of 42% above a personal allowance of DKK 49,900. Benefits are phased out at 50% for the first DKK 11,600 above the individual income limit and at 100% beyond that, so the effective marginal rate jumps from 42% to 72% at the baseline limit under optimal take-up. If the payback exceeds DKK 9,200, the whole payback rises by 7% (a notch). The 2009 reform raised the baseline limit by 24% and the phase-out rate from 52% to 62%.
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, footnotes 5 and 11, Figure 2
  • Excess income and predicted payback 劳动收入与收入
    Total earned income from tax records minus the individual income limit; positive amounts translate into payback of benefits. Predicted end-of-year benefits (initial payout minus predicted payback) match reported benefits within DKK 2 for 97.9% of the core sample.
    登记库： Tax returns, Student Benefit Administration records
    工作论文 · Section 4.3; Appendix C, Table C.I
  • Study-related job 部门与行业
    All jobs not in wholesale (NACE 46), retail (47), postal service (53), hotels and restaurants (55, 56), cleaning (81), elderly, social and childcare (87, 88), or sports and amusement facilities (93).
    登记库： Monthly earnings records (employer/firm link)
    代码： NACE 46, 47, 53, 55, 56, 81, 87, 88, 93 = not study-related
    工作论文 · Table 3, note e
  • Monthly earnings and hours 工作时间
    Monthly records of earnings and hours worked for all wage earners, available from 2008 and used for average weekly hours and the within-person variability of monthly earnings.
    登记库： Monthly payroll records (from 2008)
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, Table 3, Appendix Figure A.II
  • Student experience 教育与考试成绩
    Number of years enrolled in tertiary education between 2004 and 2007 (that is, over the previous four years).
    登记库： Education registers

数据
Weekly labour market spell data from administrative registers (jobs reported to tax authorities, public transfers, mandatory pension contributions), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA): education, hourly wages and firm sector
关键变量
  • 结果变量：小时工资（11 月最后一周）
  • 关键变量：工作间转换和失业时段
  • 估计对象：工人技能类型和企业生产率类型（分选）
  • 分解：将对数工资方差分解为工人异质性、企业异质性、摩擦和分选
时期
1994–2003 年（时段数据覆盖 1985–2003 年）
样本
6,815,884 个观测值；782,951 人；1,698,990 个工作时段；117,847 家企业（NBER 2014 年版本） 进入劳动力市场之后、年龄不超过 55 岁的丹麦工人，且从未被观测到在公共部门就业、自雇、退休或从事农业。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Weekly labour market spells 就业与劳动力状态
    Weekly spells 1985-2003 for the population aged 15-70 constructed from registers on public transfers, hourly wages, employer-reported job start/end dates and mandatory employer pension contributions; five states (employment, unemployment, retirement, self-employment, non-participation), with non-participation a residual state (neither employed, self-employed nor receiving a transfer classifying the person as unemployed or retired).
    登记库： Spell data (administrative registers), IDA
    工作论文 · Section 5 (Data sources)
  • Unemployment spell (broad) and recall recoding 失业与福利金
    Non-participation recoded as unemployment; unemployment spells of 13 weeks or less followed by recall to the same employer are recoded as part of the original employment spell; unemployment spells of 2 weeks or less between employment spells with different employers are treated as a job-to-job transition.
    登记库： Spell data
    工作论文 · Section 5 (Analysis panel), footnotes 10-11
  • Hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    IDA estimate of the average hourly wage for jobs active in the last week of November (no wage for spells not overlapping it); trimmed at 1st and 99th percentiles annually and trended to 2003 levels using implicit deflators.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 5
  • Analysis panel 样本界定与时间
    1994-2003; histories truncated at age 55 and starting at graduation from highest completed education; workers ever observed in public-sector employment, self-employment, retirement or agriculture are discarded.
    登记库： Spell data, IDA
    工作论文 · Section 5 (Analysis panel)
  • Firm inflow (poaching) rank 企业特征与生产率
    For each firm, the fraction of all hires over the 10-year window that come directly from other firms (job-to-job); measured only for firms with more than 15 hires and at least one hire from unemployment; used as a firm productivity rank.
    登记库： Spell data
    工作论文 · Section 6 (moments), footnote 17
  • Education strata 教育与考试成绩
    Robustness estimation splits workers into less than 15 and more than 15 years of education.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section on education-stratified estimation

Sharon Traiberman · American Economic Review, 2019 · 个人 + 企业

基于丹麦劳动者的职业履历估计一个动态职业选择模型，模型中劳动者积累职业专用人力资本，而转换职业时这部分人力资本会丧失。在贸易造成的劳动者结果差异中，职业解释了 57%，行业仅解释 16%；1995 年至 2005 年进口竞争的加剧使约 5% 的劳动者终身劳动收入下降。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA/IDAS) with ISCO occupation codes, Firm and establishment statistics (FIRE, FIRM) for industry codes, Customs trade data (UHDI), UN Comtrade (CEPII BACI), Danish national accounts, Danish CPI, LIBOR
关键变量

  • 冲击：分行业的进口价格 / 进口竞争
  • 劳动者技能组：低、中、高教育程度
  • 职业任职年限
时期
1996–2007 年劳动者面板（任职年限根据 1990–1996 年数据构建）；进口竞争为 1995–2005 年
样本
样本框中 18,513,301 个观测值（原始数据中 33,502,593 个） IDA 中 23–59 岁的丹麦个人，1996–2007 年，用于估计职业选择模型。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Two-digit occupation (cleaned) 职业与职位层级
    Two-digit ISCO (DISCO) code taken from the four-digit occupation code in IDA, using only codes whose quality flag indicates they come from administrative surveys or pension funds (not imputation or lagged information). Missing codes are imputed if the worker has the same occupation at t-1 and t+1, or from t+2 after a firm switch; managerial codes 10-13 are combined into one, legislators and military are dropped, and small occupations are merged by skill group (e.g. 52 into 51, 92 into 61 for all skill groups).
    登记库： IDA, IDAS
    代码： DISCO/ISCO two-digit; quality flag codes 1, 2, 4, 10 kept; ISCO 10-13 combined; high-skilled merges 42->41, 52->51, 72->71/74, 81->82/83, 91->93 per Appendix table; 21/22 merged for low/medium skill
    在线附录 · Online Appendix D.1, Data Cleaning: Occupations (and footnote 11)
  • Four-sector industry aggregation 部门与行业
    NACE 1.1 four-digit industry codes assigned to plants (FIRE; firm-level FIRM data used when plant data not available) and matched to workers, aggregated into four sectors: Manufacturing (incl. construction, agriculture, utilities), FIRE, Public Services (labelled Health & Education), and Other Services.
    登记库： FIRE, FIRM, IDA
    代码： NACE 1 2-digit 0-45 = Manufacturing; 64-74 = FIRE; 75, 80, 85-90 = Public Services; all remaining = Other Services
    在线附录 · Online Appendix D.1, Data Cleaning: Industry (full mapping in appendix Table 16)
  • Skill group 教育与考试成绩
    Three skill groups from completed education in IDA: low = high school or short-cycle education; medium = vocational or medium-cycle education; high = bachelor's degree or more. Education is never allowed to decrease (higher earlier level imputed) and missing values are filled from the previous year, else the next reported year.
    登记库： IDA
    在线附录 · Online Appendix D.1, Data Cleaning: Skill
  • 职业任职年限 职业与职位层级
    Tenure measured at the occupation-sector pair level, constructed for early cohorts using data from 1990-1996, and censored above at 6 years to keep the measure comparable across cohorts; tenure resets upon switching occupations.
    登记库： IDA
    在线附录 · Online Appendix D.1, Occupational Tenure; Appendix model section
  • Annual income (November job) 劳动收入与收入
    Total salary-based income reported by IDA in November of each year, covering the worker's primary and any secondary occupation; all of it is attributed to the reported (primary) occupation. Hours are not used because they are often imputed. Deflated by the 2000 Danish CPI (1000s DKK).
    登记库： IDA
    在线附录 · Online Appendix D.1, Income; notes to Table A.7
  • Employed 就业与劳动力状态
    A worker is counted as employed in year t if employed in November of t (IDA November position).
    登记库： IDA
    在线附录 · Online Appendix D.1, Employment
  • Sample frame 样本界定与时间
    Raw data are all individuals in IDAS aged 23-59 in 1996-2007; the final sample applies the occupation/education imputation and cleaning and drops workers non-employed for the whole sample period.
    登记库： IDAS
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Table A.7 notes; D.1
  • Foreign (import) price index by industry 贸易与离岸外包
    Variety-corrected CES import price index per industry built following Broda-Weinstein/Feenstra (Sato-Vartia weights on the common set of goods, adjusted for new and disappearing varieties) from customs data aggregated to the country-product level; a similar index is built from Comtrade, and the geometric mean of the customs, Comtrade and national-accounts indices is used as the path of foreign prices.
    登记库： UHDI, Comtrade (CEPII BACI), National accounts

1992–2002 年（任命发生在 2000 年和 2001 年）
样本

  • Top management appointment (career success) 职业与职位层级
    APPOINTMENT = 1 if the worker is appointed to a top management position, defined as DISCO 12 (Corporate Managers) or DISCO 13 (General Managers), in a firm with 100 or more employees between year t and t+1 (appointments in 2000 and 2001); robust to a 50-employee cut-off.     INT_OCC = number of occupations experienced within the present firm excluding the current one; INT_EXT_OCC = total number of all occupations experienced excluding the present one, counting the same occupation in two different firms as two occupations. Internal promotion vs external recruitment distinguished by whether the appointment occurs without switching firm.

Labour Market Effects of International Trade When Mobility is Costly

Damoun Ashournia · Economic Journal, 2018 · 个人

构建了一个动态结构模型：异质性工人在五个部门之间进行选择，积累只能部分跨部门转移的工作经验，并在转换部门时付出效用成本。利用丹麦工人—企业匹配登记数据、以模拟最小距离法估计，效用成本为平均年工资的 10% 至 19%；若去掉永久性的不可观测异质性，该成本大约上升十倍。反事实模拟表明，人力资本损失和效用成本都会减缓劳动力市场对冲击的调整。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), entire Danish population aged 15-74, Firm Statistics Register (FirmStat), universe of Danish firms with NACE Rev. 2 industry, Firm-Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (FIDA), worker-firm link, Statistics Denmark aggregate series (Statistikbanken: CPI from PRIS8, sectoral value added and income shares from NATE101/NATE102, capital stocks from NAT09N) and 2008 input-output tables
关键变量
  • 结果变量：每年的就业部门（五个部门）或失业状态，以及它们之间的转换
  • 结果变量：分部门的小时工资对数
  • 状态变量：年龄、性别、大学教育、工作经验、失业保险基金成员身份／失业保险领取资格
  • 估计对象：转换部门的效用成本，以及可跨部门转移的经验份额
  • 反事实：制造业受到的失业冲击和贸易自由化冲击
时期
1996–2008 年（1995 年用于初始条件）
样本
部门选择和转换回归中有 20,373,918 个工人—年观测值；五个分部门工资对数回归合计 19,564,785 个（2015 年讨论稿版本的 Appendix D，Tables D.1-D.2） 年龄 30 至 65 岁、在五个加总部门之一就业或处于失业状态的全体丹麦工人，在工人—企业匹配登记库中逐年追踪。 来源
变量如何定义（4）
  • Matched worker-firm panel of workers aged 30-65 样本界定与时间
    Worker data for each year are taken from IDA, which covers the entire Danish population aged 15-74; firms are taken from FirmStat and linked to workers through FIDA. The author extracts age, gender, labour market status (employed or unemployed), UI fund membership, work experience and hourly wages for workers aged 30 to 65; the entry age of 30 is chosen because almost all workers have completed their education by then. Workers and firms can be matched only from 1995 onwards, so 1995 is used to construct initial conditions.
    登记库： IDA, FIDA, FirmStat
    代码： Age 30-65; sample years 1996-2008; 1995 = initial conditions
    工作论文 · Section 3.1 (Worker Data)
  • Five productive sectors plus unemployment 部门与行业
    Each firm is assigned to one of five productive sectors defined from the NACE Rev. 2 classification: (1) Agriculture/Mining, (2) Manufacturing, (3) Construction, (4) Trade/Utilities/Transportation/Communication, (5) Services. Unemployment is treated as a sixth, unproductive sector (0).
    登记库： FirmStat, FIDA
    代码： NACE Rev. 2 divisions: Agriculture/Mining 01, 02, 03, 06, 08, 09; Manufacturing 10-33; Construction 41-43; Trade/Utilities/Transportation/Communication 35-38, 45-47, 49-53, 58-63; Services 55, 56, 64-66, 68-75, 77-82, 84-88, 90-97
    工作论文 · Section 3.1 and Appendix B, Table B.1
  • Educ (college indicator) 教育与考试成绩
    Indicator for whether the worker has completed college education; enters the human capital function, the utility cost of switching, the type probabilities and the unemployment probabilities.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 2.2.1, equation (6)
  • Unemployment benefit and UI eligibility 失业与福利金
    For the employed the data give hourly wage rates; for the unemployed they give unemployment benefits, split into UI benefits for those eligible and welfare assistance for others. In the model a worker is eligible for UI if he is a member of a UI fund and has not received UI benefits for more than 4 years; the benefit is min(k x last wage, UI) if eligible and WA otherwise. Unemployment probabilities are set to the empirical frequencies by gender, education, age and previous sector.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： k = 0.90; UI = 101 and WA = 75 (hourly, 2000 DKK; annual figures divided by 1,702 work hours); 864 unemployment probabilities

在针对中国进口产品的配额取消之后，对丹麦纺织和服装业工人追踪十年，并利用行业内部和职业内部在暴露程度上的差异。劳动收入和就业持续下降，服务业中的工作不稳定是主要的调整摩擦，而受过制造业专用教育的工人通过继续接受学校教育来重建人力资本。

Replication package

Parental Responses to Child Support Obligations: Evidence from Administrative Data

Maya Rossin-Slater and Miriam Wüst · Journal of Public Economics, 2018 · 个人

利用丹麦子女抚养费标准随父亲收入变化而出现的断点，估计更高的抚养费义务如何影响已分居的父母。文章记录了父亲的收入、其后的家庭组建以及父母居住安排等方面的反应。

数据
Danish administrative registers on children born 1985–2008 linked to parents and siblings (population/family registers), Income and tax records including tax-deductible child support payments, Labour market registers (employment, earnings, disability insurance, early retirement), Birth records (fertility through 2010), Education registers, Danish Longitudinal Survey of Children (DALSC) and Children and Youth in Denmark (CYD) survey (descriptive, supplementary)
关键变量
  • 处理：父亲的平均子女抚养费义务（依据丹麦子女抚养费指导标准表）
  • 识别变异：子女抚养费指导标准中的收入门槛（模拟工具变量）
  • 结果变量：父亲每年支付的子女抚养费
  • 结果变量：父亲与子女共同居住（实际监护）
  • 结果变量：分居后父母双方的生育和劳动供给
时期
1998–2010 年（分居年份为 1999–2008 年）
样本
73,303 名父亲（71,575 名不重复的母亲） 1998–2010 年每年均可观测到的父亲，他们在 1999–2008 年间与最年长子女的母亲分居（或在未同居的情况下有了第一个孩子），有一到两个 18 岁以下的子女，且分居当年的收入接近指导标准的前三个门槛。 来源
调查
Children and Youth in Denmark, DALSC
变量如何定义（8）
  • Separation year 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    The year in which the father no longer resides with his oldest child's mother, or the year he has a first child while not living with the child's mother. The sample is restricted to separation years 1999-2008.
    登记库： Danish administrative population/family registers
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Analysis Sample)
  • Analysis sample of fathers 样本界定与时间
    Fathers observed in the registers every year 1998-2010 who either were married to or cohabiting with their oldest child's mother at childbirth (or in 1998 for children born earlier), or had a first child 1999-2008 while not married to or cohabiting with the mother. Also required: separation in 1999-2008, one or two children under 18 at separation, and separation-year income in a 100,000 DKK window around the first three schedule thresholds (175,000-505,000 DKK). The result is 73,303 fathers, one observation each.
    登记库： Danish administrative registers
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Analysis Sample), footnotes 17-18
  • Child support obligation (actual average) 税收与税率
    The father's annual obligation from the Danish child support guideline (normal amount plus extra amount per child, plus a supplement of 25-300% of the normal amount above income thresholds). It is a step function of current gross income and the number of biological children under 18, including new children. It is averaged over all post-separation years and expressed in thousands of real 2000 DKK.
    登记库： Danish income registers
    工作论文 · Section 2; Section 5, equation (2)
  • Predicted (simulated) child support obligation 税收与税率
    Instrument: the obligation in each post-separation year computed from the father's separation-year gross income and his 'original' children still under 18, so children ageing out are counted but new children and post-separation income changes are ignored. It is averaged over the post-separation period.
    登记库： Danish income registers
    工作论文 · Section 5 (Simulated IV Method), equation (3)
  • Child support payment 劳动收入与收入
    Tax-deductible annual child support payments by non-custodial fathers as reported to the tax authorities, so only payments above the non-deductible extra amount are observed. Formal and voluntary payments cannot be distinguished.
    登记库： Danish income/tax registers
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Outcomes)
  • Father-child co-residence 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator that the father shares a residence address with the child in any year after separation, based on one address per person per year. It captures sole-father and some joint physical custody but understates joint custody.
    登记库： Danish population register (addresses)
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Outcomes)
  • Post-separation fertility 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Whether the mother or father has an additional child after separation, measured from the universe of birth records through 2010 and split by birth within or outside a new partnership.
    登记库： Birth records
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Outcomes); Section 6.3
  • Labour force participation / NILF 就业与劳动力状态
    Fraction of post-separation years in which the father has any positive labour income, and the proportion of years not in the labour force. NILF is split by disability leave (Social Disability Pension), retirement including early retirement (Post-Employment Wage program, ages 60-64), and means-tested welfare.
    登记库： Danish labour market registers
    工作论文 · Section 6.4, Table 6, footnote 29

Estimating Equilibrium Effects of Job Search Assistance

Pieter Gautier, Paul Muller, Bas van der Klaauw, Michael Rosholm and Michael Svarer · Journal of Labor Economics, 2018 · 个人

在丹麦两个郡开展的一项随机化激活实验帮助处理组求职者更快找到工作，但同郡未受处理的求职者找到工作的速度比对照郡的求职者更慢。用数据拟合的均衡搜寻模型表明，这些挤出效应使大规模推广的收益远低于局部估计所显示的水平。

数据
National Labour Market Board administrative data on unemployment benefit spells (all Danish counties), Randomised activation experiment assignment (Storstrøm and South Jutland, birth date 1st–15th of month), Income transfer data (exit destinations), National Labour Market Board monthly stock of open vacancies by county (from local job centres)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：失业持续时间／退出失业金领取的比率（周）
  • 处理：被分配到强化激活项目（出生日为每月 1–15 日）
  • 溢出效应比较：实验郡的未参与者与对照郡（双重差分）
  • 结果变量：按郡和月份统计的空缺职位存量的对数
  • 结构性均衡搜寻模型参数
时期
失业金流入人群：2004 年 11 月–2005 年 2 月（实验前）和 2005 年 11 月–2006 年 2 月（实验期），最长追踪两年；职位空缺：2004 年 1 月–2007 年 11 月
样本
实验期有 40,403 名失业金领取者（3,751 名实验参与者：1,814 名处理组、1,937 名对照组）；实验前样本为 49,063 人 2005 年 11 月至 2006 年 2 月间在丹麦开始领取常规失业金的全部个人，另加一年前的实验前流入队列。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Unemployment duration / exit from benefits 失业与福利金
    Duration (in weeks) of collecting regular unemployment benefits from the week benefits start, followed for at most two years; exits treated as exits from unemployment (linked income-transfer data show almost all exits in the first two years are to employment); durations censored otherwise.
    登记库： National Labour Market Board benefit spell data, Income transfer data
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Data)
  • Activation programme treatment 失业与福利金
    All individuals starting to collect unemployment benefits November 2005-February 2006 in Storstrom and South Jutland counties took part; those born on the 1st-15th of the month were assigned to the intensive activation programme (letter after ~1.5 weeks, 2-week JSA course after 5-6 weeks, weekly/biweekly caseworker meetings, new programme after 4 months); those born 16th-31st are controls.
    登记库： National Labour Market Board benefit spell data
    工作论文 · Sections 2.1 and 3
  • Experiment, comparison and pre-experiment samples 样本界定与时间
    All 41,801 individuals applying for regular benefits November 2005-February 2006 in all Danish counties, minus 1,398 with inconsistent county of residence; non-experiment counties form the comparison group; a pre-experiment sample of 49,063 individuals starting benefits November 2004-February 2005 controls for county differences (difference-in-differences in a stratified proportional hazard model).
    登记库： National Labour Market Board benefit spell data
    工作论文 · Sections 3 and 4.1.1
  • Stock of open vacancies 其他
    Monthly average number of open vacancies per day by county, January 2004-November 2007, collected by the National Labour Market Board from local job centres; used in logs.
    登记库： National Labour Market Board vacancy data
    工作论文 · Section 3
  • Benefit history covariates 失业与福利金
    Weeks of benefit receipt in the previous year and in the past two years, plus gender, nationality and an indicator for entering unemployment in November or December.
    登记库： National Labour Market Board benefit spell data
    工作论文 · Section 4.1.1; Table 1

Can Women Have Children and a Career? IV Evidence from IVF Treatments

Petter Lundborg, Erik Plug and Astrid Würtz Rasmussen · American Economic Review, 2017 · 个人

以无子女的丹麦女性体外受精治疗的成功作为生育子女的工具变量，因为 IVF 是否成功与劳动力市场经历无关。子女使女性的劳动收入大幅且持久地下降，主要是通过小时收入而非工时；第一个孩子的效应远大于之后的孩子。

数据
IVF register held by the Danish National Board of Health (all IVF treatments in public and private clinics, 1994–2005), Linked administrative registers on education, age, marital status and number of children, Linked labour market registers: labour force status, hours worked, hourly wages, annual earnings, occupation, sector and firm
关键变量
  • 工具变量：首次 IVF 治疗的成功
  • 内生处理变量：生育子女（广延边际上的生育）
  • 结果变量：年劳动收入
  • 结果变量：小时工资与工作小时数／就业
  • 机制：职业、部门和企业的变动
时期
1991–2009 年（IVF 治疗时间为 1995–2005 年）
样本
18,538 名接受治疗的女性 1995 至 2005 年间开始首次有胚胎植入的 IVF 治疗的无子女女性。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • IVF treatment success (instrument) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Equals 1 if the first IVF treatment with embryo implants (in a sequence of treatments) led to a childbirth, 0 otherwise; treatment outcome (birth, abortion, stillbirth, failure) and dates from the IVF register (mandatory reporting 1994-2005).
    登记库： IVF register (Danish National Board of Health)
    论文正文 · Section III (model) and Section II.B
  • Having children (endogenous treatment) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator equal to 1 if the woman has children and 0 otherwise, measured over periods t = 0-1, 2-5 and 6-10 after the (potential) childbirth.
    登记库： Population registers
    论文正文 · Section III and Table 2 notes
  • IVF sample and potential childbirth year 样本界定与时间
    Treatment success is measured at the first IVF treatment with embryo implant; t=0 is the year of (potential) childbirth. All regressions control for age at first IVF treatment, year of first IVF treatment, and pre-treatment education and earnings; pre-treatment baseline means are taken over years 1-4 before the first IVF treatment. Four samples: (i) IVF-treated women without children (baseline); (ii) IVF-treated women with children; (iii) successfully treated women with at least two embryos implanted (twin strategy); (iv) representative sample of women with a first child born 1995-2005. Balanced-panel robustness sample also used.
    登记库： IVF register, Population/fertility registers
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A, B (Table 2 notes), D, E
  • Annual earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Annual labour earnings from tax and employer-employee registers, including parental leave and sickness benefits, in 2008 DKK.
    登记库： Tax registers, Employer-employee registers
    论文正文 · Section I and Table 1 notes
  • Job changes and job characteristics 职业与职位层级
    Dummies for any workplace change and any (four-digit) occupation change in the short, medium and long run; job characteristics are averages of earnings, hours and log hourly wages by workplace and four-digit occupation over the study period computed in a representative sample of Danish women, plus workplace percent female, public sector and home-work distance.
    登记库： Employer-employee registers
    代码： Four-digit occupation code
    论文正文 · Section IV.C and Table 4 notes
  • Depression 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Measured as antidepressant medication use (data complete only from 1994 onward).
    登记库： Prescription registry
    论文正文 · Section IV and Table 2 notes
  • IVF medical controls 医疗服务利用
    Sensitivity specification adds medical factors from the IVF register: number of eggs retrieved, number of embryos implanted, diagnoses, causes of infertility, type of IVF treatment, and clinic indicators. A 'healthy women' subsample consists of women not diagnosed with any fertility problem.
    登记库： IVF register (Danish National Board of Health)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix B, Table 2 notes
  • Hourly wages (incl. zeros robustness) 劳动收入与收入
    Main wage regressions condition on observing positive wages; robustness extends the sample to all women by setting missing wages to 0.
    登记库： Labour market registers
    在线附录 · Online Appendix B, Table 3 notes
  • Pre-treatment sickness benefits and positive earnings 失业与福利金
    Pre-treatment balance covariates measured the year before IVF treatment: years of schooling, annual earnings (100,000 DKK), sickness benefit receipt, marriage, indicator for positive earnings, and partner's schooling and earnings.
    登记库： Income and transfer registers
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A, Table 1

Replication package

Tax Reforms and Intertemporal Shifting of Wage Income: Evidence from Danish Monthly Payroll Records

Claus Thustrup Kreiner, Søren Leth-Petersen and Peer Ebbesen Skov · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2016 · 个人 + 企业

2010 年最高边际税率的下调是提前公布的，月度工资记录显示高收入者把工资收入从 2009 年 12 月转移到 2010 年 1 月。这种转移集中在管理人员和小企业雇员中，并会抬高短期弹性的估计值。

数据
Monthly payroll records (eIndkomst / eIncome register) from the tax agency SKAT, Background registers on individuals and firms at Statistics Denmark (incl. firm size, liquid assets), Telephone survey on awareness of income-shifting opportunity (January 2011), merged to eIncome register
关键变量
  • 结果变量：月度总工资相对于 2008 年平均水平的百分比变化
  • 处理：2008 年月劳动收入高于 DKK 35,000 的私营部门雇员（2010 年改革带来的最高税档激励）
  • 对照组：月劳动收入为 DKK 30,000–35,000
  • 异质性：企业规模、流动性资产、劳动收入百分位
  • 含与不含转移成分的应税收入弹性
时期
2008 年 1 月–2011 年 12 月（月度）
样本
328,679 人，其中 219,179 人属于处理组；问卷调查样本为 878 名纳税人 2008 年每个月都有工资记录、各年收入均为正，且 2008 年月劳动收入高于 DKK 30,000 的私营部门雇员。 来源
调查
Income-shifting survey
变量如何定义（8）
  • Monthly wage change relative to 2008 劳动收入与收入
    Percentage change in individual monthly gross wage income (year t, month m) relative to the individual's average monthly gross earnings in 2008; percentage changes are used instead of logs because monthly earnings may be zero or near zero.
    登记库： eIncome register (SKAT)
    工作论文 · Section II, eq. (1)
  • Treatment and control groups (top-tax incentive) 样本界定与时间
    Robustness variants of the control group by average monthly 2008 earnings: narrow C-group DKK 32,000-35,000, wide C-group DKK 24,000-35,000; doughnut sample excludes individuals with average monthly 2008 earnings DKK 33,000-37,000; alternative baseline year 2009 (groups and income differences relative to 2009); alternative post-reform year 2011. T-group by percentile bins of average monthly earnings: [P80,P90), [P90,P95), [P95,P99), [P99,+].
    登记库： eIncome monthly payroll register (SKAT)
    代码： Narrow C: 32,000-35,000 DKK/month; wide C: 24,000-35,000 DKK/month; doughnut excl. 33,000-37,000 DKK/month (2008)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Table A2 notes; Figure A1
  • Analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    Individuals employed throughout 2008 (a wage record in every month of 2008) with positive income in all years, observed January 2008 - December 2011; includes people who are both wage earners and self-employed. Sensitivity: excluding employees with any exit to unemployment during 2009-2010.
    登记库： eIncome register (SKAT)
    工作论文 · Section II, footnote 5; footnote 6
  • Income-shifting indicator 劳动收入与收入
    Equals one if income in a month is high (more than 50 percent above) relative to its level in the same month of 2008 and income in the preceding month is low (more than 50 percent below) relative to its 2008 level; zero otherwise. Robustness with 25%-25% and 75%-75% cutoffs; a stricter version also requires November 2009 income to be unusually low.
    登记库： eIncome register (SKAT)
    工作论文 · Section III.A, eq. (3) and footnote 6
  • Financial capacity (liquidity) 财富、负债与消费
    Financial assets (money in bank accounts and value of shares and bonds) at end of 2008 relative to 2008 annual disposable income; groups below one month, between one and two months, and above two months of disposable income.
    登记库： Background registers at Statistics Denmark
    工作论文 · Section III.B, Figure 8
  • Firm size groups and top-five paid 企业特征与生产率
    Firm size groups: fewer than 25, 25-99, 100-499 and 500+ employees; large firms defined as more than 100 employees (top decile by number of employees); top-five paid employees within each firm used to isolate top management.
    登记库： eIncome register (SKAT), Firm registers
    工作论文 · Section III.B, Figures 6-7
  • Awareness of shifting opportunity 其他
    Survey respondents are classified as informed about the opportunity to shift income if they answered Q1 = 'After New Year' and Q2 = 'Legal' in the Capacent Epinion telephone survey (588 T-group and 290 C-group respondents).
    登记库： eIncome monthly payroll register (SKAT) linked to telephone survey
    代码： Q1 = 'After New Year' & Q2 = 'Legal'

Mathematics and Gender: Heterogeneity in Causes and Consequences

Juanna Schrøter Joensen and Helena Skyt Nielsen · Economic Journal, 2016 · 个人

丹麦高中的一项试点方案允许学生将高级数学与化学组合选修，提高了高级数学的选修率，在女生中尤为明显。由此获得的数学资质提高了日后的劳动收入，收益集中于原本会少修数学的学生，并通过高等教育选择发挥作用。

数据

关键变量

  • 工具变量：允许数学—化学组合的高中试点方案的意外推出
时期
1984–1986 年入学的高中生，追踪至进入劳动力市场
样本
约 25,658 名女生和 19,406 名男生，来自约 140 所高中 1984–86 年入学、三年内毕业且至少有一年就业记录的丹麦高中生。 来源

Immigrants' Effect on Native Workers: New Analysis on Longitudinal Data

Mette Foged and Giovanni Peri · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2016 · 个人

1991 至 2008 年间，来自难民来源国的移民流入丹麦各市镇，推动受教育程度较低的本国出生工人转向更复杂、体力成分更少的职业。本国出生者的工资和就业不降反升，即便是跨企业流动的低技能本国出生者，效应也为正。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Occupation codes linked to O*NET task intensities (manual, communication, cognitive), Full population registers for municipality immigrant shares, Refugee spatial dispersal policy 1986–1998 (initial refugee allocation by municipality)
关键变量
  • 处理：工作所在市镇中来自难民来源国的移民所占比重
  • 工具变量：根据 1986–1998 年难民分散安置政策预测的移民流入
  • 结果变量：职业复杂度指数（基于 O*NET）
  • 结果变量：小时工资的对数（含强制性养老金缴款）
  • 结果变量：一年中工作时间所占比例；职业流动
  • 控制变量：年龄、工作经验、任职年限、教育、婚姻状况、地区、行业
时期
1991–2008
样本
固定效应面板中为 1995–2008 年在业低技能本国出生者的 1,864,027 个观测值（本国出生者的 20% 随机样本）；平衡面板双重差分回归使用 1994 年在业的 71,053 名本国出生者 18–65 岁、不在学且非永久残疾的丹麦出生者，重点关注低技能（未受过大学教育）的本国出生者，覆盖 97 个市镇。 来源
变量如何定义（10）
  • Refugee-country immigrants 移民身份与来源地
    Immigrants (foreign-born) from eight refugee-sending countries that generated substantial refugee inflows 1994-2008: Yugoslavia, Somalia, Afghanistan, Iraq, Sri Lanka, Vietnam, Iran and Lebanon (Bosnia included in actual inflow but not in the instrument).
    登记库： IDA, Population registers
    工作论文 · Section 2, footnote 12; footnote 26
  • Refugee-country immigrant employment share 移民身份与来源地
    S_mt = F_mt / P_mt, the stock of employed refugee-country immigrants divided by total employment in municipality of work m in year t; computed on the full population (outcomes use a 20 percent random sample of natives).
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 4.1; footnote 16
  • Dispersal-policy imputed refugee share (instrument) 移民身份与来源地
    For t > 1994, imputed working-age population from refugee country c in municipality m = s_cm x F_ct, where s_cm is the share of new immigrants from c first settling in m during 1986-1998 under the dispersal policy and F_ct is the national working-age population from c; summed over refugee countries and divided by municipality working-age population in 1988. Also used to define top and bottom quartile exposure municipalities for the difference-in-differences.
    登记库： Population registers
    工作论文 · Section 4.3
  • Occupational complexity index 职业与职位层级
    O*NET abilities merged to Danish registers at the four-digit ISCO-88 level via the National Crosswalk Center crosswalk. Following Ottaviano, Peri and Wright (2013), abilities are averaged into communication, cognitive (analytical) and manual intensity indices, each standardized to [0,1] as the occupation's centile in the 2000 ranking. Complexity = ln((Communication + Analytical)/Manual).
    登记库： IDA, O*NET
    代码： ISCO-88 4-digit (Danish version)
    在线附录 · Appendix A.1
  • Occupational mobility 职业与职位层级
    Occupations are reported by firms using the Danish version of ISCO-88. Missing or invalid ISCO-88 values are replaced by the next value within the worker-firm match if that value is also the most frequent ISCO-88 code within the match; authors note this (and weak incentives for firms to update codes) may understate within-firm job mobility.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： ISCO-88
    在线附录 · Appendix A.1
  • Hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Log hourly wage of native worker including mandatory pension contributions, deflated by the Danish CPI; since pension payments are available only from 1995, wages net of pension contributions are used when pre-1995 data are included. Observed only for those employed at end of November.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, footnote 15
  • Fraction of year worked 就业与劳动力状态
    Equals one for a full-time employee throughout the year; for part-time and/or part-year employment, the share of the regular working year spent at work.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1
  • Working-age native samples 样本界定与时间
    Event-study regressions use a strongly balanced panel of low-skilled (and separately high-skilled) natives employed in 1994; 'cohort' specifications fix controls and municipality at 1994 values (SEs clustered by 1994 municipality), 'area' specifications use actual values (SEs clustered by actual municipality).
    登记库： IDA
    在线附录 · Table A.1, Figure A.1 notes
  • Local labour market 地理与社区
    97 municipalities identifiable consistently 1988-2008, merging Frederiksberg and Copenhagen; exposure measured by municipality of work (DiD exposure by 1994 municipality of residence).
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.2; Introduction
  • Experience and tenure 就业与劳动力状态
    Labour market experience = cumulative employment in years since first joining the labour force; tenure = time elapsed since hiring in the current establishment; low tenure = below sample average of 4.35 years in the establishment as of 1994.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; Section 5 heterogeneity

Taxation and the Long Run Allocation of Labor: Theory and Danish Evidence

Claus Thustrup Kreiner, Jakob Roland Munch and Hans Jørgen Whitta-Jacobsen · Journal of Public Economics, 2015 · 个人 + 企业

在覆盖 2004 至 2006 年丹麦全部工人和工作场所的雇主—雇员登记数据上，估计一个含非线性税收的搜寻模型，模型中工人会不断寻找报酬更高的工作。丹麦的税收通过影响劳动力在不同工作之间的配置，使总收入减少约 12%；若降至 OECD 低税国家的水平，可挽回五分之四的损失。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Wage Statistics Register (Lønstatistikken) for hours-adjusted wages (robustness), Empirical effective marginal tax rate schedule for 2006 from Kleven and Kreiner (2006)
关键变量
  • 工作场所平均小时工资率（年劳动收入/年工作小时数）
  • 工作场所规模、留任者人数和新雇人数（工作间流动）
  • 来自非就业状态的新雇人员
  • 按收入水平划分的有效边际税率（用于估计结构搜寻模型和效率损失）
时期
2004–2006 年（基年为 2005 年）
样本
126,400 个工作场所，雇用 140 万名工人 2005 年丹麦私营部门的全部工作场所及其 18–65 岁的工人，小时工资介于 DKK 90 与 DKK 714 之间。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Workers aged 18-65 employed in private-sector workplaces in 2005, drawn from IDA for 2004-2006; employment at each workplace is observed in a specific week in each year. Workers with hourly wage rates in the top percentile (above DKK 714) or below DKK 90 are excluded.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1 (Data)
  • Workplace 企业特征与生产率
    A workplace is an IDA establishment defined by a geographical location; most firms have one workplace but some larger firms have several.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, footnote 9
  • Hourly wage rate (IDA) 劳动收入与收入
    Annual labour income (including mandatory pension fund payments) divided by annual hours; annual hours are based on the mandatory ATP pension contributions, so overtime is not counted and part-time hours are imprecise.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; Section 5 (robustness)
  • Workplace average wage 劳动收入与收入
    Each worker is assigned the average hourly wage rate of employees at his/her workplace in 2005 (following Christensen et al. 2005), after trimming wages below DKK 90 and above DKK 714.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1
  • Workplace size and stayers 企业特征与生产率
    Size is the number of employees at the workplace in 2005; stayers are workers employed at the workplace in 2005 who are still employed there in 2006.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, Table 1
  • New hires / new hires from non-employment 就业与劳动力状态
    New hires are workers employed at the workplace in 2005 who were not employed there in 2004; new hires from non-employment are workers employed at the workplace in 2005 who were not employed at any workplace in 2004 (non-employment or non-participation).
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1
  • Wage offer distribution 劳动收入与收入
    Distribution of firm-specific average wages for persons entering firms in 2005 from non-employment in 2004, weighting each firm's wage by its share of all hires from non-employment.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1
  • Effective marginal tax rate 税收与税率
    Effective marginal tax rates by annual labour income from the Kleven and Kreiner (2006) empirical tax function for 2006 (income taxes, indirect taxes and benefit claw-back), deflated to 2005 by average labour income growth; hourly wages are converted to annual income using median annual hours of 1,660. The participation tax rate m0 is 0.59 at baseline (0.82 in a robustness check).
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, Figure 1; Section 5
  • Hours-adjusted wage rate (WSR imputation) 劳动收入与收入
    Robustness check: the employer-reported hourly wage from the Wage Statistics Register (Lønstatistikken) is regressed on the IDA wage rate after dropping the top and bottom 1% and IDA wages flagged as low quality by Statistics Denmark. The fitted relationship is then used to impute an overtime- and part-time-adjusted wage for all workers.
    登记库： IDA, Lønstatistikken (WSR)
    工作论文 · Section 5 (robustness), Figure 5

The U-Shapes of Occupational Mobility

Fane Groes, Philipp Kircher and Iourii Manovskii · Review of Economic Studies, 2015 · 个人

利用每位工人在本职业工资分布中的位置，考察哪些工人会离开所在职业以及他们去向何处。职业转换呈 U 形：一个职业中工资最低和最高的工人最有可能离开，低收入者转向平均工资较低的职业，高收入者转向平均工资较高的职业。在工资快速上涨的职业中，离开的主要是低工资者；在走下坡路的职业中，离开的主要是高工资者。作者用一个工人逐步了解自身能力、在职业间垂直分选的模型来解释这些规律。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA): socioeconomic variables, sector, industry and occupation (DISCO), Income registers: hourly wage in the job held in the last week of November, from labour income and mandatory pension contributions reported to the tax authorities, Education register (UDDA): completed education and graduation date, Firm–employee link (FIDA): employer identifiers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：在第 t 年与第 t+1 年之间转换 4 位数职业（DISCO）
  • 结果变量：转换的方向，即转入平均工资较高还是较低的职业
  • 关键变量：工人小时工资在其所在职业和年份内的百分位排名（原始工资和残差工资）
  • 异质性：按留任者平均工资的增长把职业分组（最低 10%、中间 80%、最高 10%）
  • 方法：描述性分析；核平滑局部线性回归，以及逐职业对工资百分位二次式做的 probit 回归
时期
1995–2002 年（使用 1980 年起的登记库构建任职年限和工作经验）
样本
229 个职业中的 402,136 个工人—年度观测值（Small Sample A，主要结果）；324 个职业中的 1,292,932 个观测值（Large Sample A）。工作论文版本，2010 年 8 月 1980 年或之后完成学业、至少到 1995 年仍在数据中、且次年有有效职业代码的男性雇员。Small Sample 保留私营部门全职工人，并在以下时点截断每个人的履历：首次出现非全职、公共部门或自雇经历时，首次出现工资、企业或职业代码缺失时，以及毕业满 15 年时。Large Sample 加入了公共部门工人以及非全职工作和非就业的时段。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Occupation (4-digit DISCO) 职业与职位层级
    Occupational affiliation is the DISCO code, the Danish version of ISCO-88, used at the 4-digit level. Robustness checks use 1-, 2- and 3-digit codes. In the code, occupation is unknown if discok equals 0 or 9999 or is below 1000.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： discok
    工作论文 · Section 2.1 (Data); supplementary Stata programs
  • Occupational switch 职业与职位层级
    A worker switches occupation in year t if his 4-digit occupation code in t+1 differs from the one in t, for workers employed in both years from 1995 on. Firm and industry switches are defined in the same way. A measurement-error check requires the same occupation in t-1 and t and again in t+1 and t+2.
    登记库： IDA, FIDA
    代码： occ_switch = 1 if discok differs between t and t+1
    复制代码 · Supplementary data, select_data_9small_men.do
  • Hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Total labour income plus mandatory pension fund payments of the job held in the last week of November, divided by the hours worked in that job; deflated to the 1995 level with Statistics Denmark's consumer price index. No wage is available for workers not employed in the last week of November. The working paper trims wages at the 1st and 99th percentile in each year; a comment in the 2014 replication code says the top and bottom 0.1% are deleted.
    登记库： Income registers, IDA
    代码： timelon_pens = timelon + pension per hour (pension = sum of arbpen10–arbpen15)
    工作论文 · Section 2.1 (Data); supplementary gen_vars_7small.do
  • Wage percentile within occupation 劳动收入与收入
    The worker's percentile rank in the hourly wage distribution of his occupation in a given year (Sample A, at least 10 workers in the occupation-year) or of his occupation, year and graduation cohort (Sample B). Residual-wage versions rank residuals from occupation-specific log wage regressions on year dummies, polynomials in experience and in occupational, industry and firm tenure, occupational spell number, education, marital status, union membership and region.
    登记库： IDA, Income registers
    工作论文 · Sections 2.1.1 and 2.2; Appendix Table A-1
  • Small and Large samples 样本界定与时间
    Both samples: men, employees, education completed in or after 1980, in the data at least until 1995, not returning to school for at least three years after graduation. Small Sample: full-time private-sector workers, with histories truncated at the first part-time, public-sector or self-employment spell, at the first missing wage, firm or occupation code, and 15 years after graduation. Large Sample: adds public-sector workers, spells of part-time work and non-employment, and re-entry after missing firm, industry or occupation codes.
    登记库： IDA, UDDA
    工作论文 · Section 2.1.1 (Sample Selection)

The Wage Effects of Offshoring: Evidence from Danish Matched Worker-Firm Data

David Hummels, Rasmus Jørgensen, Jakob Munch and Chong Xiang · American Economic Review, 2014 · 个人 + 企业

将企业的产品层面进出口与工人工资相连接。在同一工作时段内，离岸外包提高高技能工人的工资、降低低技能工人的工资，而出口则提高所有工人的工资。常规性强或容易被离岸外包的任务受损最大。

数据
Firm Statistics Register (FirmStat/FIRM), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Firm-worker link (FIDA), Foreign Trade Statistics Register, Extrastat and Intrastat (UHDI), UN COMTRADE world trade data for instruments, Firm accounts and other firm registers (Data Appendix)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：工作时段内工人小时工资的对数
  • 处理：企业离岸外包（投入品进口）
  • 处理：企业出口
  • 工具变量：按产品和国家划分的世界出口供给冲击与世界进口需求冲击（COMTRADE），以及运输成本
  • 异质性：工人技能类型（高技能与低技能）
  • 结果变量：被裁工人的劳动收入损失
时期
1995–2006 年（贸易数据为 1990–2006 年）
样本
约 195 万个工人—企业—年份观测值和 9,800 个企业—年份观测值 既进口又出口的丹麦企业中的制造业工人，剔除仅持续一年的工作时段、技能水平发生变化的工人，以及雇员少于 50 人且进口额不足 60 万 DKK 的企业。 来源
变量如何定义（13）
  • Hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Wage rate uses annual hours from IDA (following Christensen et al. 2005); annual hours do not capture overtime. In a 2006 subsample with overtime data, a wage rate including overtime correlates 0.86 with the main wage rate.
    登记库： IDA
    在线附录 · Data Appendix, section 1
  • High- vs low-skilled worker 教育与考试成绩
    Robustness split of low-skilled workers into medium-skilled (vocational education, defined as the final stage of secondary education preparing for labour market entry) and very-low-skilled (high school equivalent or less); results very similar. Workers whose skill level changes during the sample period are dropped.
    登记库： IDA
    在线附录 · Data Appendix, section 1
  • Broad offshoring 贸易与离岸外包
    Total value of imports by a given manufacturing firm in a given year, from the Foreign Trade Statistics Register (Extrastat and Intrastat), recorded at CN8 and aggregated to HS6.
    登记库： Foreign Trade Statistics Register (UHDI)
    工作论文 · Section II.3
  • Narrow offshoring 贸易与离岸外包
    Machinery imports (HS 84 and HS 85, 16.9% of imports) are included in broad offshoring for all firms; narrow offshoring excludes them except for firms that themselves produce machinery for sale. Within HS 84 the top 20 HS6 import products (59% of HS 84 imports) are all parts rather than machines.
    登记库： Foreign Trade Statistics Register
    代码： HS 84; HS 85
    在线附录 · Data Appendix, section 3.2
  • World export supply and world import demand instruments 贸易与离岸外包
    WES: country c's total supply of HS6 product k to the world market minus its supply to Denmark in year t; WID: country c's total purchases of product k from the world market less purchases from Denmark; both from COMTRADE and weighted by pre-sample firm input/output shares; plus exchange rates and transport costs fitted from US imports data.
    登记库： UN COMTRADE, Foreign Trade Statistics Register
    工作论文 · Section III and Data Appendix section 2
  • Estimation sample (firms) 样本界定与时间
    Start from 2.8 million manufacturing worker-firm-year observations after merging workers, firms and trade. Drop worker-firm-years whose job spell lasts a single year (~200,000 obs); drop workers whose skill level changes in the sample (~35,000 obs); drop firms with fewer than 50 employees and less than DKK 0.6 million in imports (about two manufacturing workers' average annual wages) (~600,000 obs).
    登记库： IDA, FirmStat, Foreign Trade Statistics Register
    代码： firm size < 50 employees and imports < DKK 0.6m dropped
    在线附录 · Data Appendix, section 1
  • Firm controls 企业特征与生产率
    Firm identifier from 'Old Firm Statistics' (1995-1999) and 'General Firm Statistics' (1999-2006), combined in FirmStat to track firms across the 1999 break. Employees = number of full-time equivalent workers in the year (FirmStat). Capital stock = value of land, buildings, machines, equipment and inventory (Accounting Statistics register). Gross output (net of taxes) from the VAT register. Firm skill intensity = educational attainment of individual workers in IDA aggregated to the firm via FIDA.
    登记库： FirmStat, Old Firm Statistics, General Firm Statistics, Accounting Statistics, VAT register, IDA, FIDA
    在线附录 · Data Appendix, section 1
  • Routine / non-routine task intensity 职业与职位层级
    IDA occupation uses the Danish version of ISCO-88, mapped to O*NET via the National Crosswalk Center crosswalk. Non-routine = principal component of O*NET 1.A.1.c.1 (mathematical reasoning), 1.A.2.b.3 (response orientation), 1.A.3.c.3 (gross body coordination), 2.A.1.e (mathematics), 4.A.2.b.2 (thinking creatively), 4.A.2.b.6 (organizing, planning, prioritizing). Routine = 1.A.2.a.2 (manual dexterity), 1.A.2.a.3 (finger dexterity), 1.A.2.b.2 (multilimb coordination), 4.A.2.a.2 (processing information), 4.A.2.a.3 (evaluating compliance with standards).
    登记库： IDA, O*NET
    代码： ISCO-88 (Danish version); O*NET 1.A.1.c.1, 1.A.2.b.3, 1.A.3.c.3, 2.A.1.e, 4.A.2.b.2, 4.A.2.b.6 (non-routine); O*NET 1.A.2.a.2, 1.A.2.a.3, 1.A.2.b.2, 4.A.2.a.2, 4.A.2.a.3 (routine)
    在线附录 · Data Appendix, section 1
  • Mass-layoff displacement and offshorer 就业与劳动力状态
    Displaced workers separate from firms where at least 30% of the initial-year workers are not employed by the firm the following year (gross flows). Returns to Tenure or Seniority?

I. Sebastian Buhai, Miguel A. Portela, Coen N. Teulings and Aico van Vuuren · Econometrica, 2014 · 个人 + 企业

利用丹麦和葡萄牙的雇主—雇员匹配数据，把任职年限的工资回报与资历的回报区分开来，其中资历定义为劳动者的任职年限在同一企业同事中的排名。最后入职的劳动者最先离开；在给定任职年限和企业规模的条件下，资历排名越高，离职风险率越低，工资越高。在任职满十年时，资历第 10 与第 90 百分位之间的工资差距在丹麦为 1.1-1.4 个百分点，在葡萄牙为 2.3-3.4 个百分点。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Statistics Denmark, 1980–2001: annual (30 November) worker records with plant and firm identifiers, ATP mandatory pension contribution histories (tenure of workers hired 1964–1980), Quadros de Pessoal, Portuguese Ministry of Labour, 1986–2009 (Portuguese matched employer-employee data, not Danish)
关键变量
  • 关键解释变量：资历指数（企业规模的对数减去企业内任职年限排名的对数）
  • 结果变量：离职风险率（离散时间混合比例风险模型）
  • 结果变量：对数实际小时工资
  • 控制变量：任职年限、潜在工作经验、企业规模的对数、教育、行业和地区
  • 估计方法：OLS、Topel 一阶差分、Altonji-Shakotko、工作期固定效应
时期
丹麦 1980–2001 年；葡萄牙 1986–2009 年
样本
丹麦：12,634,236 个观测值，涉及 1,412,646 名劳动者、3,456,711 段工作期和 221,807 家企业；葡萄牙：15,371,019 个观测值，涉及 2,931,323 名劳动者和 458,888 家企业（2011 年 7 月“forthcoming in Econometrica”版本的表 1） 丹麦和葡萄牙 25 岁以上男性在私营部门的工作期（不含农业、渔业和采矿业）；离职风险模型在 5% 的样本上估计。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Seniority index (r_ijt) 职业与职位层级
    q_ijt is the log number of workers in firm j with tenure greater than or equal to that of worker i (including worker i) at time t, and n_jt is the log total number of workers in firm j at time t. The seniority index is r_ijt = n_jt - q_ijt: it equals log firm size for the most senior worker and zero for the least senior worker. An alternative index r*_ijt = q*_ijt - n_jt uses the log number of workers with tenure less than or equal to worker i's. Seniority is calculated before any data deletion.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： r_ijt = n_jt - q_ijt
    工作论文 · Section 2, equations (1) and (2); Section 3
  • Job tenure 就业与劳动力状态
    Labour market status is recorded on 30 November of each year. Tenure of workers hired since 1980 is calculated directly from IDA; for workers hired between 1964 and 1980 it is calculated from contribution histories to ATP, a mandatory pension program. Tenure in job spells started before 1964 is left censored (less than 3% of the observations, discarded). Potential experience is age minus schooling minus 6.
    登记库： IDA, ATP contributions
    代码： Hired >= 1980: IDA; hired 1964-1980: ATP; spells started before 1964 dropped
    工作论文 · Section 3 (The data)
  • Firm size and industry 企业特征与生产率
    IDA contains a plant identifier that allows the total workforce of a plant, and hence of the firm, to be constructed. Firm size is the number of individuals holding primary jobs in that firm and earning a positive wage. Industry is the industry employing the largest share of the firm's workforce.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3 (The data)
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    All private sector jobs except agriculture, fishing and mining. Wage observations below the legal minimum wage and the top 1% of the wage distribution are deleted for each year. Unless otherwise stated, employment spells of men aged over 25. Workers above age 55 are excluded from the LIFO duration analysis (spells started before 55 and finished afterwards are treated as right censored), but not from the construction of seniority or the wage analysis. Location and industry are taken at the start of the spell.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： Men aged > 25; age <= 55 in duration analysis; wages below minimum wage and top 1% dropped per year
    工作论文 · Section 3 (The data)
  • Log real hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Hourly gross earnings from IDA; log wages are expressed in euro and deflated to year 2000 prices. The wage regressions use the time-detrended log real hourly wage as dependent variable.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3 and notes to Tables 1 and 5

Wages and Commuting: Quasi-natural Experiments' Evidence from Firms that Relocate

Ismir Mulalic, Jos N. van Ommeren and Ninette Pilegaard · Economic Journal, 2014 · 个人 + 企业

研究工人的通勤距离变长时工资是否会提高。利用工人所在企业迁至新地址所引起的通勤距离变化，比较同一搬迁企业中既未更换雇主也未搬家的工人。通勤距离每增加 1 km，搬迁后一年的工资几乎没有上升，三年后上升约 0.15%，作者将其解读为存在求职搜寻摩擦的证据。

数据
Annual register data from Statistics Denmark covering the full population of workers and firms, matched worker to establishment (2003–2005 in the working-paper version), Residence and establishment (workplace) addresses on 31 December each year; commuting distance computed as the shortest route between the exact addresses, Annual net wages derived from workers' pay slips as observed by the Danish Tax Authorities, Labour market register occupation code RASDISCO (4-digit job function), Firm units identified by SE number (tax authorities' register of enterprises liable to VAT)
关键变量
  • 处理：企业变更地址所导致的单程通勤距离变化（km）
  • 结果变量：年净工资对数的变化
  • 控制变量：企业固定效应、工人职务的变化（晋升的代理变量）
  • 异质性：丹麦通勤税收扣除的通勤距离区间（12.5–50 km、50 km 以上）
  • 选择性检验：针对留在原雇主和未迁居的 Heckman 模型
时期
2010 年工作论文中为 2003–2005 年（企业搬迁发生在 2004 年）；发表版本追踪搬迁后最长三年的工资，具体年份未经核实
样本
主样本为 1,144 家搬迁企业中的 6,165 名工人；全样本为 1,333 家企业中的 8,601 名工人（2010 年工作论文，Section 3.2 和 Table A1） 2004 年期间变更地址的企业中只有一份工作的全职工人，他们在 2003 年 1 月至 2005 年 12 月间留在该企业且未变更住所（工作论文版本；发表版本的样本可能不同）。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Workers of relocating firms (main and full samples) 样本界定与时间
    From the full population of 321,337 firms and 2,710,462 workers, firms that changed address between January 2004 and December 2004 are selected (11,314 firms; 64,643 workers). Dropped: records with missing information, workers with more than one job, part-time workers, address changes that imply no change in commuting distance, and outliers (commuting distance above 100 km, change in commuting distance above 50 km, absolute change in log wage above 0.5). This leaves a full sample of 8,601 workers in 1,333 firms; the main sample keeps workers who stayed with their firm and did not change residence from January 2003 to December 2005 (6,165 workers; 1,144 firms). Wages are compared between 2003 and 2005, the years in which commuting distance is constant.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark annual register data on workers and firms
    代码： Address change Jan 2004-Dec 2004; commuting distance > 100 km excluded; change in commuting distance > 50 km excluded; |change in log(wage)| > 0.5 excluded; full-time job lasting at least 1 year continuously
    工作论文 · Section 3.2 and Appendix A, Table A1
  • Commuting distance and its change 地理与社区
    One-way commuting distance in kilometres between the worker's residence and the establishment workplace, both observed on 31 December each year, calculated as the shortest route between the exact residence and workplace addresses. The treatment is the change in this distance caused by the firm's change of address. Interaction dummies mark commutes between 12.5 and 50 km (D12.5) and above 50 km (D50), the ranges in which the Danish commuting tax deduction applies.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark annual register data (residence and workplace addresses)
    代码： D12.5 = one-way commute between 12.5 and 50 km; D50 = one-way commute above 50 km
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; Table 2 notes
  • Change in log wage 劳动收入与收入
    Annual net wages, derived from workers' pay slips as observed by the Danish Tax Authorities. The dependent variable is log(wage 2005) minus log(wage 2003).
    登记库： Tax-authority pay slip records (via Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, footnote 9; Table 1
  • Change in worker's function 职业与职位层级
    Indicator for a change in the worker's job function between 2003 and 2005, used to control for promotions. Computed from the labour market administrative register variable RASDISCO, a 4-digit function code with more than a thousand function descriptions.
    登记库： RAS
    代码： RASDISCO (4-digit)
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, footnote 12
  • Firm unit (SE number) 企业特征与生产率
    The statistical unit of firms is an administrative unit in the tax authorities' register of enterprises liable to VAT, identified by its SE number. It usually equals the legal unit (the enterprise), but an enterprise may split its registration into several SE numbers; each SE number is treated as a separate firm. Workplace location is measured at the establishment, and the paper refers to establishments as firms.
    登记库： Tax authorities' register of enterprises liable to VAT (SE numbers)
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; Section 3.2, footnote 10

Jesper Bagger, François Fontaine, Fabien Postel-Vinay and Jean-Marc Robin · American Economic Review, 2014 · 个人 + 企业

  • 结果变量：11 月最后一周在职工作的小时工资

  • 关键变量：工作到工作、就业到失业的转换（时段数据）
  • 分层：三个受教育年限组（7–11 年、12–14 年、15–20 年）
时期
1985–2003
样本

调查
Accounts Statistics survey
变量如何定义（7）
  • Weekly labour market states (spell data) 就业与劳动力状态
    Job spells defined at firm (not establishment) level; establishment-level IDA information aggregated to the firm, with firm industry and ownership taken from its largest establishment by remaining workers. Nonparticipation is a residual state: 47% of workers have at least one nonparticipation spell and 5.5% of last-week-of-November spells are nonparticipation.

  • Actual labour market experience 就业与劳动力状态
    Actual experience at end of calendar year constructed from mandatory ATP pension payments back to 1 January 1964; pre-1980 experience measured in years and post-1980 in 1/1000 of a year's full-time work.   • Firm productivity (hourly value added) 企业特征与生产率

    登记库： Accounts Statistics (regnskabsstatistik), IDA
