Wage Dispersion and Decentralization of Wage Bargaining

Christian M. Dahl, Daniel le Maire and Jakob R. Munch · Journal of Labor Economics, 2013 · 个人 + 企业

利用丹麦 1990 年代工资谈判由集中谈判转向企业层面谈判这一变化。与部门层面谈判相比，适用企业层面谈判的工人获得工资溢价，技能回报更高，工资离散程度也更大。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), matched employer-employee data, Income register (tax files), Supplementary Pension Fund (ATP) contributions for hours worked, DA/LO bargaining-segment classification by NACE industry and DISCO occupation (Confederation of Danish Employers)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：小时工资的对数（劳动收入加强制性养老金缴款，除以工时）
  • 处理：工资决定制度（标准工资率制、最低工资制、最低薪酬制、企业层面谈判）
  • 结果变量：工资离散度（分位数回归）和技能回报
  • 控制变量：性别、子女、婚姻、移民身份、教育、工作经验、工作场所规模、行业×年份虚拟变量
  • 工人固定效应；工资决定制度随时间的变化
时期
1992–2001
样本
约 114 万个工人—年观测值（1,137,367） 36 个 DA/LO 谈判领域中年龄 25–65 岁的私营部门全职工人的 30% 随机样本，所在工作场所至少有五名雇员。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Hourly wage rate 劳动收入与收入
    Sum of total labour income (from tax files in the Income Register) and mandatory pension fund payments, divided by the total number of hours worked in the year (ATP-imputed); observations with unobserved wage, wage flagged by Statistics Denmark as low precision, or in the top or bottom half percentile are discarded.
    登记库： IND, IDA, ATP
    工作论文 · Section 4 (pp. 13-14)
  • Annual hours (ATP-based) 工作时间
    Imputed from the worker's ATP contribution group: no payment for 0-9 weekly hours, 1/3 of full-time payment for 9-18, 2/3 for 18-27, and full payment for 27+; workers paying full-time ATP are assigned hours corresponding to the standard 37-hour week. Overtime not captured.
    登记库： ATP
    工作论文 · Section 4 (p. 13)
  • Bargaining segment / wage-setting system 部门与行业
    Workers are allocated to 36 DA/LO bargaining segments using six-digit NACE industry and four-digit DISCO (ISCO-88) occupation codes, as DA and LO do (about 85% of DA/LO employment); each segment's yearly system is classified as standard-rate (normallønssystemet), minimum-wage (minimallønssystemet), minimum-pay (mindstebetalingssystemet) or firm-level bargaining (uden lønsats).
    登记库： IDA, DA/LO bargaining segment classification
    代码： NACE 6-digit x DISCO 4-digit (segment list not given)
    工作论文 · Section 2 (p. 10) and Section 4 (p. 12)
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Full-time workers aged 25-65 employed in one of the DA/LO bargaining segments, 1992-2001, excluding scholarship recipients in ordinary education, plants with fewer than five employees, and observations with unreliable/extreme wages; a 30% random sample is drawn (about 1.14 million worker-years).
    登记库： IDA, IND
    工作论文 · Section 4 (p. 14)
  • Education groups 教育与考试成绩
    Unskilled (high school or equivalent or less), vocational education (final stage of secondary education preparing for direct labour market entry), short-term higher education and long-term higher education, from the Danish education code corresponding to ISCED (higher education = ISCED 5 and 6).
    登记库： UDDA
    代码： ISCED 5-6 = higher education
    工作论文 · Section 4 and footnote 4
  • Labour market experience 就业与劳动力状态
    Actual labour market experience accumulated since 1964.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 4 (p. 13)
  • Plant size and workforce composition 企业特征与生产率
    Plant size defined as the number of employees, plus variables measuring the labour force composition at plant level; regressions also include 25 industry dummies interacted with year dummies.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 4 (p. 13)

Is Business Failure Due to Lack of Effort? Empirical Evidence from a Large Administrative Sample

Mette Ejrnæs and Stefan Hochguertel · Economic Journal, 2013 · 个人

丹麦的自雇者可以自愿购买失业保险，这为检验道德风险提供了机会。基于一个大型行政面板数据，研究发现参保的创业者更可能关闭企业并进入失业状态，且这一效应随着取得资格的日期临近而增强，这与努力程度下降相一致，而不能仅用选择效应来解释。

数据
CAM 10% Sample: 10% random sample of the Danish population aged 16+ (linked administrative registers incl. tax and benefit records), Unemployment insurance fund membership records
关键变量
  • 结果变量：由自雇转入失业（登记失业时间 >10% 的全年时间）
  • 处理：失业保险基金成员身份（参保状态）
  • 工具变量：仅向失业保险基金成员开放的提前退休计划（VERP）的资格
  • 估计方法：双变量随机效应 probit
时期
1981–1998
样本
13,434 人、86,092 个观测值（估计样本） 出生于丹麦、年龄 25–59 岁的丹麦籍男性，在其被观测到的前三年为自雇者，不含农业，取自 CAM 10% 样本。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • CAM 10% sample 样本界定与时间
    10% random sample of the Danish population aged 16 and above from the Danish National Register, followed annually from 1981; waves up to and including 1998 are used. Unbalanced: new residents turning 16 or immigrating enter, people leave through death or emigration.
    登记库： CAM 10% Sample
    工作论文 · Section 4.1 (Register Data)
  • Self-employment / labour market status 就业与劳动力状态
    Labour market status is recorded in calendar week 48 (late November) of each year; individuals are classified as self-employed according to their main economic activity in that week. Persons originally classified as 'on leave' (possible for UI fund members from 1994) are re-classified to their state of origin.
    登记库： CAM 10% Sample
    工作论文 · Section 4.1 and footnote 22
  • Unemployment (outcome) 失业与福利金
    Indicator equal to one if the individual was registered unemployed in excess of 10% of the year according to the annual 'unemployment degree' (fraction of the year UI benefits are received), zero otherwise. 'Unemployed' means registered as such with the job centre, which also covers non-UI-members on social assistance; an alternative measure is the week-48 unemployment stock.
    登记库： CAM 10% Sample
    工作论文 · Sections 4.1 and 5.1
  • UI fund membership (insured) 失业与福利金
    Membership in an unemployment insurance fund, as recorded in the administrative data; 'insured' and UI fund member are used interchangeably. Treatment enters the unemployment equation lagged one year (status in t-1).
    登记库： CAM 10% Sample
    工作论文 · Section 4.1 (fn. 16) and Section 5.1
  • Early retirement (VERP) eligibility instrument 退休与养老金
    Institutional-rule indicator of eligibility for the UI-fund-linked early retirement (ER) scheme (retirement from age 60). Before 1992 members qualified with 10 years of UI membership before age 60 ('10-year rule'); the 1992 reform required at least 20 years ('20-year rule', latest joining age 40), with those aged 40-50 in 1992 required to join in 1992 and stay until 60. Identification comes from changes over year and cohort in this rule.
    登记库： CAM 10% Sample
    工作论文 · Section 2 (institutions) and Sections 5.1-5.2
  • Analysis sample restrictions 样本界定与时间
    Denmark-born males with Danish citizenship aged 25-59; excludes students, retirees, persons out of the labour force in every year, persons receiving public pensions, and anyone who worked as wage earner or self-employed in agriculture 1981-1998; requires at least one employment spell. Estimation sample: persons self-employed in their first three observed years and not unemployed (>10% measure) in any of those years (13,434 individuals, 86,092 obs).
    登记库： CAM 10% Sample
    工作论文 · Sections 4.1 and 5.1
  • Health proxy (sickness benefits) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Receipt of sickness benefits is used as the health or illness measure because of data limitations.
    登记库： CAM 10% Sample
    工作论文 · Section 5.2
  • Self-employment income 劳动收入与收入
    Income from self-employment (surplus or profit of business), entered linearly with a dummy for negative values; income and wealth measured in constant 1981 million DKK. Controls also include receipt of start-up allowance (for entrants from unemployment via active labour market programmes) and regional unemployment calculated from the micro data.
    登记库： CAM 10% Sample
    工作论文 · Section 5.2

Unemployment Insurance, Wage Dynamics and Inequality Over the Life Cycle

Paul Bingley, Lorenzo Cappellari and Niels Westergård-Nielsen · Economic Journal, 2013 · 个人

对丹麦男性生命周期内工资的持久性和暂时性动态建模，并允许这些动态因是否加入失业保险而不同。参保与较低的工资不平等和较弱的冲击持续性相关；论文还量化了与非成员相比，失业保险成员避免了多少生命周期工资不平等。

数据
Administrative register data on the Danish labour force (Statistics Denmark): annual labour earnings and hours-derived hourly wages, UI fund membership contributions reported to tax authorities, Mandatory pension contributions (ATP) for year of labour market entry
关键变量
  • 结果变量：税前小时工资的对数（持久性成分与暂时性成分）
  • 核心解释变量：失业保险基金成员身份
  • 潜在劳动力市场经验
  • 出生队列（1943–1973 年，共 31 个队列）
时期
1980–2003
样本
约 810,000 人，约 1250 万个人年观测值 年龄 21–55 岁、1943–1973 年出生的丹麦男性私营部门全职雇员，至少有连续五个有效工资观测值。 来源
变量如何定义（4）
  • Gross hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Calculated by Statistics Denmark as annual labour earnings (reported by employers to the tax authorities) divided by hours worked, where hours are an annual average derived by Statistics Denmark from mandatory pension (ATP) contributions adjusted for contribution rates by sector and collective agreement. Zero wages dropped, bottom and top 0.5% trimmed per year, observations below minimum wage dropped.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark administrative registers, ATP
    工作论文 · Section 4 and footnote 13
  • UI fund membership 失业与福利金
    Annual dummy for UI fund membership, observed from tax-deductible UI fund membership contributions reported annually by the funds to the tax authorities.
    登记库： Tax records
    工作论文 · Section 4
  • 潜在劳动力市场经验 就业与劳动力状态
    Years since entering the labour market, where year of entry is observed from the first mandatory pension (ATP) contribution; ATP was introduced in 1964, so entry is censored at 1964.
    登记库： ATP
    工作论文 · Section 4
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Men aged 21-55, full-time private-sector employees, 1980-2003, birth cohorts 1943-1973 (31 single-year cohorts; each observed at least ten years). Individuals must have valid wage observations for at least five consecutive years.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark administrative registers
    工作论文 · Section 4

Productivity Spillovers Across Firms through Worker Mobility

Andrey Stoyanov and Nikolay Zubanov · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2012 · 个人 + 企业

追踪丹麦制造业中工人在企业间的流动。从生产率更高的企业招聘工人的企业，生产率会随之提高，对一家平均水平的企业而言每年约 0.35%；这一增益随新雇员的教育、任职年限和技能水平而上升，并持续数年，与由工人携带的知识溢出相一致。

数据
Matched employer-employee data from Statistics Denmark (worker records from 1983, ages 15–65), Manufacturing firm-level accounts data with sales, value added, materials, capital and investment, 1995–2007
关键变量
  • 结果变量：接收企业的人均增加值对数，以 4 位数行业—年份均值作标准化
  • 处理：新雇用工人的流出企业与接收企业之间的生产率差距，以新雇员占就业的份额加权
  • 正向和负向生产率差距（来自生产率更高的企业与来自生产率更低的企业的新雇员）
  • 工人特征：教育、职业/技能水平、工作经验、工资
  • 企业特征：规模、行业
时期
1995–2007
样本
173,929 个企业—年度观测值（约 580 万个工人—年度观测值，668,034 名换工作者）；基准回归使用 74,507 和 61,112 个企业—年度观测值 1995–2007 年丹麦全部制造业企业及其年薪为正的雇员。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Normalized labour productivity 企业特征与生产率
    Natural log of firm value added per worker normalized by the 4-digit NACE industry-year average; manufacturing firms 1995-2007, with firm accounts from annual surveys (all firms with 50+ workers) and interpolated values for less frequently surveyed small firms.
    登记库： Firm-level accounts (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： NACE 4-digit
    论文正文 · Section I.A
  • Productivity gap of new hires 企业特征与生产率
    Split into four groups by sending firm: from more productive firms in the same 2-digit industry (gap_p_same), more productive firms in a different industry (gap_p_diff), less productive same industry (gap_n_same), less productive different industry (gap_n_diff). Regressions include five lags of value added per worker (autocorrelation insignificant at the sixth lag), industry-year fixed effects and average size of the sending firm; period 1995-2007; firm-specific trend robustness restricted to firms with 50+ workers.
    登记库： Matched employer-employee data, Firm accounts data
    代码： firms >=50 workers (trend robustness)
    在线附录 · Web Appendix A1-A3, Tables A2-A4
  • Job mover / new hire 就业与劳动力状态
    Worker observed at a different firm than in the previous year; employment record is as of end of calendar year, so only the year of the move is observed. Sample restricted to manufacturing firms and employees aged 15-65 with positive annual salary; multiple jobs treated as different.
    登记库： Matched employer-employee data (Statistics Denmark)
    论文正文 · Section I.A
  • Skill level / occupation category 职业与职位层级
    Occupation grouped into four categories: low-skilled, mid-skilled, high-skilled workers and managers.
    登记库： Matched employer-employee data (Statistics Denmark)
    论文正文 · Section I.A
  • Educational attainment 教育与考试成绩
    Highest completed education measured in three levels: high school, college and university.
    登记库： Matched employer-employee data (Statistics Denmark)
    论文正文 · Section I.A
  • Labour market experience 工作时间
    Work experience recorded in thousands of hours in the individual-level data.
    登记库： Matched employer-employee data (Statistics Denmark)
    论文正文 · Section I.A
  • Firm human capital of workers (AKM-based) 劳动收入与收入
    Firm average of worker wage net of the AKM firm effect, h = (1/N) sum (w - lambda - psi_j), from a wage equation with person and firm fixed effects (Abowd, Kramarz and Margolis 1999); new workers' human capital measured in t-1, their last full year in the previous firm.
    登记库： Matched employer-employee data (Statistics Denmark)
    论文正文 · Section I.B eq. (5)
  • Manufacturing industry groups (2-digit NACE) 部门与行业
    Nine 2-digit NACE manufacturing industry groups used for industry-specific estimates and industry-year fixed effects: Food, beverages, tobacco; Textiles, clothing, footwear; Wood, paper and products thereof; Publishing, printing, recording; Fuel, chemical and other non-metallic mineral products; Metals and products thereof (excluding machinery); Machinery and equipment; Electrical and optical equipment; Manufacturing n.e.c.
    登记库： Firm accounts data
    代码： NACE 2-digit (manufacturing)

Adjustment Costs, Firm Responses, and Micro vs. Macro Labor Supply Elasticities: Evidence from Danish Tax Records

Raj Chetty, John N. Friedman, Tore Olsen and Luigi Pistaferri · Quarterly Journal of Economics, 2011 · 个人 + 企业

利用丹麦税率表拐点处的聚束现象，说明观测到的劳动收入反应受到搜寻成本以及企业围绕税收门槛协调工时的影响。一旦考虑调整摩擦，结构性劳动供给弹性约为 0.3，远高于个体层面微观研究得到的很小的弹性，这有助于调和微观与宏观估计。

数据
Income tax register / Income Statistics Register (IND), Population register (BEF), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA) with firm ID and occupation
关键变量
  • 结果变量：应税收入在最高税率拐点处的聚束（超额质量）
  • 处理：税级分界点处的边际税率变化（税收模拟器）
  • 关键变量：企业层面和职业层面的聚束（工时约束 / 企业反应）
  • 关键变量：各拐点处税率变化的幅度
  • 比较：工薪劳动者与自雇者
时期
1994–2001
样本
工薪劳动者 1790 万个观测值（其中 680 万个位于最高税率分界点上下 DKr 50,000 以内；自雇者观测值 180 万个） 15–70 岁的丹麦工薪劳动者，不含自雇者和养老金领取者，自雇者另行研究。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Wage earner sample 就业与劳动力状态
    Individuals aged 15-70 in the tax register 1994-2001 classified as wage earners by IDA employment status, excluding self-employed, pensioners, wage earners with self-employment income and wage earners with unemployment; much of the analysis uses wage earners within DKr 50,000 of the top tax cutoff. Self-employed analysed separately.
    登记库： IND (tax register), IDA
    代码： BESKST=4 (robustness: BESKST in 4, 5, 7, 8)
    工作论文 · Section 4; Appendix B
  • Tax simulator and marginal tax rates 税收与税率
    Authors' tax simulator computing tax liabilities and marginal tax rates from own and spouse's tax variables and previous-year municipality of residence; it matches actual municipal, regional, bottom, middle and top taxes within DKr 5 for 95% of observations.
    登记库： IND (tax register)
    代码： pnr, henv (spouse), glskkmnr (municipality), pfrdst, berfrdst (personal exemption), perindkp, berpi (personal income), kapindkp, berkap (capital income), lignfrdp (special deductions), kappens, fosfufrd (individual pension contributions), arbpen14, arbpen15 (employer capital pension contributions), underhol (alimony)
    工作论文 · Appendix B
  • Wage earnings and net deductions 劳动收入与收入
    Wage earnings from the tax register; net deductions = deductions minus non-wage income (accounting for spousal deductions), equivalently wage earnings minus taxable income; in the top-tax base, net deductions = wage earnings needed to start paying top tax minus the statutory top tax cutoff. Small-deduction group: net deductions below DKr 7,500 in magnitude.
    登记库： IND (tax register)
    代码： wage earnings qlontmp2; self-employment profits qovskvir, virkordind
    工作论文 · Section 4; Appendix B
  • Bunching (excess mass) at kinks 税收与税率
    Excess mass b = number of individuals in a window around the kink in excess of a counterfactual density, relative to the average counterfactual density in the window; the counterfactual is a seventh-degree polynomial fitted to binned counts of the earnings distribution excluding a DKr 15,000 window centred on the kink (q=7, R=7).
    登记库： IND (tax register)
    代码： q=7 (polynomial degree), R=7 (bins on each side), excluded window DKr 15,000
    工作论文 · Section 4, equations (15)-(16)
  • Firm bunching and occupation earnings modes 职业与职位层级
    Occupation-year modes = DKr 5,000 wage-earnings bin with most workers in each 4-digit ISCO occupation-year (occupation-years with under 7,000 workers excluded). Firm bunching b_F = excess mass at the statutory top-tax cutoff for workers with more than DKr 20,000 in deductions; individual bunching b_I = excess mass at the pension kink for the same group; compared across 2-digit ISCO occupations.
    登记库： IDA, IND
    代码： occupation discok (ISCO 4-digit; 2-digit for Figure 18); deductions > DKr 20,000
    工作论文 · Section 6 (Predictions 2 and 3); Appendix B; Figures 14, 18
  • Pension-driven kink 退休与养老金
    Cap on tax-deductible pension contributions (about DKr 33,000 on average) means workers contributing up to the cap enter the top bracket at wage earnings about DKr 33,000 above the statutory cutoff; bunching there is used to measure individual (job-search) bunching.
    登记库： IND (tax register)
    工作论文 · Introduction; Section 6

Andrew E. Clark, Nicolai Kristensen and Niels Westergård-Nielsen · Economic Journal, 2009 · 个人 + 企业

将问卷调查中的工作满意度指标与同一工作场所内全部同事的登记库工资相匹配。同事挣得越多，本人的满意度越高，这与通常的收入比较结论相反；作者将其解释为同事的薪酬是本人未来劳动收入的信号。这一效应在男性和私营部门中更强。

数据
Danish sample of the European Community Household Panel (ECHP), eight waves, Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), matched via CPR number
关键变量
  • 结果变量：总体工作满意度（1–6 级量表）
  • 核心解释变量：同一工作场所内同事的工资
  • 本人工资（来自 IDA 的税前年收入）
  • 相对于工作场所工资分布的工资落差
时期
1994–2001
样本
约 16,000 个观测值，涉及约 4,100 人 1994–2001 年丹麦 ECHP 中与 IDA 匹配的雇员，所在工作场所至少有 5 名同事。 来源
调查
ECHP
变量如何定义（4）
  • Overall job satisfaction 其他
    ECHP question 'How satisfied are you with your work or other main activity?', ordered scale from 1 (not at all satisfied) to 6 (fully satisfied); Danish ECHP waves 1994-2001, employees only.
    登记库： ECHP (Danish sample)
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; Figure 1 note
  • Own wage 劳动收入与收入
    Individual's gross annual income from IDA, matched to ECHP respondents via CPR number; entered as ln(own wage) together with a Mundlak term (individual mean wage over waves); summary statistics in 1994 DKK real terms.
    登记库： IDA, ECHP
    工作论文 · Section 3.1-3.2; Appendix Table B1
  • Co-worker (establishment) wage 企业特征与生产率
    Average wage of all other employees at the same establishment (IDA establishment identifier); alternatives are the 75th (and 90th) percentile of the establishment wage distribution and mean wage by three occupation categories (managers, middle-ranking, lower-level). Sample restricted to establishments with at least 5 colleagues (robustness 4 and 6).
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1-3.2; Section 4 (Tables 3-4); footnotes 7, 11, 12
  • Wage surplus / wage deficit 劳动收入与收入
    Following Ferrer-i-Carbonell (2005): if own wage > establishment average wage, wage surplus = ln(own) - ln(average) and deficit = 0; if own < average, wage deficit = ln(average) - ln(own) and surplus = 0; both zero if equal.
    登记库： IDA

Anna Piil Damm · Journal of Labor Economics, 2009 · 个人

利用 1986 至 1998 年间难民在丹麦各市镇的准随机分散安置，将居住在族裔聚居区的效应与自我选择区分开来。聚居区规模越大，难民男性的年劳动收入越高，而就业率不变；在同胞就业者更多的地方收益更大，这指向求职信息网络的作用。

  • 结果变量：就业概率
  • 结果变量：实际年劳动收入
  • 核心解释变量：所在市镇的族裔聚居区（同国籍群体）规模
  • 工具变量／识别：1986–1998 年空间分散安置政策下的初始分配市镇
  • 控制变量：性别、年龄、婚姻状况、子女、教育、来源国、移民年份
时期
登记库为 1984–2000 年；难民移民入境队列为 1986–1993 年
样本
13,927 人（平衡面板，移民后七年内逐年观测） 来自 11 个主要难民来源国、在分散安置政策下被分配到丹麦各市镇的成年难民，从获得居留许可起逐年观测至七年后。 来源
调查
Foreign-education survey
变量如何定义（9）
  • Employment 就业与劳动力状态
    Based on labour market status in November of each year: employed if main occupation is wage-employment with at least 9 hours of weekly work, or self-employment (includes part-time of at least 9 weekly hours and full-time). Outcome measured seven years after immigration.
    登记库： Immigrant population registers (Statistics Denmark), RAS
    工作论文 · Section III.D
  • Real annual earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Sum of wage earnings, profits from own company and sickness benefits, deflated by the consumer price index (base year 1980); analysed for refugees with positive earnings seven years after immigration.
    登记库： Income register (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section III.D; Table I notes
  • Ethnic group (enclave) size 移民身份与来源地
    Number of first- and second-generation immigrants (immigrants and descendants) from individual i's source country living in i's municipality of residence; ethnicity proxied by country of origin.
    登记库： BEF (100 per cent sample of immigrants)
    工作论文 · Section III.B (p. 13); Table A.I Part B
  • Refugee sample identification 移民身份与来源地
    Individuals from 11 main refugee-sending countries extracted by an algorithm based on country of origin and first year of residence permit (built from official asylum permit counts), immigrating under the 1986-1998 dispersal policy, aged 18-59, observed annually up to seven years after immigration (balanced panel of 13,927). Excludes those married at immigration to a Dane, an immigrant from a non-refugee-sending country, or an immigrant from a refugee-sending country who immigrated at least one year earlier (family reunification).
    登记库： Immigrant population registers (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section III.D and footnote 12
  • Municipality of assignment 地理与社区
    The first municipality of residence observed in the registers is classified as temporary housing if the person relocates to another municipality within the same county within one year after receipt of the first residence permit; otherwise the first municipality is the municipality of assignment (algorithm based on the Danish Refugee Council's statistics on temporary housing).
    登记库： BEF, Danish Refugee Council administrative statistics
    工作论文 · Section III.D
  • Instrument: number of placed co-nationals 移民身份与来源地
    Number of immigrants from the individual's source country placed by the authorities in the individual's municipality of assignment in year t, for t = -7, ..., 0 (0 = year of immigration), i.e. initial and past inflows of placed co-nationals.
    登记库： BEF (100 per cent sample of immigrants)
    工作论文 · Table A.I Part B
  • Education attained (pre-immigration) 教育与考试成绩
    Dummies from the education code of highest degree attained: no degree = 0-9 years, high school = 10-12 years, professional = 13+ years, plus unknown education.
    登记库： Survey-based register on immigrants' pre-immigration education, Integrated pupil register
    工作论文 · Table A.I Part A
  • Local unemployment rate 失业与福利金
    Unemployment rate within a radius of DKK 60 (approx. USD 10) of transport cost around the largest post office in the municipality, constructed by Local Government Studies.
    登记库： Unemployment register (Statistics Denmark), Ministry of Transport cost statistics
    工作论文 · Table A.I Part B
  • Municipality characteristics (right-wing votes, county jobs, social housing) 地理与社区
    % right-wing votes: Liberal plus Conservative votes as a share of Liberal, Conservative, Social Democratic and Socialist People's Party votes at the latest municipal election; % county jobs: persons employed in the municipality as a share of county employment; % social housing: social housing dwellings for all-year residence as a share of all such dwellings.
    登记库： Election statistics, RAS, Buildings and housing statistics
    工作论文 · Table A.I Part B

How to Help Unemployed Find Jobs Quickly: Experimental Evidence from a Mandatory Activation Program

Brian Krogh Graversen and Jan C. van Ours · Journal of Public Economics, 2008 · 个人

丹麦两个郡的一项随机实验把新近失业者分配到一个强化激活项目中，内容包括早期求职课程、频繁会谈和强制激活。处理组找到工作的速度明显更快，其中强制激活的威胁是这一效应的重要组成部分。

数据
Public Employment Service (PES) administrative registers (treatment status, demographics, meetings with caseworkers), DREAM weekly register of public income transfers (Danish National Labour Market Authority)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：以周计的失业持续时间/找到工作的比率
  • 处理：按出生日期（每月 1–15 日出生）随机分配到强制激活项目
  • 机制：与个案工作者会谈、求职项目、培训项目
  • 退出状态：就业、其他福利、右删失
时期
2005 年 11 月至 2006 年 9 月中旬
样本
4,520 段失业期（处理组 2,229 段，对照组 2,291 段） 2005 年 11 月至 2006 年 2 月间在 Storstrøm 郡和南日德兰（South Jutland）郡的公共就业服务机构（PES）登记的新近失业的失业保险金领取者，仅取第一段失业期。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Unemployment spell duration 失业与福利金
    From weekly DREAM transfer data: the spell starts in the week the person became unemployed and continues until the person has not received UI benefits (or participated in ALMPs) for four consecutive weeks; switching to sickness benefits counts as still unemployed. Only the first spell is used; data run to mid-September 2006, so spells are censored after 26-43 weeks depending on assignment week.
    登记库： DREAM, PES registers
    工作论文 · Section 2.3 'Available data' and footnote 11
  • Exit to employment and other exit states 失业与福利金
    A worker is assumed to find a job as soon as he or she no longer receives benefit payments (after the 4-week rule); other exit states (e.g. early retirement pay, other benefits) and right-censoring are distinguished using the DREAM event history.
    登记库： DREAM
    工作论文 · Section 2.3 footnote 11; Appendix A Table A2
  • Random assignment by birth date 样本界定与时间
    Newly unemployed UI benefit recipients (clean seniority record, i.e. eligible for the full 4-year UI period) registering at the PES in Storstrom and South Jutland counties between week 43 of 2005 and week 8 of 2006 and still unemployed on the Friday of the registration week; treatment if born on the 1st-15th of a month, control if born on the 16th or later. Bad-weather and work-sharing unemployment excluded.
    登记库： PES registers, CPR
    工作论文 · Section 2.2 and Appendix A
  • Net analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    From 5,180 assigned: drop 27 incorrectly assigned by birth date, 43 bad-weather/work-sharing cases, 37 who died or moved abroad, and 553 who did not receive UI benefits within 6 weeks of PES registration, leaving 4,520 (2,229 treatment, 2,291 control).
    登记库： PES registers, DREAM
    工作论文 · Appendix A, Table A1
  • Treatment programme components (meetings, job search and training programmes) 失业与福利金
    Meetings with caseworkers (type and date, from PES registers, including private contractors); job search programmes (2-week courses); training programmes grouping short work experience (up to 4 weeks), employment subsidy and training/education programmes.
    登记库： PES registers
    工作论文 · Sections 2.3-2.4
  • Previous occupation 职业与职位层级
    Occupational classification based on the name of the UI fund that pays the individual's UI benefits.
    登记库： PES registers
    工作论文 · Section 2.3, footnote 9

Inside the Family Firm: The Role of Families in Succession Decisions and Performance

Morten Bennedsen, Kasper Meisner Nielsen, Francisco Pérez-González and Daniel Wolfenzon · Quarterly Journal of Economics, 2007 · 个人 + 企业

以离任 CEO 头胎子女的性别作为丹麦企业家族继任的工具变量。家族 CEO 损害企业绩效：与聘用外部 CEO 的企业相比，营业利润率至少下降 4 个百分点，在高增长行业和大企业中代价最大。

数据
Købmandsstandens Oplysningsbureau (KOB) firm financial and management data (private, from annual reports), Danish Civil Registration System (CPR) with family links, Danish Commerce and Companies Agency (Erhvervs- og Selskabsstyrelsen) management/board records with CPR numbers, Industry-level data from Statistics Denmark and OECD STAN
关键变量
  • 结果变量：CEO 更替前后的营业资产回报率（OROA）
  • 处理：家族 CEO 继任（新任 CEO 有血缘或姻亲关系）
  • 工具变量：离任 CEO 头胎子女的性别
  • 异质性：行业增长、技能密集度和企业规模
时期
1994–2002 年（管理层数据）；财务数据为 1991–2003 年
样本
5,334 次继任 1994 至 2002 年间丹麦有限责任公司（包括公众公司和私人公司）的 CEO 继任，每家企业只取第一次更替。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Operating return on assets (OROA) 企业特征与生产率
    Ratio of earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) to the book value of assets, from annual reports of limited liability firms (KOB). Performance change is the three-year average after succession minus the three-year average before, omitting the succession year.
    登记库： KOB
    工作论文 · Section II.B; footnote 13; Table IV notes
  • Industry-adjusted OROA 企业特征与生产率
    OROA minus the equally weighted average OROA of all active firms (including non-event firms) in the same industry and year; four-digit NACE industries are used if they contain at least 20 non-event firms in a year, otherwise three- or two-digit groupings.
    登记库： KOB
    代码： NACE 4-digit, falling back to 3- or 2-digit; minimum 20 non-event firms
    工作论文 · Section II.B
  • Industry-and-performance-adjusted OROA 企业特征与生产率
    OROA adjusted using as control firms in the same industry and the same industry-adjusted performance decile in the year before succession (Barber and Lyon, 1996).
    登记库： KOB
    工作论文 · Section IV.A
  • Family CEO succession 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator equal to one if the incoming CEO is related by blood or marriage to the departing CEO according to family trees built from the Civil Registration System (parents, siblings, children, marital history), zero otherwise; family successions split into children and other relatives.
    登记库： CPR, Erhvervs- og Selskabsstyrelsen (ES) management records
    工作论文 · Section II.A, II.C; equation (2)
  • Gender of firstborn child (instrument) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator equal to one if the departing CEO's first child is male and zero if female; used as an instrument for family succession in a linear first stage.
    登记库： CPR
    工作论文 · Section III, equation (2)
  • CEO succession sample 样本界定与时间
    CEO successions 1994-2002 in Danish limited liability firms, kept when the departing (incoming) CEO had been (stayed) in the position at least two years, CEO names were matched to CPR numbers via the ES dataset, matching KOB financial data existed around the transition and employment (where available) was non-zero; only the first transition per firm is kept (5,334 successions).
    登记库： KOB, ES, CPR
    工作论文 · Section II.A
  • Industry heterogeneity measures 部门与行业
    Sample split at the median of industry production growth, output volatility (value of production), labour compensation per employee and import penetration (Statistics Denmark), workers' schooling (authors' calculation from individual schooling and industry of employment), and R&D (industries reporting R&D expenses in OECD STAN).
    登记库： Statistics Denmark industry statistics, OECD STAN
    工作论文 · Section V, footnote 11
  • Return on capital employed and net income to assets 企业特征与生产率
    ROCE is operating income divided by book equity plus book debt; net income to assets is after-tax profits over book value of assets; assets measured as log assets in 2000 DKK.
    登记库： KOB
    工作论文 · Section II.B; footnote 13

Paul Bingley and Gauthier Lanot · Journal of Public Economics, 2007 · 个人

在丹麦夫妇的 1% 登记样本上估计一个关于夫妇共同退休与储蓄的动态离散选择模型，以提前退休计划（efterløn）的引入及其历次改革作为识别来源。男性和女性的退休对本人及配偶收入流的反应并不对称。

  • 识别变异：由公共财政出资的提前退休计划（efterløn）的引入及其后的历次改革
  • 解释变量：本人和配偶的收入流
  • 模型：含储蓄的动态离散选择模型
时期
所查资料中未注明
样本
所查资料中未注明 处于可能退休年龄的丹麦已婚夫妇的 1% 登记样本。 来源（摘要）

Are Homeowners Really More Unemployed?

Jakob Roland Munch, Michael Rosholm and Michael Svarer · Economic Journal, 2006 · 个人

检验 Oswald 假说，即住房自有会提高失业。丹麦的自有住房者地域流动性较低，但他们在本地找到工作的速度更快，因此总体上失业持续期更短。住房自有并不会提高总体失业。

数据
Administrative register data on unemployment spells for a 2.5% random sample of the Danish population, Regional unemployment measure from the Institute for Local Government Studies (1987–2000)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：失业持续时间（周）
  • 结果变量：退出去向（在本地找到新工作、在另一通勤区就业、其他状态）
  • 关键解释变量：是否自有住房的指示变量
  • 控制变量：年龄、性别、子女、家庭类型、移民身份、教育、失业保险基金成员身份及替代率
时期
1997–2000
样本
18,992 人，共 52,738 段失业期 丹麦人口 2.5% 随机样本中 19–66 岁个人在 1997–2000 年全部失业期的流量样本。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Unemployment spell inflow sample 样本界定与时间
    Flow sample of all unemployment spells in 1997-2000 for individuals in a 2.5% random sample of the Danish population, restricted to inflow into unemployment of workers aged 19-66; spell duration measured in weeks (18,992 persons, 52,738 spells).
    登记库： Administrative registers (2.5% random population sample)
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Data and the Danish labour and housing markets), pp. 9-10
  • Exit destination 失业与福利金
    Destination after an unemployment spell: new job in the local labour market, new job in another commuting area, or other states than employment and unemployment. A worker is geographically mobile if he or she gets a job and moves to another commuting area up to 8 weeks before and 52 weeks after the start of the job spell (exact moving dates known).
    登记库： Administrative registers
    工作论文 · Section 3, p. 9
  • Commuting areas (local labour markets) 地理与社区
    Local labour markets are commuting areas built from geographically connected municipalities such that the internal migration rate is 50% higher than the external migration rate (Andersen 2000); the 275 municipalities are merged into 51 commuting areas.
    登记库： Administrative registers
    工作论文 · Section 3, p. 9
  • Regional unemployment rate 地理与社区
    Measure constructed by the Institute for Local Government Studies (AKF): unemployment rate in an area around each municipality, defined by how far a resident can commute without a daily commuting cost exceeding DKK 60 (1987 prices); available 1987-2000.
    登记库： Institute for Local Government Studies regional unemployment data
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, p. 10
  • Home ownership 财富、负债与消费
    Indicator for being a home owner (living in owner-occupied housing) versus renting (private rental, social or cooperative housing).
    登记库： Administrative registers
    工作论文 · Section 2-3, pp. 8-10
  • UI fund membership and replacement rate 失业与福利金
    Indicator for membership of an unemployment insurance fund and, for members, the UI replacement rate; other controls are age, gender, number of dependent children aged 0-17, two-adult household, immigrant from a non-OECD country, municipality size and education.
    登记库： Administrative registers
    工作论文 · Section 3, p. 10

Lars Pico Geerdsen · Economic Journal, 2006 · 个人

利用丹麦失业保险制度中强制激活的时间规则，检验即将被激活这一前景是否会加快失业者退出失业。随着激活期限临近，退出率明显上升，由此识别出积极劳动力市场项目具有相当可观的威胁效应。

数据
Danish UI system administrative data (not specified in abstract)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：在参加项目之前由失业转入就业
  • 识别：强制激活之前失业保险金领取期长度的立法变动
  • 处理：强制参加 ALMP 的日期临近（威胁效应）
时期
所查资料中未注明
样本
所查资料中未注明 丹麦领取失业保险金、在领取期结束后须强制参加劳动力市场项目的失业者。 来源（摘要）
变量如何定义（5）
  • UI spell 失业与福利金
    Unemployment spell = at least 15 days of unemployment within a given month; a spell is broken if the individual receives no UI for more than 2 weeks in a month or regains the right to a new UI period mid-spell. Exit is any departure from UI (employment, leave, social benefits, early retirement, disability pension, education) in the thesis version. UI days per month come from SSHS, built from CRAM (unemployment fund records).
    登记库： SSHS, CRAM
    工作论文 · PhD thesis (SFI 2003), Paper II, Sections 5.1-5.2, pp. 113-116
  • Activation participation 失业与福利金
    Days in activation per month after 1994 from the Register on Labour Market Measures (AMFORA), based on the Labour Market Agency's Labour Market Policy Register (AMPO) reports of activation start and end; before 1994 from the Job Offer Data Set (ATB), 1980-1994.
    登记库： AMFORA, AMPO, ATB
    工作论文 · PhD thesis (SFI 2003), Paper II, Section 5.1, pp. 113-114
  • Time remaining to activation period 失业与福利金
    Months of passive UI left before the compulsory activation period, constructed by replicating the 1994 departmental order that placed each unemployed person in the new UI system (entitlement depends on prior activation, UI use and employment before 1994). Passive period cut from 4 years (1994) to 3 years (July 1996) to 2 years (January 1998); three expectation models (perfect foresight, system foresight, no foresight) for how individuals perceive the remaining months.
    登记库： CRAM, SSHS, AMFORA, IDA
    工作论文 · PhD thesis (SFI 2003), Paper II, Sections 2.2, 4.1, 5.2 and Appendix A
  • Monthly employment 就业与劳动力状态
    IDA gives employment status in November and the number of months employed in the year; monthly employment is located in the residual months not covered by other monthly/weekly states (leave schemes, UI, activation, early retirement, social benefits).
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · PhD thesis (SFI 2003), Paper II, Section 5.1, p. 114
  • Analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    10% sample of the Danish population aged 17-67, panel 1980-1998, topped up each year with 10% of new 17-year-olds and immigrants; leavers at age 68, emigration or death drop out. Restricted to UI spells beginning between January 1994 and January 1998.
    登记库： IDA, CPR
    工作论文 · PhD thesis (SFI 2003), Paper II, Section 5.2, pp. 114-115

Bent Jesper Christensen, Rasmus Lentz, Dale T. Mortensen, George R. Neumann and Axel Werwatz · Journal of Labor Economics, 2005 · 个人 + 企业

利用丹麦劳动力市场研究综合数据库（Integrated Database for Labour Market Research）估计一个在职搜寻模型，将每家企业的离职率分解为外生部分和随企业工资上升而下降的工作间转换部分。工资越高，工人的搜寻强度越低；估计出的模型能够解释实际所得工资分布与工资报价分布之间的差距。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), matched employer-employee data
关键变量
  • 结果变量：按工作场所统计的离职（一年后的留任者）

  • 以从非就业状态招入的人数加权的工资报价分布
  • 以工作场所就业人数加权的实际所得工资分布
  • 按职业划分的子样本：技术工人、非技术工人、管理人员、受薪职员
时期
1994 年 11 月–1995 年 11 月
样本
113,332 个私营部门工作场所 丹麦私营部门的全部工作场所，工人年龄为 18–65 岁，按职业类别划分。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Stayers (job separations) 样本界定与时间
    For each establishment, the number of employees in November 1994 and the number of 'stayers', defined as workers who were employees both initially (November 1994) and in the following November (1995); separations are modelled as stayers out of initial employment.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1 (p. 8)
  • Establishment average hourly wage 企业特征与生产率
    For each private-sector establishment and occupational sub-sample, the average of the Statistics Denmark estimate of the hourly wage of each worker of that occupational type employed during November 1994 to November 1995, in 1994 DKK; only workers aged 18-65 included, and wage rates below 69 DKK per hour (taken as the effective legal minimum wage) and in the top 1 percent are excluded from the average (but such workers are kept in employment and stayer counts).
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.2 and Table 1 (pp. 9-10)
  • Wage offer distribution F 劳动收入与收入
    Distribution of establishment average hourly wages, each weighted by the fraction of all non-employed workers hired by the establishment during the year (only hires from non-employment are used, to avoid selection among job-to-job movers).
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1-3.2 (pp. 8-10)
  • Wage earned distribution G 劳动收入与收入
    Distribution of the same establishment average hourly wages weighted by the establishment's relative employment size in November 1994.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.2 (p. 10)
  • Occupational sub-samples 职业与职位层级
    Pooled private-sector establishment sample partitioned by worker occupation into skilled and unskilled workers ('blue collar') and managers and salaried workers ('white collar'); distributions and counts are built separately per sub-sample.

    工作论文 · Section 3.2 (p. 9)
  • Private sector establishments 部门与行业
    All establishments in the Danish private sector are included (overall 'private sector sample', 113,332 establishments).
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.2 and Table 1

Rent Control and Unemployment Duration

Michael Svarer, Michael Rosholm and Jakob Roland Munch · Journal of Public Economics, 2005 · 个人

利用丹麦关于失业期和住房的登记数据，研究居住在租金管制住房中是否影响找到工作。住在租金管制住房中的失业者脱离失业的比率较低，这与租金管制降低地域流动性的看法一致。

数据
10% random sample of the Danish adult population from administrative registers (Statistics Denmark), Housing unit characteristics for dwellings occupied by the sample, Weekly labour market event histories, Danish Tax Authorities 1999 hedonic model for owner-occupied housing (to predict uncontrolled rent)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：以周计的失业持续时间（在本地或全国劳动力市场找到工作而退出失业）
  • 解释变量：租金管制收益的十分位（预测的无管制租金减去实际租金），随时间变化
  • 流动性：找到工作并迁往 51 个通勤区中的另一个
  • 住房保有类型：私人租赁住房与其他
时期
1997–2000
样本
14,645 人，共 31,966 段失业期 取自丹麦成年人口 10% 随机样本的 1997–2000 年失业期流入样本（IZA DP 842 工作论文版本）。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Unemployment duration and exit destination 失业与福利金
    Flow sample of unemployment spells starting 1997-2000, from weekly labour-market event histories; duration measured in weeks, with destination employment recorded. Temporary layoffs (return to the previous employer, about 40% of spells) are treated as right-censored, as are exits to states outside the labour market.
    登记库： 10% sample of Danish adult population (Statistics Denmark registers)
    工作论文 · Section 4.1 'Unemployment spells and geographical mobility'
  • Local labour market (commuting area) 地理与社区
    Local labour markets are groups of municipalities between which the internal migration rate is 50% higher than the external migration rate (Andersen 2000), giving 51 commuting areas in Denmark.
    登记库： Population registers
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Geographically mobile job finding 地理与社区
    An unemployed worker is geographically mobile if he or she gets a job and moves to another commuting area within the window from 8 weeks before to 52 weeks after the start of the job spell; otherwise a job exit is local.
    登记库： Population registers, Weekly event histories
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Rent control benefit and decile of rent control degree 财富、负债与消费
    Rent control benefit = predicted uncontrolled rent minus actual rent; uncontrolled rent from the Danish Tax Authorities' 1999 hedonic model for owner-occupied housing (sales 1996-1999, dwelling traits, more than 50,000 geographic areas) times an estimate of user cost; missing actual rents (about 50% of units) imputed by Heckman two-step. The regressor is the decile of the rent control degree (benefit / uncontrolled rent), using 1999 decile limits applied to 1997, 1998 and 2000; time-varying across housing units via moving dates.
    登记库： Housing unit characteristics (Statistics Denmark), DTA 1999 hedonic model
    工作论文 · Section 4.2 'The rent control benefit'
  • Replacement rate 失业与福利金
    Ratio of UI benefits received to the most recent wage.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark registers
    工作论文 · Section 4.3 'Explanatory variables'
  • Private rental housing tenure 地理与社区
    Housing market split into owner-occupied (51%), co-operative (6%), public rental (19%) and private rental (18%); analysis concerns private rental units, where rents are regulated except in dwellings built after 1991.
    登记库： Housing unit characteristics (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 3 'The Danish private rental housing market'

Job Creation and Job Destruction, Worker Reallocation, and Wages

Christian Belzil · Journal of Labor Economics, 2000 · 个人 + 企业

考察工人在正在创造就业岗位或人员流动频繁的企业中是否挣得更多。作者在丹麦企业—工人匹配数据上用固定效应估计个人工资方程，并在其中加入企业层面的净就业创造和工人再配置指标。净就业创造在经济周期的各个阶段都会提高男性工资，对入职工资和任职年限较短的工人作用最强；女性工资除入职工资外则没有反应。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Statistics Denmark: November employment of firms/workplaces linked to register records on all their employees (named in the 1996 working-paper version, EUI ECO 96/17; the published abstract only says 'Danish firm (workplace) data ... merged with individual records')
关键变量
  • 处理：企业的净就业创造/就业破坏率
  • 处理：企业的工人（总就业）再配置率，即新进人员加离职人员相对于企业规模的比例
  • 结果变量：个人对数小时工资，包括入职工资
  • 控制变量：个人固定效应、年龄、工作经验、教育、企业规模、经济周期（年份）效应
  • 异质性：男性与女性、任职年限、经济周期阶段
时期
据 1996 年工作论文版本为 1980–1991 年（发表版摘要中未说明）
样本
所查资料中未注明 受雇于一个丹麦企业（工作场所）样本的男女工人，企业的雇佣史与工人的个人记录相合并。 来源（摘要）
变量如何定义（5）
  • IDA firm sample and worker restrictions (1996 working-paper version) 样本界定与时间
    Sample extracted from IDA, which covers the entire population of Danish firms and workers with annual observations from 1980. Initially 1000 private-sector firms were selected randomly in 1980, representative in terms of industry, sector and region, and followed until 1991; as firms disappear new firms are added so that the number of firms always exceeds 1000; agriculture and mining are excluded. Workers are restricted to full-time workers, to wage observations with the maximum value of Statistics Denmark's wage quality index, and to individuals aged 16 or less in 1964 (at most 46 years old in 1991) because the experience measure is less reliable before 1964.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： 1000 private firms sampled in 1980; panel 1980-1991; full-time only; maximum wage-quality index; age <= 16 in 1964
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1-3.2 of EUI Working Paper ECO 96/17 ('Employment Reallocation, Wages and the Allocation of Workers Between Expanding and Declining Firms'), an earlier version of the article under a different title
  • Net job creation rate 企业特征与生产率
    Job creation for firm j in year t is the change in firm employment between t-1 and t divided by firm size, X_jt = (E_jt - E_jt-1) / S_jt. Total employment in each firm is computed from the number of primary job holders in November of each year.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： X_jt = (E_jt - E_jt-1) / S_jt; employment measured in November
    工作论文 · Section 4.1, eq. (3), and Appendix 1 comments of EUI Working Paper ECO 96/17 (earlier version under a different title)
  • Gross employment (worker) reallocation rate 企业特征与生产率
    Sum of all newcomers (workers with no attachment to the current firm in the previous year) and all leavers (workers with no attachment to the firm in the following year) divided by firm size, (N_jt + M_jt) / S_jt. Because IDA does not record the cause of separation, this turnover measure is treated as an upper bound for gross employment reallocation.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： (N_jt + M_jt) / S_jt
    工作论文 · Section 2 and Section 4.1, eq. (4), of EUI Working Paper ECO 96/17 (earlier version under a different title)
  • Real hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Individual hourly wage rate from IDA, in Danish kroner per hour, measured in November of each year; the dependent variable is the log real hourly wage. Only observations with the maximum value of the wage quality index imputed by Statistics Denmark are used.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1-3.2, eq. (1), and Appendix 1 comments of EUI Working Paper ECO 96/17 (earlier version under a different title)
  • Labour market experience 就业与劳动力状态
    Total cumulated experience reported in IDA, measured as the sum of all employment periods since entering the labour force (actual rather than potential experience), which allows age and experience effects to be separately identified. The measure is less reliable for workers employed before 1964.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 2 and Section 3.2 of EUI Working Paper ECO 96/17 (earlier version under a different title)

Worker Flows and Job Flows in Danish Manufacturing, 1980–91

Karsten Albæk and Bent E. Sørensen · Economic Journal, 1998 · 个人 + 企业

最早使用 IDA 雇主—雇员匹配数据的研究之一，度量丹麦制造业各工厂的岗位创造、岗位消失和工人流动。工人流转远远超过岗位再配置，两者在工厂层面都规模很大且具有持续性。

数据
Plant-level data on all Danish manufacturing plants and their workers (register not named in abstract)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：工人流动（雇佣与离职）
  • 结果变量：岗位流动（岗位创造与岗位消失）
  • 替补性雇佣（现有岗位上的离职与补入）
  • 经济周期变动
时期
1980–1991
样本
所查资料中未注明 1980–91 年丹麦的全部单个制造业工厂。 来源（摘要）

贸易与离岸外包

企业层面分产品的进出口数据，与企业内部员工的工资相连。

Multiproduct Firms, Horizontal Mergers, and International Trade

Jackie M.L. Chan, Michael Irlacher and Michael Koch · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2025 · 企业

研究横向并购如何改变多产品企业的产品组合。并购根据丹麦登记库中机构（establishment）所有权的变动来识别，并围绕并购年份做事件研究，以从未并购的企业和匹配的合成并购作为对照。并购后的企业在国内销售的产品比收购方与目标方原先合计少约 30%，销售向核心产品集中，并向更多目的地出口更多产品；一个寡头多产品企业之间并购的模型可以解释这一规律。

数据
IDAS establishment register (establishment and firm identifiers, used to identify mergers), FIRM firm-level register (general firm information, NACE Rev. 2 industry codes), VARS, the Danish version of the PRODCOM production survey (product sales at CN 10-digit level, aggregated to 8-digit), UHDI foreign trade register (exports by product and destination), IDAN and BEF individual-level registers (number of employees aged 18–65)
关键变量
  • 处理：横向并购事件（收购方取得同一 4 位数行业中目标方的全部所有权）
  • 结果变量：国内产品数量（CN 8 位数），分别就收购方以及收购方与目标方合计计算
  • 结果变量：国内销售在各产品间的偏斜程度（Theil 指数）；销售额最高、居中和最低产品的销售额
  • 结果变量：出口目的地数量、出口产品数量以及每个目的地的产品数量
  • 结果变量：出口目的地的距离排名和进口成本排名
  • 对照组：从未并购的企业；匹配的合成并购
时期
1996–2015
样本
识别出 4,580 起横向并购交易；估计样本中，国内结果变量为 139 个并购事件（160 起交易），出口结果变量为 492 个并购事件（574 起交易）；基准回归中 N = 21,843 和 67,120 个观测值（第 2.2 节和第 4.2 节，图 2 和图 3） 1996–2015 年丹麦私营行业的企业：国内横向并购（收购方与目标方属于同一 4 位数行业）中的收购方，加上从未并购的对照企业；国内产品结果变量涵盖雇员不少于 10 人的制造业企业，出口结果变量涵盖雇员不少于 5 人的企业。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Merger (change of establishment ownership) 企业特征与生产率
    Following Smeets et al. (2016): the establishment register IDAS has an establishment identifier that stays fixed under ownership changes and gives the establishment's firm identifier in the current and following year. A change in the firm identifier to that of an existing firm is classified as a change of ownership and hence a merger. The acquirer is the firm identifier used after the merger; the target is the identifier observed before the merger that then disappears. Partial acquisitions (13.9% of deals), joint mergers that form a new firm identifier, and spurious identifier changes are excluded, giving 8,344 merger deals for 1996-2015.
    登记库： IDAS
    工作论文 · Sections 2.1-2.2, footnotes 6-7
  • Horizontal merger 部门与行业
    Deals in which the acquirer and target operate within the same 4-digit industry (NACE Rev. 2 classification from FIRM, private industries only). Roughly 55% (4,580) of the mergers identified over the sample period are horizontal by this definition.
    登记库： FIRM
    代码： Same 4-digit NACE Rev. 2 industry
    工作论文 · Sections 2.1-2.2
  • Domestic sales by product 贸易与离岸外包
    Total product sales from VARS (the Danish version of PRODCOM) are aggregated from the Combined Nomenclature 10-digit to the 8-digit level to match the trade data; domestic sales are total sales in VARS minus exports in UHDI at the product level. For a small fraction of product-year observations exports exceed total sales, because export values may include traded goods while VARS excludes goods for resale; products with negative domestic sales are dropped in the baseline. VARS covers firms with 10 or more employees in manufacturing and raw material extraction; the trade data cover all industries without a size limit.
    登记库： VARS, UHDI
    代码： CN 8-digit products; VARS firms with 10 or more employees
    工作论文 · Section 2.1, footnote 8
  • Event window and estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Event window of seven years: the pre-merger period is the four years before and including the merger year and the post-merger period the three years after; more distant years are binned. A merger event may comprise several deals in a calendar year, at least one of them horizontal. Regressions on domestic sales from VARS require 10 or more employees and export regressions 5 or more, with the number of employees aged 18 to 65 computed from IDAN and BEF. Acquirers with multiple horizontal merger events, and mergers within seven years of another deal by the same acquirer, are excluded.
    登记库： IDAN, BEF, VARS, UHDI
    代码： Employees >= 10 (VARS sample) or >= 5 (export sample); 139 merger events (160 deals) domestic, 492 merger events (574 deals) export
    工作论文 · Sections 4.1-4.2, footnote 16
  • Skewness of sales across products 企业特征与生产率
    Skewness is used as an index of inequality in the distribution of product sales, not in its statistical sense of asymmetry; it is measured by the Theil index of the market shares of the firm's different products.
    登记库： VARS, UHDI
    工作论文 · Section 4.2, footnote 15

Do Export Support Programs Affect Prices, Quality, Markups, and Marginal Costs? Evidence From a Natural Policy Experiment

Magnus T. Buus, Jakob R. Munch, Joel Rodrigue and Georg Schaur · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2025 · 企业

利用丹麦贸易委员会（Danish Trade Council）向企业提供出口支持过程中的一个准自然实验。出口支持提高了企业在目的地市场内的出口，但价格、质量、加成率和边际成本均未改变，这与企业靠移动需求而非改变产品来实现海外增长的解释相一致。

数据
Trade Council export promotion records: firm purchases and Trade Council approaches by destination, International Trade in Goods statistics: Intrastat and Extrastat firm exports by CN8 product and destination (UHDI), Manufacturers' Sales of Goods (VARES/Prodcom): firm sales by product, value and quantity, Firm Statistics Register (FirmStat) and Firm Accounts Statistics (FIRE)
关键变量
  • 处理：在 t 年或 t-1 年为某一目的地购买出口促进服务
  • 工具变量：Trade Council 是否主动接洽该企业
  • 结果变量：企业—产品—目的地层面的出口销售额
  • 结果变量：出口单位价值（价格）、质量、加成率和边际成本
时期
2002–2015
样本
18,181 个企业—年份（Prodcom 数据中的制造业出口企业，77 个目的地） 2002–2015 年出现在生产数据中、至少有 10 名雇员、向 Trade Council 所服务的 77 个目的地出口的丹麦制造业出口企业。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Export support treatment 贸易与离岸外包
    Dummy equal to 1 if the firm purchased an export promotion service from the Danish Trade Council for a given destination (or, at firm level, any destination) in year t or year t-1; multiple purchases within a year are not distinguished (collapsed with max). Trade Council records restricted to 2002-2015 with non-missing destination.
    登记库： Trade Council export promotion records (promodata.dta)
    代码： treated=1 for all promodata cases, 0 for turned-down cases (tdc.dta); treated_2 = (treated_1==1 | L.treated_1==1)
    复制代码 · BMRS_restat/4_reg_variables/code/4_4_promotion.do; 1_data/code/1_5_promotion.do; 2_prepare/code/2_2_variables.do
  • Trade Council initiative (instrument) 贸易与离岸外包
    Dummy equal to 1 if the firm was contacted (approached) by the Trade Council for a destination, defined over both purchased cases and turned-down cases where contact was established but no support was bought; used as of year t or t-1 like the treatment.
    登记库： Trade Council export promotion records (promodata.dta, tdc.dta)
    代码： tdcinitiative=1 if firm contacted by the TC; tdcinitiative_2 = (tdcinitiative_1==1 | L.tdcinitiative_1==1)
    复制代码 · BMRS_restat/1_data/code/1_5_promotion.do; 4_reg_variables/code/4_4_promotion.do
  • Firm-product-destination exports and quantity 贸易与离岸外包
    Export value (1000 DKK) by firm, CN8+ product, destination and year from the trade-in-goods statistics, exports only. Quantity is weight in kg unless the supplementary unit is not kg, is unique within the product, and the value of observations with non-missing amounts is at least that with non-missing weights, in which case the supplementary amount is used; observations with zero/missing value or quantity are dropped. A variant keeps only flows above 7.5 (1000 DKK).
    登记库： UHDI
    代码： ie=="2" (exports); value vrd, weight vgt, amount mgd, unit enhedskode ("00" = kg); vrd_exp_exsmall if vrd_exp>7.5
    复制代码 · BMRS_restat/1_data/code/1_3_export_import.do; 4_reg_variables/code/4_3_export.do
  • Product classification (CN8+) 贸易与离岸外包
    CN8 product codes are made consistent over 2002-2015 by aggregating to CN8+ categories using the Van Beveren et al. (2012) algorithm; each CN8+ code is assigned the CN6 category with the largest Prodcom sales value.
    登记库： UHDI, VARS
    代码： cn8_cn8plus_2002_2015 concordance; Prodcom vnr>100, cn8=floor(varenr/100)
    复制代码 · Readme.pdf section 1; 2_prepare/code/2_1_clean.do
  • Firm-year estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Firm-years present in the Prodcom (manufacturers' sales) data from 2002, matched to FIRM and FIRE, in manufacturing with at least 10 employees year by year (employees >= 9.5), observed in FIRM in the previous year, and with positive sales, wage bill, capital and material expenditures.
    登记库： VARS, FIRM, FIRE
    代码： FIRM gf_gr019_db07 (nace1)=="C"; gf_aarsv (employees)>=9.5
    复制代码 · BMRS_restat/4_reg_variables/code/4_1_samples.do; 2_prepare/code/2_2_variables.do
  • Capital, materials and wage bill inputs 企业特征与生产率
    Capital is the sum of FIRE balance-sheet asset items, deflated by the gross fixed capital formation index (NABK69) by 69-industry; material expenditures are krh (2001-2003) or krhe+kvv (2004 onward), deflated by the intermediate consumption index (NABP69); the wage bill (lgag) is deflated by the CPI (PRIS112). Firm-level inputs and sales are multiplied by the share of Prodcom sales value with non-missing quantity.
    登记库： FIRE, FIRM, VARS
    代码： capital = iaat+grby+atam+fmaa+aadi; expenditures = krh (<=2003), krhe+kvv (>=2004); wagebill = lgag; sales = FIRM gf_oms
    复制代码 · BMRS_restat/1_data/code/1_2_fire.do; 2_prepare/code/2_2_variables.do
  • Prodcom product sales and quantities 企业特征与生产率
    Quarterly Prodcom reports of value and quantity per 10-digit product are summed to firm-product(CN8+ x unit)-year; missing firm IDs are imputed from report ID and alternative ID within 2002-2006 and 2007+ separately; observations with missing or zero quantity are dropped; firm industry is the DB07 code with the largest sales value.
    登记库： VARS
    代码： jurnr, rapport_id, saflbnr, varenr, vaerdi, maengde, mgd_tekst, fag_hoved_bra_db07
    复制代码 · BMRS_restat/1_data/code/1_4_vars.do; 2_prepare/code/2_1_clean.do
  • Markups and marginal costs 企业特征与生产率
    Firm-product markups and marginal costs from the De Loecker et al. (2016) procedure: a translog production function estimated on single-product firms by 2-digit sector, with the original tariff controls replaced by the firm- and firm-product-level export support indicators; markup = output elasticity of materials over the materials expenditure share allocated to the product.
    登记库： VARS, FIRE, FIRM, UHDI
    代码： outputs lmu_x (log markup), lmc_x (log marginal cost), theta_fjt_x; tau_in1=treated_p, tau_ou1=treated
    复制代码 · BMRS_restat/3_lgkp/code/01_sample.do, 02_pf.do; 4_reg_variables/code/4_6_vars.do
  • Export support service types 贸易与离岸外包
    Trade Council support products grouped into four types: (1) partner search/matchmaking, meeting facilitation, networks; (2) fairs, PR activities, conferences/workshops; (3) intelligence/analysis, publications, market monitoring, customs/export/import information; (4) other commercial assistance, market entry assistance, trade-policy assistance; remaining products form a fifth group.
    登记库： Trade Council export promotion records

Replication package

Trade Shocks, Firm Hierarchies, and Wage Inequality

Benjamin U. Friedrich · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2022 · 个人 + 企业

利用企业层面的外国需求冲击以及 2006 年漫画危机后穆斯林对丹麦出口产品的抵制，表明贸易冲击通过改变企业层级结构来改变企业内部的工资不平等。增加一个层级会拉大整个企业内的工资差距，而抵制之后的层级削减则通过降薪、降职和人员流动压缩工资差距。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA) with DISCO occupation codes, Firm-Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (FIDA), Danish Business Register / firm statistics (GF): sales, value added, industry, Foreign Trade Statistics Register: firm-level exports by CN8 product and destination (UHDI), UN Comtrade bilateral trade flows (HS6), U.S. Imports of Merchandise, Penn World Tables distances, Brent oil prices (transport cost estimation)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：企业内部工资不平等（对数工资的标准差、90-10 差距）
  • 处理：基于职业划分的层级数
  • 工具变量：企业特定的世界进口需求冲击和运输成本冲击
  • 自然实验：2006 年穆斯林对丹麦出口产品的抵制（漫画危机）
时期
1999–2008
样本
12,470 家企业的 68,090 个企业—年度观测值（企业内部不平等回归） 1999–2008 年丹麦此前已存在的全部私营部门出口企业。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Occupational layer 职业与职位层级
    Workers' DISCO occupation code (DISCOALLE_INDK) harmonised to 3 digits and mapped to four hierarchical layers following Caliendo et al. via a DISCO3-to-PCS layer correspondence; missing layers imputed from the same worker-firm's adjacent years (up to 2 years), then from the layer whose average hourly wage is closest; firm-years with more than 20% of hours requiring imputation are set to missing.
    登记库： IDAP, FIDA
    代码： DISCOALLE_INDK; military code 0110/011000 recoded to 900; file correspondence_DISCO3_pcslayer
    复制代码 · Setup_Workerdata.do
  • Number of hierarchy layers 职业与职位层级
    Number of distinct occupational layers present in the firm-year (layers renumbered consecutively from the lowest present), missing if more than 20% of firm hours had imputed layers; alternative 3-layer versions collapse layers 1-2 or use DISCO 3-digit <200 for layer 3.
    登记库： IDAP, FIDA
    代码： layers = max(layerN); managers: first DISCO digit = 1
    复制代码 · Setup_Firm_Outcomes.do, lines ~72-185
  • Hourly wage and within-firm wage inequality 劳动收入与收入
    Hourly wage TIMELON (job earnings JOBLON / hours) for active November jobs (JOBLON and TIMELON > 0), CPI-deflated to 2000; observations below the 0.25th or above the 99.75th percentile of the yearly hourly wage distribution dropped; firm-year inequality is the s.d. of log hourly wages and percentile gaps 90-10, 75-25, 90-50, 50-10.
    登记库： IDAP
    代码： TIMELON, JOBLON; hours = JOBLON/TIMELON
    复制代码 · Setup_Firm_Outcomes.do, lines ~60-218; Setup_Workerdata.do
  • Private-sector sample 部门与行业
    Worker-level data restricted to IDA sector code 2 (private sector) before building firm outcomes.
    登记库： IDAP
    代码： SEKTOR == "2"

Globalization, Gender, and the Family

Wolfgang Keller and Hale Utar · Review of Economic Studies, 2022 · 个人 + 企业

受到同样的中国进口冲击时，男性和女性的调整方式不同。年近四十而失去工作的女性会以生育作为回应，高收入者和需要重新接受培训者尤其如此，因此一个性别中性的贸易冲击会通过生物钟造成长期的性别差距。

1999–2007
样本
约 1,600,000 名工人；约 10,000 名纺织和服装业工人 1999 年丹麦私营部门 18–56 岁全职工人队列，追踪至 2007 年。 来源

以丹麦的难民分散安置政策为自然实验，使用 1995 至 2011 年全部企业和工人的匹配数据。移民外生流入某一市镇会在两个边际上减少企业层面的离岸外包，而移民与其来源国的联系则会增加对这些特定国家的离岸外包。

数据

关键变量
  • 结果变量：离岸外包的广延边际（企业进口与自身产品属于同一 HS4 类别的产品）

  • 处理：非欧盟移民占市镇劳动力的份额

1995–2011
样本
约 35,000 家企业和 100 万名工人 1995–2011 年 97 个市镇中雇员超过一人的丹麦私营部门企业的非平衡面板。 来源

Occupations and Import Competition: Evidence from Denmark

Sharon Traiberman · American Economic Review, 2019 · 个人 + 企业

基于丹麦劳动者的职业履历估计一个动态职业选择模型，模型中劳动者积累职业专用人力资本，而转换职业时这部分人力资本会丧失。在贸易造成的劳动者结果差异中，职业解释了 57%，行业仅解释 16%；1995 年至 2005 年进口竞争的加剧使约 5% 的劳动者终身劳动收入下降。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA/IDAS) with ISCO occupation codes, Firm and establishment statistics (FIRE, FIRM) for industry codes, Customs trade data (UHDI), UN Comtrade (CEPII BACI), Danish national accounts, Danish CPI, LIBOR
关键变量
  • 结果变量：来自 11 月雇主的年度工资收入
  • 选择变量：两位数职业与行业的组合
  • 冲击：分行业的进口价格 / 进口竞争
  • 劳动者技能组：低、中、高教育程度
  • 职业任职年限
时期
1996–2007 年劳动者面板（任职年限根据 1990–1996 年数据构建）；进口竞争为 1995–2005 年
样本
样本框中 18,513,301 个观测值（原始数据中 33,502,593 个） IDA 中 23–59 岁的丹麦个人，1996–2007 年，用于估计职业选择模型。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Two-digit occupation (cleaned) 职业与职位层级
    Two-digit ISCO (DISCO) code taken from the four-digit occupation code in IDA, using only codes whose quality flag indicates they come from administrative surveys or pension funds (not imputation or lagged information). Missing codes are imputed if the worker has the same occupation at t-1 and t+1, or from t+2 after a firm switch; managerial codes 10-13 are combined into one, legislators and military are dropped, and small occupations are merged by skill group (e.g. 52 into 51, 92 into 61 for all skill groups).
    登记库： IDA, IDAS
    代码： DISCO/ISCO two-digit; quality flag codes 1, 2, 4, 10 kept; ISCO 10-13 combined; high-skilled merges 42->41, 52->51, 72->71/74, 81->82/83, 91->93 per Appendix table; 21/22 merged for low/medium skill
    在线附录 · Online Appendix D.1, Data Cleaning: Occupations (and footnote 11)
  • Four-sector industry aggregation 部门与行业
    NACE 1.1 four-digit industry codes assigned to plants (FIRE; firm-level FIRM data used when plant data not available) and matched to workers, aggregated into four sectors: Manufacturing (incl. construction, agriculture, utilities), FIRE, Public Services (labelled Health & Education), and Other Services.
    登记库： FIRE, FIRM, IDA
    代码： NACE 1 2-digit 0-45 = Manufacturing; 64-74 = FIRE; 75, 80, 85-90 = Public Services; all remaining = Other Services
    在线附录 · Online Appendix D.1, Data Cleaning: Industry (full mapping in appendix Table 16)
  • Skill group 教育与考试成绩
    Three skill groups from completed education in IDA: low = high school or short-cycle education; medium = vocational or medium-cycle education; high = bachelor's degree or more. Education is never allowed to decrease (higher earlier level imputed) and missing values are filled from the previous year, else the next reported year.
    登记库： IDA
    在线附录 · Online Appendix D.1, Data Cleaning: Skill
  • 职业任职年限 职业与职位层级
    Tenure measured at the occupation-sector pair level, constructed for early cohorts using data from 1990-1996, and censored above at 6 years to keep the measure comparable across cohorts; tenure resets upon switching occupations.
    登记库： IDA
    在线附录 · Online Appendix D.1, Occupational Tenure; Appendix model section
  • Annual income (November job) 劳动收入与收入
    Total salary-based income reported by IDA in November of each year, covering the worker's primary and any secondary occupation; all of it is attributed to the reported (primary) occupation. Hours are not used because they are often imputed. Deflated by the 2000 Danish CPI (1000s DKK).

    在线附录 · Online Appendix D.1, Income; notes to Table A.7
  • Employed 就业与劳动力状态

  • Foreign (import) price index by industry 贸易与离岸外包
    Variety-corrected CES import price index per industry built following Broda-Weinstein/Feenstra (Sato-Vartia weights on the common set of goods, adjusted for new and disappearing varieties) from customs data aggregated to the country-product level; a similar index is built from Comtrade, and the geometric mean of the customs, Comtrade and national-accounts indices is used as the path of foreign prices.

Labour Market Effects of International Trade When Mobility is Costly

Damoun Ashournia · Economic Journal, 2018 · 个人

构建了一个动态结构模型：异质性工人在五个部门之间进行选择，积累只能部分跨部门转移的工作经验，并在转换部门时付出效用成本。利用丹麦工人—企业匹配登记数据、以模拟最小距离法估计，效用成本为平均年工资的 10% 至 19%；若去掉永久性的不可观测异质性，该成本大约上升十倍。反事实模拟表明，人力资本损失和效用成本都会减缓劳动力市场对冲击的调整。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), entire Danish population aged 15-74, Firm Statistics Register (FirmStat), universe of Danish firms with NACE Rev. 2 industry, Firm-Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (FIDA), worker-firm link, Statistics Denmark aggregate series (Statistikbanken: CPI from PRIS8, sectoral value added and income shares from NATE101/NATE102, capital stocks from NAT09N) and 2008 input-output tables
关键变量
  • 结果变量：每年的就业部门（五个部门）或失业状态，以及它们之间的转换
  • 结果变量：分部门的小时工资对数
  • 状态变量：年龄、性别、大学教育、工作经验、失业保险基金成员身份／失业保险领取资格
  • 估计对象：转换部门的效用成本，以及可跨部门转移的经验份额
  • 反事实：制造业受到的失业冲击和贸易自由化冲击
时期
1996–2008 年（1995 年用于初始条件）
样本
部门选择和转换回归中有 20,373,918 个工人—年观测值；五个分部门工资对数回归合计 19,564,785 个（2015 年讨论稿版本的 Appendix D，Tables D.1-D.2） 年龄 30 至 65 岁、在五个加总部门之一就业或处于失业状态的全体丹麦工人，在工人—企业匹配登记库中逐年追踪。 来源
变量如何定义（4）
  • Matched worker-firm panel of workers aged 30-65 样本界定与时间
    Worker data for each year are taken from IDA, which covers the entire Danish population aged 15-74; firms are taken from FirmStat and linked to workers through FIDA. The author extracts age, gender, labour market status (employed or unemployed), UI fund membership, work experience and hourly wages for workers aged 30 to 65; the entry age of 30 is chosen because almost all workers have completed their education by then. Workers and firms can be matched only from 1995 onwards, so 1995 is used to construct initial conditions.
    登记库： IDA, FIDA, FirmStat
    代码： Age 30-65; sample years 1996-2008; 1995 = initial conditions
    工作论文 · Section 3.1 (Worker Data)
  • Five productive sectors plus unemployment 部门与行业
    Each firm is assigned to one of five productive sectors defined from the NACE Rev. 2 classification: (1) Agriculture/Mining, (2) Manufacturing, (3) Construction, (4) Trade/Utilities/Transportation/Communication, (5) Services. Unemployment is treated as a sixth, unproductive sector (0).
    登记库： FirmStat, FIDA
    代码： NACE Rev. 2 divisions: Agriculture/Mining 01, 02, 03, 06, 08, 09; Manufacturing 10-33; Construction 41-43; Trade/Utilities/Transportation/Communication 35-38, 45-47, 49-53, 58-63; Services 55, 56, 64-66, 68-75, 77-82, 84-88, 90-97
    工作论文 · Section 3.1 and Appendix B, Table B.1
  • Educ (college indicator) 教育与考试成绩
    Indicator for whether the worker has completed college education; enters the human capital function, the utility cost of switching, the type probabilities and the unemployment probabilities.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 2.2.1, equation (6)
  • Unemployment benefit and UI eligibility 失业与福利金
    For the employed the data give hourly wage rates; for the unemployed they give unemployment benefits, split into UI benefits for those eligible and welfare assistance for others. In the model a worker is eligible for UI if he is a member of a UI fund and has not received UI benefits for more than 4 years; the benefit is min(k x last wage, UI) if eligible and WA otherwise. Unemployment probabilities are set to the empirical frequencies by gender, education, age and previous sector.

Hale Utar · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2018 · 个人 + 企业

在针对中国进口产品的配额取消之后，对丹麦纺织和服装业工人追踪十年，并利用行业内部和职业内部在暴露程度上的差异。劳动收入和就业持续下降，服务业中的工作不稳定是主要的调整摩擦，而受过制造业专用教育的工人通过继续接受学校教育来重建人力资本。

1999–2010
样本
10,521 名工人 1999 年主要工作在丹麦纺织和服装业、出生于 1943–1982 年（2002–2010 年间年龄为 20–67 岁）的全部工人。 来源

    Worker is treated if his/her 1999 primary employer domestically produced in 1999 (at the 8-digit CN level, per VARES) any good subject to the MFA quota removal for China; SIGL quota categories are mapped to CN 8-digit products (CN 1999) and firm ids are linked to workers through FIDA. Called CompExp^D in the paper.

The Effect of Export Promotion on Firm-Level Performance

Jakob Munch and Georg Schaur · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2018 · 企业

评估丹麦贸易委员会（Danish Trade Council）的出口促进服务，在可观测特征的基础上把主动寻求帮助的企业与由委员会主动接触的企业区分开来。出口促进提高了销售额、增加值、就业和人均增加值；对小企业而言，增加值的增幅大约是直接成本的三倍。

数据
Danish Trade Council data on export promotion services (self-selected vs. Council-approached firms), Danish firm-level performance data (sales, value added, employment); specific registers not stated in abstract
关键变量
  • 处理：企业接受 Danish Trade Council 的出口促进服务
  • 比较：自行选择使用服务的企业与由 Trade Council 主动接触的企业
  • 结果变量：销售额、增加值、就业、人均增加值
  • 控制变量：大量企业特征（基于可观测变量的选择）
时期
所查资料中未注明
样本
所查资料中未注明 丹麦企业，将使用 Trade Council 出口促进服务的企业与可比的未使用企业进行比较。 来源（摘要）

Transfer Pricing by Multinational Firms: New Evidence from Foreign Firm Ownerships

Anca D. Cristea and Daniel X. Nguyen · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2016 · 企业

检验丹麦跨国公司是否通过压低对其拥有关联企业且公司税较低的国家的出口价格来转移利润。三重差分设计比较企业在某一目的地收购多数控股的关联企业前后的出口单位价值，并在相对丹麦税率不同的目的地之间进行比较，以没有关联企业的出口商为对照组。在税率较低的国家收购关联企业后，丹麦跨国公司对当地的出口单位价值平均下降 5.7% 至 9.1%。

数据
Firm Statistics Register (Statistics Denmark): employment, sales and industry for the universe of private-sector firms, Customs statistics on export transactions by firm, product and destination country (Statistics Denmark), Experian data on foreign ownership shares of Danish firms (from annual reports, supplemented with transaction records of the National Bank of Denmark), linked by the Statistics Denmark firm identifier, Statutory corporate tax rates: OECD Tax Database and World Tax Database (University of Michigan), Penn World Tables (population, per-capita GDP, exchange rate)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：按企业、产品、目的地和年份计的出口单位价值对数
  • 处理：企业在目的地国拥有多数控股的关联企业
  • 处理强度：丹麦与目的地之间公司税率差的绝对值，对低税率和高税率目的地分别计算
  • 对照组：在目的地没有关联企业的出口商
  • 控制变量：企业就业人数和销售额；目的地人口、人均 GDP、汇率
  • 异质性：差异化产品（Rauch 分类）；新设立的关联企业与存续的关联企业
时期
1999–2006
样本
1,203,111 个企业—产品—国家—年度观测值（工作论文表 1） 1999–2006 年经营的丹麦制造业出口商；跨国公司对其拥有多数控股关联企业的国家的出口占观测值的 11.4%。 来源
变量如何定义（4）
  • Export unit value 贸易与离岸外包
    Average unit values are computed by dividing annual export values by the quantities shipped (weight) at the firm-product-destination level. Observations with negative or missing export values, or with zero or missing weight, are dropped (about 4 percent of the data), and the top and bottom 1 percent of prices are dropped to remove measurement or keying errors.
    登记库： Customs statistics (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： Drop top and bottom 1 percent of prices
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Data), footnote 34
  • Majority-owned foreign affiliate (Affiliate) 企业特征与生产率
    Indicator equal to 1 if the Danish exporter has majority ownership of a local establishment in the destination market, built from Experian data on foreign firm ownership shares and merged with the customs data by the firm identifier used by Statistics Denmark. Holdings below the 50 percent majority break point are disregarded. For firms that establish an affiliate during the sample period, the observation for the year of acquisition is removed. The data do not show whether a given export transaction goes to an affiliated or an unrelated buyer.
    登记库： Experian foreign ownership data, Firm Statistics Register
    代码： Majority ownership (50 percent break point; FDI statistics use a 10 percent threshold)
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Data), footnotes 35-37; Table 3 notes
  • Tax wedge and low-/high-tax destination 税收与税率
    Absolute difference between the statutory corporate tax rate of the foreign country and that of Denmark, with indicator variables for countries with tax rates below (Low Tax) or above (High Tax) Denmark's rate. Tax rates are from the OECD Tax Database and, for non-OECD countries, the World Tax Database of the Office of Tax Policy Research at the University of Michigan.
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Data); Table 3 notes
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Manufacturing exporters operating during 1999-2006, drawn from the Firm Statistics Register, which covers the universe of private-sector Danish firms. The unit of observation is a firm-product-country-year quadruplet. Almost 3 percent of observations belong to Danish multinationals that establish their first majority-owned affiliate in a country during the sample period.
    登记库： Firm Statistics Register, Customs statistics (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： Years 1999-2006; manufacturing exporters; 1,203,111 observations
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Data); Table 1

The Wage Effects of Offshoring: Evidence from Danish Matched Worker-Firm Data

David Hummels, Rasmus Jørgensen, Jakob Munch and Chong Xiang · American Economic Review, 2014 · 个人 + 企业

将企业的产品层面进出口与工人工资相连接。在同一工作时段内，离岸外包提高高技能工人的工资、降低低技能工人的工资，而出口则提高所有工人的工资。常规性强或容易被离岸外包的任务受损最大。

数据
Firm Statistics Register (FirmStat/FIRM), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Firm-worker link (FIDA), Foreign Trade Statistics Register, Extrastat and Intrastat (UHDI), UN COMTRADE world trade data for instruments, Firm accounts and other firm registers (Data Appendix)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：工作时段内工人小时工资的对数
  • 处理：企业离岸外包（投入品进口）
  • 处理：企业出口
  • 工具变量：按产品和国家划分的世界出口供给冲击与世界进口需求冲击（COMTRADE），以及运输成本
  • 异质性：工人技能类型（高技能与低技能）
  • 结果变量：被裁工人的劳动收入损失
时期
1995–2006 年（贸易数据为 1990–2006 年）
样本
约 195 万个工人—企业—年份观测值和 9,800 个企业—年份观测值 既进口又出口的丹麦企业中的制造业工人，剔除仅持续一年的工作时段、技能水平发生变化的工人，以及雇员少于 50 人且进口额不足 60 万 DKK 的企业。 来源
变量如何定义（13）
  • Hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Wage rate uses annual hours from IDA (following Christensen et al. 2005); annual hours do not capture overtime. In a 2006 subsample with overtime data, a wage rate including overtime correlates 0.86 with the main wage rate.
    登记库： IDA
    在线附录 · Data Appendix, section 1
  • High- vs low-skilled worker 教育与考试成绩
    Robustness split of low-skilled workers into medium-skilled (vocational education, defined as the final stage of secondary education preparing for labour market entry) and very-low-skilled (high school equivalent or less); results very similar. Workers whose skill level changes during the sample period are dropped.
    登记库： IDA
    在线附录 · Data Appendix, section 1
  • Broad offshoring 贸易与离岸外包
    Total value of imports by a given manufacturing firm in a given year, from the Foreign Trade Statistics Register (Extrastat and Intrastat), recorded at CN8 and aggregated to HS6.
    登记库： Foreign Trade Statistics Register (UHDI)
    工作论文 · Section II.3
  • Narrow offshoring 贸易与离岸外包
    Machinery imports (HS 84 and HS 85, 16.9% of imports) are included in broad offshoring for all firms; narrow offshoring excludes them except for firms that themselves produce machinery for sale. Within HS 84 the top 20 HS6 import products (59% of HS 84 imports) are all parts rather than machines.
    登记库： Foreign Trade Statistics Register
    代码： HS 84; HS 85
    在线附录 · Data Appendix, section 3.2
  • World export supply and world import demand instruments 贸易与离岸外包
    WES: country c's total supply of HS6 product k to the world market minus its supply to Denmark in year t; WID: country c's total purchases of product k from the world market less purchases from Denmark; both from COMTRADE and weighted by pre-sample firm input/output shares; plus exchange rates and transport costs fitted from US imports data.
    登记库： UN COMTRADE, Foreign Trade Statistics Register
    工作论文 · Section III and Data Appendix section 2
  • Estimation sample (firms) 样本界定与时间
    Start from 2.8 million manufacturing worker-firm-year observations after merging workers, firms and trade. Drop worker-firm-years whose job spell lasts a single year (~200,000 obs); drop workers whose skill level changes in the sample (~35,000 obs); drop firms with fewer than 50 employees and less than DKK 0.6 million in imports (about two manufacturing workers' average annual wages) (~600,000 obs).
    登记库： IDA, FirmStat, Foreign Trade Statistics Register
    代码： firm size < 50 employees and imports < DKK 0.6m dropped
    在线附录 · Data Appendix, section 1
  • Firm controls 企业特征与生产率
    Firm identifier from 'Old Firm Statistics' (1995-1999) and 'General Firm Statistics' (1999-2006), combined in FirmStat to track firms across the 1999 break. Employees = number of full-time equivalent workers in the year (FirmStat). Capital stock = value of land, buildings, machines, equipment and inventory (Accounting Statistics register). Gross output (net of taxes) from the VAT register. Firm skill intensity = educational attainment of individual workers in IDA aggregated to the firm via FIDA.
    登记库： FirmStat, Old Firm Statistics, General Firm Statistics, Accounting Statistics, VAT register, IDA, FIDA

  • Routine / non-routine task intensity 职业与职位层级
    IDA occupation uses the Danish version of ISCO-88, mapped to O*NET via the National Crosswalk Center crosswalk. Non-routine = principal component of O*NET 1.A.1.c.1 (mathematical reasoning), 1.A.2.b.3 (response orientation), 1.A.3.c.3 (gross body coordination), 2.A.1.e (mathematics), 4.A.2.b.2 (thinking creatively), 4.A.2.b.6 (organizing, planning, prioritizing). Routine = 1.A.2.a.2 (manual dexterity), 1.A.2.a.3 (finger dexterity), 1.A.2.b.2 (multilimb coordination), 4.A.2.a.2 (processing information), 4.A.2.a.3 (evaluating compliance with standards).
