When the Floodgates Open: Northern Firms' Response to Removal of Trade Quotas on Chinese Goods

Hale Utar · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2014 · 个人 + 企业

中国加入 WTO 时，多种纤维协定（Multi-Fibre Arrangement）对中国纺织品的配额被取消，丹麦纺织企业由此面临低工资竞争。在企业内部，就业、增加值和无形资产下降，劳动力构成向技能型劳动者倾斜，同时企业把重心从中国优势增强的产品上转移开。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Firm accounting statistics (Regnskabsdata / FIRE), International trade data from customs records (Udenrigshandel / UHDI), Domestic production/sales by product (Varestatistik / VARES), 1995–2005, EU SIGL textile and clothing quota licence database
关键变量
  • 处理：企业在 1999 年生产 2005 年对华 MFA 配额所涉商品（对配额取消的暴露）
  • 结果变量：企业就业、增加值、无形资产、资本密集度
  • 结果变量：按职业和教育划分的劳动力技能构成
  • 结果变量：基于交易层面数据的产品范围 / 产品创新
  • 企业固定效应、年份效应
时期
1995–2007
样本
1,090 家不同的纺织和服装企业（产品组合分析为 875 家企业，1995–2005 年） 1995–2007 年所有至少有 0.5 个全职当量雇员的丹麦纺织和服装企业，与其雇员和产品交易相匹配。 来源
变量如何定义（11）
  • MFA quota goods (MFAQ2, MFAQ5) 贸易与离岸外包
    Chinese quota categories from the EU SIGL licence database assigned to CN 8-digit codes (CN 1999) by matching category and CN descriptions, confirmed with Annex I of Council Regulation (EEC) No 3030/93; linked across CN 1995-2007 vintages with Eurostat correspondence tables. Analysis restricted to China quotas utilized at least 10% prior to removal (excludes some unused silk and ramie fabric quotas).
    登记库： EU SIGL; Udenrigshandel; Varestatistik
    代码： CN 8-digit; quota utilization >= 10%
    在线附录 · Appendix C-III, Product Characteristics
  • Treatment: produced MFA quota goods in 1999 贸易与离岸外包
    MFAQProd99 = 1 if the T&C manufacturing firm is found to have produced any MFA quota good in 1999 (before China's WTO accession), identified from domestic sales (Varestatistik, firms with 10+ employees) and export data; MFAQShare99 is the share of 1999 firm sales from MFA quota goods. Interacted with a post-2002 dummy (Dum02) in firm and year fixed-effects regressions.
    登记库： Varestatistik, Udenrigshandel
    工作论文 · Section 4, eqs. (3)-(4) and footnotes 14-15
  • Value added 企业特征与生产率
    Constructed by the author from Regnskabsdata as turnover + work performed for own purposes and capitalized + (end-of-year inventory - beginning-of-year inventory) - (purchases of raw materials + energy + subcontracting expenses). Deflated with Statistics Denmark output deflators (separately for textile and apparel producers); values in thousands of year-2000 DKK.
    登记库： Regnskabsdata (firm accounts statistics)
    在线附录 · Appendix C-I, Firm-Level Values
  • Intangible assets 企业特征与生产率
    Assets intended for long-term ownership or use, including licences, trademarks, copyrights, exclusive distribution rights, software and goodwill, from the accounting statistics; outcomes are log intangible assets and the logit of intangibles over total assets. Physical capital: plants, machinery, technical installations, land, buildings, furniture and office equipment.
    登记库： Regnskabsdata (firm accounts)
    工作论文 · Section 5, footnote 26; Appendix B.1
  • Occupational skill groups 职业与职位层级
    Occupation categories derived from IDA variable 'pstill2' (employee status/position in firm). Professional and technical occupations = pstill2 32 (top-level employees, e.g. engineers) and 34 (intermediate-level professional/technical employees, e.g. laboratory technician, programmer); base-level occupations (basic skills, e.g. office work, operating stationary machinery) = pstill2 35; auxiliary employees (no skill requirement: cleaning, delivery, guard, transport work) = pstill2 36; unclassified = pstill2 37. Year 1995 excluded from occupation analyses because of the 1996 switch to DISCO-88. Inactive persons on the payroll (retirees, employees on leave, owners' spouses) are dropped before computing firm-level employment characteristics.
    登记库： IDA (Persondata)
    代码： pstill2 in {32,34} professional/technical; 35 base-level; 36 auxiliary; 37 unspecified
    在线附录 · Appendix C-II, Employee Characteristics (IDA)
  • Employee education groups 教育与考试成绩
    Built from IDA education code 'hffsp' (highest completed education combined with professional training); first two digits give the main education group. At most high school diploma = first two digits <= 25; at least some college = first two digits >= 40. Textile/clothing technical design training (college level; industrial designer, model engineering, product developer, textile and garment engineering) = hffsp 405985. Textile/clothing production training (clothing operator, fashion craft, hand stitcher, cutter, tailor, knitting/textile operator) = hffsp 355880 and 355890. Not constructed for 2007 because the detailed education code is not reported that year.
    登记库： IDA (Persondata)
    代码： hffsp first 2 digits <=25 (<= high school); >=40 (some college+); 405985 textile design; 355880, 355890 textile production training
    在线附录 · Appendix C-II
  • New and dropped products 贸易与离岸外包
    Products defined at CN 8-digit level (first 8 digits of the 10-digit Varestatistik code equal CN). New product = product a firm starts to sell/export in the current year that is not observed produced by the firm in previous years; dropped product = product the firm stops selling in the current year and is not observed sold in subsequent years. Logs taken of period means over 1996-2001 and 2002-2004.
    登记库： Udenrigshandel (customs); Varestatistik
    代码： CN 8-digit
    在线附录 · Appendix C-III and notes to Table A-6
  • Firm employment (FTE and head-count) 就业与劳动力状态
    Full-time equivalent employment from firm accounts (firms with at least 0.5 FTE are covered) and head-count of employees from IDA matched via the unique firm identifier.
    登记库： Regnskabsdata, IDA
    工作论文 · Section 2; Appendix B, B.2
  • Physical capital assets 企业特征与生产率
    Plant, machinery, technical installations, land, buildings and other equipment such as computers and office furniture; deflated with capital-goods deflators, thousands of year-2000 DKK. Wages deflated with CPI; hourly wages in year-2000 DKK.
    登记库： Regnskabsdata (firm accounts statistics)

  • Source data coverage thresholds 样本界定与时间
    Customs trade data: universe of firm shipments 1993-2007 aggregated to firm x CN8 x country x year, but only product shipments of DKK 10,000 or more included. Varestatistik (1995-2005): only firms with 10 or more employees two years prior. Regnskabsdata: firms with at least 0.5 FTE and/or earnings above a size limit (about DKK 500,000 in wholesale, DKK 150,000-200,000 in manufacturing); manufacturing, construction and retail only until 1998, wholesale from 1998, almost all private sectors from 1999 (excluding agriculture, finance, public, education and medical services). IDA covers persons aged 15-70.
    登记库： Udenrigshandel; Varestatistik; Regnskabsdata; IDA

Disaggregated Economic Accounts

Asger Lau Andersen, Kilian Huber, Niels Johannesen, Ludwig Straub and Emil Toft Vestergaard · Quarterly Journal of Economics, 2026 · 个人 + 企业

构建一套国民账户体系，将其细分为地区 × 行业的消费者单元、生产者单元、政府和世界其他地区之间的双边资金流，并利用银行交易数据和登记库在丹麦加以实现。支出存在本地偏向和城市偏向；当财政转移支付投向那些支出会流向高失业单元的单元时，对 GDP 的提升更大。

数据
Danske Bank geo-coded transaction-level data (about 20% of Danish adult consumers), 2018–2019, Government tax and income registers (labour compensation, mixed income, interest, dividends, transfers), Employment registers linking adults to industry of main employment and region, Danish national accounts (SNA positions, input-output tables), 2018, CrediWire producer-to-producer transactions (about 5 million), Firm-level export and import data for manufacturing firms
关键变量
  • 结果变量：单元对单元的双边流量（消费支出、劳动收入和利润收入、税收、转移支付、中间品贸易）
  • 单位：消费者单元（主要就业行业 × 居住地区）
  • 单位：生产者单元（工作场所的行业 × 地区）
  • 衍生指标：国内支出份额、引力、城市偏向和支出强度等度量
时期
2018 年（消费支出为 2018–2019 年）
样本
约 2,700 个消费者单元和约 2,600 个生产者单元；约 4300 万个条目 丹麦全体成年人和生产性工作场所，按地区 × 行业单元分组，消费支出根据 Danske Bank 客户测算。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Consumer cell (region x industry of main employment) 地理与社区
    Every adult is assigned to a region by home address at the start of 2018 (BEF), one per each of 98 municipalities, and to an industry by the NACE code of the establishment responsible for the largest part of 2018 labour income (AKM), mapped from six-digit NACE to 24 work industries. Cells with fewer than 3 individuals or establishments are censored.
    登记库： BEF, AKM
    代码： six-digit NACE mapped to 24 DEA work industries (Table A.I); 98 municipalities
    工作论文 · Appendix D; Section II
  • Non-working consumer industries 就业与劳动力状态
    Adults without labour income are assigned to 'retired' if older than 65, 'students' if they receive a government stipend, 'long-term unemployed' if they receive unemployment or cash benefits (fully benefit-dependent with no labour income all year), and otherwise 'out of workforce'.
    登记库： BEF, IND
    工作论文 · Appendix D; footnote 5
  • Producer cell (establishment region x industry) 企业特征与生产率
    Firm establishments are assigned to 2,646 producer cells by region and production industry using the employment registers; 24 work industries plus 3 housing industries without employees (private landlords, owner-occupied housing, government-owned housing).
    登记库： BFL, IDAN
    工作论文 · Appendix D; Section II
  • Labour compensation flows 劳动收入与收入
    Total annual labour compensation per individual including employer pension contributions, from IND and INPI, aggregated to consumer x producer cells and scaled by 1.01 to SNA D.1. Compensation from foreign producers (IND) scaled by 1.47; payments by Danish producers in BFL to persons not in BEF are treated as foreign employees and scaled by 1.14.
    登记库： IND, INPI, BFL, BEF
    代码： SNA D.1; scale factors 1.01, 1.47, 1.14
    工作论文 · Appendix I
  • Mixed income, dividends and owner-occupied housing surplus 劳动收入与收入
    Mixed income links sole-proprietorship establishments in IDAN (including municipality) to owners' mixed income. Dividends (SNA D.42) are allocated to consumer cells in proportion to stock dividend income in IND and to producer cells in proportion to accounting income. Owner-occupied housing surplus (B.2G) = imputed rental values in IND scaled by 0.67.
    登记库： IDAN, IND
    代码： SNA B.3g, D.42, B.2G; scale 0.67
    工作论文 · Appendix J
  • Government benefits to consumers 失业与福利金
    Social benefits (SNA D.62) = all government income transfers plus private pension payouts from IND, scaled by 1.03. Other current transfers (D.7) allocated by BEF population shares; pension entitlement adjustment (D.8) from IND and INPI contributions net of payouts.
    登记库： IND, INPI, BEF
    代码： SNA D.62, D.7, D.8; scale 1.03
    工作论文 · Appendix K
  • Disaggregated consumer spending 财富、负债与消费
    Danske Bank customers (main account at Danske Bank and at least one spending transaction per month in 2018-2019) assigned home region monthly from bank address records and industry from the employer paying the largest share of annual income. Merchant region from geocoded transaction-string addresses and industry from an MCC-to-ISIC/NACE crosswalk; cash withdrawals allocated in proportion to in-person card payments.
    登记库： Danske Bank transactions
    代码： MCC to ISIC/NACE crosswalk
    工作论文 · Section III.A; Appendix E.A-E.C
  • Manual labour share and cell characteristics 职业与职位层级
    Individual does manual labour if main occupation (AKM) is manual trades, operator and assembly, transportation, other manual labour or military. Cell averages also of university degree (UDDA), total debt, liquid financial assets (deposits, stocks, bonds, fund shares) and illiquid assets (FORMGELD).
    登记库： AKM, UDDA, FORMGELD
    工作论文 · Appendix M
  • Establishment output for IO disaggregation 企业特征与生产率
    Firm output is distributed across a firm's establishments using within-firm labour compensation shares, then aggregated to 173 subindustries combining the 117-industry national IO table and DEA industries; intermediate flows are split proportional to output shares.
    登记库： NIO1-NIO3 (statbank)
    代码： 117 NA industries; 173 subindustries
    工作论文 · Appendix N.A

Replication package

Taxing Top Wealth: Migration Responses and Their Aggregate Economic Implications

Katrine Jakobsen, Henrik Kleven, Jonas Kolsrud, Camille Landais and Mathilde Muñoz · American Economic Review, 2026 · 个人

估计富人的国际迁移对财富税的反应，主要依据 2007 年瑞典废除财富税这一事件，并用丹麦的两次财富税改革（1989 年和 1997 年）来验证迁出弹性、估计迁入反应。最高财富税率每提高一个百分点，富裕纳税人的存量约减少 2%。瑞典的事件研究显示，富有的所有者移居国外后其企业会收缩，但对就业、投资和增加值的总体影响很小。

数据
Denmark (validation and in-migration analysis only): wealth and income registers based on Danish Tax Agency (SKAT) tax returns, with year-end third-party and self-reported wealth components, Denmark: CPR-based citizenship and migration records with daily dates of entry and exit, Denmark: longitudinal register data on earnings, transfers and demographics, 1989–2006, Sweden (main analysis, not Danish): wealth tax register (Förmögenhetsregistret) 1993–2007, LISA, RAMS employer-employee data, K10 closely-held firm ownership files, firm financial accounts and migration registers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：按财富排名划分的迁出率和迁入率
  • 处理（丹麦）：1989 年财富税率由 2.2% 降至 1%，1997 年废除财富税；财富最高 1% 与最高 5–2.5% 的比较
  • 处理（瑞典）：2007 年废除财富税
  • 估计对象：迁移率对财富税后留存率的半弹性
  • 结果变量（仅瑞典）：迁出的富有所有者所持企业的就业、投资、增加值和税收
时期
丹麦：迁出序列为 1980–2006 年，财富税年份为 1989–1996 年；瑞典：1993–2007 年的财富登记库，与截至 2017–2019 年的各登记库相链接
样本
所查资料中未注明 丹麦部分为 1989 年和 1997 年财富税改革前后财富分布最高 1% 的纳税人（处理组）以及介于最高 5% 与最高 2.5% 之间的纳税人（对照组）；主样本为全体瑞典家庭，重点关注财富最高的 2%。 来源
变量如何定义（4）
  • Danish wealth-tax reforms: treatment and control groups 样本界定与时间
    Out-of-sample validation of the Swedish estimates. In 1989 the marginal tax rate on wealth above the exemption threshold was reduced from 2.2% to 1%, phased in over three years; in 1997 the wealth tax was abolished. Individuals in the top 1% of the wealth distribution form the treatment group and individuals between the top 5% and top 2.5% form the control group; out-migration rates of the two groups are compared over 1980-2006 and semi-elasticities are estimated with the same specification (4) as for Sweden.
    登记库： Wealth tax register (SKAT tax returns), CPR migration records
    代码： Treated: top 1% of wealth; controls: top 5% to top 2.5%; reforms 1989 and 1997
    工作论文 · Section 5.3 and footnote 32; Appendix V.2 and Figure V.6
  • Danish wealth data 财富、负债与消费
    Wealth and income registries are based on tax return data from the Danish Tax Agency (SKAT), stated at the end of the year. Most components are third-party reported (cash value of real estate, deposits, bonds, shares). Until 1997 self-reported components subject to auditing are also observed: value of listed and non-listed stocks, durables (cars, boats, caravans), share certificates for housing cooperatives, premium bonds and cash holdings. Liabilities include debt in financial institutions, mortgage credit debt, credit and debit card debt, student debt and other liabilities. After 1997 the asset statement is based solely on third-party reporting. Closely-held businesses and unlisted shares are not observed, so firm outcomes of migrants cannot be tracked in Denmark.
    登记库： Wealth tax register (SKAT tax returns)
    工作论文 · Appendix II.3 and Appendix Table II.1; footnote 24
  • Out-migration and in-migration rates by wealth 移民身份与来源地
    Citizenship and migration information with daily dates of entry and exit comes from the CPR; individuals must register their move to the CPR office to stop paying taxes in Denmark. For out-migration rates, individuals are ranked by household net wealth in year t and the fraction who out-migrate in t+1 is computed for each wealth fractile; for in-migration rates, individuals are ranked by household net wealth in year t and the fraction who in-migrated in t-1 is computed. Descriptive statistics for Denmark cover 1989-1996, when the wealth tax was still in place. Wealth of arrivals is measured consistently before and after the reforms, which is why in-migration elasticities are estimated on Danish data.
    登记库： CPR migration records, Wealth tax register (SKAT tax returns)
    代码： Denmark: 1989-1996
    工作论文 · Section 3.2 and notes to Figure 2; Section 5.4; Appendix II.3
  • Danish wealth tax 税收与税率
    Annual progressive wealth tax levied from 1903 to 1997 on Danish tax residents with net taxable wealth above an exemption threshold, which was always above the 98th percentile of the wealth distribution in the study period. Taxable wealth was total household net wealth excluding pension wealth: cash, deposits, bonds, equities, housing, large durables and business assets, net of debts. Wealth above the threshold was taxed at a flat 2.2% until the rate was cut to 1% after 1989; the tax was repealed in 1997. Unlike in Sweden, business assets were included in the base (with valuation reliefs for physical business assets), and a tax ceiling capped the wealth tax as a fraction of taxable income.
    代码： 2.2% above the exemption threshold; 1% after 1989; repealed 1997
    工作论文 · Section 2.2; Appendix I.2 and Appendix Table II.1

Managing Inequality: Manager-Specific Wage Premiums and Selection in the Managerial Labor Market

Alex Xi He and Daniel le Maire · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2025 · 个人 + 企业

构建了覆盖丹麦全体人口的经理—企业—工人匹配数据集，用以估计经理对工资的影响。在企业间工资不平等中，经理特定的工资溢价几乎与企业溢价同样重要，且与生产率无关；支付高工资的经理在企业被收购后更有可能被替换。

数据
Matched employer-employee data covering all Danish workers and firms (IDA), Occupation codes used to identify managers, Firm balance sheet data for private-sector firms (FIRE), Mergers and acquisitions identified from firm and establishment identifiers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：工人的对数工资
  • 关键估计量：经理特定的工资溢价（由工人和经理的流动识别的经理固定效应）
  • 比较：企业特定的工资溢价
  • 事件：企业被收购和经理更换
  • 异质性：行业集中度（HHI）
时期
1995–2011 年（据 2019 年工作论文的幻灯片）
样本
所查资料中未注明 覆盖丹麦全体人口的经理—企业—工人匹配面板；2019 年工作论文版本中的收购样本包含约 3,700 起私营部门收购。 来源（摘要）
变量如何定义（8）
  • Manager identification 职业与职位层级
    A worker is a manager if their ISCO-88 occupation is 1200-1399 or their job position code is top management (pstill 31); a manager status is carried forward within an establishment in years where it has no identified manager. If no manager is found, the top earner (or anyone in the top 5% of earners) is flagged when not in a non-managerial ISCO>=2000 occupation, earns at least 1.6 times the average of co-workers, or earns more than 1.5 times the second-highest earner; further fallbacks assign the top earner with a unique occupation/position earning >1.3 times the second highest.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： isco 1200-1399; PSTILL==31 (top manager), PSTILL 32 exception; ratio = lonind*(n-1)/(wagebill-lonind) >= 1.6; lonind/second-highest > 1.5
    复制代码 · clean_manager.do
  • Top manager per firm-year 职业与职位层级
    Among identified managers, one manager per establishment-year is kept by successively preferring ISCO 1210 (CEOs), then pstill 31, managers with longer tenure in the establishment, and higher within-establishment earnings rank; only managers observed in at least two firms are retained (mobility needed for identification), establishments that were acquisition targets are excluded, and at the firm (CVR) level the manager of the largest establishment is used.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： isco==1210; pstill==31; target_cumu>=1 dropped
    复制代码 · clean_manager.do
  • Log hourly wage (AKM outcome) 劳动收入与收入
    Log of the IDA hourly wage, deflated to constant prices; when the hourly wage is zero it is replaced by annual labour income divided by 1800. Observations with missing firm ID, labour income <=1, missing education or experience, or unemployment degree above 500 are dropped; firms whose maximum employment is 5 or fewer are excluded.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： timelon; lonind; replace timelon=lonind/1800 if timelon==0; arledgr (unemployment degree) >500 dropped; maxemp<=5 dropped
    复制代码 · AKM_merger_cvrnr.do
  • Mergers and acquisitions 企业特征与生产率
    M&As are identified from establishment (workplace) IDs changing firm (CVR) IDs: a firm-year is a merger if its establishments were owned by more than one distinct firm in the previous year (ignoring spurious ownership changes where an establishment's firm ID reverts); the acquirer is the establishment whose firm ID is unchanged, and targets are establishments whose previous-year firm ID differs when the firm also has an acquirer.
    登记库： IDA, IDAS
    代码： lbnr (establishment), cvrnr (firm); merger = nvals(cvrnr_prevyear)>1 within cvrnr-year; acquirer: cvrnr==cvrnr_prevyear; target: cvrnr!=cvrnr_prevyear & nacquirer>0
    复制代码 · clean_merger.do
  • Firm spinouts and exits 企业特征与生产率
    Share of a firm's workers in establishments that move to a different firm ID next year (spinout) or disappear next year before 2011 (exit).
    登记库： IDA
    代码： spinout = cvrnr_nextyear!=cvrnr; exit = cvrnr_nextyear missing & year<2011
    复制代码 · clean_merger.do
  • Education groups 教育与考试成绩
    Four education groups from the first two digits of the highest completed education code: basic (<=25), vocational (35), short/medium higher (40-50), long higher (>=60).
    登记库： IDA, UDDA
    代码： max_educ = int(HFFSP/1e6): <=25 basic; 35 vocational; 40-50; >=60
    复制代码 · AKM_merger_cvrnr.do; clean_merger.do
  • Firm industry 部门与行业
    Establishment industry is the modal worker industry code if held by more than 50% of workers; firm industry (127- and 36-group) is assigned only if at least 70% of the firm's workers share it, otherwise missing.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： persbrc mapped to pb07, ind127, ind36; thresholds 0.5 (establishment) and 0.7 (firm)
    复制代码 · clean_merger.do
  • Hiring and firing rates 企业特征与生产率
    Hiring rate = workers whose firm ID differs from the previous year divided by lagged firm employment; firing rate = workers whose firm ID differs next year divided by current employment.
    登记库： IDA
    复制代码 · AKM_merger_cvrnr.do

David Hummels, Jakob R. Munch and Chong Xiang · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2025 · 个人 + 企业

将丹麦工人—企业数据与住院和处方记录相关联，研究工作负荷上升如何影响健康。企业销售额增加使工人的工作时间延长，并提高出现压力、抑郁、心脏病和中风的概率，年龄较大和本已不堪重负的工人受影响最大；患病造成的福利损失抵消了近四分之一的劳动收入增益。

变量如何定义（10）
  • Antidepressant expenditure 医疗服务利用

Replication package

Multiproduct Firms, Horizontal Mergers, and International Trade

Jackie M.L. Chan, Michael Irlacher and Michael Koch · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2025 · 企业

研究横向并购如何改变多产品企业的产品组合。并购根据丹麦登记库中机构（establishment）所有权的变动来识别，并围绕并购年份做事件研究，以从未并购的企业和匹配的合成并购作为对照。并购后的企业在国内销售的产品比收购方与目标方原先合计少约 30%，销售向核心产品集中，并向更多目的地出口更多产品；一个寡头多产品企业之间并购的模型可以解释这一规律。

数据
IDAS establishment register (establishment and firm identifiers, used to identify mergers), FIRM firm-level register (general firm information, NACE Rev. 2 industry codes), VARS, the Danish version of the PRODCOM production survey (product sales at CN 10-digit level, aggregated to 8-digit), UHDI foreign trade register (exports by product and destination), IDAN and BEF individual-level registers (number of employees aged 18–65)
关键变量
  • 处理：横向并购事件（收购方取得同一 4 位数行业中目标方的全部所有权）
  • 结果变量：国内产品数量（CN 8 位数），分别就收购方以及收购方与目标方合计计算
  • 结果变量：国内销售在各产品间的偏斜程度（Theil 指数）；销售额最高、居中和最低产品的销售额
  • 结果变量：出口目的地数量、出口产品数量以及每个目的地的产品数量
  • 结果变量：出口目的地的距离排名和进口成本排名
  • 对照组：从未并购的企业；匹配的合成并购
时期
1996–2015
样本
识别出 4,580 起横向并购交易；估计样本中，国内结果变量为 139 个并购事件（160 起交易），出口结果变量为 492 个并购事件（574 起交易）；基准回归中 N = 21,843 和 67,120 个观测值（第 2.2 节和第 4.2 节，图 2 和图 3） 1996–2015 年丹麦私营行业的企业：国内横向并购（收购方与目标方属于同一 4 位数行业）中的收购方，加上从未并购的对照企业；国内产品结果变量涵盖雇员不少于 10 人的制造业企业，出口结果变量涵盖雇员不少于 5 人的企业。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Merger (change of establishment ownership) 企业特征与生产率
    Following Smeets et al. (2016): the establishment register IDAS has an establishment identifier that stays fixed under ownership changes and gives the establishment's firm identifier in the current and following year. A change in the firm identifier to that of an existing firm is classified as a change of ownership and hence a merger. The acquirer is the firm identifier used after the merger; the target is the identifier observed before the merger that then disappears. Partial acquisitions (13.9% of deals), joint mergers that form a new firm identifier, and spurious identifier changes are excluded, giving 8,344 merger deals for 1996-2015.
    登记库： IDAS
    工作论文 · Sections 2.1-2.2, footnotes 6-7
  • Horizontal merger 部门与行业
    Deals in which the acquirer and target operate within the same 4-digit industry (NACE Rev. 2 classification from FIRM, private industries only). Roughly 55% (4,580) of the mergers identified over the sample period are horizontal by this definition.
    登记库： FIRM
    代码： Same 4-digit NACE Rev. 2 industry
    工作论文 · Sections 2.1-2.2
  • Domestic sales by product 贸易与离岸外包
    Total product sales from VARS (the Danish version of PRODCOM) are aggregated from the Combined Nomenclature 10-digit to the 8-digit level to match the trade data; domestic sales are total sales in VARS minus exports in UHDI at the product level. For a small fraction of product-year observations exports exceed total sales, because export values may include traded goods while VARS excludes goods for resale; products with negative domestic sales are dropped in the baseline. VARS covers firms with 10 or more employees in manufacturing and raw material extraction; the trade data cover all industries without a size limit.
    登记库： VARS, UHDI
    代码： CN 8-digit products; VARS firms with 10 or more employees
    工作论文 · Section 2.1, footnote 8
  • Event window and estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Event window of seven years: the pre-merger period is the four years before and including the merger year and the post-merger period the three years after; more distant years are binned. A merger event may comprise several deals in a calendar year, at least one of them horizontal. Regressions on domestic sales from VARS require 10 or more employees and export regressions 5 or more, with the number of employees aged 18 to 65 computed from IDAN and BEF. Acquirers with multiple horizontal merger events, and mergers within seven years of another deal by the same acquirer, are excluded.
    登记库： IDAN, BEF, VARS, UHDI
    代码： Employees >= 10 (VARS sample) or >= 5 (export sample); 139 merger events (160 deals) domestic, 492 merger events (574 deals) export
    工作论文 · Sections 4.1-4.2, footnote 16
  • Skewness of sales across products 企业特征与生产率
    Skewness is used as an index of inequality in the distribution of product sales, not in its statistical sense of asymmetry; it is measured by the Theil index of the market shares of the firm's different products.
    登记库： VARS, UHDI
    工作论文 · Section 4.2, footnote 15

Do Export Support Programs Affect Prices, Quality, Markups, and Marginal Costs? Evidence From a Natural Policy Experiment

Magnus T. Buus, Jakob R. Munch, Joel Rodrigue and Georg Schaur · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2025 · 企业

利用丹麦贸易委员会（Danish Trade Council）向企业提供出口支持过程中的一个准自然实验。出口支持提高了企业在目的地市场内的出口，但价格、质量、加成率和边际成本均未改变，这与企业靠移动需求而非改变产品来实现海外增长的解释相一致。

数据
Trade Council export promotion records: firm purchases and Trade Council approaches by destination, International Trade in Goods statistics: Intrastat and Extrastat firm exports by CN8 product and destination (UHDI), Manufacturers' Sales of Goods (VARES/Prodcom): firm sales by product, value and quantity, Firm Statistics Register (FirmStat) and Firm Accounts Statistics (FIRE)
关键变量
  • 处理：在 t 年或 t-1 年为某一目的地购买出口促进服务
  • 工具变量：Trade Council 是否主动接洽该企业
  • 结果变量：企业—产品—目的地层面的出口销售额
  • 结果变量：出口单位价值（价格）、质量、加成率和边际成本
时期
2002–2015
样本
18,181 个企业—年份（Prodcom 数据中的制造业出口企业，77 个目的地） 2002–2015 年出现在生产数据中、至少有 10 名雇员、向 Trade Council 所服务的 77 个目的地出口的丹麦制造业出口企业。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Export support treatment 贸易与离岸外包
    Dummy equal to 1 if the firm purchased an export promotion service from the Danish Trade Council for a given destination (or, at firm level, any destination) in year t or year t-1; multiple purchases within a year are not distinguished (collapsed with max). Trade Council records restricted to 2002-2015 with non-missing destination.
    登记库： Trade Council export promotion records (promodata.dta)
    代码： treated=1 for all promodata cases, 0 for turned-down cases (tdc.dta); treated_2 = (treated_1==1 | L.treated_1==1)
    复制代码 · BMRS_restat/4_reg_variables/code/4_4_promotion.do; 1_data/code/1_5_promotion.do; 2_prepare/code/2_2_variables.do
  • Trade Council initiative (instrument) 贸易与离岸外包
    Dummy equal to 1 if the firm was contacted (approached) by the Trade Council for a destination, defined over both purchased cases and turned-down cases where contact was established but no support was bought; used as of year t or t-1 like the treatment.
    登记库： Trade Council export promotion records (promodata.dta, tdc.dta)
    代码： tdcinitiative=1 if firm contacted by the TC; tdcinitiative_2 = (tdcinitiative_1==1 | L.tdcinitiative_1==1)
    复制代码 · BMRS_restat/1_data/code/1_5_promotion.do; 4_reg_variables/code/4_4_promotion.do
  • Firm-product-destination exports and quantity 贸易与离岸外包
    Export value (1000 DKK) by firm, CN8+ product, destination and year from the trade-in-goods statistics, exports only. Quantity is weight in kg unless the supplementary unit is not kg, is unique within the product, and the value of observations with non-missing amounts is at least that with non-missing weights, in which case the supplementary amount is used; observations with zero/missing value or quantity are dropped. A variant keeps only flows above 7.5 (1000 DKK).
    登记库： UHDI
    代码： ie=="2" (exports); value vrd, weight vgt, amount mgd, unit enhedskode ("00" = kg); vrd_exp_exsmall if vrd_exp>7.5
    复制代码 · BMRS_restat/1_data/code/1_3_export_import.do; 4_reg_variables/code/4_3_export.do
  • Product classification (CN8+) 贸易与离岸外包
    CN8 product codes are made consistent over 2002-2015 by aggregating to CN8+ categories using the Van Beveren et al. (2012) algorithm; each CN8+ code is assigned the CN6 category with the largest Prodcom sales value.
    登记库： UHDI, VARS

  • Firm-year estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Firm-years present in the Prodcom (manufacturers' sales) data from 2002, matched to FIRM and FIRE, in manufacturing with at least 10 employees year by year (employees >= 9.5), observed in FIRM in the previous year, and with positive sales, wage bill, capital and material expenditures.
    登记库： VARS, FIRM, FIRE

  • Capital, materials and wage bill inputs 企业特征与生产率
    Capital is the sum of FIRE balance-sheet asset items, deflated by the gross fixed capital formation index (NABK69) by 69-industry; material expenditures are krh (2001-2003) or krhe+kvv (2004 onward), deflated by the intermediate consumption index (NABP69); the wage bill (lgag) is deflated by the CPI (PRIS112). Firm-level inputs and sales are multiplied by the share of Prodcom sales value with non-missing quantity.

    Quarterly Prodcom reports of value and quantity per 10-digit product are summed to firm-product(CN8+ x unit)-year; missing firm IDs are imputed from report ID and alternative ID within 2002-2006 and 2007+ separately; observations with missing or zero quantity are dropped; firm industry is the DB07 code with the largest sales value.

Healthy at Work? Evidence from a Social Experimental Evaluation of a Firm-Based Wellness Program

Marianne Simonsen and Lars Skipper · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2025 · 个人 + 企业

一项跨工作场所的大型社会实验评估了一个由雇主出资的健康项目，并在登记库中追踪长达十二年。处理组工作场所的雇员在长达七年的时间里看全科医生的次数减少、购买的处方药减少，而住院、缺勤和离职没有变化，并在家庭内部存在一定的溢出效应。

数据
Healthy-at-Work randomised experiment records (work-unit assignment, September 2008), Primary care physician consultation records (Statistics Denmark registers), Prescription drug purchase records, Hospital contact / hospitalisation records, Employment, sickness absence and turnover registers, Socio-economic background registers
关键变量
  • 处理：工作单位被随机分配到 Healthy-at-Work 健康促进项目
  • 结果变量：初级保健医生就诊
  • 结果变量：处方药购买（是否购买、供应月数）
  • 结果变量：住院（躯体疾病、精神疾病）
  • 结果变量：病假缺勤和离职
  • 溢出结果变量：配偶的医疗服务使用
时期
2008 年随机分配；追踪至 2020 年（PCP 就诊和工作结果）、2019 年（处方）、2018 年（住院）
样本
314 个工作单位中的 7,541 名工人（处理组 3,735 人，对照组 3,806 人） 参加 Healthy-at-Work 实验的老年护理卫生工作者，分布在丹麦 11 个市镇 110 家雇主的 314 个工作单位。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Treatment assignment and study population 样本界定与时间
    Work units (314 units of eldercare workers across 110 employers in 11 municipalities) were randomised in September 2008, with 144 units (46%) assigned to Healthy-at-Work. The population is individuals employed at participating work units in the month just before randomisation (7,541 of 7,660 linked to registers). Treatment status is fixed at the initial randomisation month, so post-randomisation moves are ignored and estimates are intention-to-treat.
    登记库： Healthy-at-Work experimental records, Statistics Denmark registers (CPR-linked)
    工作论文 · Sections 2.1, 3 and 4 (treatment assignment)
  • High-risk group 医疗服务利用
    Individuals with an above-median number of primary care physician consultations in the six months before randomisation; the low-risk group is at or below the median.
    登记库： Primary care physician consultation records (Statistics Denmark)

  • Primary care physician consultations 医疗服务利用

    登记库： Primary care physician fee-for-service records (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 3; Section 4 results; cost-benefit section

    登记库： Hospital contact records (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Table 4 panels A-D
  • Sickness absence 就业与劳动力状态
    Any absence and yearly absence rate (share of scheduled hours missed), conditional on hours > 0. Absence data cover about 95% of the sample.
    登记库： Absence register (Statistics Denmark; name not given)

Is Parental Leave Costly for Firms and Coworkers?

Anne Ardila Brenøe, Serena Canaan, Nikolaj A. Harmon and Heather N. Royer · Journal of Labor Economics, 2024 · 个人 + 企业

将有女性雇员即将生育的丹麦小企业与没有即将发生生育的类似企业进行比较。几乎没有证据表明企业产出或同事受到负面影响：多数企业通过雇用临时工和增加其他雇员的工时来填补缺勤，只有无法重新分配工作的企业才出现损失。

数据
Central Person Registry with parent-child links (CPR/BEF), Parental leave benefit payouts and employer leave reimbursements, Central education register (UDDA), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Annual employer wage payment records (CON and RAS), Mandatory pension contributions for approximate hours (ATP), Value-added tax (VAT) firm sales and purchases data
关键变量
  • 处理：小型私营企业的一名女性雇员生育（事件年）
  • 结果变量：企业就业人数、全职当量工时、工资总额（总额及剔除休假部分）、销售额、毛利润的代理指标、存活
  • 结果变量：同事的工时、劳动收入、就业和病假天数
  • 机制：企业内的育儿假天数
  • 设计：采用匹配对照事件的动态双重差分
时期
2001–2013 年（生育发生在 2003–2012 年）
样本
24,829 个处理事件（生育）和 162,151 个对照事件，涉及 45,940 家不同企业；修剪后为 16,080 家企业中的 9,934 个处理事件 受雇于丹麦私营部门小企业的壮年（21–35 岁）女性的生育，与没有此类生育的匹配对照企业相比较。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Treatment and control events 样本界定与时间
    Potential event = a woman's main job at a firm in a baseline year; event year = baseline + 2. Treatment event: woman gives birth in the event year but not in the year before or after; control event: no birth in the event year, the year before or the year after. Woman aged 19-33 at baseline, at least one year tenure at the baseline firm and not a student.
    登记库： CPR, IDA
    工作论文 · Sections 5.1-5.2; Appendix C.2
  • Small private firm sample 企业特征与生产率
    Private-sector firm (CVR) with 3-30 employees in November of the baseline year and fewer than 60 employment relationships during the baseline year; active at baseline (hours at least one FTE, positive sales and wage payments in baseline, positive sales or wages the year before); sales per employee 10,000 DKK-100 million DKK and wages per worker 10,000 DKK-1 million DKK.
    登记库： IDA, VAT, CON, RAS
    工作论文 · Section 5.2; Appendix C.2
  • Firm employees (November stock) 就业与劳动力状态
    Standard IDA main November employment relationship: worker counted at the firm if their main job was there in the last week of November; includes workers on leave. Main job = job with most hours, ties broken by highest earnings.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 4.2; Appendix C.1
  • FTE hours from ATP contributions 工作时间
    Approximate yearly hours from mandatory ATP pension contributions (step schedule for 0-9, 9-17, 18-26 and 27+ weekly hours, topping out at full time, 37 hours), scaled to full-time equivalents (Lund and Vejlin 2016); share of year on paid parental leave subtracted since ATP continues during paid leave. Misses overtime.
    登记库： ATP
    工作论文 · Section 4.2; Appendix C.1
  • Wage bill and wage bill ex. leave 劳动收入与收入
    Total wage bill = sum of all pre-tax payments to workers in the year (from CON and RAS), including payments to workers on paid leave. Wage bill ex. leave: each worker's wage = payments / ATP hours incl. paid leave, multiplied by hours excluding paid leave; the gap (paid leave covered by the firm) is subtracted from the total wage bill.
    登记库： CON, RAS, ATP
    工作论文 · Section 4.2; Appendix C.1
  • Sales, gross profit proxy and survival 企业特征与生产率
    Total sales and purchases from VAT data (corrected to include exports; negative values recoded to zero). Gross profit proxy = sales minus purchases minus wage bill ex. leave (purchases include capital equipment). Total variable costs = purchases + wage bill ex. leave. Exiting firms kept with zero employees/hours/sales; shutdown proxied by zero sales.
    登记库： VAT
    工作论文 · Section 4.3; Appendix C.1
  • Parental leave days 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Total days of paid and unpaid leave from payouts of parental leave benefits to individuals and leave reimbursements to firms, incl. pregnancy-related extensions; prenatal and postnatal days allocated around the birth; truncated at 38 weeks any prenatal, 6 weeks paid prenatal, 52 weeks paid postnatal, 104 weeks any postnatal.
    登记库： Parental leave benefit payouts, Employer leave reimbursements
    工作论文 · Section 4.1; Appendix C.1
  • Coworker sample 样本界定与时间
    Male and female coworkers of event women in the baseline year whose job at the baseline firm is their main labour market attachment, with hours at least half an FTE and earnings above 75,000 DKK in the baseline year; followed even if they leave the firm.
    登记库： IDA, ATP
    工作论文 · Section 5.4; Appendix C.2
  • Coworker sick days 医疗服务利用
    Take-up of publicly paid sick days (any sick days); eligibility for public sickness funds starts after two weeks of sickness, so the measure captures longer sickness spells.
    工作论文 · Section 6, footnote 18; Figure 7(d)

Credit Supply Shocks and Prices: Evidence from Danish Firms

Tobias Renkin and Gabriel Züllig · AEJ: Macroeconomics, 2024 · 企业

将丹麦企业—银行关系的贷款层面数据与调查所得的生产者价格和出口单位价值相结合。往来银行受全球金融危机冲击的企业，贷款减少、利率上升，并把产出价格提高 3% 至 5% 以获取现金；需求弹性越大，提价幅度越小。

数据

  • 中间结果变量：企业银行贷款与平均利率
  • 异质性：产品需求弹性
时期
2005–2010
样本
1,753 家企业（其中 213 家与 PPI 调查匹配，1,176 家与出口数据匹配） 2005–2010 年持续经营、至少有十名雇员且在 2007 年有活跃银行借贷关系的丹麦制造业企业。 来源
调查
Producer Price survey
变量如何定义（10）
  • Firm exposure to wholesale-funded banks 企业特征与生产率
    Share of wholesale-funded banks in the firm's 2007 loan portfolio. Descriptive bins: no exposure (<0.02), low (0.02-0.5), high (0.5-0.98), full (>0.98).
    登记库： Bank account-level loan reports, Bank balance sheets
    代码： <0.02, 0.02-0.5, 0.5-0.98, >0.98
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Figure A.4 and Table A.2 notes
  • Firm bank loans 财富、负债与消费
    Account balance as of December 31 summed over all of a firm's bank loan relationships reported by banks to the Danish Tax Authority, including regular and syndicated loans, credit card debt and variable-utilisation accounts (revolving loans, overdrafts). Mortgages are not included because they are provided by specialised mortgage institutions outside the banking system.
    登记库： URTEVIRK
    论文正文 · Section I.A (Loan Data)
  • Average interest rate on bank loans 企业特征与生产率
    Because contractual rates are often missing in the loan micro data, the average interest rate is computed as interest paid divided by the average of current and lagged end-of-year loan balances (Equation 1); regression of it on the contractual rate gives a coefficient of 0.91 for rates below 0.1.
    登记库： Bank account-level loan reports to the tax authority
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Figure A.3 notes
  • Producer prices (PPI microdata) 企业特征与生产率
    Monthly transaction prices (DKK, incl. temporary sales and discounts) reported by firms in the PPI survey for products classified by eight-digit HS codes; baseline uses domestic prices only. Prices are quality-adjusted, monthly price changes winsorized at +/-1 log points, and the data converted to quarterly frequency by keeping the price in the first month of each quarter.
    登记库： Producer Price Index survey microdata (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： 8-digit Harmonized System product codes
    论文正文 · Section I.B (Price Data)
  • Export unit values 贸易与离岸外包
    Annual firm-level unit values for 8-digit Combined Nomenclature (CN) goods = export revenue / export quantity. CN revisions handled by identifying one-to-one, many-to-one, one-to-many and many-to-many concordance sets between consecutive years; log changes computed over mapped sets (physical weight used if units differ); aggregated to firm-level 2-digit CN geometric mean indices weighted by year y-1 sales.
    登记库： Customs export data
    代码： CN8 -> CN2
    在线附录 · Online Appendix B, eq. B.1-B.2
  • Firm sample 样本界定与时间
    Starting from the complete 2007 Danish firm register, cumulative restrictions: active manufacturing firms (7,281); more than 10 employees (3,322); at least one bank connection (3,295); survival 2005-2010 (2,703); bank loans >100,000 DKK in 2006 and 2007 and 2007 loan-to-sales ratio >0.01 (1,753 firms; 213 matched to PPI, 1,176 to export unit values). Positive outstanding loans in 2006 and 2007 are required to compute the 2007 average interest rate control.
    登记库： Firm register, Bank loan reports to the tax authority

  • Product demand elasticity 贸易与离岸外包

Baseline: 4-digit SITC Rev. 3 estimates matched to HS 6-digit codes (94% of PPI products; 98.9% after filling with 4-digit averages); for unit values, the volume-weighted mean elasticity within the firm's 2-digit CN cell (98.5% matched). Alternative: 10-digit HS estimates (86.4% of PPI, 96% of unit value sample matched).

  • Gross operating margin 企业特征与生产率

Accounting profits are after interest, taxes and depreciation; total inventories include raw/intermediate inputs and pre-payments, final goods inventories only produced goods.

Externalities in International Tax Enforcement: Theory and Evidence

Thomas Tørsløv, Ludvig Wier and Gabriel Zucman · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2023 · 企业

作者认为，高税率国家的税务机关打击向避税地转移利润的激励较弱，转而去调整与其他高税率国家之间的交易，因为这类案件更容易胜诉。丹麦税务机关全部转让定价调整的案件层面数据显示，约 82% 的调整金额涉及其他高税率国家，因此这些调整增加了丹麦的税收，同时略微降低了企业的全球税负。跨国调查和争议统计数据显示出同样的规律，一个税收执法模型可以解释这一规律。

数据
Danish tax authority internal confidential micro-data: universe of transfer price corrections initiated in 2009, 2014 and 2015, with the demanded increase in the tax base and the counterpart countries, Danish data on completed Mutual Agreement Procedures, 2008–2015 (cannot be linked to the corrections at case level), Danish court appeals of transfer price corrections, 2011–2016, ORBIS (Bureau van Dijk) links between Danish multinational entities and their foreign related parties, used as a random-audit benchmark, Cross-country aggregates (not Danish): EY 2014 transfer pricing tax authority survey of 26 economies, EU Joint Transfer Pricing Forum and OECD Mutual Agreement Procedure statistics, Statutory tax rates (KPMG) and effective tax rates and profit-shifting estimates from Tørsløv et al. (2020)
关键变量
  • 单位：转让定价调整案件（要求调增的税基、对方国家）
  • 关键指标：税率差，即丹麦公司税率减去对方国家公司税率
  • 结果变量：涉及避税地与涉及其他高税率国家的调整所占份额（按件数和按欧元金额计）
  • 结果变量：隐含的丹麦及国外税收收入变动
  • 结果变量：企业就哪些调整向法院提起上诉
  • 异质性：总部设在丹麦的跨国公司与外国跨国公司的丹麦子公司
时期
2009 年和 2014–2015 年（调整）；2008–2015 年（相互协商程序，Mutual Agreement Procedures）；2011–2016 年（法院上诉）
样本
2009 年、2014 年和 2015 年启动的 185 项转让定价调整，平均每年 62 项（第 4.1 节和表 1） 丹麦税务机关在 2009 年、2014 年和 2015 年对跨国公司启动的全部转让定价调整；未导致调整的稽查无法观测到。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Universe of Danish transfer price corrections 样本界定与时间
    Internal confidential micro-data on the universe of transfer price corrections undertaken by the Danish tax authority for 2009 and 2014-15, the only years for which comprehensive data are available. Corrections involve transfer prices of goods and services, debt shifting, intra-group sales of intangibles and abuses of double-tax treaties. The data include the increase in the tax base demanded and the names of the counterpart countries. The ultimate outcome of cases is not tracked, and audits that did not result in any correction are not observed.
    登记库： Danish tax authority internal transfer pricing case data
    代码： Years 2009, 2014 and 2015; 185 corrections in total
    工作论文 · Section 4.1 and footnote 6
  • Auxiliary Mutual Agreement Procedure and court-appeal data 样本界定与时间
    Because final outcomes are not tracked in the corrections data, it is supplemented with data on completed Mutual Agreement Procedures covering 2008-15 and data on court appeals covering 2011-16. These sources could not be linked at the micro level, so a case cannot be followed from start to finish. The final outcome of court appeals is not observed.
    登记库： Danish tax authority internal transfer pricing case data
    代码： Mutual Agreement Procedures 2008-2015; court appeals 2011-2016
    工作论文 · Sections 4.1 and 4.1.3
  • Tax rate differential 税收与税率
    Danish corporate tax rate less the counterpart country's tax rate, using statutory rates from KPMG (2018); robustness versions use effective tax rates from Tørsløv et al. (2020). The benchmark for random audits is the distribution of tax differentials between all Danish multinational entities (parents or subsidiaries) and their foreign related parties, built from ORBIS.
    登记库： Danish tax authority internal transfer pricing case data, ORBIS (Bureau van Dijk)
    工作论文 · Section 4.1.1; Figure 2 notes
  • Implied tax revenue impact of corrections 税收与税率
    Effect of the corrections on tax collection in Denmark and abroad if the corrections are fully realised, i.e. assuming they are not overturned in court or reduced in a Mutual Agreement Procedure and that profit increases in Denmark are matched by corresponding declines abroad. The decline in tax revenue abroad is computed with statutory tax rates for non-havens (KPMG 2018) and effective tax rates for havens (Tørsløv et al. 2020). Figures are averages for 2009, 2014 and 2015.
    登记库： Danish tax authority internal transfer pricing case data
    工作论文 · Table 1 notes
  • Tax haven 税收与税率
    Counterpart countries are classified as tax havens using the list in Tørsløv et al. (2020).
    代码： Belgium, Cyprus, Ireland, Netherlands, Hong Kong, Luxembourg, Malta, Marshall Islands, Puerto Rico, Switzerland, Singapore; smaller havens: Andorra, Anguilla, Antigua and Barbuda, Aruba, The Bahamas, Bahrain, Barbados, Belize, Bermuda, the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, Gibraltar, Grenada, Guernsey, the Isle of Man, Jersey, Lebanon, Liechtenstein, Macao, Mauritius, Monaco, the Netherlands Antilles, Panama, Samoa, Seychelles, St. Kitts and Nevis, St. Lucia, St. Vincent & Grenadines, Turks and Caicos, Vanuatu

Trade Shocks, Firm Hierarchies, and Wage Inequality

Benjamin U. Friedrich · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2022 · 个人 + 企业

利用企业层面的外国需求冲击以及 2006 年漫画危机后穆斯林对丹麦出口产品的抵制，表明贸易冲击通过改变企业层级结构来改变企业内部的工资不平等。增加一个层级会拉大整个企业内的工资差距，而抵制之后的层级削减则通过降薪、降职和人员流动压缩工资差距。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA) with DISCO occupation codes, Firm-Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (FIDA), Danish Business Register / firm statistics (GF): sales, value added, industry, Foreign Trade Statistics Register: firm-level exports by CN8 product and destination (UHDI), UN Comtrade bilateral trade flows (HS6), U.S. Imports of Merchandise, Penn World Tables distances, Brent oil prices (transport cost estimation)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：企业内部工资不平等（对数工资的标准差、90-10 差距）
  • 处理：基于职业划分的层级数
  • 工具变量：企业特定的世界进口需求冲击和运输成本冲击
  • 自然实验：2006 年穆斯林对丹麦出口产品的抵制（漫画危机）
时期
1999–2008
样本
12,470 家企业的 68,090 个企业—年度观测值（企业内部不平等回归） 1999–2008 年丹麦此前已存在的全部私营部门出口企业。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Occupational layer 职业与职位层级
    Workers' DISCO occupation code (DISCOALLE_INDK) harmonised to 3 digits and mapped to four hierarchical layers following Caliendo et al. via a DISCO3-to-PCS layer correspondence; missing layers imputed from the same worker-firm's adjacent years (up to 2 years), then from the layer whose average hourly wage is closest; firm-years with more than 20% of hours requiring imputation are set to missing.
    登记库： IDAP, FIDA
    代码： DISCOALLE_INDK; military code 0110/011000 recoded to 900; file correspondence_DISCO3_pcslayer
    复制代码 · Setup_Workerdata.do
  • Number of hierarchy layers 职业与职位层级
    Number of distinct occupational layers present in the firm-year (layers renumbered consecutively from the lowest present), missing if more than 20% of firm hours had imputed layers; alternative 3-layer versions collapse layers 1-2 or use DISCO 3-digit <200 for layer 3.
    登记库： IDAP, FIDA
    代码： layers = max(layerN); managers: first DISCO digit = 1
    复制代码 · Setup_Firm_Outcomes.do, lines ~72-185
  • Hourly wage and within-firm wage inequality 劳动收入与收入
    Hourly wage TIMELON (job earnings JOBLON / hours) for active November jobs (JOBLON and TIMELON > 0), CPI-deflated to 2000; observations below the 0.25th or above the 99.75th percentile of the yearly hourly wage distribution dropped; firm-year inequality is the s.d. of log hourly wages and percentile gaps 90-10, 75-25, 90-50, 50-10.
    登记库： IDAP
    代码： TIMELON, JOBLON; hours = JOBLON/TIMELON
    复制代码 · Setup_Firm_Outcomes.do, lines ~60-218; Setup_Workerdata.do
  • Private-sector sample 部门与行业
    Worker-level data restricted to IDA sector code 2 (private sector) before building firm outcomes.
    登记库： IDAP
    代码： SEKTOR == "2"
    复制代码 · Setup_Firm_Outcomes.do, line 14
  • Firm sales, value added, industry 企业特征与生产率
    Sales (GF_OMS), value added (GF_BAV) and full-time equivalent employment (GF_AARSV) from firm statistics, CPI-deflated; industry from DB93/DB03 9-, 27- and 53-group aggregations, 2007 industry carried forward to 2008 if missing; firm age = year - start year + 1.
    登记库： FIRM (GF), FIRE
    代码： GF_OMS, GF_BAV, GF_AARSV, GF_gr009_DB93/DB03, GF_gr027_DB93/DB03, GF_gr053_DB93/DB03
    复制代码 · Prepare_firmdata.do
  • Firm-level world import demand shock 贸易与离岸外包
    Firm-level Bartik shock: sum over HS6 product-destination pairs of the firm's pre-sample (first year exported, from 1998) export share times log world import demand, where world import demand is the destination country's total HS6 imports from the world excluding Denmark (Comtrade 1999-2008), aggregated to HS4/HS2 when HS6 unavailable.
    登记库： UHDI, UN Comtrade
    代码： UHDI ie == 2 (exports); vrd (value), vgt (weight); HS1988/92 concordance
    复制代码 · Setup_Tradedata_Bartik.do, sections 'Main Setup' and '(A) WID'
  • Transport cost shock 贸易与离岸外包
    Predicted transport costs per product-destination from US Imports of Merchandise estimates, combining HS2 group coefficients, log Brent oil price, log distance, their interaction and (for one version) new-EU-member accession after 2003, weighted by the firm's pre-sample export shares.
    登记库： UHDI, US Imports of Merchandise, Brent oil prices
    代码： neweumember = CY,CZ,EE,HU,LV,MT,PL,SI,SK & year > 2003
    复制代码 · Setup_Tradedata_Bartik.do, section '(B) Transport Costs'
  • Cartoon-crisis exposure (treatment) 贸易与离岸外包
    Treated firms exported to Muslim-majority countries (>50% Muslim population) in 2003-2005 and had more than 0.5% of 2005 exports going to those countries; control firms had no such exports in 2003-2005.

    复制代码 · Main_Sample_Cartoon.do, lines ~127-300
  • Offshoring indicator 贸易与离岸外包
    Firm imports (ie == 1) a product at HS4 or HS6 level that it also exports in the same year.
    登记库： UHDI
    代码： offshoring_hs4, offshoring_hs6

Constraints on Hours within the Firm

Claudio Labanca and Dario Pozzoli · Journal of Labor Economics, 2022 · 个人 + 企业

利用含工时信息的丹麦雇主—雇员匹配数据，以及 2010 年丹麦税制改革带来的税率变化。在工时约束较紧的企业中，雇员在税负变化时并不调整工时；而在更灵活的企业中，雇员既直接作出反应，也通过同事的溢出效应作出反应。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Wage statistics with annual regular and overtime hours (Lønstatistikken, LON), Firm Statistics Register (Firmstat), Danish Foreign Trade Statistics Register, Firm-Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (FIDA), Danish Tax Register (income tax records), O*NET occupational data
关键变量
  • 结果变量：年工作小时数（正常工时加加班工时）
  • 处理：2010 年丹麦税制改革引起的模拟边际税率变化（2008–2011 年区间）
  • 调节变量：企业层面的工时约束／协调，以企业内部工时的离散程度衡量
  • 小时工资：年劳动收入除以总工时
  • 溢出效应：同事的税收变化
时期
2003–2011
样本
超过 400,000 名雇员和约 8,300 家企业（787,683 个个人—年观测值） 2003–2011 年私营企业中年龄 15–65 岁的全职雇员，所在企业至少 95% 的员工有工时报告（工作论文版本“Coordination of Hours within the Firm”，IZA DP 12062）。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Annual hours worked 工作时间
    Annual hours of regular plus overtime work from Lønstatistikken (LON), reported by employers whose pension contributions depend on hours. Only firms where hours are observed for at least 95 percent of the workforce are kept; for spells in week 48 shorter than a year, hours and earnings are annualized.
    登记库： LON, IDA, FIDA
    工作论文 · Section 3 (The data)
  • Hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Annual earnings divided by the sum of regular and overtime hours.
    登记库： IDA, LON
    工作论文 · Section 3
  • Employer link and full-time sample 样本界定与时间
    Each employee is matched to the highest-paying employer in the employment spell of week 48 (FIDA). Sample: full-time employees aged 15-65 in 2003-2011, full-time defined (official definition) as working more than an average of 26 weekly hours over a year, in private firms covered by Firmstat.
    登记库： FIDA, Firmstat, IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3
  • Hours coordination (dispersion of hours across skill groups) 工作时间
    Standard deviation across skill groups in a firm-year of the average annual (regular plus overtime) hours of each skill group; firm measure is its average over 2003-2011. Lower dispersion means greater coordination. Skill groups are deciles of the sum of the fixed and time-varying individual components of an AKM hourly-wage model; alternative: education (primary/secondary/tertiary) x occupation (manager/middle manager/blue collar) cells.
    登记库： LON, IDA
    工作论文 · Section 4.3, equation (9)
  • Simulated marginal tax rate 税收与税率
    Marginal tax rate on labour income simulated from the Danish Tax Register with an extension of the Kleven-Schultz (2014) tax simulator to 2006-2011: increase in tax liability from raising labour income by 100 DKK, holding other income components fixed. Changes are taken over the 2008-2011 interval.
    登记库： Danish Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 5.2
  • Mechanical net-of-tax rate change (instrument) 税收与税率
    Post-reform (2011) marginal tax rate simulated using pre-reform (2008) income adjusted for inflation; the log change in the marginal net-of-tax rate from this mechanical rate instruments the observed change. For spillovers, the firm average of mechanical changes among high-income workers instruments the change in their average hours.
    登记库： Danish Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 5.5
  • High- vs low-income workers 税收与税率
    Low-income: tax-exempt or in the bottom tax bracket in 2008. High-income: in the middle or top bracket in 2008, excluding a residual group in the top bracket in 2008 predicted (from 2008 real income and the post-reform schedule) to fall into the bottom bracket in 2011.
    登记库： Danish Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 5.1
  • Firm productivity 企业特征与生产率
    Value added per employee and TFP from Firmstat accounting data; in some specifications value added per employee is instrumented with TFP. Construction details are in an online appendix not included in the WP.
    登记库： Firmstat
    工作论文 · Section 4.1, footnote 15; Figure notes

The Impact of Immigration on Firm-Level Offshoring

William W. Olney and Dario Pozzoli · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2021 · 个人 + 企业

以丹麦的难民分散安置政策为自然实验，使用 1995 至 2011 年全部企业和工人的匹配数据。移民外生流入某一市镇会在两个边际上减少企业层面的离岸外包，而移民与其来源国的联系则会增加对这些特定国家的离岸外包。

数据
Firm Statistics Register (FirmStat), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Firm-Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (FIDA), Foreign Trade Statistics Register: Intrastat and Extrastat firm-level imports (UHDI), Central Business Register (foreign ownership)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：离岸外包的广延边际（企业进口与自身产品属于同一 HS4 类别的产品）
  • 结果变量：狭义离岸外包规模的对数
  • 处理：非欧盟移民占市镇劳动力的份额
  • 工具变量：1986–1998 年空间分散安置政策（Spatial Dispersal Policy）下的难民安置（shift-share）
时期
1995–2011
样本
约 35,000 家企业和 100 万名工人 1995–2011 年 97 个市镇中雇员超过一人的丹麦私营部门企业的非平衡面板。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Narrow offshoring (volume and extensive margin) 贸易与离岸外包
    Sum of a firm's imports (Foreign Trade Statistics, Intrastat/Extrastat, 1995-2011) in the same product category as the firm's production (paper: same HS4 category; code: import product code equals the firm's export product code or domestic-production product code). Extensive margin = 1 if narrow offshoring > 0; intensive margin = log of narrow offshoring volume. Broad offshoring = all imports.
    登记库： UHDI (Foreign Trade Statistics: Intrastat/Extrastat), VARES (vars, firm product sales), FirmStat
    代码： uhdi ie=='1' imports, ie=='2' exports; product vare (8-digit CN) -> HS4_imp=int(vare/100), HS4_exp=int(vare/100); vars varenr -> HS4_dom_1=int(varenr/10000); narrow=(HS6_imp==HS6_exp | HS6_imp==HS6_dom_1); ext_narrow_off=(narrow_off>0); int_narrow_off=ln(narrow_off)
    复制代码 · Trade_data.sas; offshoring_project_will_dario.do (narrow offshoring block); working paper Section 3 and fn. 23
  • Non-EU immigrant share of municipality workforce 移民身份与来源地
    Share of workers in a municipality-year (IDA, workplace municipality akom) who are not natives, where natives are ie_type=='1' (Danish origin) or born in an EU15 country; lagged one year in regressions. 97 municipalities (Copenhagen and Frederiksberg combined; pre-2007 municipalities recoded to post-reform codes).
    登记库： IDA, ie_type (immigrant type/origin from BEF)
    代码： ie_type=='1' native; opr_land (ieland) EU15 codes 5126,5130,5180,5134,5142,5150,5108,5140,5156,5164,5170,5182,5104,5120 treated as natives; foreigner_nonEU=(natives!=1)

  • Shift-share instrument (predicted non-EU immigrant share) 移民身份与来源地
    For each origin country d, the national number of immigrants in year t is allocated to municipalities using the municipality's 1990 share of immigrants from d, summed over non-EU origins and normalized by municipality total employment in 1990.
    登记库： IDA (1990 extract idapall_eer_1990)

    From the first two digits of the highest completed education code (HFFSP): skill1 (medium) if 15, 20, 25, 35 or 40; skill2 (high) if 50, 60, 65 or 70; otherwise low (incl. missing). Years of education: 10->6, 15/35->10, 20/25/39->12, 40->14, 50/60->15, 65->17, 70->20, missing->6.

The Effect of Export Promotion on Firm-Level Performance

Jakob Munch and Georg Schaur · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2018 · 企业

评估丹麦贸易委员会（Danish Trade Council）的出口促进服务，在可观测特征的基础上把主动寻求帮助的企业与由委员会主动接触的企业区分开来。出口促进提高了销售额、增加值、就业和人均增加值；对小企业而言，增加值的增幅大约是直接成本的三倍。

数据
Danish Trade Council data on export promotion services (self-selected vs. Council-approached firms), Danish firm-level performance data (sales, value added, employment); specific registers not stated in abstract
关键变量
  • 处理：企业接受 Danish Trade Council 的出口促进服务
  • 比较：自行选择使用服务的企业与由 Trade Council 主动接触的企业
  • 结果变量：销售额、增加值、就业、人均增加值
  • 控制变量：大量企业特征（基于可观测变量的选择）
时期
所查资料中未注明
样本
所查资料中未注明 丹麦企业，将使用 Trade Council 出口促进服务的企业与可比的未使用企业进行比较。 来源（摘要）

Transfer Pricing by Multinational Firms: New Evidence from Foreign Firm Ownerships

Anca D. Cristea and Daniel X. Nguyen · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2016 · 企业

检验丹麦跨国公司是否通过压低对其拥有关联企业且公司税较低的国家的出口价格来转移利润。三重差分设计比较企业在某一目的地收购多数控股的关联企业前后的出口单位价值，并在相对丹麦税率不同的目的地之间进行比较，以没有关联企业的出口商为对照组。在税率较低的国家收购关联企业后，丹麦跨国公司对当地的出口单位价值平均下降 5.7% 至 9.1%。

数据
Firm Statistics Register (Statistics Denmark): employment, sales and industry for the universe of private-sector firms, Customs statistics on export transactions by firm, product and destination country (Statistics Denmark), Experian data on foreign ownership shares of Danish firms (from annual reports, supplemented with transaction records of the National Bank of Denmark), linked by the Statistics Denmark firm identifier, Statutory corporate tax rates: OECD Tax Database and World Tax Database (University of Michigan), Penn World Tables (population, per-capita GDP, exchange rate)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：按企业、产品、目的地和年份计的出口单位价值对数
  • 处理：企业在目的地国拥有多数控股的关联企业
  • 处理强度：丹麦与目的地之间公司税率差的绝对值，对低税率和高税率目的地分别计算
  • 对照组：在目的地没有关联企业的出口商
  • 控制变量：企业就业人数和销售额；目的地人口、人均 GDP、汇率
  • 异质性：差异化产品（Rauch 分类）；新设立的关联企业与存续的关联企业
时期
1999–2006
样本
1,203,111 个企业—产品—国家—年度观测值（工作论文表 1） 1999–2006 年经营的丹麦制造业出口商；跨国公司对其拥有多数控股关联企业的国家的出口占观测值的 11.4%。 来源
变量如何定义（4）
  • Export unit value 贸易与离岸外包
    Average unit values are computed by dividing annual export values by the quantities shipped (weight) at the firm-product-destination level. Observations with negative or missing export values, or with zero or missing weight, are dropped (about 4 percent of the data), and the top and bottom 1 percent of prices are dropped to remove measurement or keying errors.
    登记库： Customs statistics (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： Drop top and bottom 1 percent of prices
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Data), footnote 34
  • Majority-owned foreign affiliate (Affiliate) 企业特征与生产率
    Indicator equal to 1 if the Danish exporter has majority ownership of a local establishment in the destination market, built from Experian data on foreign firm ownership shares and merged with the customs data by the firm identifier used by Statistics Denmark. Holdings below the 50 percent majority break point are disregarded. For firms that establish an affiliate during the sample period, the observation for the year of acquisition is removed. The data do not show whether a given export transaction goes to an affiliated or an unrelated buyer.
    登记库： Experian foreign ownership data, Firm Statistics Register
    代码： Majority ownership (50 percent break point; FDI statistics use a 10 percent threshold)
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Data), footnotes 35-37; Table 3 notes
  • Tax wedge and low-/high-tax destination 税收与税率
    Absolute difference between the statutory corporate tax rate of the foreign country and that of Denmark, with indicator variables for countries with tax rates below (Low Tax) or above (High Tax) Denmark's rate. Tax rates are from the OECD Tax Database and, for non-OECD countries, the World Tax Database of the Office of Tax Policy Research at the University of Michigan.
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Data); Table 3 notes
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Manufacturing exporters operating during 1999-2006, drawn from the Firm Statistics Register, which covers the universe of private-sector Danish firms. The unit of observation is a firm-product-country-year quadruplet. Almost 3 percent of observations belong to Danish multinationals that establish their first majority-owned affiliate in a country during the sample period.
    登记库： Firm Statistics Register, Customs statistics (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： Years 1999-2006; manufacturing exporters; 1,203,111 observations
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Data); Table 1

Itzik Fadlon, Jessica Laird and Torben Heien Nielsen · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2016 · 个人 + 企业

一项改革削减了最高税级劳动者资本养老金账户的补贴，雇主随即减少了对这类账户的缴费，受影响雇员占比越大，减少幅度越大，并把资金转向年金账户。雇主缴费跟随雇员的储蓄偏好而变动。

The Wage Effects of Offshoring: Evidence from Danish Matched Worker-Firm Data

David Hummels, Rasmus Jørgensen, Jakob Munch and Chong Xiang · American Economic Review, 2014 · 个人 + 企业

将企业的产品层面进出口与工人工资相连接。在同一工作时段内，离岸外包提高高技能工人的工资、降低低技能工人的工资，而出口则提高所有工人的工资。常规性强或容易被离岸外包的任务受损最大。

数据
Firm Statistics Register (FirmStat/FIRM), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Firm-worker link (FIDA), Foreign Trade Statistics Register, Extrastat and Intrastat (UHDI), UN COMTRADE world trade data for instruments, Firm accounts and other firm registers (Data Appendix)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：工作时段内工人小时工资的对数
  • 处理：企业离岸外包（投入品进口）
  • 处理：企业出口
  • 工具变量：按产品和国家划分的世界出口供给冲击与世界进口需求冲击（COMTRADE），以及运输成本
  • 异质性：工人技能类型（高技能与低技能）
  • 结果变量：被裁工人的劳动收入损失
时期
1995–2006 年（贸易数据为 1990–2006 年）
样本
约 195 万个工人—企业—年份观测值和 9,800 个企业—年份观测值 既进口又出口的丹麦企业中的制造业工人，剔除仅持续一年的工作时段、技能水平发生变化的工人，以及雇员少于 50 人且进口额不足 60 万 DKK 的企业。 来源
变量如何定义（13）
  • Hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Wage rate uses annual hours from IDA (following Christensen et al. 2005); annual hours do not capture overtime. In a 2006 subsample with overtime data, a wage rate including overtime correlates 0.86 with the main wage rate.
    登记库： IDA
    在线附录 · Data Appendix, section 1
  • High- vs low-skilled worker 教育与考试成绩
    Robustness split of low-skilled workers into medium-skilled (vocational education, defined as the final stage of secondary education preparing for labour market entry) and very-low-skilled (high school equivalent or less); results very similar. Workers whose skill level changes during the sample period are dropped.
    登记库： IDA
    在线附录 · Data Appendix, section 1
  • Broad offshoring 贸易与离岸外包
    Total value of imports by a given manufacturing firm in a given year, from the Foreign Trade Statistics Register (Extrastat and Intrastat), recorded at CN8 and aggregated to HS6.
    登记库： Foreign Trade Statistics Register (UHDI)
    工作论文 · Section II.3
  • Narrow offshoring 贸易与离岸外包
    Machinery imports (HS 84 and HS 85, 16.9% of imports) are included in broad offshoring for all firms; narrow offshoring excludes them except for firms that themselves produce machinery for sale. Within HS 84 the top 20 HS6 import products (59% of HS 84 imports) are all parts rather than machines.
    登记库： Foreign Trade Statistics Register
    代码： HS 84; HS 85
    在线附录 · Data Appendix, section 3.2
  • World export supply and world import demand instruments 贸易与离岸外包
    WES: country c's total supply of HS6 product k to the world market minus its supply to Denmark in year t; WID: country c's total purchases of product k from the world market less purchases from Denmark; both from COMTRADE and weighted by pre-sample firm input/output shares; plus exchange rates and transport costs fitted from US imports data.
    登记库： UN COMTRADE, Foreign Trade Statistics Register
    工作论文 · Section III and Data Appendix section 2
  • Estimation sample (firms) 样本界定与时间
    Start from 2.8 million manufacturing worker-firm-year observations after merging workers, firms and trade. Drop worker-firm-years whose job spell lasts a single year (~200,000 obs); drop workers whose skill level changes in the sample (~35,000 obs); drop firms with fewer than 50 employees and less than DKK 0.6 million in imports (about two manufacturing workers' average annual wages) (~600,000 obs).
    登记库： IDA, FirmStat, Foreign Trade Statistics Register
    代码： firm size < 50 employees and imports < DKK 0.6m dropped

  • Firm controls 企业特征与生产率
    Firm identifier from 'Old Firm Statistics' (1995-1999) and 'General Firm Statistics' (1999-2006), combined in FirmStat to track firms across the 1999 break. Employees = number of full-time equivalent workers in the year (FirmStat). Capital stock = value of land, buildings, machines, equipment and inventory (Accounting Statistics register). Gross output (net of taxes) from the VAT register. Firm skill intensity = educational attainment of individual workers in IDA aggregated to the firm via FIDA.
    登记库： FirmStat, Old Firm Statistics, General Firm Statistics, Accounting Statistics, VAT register, IDA, FIDA

    IDA occupation uses the Danish version of ISCO-88, mapped to O*NET via the National Crosswalk Center crosswalk. Non-routine = principal component of O*NET 1.A.1.c.1 (mathematical reasoning), 1.A.2.b.3 (response orientation), 1.A.3.c.3 (gross body coordination), 2.A.1.e (mathematics), 4.A.2.b.2 (thinking creatively), 4.A.2.b.6 (organizing, planning, prioritizing). Routine = 1.A.2.a.2 (manual dexterity), 1.A.2.a.3 (finger dexterity), 1.A.2.b.2 (multilimb coordination), 4.A.2.a.2 (processing information), 4.A.2.a.3 (evaluating compliance with standards).
