Returns to Tenure or Seniority?

I. Sebastian Buhai, Miguel A. Portela, Coen N. Teulings and Aico van Vuuren · Econometrica, 2014 · 个人 + 企业

利用丹麦和葡萄牙的雇主—雇员匹配数据，把任职年限的工资回报与资历的回报区分开来，其中资历定义为劳动者的任职年限在同一企业同事中的排名。最后入职的劳动者最先离开；在给定任职年限和企业规模的条件下，资历排名越高，离职风险率越低，工资越高。在任职满十年时，资历第 10 与第 90 百分位之间的工资差距在丹麦为 1.1-1.4 个百分点，在葡萄牙为 2.3-3.4 个百分点。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Statistics Denmark, 1980–2001: annual (30 November) worker records with plant and firm identifiers, ATP mandatory pension contribution histories (tenure of workers hired 1964–1980), Quadros de Pessoal, Portuguese Ministry of Labour, 1986–2009 (Portuguese matched employer-employee data, not Danish)
关键变量
  • 关键解释变量：资历指数（企业规模的对数减去企业内任职年限排名的对数）
  • 结果变量：离职风险率（离散时间混合比例风险模型）
  • 结果变量：对数实际小时工资
  • 控制变量：任职年限、潜在工作经验、企业规模的对数、教育、行业和地区
  • 估计方法：OLS、Topel 一阶差分、Altonji-Shakotko、工作期固定效应
时期
丹麦 1980–2001 年；葡萄牙 1986–2009 年
样本
丹麦：12,634,236 个观测值，涉及 1,412,646 名劳动者、3,456,711 段工作期和 221,807 家企业；葡萄牙：15,371,019 个观测值，涉及 2,931,323 名劳动者和 458,888 家企业（2011 年 7 月“forthcoming in Econometrica”版本的表 1） 丹麦和葡萄牙 25 岁以上男性在私营部门的工作期（不含农业、渔业和采矿业）；离职风险模型在 5% 的样本上估计。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Seniority index (r_ijt) 职业与职位层级
    q_ijt is the log number of workers in firm j with tenure greater than or equal to that of worker i (including worker i) at time t, and n_jt is the log total number of workers in firm j at time t. The seniority index is r_ijt = n_jt - q_ijt: it equals log firm size for the most senior worker and zero for the least senior worker. An alternative index r*_ijt = q*_ijt - n_jt uses the log number of workers with tenure less than or equal to worker i's. Seniority is calculated before any data deletion.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： r_ijt = n_jt - q_ijt
    工作论文 · Section 2, equations (1) and (2); Section 3
  • Job tenure 就业与劳动力状态
    Labour market status is recorded on 30 November of each year. Tenure of workers hired since 1980 is calculated directly from IDA; for workers hired between 1964 and 1980 it is calculated from contribution histories to ATP, a mandatory pension program. Tenure in job spells started before 1964 is left censored (less than 3% of the observations, discarded). Potential experience is age minus schooling minus 6.
    登记库： IDA, ATP contributions
    代码： Hired >= 1980: IDA; hired 1964-1980: ATP; spells started before 1964 dropped
    工作论文 · Section 3 (The data)
  • Firm size and industry 企业特征与生产率
    IDA contains a plant identifier that allows the total workforce of a plant, and hence of the firm, to be constructed. Firm size is the number of individuals holding primary jobs in that firm and earning a positive wage. Industry is the industry employing the largest share of the firm's workforce.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3 (The data)
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    All private sector jobs except agriculture, fishing and mining. Wage observations below the legal minimum wage and the top 1% of the wage distribution are deleted for each year. Unless otherwise stated, employment spells of men aged over 25. Workers above age 55 are excluded from the LIFO duration analysis (spells started before 55 and finished afterwards are treated as right censored), but not from the construction of seniority or the wage analysis. Location and industry are taken at the start of the spell.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： Men aged > 25; age <= 55 in duration analysis; wages below minimum wage and top 1% dropped per year
    工作论文 · Section 3 (The data)
  • Log real hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Hourly gross earnings from IDA; log wages are expressed in euro and deflated to year 2000 prices. The wage regressions use the time-detrended log real hourly wage as dependent variable.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 3 and notes to Tables 1 and 5

Wages and Commuting: Quasi-natural Experiments' Evidence from Firms that Relocate

Ismir Mulalic, Jos N. van Ommeren and Ninette Pilegaard · Economic Journal, 2014 · 个人 + 企业

研究工人的通勤距离变长时工资是否会提高。利用工人所在企业迁至新地址所引起的通勤距离变化，比较同一搬迁企业中既未更换雇主也未搬家的工人。通勤距离每增加 1 km，搬迁后一年的工资几乎没有上升，三年后上升约 0.15%，作者将其解读为存在求职搜寻摩擦的证据。

数据
Annual register data from Statistics Denmark covering the full population of workers and firms, matched worker to establishment (2003–2005 in the working-paper version), Residence and establishment (workplace) addresses on 31 December each year; commuting distance computed as the shortest route between the exact addresses, Annual net wages derived from workers' pay slips as observed by the Danish Tax Authorities, Labour market register occupation code RASDISCO (4-digit job function), Firm units identified by SE number (tax authorities' register of enterprises liable to VAT)
关键变量
  • 处理：企业变更地址所导致的单程通勤距离变化（km）
  • 结果变量：年净工资对数的变化
  • 控制变量：企业固定效应、工人职务的变化（晋升的代理变量）
  • 异质性：丹麦通勤税收扣除的通勤距离区间（12.5–50 km、50 km 以上）
  • 选择性检验：针对留在原雇主和未迁居的 Heckman 模型
时期
2010 年工作论文中为 2003–2005 年（企业搬迁发生在 2004 年）；发表版本追踪搬迁后最长三年的工资，具体年份未经核实
样本
主样本为 1,144 家搬迁企业中的 6,165 名工人；全样本为 1,333 家企业中的 8,601 名工人（2010 年工作论文，Section 3.2 和 Table A1） 2004 年期间变更地址的企业中只有一份工作的全职工人，他们在 2003 年 1 月至 2005 年 12 月间留在该企业且未变更住所（工作论文版本；发表版本的样本可能不同）。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Workers of relocating firms (main and full samples) 样本界定与时间
    From the full population of 321,337 firms and 2,710,462 workers, firms that changed address between January 2004 and December 2004 are selected (11,314 firms; 64,643 workers). Dropped: records with missing information, workers with more than one job, part-time workers, address changes that imply no change in commuting distance, and outliers (commuting distance above 100 km, change in commuting distance above 50 km, absolute change in log wage above 0.5). This leaves a full sample of 8,601 workers in 1,333 firms; the main sample keeps workers who stayed with their firm and did not change residence from January 2003 to December 2005 (6,165 workers; 1,144 firms). Wages are compared between 2003 and 2005, the years in which commuting distance is constant.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark annual register data on workers and firms
    代码： Address change Jan 2004-Dec 2004; commuting distance > 100 km excluded; change in commuting distance > 50 km excluded; |change in log(wage)| > 0.5 excluded; full-time job lasting at least 1 year continuously
    工作论文 · Section 3.2 and Appendix A, Table A1
  • Commuting distance and its change 地理与社区
    One-way commuting distance in kilometres between the worker's residence and the establishment workplace, both observed on 31 December each year, calculated as the shortest route between the exact residence and workplace addresses. The treatment is the change in this distance caused by the firm's change of address. Interaction dummies mark commutes between 12.5 and 50 km (D12.5) and above 50 km (D50), the ranges in which the Danish commuting tax deduction applies.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark annual register data (residence and workplace addresses)
    代码： D12.5 = one-way commute between 12.5 and 50 km; D50 = one-way commute above 50 km
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; Table 2 notes
  • Change in log wage 劳动收入与收入
    Annual net wages, derived from workers' pay slips as observed by the Danish Tax Authorities. The dependent variable is log(wage 2005) minus log(wage 2003).
    登记库： Tax-authority pay slip records (via Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, footnote 9; Table 1
  • Change in worker's function 职业与职位层级
    Indicator for a change in the worker's job function between 2003 and 2005, used to control for promotions. Computed from the labour market administrative register variable RASDISCO, a 4-digit function code with more than a thousand function descriptions.
    登记库： RAS
    代码： RASDISCO (4-digit)
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, footnote 12
  • Firm unit (SE number) 企业特征与生产率
    The statistical unit of firms is an administrative unit in the tax authorities' register of enterprises liable to VAT, identified by its SE number. It usually equals the legal unit (the enterprise), but an enterprise may split its registration into several SE numbers; each SE number is treated as a separate firm. Workplace location is measured at the establishment, and the paper refers to establishments as firms.
    登记库： Tax authorities' register of enterprises liable to VAT (SE numbers)
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; Section 3.2, footnote 10

Tax Bunching, Income Shifting and Self-Employment

Daniel le Maire and Bertel Schjerning · Journal of Public Economics, 2013 · 个人

丹麦的自雇者在最高税率拐点处明显聚束，但其中很大一部分反映的是通过企业留存收益进行的收入跨期转移，而非努力程度的真实变化。把收入转移考虑进来之后，真实收入的弹性要小得多。

数据
Tax records of Danish self-employed individuals (taxable income, retained earnings)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：应税收入在税率表拐点处的聚束
  • 机制：通过企业税收方案中的留存收益进行跨期收入转移
  • 估计值：应税收入弹性（忽略收入转移时为 0.43–0.53；结构估计为 0.14–0.20）
时期
所查资料中未注明
样本
所查资料中未注明 丹麦的自雇纳税人。 来源（摘要）
变量如何定义（8）
  • Self-employed (main occupation) 就业与劳动力状态
    Persons whose primary occupation is self-employment, classified with the Statistics Denmark occupation variables pstill2 (primary) and sstill2 (secondary); narrower than Chetty et al. (2011), excluding wage earners with self-employment as secondary occupation.
    登记库： IDA, Income Tax Register
    代码： pstill2, sstill2
    工作论文 · Section 2.1, Table 1 notes
  • Analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    Entire population panel 1994-2009, aged 25-59, main occupation self-employment; restricted to self-employed whose spouse's primary or secondary occupation is not self-employment (because transfers to assisting spouses are only observed 1994-2001).
    登记库： Income Tax Register, IDA
    工作论文 · Section 2 'Data and Institutional Background'
  • Personal income 劳动收入与收入
    Sum of wage earnings, declared firm profits (net of retained earnings), remunerations, provisions, alimony etc. minus deductions; interest income is capital income and not part of personal income.
    登记库： Income Tax Register
    工作论文 · Figure 1 notes; Section 2.1
  • Taxable income relative to the effective kink 税收与税率
    For each individual, the difference between actual taxable income and the taxable income needed to reach the middle or top tax bracket, computed with the authors' own tax simulator accounting for special deductions and joint taxation of couples (simulated tax within +/-5 DKK of actual for 95% of the sample); distributions plotted in 1,000 DKK bins.
    登记库： Income Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 2 and Figure 2
  • Tax schedule kinks 税收与税率
    Piecewise-linear personal income tax with five brackets before 1996 and four from 1996; e.g. 2001: about 8% below 33,400 DKK, about 44% up to 179,900 DKK (bottom tax), 49% above (middle tax) and 63% above 279,900 DKK (top tax). Top-tax base is mainly individual; middle-tax base depends on household income; middle cutoff raised to the top cutoff in 2009.
    登记库： Income Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 2
  • Business tax scheme and retained earnings 企业特征与生产率
    Self-employed choose the personal income tax scheme, the capital returns scheme (from 1993) or the firm tax scheme (from 1987); the latter two are treated as one and allow retaining profits in the firm, taxed provisionally at the firm tax rate (34% in 1994 falling to 25% in 2009), with withdrawals taxed as personal income. Retained earnings = profits retained under these schemes.
    登记库： Income Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 2.1 'Three Tax Schemes for the Self-employed'; Table 2
  • Earned income 劳动收入与收入
    Income before shifting: personal income plus retained earnings plus income shifted along other margins such as pension contributions and transfers to assisting spouses; used (adjusted for income shocks) to estimate the real bunching response.
    登记库： Income Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 4 discussion of Figures 11-12
  • Excess mass at kink (bunching) 税收与税率
    Excess mass at the tax cutoff estimated following Saez (2010) within a bandwidth around the kink, applied to taxable income and to adjusted earned income; the dynamic extension separates bunching from intertemporal shifting via retained earnings.
    登记库： Income Tax Register
    工作论文 · Section 3-4, equation (3)

Is Business Failure Due to Lack of Effort? Empirical Evidence from a Large Administrative Sample

Mette Ejrnæs and Stefan Hochguertel · Economic Journal, 2013 · 个人

丹麦的自雇者可以自愿购买失业保险，这为检验道德风险提供了机会。基于一个大型行政面板数据，研究发现参保的创业者更可能关闭企业并进入失业状态，且这一效应随着取得资格的日期临近而增强，这与努力程度下降相一致，而不能仅用选择效应来解释。

数据
CAM 10% Sample: 10% random sample of the Danish population aged 16+ (linked administrative registers incl. tax and benefit records), Unemployment insurance fund membership records
关键变量
  • 结果变量：由自雇转入失业（登记失业时间 >10% 的全年时间）
  • 处理：失业保险基金成员身份（参保状态）
  • 工具变量：仅向失业保险基金成员开放的提前退休计划（VERP）的资格
  • 估计方法：双变量随机效应 probit
时期
1981–1998
样本
13,434 人、86,092 个观测值（估计样本） 出生于丹麦、年龄 25–59 岁的丹麦籍男性，在其被观测到的前三年为自雇者，不含农业，取自 CAM 10% 样本。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • CAM 10% sample 样本界定与时间
    10% random sample of the Danish population aged 16 and above from the Danish National Register, followed annually from 1981; waves up to and including 1998 are used. Unbalanced: new residents turning 16 or immigrating enter, people leave through death or emigration.
    登记库： CAM 10% Sample
    工作论文 · Section 4.1 (Register Data)
  • Self-employment / labour market status 就业与劳动力状态
    Labour market status is recorded in calendar week 48 (late November) of each year; individuals are classified as self-employed according to their main economic activity in that week. Persons originally classified as 'on leave' (possible for UI fund members from 1994) are re-classified to their state of origin.
    登记库： CAM 10% Sample
    工作论文 · Section 4.1 and footnote 22
  • Unemployment (outcome) 失业与福利金
    Indicator equal to one if the individual was registered unemployed in excess of 10% of the year according to the annual 'unemployment degree' (fraction of the year UI benefits are received), zero otherwise. 'Unemployed' means registered as such with the job centre, which also covers non-UI-members on social assistance; an alternative measure is the week-48 unemployment stock.
    登记库： CAM 10% Sample
    工作论文 · Sections 4.1 and 5.1
  • UI fund membership (insured) 失业与福利金
    Membership in an unemployment insurance fund, as recorded in the administrative data; 'insured' and UI fund member are used interchangeably. Treatment enters the unemployment equation lagged one year (status in t-1).
    登记库： CAM 10% Sample
    工作论文 · Section 4.1 (fn. 16) and Section 5.1
  • Early retirement (VERP) eligibility instrument 退休与养老金
    Institutional-rule indicator of eligibility for the UI-fund-linked early retirement (ER) scheme (retirement from age 60). Before 1992 members qualified with 10 years of UI membership before age 60 ('10-year rule'); the 1992 reform required at least 20 years ('20-year rule', latest joining age 40), with those aged 40-50 in 1992 required to join in 1992 and stay until 60. Identification comes from changes over year and cohort in this rule.
    登记库： CAM 10% Sample
    工作论文 · Section 2 (institutions) and Sections 5.1-5.2
  • Analysis sample restrictions 样本界定与时间
    Denmark-born males with Danish citizenship aged 25-59; excludes students, retirees, persons out of the labour force in every year, persons receiving public pensions, and anyone who worked as wage earner or self-employed in agriculture 1981-1998; requires at least one employment spell. Estimation sample: persons self-employed in their first three observed years and not unemployed (>10% measure) in any of those years (13,434 individuals, 86,092 obs).
    登记库： CAM 10% Sample
    工作论文 · Sections 4.1 and 5.1
  • Health proxy (sickness benefits) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Receipt of sickness benefits is used as the health or illness measure because of data limitations.
    登记库： CAM 10% Sample
    工作论文 · Section 5.2
  • Self-employment income 劳动收入与收入
    Income from self-employment (surplus or profit of business), entered linearly with a dummy for negative values; income and wealth measured in constant 1981 million DKK. Controls also include receipt of start-up allowance (for entrants from unemployment via active labour market programmes) and regional unemployment calculated from the micro data.
    登记库： CAM 10% Sample
    工作论文 · Section 5.2

Productivity Spillovers Across Firms through Worker Mobility

Andrey Stoyanov and Nikolay Zubanov · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2012 · 个人 + 企业

追踪丹麦制造业中工人在企业间的流动。从生产率更高的企业招聘工人的企业，生产率会随之提高，对一家平均水平的企业而言每年约 0.35%；这一增益随新雇员的教育、任职年限和技能水平而上升，并持续数年，与由工人携带的知识溢出相一致。

数据
Matched employer-employee data from Statistics Denmark (worker records from 1983, ages 15–65), Manufacturing firm-level accounts data with sales, value added, materials, capital and investment, 1995–2007
关键变量
  • 结果变量：接收企业的人均增加值对数，以 4 位数行业—年份均值作标准化
  • 处理：新雇用工人的流出企业与接收企业之间的生产率差距，以新雇员占就业的份额加权
  • 正向和负向生产率差距（来自生产率更高的企业与来自生产率更低的企业的新雇员）
  • 工人特征：教育、职业/技能水平、工作经验、工资
  • 企业特征：规模、行业
时期
1995–2007
样本
173,929 个企业—年度观测值（约 580 万个工人—年度观测值，668,034 名换工作者）；基准回归使用 74,507 和 61,112 个企业—年度观测值 1995–2007 年丹麦全部制造业企业及其年薪为正的雇员。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Normalized labour productivity 企业特征与生产率
    Natural log of firm value added per worker normalized by the 4-digit NACE industry-year average; manufacturing firms 1995-2007, with firm accounts from annual surveys (all firms with 50+ workers) and interpolated values for less frequently surveyed small firms.
    登记库： Firm-level accounts (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： NACE 4-digit
    论文正文 · Section I.A
  • Productivity gap of new hires 企业特征与生产率
    Split into four groups by sending firm: from more productive firms in the same 2-digit industry (gap_p_same), more productive firms in a different industry (gap_p_diff), less productive same industry (gap_n_same), less productive different industry (gap_n_diff). Regressions include five lags of value added per worker (autocorrelation insignificant at the sixth lag), industry-year fixed effects and average size of the sending firm; period 1995-2007; firm-specific trend robustness restricted to firms with 50+ workers.
    登记库： Matched employer-employee data, Firm accounts data
    代码： firms >=50 workers (trend robustness)
    在线附录 · Web Appendix A1-A3, Tables A2-A4
  • Job mover / new hire 就业与劳动力状态
    Worker observed at a different firm than in the previous year; employment record is as of end of calendar year, so only the year of the move is observed. Sample restricted to manufacturing firms and employees aged 15-65 with positive annual salary; multiple jobs treated as different.
    登记库： Matched employer-employee data (Statistics Denmark)
    论文正文 · Section I.A
  • Skill level / occupation category 职业与职位层级
    Occupation grouped into four categories: low-skilled, mid-skilled, high-skilled workers and managers.
    登记库： Matched employer-employee data (Statistics Denmark)
    论文正文 · Section I.A
  • Educational attainment 教育与考试成绩
    Highest completed education measured in three levels: high school, college and university.
    登记库： Matched employer-employee data (Statistics Denmark)
    论文正文 · Section I.A
  • Labour market experience 工作时间
    Work experience recorded in thousands of hours in the individual-level data.
    登记库： Matched employer-employee data (Statistics Denmark)
    论文正文 · Section I.A
  • Firm human capital of workers (AKM-based) 劳动收入与收入
    Firm average of worker wage net of the AKM firm effect, h = (1/N) sum (w - lambda - psi_j), from a wage equation with person and firm fixed effects (Abowd, Kramarz and Margolis 1999); new workers' human capital measured in t-1, their last full year in the previous firm.
    登记库： Matched employer-employee data (Statistics Denmark)
    论文正文 · Section I.B eq. (5)
  • Manufacturing industry groups (2-digit NACE) 部门与行业
    Nine 2-digit NACE manufacturing industry groups used for industry-specific estimates and industry-year fixed effects: Food, beverages, tobacco; Textiles, clothing, footwear; Wood, paper and products thereof; Publishing, printing, recording; Fuel, chemical and other non-metallic mineral products; Metals and products thereof (excluding machinery); Machinery and equipment; Electrical and optical equipment; Manufacturing n.e.c.
    登记库： Firm accounts data
    代码： NACE 2-digit (manufacturing)
    在线附录 · Web Appendix A2, Table A3

An Empirical Model of Growth Through Product Innovation

Rasmus Lentz and Dale T. Mortensen · Econometrica, 2008 · 企业

用丹麦企业面板估计一个通过产品创新实现企业成长的熊彼特式模型。劳动力从创新能力较弱的企业向创新能力较强的企业再配置，约占总体生产率增长的一半，其余来自企业内部的创新。

数据
Danish Business Statistics Register: annual panel of privately owned firms (value added, total wage bill, full-time equivalent employment)
关键变量
  • 企业增加值（Y）
  • 工资总额（W），用于构造质量调整后的就业
  • 全职当量就业（N）
  • 劳动生产率：每名工人的增加值和每名质量调整工人的增加值
  • 矩：包含退出在内的企业增长率，以及生产率增长分解（企业内、企业间、交叉项、退出）
时期
1992–1997
样本
4,872 家企业的非平衡面板 1992 年已存在、雇员超过 20 人的全部丹麦私营企业，跟踪至 1997 年，不含此后进入的企业。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Firm panel 样本界定与时间
    Unbalanced annual panel 1992-1997 of privately owned firms from the Danish Business Statistics Register: all firms existing in 1992 with more than 20 workers, followed over time; entrants after 1992 excluded (about 4,872 firms).
    登记库： Danish Business Statistics Register
    工作论文 · Section 2 (Danish Firm Data); Section 5 (Danish Firm Data)
  • Quality-adjusted employment 企业特征与生产率
    N* of firm j equals its total wage bill W_j divided by the economy-wide average wage per worker (sum of W over sum of N); for firms observed in several years the implied labour quality is averaged over time.
    登记库： Danish Business Statistics Register
    代码： N*_j = W_j / w, w = sum_j W_j / sum_j N_j
    工作论文 · Section 2, equation (1) and footnote 2
  • Labour productivity 企业特征与生产率
    Value added per worker (Y/N) and value added per quality-adjusted worker (Y/N*), with Y in DKK.
    登记库： Danish Business Statistics Register
    工作论文 · Section 2, Figure 1
  • Firm growth including exit 企业特征与生产率
    Firm growth rate in value added (dY/Y) where an exiting firm contributes an observation of -1.
    登记库： Danish Business Statistics Register
    工作论文 · Section 5, Table 2
  • Productivity growth decomposition 企业特征与生产率
    Growth in aggregate value added per worker decomposed following Foster, Haltiwanger and Krizan (2001) into within, between, cross, entry and exit terms, with firm employment shares as weights; no entry term because entrants are excluded.
    登记库： Danish Business Statistics Register
    代码： P_t = sum_e s_et p_et, p_et = Y_et/N_et, s_et = N_et/N_t
    工作论文 · Section 5, equation (19), Table 3

Inside the Family Firm: The Role of Families in Succession Decisions and Performance

Morten Bennedsen, Kasper Meisner Nielsen, Francisco Pérez-González and Daniel Wolfenzon · Quarterly Journal of Economics, 2007 · 个人 + 企业

以离任 CEO 头胎子女的性别作为丹麦企业家族继任的工具变量。家族 CEO 损害企业绩效：与聘用外部 CEO 的企业相比，营业利润率至少下降 4 个百分点，在高增长行业和大企业中代价最大。

数据
Købmandsstandens Oplysningsbureau (KOB) firm financial and management data (private, from annual reports), Danish Civil Registration System (CPR) with family links, Danish Commerce and Companies Agency (Erhvervs- og Selskabsstyrelsen) management/board records with CPR numbers, Industry-level data from Statistics Denmark and OECD STAN
关键变量
  • 结果变量：CEO 更替前后的营业资产回报率（OROA）
  • 处理：家族 CEO 继任（新任 CEO 有血缘或姻亲关系）
  • 工具变量：离任 CEO 头胎子女的性别
  • 异质性：行业增长、技能密集度和企业规模
时期
1994–2002 年（管理层数据）；财务数据为 1991–2003 年
样本
5,334 次继任 1994 至 2002 年间丹麦有限责任公司（包括公众公司和私人公司）的 CEO 继任，每家企业只取第一次更替。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Operating return on assets (OROA) 企业特征与生产率
    Ratio of earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) to the book value of assets, from annual reports of limited liability firms (KOB). Performance change is the three-year average after succession minus the three-year average before, omitting the succession year.
    登记库： KOB
    工作论文 · Section II.B; footnote 13; Table IV notes
  • Industry-adjusted OROA 企业特征与生产率
    OROA minus the equally weighted average OROA of all active firms (including non-event firms) in the same industry and year; four-digit NACE industries are used if they contain at least 20 non-event firms in a year, otherwise three- or two-digit groupings.
    登记库： KOB
    代码： NACE 4-digit, falling back to 3- or 2-digit; minimum 20 non-event firms
    工作论文 · Section II.B
  • Industry-and-performance-adjusted OROA 企业特征与生产率
    OROA adjusted using as control firms in the same industry and the same industry-adjusted performance decile in the year before succession (Barber and Lyon, 1996).
    登记库： KOB
    工作论文 · Section IV.A
  • Family CEO succession 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator equal to one if the incoming CEO is related by blood or marriage to the departing CEO according to family trees built from the Civil Registration System (parents, siblings, children, marital history), zero otherwise; family successions split into children and other relatives.
    登记库： CPR, Erhvervs- og Selskabsstyrelsen (ES) management records
    工作论文 · Section II.A, II.C; equation (2)
  • Gender of firstborn child (instrument) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator equal to one if the departing CEO's first child is male and zero if female; used as an instrument for family succession in a linear first stage.
    登记库： CPR
    工作论文 · Section III, equation (2)
  • CEO succession sample 样本界定与时间
    CEO successions 1994-2002 in Danish limited liability firms, kept when the departing (incoming) CEO had been (stayed) in the position at least two years, CEO names were matched to CPR numbers via the ES dataset, matching KOB financial data existed around the transition and employment (where available) was non-zero; only the first transition per firm is kept (5,334 successions).
    登记库： KOB, ES, CPR
    工作论文 · Section II.A
  • Industry heterogeneity measures 部门与行业
    Sample split at the median of industry production growth, output volatility (value of production), labour compensation per employee and import penetration (Statistics Denmark), workers' schooling (authors' calculation from individual schooling and industry of employment), and R&D (industries reporting R&D expenses in OECD STAN).
    登记库： Statistics Denmark industry statistics, OECD STAN
    工作论文 · Section V, footnote 11
  • Return on capital employed and net income to assets 企业特征与生产率
    ROCE is operating income divided by book equity plus book debt; net income to assets is after-tax profits over book value of assets; assets measured as log assets in 2000 DKK.
    登记库： KOB
    工作论文 · Section II.B; footnote 13

Job Creation and Job Destruction, Worker Reallocation, and Wages

Christian Belzil · Journal of Labor Economics, 2000 · 个人 + 企业

考察工人在正在创造就业岗位或人员流动频繁的企业中是否挣得更多。作者在丹麦企业—工人匹配数据上用固定效应估计个人工资方程，并在其中加入企业层面的净就业创造和工人再配置指标。净就业创造在经济周期的各个阶段都会提高男性工资，对入职工资和任职年限较短的工人作用最强；女性工资除入职工资外则没有反应。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Statistics Denmark: November employment of firms/workplaces linked to register records on all their employees (named in the 1996 working-paper version, EUI ECO 96/17; the published abstract only says 'Danish firm (workplace) data ... merged with individual records')
关键变量
  • 处理：企业的净就业创造/就业破坏率
  • 处理：企业的工人（总就业）再配置率，即新进人员加离职人员相对于企业规模的比例
  • 结果变量：个人对数小时工资，包括入职工资
  • 控制变量：个人固定效应、年龄、工作经验、教育、企业规模、经济周期（年份）效应
  • 异质性：男性与女性、任职年限、经济周期阶段
时期
据 1996 年工作论文版本为 1980–1991 年（发表版摘要中未说明）
样本
所查资料中未注明 受雇于一个丹麦企业（工作场所）样本的男女工人，企业的雇佣史与工人的个人记录相合并。 来源（摘要）
变量如何定义（5）
  • IDA firm sample and worker restrictions (1996 working-paper version) 样本界定与时间
    Sample extracted from IDA, which covers the entire population of Danish firms and workers with annual observations from 1980. Initially 1000 private-sector firms were selected randomly in 1980, representative in terms of industry, sector and region, and followed until 1991; as firms disappear new firms are added so that the number of firms always exceeds 1000; agriculture and mining are excluded. Workers are restricted to full-time workers, to wage observations with the maximum value of Statistics Denmark's wage quality index, and to individuals aged 16 or less in 1964 (at most 46 years old in 1991) because the experience measure is less reliable before 1964.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： 1000 private firms sampled in 1980; panel 1980-1991; full-time only; maximum wage-quality index; age <= 16 in 1964
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1-3.2 of EUI Working Paper ECO 96/17 ('Employment Reallocation, Wages and the Allocation of Workers Between Expanding and Declining Firms'), an earlier version of the article under a different title
  • Net job creation rate 企业特征与生产率
    Job creation for firm j in year t is the change in firm employment between t-1 and t divided by firm size, X_jt = (E_jt - E_jt-1) / S_jt. Total employment in each firm is computed from the number of primary job holders in November of each year.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： X_jt = (E_jt - E_jt-1) / S_jt; employment measured in November
    工作论文 · Section 4.1, eq. (3), and Appendix 1 comments of EUI Working Paper ECO 96/17 (earlier version under a different title)
  • Gross employment (worker) reallocation rate 企业特征与生产率
    Sum of all newcomers (workers with no attachment to the current firm in the previous year) and all leavers (workers with no attachment to the firm in the following year) divided by firm size, (N_jt + M_jt) / S_jt. Because IDA does not record the cause of separation, this turnover measure is treated as an upper bound for gross employment reallocation.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： (N_jt + M_jt) / S_jt
    工作论文 · Section 2 and Section 4.1, eq. (4), of EUI Working Paper ECO 96/17 (earlier version under a different title)
  • Real hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Individual hourly wage rate from IDA, in Danish kroner per hour, measured in November of each year; the dependent variable is the log real hourly wage. Only observations with the maximum value of the wage quality index imputed by Statistics Denmark are used.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1-3.2, eq. (1), and Appendix 1 comments of EUI Working Paper ECO 96/17 (earlier version under a different title)
  • Labour market experience 就业与劳动力状态
    Total cumulated experience reported in IDA, measured as the sum of all employment periods since entering the labour force (actual rather than potential experience), which allows age and experience effects to be separately identified. The measure is less reliable for workers employed before 1964.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 2 and Section 3.2 of EUI Working Paper ECO 96/17 (earlier version under a different title)

Worker Flows and Job Flows in Danish Manufacturing, 1980–91

Karsten Albæk and Bent E. Sørensen · Economic Journal, 1998 · 个人 + 企业

最早使用 IDA 雇主—雇员匹配数据的研究之一，度量丹麦制造业各工厂的岗位创造、岗位消失和工人流动。工人流转远远超过岗位再配置，两者在工厂层面都规模很大且具有持续性。

Plant-level data on all Danish manufacturing plants and their workers (register not named in abstract)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：工人流动（雇佣与离职）

  • 替补性雇佣（现有岗位上的离职与补入）
  • 经济周期变动
时期
1980–1991
样本
所查资料中未注明 1980–91 年丹麦的全部单个制造业工厂。 来源（摘要）

性别与家庭

生育惩罚，以及以家庭为单位的劳动供给、健康行为和保险。

Working Hours, Top Management Appointments, and Gender: Evidence from Linked Employer-Employee Data

Anders Frederiksen, Takao Kato and Nina Smith · Journal of Labor Economics, 2026 · 个人 + 企业

把丹麦劳动力调查（Labour Force Survey）中详细的工时信息与登记库中的职业生涯史相连接。长工时、相对于同侪的工时以及非标准时段工作，都会提高在企业内部被任命为高层管理者的几率；主要由供给侧因素驱动的工时性别差距，是进入高层管理职位的性别差距的一个主要来源。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Danish Labour Force Survey (DLFS/AKU) linked on person identifier, Organizational hierarchy codes (occupation-based) from registers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：在 t 年至 t+1 年之间被任命到高层管理职位
  • 解释变量：t 年 Labour Force Survey 中的每周工作小时数
  • 异质性：性别（工时和晋升上的性别差距）
  • 层级：高层管理者、管理者、白领、蓝领/灰领
  • 控制变量：工作经验、任职年限、教育、子女、婚姻状况
时期
1994–2010
样本
168,499 名雇员 1994–2010 年 Labour Force Survey 随机抽取的丹麦雇员，并与 IDA 登记数据合并（IZA DP 11675 工作论文版本）。 来源
调查
Labour Force Survey (AKU)
变量如何定义（11）
  • Hierarchy level (position) 职业与职位层级
    Job level from the RAS socioeconomic job code: 131 = top manager, 132 = (function) manager, 133 = white-collar, 134 or 135 = blue/grey-collar. Only persons with job_socio_kode 131-135 are extracted from RAS (from 1994 on).
    登记库： RAS, IDA
    代码： RAS job_socio_kode 131 (top manager), 132 (function manager), 133 (white collar), 134-135 (blue/grey collar)

Replication package

Fertility and Family Labor Supply

Katrine Jakobsen, Thomas H. Jørgensen and Hamish Low · American Economic Review (forthcoming), 2026 · 个人

利用 2009 年丹麦税制改革，表明女性税后净工资提高会降低生育，而男性工资提高则会提高生育。基于登记数据估计的一个夫妻选择生育时点和子女数量的生命周期模型表明，允许生育作出调整会大幅提高女性劳动供给的反应程度，而生育前后的人力资本折旧在很大程度上造成了长期的性别工资差距。

数据
Monthly payroll records (BFL/eIndkomst), Annual income tax data (IND), Population and family register (BEF), family definitions and parent links, Education register (UDDA), Labour market experience from ATP payments, Parental leave spell register (OF)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：生育（出生）
  • 处理：2009–2018 年税制改革带来的边际税后净工资率变化
  • 结果变量：劳动力市场参与、兼职与全职工作（根据工资单工时）
  • 结果变量：年度劳动收入
  • 控制变量：教育（高技能对较低技能）、劳动力市场经验
时期
2004–2018 年（税收样本 2004–2018 年；估计样本 2010–2018 年）
样本
10,851,444 个个人—年份观测值（估计样本）；2,531,181 个（税收样本） 25–60 岁、有异性伴侣的丹麦个人，不含学生、自雇者、退休者和领取残疾养老金者；税收样本限于 25–40 岁的同居或已婚女性。 来源
变量如何定义（11）
  • Labour market participation, part-time and full-time work 就业与劳动力状态
    Participation means at least 481 annual hours (e.g. 37 hours for 13 weeks) on BFL pay slips together with annual income of at least 50,000 DKK; part time is 481-1,664 annual hours; full time is more than 1,664 hours. Monthly hours and income are scaled down by the share of the month registered on parental leave in the OF register.
    登记库： BFL (eIndkomst), OF
    代码： thresholds 481 and 1,664 annual hours; 50,000 DKK
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Annual labour income (BFL) 劳动收入与收入
    12-month sum of monthly labour income from BFL pay slips, by calendar year for age profiles and centred on the birth month for event-study moments (e.g. income from January-February before a March birth counts as year -1); excludes income registered while on parental leave; deflated by CPI, in 1000 DKK. Estimation sample 2010-2018.
    登记库： BFL (eIndkomst), OF
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Personal income (tax sample) 劳动收入与收入
    Personal income from annual tax data: labour income from wage work, profits from own firms and labour market transfers; deflated by CPI.
    登记库： IND
    代码： PERINDKP
    工作论文 · Supplemental Material A
  • Couples / partners 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Partners follow Statistics Denmark's family definition, including married and cohabiting couples; cohabitants are two adults at the same address registered as parents to a child, or two opposite-sex adults with an age difference under 15 years at the same address. Constructed from EFALLE in BEF; couple age is the woman's age. Estimation sample keeps couples with at most five years age difference.
    登记库： BEF
    代码： EFALLE; FOED_DAG; KOEN
    工作论文 · Section 2, footnote 8; Supplemental Material A
  • High skilled vs less skilled 教育与考试成绩
    High skilled if at least 180 months of education (at least a bachelor's degree), measured as the highest degree earned in the sample period; less skilled otherwise.
    登记库： UDDA
    代码： HFPRIA >= 180 months
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Labour market experience 就业与劳动力状态
    Statistics Denmark's experience measure based on accumulated mandatory ATP pension payments, which depend on hours worked; part-time employment counts as 2/3 of full time.
    登记库： IDAP
    代码： ERHVER, ERHVER79
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Sample exclusions by main activity 样本界定与时间
    Individuals aged 25-60 with an opposite-sex partner; observations dropped if mainly student, self-employed, retired or on disability pension, based on main activity at end of November.
    登记库： IDAP/AKM (socio-economic status)
    代码： SOCSTIL, SOCSTIL_KODE
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Mechanical net-of-tax rate change (instrument) 税收与税率
    Four-year mechanical change log(1 - tau_{t+4}(z_t)) - log(1 - tau_t(z_t)) in the marginal net-of-tax rate, holding income and characteristics at year-t values, computed with a Danish tax simulator; used to instrument own and partner net-of-tax rate changes and virtual income. Restricted to couples where both have personal income of 50,000-600,000 DKK in the base year. Outcome is the 4-year difference in number of children born.
    登记库： IND
    工作论文 · Section 3; Supplemental Material A.1
  • Household wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Bank deposits, bonds, stocks and property net of loans and mortgages at end of year; registered property values raised by 10% (following Leth-Petersen 2010); deflated by CPI, in 1000 DKK.
    登记库： IND
    代码： FORM; FORMREST_NY05 (after 1996)
    工作论文 · Supplemental Material A
  • Child linkage and age of children 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Children and their ages are linked to parents through the parent identifiers in BEF; almost all children can be linked to a mother.
    登记库： BEF
    在线附录 · Supplemental Material, Data Appendix (p. S2)
  • Estimation sample vs tax sample 样本界定与时间
    Two samples: the BFL estimation sample of all individuals aged 25-60 with partners, 2010-2018; and the tax sample of women aged 25-40 with partners, 2004-2018 (used with personal income PERINDKP). Both split by less skilled vs high skilled.
    登记库： BFL (eIndkomst), IND, BEF
    在线附录 · Supplemental Material, Table A.1

Universal Daycare and Mothers' Working Lifetime

Sarah Sander · Economic Journal, 2026 · 个人

利用日托中心在丹麦各市镇的逐步铺开，追踪母亲的整个职业生涯。日托的可得性提高了首次生育十六年后的劳动参与、工时和劳动收入，效应由低学历母亲驱动，并部分通过生育和伴侣分离这两条中介渠道起作用。

数据
1970 Census (FT70) with parish of residence, Historical daycare institution yearbooks digitised (1964–1975) and daycare institutions in registers from 1976, Population register with parent-child links and fertility histories (BEF), Earnings from tax records (income registers), 1980–2015, Supplementary Pension Fund register (ATP) contributions for hours and participation, Education registers (UDDA)
关键变量

  • 中介变量：生育以及与孩子父亲分离

首次生育时间为 1964–1975 年；劳动收入为 1980–2015 年
样本
370,602 名母亲 1970 年人口普查时居住在丹麦、于 1964 至 1975 年间生育第一个孩子并在该孩子年满 16 岁之前一直留在丹麦的非移民女性。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Daycare availability in 1970 parish (treatment) 地理与社区
    Mothers are placed in their parish of residence in the 1970 Census. vg = 1 if a daycare institution for ages 0-2 (nursery or integrated institution, from digitised institution data) existed in the parish in the year of first birth; bh = same for ages 3-6 (kindergarten); availability is also tracked for each year from child age 0 to 6 (all/some/no years).

First-birth year is the earliest birth year among children linked through MOR_ID (supplemented by family-register child counts).
    登记库： BEF, Fødselsdata (birth data), FAMILIE, FT70

    For child ages 0-15, participation = positive ATP contributions in the year (hours > 0); for ages 16-40, participation = positive wage earnings (non-missing log earnings), set to 0 if missing and the mother is alive.

Depressed Peers in Early Parenthood

Anne Toft Hansen, Jonas Cuzulan Hirani and Miriam Wüst · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2025 · 个人

在给定少数几项特征的条件下，市镇护士基本上是任意地把新手母亲分配到产后同伴小组。接触到一位抑郁的同伴，会使母亲本人在产后两年的心理健康服务使用增加 11%，并使她自评的心理健康状况和劳动力市场结果变差。

数据
Municipal health visitor records with mothers' group assignments and EPDS postpartum depression screening, Statistics Denmark registers: GP consultations, psychologist/psychiatrist appointments, hospital contacts for mental illness, sick leave
关键变量
  • 处理：新手母亲小组中有一位存在产后抑郁风险（EPDS）的同伴
  • 结果变量：产后两年内对心理健康服务的使用
  • 结果变量：因精神疾病到医院就诊
  • 结果变量：病假／劳动力市场结果
时期
2012–2017 年（健康访视员记录）
样本
所查资料中未注明 在丹麦各市镇由市镇健康访视员分配到新手母亲小组的初次生育的母亲。 来源（摘要）
变量如何定义（5）
  • Depressed peer (treatment) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Mother's own EPDS (Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale) score from municipal health-visitor records (first postnatal screening); high = EPDS > 10. Treatment = at least one other mother in the assigned mothers' group has a high EPDS score (leave-self-out group mean of high > 0); untested mothers coded as not high.
    登记库： Municipal health visitor records (EPDS), MFR
    代码： high = (score_e1 > 10); peer_treat = (leave-one-out mean of high in group > 0); questionnaires 'EPDS gravide','EPDS nybagt','Edinburgh' variants

    登记库： SSSY, MFR
    代码： SPEC2 == '80' (raw extract keeps 80, 81, 82, 83, 89); BRUHON; HONUGE
    复制代码 · 4_cr_gpcontacts.do
  • Psychologist/psychiatrist consultations and GP mental-health tests 医疗服务利用

    登记库： LPR (PSYKADM)

    复制代码 · 3_cr_psyksssy.do, 'psych hospital contacts' and 'Generate outcomes' sections
  • Sick leave and UI/benefit receipt (weekly) 失业与福利金

Is Parental Leave Costly for Firms and Coworkers?

Anne Ardila Brenøe, Serena Canaan, Nikolaj A. Harmon and Heather N. Royer · Journal of Labor Economics, 2024 · 个人 + 企业

将有女性雇员即将生育的丹麦小企业与没有即将发生生育的类似企业进行比较。几乎没有证据表明企业产出或同事受到负面影响：多数企业通过雇用临时工和增加其他雇员的工时来填补缺勤，只有无法重新分配工作的企业才出现损失。

数据
Central Person Registry with parent-child links (CPR/BEF), Parental leave benefit payouts and employer leave reimbursements, Central education register (UDDA), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Annual employer wage payment records (CON and RAS), Mandatory pension contributions for approximate hours (ATP), Value-added tax (VAT) firm sales and purchases data
关键变量
  • 处理：小型私营企业的一名女性雇员生育（事件年）
  • 结果变量：企业就业人数、全职当量工时、工资总额（总额及剔除休假部分）、销售额、毛利润的代理指标、存活
  • 结果变量：同事的工时、劳动收入、就业和病假天数
  • 机制：企业内的育儿假天数
  • 设计：采用匹配对照事件的动态双重差分
时期
2001–2013 年（生育发生在 2003–2012 年）
样本
24,829 个处理事件（生育）和 162,151 个对照事件，涉及 45,940 家不同企业；修剪后为 16,080 家企业中的 9,934 个处理事件 受雇于丹麦私营部门小企业的壮年（21–35 岁）女性的生育，与没有此类生育的匹配对照企业相比较。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Treatment and control events 样本界定与时间
    Potential event = a woman's main job at a firm in a baseline year; event year = baseline + 2. Treatment event: woman gives birth in the event year but not in the year before or after; control event: no birth in the event year, the year before or the year after. Woman aged 19-33 at baseline, at least one year tenure at the baseline firm and not a student.
    登记库： CPR, IDA
    工作论文 · Sections 5.1-5.2; Appendix C.2
  • Small private firm sample 企业特征与生产率
    Private-sector firm (CVR) with 3-30 employees in November of the baseline year and fewer than 60 employment relationships during the baseline year; active at baseline (hours at least one FTE, positive sales and wage payments in baseline, positive sales or wages the year before); sales per employee 10,000 DKK-100 million DKK and wages per worker 10,000 DKK-1 million DKK.
    登记库： IDA, VAT, CON, RAS
    工作论文 · Section 5.2; Appendix C.2
  • Firm employees (November stock) 就业与劳动力状态
    Standard IDA main November employment relationship: worker counted at the firm if their main job was there in the last week of November; includes workers on leave. Main job = job with most hours, ties broken by highest earnings.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 4.2; Appendix C.1
  • FTE hours from ATP contributions 工作时间
    Approximate yearly hours from mandatory ATP pension contributions (step schedule for 0-9, 9-17, 18-26 and 27+ weekly hours, topping out at full time, 37 hours), scaled to full-time equivalents (Lund and Vejlin 2016); share of year on paid parental leave subtracted since ATP continues during paid leave. Misses overtime.
    登记库： ATP
    工作论文 · Section 4.2; Appendix C.1
  • Wage bill and wage bill ex. leave 劳动收入与收入
    Total wage bill = sum of all pre-tax payments to workers in the year (from CON and RAS), including payments to workers on paid leave. Wage bill ex. leave: each worker's wage = payments / ATP hours incl. paid leave, multiplied by hours excluding paid leave; the gap (paid leave covered by the firm) is subtracted from the total wage bill.
    登记库： CON, RAS, ATP
    工作论文 · Section 4.2; Appendix C.1
  • Sales, gross profit proxy and survival 企业特征与生产率
    Total sales and purchases from VAT data (corrected to include exports; negative values recoded to zero). Gross profit proxy = sales minus purchases minus wage bill ex. leave (purchases include capital equipment). Total variable costs = purchases + wage bill ex. leave. Exiting firms kept with zero employees/hours/sales; shutdown proxied by zero sales.
    登记库： VAT
    工作论文 · Section 4.3; Appendix C.1
  • Parental leave days 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Total days of paid and unpaid leave from payouts of parental leave benefits to individuals and leave reimbursements to firms, incl. pregnancy-related extensions; prenatal and postnatal days allocated around the birth; truncated at 38 weeks any prenatal, 6 weeks paid prenatal, 52 weeks paid postnatal, 104 weeks any postnatal.
    登记库： Parental leave benefit payouts, Employer leave reimbursements
    工作论文 · Section 4.1; Appendix C.1
  • Coworker sample 样本界定与时间
    Male and female coworkers of event women in the baseline year whose job at the baseline firm is their main labour market attachment, with hours at least half an FTE and earnings above 75,000 DKK in the baseline year; followed even if they leave the firm.
    登记库： IDA, ATP
    工作论文 · Section 5.4; Appendix C.2
  • Coworker sick days 医疗服务利用
    Take-up of publicly paid sick days (any sick days); eligibility for public sickness funds starts after two weeks of sickness, so the measure captures longer sickness spells.
    工作论文 · Section 6, footnote 18; Figure 7(d)

Hanno Foerster · Review of Economic Studies, 2024 · 个人

利用丹麦登记数据和调查数据估计了一个涵盖家庭劳动供给、家庭生产、储蓄和离婚的动态模型，用以研究婚姻解除后的扶养给付。与子女抚养费相比，配偶赡养费对劳动供给的抑制作用更大，为消费提供保险的效率也更低，因此提高子女抚养费、降低配偶赡养费会使福利上升。

数据

时期
1980–2013
样本

调查
Time Use Survey 2001
变量如何定义（10）

    登记库： BEF (personer)

    Divorce year is the minimum of the formal divorce year and the first year, within 6 years before formal divorce, in which a married, never-divorced person's partner ID (FAELLE_NR) changes to a new partner or no partner.
    登记库： BEF

  • Couples sample 样本界定与时间

    登记库： IDAN
    代码： TILKNYT: {0,10,20,30}=0; {5,15,25,35}=5; {4,14,24,34}=15; {3,13,23,33}=25; {2,12,22,32}=34; {1,11,21,31}=38

  • Out of labour force / participation 就业与劳动力状态

  • Maintenance payments (observed) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户

    Custody counts children under 19 living in the same family ID after a divorce. Child support imputed from 2004 rules: 10,608 DKK per child times an earnings-dependent multiplier (thresholds 320k/340k/370k/500k/900k for one child, higher for 2-3 children) for children in the ex-partner's custody; alimony = 20% of (payer earnings minus child support minus max(ex-partner earnings, 90,000)), capped, only if ex-partner not remarried; total maintenance capped at one third of earnings. The Gender Application Gap: Do Men and Women Apply for the Same Jobs?

Jonas Fluchtmann, Anita M. Glenny, Nikolaj A. Harmon and Jonas Maibom · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2024 · 个人

利用丹麦每一位失业保险领取者求职申请的行政记录。即使可观测特征相近，男性和女性申请的工作类型也大不相同，这些申请上的差异可以解释残差性别工资差距的 70% 以上。

数据
Joblog job application records from the public employment service platform (Jobnet), Unemployment insurance payment records / DREAM event-history data, Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Employment Statistics for Employees, monthly earnings and hours (BFL)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：所申请工作的特征（职业、行业、AKM 企业工资溢价、通勤、工时）
  • 分组：性别
  • 结果变量：入职一个月后新工作的小时工资
  • 所申请工作的预测“典型工资”
时期
2015 年 9 月–2017 年 9 月
样本
105,879 人，114,375 段失业保险（UI）领取期，2,911,585 份求职申请 2015 年 9 月至 2017 年 9 月开始新一段领取期的丹麦失业保险（UI）领取者，领取期至少持续 8 周，至少有 4 份登记在案的申请，并在一年内找到工作。 来源
变量如何定义（11）
  • New UI spell and analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    UI recipients of Danish nationality entering new UI spells September 2015 to September 2017. A new UI spell starts when a person who received no UI benefits in the previous 4 weeks is observed with at least 4 consecutive weeks of UI payouts. Restrictions: spell lasts at least 8 weeks; at least 4 Joblog applications registered during the spell (counted after dropping the last 4 weeks); exits UI to employment within 52 weeks; applications from the last 4 weeks before the new job starts are dropped (median transition time 6 weeks minus an assumed 2 weeks from application to offer). Observations with an estimated propensity score above 0.99 or below 0.01 are trimmed.
    登记库： DREAM, Joblog (Jobnet), IDA, BFL
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.1 and A.6, Table A.1, fn. 39
  • Job applications (Joblog) 失业与福利金
    Applications self-reported in the Joblog section of Jobnet during the UI spell. Only applications actually sent are kept, using the first saved version of each entry. Other Joblog events (vacancies saved for later, interviews, rejections) are excluded. Mandatory fields include job title, part-time or full-time status, and firm name, zip code and city.
    登记库： Joblog (Jobnet)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.1, fn. 38; A.2
  • Occupation of applied-for job 职业与职位层级
    Self-reported job titles were cleaned and mapped to DISCO (the Danish version of ISCO) in three steps: (1) unique 1:1 occurrences of DISCO occupation names in the title (43.4% of applications); (2) manual mapping of acronyms and common titles, e.g. 'sosu-hjælper' (+27.2%); (3) fuzzy matching with SAS compget, speedist and soundex plus substring matches, keeping only consistently high-ranked matches (+10.9%). In total 81.5% of applications are matched. Occupations are used at the 1-, 2- and 3-digit levels (9, 55 and 153 groups).
    登记库： Joblog (Jobnet)
    代码： DISCO 1-digit (9 groups), 2-digit (55), 3-digit (153)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.2, fn. 41, fn. 43
  • Industry / firm of applied-for job 部门与行业
    The reported firm name, zip code and city are matched to the CVR firm register and then to BFL. Steps: exact 1:1 match on firm name and zip code (66.3%); substring matches closest to the reported address (+13.9%); fuzzy matching on the 50 closest Stata matchit candidates, ranked by 5 scores (bigram similscore, token, tokensound, SAS compget and speedist), keeping the best average rank (+6.2%). Overall firm match rate is 86.4%. Industry comes from BFL using NACE Rev. 2 groupings of 10, 21 or 38 industries. Industry is missing when the firm is too new or small to have an industry recorded in BFL.
    登记库： CVR, BFL
    代码： NACE Rev. 2 aggregations: 10, 21 and 38 industries
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.2, fn. 41, 42, 44
  • Firm wage premium (AKM firm effect) 企业特征与生产率
    AKM model on log hourly wages (BFL monthly earnings divided by monthly paid hours) with worker, firm and calendar-month fixed effects. The panel uses March and September of each year from 2008 to 2017, giving 265,425 connected firms (about 95% of firms). Firm effects are standardised within industry by subtracting the industry mean and dividing by the industry SD. Decile bins are employment-weighted by firm employment in August 2015. Gender-specific AKM effects are used as a robustness check.
    登记库： BFL
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.3
  • Hourly wage in new job 劳动收入与收入
    BFL monthly earnings divided by recorded monthly paid hours in the first full month of employment in the new job. Results are similar using a 4-month average or excluding observations whose hours were imputed by Statistics Denmark.
    登记库： BFL
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.1, fn. 40
  • Typical wage of a job 劳动收入与收入
    Predicted log wage from a Post-LASSO OLS model estimated on new jobs in the analysis sample. Candidate regressors are 1-, 2- and 3-digit industry and occupation dummies, the within-industry standardised AKM firm effect (set to 0 when missing, plus a missing dummy) and all pairwise interactions, 10,407 variables in total. Rigorous LASSO (Belloni et al. 2016, LASSOPACK, clustered by individual) selects 233 variables, of which 117 remain after collinearity. Out-of-sample R2 is 0.201. Alternative models without firm information or without occupation information fill in values for unlinked applications. The model uses no worker characteristics.
    登记库： BFL, Joblog (Jobnet)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.4, Tables A.3-A.4
  • Full-time vs part-time applied-for job 工作时间
    Mandatory Joblog field: full-time is 37 hours per week; part-time is less than full-time.
    登记库： Joblog
    工作论文 · Section 4 (non-wage job characteristics)
  • Implied commute 地理与社区
    Commuting distance or time from the applicant's municipality of residence to the job's postal code, computed with the Google Maps API (following Harmon 2015).
    登记库： Joblog, BEF/IDA residence
    工作论文 · Section 4, footnote 33
  • Firm family-friendliness 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Firm-level average days of parental leave per birth among employees. Built from childbirth-related payouts after 2011 in the sickness/maternity benefit register (SGDP), covering both employer reimbursements and direct payments, for workers who later return to the same pre-birth employer. Births are inferred from a new leave spell or a gap of more than half a year between payments. Leave length is censored at 14 months and demeaned by gender before averaging at the firm. Firms with no births form a separate 'no birth' category.
    登记库： SGDP (sickness/maternity benefit register)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.8.1, fn. 55-57, Figure A.4
  • Conditioning set (double-LASSO observables) 样本界定与时间
    The double-LASSO of Belloni et al. 2014 (PDSLASSO) selects 332 variables from 4,196 candidates, of which 302 remain after collinearity; they enter a logit propensity score for being male, and women are reweighted by p/(1-p). Candidates: years of education, field of study, age, total work experience and experience over the last 5 years, sector/industry/occupation of the previous job, industry- and occupation-specific experience over the last 5 years at 1/2/3-digit levels, and time on UI, social assistance and other transfers over the last 5 years, with interactions and squares of age, education and experience.
    登记库： IDA, DREAM
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.5-A.6, Table A.5

Does Granting Refugee Status to Family-Reunified Women Improve Their Integration?

Linea Hasager · Journal of Public Economics, 2024 · 个人

通过家庭团聚进入丹麦的女性，所持居留许可通常以维持婚姻为条件。给予她们独立的难民身份改善了其经济融入，提高了离婚率，并降低了她们遭受暴力的风险，这与居留不确定性下降和议价能力增强的解释一致。

数据
Admission register on immigrant status and residence permit application/approval dates (Danish Immigration Service data via Statistics Denmark), Labour market data from the Danish tax authorities (employment; hours and earnings from 2008), Police registers on victimisation and criminal convictions, Hospital admissions data (National Patient Register) for assault injuries, Central population register (BEF) for demographics, spouse links and divorce
关键变量
  • 处理：家庭团聚女性获得本人的难民身份（庇护），获得时点先后不一
  • 结果变量：季度就业、工作小时数和劳动收入
  • 结果变量：遭受暴力侵害（警方记录或因袭击住院）
  • 结果变量：离婚
  • 设计：交错双重差分，以尚未接受处理的女性为对照组
时期
2001–2019 年（工时和劳动收入自 2008 年起）
样本
1,349 名成年女性 2001 至 2017 年间以家庭团聚方式来到丹麦与难民配偶团聚、其后申请并获得本人难民身份的 18 岁及以上女性。 来源
变量如何定义（4）
  • Treatment: change from family reunification to own refugee status 移民身份与来源地
    Adult women (18+) admitted 2001-2017 as family-reunified to a refugee spouse who later apply for and obtain their own asylum (UN Convention, de facto/B-status or temporary protection), identified from application and approval dates of residence permits in the admission register; event time is the quarter of asylum recognition. Controls are not-yet-treated women recognized at most three years later; women followed from 3 years before to 1.5 years after recognition.
    登记库： Admission register (Danish Immigration Service, via Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1 and 4
  • Violent victimization 犯罪
    Quarterly indicator equal to one if police records show the woman was a victim of violence or sexual assault, or if she was hospitalized due to assault based on physician classification of injury (following Aizer 2010); captures mainly severe cases and also non-partner violence.
    登记库： Police registers on victimization, National Patient Register (hospital admissions)
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, footnote 12
  • Quarterly employment, hours and earnings 就业与劳动力状态
    Quarterly employment indicator (available 2001-2019) and quarterly hours of work and earnings (from 2008) from tax-authority labour market data; earnings CPI-deflated to 2015 and converted to 1,000 USD at the 27 March 2019 exchange rate.
    登记库： Labour market data from Danish tax authorities
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, footnote 11
  • Divorce 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator equal to one if the woman is divorced (quarterly), from the central population register with spouse links.
    登记库： BEF
    工作论文 · Section 3.2

Income Effects and Labour Supply: Evidence from a Child Benefits Reform

Mathias Fjællegaard Jensen and Jack Blundell · Journal of Public Economics, 2024 · 个人

2011 年丹麦对儿童津贴设置上限，削减了有多个年幼子女的家庭所得到的津贴，而较小的家庭不受影响。削减之后母亲的劳动供给大幅上升，主要体现在广延边际上；文章还利用绝育记录来控制再生育偏好上的差异。

数据
Population register (BEF) for family composition, marital status and cohabitation, Monthly payroll records with hours worked (BFL/eIndkomst), Child benefit payment records (BOBO/BOTI), Register OF (monthly demographics and parental leave status), Sterilisation consultations from the National Patient Register (LPRADM) and health insurance service registers (SYSI, SSSY), Annual income register (IND) for self-employment robustness
关键变量
  • 处理：2011 年儿童津贴上限（DKK 35,000），减少了有年幼子女的较大家庭的非劳动收入
  • 结果变量：每月工作小时数（集约边际和广延边际）
  • 结果变量：年劳动收入（稳健性检验中包括自雇者）
  • 控制/样本限制：改革前家庭有过绝育咨询
  • 设计：双重差分，处理组家庭与未受影响家庭对比
时期
2008 年 9 月至 2014 年 12 月（月度）
样本
28,968 名处理组女性和 22,477 名处理组男性 本国出生的丹麦已婚或同居父母，在整个窗口期内年龄为 25–59 岁，2011 年 1 月有 2–4 个子女（至少两个未满 18 岁），非自雇，在平衡的月度面板中可观测。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Monthly hours worked 工作时间
    Total hours worked per month from employer reports to the tax authorities (BFL, from 2008), summed over all jobs held in the month; for employees on parental leave with fixed contractual hours not adjusted in BFL, hours are adjusted using observed days of leave.
    登记库： BFL, OF
    论文正文 · Section 5.1 and footnote 4
  • Employment indicator (extensive margin) 就业与劳动力状态
    Indicator for working non-zero hours in the month in BFL.
    登记库： BFL
    论文正文 · Fig. 10 and Table notes (employment indicator), Section 6
  • Treatment group (child benefit cap) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Family experienced a strictly positive reduction in child benefits due to the DKK 35,000 cap in the first and/or second quarter of 2011 (benefits based on number and ages of children in the previous quarter; simulated from population registers and validated with Q4 BOBO/BOTI payments); control group = families not affected in Q1-Q2 2011. Continuous treatment = reduction in child benefits in 2011 in thousand DKK for treated families, zero otherwise.
    登记库： BEF, BOBO/BOTI
    论文正文 · Sections 3.1, 5.2, 6.2
  • Family sterilisation consultation 医疗服务利用
    Monthly indicator equal to one if the individual has ever (from 1994 onwards) consulted a doctor regarding sterilisation; a family-level version equals one if either partner in the couple has done so.
    登记库： LPRADM, SYSI, SSSY
    论文正文 · Section 5.1
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Balanced monthly panel September 2008-December 2014 of individuals aged at least 25 in September 2008 and under 60 in December 2014; excludes immigrants and children of immigrants, parents of children with irregular child benefit payments, and (main analysis) anyone self-employed at any point; in January 2011 must have at least 2 children under 18, no more than 4 children in total, and be married or cohabiting.
    登记库： BEF, OF, BFL, BOBO/BOTI
    论文正文 · Sections 5.1-5.2, footnotes 5-6
  • Annual earnings incl. self-employment (robustness) 劳动收入与收入
    Annual income measures from the income register IND, used in a robustness check that includes the self-employed because self-employment income is not measured monthly.
    登记库： IND

The Division of Parental Leave: Empirical Evidence and Policy Design

Thomas Høgholm Jørgensen and Jakob Egholt Søgaard · Journal of Public Economics, 2024 · 个人

利用丹麦育儿假津贴制度中的强激励和约 190,000 例生育的数据，估计父母对休假的支付意愿。父母在拐点处聚束，并且愿意为父亲休假很少的传统分工付出代价；模拟表明，专属假期与高替代率相结合时效果要好得多。

数据
Parental leave benefit spell data (parents of children born 2008–2015), incl. benefits paid to parent or employer, Monthly earnings records for all employees (BFL/eIndkomst), from 2008, Danish administrative registers on demographics, family links and firm links (population and labour market registers)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：出生后三年内母亲和父亲各自休的育儿假周数
  • 激励：个人津贴替代率和津贴上限在家庭预算集上形成的拐点
  • 激励：雇主提供的全额工资补偿（根据支付给雇主的津贴识别）
  • 政策：结构模型中关于专属假期（父亲配额）和替代率的反事实模拟
时期
2008–2015 年的生育
样本
189,974 例生育 2008–2015 年的生育，父母就业稳定且在生育前三个月内未领取与生育无关的公共福利，不含 15 个月内又生育下一个孩子的情形。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Weeks of parental leave 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Total number of parental leave weeks computed from start and end dates of benefit spells in the parental leave spell data (children born 2008-2015); includes all full-time leave taken at most three years after childbirth, separately for mother and father.
    登记库： Parental leave benefit spell data, BFL/eIndkomst
    工作论文 · Section 3.2 (Data)
  • Individual benefit replacement rate 失业与福利金
    Computed from total parental leave benefits paid out per parent-child spell relative to weeks of leave; statutory benefits replace 100% of pre-birth earnings for a full-time (37 hours/week) employee up to a cap of EUR 580 per week (2019 level), scaled down proportionally for part-time.
    登记库： Parental leave benefit spell data
    工作论文 · Sections 2 and 3.2, footnote 11
  • Weeks with full wage compensation 失业与福利金
    Weeks of leave with employer-provided full wage compensation, computed from the amount of parental leave benefits paid to the employer (benefits are paid to the employer as reimbursement when it pays full wage) using the individual replacement rate.
    登记库： Parental leave benefit spell data
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Imputed individual right to wage compensation 失业与福利金
    Public sector: imputed from collective-agreement rules (6-6-6 model, Apr 2008-Apr 2015: 6 weeks each parent plus 6 shared weeks if both parents work in the same public sub-sector, otherwise the shared 6 accrue to the public-sector parent) using both parents' employment sector. Private sector: equals observed compensated weeks for parents who also take uncompensated leave (exhausters); otherwise the mode of compensated weeks among exhausting co-workers with weakly higher compensation, with co-worker groups defined as firm-year cells, or 6-digit then 5-digit industry-year cells when fewer than two exhausting co-workers exist.
    登记库： Parental leave benefit spell data, employer-employee links
    工作论文 · Section 3.3, eq. (11), Table 3
  • Birth sample 样本界定与时间
    Births 2008-2015; parents must be continuously employed in the same firm in the 3 months before birth and not on non-birth-related public benefits during those 3 months; births are excluded if parents have a subsequent child within 15 months; parents must appear in the parental leave data (final sample 189,974 births).
    登记库： BEF, BFL/eIndkomst, Parental leave benefit spell data
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, Table 1 and notes

Neighbourhood Gangs, Crime Spillovers and Teenage Motherhood

Christian Dustmann, Mikkel Mertz and Anna Okatenko · Economic Journal, 2023 · 个人

利用 1986 至 1998 年间难民被随机分配到各市镇这一安排。分配所在社区的帮派犯罪提高了男孩在 19 岁前犯罪的概率和女孩少女生育的概率，并带来持久后果：在 19 至 28 岁，男性更多处于非经济活动状态，女性劳动收入更低、领取福利更多。

数据
Immigration register, Annual population registers (BEF), Central Police Register (criminal charges and convictions), Education registers (including survey-based register of immigrants' education), Income registers and register-based labour force statistics (RAS), National Patient Register (abortions)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：少女生育（15–18 岁期间生育子女）；男孩的青少年犯罪定罪
  • 处理：分配当年所在市镇 15–25 岁男性的团伙（帮派）犯罪定罪率
  • 识别：1986–1998 年分散安置政策下难民被准随机分配到各市镇
  • 长期结果变量：劳动收入、就业、教育
时期
难民分配为 1986–1998 年；人口登记库为 1980–2019 年
样本
8,172 名被分配的难民儿童；少女生育估计样本中有 3,792 名女孩 来自八个难民来源国、1986 至 1998 年间在 0–14 岁时被分配到丹麦各市镇的难民儿童，逐年观测至 19 岁。 来源
调查
Foreign-education survey
变量如何定义（9）
  • Convictions (guilty cases) 犯罪
    Judicial decisions 1980-2018 from the conviction register; for each person-case (journr) the final decision is kept (appeals), and a case counts as guilty unless the decision type is acquittal or dismissal. Offences are classified by 7-digit offence code into violent/sexual, property, drug, other and traffic, and traffic offences are dropped; the date of the offence comes from the charge register.
    登记库： KRAF (conviction register), KRSI (charge register)
    代码： AFG_AFGTYP3 in 514, 411, 412, 413, 414 = acquitted/dismissed (else guilty); AFG_GER7: sexual and violent 1110505-1180705 and 1210501-1292520; property 1304505-1398590; drug 1435505-1440505 and 3210505-3210510; other 1410303-1430740, 1445705-1485720, 3410505-3410509, 3610105-3870505 (residual non-missing also other); traffic 2110005-2610180 (dropped)
    复制代码 · do/build/clean/convictions.do
  • Group (gang) crime conviction 犯罪
    A conviction for a gang-type offence in a case where more than one person is convicted (gang_crime_3 requires at least three). Gang-type offences are non-sexual violence, arson/robbery-type property offences, drug offences and weapons offences; a case is gang-type if anyone in the case is convicted of a gang-type offence.
    登记库： KRAF
    代码： gang type: 2-digit AFG_GER7 (floor(ger7/100000)) == 12; 4-digit (floor(ger7/1000)) in 1312, 1339, 1380, 1390, 1435, 1440, 3410; 7-digit in 1366505, 1445750, 1445777-1445782, 3210510; gang_crime = N convicted in journr > 1 & gang type
    复制代码 · do/build/clean/convictions.do
  • Municipal youth (gang) crime conviction rate 犯罪
    Per municipality and year: number of male residents aged 15-25 (calendar year minus birth year between 15 and 26) with at least one conviction (resp. gang-crime conviction) for an offence committed that year at age above 14 and below 27, divided by the number of such male residents, times 100. Offences from 2017 onward or before 1980 are dropped.
    登记库： KRAF, KRSI, BEF
    代码： sh_g (gang), sh_nc (overall); KOEN==1 for men; KOM municipality
    复制代码 · do/build/prepare/kom_year_n_criminals.do
  • Assigned refugee (dispersal-policy sample) 移民身份与来源地
    Immigrants arriving 1986-1998 from refugee-sending countries (Balkan origins excluded as covered by a different placement policy), with some countries restricted by arrival year; the household head at immigration is identified via father, mother (if under 18) or spouse links, and individuals arriving more than a year after the household head, or with a gap of more than one year between immigration and first appearance in the registers, are dropped.
    登记库： BEF, Immigration register (date of immigration)
    代码： IELAND: Iraq 5436; Iran 5438 (arrival>=1980); Vietnam 5468, 5488; Sri Lanka 5418 (>=1984); stateless Lebanon 5103, 5456, 5473; Ethiopia 5214 (<1991); Afghanistan 5404; Somalia 5289 (>=1989); keep refugee_ieland<=8
    复制代码 · do/build/prepare/assigned_refugees.do
  • Assignment municipality 地理与社区
    The first municipality (KOM) in which the household head at assignment is observed in the population registers after immigration; children assigned to a different municipality than their household head are dropped, and Copenhagen assignment is KOM 101.
    登记库： BEF
    代码： first_kom = kom[1]; copenhagen = KOM 101
    复制代码 · do/build/prepare/assigned_refugees.do; sample_girls_15_20_at_assignment.do
  • Teenage motherhood 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Date of first birth is the earliest birth date among children linked to the woman through the mother ID (PNRM) in the population registers; teenage motherhood (mother_1518) equals 1 if the first birth occurs at age at least 14 and below 19 (commented 'had a child by age 19'). For girls aged 15-20 at assignment, motherhood within 4 years of assignment is used, dropping those whose first birth is within 280 days of immigration.
    登记库： BEF
    代码： PNRM (mother ID); mother_1518 = (date_first_birth - date_birth)/365.25 in [14,19)
    复制代码 · do/build/clean/pnr_date_first_two_births.do; do/build/prepare/kids_by_age.do; sample_girls_15_20_at_assignment.do
  • Abortion 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicator for an abortion diagnosis in the National Patient Register 1980-2014 (medical, other, unspecified and failed attempted abortion), attached to refugee girls.
    登记库： LPR
    代码： ICD-10 (DIAG first 4 chars) DO04, DO05, DO06, DO07
    复制代码 · do/build/prepare/abortion.do
  • Labour market status (employed / unemployed / not in labour force) 就业与劳动力状态
    Primary labour market status in the last week of November from RAS, with code schemes varying by year.
    登记库： RAS
    代码： 1981-1993 ARBSTIL: employed 11-39, unemployed 40, NILF 50-92 (1990+ keep NOVPRIO==1); 1994-1995 NYARB: employed 11-39, unemployed 40, NILF 41-400; 1996-2007 SOCSTIL_KODE: employed 115-199, unemployed 200, NILF 201-400; 2008-2015 SOC_STATUS_KODE (PRIMAER_STATUS_KODE==1): employed 110-138, 611, 612, unemployed 200, NILF 311-517
    复制代码 · do/build/clean/pool_ras_for_lm_status.do
  • Long-run income and education outcomes 劳动收入与收入
    For assigned refugee children 1987-2018, income outcomes are taken from the income register over the full year and education from the education registers (measured in October of the year prior), with employment taken from RAS for November of the previous year.
    登记库： IND, UDDA, UDDANY, RAS
    代码： IND: PERINDKIALT_13, LOENMV_13, ERHVERVSINDK_13, STIP, OFF_OVERFORSEL_13, NETOVSKUD_13; UDDA: HFAUDD; RAS ARBSTIL 11-37 employed, 40 unemployed (pre-1994)
    复制代码 · do/build/prepare/Refugee_income.do

Network Connections and Board Seats: Are Female Networks Less Valuable?

Emma von Essen and Nina Smith · Journal of Labor Economics, 2023 · 个人 + 企业

利用 1995 至 2011 年的丹麦雇主—雇员数据，研究职业人脉网络如何影响首次获任监事会成员。网络越大，获得监事会席位的机会越高，这一效应对男性更强，因为男性的网络更常把他们与大型企业、上市公司以及其他男性联系起来。

数据
Matched employer-employee data for the Danish labour market
关键变量
  • 结果变量：首次获任监事会成员
  • 解释变量：职业人脉网络的规模
  • 异质性：性别
  • 网络构成：与大型企业／上市公司、与男性以及与现任监事会成员的联系
时期
1995–2011
样本
所查资料中未注明 1995–2011 年雇主—雇员数据中观测到的丹麦工人，研究其首次获任监事会成员的情况。 来源（摘要）

Globalization, Gender, and the Family

Wolfgang Keller and Hale Utar · Review of Economic Studies, 2022 · 个人 + 企业

受到同样的中国进口冲击时，男性和女性的调整方式不同。年近四十而失去工作的女性会以生育作为回应，高收入者和需要重新接受培训者尤其如此，因此一个性别中性的贸易冲击会通过生物钟造成长期的性别差距。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Central Population Register (CPR/BEF) for births, marriages, divorces and cohabitation, Domestic production database by 10-digit product (Industrial commodity statistics, VARS) to identify firms making quota goods, Industry-level imports from China and other advanced countries (instrument), Parental leave records
关键变量
  • 结果变量：新生育、结婚、离婚、育儿假
  • 结果变量：劳动收入、工时、失业
  • 处理：1999 年的雇主所生产的产品属于中国加入 WTO 后取消 MFA 配额的范围
  • 处理（全经济范围）：行业层面来自中国的进口渗透率，以其他国家的进口作为工具变量
  • 异质性：性别和年龄（生物钟）
时期
1999–2007
样本
约 1,600,000 名工人；约 10,000 名纺织和服装业工人 1999 年丹麦私营部门 18–56 岁全职工人队列，追踪至 2007 年。 来源
变量如何定义（11）
  • Exposure to MFA quota removal (treatment) 贸易与离岸外包
    A firm is exposed (treated) if as of 1999 it had domestic production in any 8-digit CN good for which China would no longer face a quota upon WTO entry; quota categories are matched to 8-digit CN goods and firms producing quota goods are identified from the domestic production database reporting establishment sales by 10-digit product. Workers are exposed if employed by such a firm in 1999.
    登记库： IDA, VARS (domestic production / industrial commodity statistics)
    代码： Stata variable affwd (1=Exposed, 0=Non-exposed); clustering on cvrnr99 (1999 firm id)
    工作论文 · Section 2.1; Analysis1.do lines 25-26
  • 1999 full-time private-sector worker cohort 样本界定与时间
    Cohort of workers who in 1999 were full-time employed in Denmark's private sector, had positive wages and were aged 18-56; part-time workers are excluded. IDA covers persons aged 15-70, establishments with at least one employee and jobs active in the last week of November. The textile sample is the roughly 10,000 such workers employed in the textile and clothing industry in 1999; the economy-wide sample excludes public administration, education and health.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 2.2 and footnote 49
  • Birth event 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator for whether a worker fathers or mothers a newborn baby in a given year (for the IV specification: parent of a new child over 2000-2007). Child births come from Statistics Denmark's Fertility Database, which links parents' personal IDs to every child born in Denmark.
    登记库： Fertility Database (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： Stata variable DBirth
    工作论文 · Section 2.3; Table 1 notes; Section 6 eq. (4)
  • Marriage and divorce events 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicators for whether a worker marries or divorces in a given year, taken from the Central Population Register and linked by personal identifier. The divorce analysis uses workers married as of 1999; marriage analysis uses workers unmarried in 1999 (1999 dropped from marriage-rate plots). Cohabiting partners are distinguished from married spouses.
    登记库： CPR (Central Population Register)
    代码： Stata variables EMARA (marriage), EDIVA (divorce), mar99
    工作论文 · Section 2.3; Table 1 notes; Analysis1.do labels
  • Parental leave take 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator for taking childcare/parental leave in a year, from childcare leave spells in Statistics Denmark's social benefits statistics, part of the income statistics registers.
    登记库： SHSS (Sammenhaengende socialstatistik), OF (Offentligt forsoergede)
    代码： Stata variable DParL
    工作论文 · Section 2.3
  • Fertile age 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Fertile-age sample is women below 37 and men below 46 years as of 1999 (fertile age limit taken as 36 for women and 45 for men). The published-version code instead uses an age 18-39 indicator (age1839) for fertility heterogeneity.
    登记库： IDA, BEF
    工作论文 · Footnote 25; Table 4 notes
  • Unemployment and UI benefits 失业与福利金
    Unemployment is the percentage of annual time in unemployment. UI benefits are the sum of unemployment insurance, education allowance for the unemployed and other UI benefits, deflated by CPI and expressed relative to the worker's average 1996-1999 monthly earnings.
    登记库： IDA, IND
    代码： arblhu (unemployment insurance), quddydl (education allowance for unemployed), andakas (other UI benefits); normalised by normsal9699
    复制代码 · Analysis1.do lines 684-705 (Table A5); WP Table 8 notes
  • Earnings and personal income 劳动收入与收入
    Annual labour earnings (salary) and personal income, the latter including unemployment insurance and government transfers; in the cumulative textile-worker regressions both are expressed as multiples of the worker's own 1999 value. Earnings at the 1999 firm are also analysed separately.
    登记库： IDA, IND
    代码： Stata variables anrsalary, anrsal99, anrperinc, anrperinc99
    工作论文 · Table 8 notes; Analysis1.do Table 3
  • Occupation groups (manager, machine operator) 职业与职位层级
    1999 occupation grouped from DISCO-88 major groups: 1 Managers; 2-3 Professionals and technicians; 4-5 Clerks and service workers; 7 Craft workers; 8 Operators; 9 Labourers; set missing if 2-digit code is 99. Machine operator is DISCO 2-digit group 82.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： DISCO-88 1-digit (disc1_99) groups {1},{2,3},{4,5},{7},{8},{9}; disc2_99==82 machine operator; disc2_99==99 missing
    复制代码 · Analysis1.do lines 7-22
  • Industry import penetration from China (economy-wide) 贸易与离岸外包
    Change in Chinese import penetration at the six-digit industry level, instrumented with Chinese imports in other advanced countries (Australia, Finland, Germany, Japan, Netherlands, New Zealand, Switzerland, USA), log average distance of Denmark's import partners in 1996, and the share of retail trading firms; two-digit industry fixed effects included.
    登记库： IDA, Foreign trade statistics
    代码： Stata IP_9909 instrumented by iv8del6, lntdistw
    工作论文 · Section 6 and footnote 51; Analysis2.do Table 5
  • Firm separation rate 企业特征与生产率
    Percentage of the workplace's 1998 employees who are not employed in the workplace in 1999.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Footnote 40
