Does Biology Drive Child Penalties? Evidence from Biological and Adoptive Families

Henrik Kleven, Camille Landais and Jakob Egholt Søgaard · AER: Insights, 2021 · 个人

利用近 40 年的丹麦收养数据，比较亲生母亲与收养母亲的事件研究生育惩罚。亲生母亲的短期惩罚略大，但长期惩罚几乎完全相同，因此生物因素并非与子女相关的性别差距的关键成因。

数据
Statistics Denmark administrative registers covering the full population 1980–2017, linked with family identifiers, Adoption registry of Statistics Denmark (1988–2009), augmented with foreign adoptions identified via country of origin and Central Person Register immigration records, Earnings and labour-supply registers incl. hours from the ATP mandated pension scheme, Education registers
关键变量
  • 事件：第一个孩子的到来（出生或收养）
  • 结果变量：年度劳动收入（工资、薪金、自雇收入）
  • 结果变量：劳动参与、工作小时数、工资率
  • 比较组：亲生家庭与收养家庭（对亲生样本重新加权以匹配收养家庭）
时期
1980–2017
样本
约 527,000 例头胎出生（亲生样本）和约 4,600 例第一个孩子到来（收养样本） 第一个孩子在 1985 年至 2007 年间通过出生或跨国收养（5 岁之前）到来的丹麦父母，父母双方身份已知、在世，且自孩子到来前 5 年至到来后 10 年一直居住在丹麦。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Foreign adoptee 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Children who (1) were born in a non-western country, (2) have two known parents born in a western country, (3) whose parents both had a legal address in Denmark with no emigration record at the time of birth, and (4) have a recorded entry (immigration record) into the Central Person Register after the date of birth. Validated against Statistics Denmark official adoption records (1988-2009), with virtually no type I or type II errors; about 16,260 foreign adoptees 1980-2017, mostly from Asia (South Korea, India, China), Latin America (Colombia) and Africa.
    登记库： CPR, BEF, Adoption registry (Statistics Denmark)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix, Figure A.I notes and Table A.I
  • Event sample (first child arrival) 样本界定与时间
    Stepwise restrictions: children with known parents born 1980-2017 (16,260 adoptive / 2,454,200 biological); born 1985-2007; first-born only; siblings all of the same type (biological or adoptive); adoptees arrived before age 5; parents balanced on event time (final 4,580 adoptive / 527,000 biological).
    登记库： BEF, CPR
    在线附录 · Online Appendix, Table A.II
  • Annual earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Annual income from wages, salaries and self-employment.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark income registers
    工作论文 · Section 2 (Data)
  • Hours worked and wage rate 工作时间
    Hours worked from administrative, third-party-reported data on contributions to the mandated ATP (Arbejdsmarkedets Tillaegspension) pension scheme, which employers pay based on employees' individual hours worked. The wage rate is earnings divided by hours worked.
    登记库： ATP
    工作论文 · Section 2 (Data)
  • Reweighting of biological families 样本界定与时间
    Baseline reweighting of the biological sample on pre-birth variables (year of first child, mother's age at first child, mother's pre-child education and pre-child earnings) plus subsequent-children variables (years to second child, total number of children); alternatives use no reweighting or pre-birth variables only.
    登记库： BEF, UDDA, IND
    在线附录 · Online Appendix, Figure A.III notes
  • Relative female earnings potential 劳动收入与收入
    Baseline measured just before the arrival of the first child (event time -1), splitting women at the median. Forward-looking (potentially endogenous) alternatives measure it 10 years after first child arrival, after 15 years of experience, or at age 45.
    登记库： UDDA, IND
    在线附录 · Online Appendix, Figure A.IV notes

Gender Differences in Negotiation: Evidence from Real Estate Transactions

Steffen Andersen, Julie Marx, Kasper Meisner Nielsen and Lise Vesterlund · Economic Journal, 2021 · 个人

在丹麦的房地产交易中，男性看似比女性拿到更好的价格，但在更好地控制房产价值后差距缩小，在重复销售样本和继承房产样本中则消失。价格差异反映的是男性和女性需求的房产不同，而非谈判上的差异。

数据
Property transactions from the Danish Tax and Customs Administration (SKAT), Housing register (BBR), Civil Registration System (CPR), Income and tax-assessed property values from SKAT, Education registers (Ministry of Education), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA) employment status, Cause-of-Death Register (Danish National Board of Health)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：住宅或公寓的实际成交价格
  • 核心解释变量：单身买方／卖方的性别
  • 控制变量：税务评估的房产价值、BBR 房产特征、房产固定效应（重复销售）
  • 遗产出售：独生子女从已故父母处继承的房产
时期
1994–2013
样本
337,685 笔房地产交易（重复销售样本 97,216 笔；遗产出售样本中有 13,953 处继承的住宅和公寓） 1994–2013 年丹麦住宅和公寓的非关联方公平交易，买方和卖方为单身女性或单身男性。 来源
变量如何定义（10）
  • Buyer and seller identification 样本界定与时间
    Buyers are the owners of the property (per BBR owner records) on January 1 in the year after the transaction; sellers are the owners on January 1 in the year of the transaction. If the sales agreement is signed in year t but ownership is transferred in t+1, buyers are the owners on January 1 of t+2, conditional on no registered trades during t+1.
    登记库： BBR, SKAT property transactions (Statstidende), CPR
    在线附录 · Appendix A, Data sources (and footnote 1)
  • Transaction sample restrictions 样本界定与时间
    All property transactions 1994-2013 restricted to single-family houses and apartments bought and sold by individuals; drops transactions flagged by Statistics Denmark as involving price clauses or extreme prices, rented-out properties, properties traded more than once within a year, transactions within a household or between parents and children, households buying or selling more than three properties in a year, and agents outside ages 18-65. Cottages, farms and cooperative housing are excluded.

    Households use the Statistics Denmark household ID: one or two adults plus children under 25 living with them; three types are couples (married, registered and cohabiting partners), single women and single men. A household must be stable: constant number of adults in the transaction year and the year after, no divorce from two years before to one year after the transaction, and no adult member lost to death within one year before or after.

  • Tax-assessed property value 财富、负债与消费
    SKAT's assessment of the property's value if sold (basis for property value tax and municipal land tax), carried out every other year and regulated by local house price growth in non-assessment years; the paper uses the assessed value in the year prior to the transaction, entered as log of thousand year-2015 DKK.

    IDA status classified at end of November each year: employed if the majority of personal income is from paid employment, self-employed if the majority is from self-employment, retired if outside the labour market with the majority of income from private or public pensions, and unemployed otherwise. Household variables are shares of adult members (0, 0.5 or 1), measured in November of the year before the transaction.

Children and Gender Inequality: Evidence from Denmark

Henrik Kleven, Camille Landais and Jakob Egholt Søgaard · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2019 · 个人

围绕第一个孩子出生的事件研究表明，从长期看母亲的劳动收入相对于父亲下降约 20%，下降来自工作时间、劳动参与和工资率三个方面。这类生育惩罚如今解释了尚存的性别劳动收入差距的大部分，并且通过母亲自身的成长环境在代际间传递。

数据
Full-population Danish administrative registers linked by personal ID (earnings, labour supply, occupation, firm, education), 1980–2013, Family and generational links (population register), ATP pension contributions as third-party measure of hours worked, Additional administrative data back to 1964 for intergenerational analysis, Matched employer-employee data (firm family-friendliness), International Social Survey Program (ISSP) 2002 for gender attitudes
关键变量
  • 处理／事件：第一个孩子出生（相对于首次生育的事件时间）
  • 结果变量：劳动收入、劳动参与、工作时间（ATP）、工资率
  • 结果变量：职业等级、部门、企业的家庭友好程度
  • 生育惩罚：女性劳动收入相对于男性下降的百分比
  • 代际：外祖父母的劳动供给
时期
1980–2013 年（代际传递分析的数据可追溯至 1964 年）；首次生育发生于 1985–2003 年
样本
约 470,000 次生育，即 15,040,000 个个人—年份观测值 第一个孩子出生于 1985–2003 年、且从生育前 5 年到生育后 10 年均在世并居住在丹麦的丹麦父母。 来源
调查
ISSP 2002
变量如何定义（10）
  • ATP hours worked 工作时间
    For the OECD-comparable gender gap series, full-time workers aged 16-64 are identified using the ATP hours measure; earnings and participation gaps use the whole population aged 16-64, hours and wage gaps are conditional on participation.
    登记库： ATP pension contributions
    代码： ages 16-64
    在线附录 · Figure A.I notes
  • Wage rate 劳动收入与收入
    Earnings divided by the ATP hours measure, for those who are working (conditional on participation).
    登记库： ATP pension contributions, Income registers
    工作论文 · Section 2; Section 3.2 footnote 9
  • Child penalty 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Event study around year of first birth (t=0), event time -5 to +10 with t=-1 omitted, separately by gender with age and year dummies, estimated in levels; penalty P_t = (alpha_men_t - alpha_women_t) / E[counterfactual women's outcome | t], the percentage by which women fall behind men due to children.
    登记库： Population register (family links)
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, eqs. (1)-(2)
  • Event-study sample 样本界定与时间
    Treatment = balanced panel of individuals with first child 1985-2003 observed in a 15-year window around the first birth; control = balanced panel of never-parents with a placebo birth in 1985-2003 observed in the same window.
    登记库： Population register
    在线附录 · Appendix B.2
  • Never-parent control group with placebo births 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Separately by sex, a probit for zero lifetime fertility is estimated on non-truncated cohorts 1955-1973 with dummies for own-cohort income quartile, own-cohort wealth quartile, spouse-cohort wealth quartile, education length/degree (8 categories), decade of birth of maternal grandmother and of maternal grandfather, and region. For each cohort born after 1973, among those childless by 2013 the individuals with the highest predicted probability are designated never-parents so that their share equals the 1955-1973 average zero-fertility share. Placebo age at first child is drawn from a log-normal distribution fitted within birth cohort x education cells (for post-1973 cohorts the mean is extrapolated by a linear trend, variance held fixed).
    登记库： Population register (fertility links), Income and wealth registers, Education register
    在线附录 · Appendix B.2
  • Occupational rank and top manager 职业与职位层级
    Occupation ranked in five levels: unskilled labour, skilled labour, white-collar work (low level), white-collar work (high level) and top manager, an ordering consistent with average earnings or wage rates by occupation; separate indicator for being top manager.
    登记库： Occupation (matched employer-employee data)
    工作论文 · Section 3.3, Figure 5 Panels A-B
  • Firm family friendliness 企业特征与生产率
    Share of women with children below age 15 in the firm's workforce (excluding the woman's own first child when it arrives); outcome is the percentile rank in the distribution of firm family friendliness.
    登记库： Matched employer-employee data
    工作论文 · Section 3.3, Figure 5 Panel D
  • Public-sector employment 部门与行业
    Indicator for working in the Danish public sector (no register code given).
    登记库： Matched employer-employee data
    工作论文 · Section 3.3, Figure 5 Panel C
  • Grandparental relative labour supply rank 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Relative labour supply of (maternal or paternal) grandparents based on cumulated hours worked 1964-79 from ATP pension contributions, in quintiles. Robustness controls: grandparents' within-generation wealth-rank quintiles, region of residence, length and field of education of grandmother and grandfather (22 dummies), and parents' total number of children measured in 2014.
    登记库： ATP pension contributions, Wealth register, Education register, Population register

以无子女的丹麦女性体外受精治疗的成功作为生育子女的工具变量，因为 IVF 是否成功与劳动力市场经历无关。子女使女性的劳动收入大幅且持久地下降，主要是通过小时收入而非工时；第一个孩子的效应远大于之后的孩子。

  • 结果变量：小时工资与工作小时数／就业
  • 机制：职业、部门和企业的变动
时期
1991–2009 年（IVF 治疗时间为 1995–2005 年）

  • IVF treatment success (instrument) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Equals 1 if the first IVF treatment with embryo implants (in a sequence of treatments) led to a childbirth, 0 otherwise; treatment outcome (birth, abortion, stillbirth, failure) and dates from the IVF register (mandatory reporting 1994-2005).

All regressions control for age at first IVF treatment, year of first IVF treatment, and pre-treatment education and earnings; pre-treatment baseline means are taken over years 1-4 before the first IVF treatment. Four samples: (i) IVF-treated women without children (baseline); (ii) IVF-treated women with children; (iii) successfully treated women with at least two embryos implanted (twin strategy); (iv) representative sample of women with a first child born 1995-2005. Educational Ambition, Marital Sorting, and Inequality

Frederik Almar, Benjamin Friedrich, Ana Reynoso, Bastian Schulz and Rune Vejlin · Journal of Labor Economics, 2026 · 个人

依据毕业生的起薪和工资增长，把丹麦细分的教育项目划分为不同的“志向类型”。尽管按传统教育层次衡量的婚姻匹配看起来没有变化，按教育志向的同质婚配却已大幅上升；1980 年以来家庭收入不平等的上升中，婚姻市场贡献了 40% 以上。

数据
Population register with partner links (BEF), Education register with four-digit ISCED programme codes (UDDA), Employment register with hourly wages (IDAN), Income register (IND), Danish Labour Force Survey (LFS/AKU), 2000–2018, Employment register for hours, part-time/full-time (RAS)
关键变量
  • 分类：根据教育项目层面的起薪和工资增长划分的教育“志向类型”（约 1,800 个教育项目）
  • 结果变量：按志向类型的婚姻匹配（同质婚配）
  • 结果变量：家庭劳动收入不平等
  • 工资度量：按教育项目计算的残差化对数小时工资
  • LFS 工作属性：工时、晚间/周末/在家工作
时期
1980–2018
样本
平均每年 3,031,511 名 19–60 岁的个人；每年 1,800,866 名处于伴侣关系中的个人 1980–2018 年居住在丹麦的全部 19–60 岁个人，伴侣定义为已婚或同居的异性伴侣。 来源
调查
Labour Force Survey (AKU)
变量如何定义（12）
  • Residualised log hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Hourly wage in the primary job held in the last week of November (IDAN), ranking job types H, 3, A, S, M and keeping the highest; variable TIMELON before 2008 and SMAL_TIMELOEN from 2008. Log hourly wages are regressed on year dummies (base 2000) and education-specific experience profiles, and the year coefficients are subtracted. Hours underlying the wage are contractual (pre-2008 in four bins).
    登记库： IDAN, IND, IDAP
    代码： TIMELON (<2008), SMAL_TIMELOEN (>=2008); JOB_TYPE rank H,3,A,S,M; reg log_wage ib2000.aar i.educ_eika#c.erhverv_akk_new
    复制代码 · Data/Gen_sample1_new/Make analysis sample 1.do; IZA DP 17814 Online Appendix A.1 fn. 35 and A.2
  • Final educational programme 教育与考试成绩
    Highest completed education (HFAUDD, four-digit Danish ISCED/audd code, about 1,800 programmes) measured at age 35, or at the oldest observed age if the person is not observed at 35; graduation year from HF_VFRA. Grades 7-9 pooled as 9th grade; 9th grade (1109) and 10th grade (1110) split into 5 sub-programmes by region of graduation (regions 81-85); old pre-1980 high-school code mapped to the new one.
    登记库： UDDA
    代码： HFAUDD, HF_VFRA; 1109 and 1110 split by region 81-85; 1097 mapped to 1198
    复制代码 · Make analysis sample 1.do ('final education'); kmeans ambition types.do; Online Appendix A.2 'Education', 'Educational programs'
  • Programme starting wage (w0) and wage growth (g) 教育与考试成绩
    For each individual graduating in 1980 or later: w0 = mean residualised log hourly wage in years 1-5 after graduation; w1 = mean in years 9-11. Programme-level values average across graduates observed in both windows, excluding those with individual wage growth exp(w1-w0)-1 at or above the 99th percentile; programme growth g = exp(mean w1 - mean w0) - 1.
    登记库： IDAN, UDDA
    复制代码 · Make analysis sample 1.do ('peer wage growth'); Online Appendix A.2 'Starting wages and growth'
  • Educational ambition type 教育与考试成绩
    Programmes are clustered by k-means on (programme starting wage, programme wage growth), with k = 3, 4 or 5 (seed 1234), both in raw and standardised versions; the four-type classification gives the (low/high w0) x (low/high g) ambition types.
    登记库： IDAN, UDDA
    代码： cluster kmeans wage_start_mean_ambition wage_growth_ambition, k(4) s(kr(1234))
    复制代码 · Data/Gen_kmeans ambition types/kmeans ambition types.do
  • Couples (married and cohabiting) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Relationship = married (CIVST = 'G') or with a cohabitation partner id (FAELLE_NR non-missing); couple id is the man's PNR, linked through AEGTE_NR (spouse) or FAELLE_NR (cohabitant). Only couples where both partners are observed and both are aged 19-60 are kept.
    登记库： BEF, PERSONER
    代码： CIVST == "G"; AEGTE_NR; FAELLE_NR
    复制代码 · kmeans ambition types.do, 'Define marital status' and 'Make couple ID'
  • Programme-outcome estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    All persons living in Denmark at end of year 1980-2018 aged 19-60, irrespective of marital status (about 3.0 million per year); persons with missing education (2.6%) excluded.
    登记库： BEF, PERSONER, UDDA
    代码： keep if age>=19 & age<=60
    复制代码 · Make analysis sample 1.do; paper Section 2 (IZA DP 17814)
  • Region of graduation 地理与社区
    Residence municipality (BOPAEL_KOM_KODE) mapped from pre-2007 to post-2007 municipalities using each person's modal 2005-to-2006 transition, then grouped into the five regions 81-85 by municipality code lists; region in the graduation year (or first observed year) is used.
    登记库： BEF
    代码： BOPAEL_KOM_KODE; region 81 (Nordjylland) ... 85 (Sjaelland) via inlist() of municipality codes
    复制代码 · Data/Gen_regions/region codes.do; Make analysis sample 1.do
  • Full-time / part-time and part-time penalty 工作时间
    Full-time from RAS: at least 32 hours per week (threshold 30 hours in 1980-1992 and 27 hours in 1993-2007). Part-time penalty = ratio of w1 (wage in years 9-11 after graduation) of full-time workers to that of part-time workers, by programme.
    登记库： RAS
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Table 1 description) and footnotes 14-15
  • LFS 'super full-time' and irregular hours 工作时间
    From LFS (AKU, 2000-2018): sft = 1 if usual weekly hours >= 38, or = 37 combined with evening, night, Saturday, Sunday or home work (answer 1 or 2) or overtime as reason (hourreas = 16); evening/night/weekend defined only when shiftwk = 3. Programme averages use yfactor weights for programmes with >= 50 (or 100) LFS observations; hwactual = 99 dropped.
    登记库： AKU, RAS
    代码： hwusual >= 38; evenwk/nightwk/satwk/sunwk/homewk in 1,2; shiftwk == 3; hourreas == 16
    复制代码 · Results/fig_A1/LFS_clustering_prep_BF_dropmissing.do
  • Lifetime earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Sum over 30 years after graduation of deflated log annual earned income ERHVERVSINDK_13 (employment plus self-employment income), year effects (base 2000) removed, for graduates observed for all 30 years; averaged by programme.

    Average net wealth at age 50 by programme, excluding pension assets, deflated to 2000 prices.
    登记库： IND
    工作论文 · Section 3, footnote 16
  • Ever manager 职业与职位层级
    Fraction of a programme's graduates who reach a managerial position, i.e. hold a corresponding occupational code for at least two consecutive years.
    登记库： RAS, AKM

Survivors' Mental Health and the Protective Role of Income Stability

Itzik Fadlon, Astrid Sophie Fugleholm and Torben Heien Nielsen · AER: Insights, 2026 · 个人

基于丹麦全部家庭，记录了配偶去世后心理健康药物使用立即、大幅且持久的上升。这一激增有很大一部分可由配偶死亡造成的收入损失来解释，因此安全网提供的流动性保护了遗属的心理健康。

数据
Population Registry (BEF) with family linkages, Death Registry, National Patient Registry (LPR), Income Registry (earnings, transfers, pension payouts, capital income), Education Registry, Pharmaceutical Database / prescription register (LMDB), Health Insurance Registry (psychiatrist visits)
关键变量
  • 处理：配偶发生致命的心脏病发作或中风（12 个月内死亡），处理组对比事件发生较晚的对照组
  • 结果变量：心理健康药物的使用（ATC N05、N06）
  • 机制：配偶死亡造成的家庭收入损失（以去世配偶的劳动收入份额作为工具变量）
  • 异质性：基期收入、净财富和保险（DI/OAP、病假工资）
时期
1995–2018
样本
12,637 个处理组家庭和 15,212 个对照组家庭 45–80 岁的丹麦夫妇，其中一方在 1999 年至 2018 年间发生心脏病发作或中风并在 12 个月内死亡，不含自雇者，事件前后各四年为平衡面板。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Fatal heart attack or stroke (death event) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Robustness version requires the spouse to die from the same cause as the index health event within 12 months.
    登记库： LPR, Death Registry
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix, Figures B.2-B.3 notes
  • Mental health medication take-up 医疗服务利用
    Indicator for redeeming a prescription for psychotropic drugs classified as psycholeptics (ATC N05) or psychoanaleptics (ATC N06) by the surviving spouse, measured at monthly and annual frequency (extensive margin).
    登记库： LMDB
    代码： ATC N05, N06
    工作论文 · Section I (Variable definitions)
  • Household income loss 劳动收入与收入
    Household income decomposed into seven sources for each spouse: earnings, sick pay, DI + old-age pension (OAP), other government benefits, private pensions, capital income and other income, compared between the year before (period -1) and the year after (period 1) the index event. In 2SLS the household income loss is normalized at the treatment-group mean and winsorized at the top and bottom 1 percent.
    登记库： Income Registry (IND)
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix, Tables B.4-B.7 notes
  • Deceased's income share (instrument) 劳动收入与收入
    Household income loss is instrumented with an indicator for whether the deceased spouse had earnings and a quadratic in the share of household income earned by the deceased spouse in the year before the event; 2SLS uses observations for years -1 and 0 with household FE, calendar-year FE and a quadratic in the survivor's age; SEs clustered by household.
    登记库： Income Registry (IND)
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix, Table B.7 notes
  • Treatment/control by event timing 样本界定与时间
    Households where one spouse has a health event 1999-2018 and dies within 12 months; treatment = event in 1999-2013, control = similar event in 2004-2018 with placebo event assigned five years earlier; both spouses aged 45-80 at baseline; balanced from four years before to four years after. Specifications include household FE, calendar-year FE and a quadratic in the surviving spouse's age. For Delta = 3-7 robustness the calendar interval of treated spousal deaths is held fixed so only the control group changes. Variables are measured in the year before the actual or placebo event.
    登记库： BEF, LPR, Death Registry, IND
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix, Table B.1-B.3 and Figure B.8 notes
  • Baseline psychiatric treatment 医疗服务利用
    Indicator for whether the surviving spouse had psychiatric treatment (visits to psychiatrists recorded in the Health Insurance Registry from 1990), used as a heterogeneity/control variable.
    登记库： SSSY, SYSI
    工作论文 · Section I (Data); Section III.B robustness
  • Deceased earner status 劳动收入与收入
    Indicator for whether the deceased spouse had labour market earnings in the year before the health event; used to split households (earner vs non-earner) and as an instrument.
    登记库： Income Registry (IND)
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix, Figures B.5-B.7 notes
  • Disability insurance and old-age pension rules 退休与养老金
    DI for those below OAP age requires a loss of work capacity of at least 50 percent (assessed by municipality) and can also be granted for social reasons; paid until OAP age. OAP for all residents from full retirement age, rising from 65 to 67 for cohorts born after 1954; both means-tested against own and partner income and independent of earnings history.
    登记库： Social pension rules
    代码： work-capacity loss >= 50%

Fertility and Family Labor Supply

Katrine Jakobsen, Thomas H. Jørgensen and Hamish Low · American Economic Review (forthcoming), 2026 · 个人

利用 2009 年丹麦税制改革，表明女性税后净工资提高会降低生育，而男性工资提高则会提高生育。基于登记数据估计的一个夫妻选择生育时点和子女数量的生命周期模型表明，允许生育作出调整会大幅提高女性劳动供给的反应程度，而生育前后的人力资本折旧在很大程度上造成了长期的性别工资差距。

数据
Monthly payroll records (BFL/eIndkomst), Annual income tax data (IND), Population and family register (BEF), family definitions and parent links, Education register (UDDA), Labour market experience from ATP payments, Parental leave spell register (OF)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：生育（出生）
  • 处理：2009–2018 年税制改革带来的边际税后净工资率变化
  • 结果变量：劳动力市场参与、兼职与全职工作（根据工资单工时）
  • 结果变量：年度劳动收入
  • 控制变量：教育（高技能对较低技能）、劳动力市场经验
时期
2004–2018 年（税收样本 2004–2018 年；估计样本 2010–2018 年）
样本
10,851,444 个个人—年份观测值（估计样本）；2,531,181 个（税收样本） 25–60 岁、有异性伴侣的丹麦个人，不含学生、自雇者、退休者和领取残疾养老金者；税收样本限于 25–40 岁的同居或已婚女性。 来源
变量如何定义（11）
  • Labour market participation, part-time and full-time work 就业与劳动力状态
    Participation means at least 481 annual hours (e.g. 37 hours for 13 weeks) on BFL pay slips together with annual income of at least 50,000 DKK; part time is 481-1,664 annual hours; full time is more than 1,664 hours. Monthly hours and income are scaled down by the share of the month registered on parental leave in the OF register.
    登记库： BFL (eIndkomst), OF
    代码： thresholds 481 and 1,664 annual hours; 50,000 DKK
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Annual labour income (BFL) 劳动收入与收入
    12-month sum of monthly labour income from BFL pay slips, by calendar year for age profiles and centred on the birth month for event-study moments (e.g. income from January-February before a March birth counts as year -1); excludes income registered while on parental leave; deflated by CPI, in 1000 DKK. Estimation sample 2010-2018.
    登记库： BFL (eIndkomst), OF
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Personal income (tax sample) 劳动收入与收入
    Personal income from annual tax data: labour income from wage work, profits from own firms and labour market transfers; deflated by CPI.
    登记库： IND
    代码： PERINDKP
    工作论文 · Supplemental Material A
  • Couples / partners 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Partners follow Statistics Denmark's family definition, including married and cohabiting couples; cohabitants are two adults at the same address registered as parents to a child, or two opposite-sex adults with an age difference under 15 years at the same address. Constructed from EFALLE in BEF; couple age is the woman's age. Estimation sample keeps couples with at most five years age difference.
    登记库： BEF
    代码： EFALLE; FOED_DAG; KOEN
    工作论文 · Section 2, footnote 8; Supplemental Material A
  • High skilled vs less skilled 教育与考试成绩
    High skilled if at least 180 months of education (at least a bachelor's degree), measured as the highest degree earned in the sample period; less skilled otherwise.
    登记库： UDDA
    代码： HFPRIA >= 180 months
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Labour market experience 就业与劳动力状态
    Statistics Denmark's experience measure based on accumulated mandatory ATP pension payments, which depend on hours worked; part-time employment counts as 2/3 of full time.
    登记库： IDAP
    代码： ERHVER, ERHVER79
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Sample exclusions by main activity 样本界定与时间
    Individuals aged 25-60 with an opposite-sex partner; observations dropped if mainly student, self-employed, retired or on disability pension, based on main activity at end of November.
    登记库： IDAP/AKM (socio-economic status)
    代码： SOCSTIL, SOCSTIL_KODE
    工作论文 · Section 2; Supplemental Material A
  • Mechanical net-of-tax rate change (instrument) 税收与税率
    Four-year mechanical change log(1 - tau_{t+4}(z_t)) - log(1 - tau_t(z_t)) in the marginal net-of-tax rate, holding income and characteristics at year-t values, computed with a Danish tax simulator; used to instrument own and partner net-of-tax rate changes and virtual income. Restricted to couples where both have personal income of 50,000-600,000 DKK in the base year. Outcome is the 4-year difference in number of children born.
    登记库： IND
    工作论文 · Section 3; Supplemental Material A.1
  • Household wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Bank deposits, bonds, stocks and property net of loans and mortgages at end of year; registered property values raised by 10% (following Leth-Petersen 2010); deflated by CPI, in 1000 DKK.
    登记库： IND
    代码： FORM; FORMREST_NY05 (after 1996)
    工作论文 · Supplemental Material A
  • Child linkage and age of children 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Children and their ages are linked to parents through the parent identifiers in BEF; almost all children can be linked to a mother.
    登记库： BEF
    在线附录 · Supplemental Material, Data Appendix (p. S2)
  • Estimation sample vs tax sample 样本界定与时间
    Two samples: the BFL estimation sample of all individuals aged 25-60 with partners, 2010-2018; and the tax sample of women aged 25-40 with partners, 2004-2018 (used with personal income PERINDKP). Both split by less skilled vs high skilled.
    登记库： BFL (eIndkomst), IND, BEF
    在线附录 · Supplemental Material, Table A.1

Effects of Parental Death on Labor Market Outcomes

Mathias Fjællegaard Jensen and Ning Zhang · American Economic Review, 2026 · 个人

利用丹麦行政数据中父母里首位去世者突然离世的事件以及匹配的对照组。男性劳动收入下降约 2%，女性下降约 3%，两者的心理健康都变差；有年幼子女的女性损失最大，约为 4%，这与失去祖辈提供的非正式育儿照料的解释相一致。

数据
Cause of death registers (DODSAARS/DODSAARG), Population register with parent-child links (BEF), Income and labour market registers (IND, AKM, IDAS/IDAN/IDAP), ATP-based hours proxy, Health Insurance Register for GP/psychologist/psychiatrist visits (SYSI/SSSY), National Patient Register (LPR_ADM/LPR_DIAG), Psychiatric Central Research Register (PSYK_ADM/PSYK_DIAG), Prescription register (LMDB), Childcare registers (DAGI/BOERNFB)
关键变量
  • 处理：父母中首位去世者为突然死亡（心脏病、脑血管疾病、急性呼吸道感染、意外事故）
  • 结果变量：年劳动收入（以去世前同性别均值为基准作指数化）
  • 结果变量：就业与工时代理变量
  • 结果变量：心理健康服务使用与处方
  • 对照组：匹配的尚未受处理个体
时期
1980–2019 年（父母去世时间为 1985–2014 年）
样本
处理组：母亲先去世的女儿 21919 人、儿子 24354 人；父亲先去世的女儿 74991 人、儿子 85022 人（另有匹配的对照组） 父母双方信息均已知、在 1985 至 2014 年间经历父母中首位去世者突然离世的 25–50 岁丹麦成年人，以及匹配的对照组。 来源

    Sudden deaths = deaths from heart diseases, cerebrovascular diseases, and traffic or other (external) accidents; non-sudden = all remaining causes. Sample: first parental deaths 1985-2014 for children aged 25-50 in the year of the first parental death with two known parents.
    登记库： DODSAARS/DODSAARG, BEF
    代码： cause categories only (no ICD list given in appendix); child age 25-50; deaths 1985-2014

SEs clustered at individual-by-match ID.
    登记库： BEF, DODSAARS/DODSAARG

    Earnings from employment and self-employment, inflated to 2020 levels and indexed by the average earnings of men (women) one year before the parental death.

Germs in the Family: The Short- and Long-Term Consequences of Intrahousehold Disease Spread

N. Meltem Daysal, Hui Ding, Maya Rossin-Slater and Hannes Schwandt · American Economic Review, 2026 · 个人

研究表明，弟弟妹妹在婴儿期因呼吸系统疾病住院的频率是其哥哥姐姐当年的两到三倍，原因是学龄前儿童把疾病带回家。结合出生次序与呼吸系统疾病流行程度的地区差异，研究发现生命早期的暴露会降低弟弟妹妹日后的劳动收入和受教育程度，并使慢性呼吸系统健康和心理健康状况恶化。

数据
National Patient Register (LPR), Medical Birth Register (MFR), Population register (BEF), Register-Based Labour Force Statistics (RAS), Income Statistics Register (IND), Education Register (UDDA), Academic Achievement Register (9th grade test scores), Psychiatric Central Research Register (PCRR), Health Insurance Register (Sygesikringsregisteret), Childcare enrollment data, National Child Database (breastfeeding)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：出生后第一年内的急性呼吸系统疾病住院
  • 处理：出生次序（第二胎对第一胎）与市镇呼吸系统疾病暴露指数的交互项
  • 结果变量：18–32 岁时的劳动收入、劳动参与和收入排名
  • 结果变量：高中和大学完成情况；九年级考试成绩
  • 结果变量：慢性呼吸系统疾病和心理健康方面的医疗服务使用
时期
1981–2017 年出生的儿童；结果变量为 1980–2019 年
样本
1,230,180 名儿童 1981–2017 年在丹麦出生的第一胎和第二胎单胎兄弟姐妹，出生间隔至少 11 个月，分布在 91 个市镇。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Acute respiratory hospitalizations (first year of life) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Number of inpatient hospitalizations in the first year of life (also split into first and second six months) with a primary diagnosis of an acute respiratory condition, from the National Patient Register (1981-2018).
    登记库： LPR
    代码： ICD-8 starting 46, 47, 48, 490, 079, 783; ICD-10 starting J (excluding J4) or B974
    在线附录 · Section 2; Appendix A
  • RSV hospitalizations 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Hospitalizations for respiratory syncytial virus, measurable only for cohorts born 1994 or later (ICD-10).
    登记库： LPR
    代码： ICD-10 J12.1, J20.5, J21.0, B97.4
    在线附录 · Appendix A
  • Chronic respiratory hospitalizations 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Inpatient visits with a primary diagnosis of a chronic respiratory condition (e.g. asthma, COPD), studied at ages 16-26.
    登记库： LPR
    代码： ICD-8 491-493; ICD-10 J4
    在线附录 · Appendix A
  • Mental healthcare visits 医疗服务利用
    Visits to psychiatric hospitals (inpatient, outpatient, ED from the Psychiatric Central Research Register) and to private psychiatric clinics (Health Insurance Register reimbursements, identified by physician specialty codes), at extensive and intensive margins, ages 16-26 (data 1997-2018).
    登记库： Psychiatric Central Research Register, Sygesikringsregisteret
    代码： physician specialty codes 24 or 26
    在线附录 · Section 2; Appendix A
  • Respiratory disease exposure index 地理与社区
    Monthly number of acute respiratory hospitalizations per 100 children aged 13-71 months in the child's municipality of residence (2007 municipality structure, via crosswalk), excluding the child's own older sibling if aged 13-71 months, summed over the 12 months of the child's first year of life (also separate indices for months 1-6 and 7-12).
    登记库： LPR, BEF
    代码： Acute respiratory ICD codes as above
    论文正文 · Section 4 and footnote 17
  • Sibling analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    From all 2,278,868 children born 1981-2017: drop one-child families; keep first- and second-born singletons only; require birth spacing of at least 11 months; require known municipality of birth in municipalities averaging at least 1,000 children aged 13-71 months (91 municipalities kept); drop missing parental controls and keep complete pairs. Final sample 1,230,180 children.
    登记库： MFR, BEF
    论文正文 · Section 2 (Analysis sample), footnote 14
  • Labour force participation 就业与劳动力状态
    Indicator equal to 1 if in the labour force (employed or unemployed searching) and 0 if out of the labour force, based on tax-record labour market status as of November of the preceding year; ages 18-32.
    登记库： RAS
    论文正文 · Section 2 (Labor market and income outcomes)
  • Wages, gross income and income rank 劳动收入与收入
    Wages among the employed and gross personal income including government transfers, in 2010 USD, winsorized at the 1st and 99th percentiles; income rank is the percentile of gross personal income within the full Danish population of the same birth cohort and age; ages 18-32.
    登记库： IND
    论文正文 · Section 2, footnote 12
  • Education attainment and 9th grade test scores 教育与考试成绩
    Indicators for high school and college graduation by ages 18-32 from highest completed schooling; 9th grade Danish (reading) and mathematics scores (2001-2019) standardized within subject and test year.
    登记库： UDDA, Academic Achievement Register
    论文正文 · Section 2 (Education outcomes)

Universal Daycare and Mothers' Working Lifetime

Sarah Sander · Economic Journal, 2026 · 个人

利用日托中心在丹麦各市镇的逐步铺开，追踪母亲的整个职业生涯。日托的可得性提高了首次生育十六年后的劳动参与、工时和劳动收入，效应由低学历母亲驱动，并部分通过生育和伴侣分离这两条中介渠道起作用。

数据
1970 Census (FT70) with parish of residence, Historical daycare institution yearbooks digitised (1964–1975) and daycare institutions in registers from 1976, Population register with parent-child links and fertility histories (BEF), Earnings from tax records (income registers), 1980–2015, Supplementary Pension Fund register (ATP) contributions for hours and participation, Education registers (UDDA)
关键变量
  • 处理：首次生育后，母亲 1970 年所在堂区的日托可得性
  • 结果变量：按第一个孩子年龄划分的劳动参与
  • 结果变量：年劳动收入的对数
  • 结果变量：根据 ATP 缴费得到的每周工时和全职就业
  • 中介变量：生育以及与孩子父亲分离
时期
首次生育时间为 1964–1975 年；劳动收入为 1980–2015 年
样本
370,602 名母亲 1970 年人口普查时居住在丹麦、于 1964 至 1975 年间生育第一个孩子并在该孩子年满 16 岁之前一直留在丹麦的非移民女性。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Daycare availability in 1970 parish (treatment) 地理与社区
    Mothers are placed in their parish of residence in the 1970 Census. vg = 1 if a daycare institution for ages 0-2 (nursery or integrated institution, from digitised institution data) existed in the parish in the year of first birth; bh = same for ages 3-6 (kindergarten); availability is also tracked for each year from child age 0 to 6 (all/some/no years).
    登记库： FT70 (1970 Census, parish), Daycare institution yearbooks/registers
    代码： institution number NUMMER < 120000 = nursery (vuggestue), > 250000 = integrated; parish (SOGNNR) x year; vg, bh, daycare0-daycare6
    复制代码 · dofiles/createfirst.do, 'FOLKETÆLLING 1970', 'DAYCARE 0-2', 'DAYCARE 3-6'
  • Mother sample and timing of first birth 样本界定与时间
    Native (IE_TYPE 1) women born 1920-1959 with a first child born 1964-1975, aged at least 13 at first birth, with a 1970 parish observed and surviving until the first child is 16. First-birth year is the earliest birth year among children linked through MOR_ID (supplemented by family-register child counts).
    登记库： BEF, Fødselsdata (birth data), FAMILIE, FT70
    代码： IE_TYPE == 1; MOR_ID; yrfirst in 1964-1975
    复制代码 · dofiles/createfirst.do, 'SAMLING AF BEF...' block
  • Hours (ATP-based) and full-time employment 工作时间
    Annual ATP pension contributions (sum of orer/100 per person-year) are divided by the full-time contribution amount for the year (194.4 up to 1964, 259.2 up to 1971, 302 in 1972, 432 in 1973-1981, 1166.4 from 1982) and capped at 1. Full-time = ratio of 1; for workers the ratio is converted to weekly hours as 9 + 26 x ratio. Measured for child ages 0-35; missing set to 0 if the mother is alive.
    登记库： ATP
    代码： ATP field ORER; divisors 194.4/259.2/302/432/1166.4 by year; full = hours>=1
    复制代码 · dofiles/createfirst.do, '*ATP' block and final forvalues x=0/35 loop
  • Labour force participation by child age 就业与劳动力状态
    For child ages 0-15, participation = positive ATP contributions in the year (hours > 0); for ages 16-40, participation = positive wage earnings (non-missing log earnings), set to 0 if missing and the mother is alive.
    登记库： ATP, IND
    代码： work = hours>0; xwork = learn (loglon non-missing) for ages 16-40
    复制代码 · dofiles/createfirst.do, final loops
  • Log annual earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Wage income (LONIND, replaced with corrected wage income CORLOEN in 2010-2015) converted to 2016 DKK with fixed year factors and to US dollars (6.7327), negative values set to 0, top-coded at 400,000, and logged (also inverse hyperbolic sine); measured child ages 5-40. Gross income (BRUTTO) is treated the same way for 1976 onward.
    登记库： IND
    代码： LONIND, CORLOEN, BRUTTO
    复制代码 · dofiles/createfirst.do, 'LØN INDKOMST' and 'BRUTTO INDKOMST'
  • Mother's education before first birth 教育与考试成绩
    Years of education (normed months/12) completed by the year of first birth, taken from the highest, vocational or general education fields with completion dates before the first birth (or inferred from age 5 + length), with self-reported sources dropped and minimum 7 years; grouped into basic (main level 10), medium (20, 25, 35) and high.
    登记库： UDDA
    代码： HFPRIA, EKPRIA, ALMPRIA; HFAUDD, ERHAUDD, ALMAUDD; HF_VFRA, ERH_VFRA, ALM_VFRA; drop HF_KILDE in 3, 9, 10, 17, 18; H1 10 = basic, 20/25/35 = medium
    复制代码 · dofiles/createfirst.do, 'UDDANNELSE FØR FØRSTE BARN'
  • Separation from the first child's father 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    divor = 1 if the mother's partner ID (C_FAELLE_ID) in the population register when the first child is 16 differs from the first child's father ID (FAR_ID); missing if father unknown.
    登记库： BEF
    代码： C_FAELLE_ID at age 16 of first child vs FAR_ID
    复制代码 · dofiles/createfirst.do, 'DIVORSE' block and divor definition
  • Fertility and birth spacing 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Number of children (more1-more4 indicators for at least 2-5 children) and time from first to second birth (space1-space3: second birth within 1, 2, 3 years).
    登记库： BEF, FAMILIE
    代码： numkid; yrnext - yrfirst
    复制代码 · dofiles/createfirst.do; resfirst_final_EJ.do, Table 7
  • Early retirement / pension 退休与养老金
    From IDA labour market position, early retirement pension = PSTILL 50, 55 or 56 and old-age pension = PSTILL 92, 93 or 94; first year observed used to compute pension age.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： PSTILL 50, 55, 56 (early pension); 92, 93, 94 (pension)
    复制代码 · dofiles/createfirst.do, '* PENSION'

Depressed Peers in Early Parenthood

Anne Toft Hansen, Jonas Cuzulan Hirani and Miriam Wüst · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2025 · 个人

在给定少数几项特征的条件下，市镇护士基本上是任意地把新手母亲分配到产后同伴小组。接触到一位抑郁的同伴，会使母亲本人在产后两年的心理健康服务使用增加 11%，并使她自评的心理健康状况和劳动力市场结果变差。

数据
Municipal health visitor records with mothers' group assignments and EPDS postpartum depression screening, Statistics Denmark registers: GP consultations, psychologist/psychiatrist appointments, hospital contacts for mental illness, sick leave
关键变量
  • 处理：新手母亲小组中有一位存在产后抑郁风险（EPDS）的同伴
  • 结果变量：产后两年内对心理健康服务的使用
  • 结果变量：因精神疾病到医院就诊
  • 结果变量：病假／劳动力市场结果
时期
2012–2017 年（健康访视员记录）
样本
所查资料中未注明 在丹麦各市镇由市镇健康访视员分配到新手母亲小组的初次生育的母亲。 来源（摘要）
变量如何定义（5）
  • Depressed peer (treatment) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Mother's own EPDS (Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale) score from municipal health-visitor records (first postnatal screening); high = EPDS > 10. Treatment = at least one other mother in the assigned mothers' group has a high EPDS score (leave-self-out group mean of high > 0); untested mothers coded as not high.
    登记库： Municipal health visitor records (EPDS), MFR
    代码： high = (score_e1 > 10); peer_treat = (leave-one-out mean of high in group > 0); questionnaires 'EPDS gravide','EPDS nybagt','Edinburgh' variants
    复制代码 · 10_cr_merge.do lines ~228-245; 2a_cr_efterf.do
  • GP contacts and fees 医疗服务利用
    Health insurance claims with SPEC2 = 80 (general practice) per service week (HONUGE); fees BRUHON summed by person and week (negative set to 0, duplicates by week x SPECIALE dropped) and by year of age relative to the birth; for children, contacts in the first 182 days after birth are excluded.
    登记库： SSSY, MFR
    代码： SPEC2 == '80' (raw extract keeps 80, 81, 82, 83, 89); BRUHON; HONUGE
    复制代码 · 4_cr_gpcontacts.do
  • Psychologist/psychiatrist consultations and GP mental-health tests 医疗服务利用
    Mother's claims with SPEC2 = 24 or 63 (psychiatrist / psychologist) by month since birth; GP contacts with a psychological test (code comment: test for depression/mental health screening) identified by SPECIALE codes 802147, 802148, 802149, 804106, 806101.
    登记库： SSSY
    代码： SPEC2 in ('24','63'); SPECIALE in ('802147','802148','802149','804106','806101')
    复制代码 · 3_cr_psyksssy.do
  • Psychiatric hospital contacts 医疗服务利用
    Hospital contacts with an action diagnosis in ICD-10 chapter F (DF00-DF99), split into inpatient (C_PATTYPE = 0) and outpatient (other patient types), by month since birth (admission date D_INDDTO).
    登记库： LPR (PSYKADM)
    代码： C_ADIAG DF00-DF99; C_PATTYPE == 0 inpatient
    复制代码 · 3_cr_psyksssy.do, 'psych hospital contacts' and 'Generate outcomes' sections
  • Sick leave and UI/benefit receipt (weekly) 失业与福利金
    Weekly DREAM codes for each parent from the birth week up to 5 years: sick leave if code 890 or 893-899; UI/other benefits if code 111, 115, 121, 151-153, 130, 133-139, 213-219, 299, 710, 713-719, 730, 733-739, 740, 743-749 (among others); 'working/self-sufficient' if no DREAM code in the week; parental leave benefit code 881.
    登记库： DREAM
    代码： sick: 890, 893-899; ui: 111,115,121,151,152,153,130,133-139,213-219,299,710,713-719,730,733-739,740,743-749,...; work: y == ''

Replication package

Is Parental Leave Costly for Firms and Coworkers?

Anne Ardila Brenøe, Serena Canaan, Nikolaj A. Harmon and Heather N. Royer · Journal of Labor Economics, 2024 · 个人 + 企业

将有女性雇员即将生育的丹麦小企业与没有即将发生生育的类似企业进行比较。几乎没有证据表明企业产出或同事受到负面影响：多数企业通过雇用临时工和增加其他雇员的工时来填补缺勤，只有无法重新分配工作的企业才出现损失。

数据
Central Person Registry with parent-child links (CPR/BEF), Parental leave benefit payouts and employer leave reimbursements, Central education register (UDDA), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Annual employer wage payment records (CON and RAS), Mandatory pension contributions for approximate hours (ATP), Value-added tax (VAT) firm sales and purchases data
关键变量
  • 处理：小型私营企业的一名女性雇员生育（事件年）
  • 结果变量：企业就业人数、全职当量工时、工资总额（总额及剔除休假部分）、销售额、毛利润的代理指标、存活
  • 结果变量：同事的工时、劳动收入、就业和病假天数
  • 机制：企业内的育儿假天数
  • 设计：采用匹配对照事件的动态双重差分
时期
2001–2013 年（生育发生在 2003–2012 年）
样本
24,829 个处理事件（生育）和 162,151 个对照事件，涉及 45,940 家不同企业；修剪后为 16,080 家企业中的 9,934 个处理事件 受雇于丹麦私营部门小企业的壮年（21–35 岁）女性的生育，与没有此类生育的匹配对照企业相比较。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Treatment and control events 样本界定与时间
    Potential event = a woman's main job at a firm in a baseline year; event year = baseline + 2. Treatment event: woman gives birth in the event year but not in the year before or after; control event: no birth in the event year, the year before or the year after. Woman aged 19-33 at baseline, at least one year tenure at the baseline firm and not a student.
    登记库： CPR, IDA
    工作论文 · Sections 5.1-5.2; Appendix C.2
  • Small private firm sample 企业特征与生产率
    Private-sector firm (CVR) with 3-30 employees in November of the baseline year and fewer than 60 employment relationships during the baseline year; active at baseline (hours at least one FTE, positive sales and wage payments in baseline, positive sales or wages the year before); sales per employee 10,000 DKK-100 million DKK and wages per worker 10,000 DKK-1 million DKK.
    登记库： IDA, VAT, CON, RAS
    工作论文 · Section 5.2; Appendix C.2
  • Firm employees (November stock) 就业与劳动力状态
    Standard IDA main November employment relationship: worker counted at the firm if their main job was there in the last week of November; includes workers on leave. Main job = job with most hours, ties broken by highest earnings.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 4.2; Appendix C.1
  • FTE hours from ATP contributions 工作时间
    Approximate yearly hours from mandatory ATP pension contributions (step schedule for 0-9, 9-17, 18-26 and 27+ weekly hours, topping out at full time, 37 hours), scaled to full-time equivalents (Lund and Vejlin 2016); share of year on paid parental leave subtracted since ATP continues during paid leave. Misses overtime.
    登记库： ATP
    工作论文 · Section 4.2; Appendix C.1
  • Wage bill and wage bill ex. leave 劳动收入与收入
    Total wage bill = sum of all pre-tax payments to workers in the year (from CON and RAS), including payments to workers on paid leave. Wage bill ex. leave: each worker's wage = payments / ATP hours incl. paid leave, multiplied by hours excluding paid leave; the gap (paid leave covered by the firm) is subtracted from the total wage bill.
    登记库： CON, RAS, ATP
    工作论文 · Section 4.2; Appendix C.1
  • Sales, gross profit proxy and survival 企业特征与生产率
    Total sales and purchases from VAT data (corrected to include exports; negative values recoded to zero). Gross profit proxy = sales minus purchases minus wage bill ex. leave (purchases include capital equipment). Total variable costs = purchases + wage bill ex. leave. Exiting firms kept with zero employees/hours/sales; shutdown proxied by zero sales.
    登记库： VAT
    工作论文 · Section 4.3; Appendix C.1
  • Parental leave days 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Total days of paid and unpaid leave from payouts of parental leave benefits to individuals and leave reimbursements to firms, incl. pregnancy-related extensions; prenatal and postnatal days allocated around the birth; truncated at 38 weeks any prenatal, 6 weeks paid prenatal, 52 weeks paid postnatal, 104 weeks any postnatal.
    登记库： Parental leave benefit payouts, Employer leave reimbursements
    工作论文 · Section 4.1; Appendix C.1
  • Coworker sample 样本界定与时间
    Male and female coworkers of event women in the baseline year whose job at the baseline firm is their main labour market attachment, with hours at least half an FTE and earnings above 75,000 DKK in the baseline year; followed even if they leave the firm.
    登记库： IDA, ATP
    工作论文 · Section 5.4; Appendix C.2
  • Coworker sick days 医疗服务利用
    Take-up of publicly paid sick days (any sick days); eligibility for public sickness funds starts after two weeks of sickness, so the measure captures longer sickness spells.
    工作论文 · Section 6, footnote 18; Figure 7(d)

Joint Retirement of Couples: Evidence from Discontinuities in Denmark

Esteban García-Miralles and Jonathan M. Leganza · Journal of Public Economics, 2024 · 个人

利用丹麦提前退休和公共养老金领取资格上的年龄断点表明，当伴侣一方获得资格并退休时，另一方也退休的可能性大幅上升；文章由此量化了对评估退休改革十分重要的溢出效应。

数据
Danish administrative registers for the full population 1986–2014 (labour market outcomes, pension benefits, socio-demographics, family/couple links), Annual taxable earnings registers, Monthly earnings records for all employees (eIndkomst/BFL) and monthly pension benefit records, from 2008, Voluntary early retirement pension (VERP) contribution records
关键变量
  • 结果变量：配偶退休（不再有劳动收入）
  • 结果变量：养老金申领（VERP 或 OAP）和年劳动收入
  • 驱动变量（基于年龄的设计）：参照个体的年龄相对于提前退休金领取资格年龄 60 岁的位置
  • 驱动变量（基于改革的设计）：出生日期相对于 1954 年 1 月 1 日这一分界点的位置，2011 年改革以此为界把 VERP 领取资格年龄提高 6 个月
时期
1986–2014 年（基于年龄的设计为 1991–2013 年；基于改革的设计为 2008–2014 年）
样本
367,585 对伴侣、2,206,044 个伴侣—年观测值（基于年龄的样本）；10,321 对伴侣、73,395 个伴侣—年观测值（基于改革的样本） 年龄相差不超过 8 岁的丹麦双职工伴侣（已婚、登记伴侣或同居），参照个体年龄为 57–60 岁，不含自雇者和残疾福利领取者。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Retirement (age-based design) 退休与养老金
    Retirement is ceasing to earn labour market income: the year in which the individual earned labour income for the last time, treated as an absorbing state (1 thereafter). Small positive income up to the equivalent of one month of average earnings is allowed after retirement (holiday pay, delayed wages). A flow definition allowing multiple retirements is used as robustness.
    登记库： Annual labour market/income registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.2 (Key Variables), footnote 10
  • Working past July 1 (reform-based design) 退休与养老金
    Using monthly earnings records (eIncome, from 2008), a dummy equal to one if the individual works past the first half of the year (past July 1) in a given year.
    登记库： eIndkomst (monthly earnings)
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Pension claiming 退休与养老金
    Receiving pension income, either voluntary early retirement pension (VERP) or old-age pension (OAP): annual indicator for any pension income in the year (age-based design), or indicator for receiving pension income before July 1 using monthly pension benefit records (reform-based design).
    登记库： Annual pension benefit registers, Monthly pension benefit records (from 2008)
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Annual labour earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Taxable annual labour market earnings from the annual registers, winsorized at the 1st and 99th percentiles, deflated to 2010 prices and converted at 1 USD = 5.56 DKK.
    登记库： Annual income registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Couples 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Married, registered-partnership or cohabiting couples residing in Denmark 1991-2014, identified when both partners are below age 60 and followed while they remain together; age difference within couple at most 8 years.
    登记库： Population/family registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.3
  • Dual-earner couple restrictions 样本界定与时间
    Reference individual (partner reaching own eligibility age) earned labour income at least once at ages 55-59 and was never self-employed or on disability benefits at ages 50-59; spouse earned labour income at least once at ages 50-59. Age-based sample: 1991-2013, reference individual aged 57-60 (eligibility age 60). Reform-based sample: 2008-2014, reference individuals with qualifying VERP contributions at least once at ages 50-59, born within 3 months either side of 1 January 1954, balanced panel.
    登记库： Annual registers, VERP contribution records

Hanno Foerster · Review of Economic Studies, 2024 · 个人

利用丹麦登记数据和调查数据估计了一个涵盖家庭劳动供给、家庭生产、储蓄和离婚的动态模型，用以研究婚姻解除后的扶养给付。与子女抚养费相比，配偶赡养费对劳动供给的抑制作用更大，为消费提供保险的效率也更低，因此提高子女抚养费、降低配偶赡养费会使福利上升。

1980–2013
样本

调查

    Custody counts children under 19 living in the same family ID after a divorce. Does Granting Refugee Status to Family-Reunified Women Improve Their Integration?

Linea Hasager · Journal of Public Economics, 2024 · 个人

通过家庭团聚进入丹麦的女性，所持居留许可通常以维持婚姻为条件。给予她们独立的难民身份改善了其经济融入，提高了离婚率，并降低了她们遭受暴力的风险，这与居留不确定性下降和议价能力增强的解释一致。

数据
Admission register on immigrant status and residence permit application/approval dates (Danish Immigration Service data via Statistics Denmark), Labour market data from the Danish tax authorities (employment; hours and earnings from 2008), Police registers on victimisation and criminal convictions, Hospital admissions data (National Patient Register) for assault injuries, Central population register (BEF) for demographics, spouse links and divorce
关键变量
  • 处理：家庭团聚女性获得本人的难民身份（庇护），获得时点先后不一
  • 结果变量：季度就业、工作小时数和劳动收入
  • 结果变量：遭受暴力侵害（警方记录或因袭击住院）
  • 结果变量：离婚
  • 设计：交错双重差分，以尚未接受处理的女性为对照组
时期
2001–2019 年（工时和劳动收入自 2008 年起）
样本
1,349 名成年女性 2001 至 2017 年间以家庭团聚方式来到丹麦与难民配偶团聚、其后申请并获得本人难民身份的 18 岁及以上女性。 来源
变量如何定义（4）
  • Treatment: change from family reunification to own refugee status 移民身份与来源地
    Adult women (18+) admitted 2001-2017 as family-reunified to a refugee spouse who later apply for and obtain their own asylum (UN Convention, de facto/B-status or temporary protection), identified from application and approval dates of residence permits in the admission register; event time is the quarter of asylum recognition. Controls are not-yet-treated women recognized at most three years later; women followed from 3 years before to 1.5 years after recognition.
    登记库： Admission register (Danish Immigration Service, via Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1 and 4
  • Violent victimization 犯罪
    Quarterly indicator equal to one if police records show the woman was a victim of violence or sexual assault, or if she was hospitalized due to assault based on physician classification of injury (following Aizer 2010); captures mainly severe cases and also non-partner violence.
    登记库： Police registers on victimization, National Patient Register (hospital admissions)
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, footnote 12
  • Quarterly employment, hours and earnings 就业与劳动力状态
    Quarterly employment indicator (available 2001-2019) and quarterly hours of work and earnings (from 2008) from tax-authority labour market data; earnings CPI-deflated to 2015 and converted to 1,000 USD at the 27 March 2019 exchange rate.
    登记库： Labour market data from Danish tax authorities
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, footnote 11
  • Divorce 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator equal to one if the woman is divorced (quarterly), from the central population register with spouse links.
    登记库： BEF
    工作论文 · Section 3.2

Income Effects and Labour Supply: Evidence from a Child Benefits Reform

Mathias Fjællegaard Jensen and Jack Blundell · Journal of Public Economics, 2024 · 个人

2011 年丹麦对儿童津贴设置上限，削减了有多个年幼子女的家庭所得到的津贴，而较小的家庭不受影响。削减之后母亲的劳动供给大幅上升，主要体现在广延边际上；文章还利用绝育记录来控制再生育偏好上的差异。

数据
Population register (BEF) for family composition, marital status and cohabitation, Monthly payroll records with hours worked (BFL/eIndkomst), Child benefit payment records (BOBO/BOTI), Register OF (monthly demographics and parental leave status), Sterilisation consultations from the National Patient Register (LPRADM) and health insurance service registers (SYSI, SSSY), Annual income register (IND) for self-employment robustness
关键变量
  • 处理：2011 年儿童津贴上限（DKK 35,000），减少了有年幼子女的较大家庭的非劳动收入
  • 结果变量：每月工作小时数（集约边际和广延边际）
  • 结果变量：年劳动收入（稳健性检验中包括自雇者）
  • 控制/样本限制：改革前家庭有过绝育咨询
  • 设计：双重差分，处理组家庭与未受影响家庭对比
时期
2008 年 9 月至 2014 年 12 月（月度）
样本
28,968 名处理组女性和 22,477 名处理组男性 本国出生的丹麦已婚或同居父母，在整个窗口期内年龄为 25–59 岁，2011 年 1 月有 2–4 个子女（至少两个未满 18 岁），非自雇，在平衡的月度面板中可观测。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Monthly hours worked 工作时间
    Total hours worked per month from employer reports to the tax authorities (BFL, from 2008), summed over all jobs held in the month; for employees on parental leave with fixed contractual hours not adjusted in BFL, hours are adjusted using observed days of leave.
    登记库： BFL, OF
    论文正文 · Section 5.1 and footnote 4
  • Employment indicator (extensive margin) 就业与劳动力状态
    Indicator for working non-zero hours in the month in BFL.
    登记库： BFL
    论文正文 · Fig. 10 and Table notes (employment indicator), Section 6
  • Treatment group (child benefit cap) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Family experienced a strictly positive reduction in child benefits due to the DKK 35,000 cap in the first and/or second quarter of 2011 (benefits based on number and ages of children in the previous quarter; simulated from population registers and validated with Q4 BOBO/BOTI payments); control group = families not affected in Q1-Q2 2011. Continuous treatment = reduction in child benefits in 2011 in thousand DKK for treated families, zero otherwise.
    登记库： BEF, BOBO/BOTI
    论文正文 · Sections 3.1, 5.2, 6.2
  • Family sterilisation consultation 医疗服务利用
    Monthly indicator equal to one if the individual has ever (from 1994 onwards) consulted a doctor regarding sterilisation; a family-level version equals one if either partner in the couple has done so.
    登记库： LPRADM, SYSI, SSSY
    论文正文 · Section 5.1
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Balanced monthly panel September 2008-December 2014 of individuals aged at least 25 in September 2008 and under 60 in December 2014; excludes immigrants and children of immigrants, parents of children with irregular child benefit payments, and (main analysis) anyone self-employed at any point; in January 2011 must have at least 2 children under 18, no more than 4 children in total, and be married or cohabiting.
    登记库： BEF, OF, BFL, BOBO/BOTI
    论文正文 · Sections 5.1-5.2, footnotes 5-6
  • Annual earnings incl. self-employment (robustness) 劳动收入与收入
    Annual income measures from the income register IND, used in a robustness check that includes the self-employed because self-employment income is not measured monthly.
    登记库： IND

利用丹麦通过捐精和捐卵受孕出生的儿童，把养育的作用与遗传传递区分开来，因为捐赠者并不是按父母的特征挑选的。剔除基因因素之后，只有母亲的教育起作用：父亲的受教育年限对子女的考试成绩没有影响，而母亲的受教育年限对阅读成绩的提升幅度与非捐赠儿童中的幅度相同。

The Division of Parental Leave: Empirical Evidence and Policy Design

Thomas Høgholm Jørgensen and Jakob Egholt Søgaard · Journal of Public Economics, 2024 · 个人

利用丹麦育儿假津贴制度中的强激励和约 190,000 例生育的数据，估计父母对休假的支付意愿。父母在拐点处聚束，并且愿意为父亲休假很少的传统分工付出代价；模拟表明，专属假期与高替代率相结合时效果要好得多。

数据
Parental leave benefit spell data (parents of children born 2008–2015), incl. benefits paid to parent or employer, Monthly earnings records for all employees (BFL/eIndkomst), from 2008, Danish administrative registers on demographics, family links and firm links (population and labour market registers)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：出生后三年内母亲和父亲各自休的育儿假周数
  • 激励：个人津贴替代率和津贴上限在家庭预算集上形成的拐点
  • 激励：雇主提供的全额工资补偿（根据支付给雇主的津贴识别）
  • 政策：结构模型中关于专属假期（父亲配额）和替代率的反事实模拟
时期
2008–2015 年的生育
样本
189,974 例生育 2008–2015 年的生育，父母就业稳定且在生育前三个月内未领取与生育无关的公共福利，不含 15 个月内又生育下一个孩子的情形。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Weeks of parental leave 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Total number of parental leave weeks computed from start and end dates of benefit spells in the parental leave spell data (children born 2008-2015); includes all full-time leave taken at most three years after childbirth, separately for mother and father.
    登记库： Parental leave benefit spell data, BFL/eIndkomst
    工作论文 · Section 3.2 (Data)
  • Individual benefit replacement rate 失业与福利金
    Computed from total parental leave benefits paid out per parent-child spell relative to weeks of leave; statutory benefits replace 100% of pre-birth earnings for a full-time (37 hours/week) employee up to a cap of EUR 580 per week (2019 level), scaled down proportionally for part-time.
    登记库： Parental leave benefit spell data
    工作论文 · Sections 2 and 3.2, footnote 11
  • Weeks with full wage compensation 失业与福利金
    Weeks of leave with employer-provided full wage compensation, computed from the amount of parental leave benefits paid to the employer (benefits are paid to the employer as reimbursement when it pays full wage) using the individual replacement rate.
    登记库： Parental leave benefit spell data
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Imputed individual right to wage compensation 失业与福利金
    Public sector: imputed from collective-agreement rules (6-6-6 model, Apr 2008-Apr 2015: 6 weeks each parent plus 6 shared weeks if both parents work in the same public sub-sector, otherwise the shared 6 accrue to the public-sector parent) using both parents' employment sector. Private sector: equals observed compensated weeks for parents who also take uncompensated leave (exhausters); otherwise the mode of compensated weeks among exhausting co-workers with weakly higher compensation, with co-worker groups defined as firm-year cells, or 6-digit then 5-digit industry-year cells when fewer than two exhausting co-workers exist.
    登记库： Parental leave benefit spell data, employer-employee links
    工作论文 · Section 3.3, eq. (11), Table 3
  • Birth sample 样本界定与时间
    Births 2008-2015; parents must be continuously employed in the same firm in the 3 months before birth and not on non-birth-related public benefits during those 3 months; births are excluded if parents have a subsequent child within 15 months; parents must appear in the parental leave data (final sample 189,974 births).
    登记库： BEF, BFL/eIndkomst, Parental leave benefit spell data
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, Table 1 and notes

Globalization, Gender, and the Family

Wolfgang Keller and Hale Utar · Review of Economic Studies, 2022 · 个人 + 企业

受到同样的中国进口冲击时，男性和女性的调整方式不同。年近四十而失去工作的女性会以生育作为回应，高收入者和需要重新接受培训者尤其如此，因此一个性别中性的贸易冲击会通过生物钟造成长期的性别差距。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Central Population Register (CPR/BEF) for births, marriages, divorces and cohabitation, Domestic production database by 10-digit product (Industrial commodity statistics, VARS) to identify firms making quota goods, Industry-level imports from China and other advanced countries (instrument), Parental leave records
关键变量
  • 结果变量：新生育、结婚、离婚、育儿假
  • 结果变量：劳动收入、工时、失业
  • 处理：1999 年的雇主所生产的产品属于中国加入 WTO 后取消 MFA 配额的范围
  • 处理（全经济范围）：行业层面来自中国的进口渗透率，以其他国家的进口作为工具变量
  • 异质性：性别和年龄（生物钟）
时期
1999–2007
样本
约 1,600,000 名工人；约 10,000 名纺织和服装业工人 1999 年丹麦私营部门 18–56 岁全职工人队列，追踪至 2007 年。 来源
变量如何定义（11）
  • Exposure to MFA quota removal (treatment) 贸易与离岸外包
    A firm is exposed (treated) if as of 1999 it had domestic production in any 8-digit CN good for which China would no longer face a quota upon WTO entry; quota categories are matched to 8-digit CN goods and firms producing quota goods are identified from the domestic production database reporting establishment sales by 10-digit product. Workers are exposed if employed by such a firm in 1999.
    登记库： IDA, VARS (domestic production / industrial commodity statistics)
    代码： Stata variable affwd (1=Exposed, 0=Non-exposed); clustering on cvrnr99 (1999 firm id)
    工作论文 · Section 2.1; Analysis1.do lines 25-26
  • 1999 full-time private-sector worker cohort 样本界定与时间
    Cohort of workers who in 1999 were full-time employed in Denmark's private sector, had positive wages and were aged 18-56; part-time workers are excluded. IDA covers persons aged 15-70, establishments with at least one employee and jobs active in the last week of November. The textile sample is the roughly 10,000 such workers employed in the textile and clothing industry in 1999; the economy-wide sample excludes public administration, education and health.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 2.2 and footnote 49
  • Birth event 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator for whether a worker fathers or mothers a newborn baby in a given year (for the IV specification: parent of a new child over 2000-2007). Child births come from Statistics Denmark's Fertility Database, which links parents' personal IDs to every child born in Denmark.
    登记库： Fertility Database (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： Stata variable DBirth
    工作论文 · Section 2.3; Table 1 notes; Section 6 eq. (4)
  • Marriage and divorce events 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicators for whether a worker marries or divorces in a given year, taken from the Central Population Register and linked by personal identifier. The divorce analysis uses workers married as of 1999; marriage analysis uses workers unmarried in 1999 (1999 dropped from marriage-rate plots). Cohabiting partners are distinguished from married spouses.
    登记库： CPR (Central Population Register)
    代码： Stata variables EMARA (marriage), EDIVA (divorce), mar99
    工作论文 · Section 2.3; Table 1 notes; Analysis1.do labels
  • Parental leave take 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator for taking childcare/parental leave in a year, from childcare leave spells in Statistics Denmark's social benefits statistics, part of the income statistics registers.
    登记库： SHSS (Sammenhaengende socialstatistik), OF (Offentligt forsoergede)
    代码： Stata variable DParL
    工作论文 · Section 2.3
  • Fertile age 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Fertile-age sample is women below 37 and men below 46 years as of 1999 (fertile age limit taken as 36 for women and 45 for men). The published-version code instead uses an age 18-39 indicator (age1839) for fertility heterogeneity.
    登记库： IDA, BEF
    工作论文 · Footnote 25; Table 4 notes
  • Unemployment and UI benefits 失业与福利金
    Unemployment is the percentage of annual time in unemployment. UI benefits are the sum of unemployment insurance, education allowance for the unemployed and other UI benefits, deflated by CPI and expressed relative to the worker's average 1996-1999 monthly earnings.
    登记库： IDA, IND
    代码： arblhu (unemployment insurance), quddydl (education allowance for unemployed), andakas (other UI benefits); normalised by normsal9699
    复制代码 · Analysis1.do lines 684-705 (Table A5); WP Table 8 notes
  • Earnings and personal income 劳动收入与收入
    Annual labour earnings (salary) and personal income, the latter including unemployment insurance and government transfers; in the cumulative textile-worker regressions both are expressed as multiples of the worker's own 1999 value. Earnings at the 1999 firm are also analysed separately.
    登记库： IDA, IND
    代码： Stata variables anrsalary, anrsal99, anrperinc, anrperinc99
    工作论文 · Table 8 notes; Analysis1.do Table 3
  • Occupation groups (manager, machine operator) 职业与职位层级
    1999 occupation grouped from DISCO-88 major groups: 1 Managers; 2-3 Professionals and technicians; 4-5 Clerks and service workers; 7 Craft workers; 8 Operators; 9 Labourers; set missing if 2-digit code is 99. Machine operator is DISCO 2-digit group 82.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： DISCO-88 1-digit (disc1_99) groups {1},{2,3},{4,5},{7},{8},{9}; disc2_99==82 machine operator; disc2_99==99 missing
    复制代码 · Analysis1.do lines 7-22
  • Industry import penetration from China (economy-wide) 贸易与离岸外包
    Change in Chinese import penetration at the six-digit industry level, instrumented with Chinese imports in other advanced countries (Australia, Finland, Germany, Japan, Netherlands, New Zealand, Switzerland, USA), log average distance of Denmark's import partners in 1996, and the share of retail trading firms; two-digit industry fixed effects included.
    登记库： IDA, Foreign trade statistics
    代码： Stata IP_9909 instrumented by iv8del6, lntdistw
    工作论文 · Section 6 and footnote 51; Analysis2.do Table 5
  • Firm separation rate 企业特征与生产率
    Percentage of the workplace's 1998 employees who are not employed in the workplace in 1999.
    登记库： IDA

Child's Gender, Young Fathers' Crime, and Spillover Effects in Criminal Behavior

Christian Dustmann and Rasmus Landersø · Journal of Political Economy, 2021 · 个人

以头胎子女的性别作为丹麦年轻父亲的自然实验。与生女儿相比，生儿子会降低父亲此后的犯罪行为，而且这种下降会外溢到父亲的同伴，并在日后外溢到子女身上，由此既识别出直接的养育反应，也识别出犯罪中的网络效应。

数据
Birth register (child's gender, parent links), Population register (BEF) for demographics and family links, Central Police Register crime data (charges and convictions), Victim register (from 2001), Income, education and occupation registers, Residential register with neighbourhood classification
关键变量
  • 结果变量：年轻父亲的犯罪定罪与指控
  • 处理：头胎是儿子还是女儿
  • 溢出结果变量：父亲所在社区男性同伴的犯罪
  • 同伴群体：同一社区内与父亲年龄相差 ±3 岁以内的男性
  • 结果变量：社区内的犯罪受害情况
时期
1991–2004 年出生的儿童；犯罪数据自 1990 年起
样本
2,803 名 20 岁及以下初为人父者；2,114 个社区中的 101,132 名男性同伴 1991 年至 2004 年间在 20 岁及以下生育第一个孩子的丹麦男性，以及其所在社区的男性同伴。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Crime (convictions and charges) 犯罪
    Charges or convictions for offences against the criminal code from the Central Police Register, excluding traffic offences; convictions (court rulings of guilt) are the preferred measure. Charges and convictions are dated by the date the crime was committed (exact crime dates available from 1990); records are observed even after deletion from the individual's criminal record.
    登记库： Central Police Register (crime register)
    论文正文 · Section II.A and footnote 7
  • Crime categories 犯罪
    Property crime: theft, fencing, aggravated vandalism, fraud, burglary, forgery, economic crimes. Violent crime: simple violence (assault), severe or life-threatening violence, threats, violence against or obstructing a public servant, failure to help a person in danger, coercion, attempted murder or homicide. Other crime: drug possession and sale, possession of weapons/explosives, false testimony, sexual crimes.
    登记库： Central Police Register
    论文正文 · Footnote 8; online Table A1 (code breakdown, not read)
  • Young first-time father sample / treatment 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Males who father their first child at age 20 or younger, children born 1991-2004 (birth and demographic registers), with information on both parents from the birth for up to 5 subsequent years, matched uniquely to a neighbourhood; treatment is the first child being a son. Fathers in neighbourhoods with more than one young father having a first child in the same year are excluded.
    登记库： Birth register, BEF
    论文正文 · Section II.B and footnote 9
  • Neighbourhood 地理与社区
    Neighbourhoods follow the classification documented in Damm and Schultz-Nielsen (2008), constructed in 2004, linked to individuals through anonymised home address identifiers in the residential register; the largest and smallest 5% of neighbourhoods are excluded from most analyses.
    登记库： Residential register, BEF
    论文正文 · Section II.B
  • Peer group and peer crime 犯罪
    Peers are all males within +/-3 years of the focal father's age living in the father's neighbourhood on January 1 of the year the child is born (alternatively all males aged 14-25 at the birth), regardless of later moves; the father and his family members are excluded. Peer crime is their convictions/charges.
    登记库： Residential register, BEF, Central Police Register
    论文正文 · Section II.B; footnote 5
  • Neighbourhood victimisation 犯罪
    Based on individuals who report having been the victim of a crime (register available from 2001); victim sample includes all individuals living in the father's neighbourhood at the time of the birth, counting the number of victims in each neighbourhood.
    登记库： Victim register
    论文正文 · Section II.B (victim sample) and footnote 10

Does Biology Drive Child Penalties? Evidence from Biological and Adoptive Families

Henrik Kleven, Camille Landais and Jakob Egholt Søgaard · AER: Insights, 2021 · 个人

利用近 40 年的丹麦收养数据，比较亲生母亲与收养母亲的事件研究生育惩罚。亲生母亲的短期惩罚略大，但长期惩罚几乎完全相同，因此生物因素并非与子女相关的性别差距的关键成因。

数据
Statistics Denmark administrative registers covering the full population 1980–2017, linked with family identifiers, Adoption registry of Statistics Denmark (1988–2009), augmented with foreign adoptions identified via country of origin and Central Person Register immigration records, Earnings and labour-supply registers incl. hours from the ATP mandated pension scheme, Education registers
关键变量
  • 事件：第一个孩子的到来（出生或收养）
  • 结果变量：年度劳动收入（工资、薪金、自雇收入）
  • 结果变量：劳动参与、工作小时数、工资率
  • 比较组：亲生家庭与收养家庭（对亲生样本重新加权以匹配收养家庭）
时期
1980–2017
样本
约 527,000 例头胎出生（亲生样本）和约 4,600 例第一个孩子到来（收养样本） 第一个孩子在 1985 年至 2007 年间通过出生或跨国收养（5 岁之前）到来的丹麦父母，父母双方身份已知、在世，且自孩子到来前 5 年至到来后 10 年一直居住在丹麦。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Foreign adoptee 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Children who (1) were born in a non-western country, (2) have two known parents born in a western country, (3) whose parents both had a legal address in Denmark with no emigration record at the time of birth, and (4) have a recorded entry (immigration record) into the Central Person Register after the date of birth. Validated against Statistics Denmark official adoption records (1988-2009), with virtually no type I or type II errors; about 16,260 foreign adoptees 1980-2017, mostly from Asia (South Korea, India, China), Latin America (Colombia) and Africa.
    登记库： CPR, BEF, Adoption registry (Statistics Denmark)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix, Figure A.I notes and Table A.I
  • Event sample (first child arrival) 样本界定与时间
    Stepwise restrictions: children with known parents born 1980-2017 (16,260 adoptive / 2,454,200 biological); born 1985-2007; first-born only; siblings all of the same type (biological or adoptive); adoptees arrived before age 5; parents balanced on event time (final 4,580 adoptive / 527,000 biological).
    登记库： BEF, CPR
    在线附录 · Online Appendix, Table A.II
  • Annual earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Annual income from wages, salaries and self-employment.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark income registers
    工作论文 · Section 2 (Data)
  • Hours worked and wage rate 工作时间
    Hours worked from administrative, third-party-reported data on contributions to the mandated ATP (Arbejdsmarkedets Tillaegspension) pension scheme, which employers pay based on employees' individual hours worked. The wage rate is earnings divided by hours worked.
    登记库： ATP
    工作论文 · Section 2 (Data)
  • Reweighting of biological families 样本界定与时间
    Baseline reweighting of the biological sample on pre-birth variables (year of first child, mother's age at first child, mother's pre-child education and pre-child earnings) plus subsequent-children variables (years to second child, total number of children); alternatives use no reweighting or pre-birth variables only.
    登记库： BEF, UDDA, IND
    在线附录 · Online Appendix, Figure A.III notes
  • Relative female earnings potential 劳动收入与收入
    Baseline measured just before the arrival of the first child (event time -1), splitting women at the median. Forward-looking (potentially endogenous) alternatives measure it 10 years after first child arrival, after 15 years of experience, or at age 45.
    登记库： UDDA, IND
    在线附录 · Online Appendix, Figure A.IV notes

Family Labor Supply Responses to Severe Health Shocks: Evidence from Danish Administrative Records

Itzik Fadlon and Torben Heien Nielsen · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2021 · 个人

比较同一时间遭遇致命健康冲击与非致命健康冲击的家庭。配偶去世后，在世的一方增加劳动供给以自我保险；而在非致命冲击之后，配偶减少劳动供给以照顾病人。家中子女的调整幅度较小。

数据
Cause of Death Registry, National Patient Registry (LPR) hospitalisation records with ICD diagnoses, Income and transfer registers (earnings, government transfers, pension and annuity payouts, capital income), 1980–2011, Third-party reported liquid wealth balances, 1984–2011, Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), incl. ATP-based full-/part-time employment, Household linkages of spouses and cohabiting partners (population registers)
关键变量
  • 处理：配偶死亡（致命健康冲击）或首次非致命心脏病发作／中风
  • 对照组：几年后经历同样冲击的家庭
  • 结果变量：在世／健康配偶的劳动参与和劳动收入
  • 结果变量：家庭来自转移支付、养老金和保险的收入；流动性财富
  • 异质性：家庭流动性、收入损失、年龄
时期
1980–2011 年（冲击发生于 1985–2011 年）
样本
处理组 310,720 个家庭、对照组 409,190 个家庭（致命冲击）；处理组 37,437 个家庭、对照组 54,887 个家庭（非致命心脏病发作和中风） 在（实际或安慰剂）冲击发生当年双方年龄均为 45–80 岁的丹麦已婚和同居伴侣；非致命冲击样本限于 60 岁以下且至少存活三年的配偶。 来源
变量如何定义（12）
  • Fatal health shock (spousal death) 样本界定与时间
    Households in which one spouse died between 1985 and 2011 and was aged 45 to 80 in the year of the (actual or placebo) event. Treatment households are matched to control households from the same cohorts that experienced the same event five years later (Delta = 5); summary statistics measured at t = -2. Prime-age subsamples restrict to households before the Early Retirement Age of 60.
    登记库： Cause of Death Registry; population/household registers
    代码： Age at death 45-80; event years 1985-2011; Delta = 5 years
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Table A.1 notes; Figure C.1 notes
  • Non-fatal severe health shock 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Households in which one spouse experienced a heart attack or a stroke for the first time between 1985 and 2011 and survived for at least three years, with both spouses under age 60. Controls are households from the same cohorts experiencing the same event five years later.
    登记库： National Patient Registry (LPR)
    代码： First-ever heart attack or stroke; survival >= 3 years; both spouses < 60; years 1985-2011 (no ICD list given in appendix)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Table A.1 notes
  • Control group: same shock five years later 样本界定与时间
    Each treatment group of households shocked in year tau is matched to households from the same cohorts that experience the same shock in year tau + 5 (Delta = 5), who are assigned a placebo shock at t = 0 with t = year - tau; effects are identified up to four years after the shock via difference-in-differences relative to a baseline period (t = -2 in summary statistics).
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Labor force participation 就业与劳动力状态
    Indicator for having any positive level of annual earnings.
    登记库： Income registers
    工作论文 · Section 5
  • Full-time and part-time employment (ATP-based) 工作时间
    From IDA, constructed from employee ATP pension contributions (available for individuals under 60): full-time means working at least 30 hours per week all 12 months of the calendar year (full-time full-year); part-time means working at some point in the year but fewer than 30 hours per week or fewer than 12 months.
    登记库： IDA, ATP contributions
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Household income from all sources 劳动收入与收入
    Household income including income from any source: earnings, capital income, annuity payouts and benefits from any social program.
    登记库： Income and transfer registers
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Table D.1 notes
  • Liquid wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Third-party reported liquid wealth balances measured annually on 31 December, 1984-2011, including bank-account balances and lump-sum transfers from insurance companies; used in robustness checks to account for life insurance payouts.
    登记库： Tax-reported wealth data
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Potential income loss from spousal death 劳动收入与收入
    Household income from any source in t = 1 holding the surviving spouse's earnings and social benefits (labor income, Social DI and Social Security) at their t = -1 level, divided by household income in t = -1, then normalized for treated households by the corresponding control-group mean.
    登记库： Income and transfer registers
    工作论文 · Section 5.2, footnote 22
  • Municipal survivors-benefit instrument 失业与福利金
    For each municipality and year, the average Social Disability Insurance (Social DI) benefits received by non-working surviving spouses is computed; each widow in the treatment group is assigned her municipality-year leave-one-out mean. Benefits in annual DKK 1,000. Sample: widows under 67 (age of transition into Old-Age Pension) in years before 1994, when there is a data break in the reporting of survivors benefits received through Social DI. Controls: municipality unemployment rate and average earnings (interacted with Treat, Post, Treat x Post), widow age, year and municipality FE; post periods 2-4.
    登记库： Transfer income registers; municipality of residence
    代码： Widow age < 67; years < 1994; leave-one-out municipality-year mean
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Table C.3 notes
  • High-severity non-fatal shock 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Binary indicator equal to 1 if the sick spouse was hospitalized for 10 days or more following the heart attack/stroke and 0 if hospitalized for fewer than 10 days; 10 days is the 75th percentile of the distribution of hospitalization days associated with the shock in the treatment sample.
    登记库： National Patient Registry (LPR)
    代码： Hospitalization days >= 10 (75th percentile)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Table D.1 notes
  • Primary vs secondary earner status of deceased spouse 劳动收入与收入
    Deceased spouse is classified as primary (secondary) earner if the share of his/her average pre-event labor income in the household's average pre-event labor income was higher (lower) than one half.
    登记库： Income registers
    代码： Share of household labor income > 0.5 = primary earner
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Figure C.1 and Table C.2 notes
  • Husband's pre-death work status 就业与劳动力状态
    Indicator for whether the deceased husband worked throughout the entire five-year period preceding his death (periods -5 to -1); sample restricted to husbands who either worked in all five years or did not work at all in that period.
    登记库： IDA / income registers
    代码： Periods -5 to -1
