Education, Birth Order and Family Size

Jesper Bagger, Javier A. Birchenall, Hani Mansour and Sergio Urzúa · Economic Journal, 2021 · 个人

构建了一个包含出生次序偏好和人力资本成本差异的父母投资模型，由此得到广义的数量—质量权衡。丹麦行政数据证实了模型的预测：在任一给定的出生次序上，家庭规模较小的孩子受教育更多；即便考虑了出生次序，孩子的平均受教育程度也随家庭规模扩大而下降。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), 1980–2006, with mother-child links, Precise date of birth from Statistics Denmark (to identify twin/multiple births)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：受教育年限（2006 年测量）
  • 核心解释变量：出生次序与家庭规模
  • 工具变量：最后一胎为双胞胎（第 2、第 3 或第 4 胎为双胞胎）
  • 控制变量：父母教育、性别、年龄
时期
1980–2006 年（结果变量于 2006 年测量）
样本
581,159 个家庭中的 1,256,031 名子女（剔除独生子女家庭） 2006 年年龄为 25–41 岁、其母亲在 1980–2006 年间在世且出现在 IDA 中的个人，所在家庭已完成生育，兄弟姐妹按同母界定。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Years of education 教育与考试成绩
    Highest completed education in 2006 from the IDA person files (8-digit HFFSP code), mapped to years of education using the first two digits per Table A.1 (e.g. 10 = primary: 7 years if born 1958 or earlier, 9 years if born 1959 or later; 20/25 = high school 12; 35 = vocational 12; 40 = short further 14; 50 = medium-length further 16; 60 = Bachelor 15; 65 = Master 18; 70 = PhD 20; 90 = unknown, missing).
    登记库： IDA
    代码： HFFSP 2-digit: 10->7/9, 15,17->10, 20->12, 25->12, 30->10, 35->12, 40->14, 50->16, 60->15, 65->18, 70->20, 90->missing
    工作论文 · Appendix C and Table A.1
  • Family size and siblings 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Siblings are children born to the same mother (families defined by mother's identity, via the IDA pointer to mother's person ID); family size is the number of siblings born to the same mother, recorded before individual-level selection. Families with children born after 1991 (any child aged 0-14 residing at mother's address in 2006) are excluded so family size reflects completed fertility.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 4 and Appendix C (fn. 29)
  • Birth order 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Order of birth of each child within the mother's family, identified using precise date of birth obtained from Statistics Denmark and merged onto IDA (69.4% of IDA individuals matched, unmatched mostly older cohorts).
    登记库： IDA, Date-of-birth data (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Appendix C and footnote 22
  • Twin (multiple) birth instrument 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Multiple births identified from precise dates of birth (24,186 twin sets, 217 triplets, 5 quadruplets); twin observations themselves are dropped, retaining an indicator for a twin birth in the family and its order. Family size is instrumented with twins at the second, third or fourth birth in respective samples, and with twins at last birth.
    登记库： IDA, Date-of-birth data (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Appendix C (fn. 25) and Section 5
  • Analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    Individuals aged 25-41 in 2006 linked to a mother alive, aged 15-70 and present in IDA during 1980-2006. Excludes families with mother younger than 17 or older than 49 at birth, missing education for any member, non-twin siblings born less than seven months apart, unknown or different fathers, children born after 1991, and single-child families; 1,256,031 individuals in 581,159 families.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 4 (fn. 15) and Appendix C
  • Parental income measures 劳动收入与收入
    Parental income measures are trimmed by recoding observations in the 1st and 99th percentiles as missing; mother's education measured in the last year she appears in the data.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Appendix C

对 20 至 44 岁的丹麦房主而言，房价上涨 100,000 克朗会使生育概率提高约 2.35%。出生结果也有所改善，但主要是因为生育者的构成发生了变化；对儿童出生后头五年的健康则没有影响。

数据
Medical Birth Register (MFR), National Patient Register (LPR), State's Sales and Valuation Registry (public property valuations and sales prices), Population register (BEF) and other registers for demographics, education, household income and partner status
关键变量
  • 处理：滞后一期的估计住房价值一年变动（公共评估值按当地成交价比率调整）
  • 结果变量：是否生育的指示变量
  • 结果变量：出生体重、低出生体重、极低出生体重、早产
  • 结果变量：出生后第一年及 1–5 岁期间的住院、急诊就诊和住院天数
  • 比较组：租房者
时期
1992–2011 年（生育分析为 1995–2006 年）
样本
198,435 名女性的 1,105,559 个观测值（125,903 次生育） 在 1993 至 2004 年间首次成为房主、购房时年龄在 18 至 42 岁之间的 20–44 岁女性。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Estimated home value 财富、负债与消费
    The public valuation of the home times the owner's share, multiplied by the mean ratio of sale price to public valuation among homes sold in the same year, municipality, housing type and valuation-quartile cluster (a SPAR-type index); woman's and partner's shares are summed. The value is fixed to the first house the woman is observed buying, and is in 100,000 DKK at 2006 prices (CPI-deflated).
    登记库： State's Sales and Valuation Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3, equation (1)
  • Once-lagged one-year home price change 财富、负债与消费
    One-year change in estimated home value, lagged one year relative to the fertility outcome. Public valuations were made in January of the prior year until end-2003 and in October of the prior year afterwards. Homes whose valuation rose by more than 50% in a year, and the 1st and 99th percentiles of the lagged change, are excluded.
    登记库： State's Sales and Valuation Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3 and 3.1, footnote 13
  • Housing sample restrictions 样本界定与时间
    Residential houses and apartments in clusters with at least five sales; only normal sales between individuals (no intra-family sales). Excluded: negative valuations or sale prices, multiple addresses at the same location, and sales above 300% or below 40% of the public valuation.
    登记库： State's Sales and Valuation Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, Appendix Table A-1
  • Potential first-time homeowner women 样本界定与时间
    Women not homeowners at the beginning of 1992-1993 who became homeowners between 1993 and 2004 at ages 18-42; owning means the woman, her partner or both own the home. Women whose partner bought before the couple formed, who moved out of the new home within the year, or who have incomplete income or home data are dropped, leaving women aged 20-44 observed 1995-2006.
    登记库： Population Registry, State's Sales and Valuation Registry
    工作论文 · Section 1 footnote 2; Section 3.1
  • Low / very low birth weight, prematurity 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    From the Birth Registry for live births: low birth weight is below 2,500 grams, very low birth weight below 1,500 grams, and premature is gestational age under 37 completed weeks; birth weight is also used continuously.
    登记库： Medical Birth Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3
  • Hospital admissions, inpatient days and ER visits 医疗服务利用
    Indicators for any hospital admission and any ER visit in the first year of life and at ages 1-5, plus the number of days hospitalised and ER visits in the first five years. Inpatient days exclude the childbirth admission and the following four days.
    登记库： National Patient Register
    工作论文 · Section 3, footnote 12
  • Giving birth / conception timing 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator for giving birth in the year, from the Birth Registry. In a robustness check, the conception date is computed from gestational length and birth date, the price change is scaled by the fraction of the year before conception, and non-mothers get randomly assigned birth months.
    登记库： Medical Birth Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3; Section 4 robustness
  • Imputed household consumption 财富、负债与消费
    Household consumption imputed from income and year-to-year wealth changes following Browning and Leth-Petersen (2003).
    登记库： Danish income and wealth registers
    工作论文 · Section 5 (credit constraints)

Sibling Spillovers

Sandra E. Black, Sanni Breining, David N. Figlio, Jonathan Guryan, Krzysztof Karbownik, Helena Skyt Nielsen, Jeffrey Roth and Marianne Simonsen · Economic Journal, 2021 · 个人

利用丹麦和佛罗里达两地的行政数据，识别有一个残疾弟妹在家庭内部产生的溢出效应。在有三个及以上子女的家庭中比较头胎和二胎子女：二胎子女在幼年时期与弟妹相处的时间更长，当第三个孩子有残疾时，其受到的影响与头胎子女不同。

数据
Medical Birth Register (MFR), National Patient Register (LPR) for disability diagnoses, 9th grade exit exam grades (school/education registers), Parental education, labour market, earnings and leave registers, Florida birth records linked to Florida public school records (FCAT)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：按出生队列标准化的九年级毕业考试平均成绩（丹麦）；FCAT 考试成绩（佛罗里达）
  • 处理：排行第三的弟妹在五岁前被观测到有残疾（依据医疗登记库中的诊断）
  • 比较：二胎子女与头胎子女（双重差分）
  • 控制变量：父母年龄、教育、劳动力市场状态、劳动收入、移民身份
时期
丹麦 1990–2001 年出生者；佛罗里达 1994–2002 年出生者
样本
丹麦：134,277 个可观测到前两个子女的家庭，28,581 个可观测到前三个子女的家庭（其中 4,430 个家庭的第三个孩子在五岁前有残疾）；佛罗里达：80,879 个和 9,987 个家庭 丹麦（1990–2001 年出生）和佛罗里达（1994–2002 年出生）至少有三个子女且前两个子女同父的家庭。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Third-born sibling disability (treatment) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicator D = 1 if the third-born child is observed disabled, in Denmark from disabilities recorded in the medical (patient) registries, with the main treatment being disability first observed by age five (alternatively between ages five and ten). Most common Danish by-age-five disabilities: asthma (41%), congenital malformations of the musculoskeletal system (20%), congenital malformations of the circulatory system (10%); diagnosis code lists are not given.
    登记库： Danish medical patient register
    工作论文 · Section 2 (Data) and Eq. (1)
  • 9th grade exit exam GPA 教育与考试成绩
    Cohort-standardised 9th grade exit exam grades (GPA), based on assessments by the student's teacher and an external reviewer, normalised to mean zero and standard deviation one.
    登记库： School records / grade register
    工作论文 · Sections 1-2 and Eq. (1)
  • Birth order / exposure (second vs first born) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    M = 1 if the child is second born ('more exposed'), 0 if first born; birth order measured from exact dates of birth in the Birth Register with parent-child links. Sample restricted to families with at least three children where the first two children have the same father; Danish births 1990-2001.
    登记库： Danish Birth Register (MFR)
    工作论文 · Sections 2-3, Eq. (1)
  • Disability type and severity 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Disabilities grouped into physical, cognitive and behavioral; severity checked using hospitalisation records (inpatient, outpatient and emergency room admissions).
    登记库： Danish medical patient register
    工作论文 · Section 4, footnotes 11-12
  • Parental background controls 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Parental age, educational attainment, labour market status, earnings, leave taking and immigrant status from administrative registers linked via the unique identification number; regression covariates include year and month of birth and child gender with family fixed effects.
    登记库： Administrative registers (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 2 and Section 3

Spillover effects of stricter immigration policies

Cristina Bratu, Matz Dahlberg, Mattias Engdahl and Till Nikolka · Journal of Public Economics, 2020 · 个人

考察丹麦 2002 年收紧家庭团聚规则是否把受影响的居民推向了邻国。文章用双重差分比较有移民背景的单身丹麦公民与已同非欧盟伴侣同居的公民，发现向外迁移明显上升，其中大多迁往瑞典。瑞典登记库显示，在瑞典团聚的伴侣中有许多人后来再度离开，约 20% 在两年内、50% 在八年内离开，其中多数前往丹麦。

数据
Statistics Denmark population register, 1995–2009 (age, gender, municipality, citizenship, country of origin, migration background, partner and children in the household), Statistics Denmark migration register, 1995–2009 (all registered in- and out-migration events with date and country of origin/destination), Swedish data: GeoSweden database of Statistics Sweden registers, full population 1995–2014 (country of birth, immigration/emigration dates and countries, reason for residence, household, labour income from Sweden and Denmark) – used for the analysis of arrivals in and return migration from Sweden
关键变量
  • 处理：2002 年家庭团聚改革之后，未与伴侣同居的单身丹麦公民（18 岁及以上）
  • 对照组：与非 EU/EEA 公民同居的丹麦公民
  • 结果变量：某一年从丹麦迁出，分为迁往瑞典和迁往所有目的地
  • 结果变量（瑞典数据）：受影响伴侣抵达瑞典及其后迁出的情况，按目的地划分
  • 异质性：移民背景、来源国、西兰岛（Zealand）与其他地区、年龄
时期
1995–2009 年（丹麦登记库）；1995–2014 年（瑞典登记库，1995–2009 年抵达的移民）
样本
丹麦 1995–2009 年重复截面：处理组 12,278,256 个人年观测值（其中有移民背景者 317,534 个），对照组 464,310 个（其中有移民背景者 191,377 个）；双重差分回归使用 508,911 个观测值（工作论文表 1 和表 B.1）。瑞典数据：2002–2009 年抵达的受影响个人 5,096 名、未受影响个人 1,576 名（工作论文表 3）。 18 岁及以上的丹麦公民，或为单身（处理组），或与非 EU/EEA 公民同居（对照组），回归限于有移民背景者；在瑞典，为 1995–2009 年迁入的丹麦/非 EU 伴侣和非 EU 伴侣中的成年伴侣。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Treatment and control group (repeated cross-sections) 样本界定与时间
    Treatment group: Danish citizens older than 18 years who are not cohabiting with a partner in Denmark in a given year, and who therefore face the stricter rules for a potential family reunification after the 2002 reform. Control group: Danish citizens older than 18 years cohabiting with a non-EU/EEA citizen in a given year in Denmark. Group status is defined year by year; the regressions are restricted to Danish citizens with immigrant background.
    登记库： Population register (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： Age 18+; Danish citizenship; sample years 1995–2009; reform passed June 2002 (reference category t = 2001)
    工作论文 · Section 3.2; Table 1 notes; Figure 6 notes
  • Immigrant background 移民身份与来源地
    Danish citizens with an immigrant background were either born abroad or born in Denmark to parents that were both born abroad and non-Danish citizens. A narrower sample keeps the four most frequent non-EU/EEA countries of origin: Turkey, Pakistan, ex-Yugoslavia and Bosnia.
    登记库： Population register (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 3.3, footnote 15; Table 1 notes; Figure 3 notes
  • Emigration from Denmark (to Sweden / all destinations) 移民身份与来源地
    Indicator equal to one if the individual emigrates (to Sweden) in a given year and zero if the person stays in Denmark. All emigration events to any country except the Faroe Islands and Greenland are counted, with no restriction on the length of the migration spell; if a person emigrates more than once in a year only the latest event is used. Registering emigration is compulsory when leaving the country for more than six months. The data keep individuals registered as residents in a given year who either emigrate or do not emigrate and appear in the register in the following year.
    登记库： Migration register (Statistics Denmark), Population register (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： Destinations exclude Faroe Islands and Greenland; reporting duty for stays abroad of more than six months
    工作论文 · Appendix A; Section 3.3, equation (1)
  • Fixed cohort for the duration (Kaplan-Meier) analysis 样本界定与时间
    Danish citizens with immigrant background who are between 18 and 29 years old in 2001 (t = 0), assigned to treatment (single, not cohabiting) or control (cohabiting with a non-EU/EEA citizen) by their status in 2001 and followed until 2009 without any change in treatment status. Individuals who drop out of the data before 2009 without being registered as emigrants are excluded. 13,292 treated and 4,130 control individuals.
    登记库： Population register (Statistics Denmark), Migration register (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： Age 18–29 in 2001; follow-up 2001–2009
    工作论文 · Section 3.3; Figure 7 notes; Appendix Table B.3
  • Couples affected by the reform who reunite in Sweden (Swedish data) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Identified from country of birth, country of arrival and household status because citizenship is not observed in the Swedish data. Affected couples are (i) couples where one partner is born in Denmark and the other is born in a non-EU country and immigrated from there, and (ii) couples where both partners are born in a non-EU country with at most one of them migrating from Denmark. Couples where both partners arrive from Denmark are treated as unaffected and serve as a control group. Partners must arrive within 6, 12 or 18 months of each other and be registered in the same household in the year the non-EU partner enters Sweden.
    登记库： GeoSweden (Statistics Sweden registers; Swedish, not Danish, data)
    代码： Arrival within 6, 12 or 18 months of each other; aged 18+ at immigration; immigration years 1995–2009
    工作论文 · Section 4.1–4.2, Table 2; Appendix C

Birth Order and Delinquency: Evidence from Denmark and Florida

Sanni Breining, Joseph Doyle, David N. Figlio, Krzysztof Karbownik and Jeffrey Roth · Journal of Labor Economics, 2020 · 个人

在丹麦和佛罗里达，排行第二的男孩都比其头胎哥哥明显更可能在学校受到纪律处分并进入刑事司法系统。证据表明，机制在于父母对后出生子女的时间投入减少，而不是出生时健康状况或社区的差异。

数据
Medical Birth Register (MFR), Population register with parent and sibling links (BEF), Central Crime Register (convictions, sentences, incarceration), School registers (9th grade exit exam grades), Register of Daycare Institutions, National Patient Register (LPR) and Psychiatric Central Register, Parental education, employment, earnings and maternity leave registers, Florida birth records linked to school and juvenile justice records
关键变量
  • 结果变量：16 岁前和 21 岁前被刑事定罪；被判处监禁；被收监
  • 处理：排行第二的男孩与头胎男孩相比（兄弟姐妹固定效应）
  • 结果变量：九年级毕业考试的阅读和数学成绩
  • 机制：母亲的休假与就业、1–3 岁时的日托入托、入学年龄、10 岁前的精神科诊断
  • 控制变量：父母年龄、教育、就业、家庭收入、移民身份
时期
丹麦 1981–1990 年出生队列；佛罗里达 1994–2002 年出生者
样本
丹麦：60,550 个家庭中的 121,100 名儿童（头胎和二胎男孩）；丹麦全体人口中 1981–1990 年的单胎出生为 448,979 例 有两个及以上同父子女的丹麦家庭，比较 1981–1990 年出生的头胎男孩和二胎男孩（另有佛罗里达的对比样本）。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Criminal conviction by age 16 / 21 犯罪
    Indicator (x100) for having any criminal conviction by age 16, and by age 21, from the Criminal Registers; convictions observable from age 15 (age of criminal responsibility). Traffic offences are excluded; crime outcomes cover convictions for violent, property and special offences.
    登记库： Danish Criminal Registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; footnote 20; Table 3 notes
  • Prison sentence / incarceration by age 16 / 21 犯罪
    More severe crime measures: indicator for ever having been issued a suspended prison sentence, and for an implemented (unsuspended) imprisonment sentence (incarceration), by age 16 and by age 21. Traffic offences excluded.
    登记库： Danish Criminal Registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; footnote 20; Figure 1 notes
  • Violent, property and special crime convictions 犯罪
    Convictions by age 21 split by crime type: violent (e.g. manslaughter, rape, death threats), property (e.g. forgery, arson, burglary) and special offences (e.g. drug offences, illegal weapon possession, human trafficking). Denmark birth cohorts 1981-1990.
    登记库： Danish Criminal Registers
    工作论文 · Section 5.1; Table 3
  • 9th grade exit exam grades 教育与考试成绩
    Ninth grade exit exam grades in reading and math from the School Registers, based on assessments by the student's teacher and an external reviewer; standardized to mean zero and unit SD within each cohort.
    登记库： School Registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.1
  • Psychiatric diagnoses by age 10 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicator for having received, by age 10, a diagnosis at a Danish hospital of a disorder of psychological development, or a behavioural and emotional disorder (e.g. ADHD), from the National Patient Registry and Psychiatric Central Registry.
    登记库： LPR, Psychiatric Central Register
    代码： ICD-10 F80-F89 (psychological development); ICD-10 F90-F98 (behavioural and emotional)
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, footnote 5
  • Daycare enrolment ages 1-3 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Enrolment in out-of-home daycare at ages 1, 2 and 3, from the Register of Daycare Institutions (type and place of daycare observed yearly 1995-2008).
    登记库： Register of Daycare Institutions
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; Table A2
  • Maternal employment after birth 就业与劳动力状态
    Mother's employment in each of years 0-10 after the child's birth: any employment, and full-time employment defined as employed at least 200 days in a year. Days of maternity leave also used as an outcome.
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; Figure 4
  • Birth order sample (second-born boys) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Birth order from the Birth Register (1960-2010 births) using exact birth dates and parent links; twins excluded; sample is the first two children of families with two or more children, restricted to full biological siblings (same mother and father) with a second-born boy (boy-boy and girl-boy families). Main crime sample is birth cohorts 1981-1990.
    登记库： MFR, Population register
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1 and 3.3; Table 3
  • Parental controls measured before birth 劳动收入与收入
    Maternal and paternal employment and family income are measured in the year before birth; missing parental education/employment (about 9-10 percent) are mean-imputed with a missing indicator.
    工作论文 · Footnotes 19 and 21

Children and Gender Inequality: Evidence from Denmark

Henrik Kleven, Camille Landais and Jakob Egholt Søgaard · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2019 · 个人

围绕第一个孩子出生的事件研究表明，从长期看母亲的劳动收入相对于父亲下降约 20%，下降来自工作时间、劳动参与和工资率三个方面。这类生育惩罚如今解释了尚存的性别劳动收入差距的大部分，并且通过母亲自身的成长环境在代际间传递。

数据
Full-population Danish administrative registers linked by personal ID (earnings, labour supply, occupation, firm, education), 1980–2013, Family and generational links (population register), ATP pension contributions as third-party measure of hours worked, Additional administrative data back to 1964 for intergenerational analysis, Matched employer-employee data (firm family-friendliness), International Social Survey Program (ISSP) 2002 for gender attitudes
关键变量
  • 处理／事件：第一个孩子出生（相对于首次生育的事件时间）
  • 结果变量：劳动收入、劳动参与、工作时间（ATP）、工资率
  • 结果变量：职业等级、部门、企业的家庭友好程度
  • 生育惩罚：女性劳动收入相对于男性下降的百分比
  • 代际：外祖父母的劳动供给
时期
1980–2013 年（代际传递分析的数据可追溯至 1964 年）；首次生育发生于 1985–2003 年
样本
约 470,000 次生育，即 15,040,000 个个人—年份观测值 第一个孩子出生于 1985–2003 年、且从生育前 5 年到生育后 10 年均在世并居住在丹麦的丹麦父母。 来源
调查
ISSP 2002
变量如何定义（10）
  • ATP hours worked 工作时间
    For the OECD-comparable gender gap series, full-time workers aged 16-64 are identified using the ATP hours measure; earnings and participation gaps use the whole population aged 16-64, hours and wage gaps are conditional on participation.
    登记库： ATP pension contributions
    代码： ages 16-64
    在线附录 · Figure A.I notes
  • Wage rate 劳动收入与收入
    Earnings divided by the ATP hours measure, for those who are working (conditional on participation).
    登记库： ATP pension contributions, Income registers
    工作论文 · Section 2; Section 3.2 footnote 9
  • Child penalty 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Event study around year of first birth (t=0), event time -5 to +10 with t=-1 omitted, separately by gender with age and year dummies, estimated in levels; penalty P_t = (alpha_men_t - alpha_women_t) / E[counterfactual women's outcome | t], the percentage by which women fall behind men due to children.
    登记库： Population register (family links)
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, eqs. (1)-(2)
  • Event-study sample 样本界定与时间
    Treatment = balanced panel of individuals with first child 1985-2003 observed in a 15-year window around the first birth; control = balanced panel of never-parents with a placebo birth in 1985-2003 observed in the same window.
    登记库： Population register
    在线附录 · Appendix B.2
  • Never-parent control group with placebo births 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Separately by sex, a probit for zero lifetime fertility is estimated on non-truncated cohorts 1955-1973 with dummies for own-cohort income quartile, own-cohort wealth quartile, spouse-cohort wealth quartile, education length/degree (8 categories), decade of birth of maternal grandmother and of maternal grandfather, and region. For each cohort born after 1973, among those childless by 2013 the individuals with the highest predicted probability are designated never-parents so that their share equals the 1955-1973 average zero-fertility share. Placebo age at first child is drawn from a log-normal distribution fitted within birth cohort x education cells (for post-1973 cohorts the mean is extrapolated by a linear trend, variance held fixed).
    登记库： Population register (fertility links), Income and wealth registers, Education register
    在线附录 · Appendix B.2
  • Occupational rank and top manager 职业与职位层级
    Occupation ranked in five levels: unskilled labour, skilled labour, white-collar work (low level), white-collar work (high level) and top manager, an ordering consistent with average earnings or wage rates by occupation; separate indicator for being top manager.
    登记库： Occupation (matched employer-employee data)
    工作论文 · Section 3.3, Figure 5 Panels A-B
  • Firm family friendliness 企业特征与生产率
    Share of women with children below age 15 in the firm's workforce (excluding the woman's own first child when it arrives); outcome is the percentile rank in the distribution of firm family friendliness.
    登记库： Matched employer-employee data
    工作论文 · Section 3.3, Figure 5 Panel D
  • Public-sector employment 部门与行业
    Indicator for working in the Danish public sector (no register code given).
    登记库： Matched employer-employee data
    工作论文 · Section 3.3, Figure 5 Panel C
  • Grandparental relative labour supply rank 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Relative labour supply of (maternal or paternal) grandparents based on cumulated hours worked 1964-79 from ATP pension contributions, in quintiles. Robustness controls: grandparents' within-generation wealth-rank quintiles, region of residence, length and field of education of grandmother and grandfather (22 dummies), and parents' total number of children measured in 2014.
    登记库： ATP pension contributions, Wealth register, Education register, Population register
    在线附录 · Figure A.IX-A.X notes; Table A.II notes
  • Third-child IV sample 样本界定与时间
    Women with first child 1985-2003 and completed fertility of two or three when last observed in 2013; unbalanced panel with the longest available window (up to t=28 after first birth); event-time dummies around the third birth instrumented with the sex mix of the first two children.
    登记库： Population register
    在线附录 · Appendix B.3

Family Health Behaviors

Itzik Fadlon and Torben Heien Nielsen · American Economic Review, 2019 · 个人

一名家庭成员遭遇严重健康冲击（如心脏病发作或中风）后，配偶和成年子女会加强自身的预防行为：更多体检、更多预防性用药以及生活方式的改变。这些反应幅度明显、立即出现且持续存在，反映的是人们对自身风险认识的更新。

数据
Prescription Drug Database (LMDB), 1995–2011, Health Insurance Registry (SSR, primary-care and specialist contacts), 1985–2011, National Patient Registry (LPR), inpatient 1980–2011 and outpatient 1994–2011, Cause of Death Registry (DAR), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA) for demographics, education and coworker links, Family links (spouses, parents–children) from population registers
关键变量
  • 处理：家庭成员首次心脏病发作或中风（非致命），或死亡（致命冲击）
  • 结果变量：开始服用他汀类及其他心血管药物
  • 结果变量：预防性医疗，如看全科医生和胆固醇检测
  • 对照组：五年后经历同样冲击的家庭
  • 暴露群体：配偶、成年亲生子女、兄弟姐妹、姻亲、同事
时期
1980–2011 年（冲击发生于 1985 至 2011 年间）
样本
非致命冲击，配偶：处理组 20,381 人、对照组 28,699 人（壮年，25–55 岁），处理组 37,828 人、对照组 36,392 人（年长，55–85 岁）；亲生子女：处理组 63,323 人、对照组 68,437 人（25–40 岁），处理组 39,783 人、对照组 32,926 人（40–65 岁） 1985 至 2011 年间首次心脏病发作或中风（或死亡）的全部丹麦人的家庭成员和关系密切的同事。 来源
变量如何定义（10）
  • Non-fatal cardiovascular shock 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    First-time heart attack or stroke (identified from the National Patient Registry, ICD diagnoses) between 1985 and 2011 where the individual survived the four-year analysis horizon (three years for stepchildren, children-in-law and coworker samples). Household matches based on period t = -1.
    登记库： LPR, Cause of Death Registry
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1-3.2
  • Fatal shock 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Death of a family member between 1985 and 2011, from the Cause of Death Registry (exact death dates and causes).
    登记库： Cause of Death Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Treatment and control groups (shock timing) 样本界定与时间
    Treated = individuals whose family member (or peer) had a shock in a calendar year; controls = individuals from the same cohorts whose family member (or peer) had the same shock five years later (Delta=5). Non-fatal sample = households in which a member had a first heart attack or stroke and survived the four-year horizon; death sample = families with a member who died 1985-2011. Alternative control group: exact match cells within calendar year on predicted cardiovascular risk of family members and lagged outcome, controls weighted by representation in cell (about 94% of controls for prime-age spouses never affected).
    登记库： National Patient Registry (LPR), Cause of Death Registry
    代码： Delta = 5 years
    在线附录 · Appendix Table 1 notes; Appendix B
  • Statin consumption and cholesterol tests 医疗服务利用
    Cholesterol (blood test) indicators are available only for residents of Greater Copenhagen; drug dosage information (e.g. opioid doses) is excluded for the adult-children sample under the data use agreement, so opioid dose outcomes are estimated only for spouses.
    登记库： Prescription Drug Database (LMDB)
    在线附录 · Appendix B; Appendix Table 2 and Table 7 notes
  • Urgent care contacts 医疗服务利用
    Non-hospital contacts with on-call local doctors or nurses initiated outside regular working hours (8 am to 4 pm).
    登记库： Health Insurance Registry
    工作论文 · Section 4.2, footnote 31
  • Addiction treatment drugs and opioid doses 医疗服务利用
    Indicator for purchasing nicotine/alcohol dependence medication; prescription opioid consumption measured in WHO defined daily doses (DDD), i.e. prescription day equivalents (spouses only, dosage data excluded for adult children).
    登记库： LMDB
    代码： ATC N07BA, N07BB (dependence treatment)
    工作论文 · Section 4.2, footnotes 29, 32
  • Family circles (spouses, children, siblings, stepchildren, in-laws) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Spouses = all married and cohabiting couples linked before the shock; adult children only for individuals born after 1960 (when parent links are available); children-in-law = spouses of the adult children of the shocked parent; 'nearby in-laws' = children-in-law living closer than the median distance to the parents-in-law; former spouses = linked by marriage or cohabitation in period -5 but not in period -1.
    登记库： Population registers (family links)
    代码： children born after 1960
    在线附录 · Appendix Table 1 notes; Appendix Tables 2, 10 notes
  • Close coworkers 企业特征与生产率
    Workplaces defined by physical establishment units in matched employer-employee data. Shocked individuals who in pre-shock periods t=-4 to t=-1 worked at workplaces with employment at or below the sample's 25th percentile (about 20 employees); their coworkers in a similar occupation class with an age gap of 5 years or less; coworkers who are also family members excluded. Robustness perturbs the 5-year age gap and the workplace-size cutoff.
    登记库： IDA (matched employer-employee)
    代码： workplace size <= 25th percentile (~20 employees); age gap <= 5 years
    在线附录 · Appendix Table 1 notes; Appendix Tables 9-10 notes
  • Predicted cardiovascular risk 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Probit for the one-year probability of a first heart attack or stroke, estimated on the whole population aged 20-90 in 1994-2014, with age fixed effects, gender, hypertension and diabetes status (from lagged indicators of condition-specific medication), year fixed effects and education; lagged fitted probability used as individual risk.
    登记库： Prescription Drug Database (LMDB), National Patient Registry (LPR), Education register
    代码： ages 20-90, years 1994-2014
    在线附录 · Appendix B, step I
  • Shock severity 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Severity of the family shock measured by the number of hospitalization days (also split at the median).
    登记库： National Patient Registry (LPR)
    在线附录 · Appendix Table 3 notes

Spillovers in Education Choice

Juanna Schrøter Joensen and Helena Skyt Nielsen · Journal of Public Economics, 2018 · 个人

利用丹麦高中的一项试点：该试点降低了部分入学队列选修高级数学的代价。兄姐选修高级数学会提高弟妹也选修高级数学的概率，溢出效应的大小取决于兄弟姐妹的性别构成。

数据
Danish administrative registers on high school enrolment, course packages and completion (Statistics Denmark education registers), Parent and sibling links from population registers, Parental education and income registers, Earnings registers (younger siblings' earnings at ages 30–35)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：弟妹在高中选择高级数学—科学课程组合
  • 内生解释变量：兄姐是否选择高级数学—科学课程
  • 工具变量：兄姐就读的高中意外引入了试点方案（PilotIntro）
  • 结果变量：弟妹 30 岁时的大学/STEM 教育以及 30–35 岁时的对数劳动收入
  • 控制变量：父母的教育和收入、郡固定效应和入学队列固定效应
时期
高中入学队列为 1984–1987 年（兄姐）和 1988–1991 年（弟妹，主样本）；登记数据自 1980 年起
样本
7,786 对兄弟姐妹（年龄相近的主样本）；年龄差 < 10 岁的更宽样本为 17,691 对兄弟姐妹 1984–1987 年进入学术型高中并在三年内毕业的兄姐，与 1988–1991 年进入高中、年龄差不超过 4 岁的弟妹配对。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Advanced math-science choice (MathScience) 教育与考试成绩
    Indicator that the student chose a high-school course package combining advanced math and advanced science. In traditional schools the only such package was advanced math, advanced physics and intermediate chemistry; pilot schools also offered advanced math, advanced chemistry and intermediate physics. The choice is made at the end of the first high-school year.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark education registers
    工作论文 · Section 2
  • PilotIntro / PilotSchool instrument 教育与考试成绩
    PilotIntro = 1 if the (older sibling) enrolled in a high school that unexpectedly introduced the pilot scheme after the student's enrolment but before the advanced-course choice (cohorts entering 1984-87). PilotSchool = 1 if the school had adopted the pilot before the student's enrolment.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark education registers
    工作论文 · Section 2, Table 1
  • Sibling-pair sample 样本界定与时间
    Older siblings entering academic high school 1984-87 who graduated in three years, paired with a younger sibling who entered after 1987 and graduated in three years. The main sample has younger-sibling cohorts 1988-91 and an age gap of at most 4 years; the wider sample has cohorts 1988-97 and a gap of at most 10 years.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark population and education registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; Appendix Table B1
  • Parental education and income controls 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Mutually exclusive indicators for the mother's and father's highest completed education, plus their gross income as observed at the end of the year before the child started high school (when the child was 15).
    登记库： Statistics Denmark administrative registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.1-3.2
  • STEM field education 教育与考试成绩
    Indicator that the highest completed education is in a STEM field, following the National Science Foundation definition (math, engineering, natural and technical sciences, and some social and life sciences). It is used for parents and for younger siblings' education at age 30.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark education registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.2; notes to Tables 6-7
  • Long college degree at age 30 教育与考试成绩
    Indicator that the younger sibling's highest completed education at age 30 is more than a 4-year college degree (also interacted with STEM field).
    登记库： Statistics Denmark education registers
    工作论文 · Table 7
  • Earnings at ages 30-35 劳动收入与收入
    Log annual earnings of the younger sibling at ages 30-35, in real 1989 DKK.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark income registers
    工作论文 · Section 5 (Table 7); Appendix A Figure A1 note

Parental Responses to Child Support Obligations: Evidence from Administrative Data

Maya Rossin-Slater and Miriam Wüst · Journal of Public Economics, 2018 · 个人

利用丹麦子女抚养费标准随父亲收入变化而出现的断点，估计更高的抚养费义务如何影响已分居的父母。文章记录了父亲的收入、其后的家庭组建以及父母居住安排等方面的反应。

数据
Danish administrative registers on children born 1985–2008 linked to parents and siblings (population/family registers), Income and tax records including tax-deductible child support payments, Labour market registers (employment, earnings, disability insurance, early retirement), Birth records (fertility through 2010), Education registers, Danish Longitudinal Survey of Children (DALSC) and Children and Youth in Denmark (CYD) survey (descriptive, supplementary)
关键变量
  • 处理：父亲的平均子女抚养费义务（依据丹麦子女抚养费指导标准表）
  • 识别变异：子女抚养费指导标准中的收入门槛（模拟工具变量）
  • 结果变量：父亲每年支付的子女抚养费
  • 结果变量：父亲与子女共同居住（实际监护）
  • 结果变量：分居后父母双方的生育和劳动供给
时期
1998–2010 年（分居年份为 1999–2008 年）
样本
73,303 名父亲（71,575 名不重复的母亲） 1998–2010 年每年均可观测到的父亲，他们在 1999–2008 年间与最年长子女的母亲分居（或在未同居的情况下有了第一个孩子），有一到两个 18 岁以下的子女，且分居当年的收入接近指导标准的前三个门槛。 来源
调查
Children and Youth in Denmark, DALSC
变量如何定义（8）
  • Separation year 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    The year in which the father no longer resides with his oldest child's mother, or the year he has a first child while not living with the child's mother. The sample is restricted to separation years 1999-2008.
    登记库： Danish administrative population/family registers
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Analysis Sample)
  • Analysis sample of fathers 样本界定与时间
    Fathers observed in the registers every year 1998-2010 who either were married to or cohabiting with their oldest child's mother at childbirth (or in 1998 for children born earlier), or had a first child 1999-2008 while not married to or cohabiting with the mother. Also required: separation in 1999-2008, one or two children under 18 at separation, and separation-year income in a 100,000 DKK window around the first three schedule thresholds (175,000-505,000 DKK). The result is 73,303 fathers, one observation each.
    登记库： Danish administrative registers
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Analysis Sample), footnotes 17-18
  • Child support obligation (actual average) 税收与税率
    The father's annual obligation from the Danish child support guideline (normal amount plus extra amount per child, plus a supplement of 25-300% of the normal amount above income thresholds). It is a step function of current gross income and the number of biological children under 18, including new children. It is averaged over all post-separation years and expressed in thousands of real 2000 DKK.
    登记库： Danish income registers
    工作论文 · Section 2; Section 5, equation (2)
  • Predicted (simulated) child support obligation 税收与税率
    Instrument: the obligation in each post-separation year computed from the father's separation-year gross income and his 'original' children still under 18, so children ageing out are counted but new children and post-separation income changes are ignored. It is averaged over the post-separation period.
    登记库： Danish income registers
    工作论文 · Section 5 (Simulated IV Method), equation (3)
  • Child support payment 劳动收入与收入
    Tax-deductible annual child support payments by non-custodial fathers as reported to the tax authorities, so only payments above the non-deductible extra amount are observed. Formal and voluntary payments cannot be distinguished.
    登记库： Danish income/tax registers
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Outcomes)
  • Father-child co-residence 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator that the father shares a residence address with the child in any year after separation, based on one address per person per year. It captures sole-father and some joint physical custody but understates joint custody.
    登记库： Danish population register (addresses)
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Outcomes)
  • Post-separation fertility 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Whether the mother or father has an additional child after separation, measured from the universe of birth records through 2010 and split by birth within or outside a new partnership.
    登记库： Birth records
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Outcomes); Section 6.3
  • Labour force participation / NILF 就业与劳动力状态
    Fraction of post-separation years in which the father has any positive labour income, and the proportion of years not in the labour force. NILF is split by disability leave (Social Disability Pension), retirement including early retirement (Post-Employment Wage program, ages 60-64), and means-tested welfare.
    登记库： Danish labour market registers
    工作论文 · Section 6.4, Table 6, footnote 29

Can Women Have Children and a Career? IV Evidence from IVF Treatments

Petter Lundborg, Erik Plug and Astrid Würtz Rasmussen · American Economic Review, 2017 · 个人

以无子女的丹麦女性体外受精治疗的成功作为生育子女的工具变量，因为 IVF 是否成功与劳动力市场经历无关。子女使女性的劳动收入大幅且持久地下降，主要是通过小时收入而非工时；第一个孩子的效应远大于之后的孩子。

数据
IVF register held by the Danish National Board of Health (all IVF treatments in public and private clinics, 1994–2005), Linked administrative registers on education, age, marital status and number of children, Linked labour market registers: labour force status, hours worked, hourly wages, annual earnings, occupation, sector and firm
关键变量
  • 工具变量：首次 IVF 治疗的成功
  • 内生处理变量：生育子女（广延边际上的生育）
  • 结果变量：年劳动收入
  • 结果变量：小时工资与工作小时数／就业
  • 机制：职业、部门和企业的变动
时期
1991–2009 年（IVF 治疗时间为 1995–2005 年）
样本
18,538 名接受治疗的女性 1995 至 2005 年间开始首次有胚胎植入的 IVF 治疗的无子女女性。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • IVF treatment success (instrument) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Equals 1 if the first IVF treatment with embryo implants (in a sequence of treatments) led to a childbirth, 0 otherwise; treatment outcome (birth, abortion, stillbirth, failure) and dates from the IVF register (mandatory reporting 1994-2005).
    登记库： IVF register (Danish National Board of Health)
    论文正文 · Section III (model) and Section II.B
  • Having children (endogenous treatment) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator equal to 1 if the woman has children and 0 otherwise, measured over periods t = 0-1, 2-5 and 6-10 after the (potential) childbirth.
    登记库： Population registers
    论文正文 · Section III and Table 2 notes
  • IVF sample and potential childbirth year 样本界定与时间
    Treatment success is measured at the first IVF treatment with embryo implant; t=0 is the year of (potential) childbirth. All regressions control for age at first IVF treatment, year of first IVF treatment, and pre-treatment education and earnings; pre-treatment baseline means are taken over years 1-4 before the first IVF treatment. Four samples: (i) IVF-treated women without children (baseline); (ii) IVF-treated women with children; (iii) successfully treated women with at least two embryos implanted (twin strategy); (iv) representative sample of women with a first child born 1995-2005. Balanced-panel robustness sample also used.
    登记库： IVF register, Population/fertility registers
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A, B (Table 2 notes), D, E
  • Annual earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Annual labour earnings from tax and employer-employee registers, including parental leave and sickness benefits, in 2008 DKK.
    登记库： Tax registers, Employer-employee registers
    论文正文 · Section I and Table 1 notes
  • Job changes and job characteristics 职业与职位层级
    Dummies for any workplace change and any (four-digit) occupation change in the short, medium and long run; job characteristics are averages of earnings, hours and log hourly wages by workplace and four-digit occupation over the study period computed in a representative sample of Danish women, plus workplace percent female, public sector and home-work distance.
    登记库： Employer-employee registers
    代码： Four-digit occupation code
    论文正文 · Section IV.C and Table 4 notes
  • Depression 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Measured as antidepressant medication use (data complete only from 1994 onward).
    登记库： Prescription registry
    论文正文 · Section IV and Table 2 notes
  • IVF medical controls 医疗服务利用
    Sensitivity specification adds medical factors from the IVF register: number of eggs retrieved, number of embryos implanted, diagnoses, causes of infertility, type of IVF treatment, and clinic indicators. A 'healthy women' subsample consists of women not diagnosed with any fertility problem.
    登记库： IVF register (Danish National Board of Health)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix B, Table 2 notes
  • Hourly wages (incl. zeros robustness) 劳动收入与收入
    Main wage regressions condition on observing positive wages; robustness extends the sample to all women by setting missing wages to 0.
    登记库： Labour market registers
    在线附录 · Online Appendix B, Table 3 notes
  • Pre-treatment sickness benefits and positive earnings 失业与福利金
    Pre-treatment balance covariates measured the year before IVF treatment: years of schooling, annual earnings (100,000 DKK), sickness benefit receipt, marriage, indicator for positive earnings, and partner's schooling and earnings.
    登记库： Income and transfer registers
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A, Table 1

Replication package

The Dynamics of Marriage and Divorce

Gustaf Bruze, Michael Svarer and Yoram Weiss · Journal of Labor Economics, 2015 · 个人

利用丹麦出生队列的长期登记记录，估计一个包含对匹配质量的学习过程的结婚、离婚和再婚动态模型。配偶双方的教育在产生婚姻剩余上是互补的，教育使婚姻更稳定，教育提高男性在剩余中所占的份额，而离婚成本在婚姻的早期和晚期都很高。

数据
Population register with marital and cohabitation histories (BEF), Education registers (UDDA), completed education at age 46
关键变量
  • 结果变量：进入和退出婚姻、离婚以及再婚的转换
  • 核心变量：46 岁时已完成的教育组别（高中及以下、职业教育、大学）
  • 按配偶教育程度的选型匹配
  • 结构模型参数：匹配质量、婚姻收益、离婚成本
时期
1980–2006 年（20 至 46 岁）
样本
61,780 人（31,835 名男性和 29,945 名女性） 1960 年出生于丹麦、1980–2006 年居住记录完整且 20 岁时未婚的全部男性和女性。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • 1960 birth cohort panel 样本界定与时间
    All men and women born in 1960 followed annually 1980-2006 (ages 20-46); individuals must have a Danish address in every year (complete marital history), and those already married at age 20 are excluded, leaving 61,780 individuals.
    登记库： BEF
    工作论文 · Section 2 (The sample)
  • Completed education at age 46 教育与考试成绩
    Three groups based on completed education at age 46: high school or less, vocational education, and college (some college or more).
    登记库： UDDA
    工作论文 · Section 2.1
  • Cohabitation (Statistics Denmark definition) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Classified as cohabiting if sharing an address with an opposite-sex person who is not family-related and is no more than 15 years older or younger. The paper uses two alternative partnership definitions: legal marriage only, and partnerships including legal marriage and cohabitation.
    登记库： BEF
    工作论文 · Section 2.2.1
  • Marital states and transitions 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Yearly states: single never married, single previously married, or married (characterised by own and spouse's marital history, spouse's education and type, and marriage duration). Divorced persons are assumed single for at least one year before remarrying; direct marriage-to-marriage moves (2.3%) have the first year of the new marriage recoded as singlehood.
    登记库： BEF
    工作论文 · Sections 4.2 (Likelihood function)
  • Marriage duration (divorce cost) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Fixed cost of divorce parameterised with ten dummies for marital duration of 1, 2, ..., 9 and 10 or more years.
    登记库： BEF
    工作论文 · Section 4.1/4.2

Public Pension Programmes and the Retirement of Married Couples in Denmark

Paul Bingley and Gauthier Lanot · Journal of Public Economics, 2007 · 个人

在丹麦夫妇的 1% 登记样本上估计一个关于夫妇共同退休与储蓄的动态离散选择模型，以提前退休计划（efterløn）的引入及其历次改革作为识别来源。男性和女性的退休对本人及配偶收入流的反应并不对称。

数据
1% sample of Danish couples of potential retirement age from an administrative register
关键变量
  • 结果变量：丈夫和妻子的退休决策（共同退休）
  • 识别变异：由公共财政出资的提前退休计划（efterløn）的引入及其后的历次改革
  • 解释变量：本人和配偶的收入流
  • 模型：含储蓄的动态离散选择模型
时期
所查资料中未注明
样本
所查资料中未注明 处于可能退休年龄的丹麦已婚夫妇的 1% 登记样本。 来源（摘要）

健康

把住院诊断、处方和分娩记录既当作冲击，也当作结果变量。

Survivors' Mental Health and the Protective Role of Income Stability

Itzik Fadlon, Astrid Sophie Fugleholm and Torben Heien Nielsen · AER: Insights, 2026 · 个人

基于丹麦全部家庭，记录了配偶去世后心理健康药物使用立即、大幅且持久的上升。这一激增有很大一部分可由配偶死亡造成的收入损失来解释，因此安全网提供的流动性保护了遗属的心理健康。

数据
Population Registry (BEF) with family linkages, Death Registry, National Patient Registry (LPR), Income Registry (earnings, transfers, pension payouts, capital income), Education Registry, Pharmaceutical Database / prescription register (LMDB), Health Insurance Registry (psychiatrist visits)
关键变量
  • 处理：配偶发生致命的心脏病发作或中风（12 个月内死亡），处理组对比事件发生较晚的对照组
  • 结果变量：心理健康药物的使用（ATC N05、N06）
  • 机制：配偶死亡造成的家庭收入损失（以去世配偶的劳动收入份额作为工具变量）
  • 异质性：基期收入、净财富和保险（DI/OAP、病假工资）
时期
1995–2018
样本
12,637 个处理组家庭和 15,212 个对照组家庭 45–80 岁的丹麦夫妇，其中一方在 1999 年至 2018 年间发生心脏病发作或中风并在 12 个月内死亡，不含自雇者，事件前后各四年为平衡面板。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Fatal heart attack or stroke (death event) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Robustness version requires the spouse to die from the same cause as the index health event within 12 months.
    登记库： LPR, Death Registry

  • Mental health medication take-up 医疗服务利用
    Indicator for redeeming a prescription for psychotropic drugs classified as psycholeptics (ATC N05) or psychoanaleptics (ATC N06) by the surviving spouse, measured at monthly and annual frequency (extensive margin).
    登记库： LMDB
    代码： ATC N05, N06
    工作论文 · Section I (Variable definitions)
  • Household income loss 劳动收入与收入
    Household income decomposed into seven sources for each spouse: earnings, sick pay, DI + old-age pension (OAP), other government benefits, private pensions, capital income and other income, compared between the year before (period -1) and the year after (period 1) the index event. In 2SLS the household income loss is normalized at the treatment-group mean and winsorized at the top and bottom 1 percent.
    登记库： Income Registry (IND)
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix, Tables B.4-B.7 notes
  • Deceased's income share (instrument) 劳动收入与收入
    Household income loss is instrumented with an indicator for whether the deceased spouse had earnings and a quadratic in the share of household income earned by the deceased spouse in the year before the event; 2SLS uses observations for years -1 and 0 with household FE, calendar-year FE and a quadratic in the survivor's age; SEs clustered by household.
    登记库： Income Registry (IND)
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix, Table B.7 notes
  • Treatment/control by event timing 样本界定与时间
    Households where one spouse has a health event 1999-2018 and dies within 12 months; treatment = event in 1999-2013, control = similar event in 2004-2018 with placebo event assigned five years earlier; both spouses aged 45-80 at baseline; balanced from four years before to four years after. Specifications include household FE, calendar-year FE and a quadratic in the surviving spouse's age. For Delta = 3-7 robustness the calendar interval of treated spousal deaths is held fixed so only the control group changes. Variables are measured in the year before the actual or placebo event.
    登记库： BEF, LPR, Death Registry, IND
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix, Table B.1-B.3 and Figure B.8 notes
  • Baseline psychiatric treatment 医疗服务利用
    Indicator for whether the surviving spouse had psychiatric treatment (visits to psychiatrists recorded in the Health Insurance Registry from 1990), used as a heterogeneity/control variable.
    登记库： SSSY, SYSI
    工作论文 · Section I (Data); Section III.B robustness
  • Deceased earner status 劳动收入与收入
    Indicator for whether the deceased spouse had labour market earnings in the year before the health event; used to split households (earner vs non-earner) and as an instrument.
    登记库： Income Registry (IND)
    在线附录 · Supplemental Appendix, Figures B.5-B.7 notes
  • Disability insurance and old-age pension rules 退休与养老金
    DI for those below OAP age requires a loss of work capacity of at least 50 percent (assessed by municipality) and can also be granted for social reasons; paid until OAP age. OAP for all residents from full retirement age, rising from 65 to 67 for cohorts born after 1954; both means-tested against own and partner income and independent of earnings history.

Universal Investments in Toddler Health: Learning from a Large Government Trial

Jennifer L. Baker, Lise G. Bjerregaard, Christian M. Dahl, Torben S. D. Johansen, Emil N. Sørensen and Miriam Wüst · Economic Journal, 2026 · 个人

20 世纪 60 年代哥本哈根由政府开展的一项幼儿预防性保健试验，依据手写的护士记录整理并与登记库相链接；该试验使成年期良好健康指数提高了一个标准差的 5%。起初处境不利的儿童和女孩获益最大，而随着反事实的政策环境改善，效应在较晚的出生队列中逐渐消退。

数据
Transcribed handwritten Copenhagen nurse records (Copenhagen City Archives), 1959–1967 cohorts, Central Person Register (CPR) linkage, Education registers (UDDA), Income registers (IND), Death register, National Patient Register (LPR), Copenhagen Perinatal Cohort (CPC), births 1959–1961, Family links to parents, siblings, children and spouses
关键变量
  • 处理：出生在每月的头三天（扩展的幼儿家访试验）
  • 第一阶段：护士记录中含有处理表格（实际参与情况）
  • 结果变量：成年期社会经济地位指数（受教育年限、中学后教育、30–50 岁的劳动收入与就业）
  • 结果变量：成年期良好健康指数（医院接触和诊断）、死亡率
  • 试验儿童自己的子女的第二代结果变量
时期
1959–1967 年出生（试验覆盖 1959 年 1 月–1968 年 4 月的出生）；登记库结果变量为 1977–2020 年
样本
87,336 人 1959–1967 年出生于哥本哈根、其护士记录已转录并与丹麦统计局行政数据相链接的儿童，剔除双胞胎。 来源
变量如何定义（11）
  • Treatment: born on days 1-3 of the month 样本界定与时间
    Indicator equal to 1 if the child's day of birth (from the transcribed nurse records) is 1-3 and 0 if 4-31; this identifies eligibility for the extended toddler home-visiting trial.
    登记库： Copenhagen nurse records, CPR
    代码： born13ext = 1 if BirthDateDay in 1-3; 0 if 4-31 (born13)

    Indicator that at least one page of the child's nurse record is a long table (the trial's table with rows such as GP referral, nutrition, vitamins, illnesses, emotional problems recorded at 15, 18, 24, 30 and 36 months).
    登记库： Copenhagen nurse records

  • Earnings (average ages 30-50) 劳动收入与收入
    Annual wage earnings LOENMV_13 (negative values set to 0), inflated to 2015 prices, assigned by age (year minus birth year) 18-65, winsorised at 1% in each tail by age, and averaged over available ages 30-50 (also 25-50).

    Employment indicator by age from IDAP: before 2008 PSTILL below 40 is employed; from 2008 PSOC_STATUS_KODE below 200 is employed. Out of labour force (defined only from 2008) is PSOC_STATUS_KODE 300-517. avg_emp is the mean employment indicator over ages 30-50; out of labour force is measured at age 50 (and 55).
    登记库： IDAP

    Latest available highest completed education HFAUDD (UDDA 2019 back to 1981), mapped to main level and normed length (months/12 = years). Higher education = KVU, MVU, bachelor, LVU or PhD; university = bachelor, LVU or PhD; above compulsory = anything but primary school (Grundskole).

Sick of Your Poor Neighborhood? Quasi-Experimental Evidence on Neighborhood Effects on Health

Linea Hasager and Mia Jørgensen · Journal of Public Economics, 2026 · 个人

利用 1986 至 1998 年难民在丹麦各社区间的准随机分散安置。被安置在低收入社区的难民在 8 至 15 年后罹患生活方式相关疾病的风险高出 12%，其驱动因素是邻居和当地环境，而非医疗可及性、族裔网络或劳动力市场结果。

数据
National Patient Register (LPR), Health Insurance Register (SYSI, SSSY), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Income register (IND), Population register (BEF) and address/mobility registers (BEFBOP, BEFADR), Migration register (VNDS), Criminal convictions register (KRAF), O*NET occupational data merged via occupation codes
关键变量
  • 处理：在 1986–1998 年难民分散安置政策（Refugee Spatial Dispersal Policy）下被分配到收入处于最低三分之一而非最高三分之一的堂区（以社区家庭可支配收入中位数衡量）
  • 结果变量：移民后 2–15 年和 8–15 年内确诊生活方式相关疾病（循环系统疾病、营养/代谢疾病、COPD、髋关节病、酒精相关疾病）
  • 结果变量：精神障碍诊断
  • 机制：医疗可及性、就业和劳动收入、邻居特征
时期
1985–2017 年（难民于 1986–1998 年抵达）
样本
21,965 名难民 来自九个难民来源国、抵达时年龄为 18–64 岁、于 1986–1998 年抵达丹麦并在分散安置政策下被分配到某一市镇的难民（不含家庭团聚的配偶）。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Lifestyle-related disease diagnosis 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicator for any primary or secondary hospital diagnosis (inpatient or outpatient, National Patient Register; ICD-8 before 1994, ICD-10 after) within 2-15 years, or within 8-15 years, after immigration in one of: circulatory diseases (hypertension, ischaemic heart diseases, pulmonary diseases, other heart disease, cerebrovascular and arterial diseases), nutritional/endocrine/metabolic diseases (diabetes type I and II, obesity, elevated cholesterol), COPD, hip arthrosis, and alcohol-related diseases. Exact code grouping is in Online Appendix Section B (not accessed).
    登记库： LPR
    工作论文 · Section I (data), footnotes 17-19
  • Mental disorder diagnosis 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicator for a hospital diagnosis 2-15 or 8-15 years after immigration of mental and behavioural disorders due to psychoactive substance use; schizophrenia, schizotypal and delusional disorders; mood (affective) disorders; neurotic, stress-related and somatoform disorders; behavioural syndromes associated with physiological disturbances; and disorders of adult personality and behaviour.
    登记库： LPR
    工作论文 · Section I, footnote 20
  • Neighbourhood income group (parish) 地理与社区
    Neighbourhood = parish (alternatives: municipality, apartment building). Each year, neighbourhoods are ranked by median household disposable income per adult household member (Income Register, CPI-deflated to 2000) and split into thirds: bottom (below 33rd percentile), middle (34th-66th), top (67th-100th); groups are recomputed every year for all neighbourhoods.
    登记库： IND, BEF
    工作论文 · Section I, footnote 25
  • Assignment neighbourhood 地理与社区
    Neighbourhood of the refugee's address on 1 January in the year after immigration, to capture permanent resettlement rather than temporary accommodation.
    登记库： BEFBOP, BEFADR
    工作论文 · Section II (identification), p. ~14
  • Refugee (dispersal policy) sample 移民身份与来源地
    Immigrants arriving 1986-1998 from Afghanistan, Ethiopia, Iran, Iraq, Lebanon, Palestine (stateless), Sri Lanka and Vietnam (1986-1998) or Somalia (1989-1998), aged 18-64 at arrival; former Yugoslavs excluded; excludes those married at arrival to a non-refugee partner or to a refugee partner who arrived earlier (family reunification).
    登记库： VNDS, BEF
    工作论文 · Section I, footnotes 14-16
  • Employment as fraction of full working year 就业与劳动力状态
    Fraction of a full-time working year employed: 1 if full-time employee during the whole year, less than one for part-time or part-year employment.
    登记库： IDA, IND
    工作论文 · Section I (labour market outcomes)
  • Annual gross earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Annual gross earnings from tax returns in the Income Register, CPI-deflated to 2000 and converted to USD at the 27 March 2020 exchange rate.
    登记库： IND
    工作论文 · Section I
  • Occupational task content 职业与职位层级
    Ratio of communication and cognitive tasks to manual tasks from O*NET, merged via ISCO occupation codes, for those employed at the end of November each year.
    登记库： IDA, O*NET
    工作论文 · Section I
  • GP and psychologist visits 医疗服务利用
    Number of visits to general practitioners and psychologists (no diagnosis codes available in these data).
    登记库： SYSI, SSSY

Effects of Parental Death on Labor Market Outcomes

Mathias Fjællegaard Jensen and Ning Zhang · American Economic Review, 2026 · 个人

利用丹麦行政数据中父母里首位去世者突然离世的事件以及匹配的对照组。男性劳动收入下降约 2%，女性下降约 3%，两者的心理健康都变差；有年幼子女的女性损失最大，约为 4%，这与失去祖辈提供的非正式育儿照料的解释相一致。

数据
Cause of death registers (DODSAARS/DODSAARG), Population register with parent-child links (BEF), Income and labour market registers (IND, AKM, IDAS/IDAN/IDAP), ATP-based hours proxy, Health Insurance Register for GP/psychologist/psychiatrist visits (SYSI/SSSY), National Patient Register (LPR_ADM/LPR_DIAG), Psychiatric Central Research Register (PSYK_ADM/PSYK_DIAG), Prescription register (LMDB), Childcare registers (DAGI/BOERNFB)

  • 对照组：匹配的尚未受处理个体

1980–2019 年（父母去世时间为 1985–2014 年）

Germs in the Family: The Short- and Long-Term Consequences of Intrahousehold Disease Spread

N. Meltem Daysal, Hui Ding, Maya Rossin-Slater and Hannes Schwandt · American Economic Review, 2026 · 个人

研究表明，弟弟妹妹在婴儿期因呼吸系统疾病住院的频率是其哥哥姐姐当年的两到三倍，原因是学龄前儿童把疾病带回家。结合出生次序与呼吸系统疾病流行程度的地区差异，研究发现生命早期的暴露会降低弟弟妹妹日后的劳动收入和受教育程度，并使慢性呼吸系统健康和心理健康状况恶化。

数据
National Patient Register (LPR), Medical Birth Register (MFR), Population register (BEF), Register-Based Labour Force Statistics (RAS), Income Statistics Register (IND), Education Register (UDDA), Academic Achievement Register (9th grade test scores), Psychiatric Central Research Register (PCRR), Health Insurance Register (Sygesikringsregisteret), Childcare enrollment data, National Child Database (breastfeeding)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：出生后第一年内的急性呼吸系统疾病住院
  • 处理：出生次序（第二胎对第一胎）与市镇呼吸系统疾病暴露指数的交互项
  • 结果变量：18–32 岁时的劳动收入、劳动参与和收入排名
  • 结果变量：高中和大学完成情况；九年级考试成绩
  • 结果变量：慢性呼吸系统疾病和心理健康方面的医疗服务使用
时期
1981–2017 年出生的儿童；结果变量为 1980–2019 年
样本
1,230,180 名儿童 1981–2017 年在丹麦出生的第一胎和第二胎单胎兄弟姐妹，出生间隔至少 11 个月，分布在 91 个市镇。 来源

  • Acute respiratory hospitalizations (first year of life) 健康结果、诊断与死亡

Breaking Bad: How Health Shocks Prompt Crime

Steffen Andersen, Elin Colmsjö, Gianpaolo Parise and Kim Peijnenburg · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2026 · 个人

利用丹麦登记库中癌症确诊时点可视为外生这一点，表明健康冲击会持续提高犯罪的概率，初次犯罪和再犯均是如此。患者以非法收入弥补损失的合法收入，并且由于存活概率下降，面临的预期惩罚成本更低；能够缓冲收入损失的福利项目会削弱这一效应。

数据
Danish administrative registers on cancer diagnoses (timing of diagnosis), Crime registers (first crimes and re-offenses), Income and welfare program registers

  • 结果变量：犯罪的概率（初次犯罪和再犯）
  • 机制：合法收入的损失
  • 机制：存活概率（预期惩罚成本）
  • 异质性：福利项目的覆盖情况
时期
所查资料中未注明
样本
所查资料中未注明 被诊断患有癌症的丹麦个人，利用确诊时点上的变异。 来源（摘要）

  • Crime (conviction for offence committed in year t) 犯罪
    Indicator equal to one if the individual is convicted of a crime committed in year t, dated by offence year and scaled to 100 in event-study figures. Offence types are classified as economic/non-economic and as property/sexual/violent (the latter following Statistics Denmark's system), covering 4,732,529 crimes 1980-2018.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark crime registers
    代码： Offence classification in Online Appendix Table I.I
    在线附录 · Online Appendix H eq. (15)-(16); Table I.I; Figure I.6 notes
  • Time from offence to apprehension 犯罪
    Log of one plus the days between when a crime is committed and when the perpetrator is apprehended, using the median time if the person commits multiple crimes in a year; only observations in the offence year are used.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark crime registers
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Table I.IX notes
  • Decline in 5-year survival probability due to cancer 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Logit of dying within 5 years, estimated on people aged 18-62 in 1980-2013 (diagnosed plus up to ten exactly matched controls per case) with cancer-type indicators (14 types plus multiple), age polynomial interactions, post-cancer, gender and marriage controls, separately for 1980-1992, 1993-2003 and 2004-2013. The decline is predicted probability minus the counterfactual with no diagnosis. Low survival means an above-median decline within gender (also split by quintile).

  • Exact-matched controls for survival estimation 样本界定与时间
    For each diagnosed individual, controls who in the year before diagnosis share age, marital status and gender and are in the same income ventile and years-of-education quintile. Up to ten controls with the smallest difference in total income are kept; unmatched observations are dropped.

  • Treatment/control (Fadlon-Nielsen DiD) 样本界定与时间
    Alternative design comparing individuals diagnosed in a given year with those diagnosed Delta years later (Delta from 3 to 8), with person, year-by-age, in-prison and cancer-recurrence fixed effects. The baseline sample keeps only the 10 years before cancer for pre-diagnosis observations.
    登记库： Cancer register, Crime registers
    在线附录 · Online Appendix H; Appendix A
  • Change in municipal welfare generosity (2007 reform) 失业与福利金
    Percentage change in labour income plus transfers in post-diagnosis years relative to the five-year pre-diagnosis average, regressed on municipality fixed effects, age fixed effects, a cubic in pre-diagnosis income rank and year effects, separately pre-reform (1987-2006) and post-reform (2007-2018). People diagnosed 2004-2006 are excluded. The generosity change is the difference between post- and pre-reform municipality effects.

Childhood Health Shocks and the Intergenerational Transmission of Inequality

Tine M. Eriksen, Amanda P. Gaulke, Niels Skipper, Jannet Svensson and Peter R. Thingholm · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2026 · 个人

利用儿童期 1 型糖尿病发病的准随机性，估计一种慢性但可治疗的健康冲击对 30 岁时劳动力市场结果的影响，将确诊儿童与同一天出生的匹配儿童进行比较。确诊儿童的劳动收入低约 14%，就业概率低 8.7 个百分点。因果森林显示，父母收入较高、母亲受教育程度较高的儿童所受的损失小得多，部分原因在于更好的疾病管理和学校教育。

数据
National Patient Registry (Landspatientregisteret): type 1 diabetes diagnoses via ICD-8 and ICD-10 codes, all children diagnosed since 1976, DanDiabKids (Danish Registry of Childhood and Adolescent Diabetes): date of diagnosis and clinical measures from annual pediatric clinic visits, since 1996, Statistics Denmark population registers: age, sex, immigrant or descendant status, birth order, siblings and parent-child links, Income and education registers for children and parents (income from 1980), Health care use around diagnosis: hospital admissions, general practitioner visits and pharmacy claims
关键变量
  • 处理：18 岁之前确诊 1 型糖尿病
  • 对照组：五名出生日期和性别完全相同、30 岁之前未确诊的匹配儿童
  • 结果变量：30 岁时的劳动力市场收入
  • 结果变量：30 岁时的就业（劳动收入为正）
  • 异质性：父母收入四分位、父母教育和年龄（因果森林）
  • 机制：HbA1c、因酮症酸中毒或昏迷住院、晚期并发症、受教育程度
时期
出生队列 1977–1987 年；确诊 1986–2004 年；结果变量在 30 岁时测量
样本
1,810 名确诊 1 型糖尿病的儿童和 9,050 名匹配的对照儿童（第 3 节和表 1）；主回归中 10,418 个观测值（表 3） 1977–1987 年出生、在 1986 至 2004 年间于 18 岁之前确诊 1 型糖尿病的丹麦本国出生者，每人匹配五名出生日期和性别相同的未确诊儿童。 来源

  • Childhood-onset type 1 diabetes 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    All children diagnosed with T1D in Denmark since 1976 are identified through the National Patient Registry (Landspatientregisteret) through ICD-10 codes and before that ICD-8 codes. Since 1996 clinical information is recorded in DanDiabKids, which covers all Danish children and adolescents with T1D seen at pediatric endocrinology clinics and provides the exact date of diagnosis and clinical characteristics from annual follow-up visits. Treatment is an indicator for being diagnosed with T1D before age 18; mean age at onset is 11.8 years.
    登记库： National Patient Registry (LPR), DanDiabKids

  • Analysis sample and matched comparison group 样本界定与时间
    Cohorts born 1977 to 1987, restricted to native Danes, diagnosed from 1986 to 2004 (other background characteristics are only available from 1986). 1,810 children are diagnosed with T1D before they turn 18. For each, five comparison children who had not been diagnosed with T1D before their 30th birthday are matched on the exact date of birth and sex (9,050 individuals). Parental characteristics are measured before the child's birth.
    登记库： Population registers (Statistics Denmark), National Patient Registry (LPR)
    代码： Born 1977-1987; diagnosed 1986-2004; 1:5 match on exact date of birth and sex
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Data and descriptive statistics); Table 1
  • Employment at age 30 就业与劳动力状态
    Indicator for having any positive labor market income at age 30.
    登记库： Income registers
    代码： Labor income > 0 at age 30
    工作论文 · Section 4, equation (1); footnote 6; notes to Table 3
  • Labor market income at age 30 and parental income 劳动收入与收入
    Labor market income in DKK measured at age 30; as a robustness check labor income is defined as the average of labor income at ages 29, 30 and 31. Parental income is measured in the year prior to the child's birth and entered as quartiles; because income data only go back to 1980, about one third of observations have missing parental income.
    登记库： Income registers
    工作论文 · Section 3; Section 5, footnote 8

    登记库： National Patient Registry (LPR), DanDiabKids

Changing Tracks: Human Capital Investment after Loss of Ability

Anders Humlum, Jakob R. Munch and Pernille Plato · American Economic Review, 2025 · 个人

利用丹麦行政数据中准随机发生的工伤事故，表明受伤劳动者会入读建立在其原有培训基础之上的学士学位项目。利用不同学位可衔接（stackable）程度的差异，研究发现高等教育使受伤劳动者从领取残疾福利转向全职工作，工资比受伤前高 25%，而技能重塑补贴的回报足以四倍覆盖其成本。

数据
Industrial Injury Register (Arbejdsskaderegisteret) / workers' compensation claims from AES, National Patient Register (LPR), Health Insurance Register (Sygesikringsregisteret), Prescription Drug Database (LMDB), Education Register (UDDA), Course Participant Register (VEUV), Danish Register for Evaluation of Marginalization (DREAM), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), linked to O*NET, Population register (BEF/POP)
关键变量
  • 处理：造成收入能力损失的工伤事故（与匹配的未受伤劳动者相比）
  • 结果变量：正规学位及课程的入读与完成情况
  • 结果变量：劳动收入、工时与职业（任务内容）
  • 结果变量：残疾福利及其他社会转移支付
  • 严重程度：评定的收入能力损失与人身损伤程度
时期
1995–2017 年（工伤索赔为 1998–2017 年）
样本
14,481 起工伤事件（14,369 名不同个人）；其中持有职业教育学位且可进入高等教育的劳动者为 4,568 起事件（4,528 人） 遭遇经认定的身体性工伤事故且收入能力损失为正的丹麦全职就业劳动者（不含军人），与匹配的未受伤劳动者相比较。 来源
变量如何定义（22）
  • Work accident causing loss of earning capacity (treatment) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Work accidents recorded by the Labour Market Insurance (AES) that caused a loss of earning capacity, restricted to physical (not psychological) injuries, non-military workers, and workers with full-time employment in each of the three years before the accident. An injury qualifies for compensation if personal impairment exceeds 5% or earning capacity loss exceeds 15%.
    登记库： Industrial Injury Register (Arbejdsskaderegisteret, AES), IDA
    工作论文 · Sections 2.1, 2.2.1 and 3.1
  • Injury severity (earning capacity loss, personal impairment) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Earnings capacity loss = loss of earning capacity in percent as assessed by The Labour Market Insurance (AES); personal impairment = degree of personal impairment in percent based on injury diagnosis. Temporary injuries = accidents AES assesses did not cause permanent loss of earning capacity or personal impairment. Non-injured controls are assigned the injury year of their matched injured worker.
    登记库： AES Industrial Injury Register (Arbejdsskaderegisteret)

  • Matched non-injured control workers 样本界定与时间
    Injured workers matched one-to-one to non-injured workers in cells of event year, pre-event occupation, age, gender and level of education (baseline specification 5); occupational earnings premium computed within Year-Occupation-Industry-Education-Age-Gender match cells.

Depressed Peers in Early Parenthood

Anne Toft Hansen, Jonas Cuzulan Hirani and Miriam Wüst · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2025 · 个人

在给定少数几项特征的条件下，市镇护士基本上是任意地把新手母亲分配到产后同伴小组。接触到一位抑郁的同伴，会使母亲本人在产后两年的心理健康服务使用增加 11%，并使她自评的心理健康状况和劳动力市场结果变差。

数据
Municipal health visitor records with mothers' group assignments and EPDS postpartum depression screening, Statistics Denmark registers: GP consultations, psychologist/psychiatrist appointments, hospital contacts for mental illness, sick leave
关键变量
  • 处理：新手母亲小组中有一位存在产后抑郁风险（EPDS）的同伴
  • 结果变量：产后两年内对心理健康服务的使用
  • 结果变量：因精神疾病到医院就诊
  • 结果变量：病假／劳动力市场结果
时期
2012–2017 年（健康访视员记录）
样本
所查资料中未注明 在丹麦各市镇由市镇健康访视员分配到新手母亲小组的初次生育的母亲。 来源（摘要）
变量如何定义（5）

利用登记库中父母的教育程度来度量全科医生童年时期的社会经济地位。社会经济地位低的患者若匹配到背景相近的全科医生，死亡率大幅降低，而社会经济地位高的患者不受影响；通过更密集的诊疗、更好地发现慢性病以及更好的依从性，死亡率的社会经济梯度缩小了四分之一。
