一项跨工作场所的大型社会实验评估了一个由雇主出资的健康项目，并在登记库中追踪长达十二年。处理组工作场所的雇员在长达七年的时间里看全科医生的次数减少、购买的处方药减少，而住院、缺勤和离职没有变化，并在家庭内部存在一定的溢出效应。

数据
Healthy-at-Work randomised experiment records (work-unit assignment, September 2008), Primary care physician consultation records (Statistics Denmark registers), Prescription drug purchase records, Hospital contact / hospitalisation records, Employment, sickness absence and turnover registers, Socio-economic background registers
关键变量
  • 处理：工作单位被随机分配到 Healthy-at-Work 健康促进项目
  • 结果变量：初级保健医生就诊
  • 结果变量：处方药购买（是否购买、供应月数）
  • 结果变量：住院（躯体疾病、精神疾病）
  • 结果变量：病假缺勤和离职
  • 溢出结果变量：配偶的医疗服务使用
时期
2008 年随机分配；追踪至 2020 年（PCP 就诊和工作结果）、2019 年（处方）、2018 年（住院）
样本
314 个工作单位中的 7,541 名工人（处理组 3,735 人，对照组 3,806 人） 参加 Healthy-at-Work 实验的老年护理卫生工作者，分布在丹麦 11 个市镇 110 家雇主的 314 个工作单位。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Treatment assignment and study population 样本界定与时间
    Work units (314 units of eldercare workers across 110 employers in 11 municipalities) were randomised in September 2008, with 144 units (46%) assigned to Healthy-at-Work. The population is individuals employed at participating work units in the month just before randomisation (7,541 of 7,660 linked to registers). Treatment status is fixed at the initial randomisation month, so post-randomisation moves are ignored and estimates are intention-to-treat.
    登记库： Healthy-at-Work experimental records, Statistics Denmark registers (CPR-linked)
    工作论文 · Sections 2.1, 3 and 4 (treatment assignment)
  • High-risk group 医疗服务利用
    Individuals with an above-median number of primary care physician consultations in the six months before randomisation; the low-risk group is at or below the median.
    登记库： Primary care physician consultation records (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Notes to Tables 2-5
  • Primary care physician consultations 医疗服务利用
    Number of consultations (and any consultation) with the primary care physician, from register data on fee-for-service payments to primary care physicians; follow-up to 2020. The paper does not give the register name or speciality codes.
    登记库： Primary care physician fee-for-service records (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 3; Section 4 results; cost-benefit section
  • Prescription drug purchases 医疗服务利用
    Any prescription drug purchase and months' supply per year (through 2019), covering drugs for hypertension, cholesterol, diabetes, severe pain relief and depression.
    登记库： Prescription drug purchase records (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： ATC C9 (hypertension, as printed), C10, A10, N2, N05A, N05B, N05C, N06A
    工作论文 · Table 3 notes
  • Hospitalisations (psychiatric / somatic) 医疗服务利用
    Any hospital contact and number of days admitted to hospital, separately for contacts with a psychiatric diagnosis and with a somatic diagnosis; follow-up to 2018. Diagnosis code lists are not given.
    登记库： Hospital contact records (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Table 4 panels A-D
  • Sickness absence 就业与劳动力状态
    Any absence and yearly absence rate (share of scheduled hours missed), conditional on hours > 0. Absence data cover about 95% of the sample.
    登记库： Absence register (Statistics Denmark; name not given)
    工作论文 · Table 5 panels A-B; Table 1 notes
  • Hours, employer continuity and earnings 就业与劳动力状态
    Any hours worked, hours worked per year, continued employment with the same employer (turnover measure), and earnings per year.
    登记库： Employment registers (Statistics Denmark; names not given)
    工作论文 · Table 5 panels C-F
  • Spouses (spillover sample) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Individuals married to or cohabiting with individuals employed at participating work units in the month just prior to randomisation.
    登记库： Population register (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Table 6 notes (spillovers to spouses)

Replication package

Do Medical Treatments Work for Work? Evidence from Breast Cancer Patients

N. Meltem Daysal, William N. Evans, Mikkel Hasse Pedersen and Mircea Trandafir · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2025 · 个人

丹麦一项诊疗指南的调整改变了哪些乳腺癌患者接受放射治疗，从而为治疗提供了准实验变异。放疗再现了临床试验中发现的生存获益，并且带来经济回报：确诊十年后，就业提高 37%，劳动收入提高 45%，抵消了确诊后就业下降的大部分。

数据
Danish Breast Cancer Cooperative Group (DBCG) clinical Breast Cancer Database, Register of Causes of Death, Register-Based Labour Force Statistics (RAS), Income Statistics Register, DREAM weekly transfer register, Population Register (BEF), Education Register
关键变量
  • 处理：接受放疗
  • 工具变量：1995 年 1 月 DBCG 指南调整扩大了放疗适用范围（1995 年之后确诊 × 符合条件组）
  • 结果变量：全因死亡率和乳腺癌死亡率
  • 结果变量：就业、年劳动收入、总收入
  • 结果变量：领取病假津贴和残疾津贴
时期
1990–2008 年（确诊时间为 1990–1998 年）
样本
2,823 个观测值（女性） 1990–1998 年在丹麦确诊乳腺癌并参加 DBCG89 临床试验的 55 岁以下高风险绝经前女性。 来源
变量如何定义（10）
  • Radiotherapy receipt 医疗服务利用
    Indicator for receiving adjuvant radiation therapy, from the DBCG clinical Breast Cancer Database, which records treatments administered and dates of diagnosis and major interventions.
    登记库： DBCG clinical Breast Cancer Database
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Data), Treatment Variable
  • T95 group and instrument 样本界定与时间
    Instrument is the interaction between an indicator for belonging to the T95 group and an indicator for diagnosis in or after 1995. The comparison group consists of 'always eligible' and 'never eligible' women (eligible or not eligible for radiotherapy regardless of year of diagnosis); full analysis sample N = 2,823. Robustness drops women diagnosed in 1994, women residing in areas with pilot universal screening programs, or women with breast-conserving surgery.
    登记库： DBCG clinical database
    在线附录 · Notes to Appendix Tables A4, A9 and Figures A4-A5
  • Analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    Female breast cancer patients diagnosed 1990-1998 (26,900), restricted to DBCG89 trial enrollees who are pre-menopausal and high-risk, excluding always-eligible patients whose radiotherapy intensity changed, patients missing radiotherapy, tumour size or micro-radical removal information, and women aged 55+ at diagnosis (final N = 2,823).
    登记库： DBCG clinical Breast Cancer Database
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Analysis Sample); Appendix Table A1
  • All-cause and breast cancer mortality 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicators for death from any cause and from breast cancer, using the exact date and ICD-coded cause of death in the Register of Causes of Death, measured for each year from the date of diagnosis up to 10 years after.
    登记库： Register of Causes of Death
    工作论文 · Section 3, Outcome Variables
  • Employed / unemployed / out of labour force 就业与劳动力状态
    Indicators of labour market status as of November from the Register-Based Labour Force Statistics, for each calendar year from diagnosis up to 10 years later. Non-survivors are assigned one for out of the labour force and zero for all other labour market outcomes.
    登记库： RAS
    工作论文 · Section 3, Outcome Variables
  • Labour earnings and gross income 劳动收入与收入
    Monetary outcomes are expressed in thousands of 2015 DKK; labour-market outcomes are averaged over 1-5 and 6-10 years after diagnosis; pre-diagnosis characteristics (employment status, labour earnings, gross personal income) are averaged over 2-4 years before diagnosis.
    登记库： Income Statistics Register
    在线附录 · Notes to Appendix Table A1 and Figures A4-A5
  • Sickness and disability benefit receipt 失业与福利金
    Transfer outcomes (any government transfer/any welfare, sickness benefits, disability pension) are indicators measured cumulatively within 5 (or 10) years after diagnosis, not as annual averages.
    登记库： DREAM
    在线附录 · Appendix Table A3; Figure A4-A5 notes
  • Clinical eligibility controls 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    All possible interactions among indicators for: mastectomy, age <45 at diagnosis, number of positive nodes (0, 1-3, 4+), tumor larger than 50mm, and tumor removed micro-radically; plus separate indicators for age at diagnosis in full years, tumor size in cm, number of positive nodes (0, 1-3, 4+), micro-radical removal, type of surgery (lumpectomy, mastectomy, or lumpectomy followed by mastectomy), and chemotherapy type (DBCG89 trial arm: CMF, CEF, OA, tamoxifen regimens, pamidronate arms); and year-of-diagnosis fixed effects. Standard errors clustered by hospital.
    登记库： DBCG clinical database
    代码： nodes 0/1-3/4+; tumor >50mm; age <45
    在线附录 · Notes to Appendix Tables A2-A4, A9
  • Radiotherapy eligibility under DBCG89 protocol 医疗服务利用
    DBCG89 protocol (age eligibility <75 years). Low risk (as printed in the appendix protocol table): tumor <=5cm and positive nodes and grade I (if premenopausal); high risk: tumor >5cm or positive nodes or (premenopausal and ductal grade II-III). Radiotherapy indicated after lumpectomy, when the carcinoma was not removed microradically, and additionally for: age <=45 with >=4 positive nodes (until January 1995); premenopausal with positive nodes or tumor >5cm (from January 1995). Positive nodes = cancer spread to at least one lymph node.
    登记库： Danish Breast Cancer Cooperative Group (DBCG) clinical database
    代码： tumor >5cm; >=4 positive nodes; age <=45; age <75
    在线附录 · Appendix Figure A1 (DBCG89 protocol)
  • Cumulative hospital contacts 医疗服务利用
    Cumulative number of inpatient and outpatient hospital contacts from diagnosis until each year after diagnosis (separate outcomes).
    在线附录 · Appendix Figure A8 notes

Understanding the Rise in Life Expectancy Inequality

Gordon B. Dahl, Claus Thustrup Kreiner, Torben Heien Nielsen and Benjamin Ly Serena · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2024 · 个人

将富人与穷人之间不断扩大的预期寿命差距，分解为分年龄死亡率的变化和存活到各个年龄的概率的差异。穷人较低的存活概率解释了丹麦预期寿命不平等的全部上升；心血管疾病方面的改善惠及所有人，但与生活方式相关的存活概率出现了分化。

数据
Population registers (BEF, FAIN): sex and age, Income register (IND): household income net of universal transfers, Death registers (DODAARS, DODAASG) with cause of death, US mortality by income from Chetty et al. (2016), IRS tax data
关键变量
  • 结果变量：分收入组的时期预期寿命
  • 收入排名：死亡前两年测得的家庭收入
  • 分解：死亡率变化与存活概率
  • 死因：心血管疾病、癌症、与生活方式相关的疾病、其他
时期
2001–2014
样本
所查资料中未注明 2001–2014 年的全体丹麦居民，并与美国基于纳税申报表的死亡率数据作比较。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Household income (net of transfers tied to age/pension) 劳动收入与收入
    Individual income = total personal income PERINDKIALT minus public pensions (QPENSNY), cash assistance (KONTHJ/KONT_GL) and other transfers (ANDOVERFORSEL), with negative business income, negative capital income (after removing surplus from owner-occupied housing OVSKEJD02_NY/OVSKEJD07) and negative wage components added back; household income is the mean of own and spouse/cohabiting partner income (rowmean of inc and partner inc).
    登记库： IND (INDUPD), BEF, FAIN
    代码： PERINDKIALT, QPENSNY, KONTHJ/KONT_GL, ANDOVERFORSEL, NETOVSKUD_GL, FORMUEINDK_NY, OVSKEJD02_NY, OVSKEJD07, LOENMV, ERHVERVSINDK_GL, OVERFORSINDK, RESUINK_GL; partner via EFALLE (from 1986) / C_FAELLE_ID (before 1986)
    复制代码 · Replication files/DKRepCode/CollectData.sas (income block) and CreateData_DK.do lines ~13-69
  • Income rank (two-year lag) 劳动收入与收入
    Percentile rank (1-100, ties broken randomly) of household income measured two years earlier (t-2), computed within gender x birth cohort x year cells; mortality sample ages 40-100, years 2001-2014, collapsed to income tertiles for trends.
    登记库： IND, BEF
    代码： laginc = hhinc[t-2]; incrank by gender birthyear year
    复制代码 · CreateData_DK.do lines ~108-130, 195-200
  • Cause of death categories 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Underlying cause of death (ICD-10) from the cause-of-death registers: cardiovascular = I00-I78; cancer = C00-C97 and D00-D09; lifestyle-related = alcohol (K70, K74, K86.0, F10), smoking (COPD J40-J44) and obesity (E66, diabetes E10-E14); other = all remaining deaths. A Case-Deaton 'behavioural' grouping (diabetes E10-E14, suicide X60-X84/Y87.0, poisoning X40-X45/Y10-Y15/Y45/Y47/Y49, chronic liver K70/K73/K74, lung cancer C34) is also built.
    登记库： DODSAASG, DODSAARS
    代码： C_DODTILGRUNDL_ACME (DODSAASG), C_DOD1 (DODSAARS); ICD-10 I00-I78; C00-C97, D00-D09; K70,K74,K860,F10; J40-J44; E66,E10-E14
    复制代码 · CreateData_DK.do lines ~132-192
  • Mortality sample and estate correction 样本界定与时间
    Population from BEF (1986+) and FAIN (before 1986), years 1998-2014, ages 37+ (mortality analyses ages 40-100, 2001-2014); person-years after the death year are dropped (unresolved estates). Age-specific mortality by income tertile and gender is linearly trended across 2001-2014 to predict 2001 and 2014 rates.
    登记库： BEF, FAIN, DODSAASG, DODSAARS
    复制代码 · CreateData_DK.do lines ~7-9, 94-98, 195-215
  • Education group (ISCED) 教育与考试成绩
    Highest completed education HFAUDD lagged one year, mapped to ISCED: low = ISCED 0-2, mid = 3-4, high = 5-6.
    登记库： UDDA
    代码： HFAUDD -> format c_isced_audd_afsp4d_k
    复制代码 · CollectData.sas (education); CreateData_DK.do lines ~71-82

Public Health Policy at Scale: Impact of a Government-Sponsored Information Campaign on Infant Mortality in Denmark

Onur Altındağ, Jane Greve and Erdal Tekin · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2024 · 个人

一场针对婴儿猝死综合征的全国性宣传运动，主要借助覆盖所有家庭的护士家访来开展；基于全体人口出生数据的断点回归显示，它使婴儿死亡率下降 17%。低出生体重儿和早产儿的效应要大 11 至 14 倍，且效应集中在社会经济地位较低的家庭。

数据
Medical Birth Register (MFR): birth weight, gestational age, parity, maternal age, immigrant status, Register of Causes of Death (exact date and cause of death), Education register (parental education)
关键变量
  • 驱动变量：出生月份相对于 1991 年 12 月
  • 处理：在 1991 年婴儿睡姿指南变更之后出生
  • 结果变量：每 10,000 例出生中的 SIDS 死亡数
  • 结果变量：每 10,000 例出生中的婴儿和儿童死亡数
  • 异质性：低出生体重、早产、母亲的教育程度
时期
1973–2006 年的活产
样本
568,106 例出生（SIDS 结果变量，MSE 最优带宽为 52 个月）；婴儿死亡率为 632,449 例出生（58 个月） 1991 年 12 月指南变更前后、落在断点回归带宽以内的丹麦全部活产。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Running variable / post-campaign treatment 样本界定与时间
    Days between the child's birth date and 31 December 1991 (main tables), with treatment = born after the cutoff; local linear specification with separate slopes, SEs clustered by birthday. The setup file also defines a birth-month distance to January 1992. Births up to 2006 retained.
    登记库： MFR
    代码： dif = birthday - mdy(12,31,1991); setup: dif = ym(byear,bmonth) - ym(1992,1), treat = dif >= 0
    复制代码 · 04 Tables_days.do lines ~38-42; 01 Set up RD data.do
  • Infant and child mortality per 10,000 births 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    mor1 = 10,000 if the child died (death register date) before the first birthday, 0 otherwise; mor5 = 10,000 if died before the fifth birthday. Deaths taken from DOD and linked to birth-register children.
    登记库： DOD, MFR
    代码： mor1 = 10000 if dead==1 & deathdate < bday_1yr; mor5 analogous with bday_5yr
    复制代码 · 01 Set up RD data.do, lines ~45-60; 01_mortality_no_cause.do
  • SIDS and other cause-specific deaths 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Primary cause of death (C_DOD1 in DODSAARS up to 2001; C_DODTILGRUNDL_ACME in DODSAASG from 2002) classified with ICD-8 before 1994 and ICD-10 from 1994; SIDS = ICD-8 795.0-795.9 / ICD-10 R95; per 10,000 births when death occurs before age 5. Other groups: infectious, neoplasms, nervous system, respiratory, perinatal, congenital malformations, unknown.
    登记库： DODSAARS, DODSAASG
    代码： SIDS: ICD-8 7950-7959, ICD-10 R950-R959; inf 0000-1399/A00-B99; neo 1400-2389/C00-C99; nerv 3200-3899/G00-H95; resp 4600-5199/J00-J99; perinatal 7600-7799/P00-P96; congenital 7400-7599/Q00-Q99; unknown 7960-7969/R96-R99
    复制代码 · 02_mortality_with cause.do
  • Low birth weight and preterm birth 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Birth weight from MFR (V_VAGT before 1997, VAEGT_BARN after) set to missing if 0 or >9,000 g; LBW = <2,500 g, VLBW = <1,500 g; preterm = gestational age < 37 weeks (fullterm37 = 0). Gestational age only available from 1978 and birth weight recorded in 500 g bands before 1978.
    登记库： MFR
    代码： V_VAGT / VAEGT_BARN; V_SVLANGDE / GESTATIONSALDER_DAGE
    复制代码 · 01_MFR_1973_1996.do lines ~23-97; 02_MFR_1996_2008.do
  • Maternal education and characteristics 教育与考试成绩
    Mother's highest education HFAUDD mapped to AUDD2008_L1L5_KT: basic (<20 or >=90), vocational/high school (20-39), short (40-49), medium (50-59), long further education (60-89); high education = short+medium+long. Couple = C_STATUS 2 or 4-7; immigrant = IE_TYPE 2 or 3.
    登记库： Grundvive (BEF/UDDA)
    代码： AUDD2008_L1L5_KT; C_STATUS; IE_TYPE in 2,3
    复制代码 · 01_maternal_ses.do lines ~72-103; 04 Tables_days.do line 27

Spillover Effects of Early-Life Medical Interventions

N. Meltem Daysal, Marianne Simonsen, Mircea Trandafir and Sanni Breining · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2022 · 个人

对极低出生体重新生儿的额外医疗救治（借助一个出生体重门槛加以识别）不仅改善了被救治婴儿本人的状况，也改善了其哥哥姐姐的结果，后者在学校表现更好。家庭资源和父母投入的时间会随孩子的健康状况而调整。

数据
Medical Birth Register (MFR): birth weight, gestational age, parity, Parent and sibling links (BEF), 9th-grade exam test score register (reading and math), Education/enrollment registers, Prescription drug register (antidepressant use, from 1995), Health registers for diagnoses (intellectual disability, ADHD) and mortality, Income and labour market registers for parents
关键变量
  • 驱动变量：焦点儿童的出生体重相对于 1,500 克 VLBW 临界值
  • 结果变量：兄弟姐妹九年级阅读和数学的标准化考试成绩
  • 结果变量：兄弟姐妹到 19 岁时是否在义务教育之后继续就读，以及高中类别
  • 机制：焦点儿童的死亡率和心理健康；母亲的抗抑郁药使用；父母的收入、就业、工作天数
时期
焦点儿童出生于 1982–1993 年；考试成绩为 2001–2010 年
样本
5,827 个兄弟姐妹观测值（3,677 名焦点儿童的兄弟姐妹） 1982–1993 年出生、出生体重在 1,300 至 1,700 克之间的丹麦儿童的（同母）兄弟姐妹。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • VLBW treatment / running variable 样本界定与时间
    Focal child's birth weight (bw) centred at 1,500 grams; treatment indicator vlbw = 1 if birth weight < 1,500 g; local linear RD with separate slopes on each side and triangular weights 1-|bw-1500|/bandwidth.
    登记库： MFR
    代码： vlbw = (bw < 1500); f1 = (bw-1500)*vlbw; f2 = (bw-1500)*(1-vlbw)

In indices, non-test outcomes are standardized by birth year.
    登记库： UDFK
    代码： UDFK2013: GRUNDSKOLEFAG in ('Dansk','Matematik'); FAGDISCIPLIN 'Mundtlig' (Danish) / 'Skriftlig','Matematisk problemløsning','Matematiske færdigheder' (math); proeveform in ('Prøvefag 2002-2006','Bundne prøvefag')

Family Labor Supply Responses to Severe Health Shocks: Evidence from Danish Administrative Records

Itzik Fadlon and Torben Heien Nielsen · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2021 · 个人

比较同一时间遭遇致命健康冲击与非致命健康冲击的家庭。配偶去世后，在世的一方增加劳动供给以自我保险；而在非致命冲击之后，配偶减少劳动供给以照顾病人。家中子女的调整幅度较小。

数据
Cause of Death Registry, National Patient Registry (LPR) hospitalisation records with ICD diagnoses, Income and transfer registers (earnings, government transfers, pension and annuity payouts, capital income), 1980–2011, Third-party reported liquid wealth balances, 1984–2011, Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), incl. ATP-based full-/part-time employment, Household linkages of spouses and cohabiting partners (population registers)
关键变量
  • 处理：配偶死亡（致命健康冲击）或首次非致命心脏病发作／中风
  • 对照组：几年后经历同样冲击的家庭
  • 结果变量：在世／健康配偶的劳动参与和劳动收入
  • 结果变量：家庭来自转移支付、养老金和保险的收入；流动性财富
  • 异质性：家庭流动性、收入损失、年龄
时期
1980–2011 年（冲击发生于 1985–2011 年）
样本
处理组 310,720 个家庭、对照组 409,190 个家庭（致命冲击）；处理组 37,437 个家庭、对照组 54,887 个家庭（非致命心脏病发作和中风） 在（实际或安慰剂）冲击发生当年双方年龄均为 45–80 岁的丹麦已婚和同居伴侣；非致命冲击样本限于 60 岁以下且至少存活三年的配偶。 来源
变量如何定义（12）
  • Fatal health shock (spousal death) 样本界定与时间
    Households in which one spouse died between 1985 and 2011 and was aged 45 to 80 in the year of the (actual or placebo) event. Treatment households are matched to control households from the same cohorts that experienced the same event five years later (Delta = 5); summary statistics measured at t = -2. Prime-age subsamples restrict to households before the Early Retirement Age of 60.
    登记库： Cause of Death Registry; population/household registers
    代码： Age at death 45-80; event years 1985-2011; Delta = 5 years
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Table A.1 notes; Figure C.1 notes
  • Non-fatal severe health shock 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Households in which one spouse experienced a heart attack or a stroke for the first time between 1985 and 2011 and survived for at least three years, with both spouses under age 60. Controls are households from the same cohorts experiencing the same event five years later.
    登记库： National Patient Registry (LPR)
    代码： First-ever heart attack or stroke; survival >= 3 years; both spouses < 60; years 1985-2011 (no ICD list given in appendix)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Table A.1 notes
  • Control group: same shock five years later 样本界定与时间
    Each treatment group of households shocked in year tau is matched to households from the same cohorts that experience the same shock in year tau + 5 (Delta = 5), who are assigned a placebo shock at t = 0 with t = year - tau; effects are identified up to four years after the shock via difference-in-differences relative to a baseline period (t = -2 in summary statistics).
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Labor force participation 就业与劳动力状态
    Indicator for having any positive level of annual earnings.
    登记库： Income registers
    工作论文 · Section 5
  • Full-time and part-time employment (ATP-based) 工作时间
    From IDA, constructed from employee ATP pension contributions (available for individuals under 60): full-time means working at least 30 hours per week all 12 months of the calendar year (full-time full-year); part-time means working at some point in the year but fewer than 30 hours per week or fewer than 12 months.
    登记库： IDA, ATP contributions
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Household income from all sources 劳动收入与收入
    Household income including income from any source: earnings, capital income, annuity payouts and benefits from any social program.
    登记库： Income and transfer registers
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Table D.1 notes
  • Liquid wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Third-party reported liquid wealth balances measured annually on 31 December, 1984-2011, including bank-account balances and lump-sum transfers from insurance companies; used in robustness checks to account for life insurance payouts.
    登记库： Tax-reported wealth data
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Potential income loss from spousal death 劳动收入与收入
    Household income from any source in t = 1 holding the surviving spouse's earnings and social benefits (labor income, Social DI and Social Security) at their t = -1 level, divided by household income in t = -1, then normalized for treated households by the corresponding control-group mean.
    登记库： Income and transfer registers

    For each municipality and year, the average Social Disability Insurance (Social DI) benefits received by non-working surviving spouses is computed; each widow in the treatment group is assigned her municipality-year leave-one-out mean. Benefits in annual DKK 1,000. Sample: widows under 67 (age of transition into Old-Age Pension) in years before 1994, when there is a data break in the reporting of survivors benefits received through Social DI. Controls: municipality unemployment rate and average earnings (interacted with Treat, Post, Treat x Post), widow age, year and municipality FE; post periods 2-4.
    登记库： Transfer income registers; municipality of residence

Spot Price Biases in Non-Linear Health Insurance Contracts

Marianne Simonsen, Lars Skipper, Niels Skipper and Anne Illemann Christensen · Journal of Public Economics, 2021 · 个人

丹麦处方药报销制度的报销比例随年度支出上升，并且每年重置。消费者在重置时点前后表现出前瞻性，但在年内对当期价格反应过度；解释这种即期价格偏误的是流动性约束，而不是对保险方案的理解能力或认知衰退。

数据
Population-wide individual data on prescription drug purchases and reimbursement under the Danish non-linear drug insurance scheme (registers not named in the abstract)
关键变量
  • 激励：药品的即期价格是年内累计支出的非线性函数
  • 激励：报销（免赔额）年度在年末重置
  • 结果变量：处方药购买的时点和金额
  • 异质性：流动性约束、对保险方案的理解能力、认知衰退
时期
所查资料中未注明
样本
所查资料中未注明 覆盖全体人口的数据，对象为适用非线性报销制度的丹麦处方药消费者（摘要中未提供细节）。 来源（摘要）
调查
Health Interview Survey 2000
变量如何定义（8）
  • Prescription drug spending and purchases 医疗服务利用
    The full history of prescription drug purchases from the Danish Prescription Drug Register (Laegemiddelstatistikregisteret), covering 1995-2014: date, shelf price, government coverage, type of coverage and type of drug. It is aggregated to daily (descriptive) or monthly (estimation) spending within coverage years. Outcomes include spending, number of pharmacy visits, and days until next purchase truncated at 365.
    登记库： Laegemiddelstatistikregisteret (Danish Prescription Drug Register)
    论文正文 · Section 3; Section 4 (outcomes before reset)
  • Coverage year and synthetic pre-reform coverage year 医疗服务利用
    Post-reform coverage years start with the first purchase after the March 2000 reform and reset 365 days after the first purchase, with the next year starting at the next purchase. Synthetic pre-reform coverage years apply the same rule from the first observed purchase, keeping only years that end by December 1999.
    登记库： Laegemiddelstatistikregisteret
    论文正文 · Section 2; Section 3
  • Spot price 医疗服务利用
    Coinsurance rate at the start of coverage month m given year-to-date spending, taking values 1, 0.5, 0.25, 0.15 or 0. Under the 2000 contract: a DKK 500 deductible, 50% coinsurance to DKK 1,200, 25% to DKK 2,800, 15% beyond, and a stop-loss at DKK 18,500 capping out-of-pocket costs at DKK 3,600. The spot price is 1 for the purchase that starts a coverage year.
    登记库： Laegemiddelstatistikregisteret
    论文正文 · Section 2, Figure 1; Section 5 (price definition a)
  • Expected end-of-year (shadow) price 医疗服务利用
    Average realised end-of-year price within cells of 5 age groups x 6 sextiles of predicted health spending x 100 percentiles of year-to-date spending, for each coverage month. Pre-reform counterfactual prices for 1998 are imputed by matching percentiles to pooled coverage years starting in 2000-2001.
    登记库： Laegemiddelstatistikregisteret
    论文正文 · Section 5 (price definitions b-c, steps i-iii)
  • Predicted pharmaceutical spending (health index) 医疗服务利用
    Following Handel (2013), year-t drug spending is regressed on year t-1 gender, age and age squared, number of GP office visits, fee-for-service payments to the physician, drug spending and its square, ATC level-3 drug-type indicators (88 categories), and hospital ICD-10 level-2 diagnosis indicators (215 categories). The model is then used to predict next year's spending; for coverage-reset analyses, covariates are measured in the 365 days before the coverage year starts.
    登记库： Laegemiddelstatistikregisteret, National Patient Register (hospital diagnoses), Health insurance (GP) records
    代码： ATC level 3 (88 categories); ICD-10 level 2 (215 categories)
    论文正文 · Appendix D
  • Chronic drug 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Following Alpert (2016), a drug at ATC level 3 (pharmacological subgroup) is chronic if its median consumer buys it in at least three calendar months of a year (more than twice).
    登记库： Laegemiddelstatistikregisteret
    代码： ATC level 3
    论文正文 · Section 3 footnote 5; Appendix C
  • Self-reported liquidity constraint 财富、负债与消费
    From the 2000 Danish National Health Interview Survey (DNHIS) question 'During the last 12 months, how often have you had trouble paying your bills'. Respondents answering at least 'some months' are coded as liquidity constrained (12%).
    登记库： DNHIS 2000 (survey linked by personal ID)
    论文正文 · Section 6 (mechanisms), Table 5
  • Plan literacy groups 教育与考试成绩
    'Economic literates' are individuals with a master-level degree in economics or business (ISCED level 7); medical professionals hold a university degree in medicine or pharmacology (ISCED levels 7-8). Cognitive decline is proxied by age 65 and above versus below 65.
    登记库： Education register
    代码： ISCED 7 (economics/business); ISCED 7-8 (medicine/pharmacology)
    论文正文 · Section 6, Table 5 notes

Home Prices, Fertility, and Early-Life Health Outcomes

N. Meltem Daysal, Michael Lovenheim, Nikolaj Siersbæk and David N. Wasser · Journal of Public Economics, 2021 · 个人

对 20 至 44 岁的丹麦房主而言，房价上涨 100,000 克朗会使生育概率提高约 2.35%。出生结果也有所改善，但主要是因为生育者的构成发生了变化；对儿童出生后头五年的健康则没有影响。

数据
Medical Birth Register (MFR), National Patient Register (LPR), State's Sales and Valuation Registry (public property valuations and sales prices), Population register (BEF) and other registers for demographics, education, household income and partner status
关键变量
  • 处理：滞后一期的估计住房价值一年变动（公共评估值按当地成交价比率调整）
  • 结果变量：是否生育的指示变量
  • 结果变量：出生体重、低出生体重、极低出生体重、早产
  • 结果变量：出生后第一年及 1–5 岁期间的住院、急诊就诊和住院天数
  • 比较组：租房者
时期
1992–2011 年（生育分析为 1995–2006 年）
样本
198,435 名女性的 1,105,559 个观测值（125,903 次生育） 在 1993 至 2004 年间首次成为房主、购房时年龄在 18 至 42 岁之间的 20–44 岁女性。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Estimated home value 财富、负债与消费
    The public valuation of the home times the owner's share, multiplied by the mean ratio of sale price to public valuation among homes sold in the same year, municipality, housing type and valuation-quartile cluster (a SPAR-type index); woman's and partner's shares are summed. The value is fixed to the first house the woman is observed buying, and is in 100,000 DKK at 2006 prices (CPI-deflated).
    登记库： State's Sales and Valuation Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3, equation (1)
  • Once-lagged one-year home price change 财富、负债与消费
    One-year change in estimated home value, lagged one year relative to the fertility outcome. Public valuations were made in January of the prior year until end-2003 and in October of the prior year afterwards. Homes whose valuation rose by more than 50% in a year, and the 1st and 99th percentiles of the lagged change, are excluded.
    登记库： State's Sales and Valuation Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3 and 3.1, footnote 13
  • Housing sample restrictions 样本界定与时间
    Residential houses and apartments in clusters with at least five sales; only normal sales between individuals (no intra-family sales). Excluded: negative valuations or sale prices, multiple addresses at the same location, and sales above 300% or below 40% of the public valuation.
    登记库： State's Sales and Valuation Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, Appendix Table A-1
  • Potential first-time homeowner women 样本界定与时间
    Women not homeowners at the beginning of 1992-1993 who became homeowners between 1993 and 2004 at ages 18-42; owning means the woman, her partner or both own the home. Women whose partner bought before the couple formed, who moved out of the new home within the year, or who have incomplete income or home data are dropped, leaving women aged 20-44 observed 1995-2006.
    登记库： Population Registry, State's Sales and Valuation Registry
    工作论文 · Section 1 footnote 2; Section 3.1
  • Low / very low birth weight, prematurity 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    From the Birth Registry for live births: low birth weight is below 2,500 grams, very low birth weight below 1,500 grams, and premature is gestational age under 37 completed weeks; birth weight is also used continuously.
    登记库： Medical Birth Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3
  • Hospital admissions, inpatient days and ER visits 医疗服务利用
    Indicators for any hospital admission and any ER visit in the first year of life and at ages 1-5, plus the number of days hospitalised and ER visits in the first five years. Inpatient days exclude the childbirth admission and the following four days.
    登记库： National Patient Register
    工作论文 · Section 3, footnote 12
  • Giving birth / conception timing 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator for giving birth in the year, from the Birth Registry. In a robustness check, the conception date is computed from gestational length and birth date, the price change is scaled by the fraction of the year before conception, and non-mothers get randomly assigned birth months.
    登记库： Medical Birth Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3; Section 4 robustness
  • Imputed household consumption 财富、负债与消费
    Household consumption imputed from income and year-to-year wealth changes following Browning and Leth-Petersen (2003).
    登记库： Danish income and wealth registers
    工作论文 · Section 5 (credit constraints)

Sandra E. Black, Sanni Breining, David N. Figlio, Jonathan Guryan, Krzysztof Karbownik, Helena Skyt Nielsen, Jeffrey Roth and Marianne Simonsen · Economic Journal, 2021 · 个人

利用丹麦和佛罗里达两地的行政数据，识别有一个残疾弟妹在家庭内部产生的溢出效应。在有三个及以上子女的家庭中比较头胎和二胎子女：二胎子女在幼年时期与弟妹相处的时间更长，当第三个孩子有残疾时，其受到的影响与头胎子女不同。

  • 处理：排行第三的弟妹在五岁前被观测到有残疾（依据医疗登记库中的诊断）
  • 比较：二胎子女与头胎子女（双重差分）

1933 年至 1960 年间，面向低收入家庭儿童的学前教育的可及性提高了成年后的教育、劳动收入和活过 65 岁的概率，而且受益女性的子女到 25 岁时获得了更多教育。婴儿期接触护士家访计划会降低学前教育的附加价值，因此这两项计划是部分替代关系。

  • 结果变量：50 岁前后的教育和劳动收入
  • 结果变量：活过 65 岁、住院、诊断
  • 代际结果变量：最年长子女到 25 岁时的受教育程度
  • 控制变量：市镇和出生年份固定效应、郡 × 年份趋势、市镇特征

1930–1957 年出生队列；结果变量为 1980–2012 年；子女出生于 1955–1987 年
样本

Family Health Behaviors

Itzik Fadlon and Torben Heien Nielsen · American Economic Review, 2019 · 个人

一名家庭成员遭遇严重健康冲击（如心脏病发作或中风）后，配偶和成年子女会加强自身的预防行为：更多体检、更多预防性用药以及生活方式的改变。这些反应幅度明显、立即出现且持续存在，反映的是人们对自身风险认识的更新。

数据
Prescription Drug Database (LMDB), 1995–2011, Health Insurance Registry (SSR, primary-care and specialist contacts), 1985–2011, National Patient Registry (LPR), inpatient 1980–2011 and outpatient 1994–2011, Cause of Death Registry (DAR), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA) for demographics, education and coworker links, Family links (spouses, parents–children) from population registers
关键变量
  • 处理：家庭成员首次心脏病发作或中风（非致命），或死亡（致命冲击）
  • 结果变量：开始服用他汀类及其他心血管药物
  • 结果变量：预防性医疗，如看全科医生和胆固醇检测
  • 对照组：五年后经历同样冲击的家庭
  • 暴露群体：配偶、成年亲生子女、兄弟姐妹、姻亲、同事
时期
1980–2011 年（冲击发生于 1985 至 2011 年间）
样本
非致命冲击，配偶：处理组 20,381 人、对照组 28,699 人（壮年，25–55 岁），处理组 37,828 人、对照组 36,392 人（年长，55–85 岁）；亲生子女：处理组 63,323 人、对照组 68,437 人（25–40 岁），处理组 39,783 人、对照组 32,926 人（40–65 岁） 1985 至 2011 年间首次心脏病发作或中风（或死亡）的全部丹麦人的家庭成员和关系密切的同事。 来源
变量如何定义（10）
  • Non-fatal cardiovascular shock 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    First-time heart attack or stroke (identified from the National Patient Registry, ICD diagnoses) between 1985 and 2011 where the individual survived the four-year analysis horizon (three years for stepchildren, children-in-law and coworker samples). Household matches based on period t = -1.
    登记库： LPR, Cause of Death Registry
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1-3.2
  • Fatal shock 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Death of a family member between 1985 and 2011, from the Cause of Death Registry (exact death dates and causes).
    登记库： Cause of Death Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Treatment and control groups (shock timing) 样本界定与时间
    Treated = individuals whose family member (or peer) had a shock in a calendar year; controls = individuals from the same cohorts whose family member (or peer) had the same shock five years later (Delta=5). Non-fatal sample = households in which a member had a first heart attack or stroke and survived the four-year horizon; death sample = families with a member who died 1985-2011. Alternative control group: exact match cells within calendar year on predicted cardiovascular risk of family members and lagged outcome, controls weighted by representation in cell (about 94% of controls for prime-age spouses never affected).
    登记库： National Patient Registry (LPR), Cause of Death Registry
    代码： Delta = 5 years

    Cholesterol (blood test) indicators are available only for residents of Greater Copenhagen; drug dosage information (e.g. opioid doses) is excluded for the adult-children sample under the data use agreement, so opioid dose outcomes are estimated only for spouses.
    登记库： Prescription Drug Database (LMDB)
    在线附录 · Appendix B; Appendix Table 2 and Table 7 notes
  • Urgent care contacts 医疗服务利用
    Non-hospital contacts with on-call local doctors or nurses initiated outside regular working hours (8 am to 4 pm).

  • Addiction treatment drugs and opioid doses 医疗服务利用
    Indicator for purchasing nicotine/alcohol dependence medication; prescription opioid consumption measured in WHO defined daily doses (DDD), i.e. prescription day equivalents (spouses only, dosage data excluded for adult children).
    登记库： LMDB
    代码： ATC N07BA, N07BB (dependence treatment)
    工作论文 · Section 4.2, footnotes 29, 32
  • Family circles (spouses, children, siblings, stepchildren, in-laws) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Spouses = all married and cohabiting couples linked before the shock; adult children only for individuals born after 1960 (when parent links are available); children-in-law = spouses of the adult children of the shocked parent; 'nearby in-laws' = children-in-law living closer than the median distance to the parents-in-law; former spouses = linked by marriage or cohabitation in period -5 but not in period -1.

Universal Investment in Infants and Long-Run Health: Evidence from Denmark's 1937 Home Visiting Program

Jonas Hjort, Mikkel Sølvsten and Miriam Wüst · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2017 · 个人

利用 1937 年普惠性婴儿家访计划在各市镇的分批推行，并在登记库中追踪受处理的出生队列直至中年。受处理者在 45 至 64 岁之间的存活率更高，住院夜数更少，心血管疾病更少，这与生命早期的营养和疾病环境对成年健康具有“编程”作用的观点相一致。

Happy Doctor Makes Happy Baby? Incentivizing Physicians Improves Quality of Prenatal Care

Vibeke Myrup Jensen · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2014 · 个人

利用 1987 年的一项改革：该改革把哥本哈根市全科医生的合同从纯按人头付费改为丹麦其他地区采用的按人头付费与按服务项目付费相结合的混合合同；作者在双重差分设计中将当地的头胎婴儿与周边哥本哈根郡（Copenhagen County）的头胎婴儿进行比较。母亲在按人头付费合同下怀孕的婴儿出生体重更低、早产更多、Apgar 评分更低。这些效应主要来自较年轻的母亲。

数据
Birth records (medical records) for a 15% random sample of firstborn infants born 1982–1992: birth date, birth weight, gestation, Apgar scores, mother's age and previous stillbirths (the working paper does not name the register), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Statistics Denmark: parental education, earnings, occupation, marital status, country of birth; GP income via workplace identifiers, Municipality of residence (treatment and control areas), GP service records for a 5% sample of women, 1997–1999 (descriptive table on prenatal services only)
关键变量
  • 处理：在纯按人头付费的全科医生合同下怀孕（1987 年 10 月 1 日改革前的哥本哈根市）
  • 对照组：哥本哈根郡（Copenhagen County），当地全科医生始终采用按人头付费与按服务项目付费相结合的混合合同
  • 结果变量：出生体重、低出生体重（低于 2,500 g）、早产（第 37 周之前）、胎儿生长
  • 结果变量：1 分钟和 5 分钟 Apgar 评分等于 10
  • 异质性：母亲年龄（26 岁及以下与 26 岁以上）
  • 控制变量：父母的受教育程度、收入、婚姻状况和族裔；市镇固定效应
时期
出生于 1982–1992 年（改革日期为 1987 年 10 月 1 日）
样本
出生体重回归中 9,239 名头胎婴儿，Apgar 评分回归中 9,272 名（工作论文表 3） 1982–1992 年出生、母亲居住在哥本哈根市（Copenhagen、Frederiksberg、Taarnby 和 Dragoer 四个市镇）或哥本哈根郡（Copenhagen County）相邻市镇的头胎婴儿，取自头胎婴儿的 15% 随机样本。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Treatment and control areas and periods 样本界定与时间
    Treatment area is Copenhagen city (municipalities of Copenhagen, Frederiksberg, Taarnby and Dragoer), where GPs shifted on 1 October 1987 from pure capitation to the mixed contract used elsewhere in Denmark (one third capitation, two thirds fee-for-service). The control area is the adjacent municipalities of Copenhagen County. The policy dummy equals one for the period when Copenhagen city GPs were on capitation contracts; periods are defined by date of conception and date of birth (conceived and born 1982-1987 versus 1988-1992).
    登记库： Birth records (medical records; register not named in the working paper), Municipality of residence
    代码： Reform date 1 October 1987; birth years 1982-1992
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1, 5.1 and 7.2 (incl. footnote 7)
  • Firstborn sample and parental link 样本界定与时间
    Medical records from a 15% random sample of firstborn infants born 1982-1992, with exact birth date, infant health measures and information on the mother such as age and previous stillbirths. Infant records are matched by unique social security numbers to parental background (educational attainment, earnings, occupation, marital status, country of birth, birth date) from the Integrated Database for Labour Market Research maintained by Statistics Denmark.
    登记库： Birth records (medical records; register not named in the working paper), IDA
    代码： 15% random sample; firstborns only; birth years 1982-1992
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Low birth weight, preterm birth and foetal growth 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Birth weight is observed in ten-gram intervals; low birth weight is a dummy using the WHO threshold of 2,500 grams. Gestation is measured in weeks and converted into a binary for preterm birth using the WHO definition of less than 37 full weeks. Foetal growth is birth weight in grams divided by weeks of gestation.
    登记库： Birth records (medical records; register not named in the working paper)
    代码： Low birth weight: below 2500 gram; preterm: born before 37th week
    工作论文 · Section 4.1; Table 1 notes
  • Apgar score (one and five minutes) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    The APGAR score sums five criteria (Appearance, Pulse, Grimace, Activity, Respiration), each scored zero, one or two, evaluated one and five minutes after birth. Both measures are converted into dummies equal to one for the best possible health condition (score equal to 10).
    登记库： Birth records (medical records; register not named in the working paper)
    代码： Dummy = 1 if score = 10
    工作论文 · Section 4.1; Table 1 notes
  • GP gross annual income 劳动收入与收入
    GP income is found using the workplace identifier from 1992, because GP workplace identifiers are pooled with all other types of health practice until 1992; GP workplaces are tracked back from 1992 to 1980 and income is taken for all persons with a medical degree working at the GP workplace in the given year (22,650 person-years). Tabulated conditional on GP age and tenure and on county, municipality and church tax.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Figure 1 notes

移民、社区与难民

把难民分散安置当作准随机分配，移民对本国出生者的影响，以及福利削减。

Taxing Top Wealth: Migration Responses and Their Aggregate Economic Implications

Katrine Jakobsen, Henrik Kleven, Jonas Kolsrud, Camille Landais and Mathilde Muñoz · American Economic Review, 2026 · 个人

估计富人的国际迁移对财富税的反应，主要依据 2007 年瑞典废除财富税这一事件，并用丹麦的两次财富税改革（1989 年和 1997 年）来验证迁出弹性、估计迁入反应。最高财富税率每提高一个百分点，富裕纳税人的存量约减少 2%。瑞典的事件研究显示，富有的所有者移居国外后其企业会收缩，但对就业、投资和增加值的总体影响很小。

数据
Denmark (validation and in-migration analysis only): wealth and income registers based on Danish Tax Agency (SKAT) tax returns, with year-end third-party and self-reported wealth components, Denmark: CPR-based citizenship and migration records with daily dates of entry and exit, Denmark: longitudinal register data on earnings, transfers and demographics, 1989–2006, Sweden (main analysis, not Danish): wealth tax register (Förmögenhetsregistret) 1993–2007, LISA, RAMS employer-employee data, K10 closely-held firm ownership files, firm financial accounts and migration registers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：按财富排名划分的迁出率和迁入率
  • 处理（丹麦）：1989 年财富税率由 2.2% 降至 1%，1997 年废除财富税；财富最高 1% 与最高 5–2.5% 的比较
  • 处理（瑞典）：2007 年废除财富税
  • 估计对象：迁移率对财富税后留存率的半弹性
  • 结果变量（仅瑞典）：迁出的富有所有者所持企业的就业、投资、增加值和税收
时期
丹麦：迁出序列为 1980–2006 年，财富税年份为 1989–1996 年；瑞典：1993–2007 年的财富登记库，与截至 2017–2019 年的各登记库相链接
样本
所查资料中未注明 丹麦部分为 1989 年和 1997 年财富税改革前后财富分布最高 1% 的纳税人（处理组）以及介于最高 5% 与最高 2.5% 之间的纳税人（对照组）；主样本为全体瑞典家庭，重点关注财富最高的 2%。 来源
变量如何定义（4）
  • Danish wealth-tax reforms: treatment and control groups 样本界定与时间
    Out-of-sample validation of the Swedish estimates. In 1989 the marginal tax rate on wealth above the exemption threshold was reduced from 2.2% to 1%, phased in over three years; in 1997 the wealth tax was abolished. Individuals in the top 1% of the wealth distribution form the treatment group and individuals between the top 5% and top 2.5% form the control group; out-migration rates of the two groups are compared over 1980-2006 and semi-elasticities are estimated with the same specification (4) as for Sweden.
    登记库： Wealth tax register (SKAT tax returns), CPR migration records
    代码： Treated: top 1% of wealth; controls: top 5% to top 2.5%; reforms 1989 and 1997
    工作论文 · Section 5.3 and footnote 32; Appendix V.2 and Figure V.6
  • Danish wealth data 财富、负债与消费
    Wealth and income registries are based on tax return data from the Danish Tax Agency (SKAT), stated at the end of the year. Most components are third-party reported (cash value of real estate, deposits, bonds, shares). Until 1997 self-reported components subject to auditing are also observed: value of listed and non-listed stocks, durables (cars, boats, caravans), share certificates for housing cooperatives, premium bonds and cash holdings. Liabilities include debt in financial institutions, mortgage credit debt, credit and debit card debt, student debt and other liabilities. After 1997 the asset statement is based solely on third-party reporting. Closely-held businesses and unlisted shares are not observed, so firm outcomes of migrants cannot be tracked in Denmark.
    登记库： Wealth tax register (SKAT tax returns)
    工作论文 · Appendix II.3 and Appendix Table II.1; footnote 24
  • Out-migration and in-migration rates by wealth 移民身份与来源地
    Citizenship and migration information with daily dates of entry and exit comes from the CPR; individuals must register their move to the CPR office to stop paying taxes in Denmark. For out-migration rates, individuals are ranked by household net wealth in year t and the fraction who out-migrate in t+1 is computed for each wealth fractile; for in-migration rates, individuals are ranked by household net wealth in year t and the fraction who in-migrated in t-1 is computed. Descriptive statistics for Denmark cover 1989-1996, when the wealth tax was still in place. Wealth of arrivals is measured consistently before and after the reforms, which is why in-migration elasticities are estimated on Danish data.
    登记库： CPR migration records, Wealth tax register (SKAT tax returns)
    代码： Denmark: 1989-1996
    工作论文 · Section 3.2 and notes to Figure 2; Section 5.4; Appendix II.3
  • Danish wealth tax 税收与税率
    Annual progressive wealth tax levied from 1903 to 1997 on Danish tax residents with net taxable wealth above an exemption threshold, which was always above the 98th percentile of the wealth distribution in the study period. Taxable wealth was total household net wealth excluding pension wealth: cash, deposits, bonds, equities, housing, large durables and business assets, net of debts. Wealth above the threshold was taxed at a flat 2.2% until the rate was cut to 1% after 1989; the tax was repealed in 1997. Unlike in Sweden, business assets were included in the base (with valuation reliefs for physical business assets), and a tax ceiling capped the wealth tax as a fraction of taxable income.
    代码： 2.2% above the exemption threshold; 1% after 1989; repealed 1997
    工作论文 · Section 2.2; Appendix I.2 and Appendix Table II.1

Sick of Your Poor Neighborhood? Quasi-Experimental Evidence on Neighborhood Effects on Health

Linea Hasager and Mia Jørgensen · Journal of Public Economics, 2026 · 个人

利用 1986 至 1998 年难民在丹麦各社区间的准随机分散安置。被安置在低收入社区的难民在 8 至 15 年后罹患生活方式相关疾病的风险高出 12%，其驱动因素是邻居和当地环境，而非医疗可及性、族裔网络或劳动力市场结果。

数据
National Patient Register (LPR), Health Insurance Register (SYSI, SSSY), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Income register (IND), Population register (BEF) and address/mobility registers (BEFBOP, BEFADR), Migration register (VNDS), Criminal convictions register (KRAF), O*NET occupational data merged via occupation codes
关键变量
  • 处理：在 1986–1998 年难民分散安置政策（Refugee Spatial Dispersal Policy）下被分配到收入处于最低三分之一而非最高三分之一的堂区（以社区家庭可支配收入中位数衡量）
  • 结果变量：移民后 2–15 年和 8–15 年内确诊生活方式相关疾病（循环系统疾病、营养/代谢疾病、COPD、髋关节病、酒精相关疾病）
  • 结果变量：精神障碍诊断
  • 机制：医疗可及性、就业和劳动收入、邻居特征
时期
1985–2017 年（难民于 1986–1998 年抵达）
样本
21,965 名难民 来自九个难民来源国、抵达时年龄为 18–64 岁、于 1986–1998 年抵达丹麦并在分散安置政策下被分配到某一市镇的难民（不含家庭团聚的配偶）。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Lifestyle-related disease diagnosis 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicator for any primary or secondary hospital diagnosis (inpatient or outpatient, National Patient Register; ICD-8 before 1994, ICD-10 after) within 2-15 years, or within 8-15 years, after immigration in one of: circulatory diseases (hypertension, ischaemic heart diseases, pulmonary diseases, other heart disease, cerebrovascular and arterial diseases), nutritional/endocrine/metabolic diseases (diabetes type I and II, obesity, elevated cholesterol), COPD, hip arthrosis, and alcohol-related diseases. Exact code grouping is in Online Appendix Section B (not accessed).
    登记库： LPR
    工作论文 · Section I (data), footnotes 17-19
  • Mental disorder diagnosis 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicator for a hospital diagnosis 2-15 or 8-15 years after immigration of mental and behavioural disorders due to psychoactive substance use; schizophrenia, schizotypal and delusional disorders; mood (affective) disorders; neurotic, stress-related and somatoform disorders; behavioural syndromes associated with physiological disturbances; and disorders of adult personality and behaviour.
    登记库： LPR
    工作论文 · Section I, footnote 20
  • Neighbourhood income group (parish) 地理与社区
    Neighbourhood = parish (alternatives: municipality, apartment building). Each year, neighbourhoods are ranked by median household disposable income per adult household member (Income Register, CPI-deflated to 2000) and split into thirds: bottom (below 33rd percentile), middle (34th-66th), top (67th-100th); groups are recomputed every year for all neighbourhoods.
    登记库： IND, BEF
    工作论文 · Section I, footnote 25
  • Assignment neighbourhood 地理与社区
    Neighbourhood of the refugee's address on 1 January in the year after immigration, to capture permanent resettlement rather than temporary accommodation.
    登记库： BEFBOP, BEFADR
    工作论文 · Section II (identification), p. ~14
  • Refugee (dispersal policy) sample 移民身份与来源地
    Immigrants arriving 1986-1998 from Afghanistan, Ethiopia, Iran, Iraq, Lebanon, Palestine (stateless), Sri Lanka and Vietnam (1986-1998) or Somalia (1989-1998), aged 18-64 at arrival; former Yugoslavs excluded; excludes those married at arrival to a non-refugee partner or to a refugee partner who arrived earlier (family reunification).
    登记库： VNDS, BEF
    工作论文 · Section I, footnotes 14-16
  • Employment as fraction of full working year 就业与劳动力状态
    Fraction of a full-time working year employed: 1 if full-time employee during the whole year, less than one for part-time or part-year employment.
    登记库： IDA, IND
    工作论文 · Section I (labour market outcomes)
  • Annual gross earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Annual gross earnings from tax returns in the Income Register, CPI-deflated to 2000 and converted to USD at the 27 March 2020 exchange rate.

  • Occupational task content 职业与职位层级

  • GP and psychologist visits 医疗服务利用

Permanent Residency and Refugee Immigrants' Skill Investment

Jacob Nielsen Arendt, Christian Dustmann and Hyejin Ku · Journal of Labor Economics, 2025 · 个人

丹麦的一项改革提高了难民获得永久居留权所须满足的就业和语言要求。改革非但没有鼓励投资，反而降低了总体就业，语言水平也几乎没有变化，因为改革前前景较差的难民在要求看似遥不可及时减少了努力。

数据
Population, income, education and immigration registers linked via the Central Person Registry, Danish language test results, Employment in annual full-time equivalents (register data)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：以全职当量计的年就业量
  • 结果变量：通过中级或更高级别的丹麦语考试
  • 处理：2004 年 1–10 月获得临时居留（受 2007 年永久居留改革影响）与 2003 年 1–10 月获得者相比
  • 异质性：改革前的就业或语言表现类型
  • 时间：获得临时居留以来的年数（YSR 1–7）
时期
2003–2004 年居留队列，自获得临时居留起追踪七年（至 2011 年）
样本
767 名不同个人；5,122 个人年观测值 2002 年 2 月 28 日之后申请庇护、并在 2003 年 1–10 月（对照组）或 2004 年 1–10 月（处理组）获得临时居留的 18–64 岁难民。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Annual employment in full-time equivalents 就业与劳动力状态
    Employment in annual full-time equivalents (FTE = 1 for a full year of work), from a register variable recording cumulative employment in a calendar year, observed for everyone in Denmark on 1 January. For YSR = 1 only, FTE can exceed 1 because the cumulative variable includes work in the year residency was granted.
    登记库： Income registers, CPR
    论文正文 · Section 5 'Data on Refugee Immigrants' and footnote 17
  • Danish language proficiency 教育与考试成绩
    Indicator for having passed the standard Danish language test at the intermediate or higher level (test levels: basic, intermediate, high); observed from YSR = 1; passing is treated as absorbing, so the person counts as proficient at that level in all later periods.
    登记库： Danish language test results
    论文正文 · Section 4, footnote 13; Section 5
  • Treatment and control cohorts 样本界定与时间
    Refugees who applied for asylum after 28 February 2002 and were aged 18-64 when granted temporary residency; treatment = temporary residency granted January-October 2004 (exposed to the 1 May 2007 permanent-residency reform), control = January-October 2003.
    登记库： Immigration registers, BEF
    论文正文 · Sections 2, 4 and 5
  • Years since residency (YSR) 样本界定与时间
    For persons granted temporary residency during year y, YSR = 1 is year y+1 (first full calendar year with employment observed as of 1 January), followed for seven years (YSR 1-7).
    登记库： Immigration registers
    论文正文 · Section 4 and Section 5
  • Pre-reform employment performance type 就业与劳动力状态
    HIGH if cumulative employment by YSR = 2 is above 0.75 FTE, otherwise LOW (20% HIGH, 80% LOW). The reform's requirement is 2.5 FTE of cumulative employment.
    登记库： Income registers
    论文正文 · Section 5, 'Classifying workers into performance types'
  • Pre-reform language performance type 教育与考试成绩
    HIGH if the person had passed the Danish language test at the intermediate level or higher by YSR = 2 (about 16%), otherwise LOW; combined with employment type into LOW/LOW, LOW/HIGH, etc.
    登记库： Danish language test results
    论文正文 · Section 5, 'Classifying workers into performance types'
  • Matched native comparison group 样本界定与时间
    Danish natives selected by propensity-score matching to treated (control) refugees on YSR = 1 employment (2005 for treated, 2004 for control), age, gender, being single, having any children and county of residence (initial assignment county for refugees), used in a triple-difference check for the 2009 recession.
    登记库： BEF, Income registers
    论文正文 · Section 6.3 'Comparison with natives'

Background Matters, but Not Whether Parents Are Immigrants: Outcomes of Children Born in Denmark

Mathias Fjællegaard Jensen and Alan Manning · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2025 · 个人

在丹麦出生、父母为移民的子女，与父母为丹麦出生者的子女相比，劳动收入更低、失业更多、受教育更少、领取的转移支付更多、被定罪也更多。但在控制父母的社会经济特征之后，他们的表现与后者持平甚至略好，可见这些差距反映的是贫困的家庭背景，而不是父母的移民身份。

数据
Danish register data linking children to parents (Statistics Denmark, 1980–2017), Income and earnings registers (annual labour income incl. self-employment, transfers), Monthly employment register (hours, hourly wages, from 2008), Education registers (incl. survey-based registration of foreign education of immigrants), Criminal justice registers (convictions, prison sentences, dropped charges / not-guilty verdicts), Occupation codes (ISCO88)

  • 分组：出生在丹麦境外的父母人数（0、1、2；格陵兰／法罗群岛）

  • 控制变量：子女童年时期父母的收入、失业年数、职业和教育
时期
1980–2017
样本
396,417 名子女（表 1 合计）；其中父母均为丹麦出生者 362,460 人，父母均为移民 10,399 人，父母一方为移民 20,908 人，父母一方来自格陵兰／法罗群岛 2,650 人 1980–1987 年出生在丹麦、父母双方信息均已知的全部子女，追踪至 30 岁。 来源
调查
Foreign-education survey

  • Child sample 样本界定与时间
    Everyone born in Denmark 1980-1987 with both parents known in BEF and known parental origin. Observed in the year they turn 30, kept only if fully liable to pay taxes in Denmark (AKM register) and resident in Denmark (BEF). Children missing any outcome or control are dropped (missing parental occupation and education allowed), as are children whose parents were not in the population at birth.

Cyprus) and non-EU (incl. Yugoslavia).

Refugee Benefit Cuts

Christian Dustmann, Rasmus Landersø and Lars Højsgaard Andersen · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2024 · 个人

2002 年的一项改革把新抵达难民的福利给付削减了大约一半。就业在短期内小幅上升，随后消退，而可支配收入大幅下降。这次削减提高了成年人的犯罪率，并损害了儿童的入学和学业结果。

  • 结果变量：就业、劳动收入、转移支付收入和可支配收入
  • 结果变量：犯罪定罪（财产犯罪）

Linea Hasager · Journal of Public Economics, 2024 · 个人

通过家庭团聚进入丹麦的女性，所持居留许可通常以维持婚姻为条件。给予她们独立的难民身份改善了其经济融入，提高了离婚率，并降低了她们遭受暴力的风险，这与居留不确定性下降和议价能力增强的解释一致。

数据
Admission register on immigrant status and residence permit application/approval dates (Danish Immigration Service data via Statistics Denmark), Labour market data from the Danish tax authorities (employment; hours and earnings from 2008), Police registers on victimisation and criminal convictions, Hospital admissions data (National Patient Register) for assault injuries, Central population register (BEF) for demographics, spouse links and divorce
关键变量

  • 结果变量：季度就业、工作小时数和劳动收入
  • 结果变量：遭受暴力侵害（警方记录或因袭击住院）
  • 结果变量：离婚
  • 设计：交错双重差分，以尚未接受处理的女性为对照组
时期
2001–2019 年（工时和劳动收入自 2008 年起）
样本
1,349 名成年女性 2001 至 2017 年间以家庭团聚方式来到丹麦与难民配偶团聚、其后申请并获得本人难民身份的 18 岁及以上女性。 来源

    Adult women (18+) admitted 2001-2017 as family-reunified to a refugee spouse who later apply for and obtain their own asylum (UN Convention, de facto/B-status or temporary protection), identified from application and approval dates of residence permits in the admission register; event time is the quarter of asylum recognition. Controls are not-yet-treated women recognized at most three years later; women followed from 3 years before to 1.5 years after recognition.
    登记库： Admission register (Danish Immigration Service, via Statistics Denmark)

  • Violent victimization 犯罪
    Quarterly indicator equal to one if police records show the woman was a victim of violence or sexual assault, or if she was hospitalized due to assault based on physician classification of injury (following Aizer 2010); captures mainly severe cases and also non-partner violence.
    登记库： Police registers on victimization, National Patient Register (hospital admissions)

Replication package

Neighbourhood Gangs, Crime Spillovers and Teenage Motherhood

Christian Dustmann, Mikkel Mertz and Anna Okatenko · Economic Journal, 2023 · 个人

利用 1986 至 1998 年间难民被随机分配到各市镇这一安排。分配所在社区的帮派犯罪提高了男孩在 19 岁前犯罪的概率和女孩少女生育的概率，并带来持久后果：在 19 至 28 岁，男性更多处于非经济活动状态，女性劳动收入更低、领取福利更多。

数据
Immigration register, Annual population registers (BEF), Central Police Register (criminal charges and convictions), Education registers (including survey-based register of immigrants' education), Income registers and register-based labour force statistics (RAS), National Patient Register (abortions)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：少女生育（15–18 岁期间生育子女）；男孩的青少年犯罪定罪
  • 处理：分配当年所在市镇 15–25 岁男性的团伙（帮派）犯罪定罪率
  • 识别：1986–1998 年分散安置政策下难民被准随机分配到各市镇
  • 长期结果变量：劳动收入、就业、教育
时期
难民分配为 1986–1998 年；人口登记库为 1980–2019 年
样本
8,172 名被分配的难民儿童；少女生育估计样本中有 3,792 名女孩 来自八个难民来源国、1986 至 1998 年间在 0–14 岁时被分配到丹麦各市镇的难民儿童，逐年观测至 19 岁。 来源
调查
Foreign-education survey
变量如何定义（9）
  • Convictions (guilty cases) 犯罪
    Judicial decisions 1980-2018 from the conviction register; for each person-case (journr) the final decision is kept (appeals), and a case counts as guilty unless the decision type is acquittal or dismissal. Offences are classified by 7-digit offence code into violent/sexual, property, drug, other and traffic, and traffic offences are dropped; the date of the offence comes from the charge register.
    登记库： KRAF (conviction register), KRSI (charge register)
    代码： AFG_AFGTYP3 in 514, 411, 412, 413, 414 = acquitted/dismissed (else guilty); AFG_GER7: sexual and violent 1110505-1180705 and 1210501-1292520; property 1304505-1398590; drug 1435505-1440505 and 3210505-3210510; other 1410303-1430740, 1445705-1485720, 3410505-3410509, 3610105-3870505 (residual non-missing also other); traffic 2110005-2610180 (dropped)
    复制代码 · do/build/clean/convictions.do
  • Group (gang) crime conviction 犯罪
    A conviction for a gang-type offence in a case where more than one person is convicted (gang_crime_3 requires at least three). Gang-type offences are non-sexual violence, arson/robbery-type property offences, drug offences and weapons offences; a case is gang-type if anyone in the case is convicted of a gang-type offence.
    登记库： KRAF
    代码： gang type: 2-digit AFG_GER7 (floor(ger7/100000)) == 12; 4-digit (floor(ger7/1000)) in 1312, 1339, 1380, 1390, 1435, 1440, 3410; 7-digit in 1366505, 1445750, 1445777-1445782, 3210510; gang_crime = N convicted in journr > 1 & gang type
    复制代码 · do/build/clean/convictions.do
  • Municipal youth (gang) crime conviction rate 犯罪
    Per municipality and year: number of male residents aged 15-25 (calendar year minus birth year between 15 and 26) with at least one conviction (resp. gang-crime conviction) for an offence committed that year at age above 14 and below 27, divided by the number of such male residents, times 100. Offences from 2017 onward or before 1980 are dropped.
    登记库： KRAF, KRSI, BEF
    代码： sh_g (gang), sh_nc (overall); KOEN==1 for men; KOM municipality
    复制代码 · do/build/prepare/kom_year_n_criminals.do
  • Assigned refugee (dispersal-policy sample) 移民身份与来源地
    Immigrants arriving 1986-1998 from refugee-sending countries (Balkan origins excluded as covered by a different placement policy), with some countries restricted by arrival year; the household head at immigration is identified via father, mother (if under 18) or spouse links, and individuals arriving more than a year after the household head, or with a gap of more than one year between immigration and first appearance in the registers, are dropped.
    登记库： BEF, Immigration register (date of immigration)
    代码： IELAND: Iraq 5436; Iran 5438 (arrival>=1980); Vietnam 5468, 5488; Sri Lanka 5418 (>=1984); stateless Lebanon 5103, 5456, 5473; Ethiopia 5214 (<1991); Afghanistan 5404; Somalia 5289 (>=1989); keep refugee_ieland<=8
    复制代码 · do/build/prepare/assigned_refugees.do
  • Assignment municipality 地理与社区
    The first municipality (KOM) in which the household head at assignment is observed in the population registers after immigration; children assigned to a different municipality than their household head are dropped, and Copenhagen assignment is KOM 101.
    登记库： BEF
    代码： first_kom = kom[1]; copenhagen = KOM 101
    复制代码 · do/build/prepare/assigned_refugees.do; sample_girls_15_20_at_assignment.do
  • Teenage motherhood 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Date of first birth is the earliest birth date among children linked to the woman through the mother ID (PNRM) in the population registers; teenage motherhood (mother_1518) equals 1 if the first birth occurs at age at least 14 and below 19 (commented 'had a child by age 19'). For girls aged 15-20 at assignment, motherhood within 4 years of assignment is used, dropping those whose first birth is within 280 days of immigration.
    登记库： BEF
    代码： PNRM (mother ID); mother_1518 = (date_first_birth - date_birth)/365.25 in [14,19)
    复制代码 · do/build/clean/pnr_date_first_two_births.do; do/build/prepare/kids_by_age.do; sample_girls_15_20_at_assignment.do
  • Abortion 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicator for an abortion diagnosis in the National Patient Register 1980-2014 (medical, other, unspecified and failed attempted abortion), attached to refugee girls.
    登记库： LPR
    代码： ICD-10 (DIAG first 4 chars) DO04, DO05, DO06, DO07
    复制代码 · do/build/prepare/abortion.do
  • Labour market status (employed / unemployed / not in labour force) 就业与劳动力状态
    Primary labour market status in the last week of November from RAS, with code schemes varying by year.
    登记库： RAS
    代码： 1981-1993 ARBSTIL: employed 11-39, unemployed 40, NILF 50-92 (1990+ keep NOVPRIO==1); 1994-1995 NYARB: employed 11-39, unemployed 40, NILF 41-400; 1996-2007 SOCSTIL_KODE: employed 115-199, unemployed 200, NILF 201-400; 2008-2015 SOC_STATUS_KODE (PRIMAER_STATUS_KODE==1): employed 110-138, 611, 612, unemployed 200, NILF 311-517
    复制代码 · do/build/clean/pool_ras_for_lm_status.do
  • Long-run income and education outcomes 劳动收入与收入
    For assigned refugee children 1987-2018, income outcomes are taken from the income register over the full year and education from the education registers (measured in October of the year prior), with employment taken from RAS for November of the previous year.
    登记库： IND, UDDA, UDDANY, RAS
    代码： IND: PERINDKIALT_13, LOENMV_13, ERHVERVSINDK_13, STIP, OFF_OVERFORSEL_13, NETOVSKUD_13; UDDA: HFAUDD; RAS ARBSTIL 11-37 employed, 40 unemployed (pre-1994)
    复制代码 · do/build/prepare/Refugee_income.do

Replication package

Intergenerational Spillover Effects of Language Training for Refugees

Mette Foged, Linea Hasager, Giovanni Peri, Jacob Nielsen Arendt and Iben Bolvig · Journal of Public Economics, 2023 · 个人

追踪受 1999 年丹麦改善语言培训的改革影响的难民的子女。处理组父母的子女取得了更好的教育结果，表明语言培训带来的融入收益会延续到下一代。

数据
Danish administrative registers from Statistics Denmark on refugees' asylum/admission dates and parent–child links, Lower secondary school completion and final exam records, Criminal conviction records (property, violent, narcotics crime), Earnings, occupation (ISCO), disposable income, marriage and fertility registers for parents
关键变量
  • 驱动变量：父母获准居留（获批庇护）的日期相对于 1999 年 1 月 1 日的位置（Integration Act 语言培训改革）
  • 结果变量：18 岁前完成初中学业并参加毕业考试
  • 结果变量：15 至 18 岁之间的刑事定罪
  • 父母的结果变量：年劳动收入、从事复杂工作、可支配收入、定罪
时期
1990–2001 年出生的儿童，追踪至 2019 年；父母的结果变量为 1999–2016 年
样本
6,467 名儿童；5,197 名成年父母 1990–2001 年出生、父母中至少一方在 1999 年 1 月 1 日前后的四年窗口内在丹麦获批庇护、并在小学学龄之前或期间抵达的儿童。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Treatment / running variable: parent's admission date 移民身份与来源地
    A child is treated if the first parent was granted refugee status (admission date) on or after 1 January 1999, when the Integration Act's language training applied. The running variable is days between the admission date and the cutoff; specifications using the father's admission date are also reported.
    登记库： Danish administrative registers (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section IV (eq. 1)
  • Child sample 样本界定与时间
    Children born 1990-2001 with at least one parent granted asylum in Denmark within a four-year window around 1 January 1999. Children were born in the first three years after the reform or were of pre-school or primary-school age on arrival. They are followed to age 18, through 2019; 6,467 children with parents born 1948-1982.
    登记库： Danish administrative registers (parent-child links)
    工作论文 · Section III (Data), footnote 8
  • Lower secondary completion and final exam 教育与考试成绩
    Two indicators: the child completed lower secondary (compulsory) school by age 18 (before turning 19), and the child took the final exams marking the end of lower secondary school. Exemption from the exams, e.g. for low language proficiency, is possible.
    登记库： Education registers
    工作论文 · Section III, footnote 9; Section V, Table 3
  • Child criminal convictions ages 15-18 犯罪
    Indicator for any criminal conviction between ages 15 and 18, and separate indicators for property, violent and narcotics crime.
    登记库： Criminal conviction records
    工作论文 · Section III; Table 3
  • Complex job (parents) 职业与职位层级
    Indicator for working in an occupation from managers (ISCO 1) to services and sales workers (ISCO 5), jobs that require some schooling and technical knowledge, or literacy and good communication skills.
    登记库： Occupation register
    代码： ISCO major groups 1-5 = complex
    工作论文 · Section III (Data)
  • Parental earnings and disposable income 劳动收入与收入
    Annual gross earnings in year-2000 prices converted to USD at 6.6 DKK/USD. Disposable income includes public transfers net of taxes, deflated to year-2000 USD.
    登记库： Income registers
    工作论文 · Section III and III.A
  • Parental marriage and fertility 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator for marrying a Danish citizen, and total number of children born after admission.
    登记库： Population/family registers
    工作论文 · Section III (Data)

The Impact of Immigration on Firm-Level Offshoring

William W. Olney and Dario Pozzoli · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2021 · 个人 + 企业

以丹麦的难民分散安置政策为自然实验，使用 1995 至 2011 年全部企业和工人的匹配数据。移民外生流入某一市镇会在两个边际上减少企业层面的离岸外包，而移民与其来源国的联系则会增加对这些特定国家的离岸外包。

数据
Firm Statistics Register (FirmStat), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Firm-Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (FIDA), Foreign Trade Statistics Register: Intrastat and Extrastat firm-level imports (UHDI), Central Business Register (foreign ownership)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：离岸外包的广延边际（企业进口与自身产品属于同一 HS4 类别的产品）
  • 结果变量：狭义离岸外包规模的对数
  • 处理：非欧盟移民占市镇劳动力的份额
  • 工具变量：1986–1998 年空间分散安置政策（Spatial Dispersal Policy）下的难民安置（shift-share）
时期
1995–2011
样本
约 35,000 家企业和 100 万名工人 1995–2011 年 97 个市镇中雇员超过一人的丹麦私营部门企业的非平衡面板。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Narrow offshoring (volume and extensive margin) 贸易与离岸外包
    Sum of a firm's imports (Foreign Trade Statistics, Intrastat/Extrastat, 1995-2011) in the same product category as the firm's production (paper: same HS4 category; code: import product code equals the firm's export product code or domestic-production product code). Extensive margin = 1 if narrow offshoring > 0; intensive margin = log of narrow offshoring volume. Broad offshoring = all imports.
    登记库： UHDI (Foreign Trade Statistics: Intrastat/Extrastat), VARES (vars, firm product sales), FirmStat
    代码： uhdi ie=='1' imports, ie=='2' exports; product vare (8-digit CN) -> HS4_imp=int(vare/100), HS4_exp=int(vare/100); vars varenr -> HS4_dom_1=int(varenr/10000); narrow=(HS6_imp==HS6_exp | HS6_imp==HS6_dom_1); ext_narrow_off=(narrow_off>0); int_narrow_off=ln(narrow_off)
    复制代码 · Trade_data.sas; offshoring_project_will_dario.do (narrow offshoring block); working paper Section 3 and fn. 23
  • Non-EU immigrant share of municipality workforce 移民身份与来源地
    Share of workers in a municipality-year (IDA, workplace municipality akom) who are not natives, where natives are ie_type=='1' (Danish origin) or born in an EU15 country; lagged one year in regressions. 97 municipalities (Copenhagen and Frederiksberg combined; pre-2007 municipalities recoded to post-reform codes).
    登记库： IDA, ie_type (immigrant type/origin from BEF)
    代码： ie_type=='1' native; opr_land (ieland) EU15 codes 5126,5130,5180,5134,5142,5150,5108,5140,5156,5164,5170,5182,5104,5120 treated as natives; foreigner_nonEU=(natives!=1)
    复制代码 · offshoring_project_will_dario.do (lines ~139-150, 216-245); working paper fn. 17
  • Shift-share instrument (predicted non-EU immigrant share) 移民身份与来源地
    For each origin country d, the national number of immigrants in year t is allocated to municipalities using the municipality's 1990 share of immigrants from d, summed over non-EU origins and normalized by municipality total employment in 1990.
    登记库： IDA (1990 extract idapall_eer_1990)
    代码： F_hat_cmt=s_cm88*F_ct; s_hat=F_hat_no_eu/P_m88
    复制代码 · iv_card_1990_off_aggr.do; working paper Section 4 (IV equation)
  • Skill groups and years of education 教育与考试成绩
    From the first two digits of the highest completed education code (HFFSP): skill1 (medium) if 15, 20, 25, 35 or 40; skill2 (high) if 50, 60, 65 or 70; otherwise low (incl. missing). Years of education: 10->6, 15/35->10, 20/25/39->12, 40->14, 50/60->15, 65->17, 70->20, missing->6.
    登记库： IDA, UDDA
    代码： edu=substr(hffsp,1,2)
    复制代码 · offshoring_project_will_dario.do (lines ~59-80)
  • Managers, middle managers and blue-collar workers 职业与职位层级
    Sample restricted to wage earners with IDA occupational position PSTILL 31-37; manager if PSTILL=31, middle level if 32-34, blue collar otherwise.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： pstill 31-37; manager: 31; ml: 32,33,34; bc=(manager==0 & ml==0)
    复制代码 · Program_to_create_stata_data.sas; offshoring_project_will_dario.do
  • Labour productivity, capital intensity, size 企业特征与生产率
    Labour productivity = ln(sales / employees); capital intensity = ln(capital / employees) with capital from FirmStat GF_EGUL (1999+) or GF_E_GUL (before 1999); size dummies 1-19, 20-49, 50+ employees (fansh). Firms with fewer than 2 employees, missing productivity/capital, or in group bra==2 (NACE 35) dropped; sample 1995-2011.
    登记库： FirmStat
    代码： GF_OMS (sales), GF_EGUL/GF_E_GUL, fansh
    复制代码 · offshoring_project_will_dario.do (firm-level controls block); Program_to_create_stata_data.sas; WP fn. 15
  • Foreign ownership 企业特征与生产率
    Firm is foreign-owned if its Central Business Register ownership-form code takes one of the listed values (lagged one year in regressions).
    登记库： Central Business Register (foreign_ownership.dta)
    代码： GF_VIRKFKOD in 160,170,180,190,196,200,210,220,290,291
    复制代码 · offshoring_project_will_dario.do (line ~748)
  • Broad industry groups 部门与行业
    Firm industry from FirmStat GF_BRANCHE_07 (NACE rev.2, first two digits) grouped into 8 sectors.
    登记库： FirmStat
    代码： branche2 10-33 (bra=1); bra=2 if branche2=='35' (code: branche2=='35' & branche2<='39'); 41-43 (3); 45-47 (4); 49-56 (5); 58-63 (6); 64-75 (7); 77-97 (8)
    复制代码 · offshoring_project_will_dario.do (lines ~789-821)

Replication package

Spillover effects of stricter immigration policies

Cristina Bratu, Matz Dahlberg, Mattias Engdahl and Till Nikolka · Journal of Public Economics, 2020 · 个人

考察丹麦 2002 年收紧家庭团聚规则是否把受影响的居民推向了邻国。文章用双重差分比较有移民背景的单身丹麦公民与已同非欧盟伴侣同居的公民，发现向外迁移明显上升，其中大多迁往瑞典。瑞典登记库显示，在瑞典团聚的伴侣中有许多人后来再度离开，约 20% 在两年内、50% 在八年内离开，其中多数前往丹麦。

数据
Statistics Denmark population register, 1995–2009 (age, gender, municipality, citizenship, country of origin, migration background, partner and children in the household), Statistics Denmark migration register, 1995–2009 (all registered in- and out-migration events with date and country of origin/destination), Swedish data: GeoSweden database of Statistics Sweden registers, full population 1995–2014 (country of birth, immigration/emigration dates and countries, reason for residence, household, labour income from Sweden and Denmark) – used for the analysis of arrivals in and return migration from Sweden
关键变量
  • 处理：2002 年家庭团聚改革之后，未与伴侣同居的单身丹麦公民（18 岁及以上）
  • 对照组：与非 EU/EEA 公民同居的丹麦公民
  • 结果变量：某一年从丹麦迁出，分为迁往瑞典和迁往所有目的地
  • 结果变量（瑞典数据）：受影响伴侣抵达瑞典及其后迁出的情况，按目的地划分
  • 异质性：移民背景、来源国、西兰岛（Zealand）与其他地区、年龄
时期
1995–2009 年（丹麦登记库）；1995–2014 年（瑞典登记库，1995–2009 年抵达的移民）
样本
丹麦 1995–2009 年重复截面：处理组 12,278,256 个人年观测值（其中有移民背景者 317,534 个），对照组 464,310 个（其中有移民背景者 191,377 个）；双重差分回归使用 508,911 个观测值（工作论文表 1 和表 B.1）。瑞典数据：2002–2009 年抵达的受影响个人 5,096 名、未受影响个人 1,576 名（工作论文表 3）。 18 岁及以上的丹麦公民，或为单身（处理组），或与非 EU/EEA 公民同居（对照组），回归限于有移民背景者；在瑞典，为 1995–2009 年迁入的丹麦/非 EU 伴侣和非 EU 伴侣中的成年伴侣。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Treatment and control group (repeated cross-sections) 样本界定与时间
    Treatment group: Danish citizens older than 18 years who are not cohabiting with a partner in Denmark in a given year, and who therefore face the stricter rules for a potential family reunification after the 2002 reform. Control group: Danish citizens older than 18 years cohabiting with a non-EU/EEA citizen in a given year in Denmark. Group status is defined year by year; the regressions are restricted to Danish citizens with immigrant background.
    登记库： Population register (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： Age 18+; Danish citizenship; sample years 1995–2009; reform passed June 2002 (reference category t = 2001)
    工作论文 · Section 3.2; Table 1 notes; Figure 6 notes
  • Immigrant background 移民身份与来源地
    Danish citizens with an immigrant background were either born abroad or born in Denmark to parents that were both born abroad and non-Danish citizens. A narrower sample keeps the four most frequent non-EU/EEA countries of origin: Turkey, Pakistan, ex-Yugoslavia and Bosnia.
    登记库： Population register (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 3.3, footnote 15; Table 1 notes; Figure 3 notes
  • Emigration from Denmark (to Sweden / all destinations) 移民身份与来源地
    Indicator equal to one if the individual emigrates (to Sweden) in a given year and zero if the person stays in Denmark. All emigration events to any country except the Faroe Islands and Greenland are counted, with no restriction on the length of the migration spell; if a person emigrates more than once in a year only the latest event is used. Registering emigration is compulsory when leaving the country for more than six months. The data keep individuals registered as residents in a given year who either emigrate or do not emigrate and appear in the register in the following year.
    登记库： Migration register (Statistics Denmark), Population register (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： Destinations exclude Faroe Islands and Greenland; reporting duty for stays abroad of more than six months
    工作论文 · Appendix A; Section 3.3, equation (1)
  • Fixed cohort for the duration (Kaplan-Meier) analysis 样本界定与时间
    Danish citizens with immigrant background who are between 18 and 29 years old in 2001 (t = 0), assigned to treatment (single, not cohabiting) or control (cohabiting with a non-EU/EEA citizen) by their status in 2001 and followed until 2009 without any change in treatment status. Individuals who drop out of the data before 2009 without being registered as emigrants are excluded. 13,292 treated and 4,130 control individuals.
    登记库： Population register (Statistics Denmark), Migration register (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： Age 18–29 in 2001; follow-up 2001–2009
    工作论文 · Section 3.3; Figure 7 notes; Appendix Table B.3
  • Couples affected by the reform who reunite in Sweden (Swedish data) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Identified from country of birth, country of arrival and household status because citizenship is not observed in the Swedish data. Affected couples are (i) couples where one partner is born in Denmark and the other is born in a non-EU country and immigrated from there, and (ii) couples where both partners are born in a non-EU country with at most one of them migrating from Denmark. Couples where both partners arrive from Denmark are treated as unaffected and serve as a control group. Partners must arrive within 6, 12 or 18 months of each other and be registered in the same household in the year the non-EU partner enters Sweden.
    登记库： GeoSweden (Statistics Sweden registers; Swedish, not Danish, data)
    代码： Arrival within 6, 12 or 18 months of each other; aged 18+ at immigration; immigration years 1995–2009
    工作论文 · Section 4.1–4.2, Table 2; Appendix C

The Welfare Magnet Hypothesis: Evidence from an Immigrant Welfare Scheme in Denmark

Ole Agersnap, Amalie Sofie Jensen and Henrik Kleven · AER: Insights, 2020 · 个人

2002 年对非欧盟移民福利的削减及其废除和重新实施，为检验福利磁石假说提供了多次准实验。削减使净移民每年减少约 5,000 人，废除则几乎完全逆转了这一变化，这意味着移民对福利水平的弹性为 1.3。

数据
Danish administrative registers on the full population 1980–2017 (immigrant status, country of origin, demographics, family links), Residence permit data by permit type (asylum, family, work/study; available from 1997), Central Person Register (CPR) migration records, National statistics bureaus of other Nordic countries and OECD International Migration Database (1991–2017)
关键变量
  • 处理：非欧盟移民的每月最高福利金（移民福利方案 2002 年出台、2012 年废除、2015 年重新实施）
  • 结果变量：按福利金组别划分的净移民流量，以方案实施前的存量标准化
  • 结果变量：按居留许可类型划分的总流入
  • 比较：欧盟移民与非欧盟移民；丹麦与其他北欧国家
时期
1980–2017
样本

Refugee Migration and Electoral Outcomes

Christian Dustmann, Kristine Vasiljeva and Anna Piil Damm · Review of Economic Studies, 2019 · 个人

利用准随机的难民分散安置政策发现，难民安置提高了反移民政党在农村市镇的得票率，而在最大的城市市镇则降低了其得票率。在难民相对于本国出生者人数较少的地方，以及安置后犯罪上升的地方，效应最强。

数据

  • 异质性：城市市镇与农村市镇
  • 控制变量：1985 年的市镇特征

样本

National Election Study

Refugees from former Yugoslavia (special 1993 policy) and family-reunified spouses/children arriving more than 12 months after the refugee are excluded.
