Self-selection of Emigrants: Theory and Evidence on Stochastic Dominance in Observable and Unobservable Characteristics

George J. Borjas, Ilpo Kauppinen and Panu Poutvaara · Economic Journal, 2019 · 个人

论文证明，Roy 模型不仅预测迁移者与留居者的平均劳动收入存在差异，还预测二者的劳动收入分布之间存在随机占优的排序。利用全体人口登记数据，比较离开丹麦至少五年的丹麦人在外迁前的劳动收入与留居者的劳动收入，发现外迁者的劳动收入分布几乎随机占优于未迁移者的分布。这种正向选择大部分来自不可观测特征（劳动收入回归的残差），而非教育等可观测特征。

数据
Statistics Denmark administrative registers for the entire Danish population, 1995–2010, merged by personal identification number, Tax records: annual gross labour income and freelance income, Migration register 1995–2010 (date of emigration, destination country, date of return), Population registers 1980–2010 (parents, citizenship and immigrant background), Register information on education, marital status, number of children and work experience gained during the year
关键变量
  • 分组：迁往北欧国家或其他目的地的长期外迁者（在国外至少五年）与未迁移者
  • 结果变量：外迁前的税前年劳动收入，按年龄、性别和年份标准化
  • 结果变量：Mincer 劳动收入回归的残差（不可观测特征）
  • 控制变量：年龄、教育、婚姻状况、子女数量、年份
  • 检验：对累积分布进行的 Kolmogorov-Smirnov 检验和随机占优检验
时期
1995–2010 年（横截面为 1995–2004 年；1996–2005 年的外迁追踪至 2010 年）
样本
未迁移者：男性 6,450,665 个、女性 5,163,129 个人年观测值；长期迁移者：男性 7,323 人、女性 3,436 人（Table 1） 1995–2004 年各年度横截面中，无移民背景、年龄 25–54 岁、整个日历年居住在丹麦且全职工作的丹麦公民；迁移者指在次年离开并在国外停留至少五年的人。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Full-time workers aged 25-54 样本界定与时间
    For each year 1995-2004, all Danish citizens aged 25-54 (age measured as of January 1st of the year after the reference year) who lived in Denmark during the entire calendar year and worked full time. Full time is defined from a register variable measuring work experience gained during the calendar year (maximum 1,000), computed as the current value minus the previous year's value; the sample keeps workers with a value of 900 or above, roughly those who worked full time at least 90 percent of the year. Persons with a missing value in either year are dropped.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark administrative registers (work experience variable; register not named)
    代码： Age 25-54; work experience gained >= 900 of a maximum 1,000; cross-sections 1995-2004
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Data), footnotes 12-13
  • Long-term emigrant 移民身份与来源地
    An individual found in one of the 1995-2004 cross-sections who emigrates from Denmark during the following year to a destination outside Greenland or the Faroe Islands and stays abroad for at least five years, with return migration tracked in the migration register through 2010. Individuals who emigrated for less than five years are removed, and the rest of the population is classified as non-migrants.
    登记库： Migration register
    代码： Migration spell of 1,825 days or longer; destinations exclude Greenland and the Faroe Islands
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Data), footnotes 15-17
  • No immigrant background 移民身份与来源地
    Migrants and non-migrants are restricted to Danish citizens without an immigration background: Statistics Denmark defines a person to have no immigrant background if at least one of the parents was born in Denmark and the person is/was a Danish citizen. The authors searched the population registers from 1980 to 2010 for the parents of sample persons, and a parent who was found was required to be a Dane with no immigrant background as well.
    登记库： Population registers
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Data), footnote 18
  • Annual earnings and standardized earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Annual income is the worker's annual gross labor income plus positive values of freelance income, taken from the tax records for each calendar year. Standardized earnings are the ratio of a worker's annual gross earnings to the mean gross earnings of workers of the same age and gender during the calendar year (migrants, non-migrants and shorter-term migrants are all included in the means).
    登记库： Tax records (income register)
    代码： Negative freelance income excluded; summary statistics in 2010 euros
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Data), footnotes 14 and 19; Table 1
  • Earnings residual (unobserved characteristics) 劳动收入与收入
    Residual from OLS regressions of log annual (non-standardized) earnings, estimated separately for men and women on the whole population of prime-aged full-time workers pooled over 1995-2004, with age fixed effects, educational attainment dummies (high school, vocational school, advanced vocational, Bachelor, Master's, PhD), marital status, number of children and year dummies.
    登记库： Tax records (income register), Statistics Denmark administrative registers (education, family)
    代码： N = 6,470,720 (men) and 5,173,706 (women)

1991 至 2008 年间，来自难民来源国的移民流入丹麦各市镇，推动受教育程度较低的本国出生工人转向更复杂、体力成分更少的职业。本国出生者的工资和就业不降反升，即便是跨企业流动的低技能本国出生者，效应也为正。

1991–2008
样本

变量如何定义（10）
  • Refugee-country immigrants 移民身份与来源地
    Immigrants (foreign-born) from eight refugee-sending countries that generated substantial refugee inflows 1994-2008: Yugoslavia, Somalia, Afghanistan, Iraq, Sri Lanka, Vietnam, Iran and Lebanon (Bosnia included in actual inflow but not in the instrument).

Following Ottaviano, Peri and Wright (2013), abilities are averaged into communication, cognitive (analytical) and manual intensity indices, each standardized to [0,1] as the occupation's centile in the 2000 ranking. Complexity = ln((Communication + Analytical)/Manual).

  • 处理：是否符合外国人优惠税制的资格（劳动收入高于门槛）
  • 结果变量：劳动收入门槛以上与以下的外国人数量（迁移反应）
  • 结果变量：方案受益者的劳动收入（工资效应／在门槛处的聚束）
  • 结果变量：对本国出生的高收入者就业和劳动收入的溢出效应
  • 关键变量：国籍和在丹麦居留的年数
时期
1980–2010 年（税收数据始于 1980 年；该方案于 1992 年推出）
样本
所查资料中未注明 居住在丹麦的全部外国人和本国出生者，重点关注劳动收入在方案资格门槛附近的外国人（不含研究人员）。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Scheme earnings eligibility threshold 税收与税率
    Foreigners' scheme requires annual wage earnings with the requesting employer above a threshold that grows roughly with average earnings and lies between the 99.2th and 99.4th percentile of the Danish wage earnings distribution (DKK 765,600 in 2009); it must be met on an annualized basis (e.g. a 6-month contract needs half the annual threshold). For pre-1991 years the threshold is imputed by holding the threshold-to-average-earnings ratio at its 1991 value, with average earnings computed over all workers with positive earnings.
    登记库： Administrative tax and payroll records
    工作论文 · Section 2.1 and footnote 14
  • Scheme eligibility (prior tax liability) 税收与税率
    To be eligible the taxpayer must have been recruited abroad and not have been tax liable in Denmark in the 3 years before going on the scheme (applied to each scheme spell separately; prior scheme time not counted); citizenship plays no formal role, so Danish citizens tax-resident abroad for 3+ years qualify. Scheme lasts at most 36 months.
    登记库： Foreigners' tax scheme beneficiary records
    工作论文 · Section 2.1 and footnote 12
  • Annualized earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Earnings of part-year residents are annualized based on duration of stay in the year, with duration of stay measured from the migration database (daily dates of entry and exit from CPR records).
    登记库： Administrative tax records, CPR migration records
    工作论文 · Section 4.1, footnote 23
  • Treatment and control groups of foreigners (migration DiD) 移民身份与来源地
    Treatment: foreigners with (annualized) earnings above the eligibility threshold; controls: foreigners with earnings between 80% and 90% (control 1) and between 90% and 99.5% (control 2) of the threshold, series normalized to 1990. In the elasticity regressions controls are foreigners between 80% and 99% of the threshold; an alternative uses the 99.5-100th percentile vs the 95-97th and 97-99th percentiles of the full earnings distribution.
    登记库： Administrative tax records, CPR citizenship records
    工作论文 · Section 4.1, Figures 4-5, Table 2
  • Citizenship groups and expatriates 移民身份与来源地
    Nordic foreigners: citizens of Finland, Iceland, Norway, Sweden; English-speaking: Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, South Africa, UK, US. Expatriates are Danish citizens returning after a spell of at least three years abroad.
    登记库： CPR citizenship records
    工作论文 · Section 4.1, Table 2 Panels A5-A7
  • Wage-effect repeated cross-section sample 样本界定与时间
    For year t, foreigners who arrived in Denmark in year t-1 and stayed the full calendar year t; earnings between 70-95% (below) and 105-400% (above) of the threshold, excluding 95-105% (bunchers) and above 400%; years 1991-1994 excluded because scheme earnings are not computerized.
    登记库： Administrative tax records, CPR migration records, Scheme beneficiary records
    工作论文 · Section 4.2, Figure 8, Table 3, footnote 30
  • Top natives and top foreign employees (spillovers) 劳动收入与收入
    Top natives: native workers with earnings above 75% of the scheme eligibility threshold (about the top 3% of native earnings). Top foreign employees: foreign employees with less than 3 years of presence in Denmark and annualized earnings above the threshold; industry scheme use = growth in top foreign employees between 1980-1990 and 1991-2000 divided by top native employees in 1980-1990.
    登记库： Administrative tax and payroll records, Employer links with 2-digit industry
    工作论文 · Section 4.3 (industry-level spillovers), footnote 35

Ethnic Enclaves and Immigrant Labor Market Outcomes: Quasi-Experimental Evidence

Anna Piil Damm · Journal of Labor Economics, 2009 · 个人

利用 1986 至 1998 年间难民在丹麦各市镇的准随机分散安置，将居住在族裔聚居区的效应与自我选择区分开来。聚居区规模越大，难民男性的年劳动收入越高，而就业率不变；在同胞就业者更多的地方收益更大，这指向求职信息网络的作用。

数据
Longitudinal administrative registers on the immigrant population (Statistics Denmark), 1984–2000, Population register (BEF) incl. country of origin, year of immigration and municipality, Survey-based register on immigrants' pre-immigration education and integrated pupil register, Municipality statistics: unemployment register, election statistics, register-based labour force statistics, housing statistics, Danish Refugee Council administrative statistics on temporary housing (to identify assignment municipality)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：就业概率
  • 结果变量：实际年劳动收入
  • 核心解释变量：所在市镇的族裔聚居区（同国籍群体）规模
  • 工具变量／识别：1986–1998 年空间分散安置政策下的初始分配市镇
  • 控制变量：性别、年龄、婚姻状况、子女、教育、来源国、移民年份
时期
登记库为 1984–2000 年；难民移民入境队列为 1986–1993 年
样本
13,927 人（平衡面板，移民后七年内逐年观测） 来自 11 个主要难民来源国、在分散安置政策下被分配到丹麦各市镇的成年难民，从获得居留许可起逐年观测至七年后。 来源
调查
Foreign-education survey
变量如何定义（9）
  • Employment 就业与劳动力状态
    Based on labour market status in November of each year: employed if main occupation is wage-employment with at least 9 hours of weekly work, or self-employment (includes part-time of at least 9 weekly hours and full-time). Outcome measured seven years after immigration.
    登记库： Immigrant population registers (Statistics Denmark), RAS
    工作论文 · Section III.D
  • Real annual earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Sum of wage earnings, profits from own company and sickness benefits, deflated by the consumer price index (base year 1980); analysed for refugees with positive earnings seven years after immigration.
    登记库： Income register (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section III.D; Table I notes
  • Ethnic group (enclave) size 移民身份与来源地
    Number of first- and second-generation immigrants (immigrants and descendants) from individual i's source country living in i's municipality of residence; ethnicity proxied by country of origin.
    登记库： BEF (100 per cent sample of immigrants)
    工作论文 · Section III.B (p. 13); Table A.I Part B
  • Refugee sample identification 移民身份与来源地
    Individuals from 11 main refugee-sending countries extracted by an algorithm based on country of origin and first year of residence permit (built from official asylum permit counts), immigrating under the 1986-1998 dispersal policy, aged 18-59, observed annually up to seven years after immigration (balanced panel of 13,927). Excludes those married at immigration to a Dane, an immigrant from a non-refugee-sending country, or an immigrant from a refugee-sending country who immigrated at least one year earlier (family reunification).
    登记库： Immigrant population registers (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section III.D and footnote 12
  • Municipality of assignment 地理与社区
    The first municipality of residence observed in the registers is classified as temporary housing if the person relocates to another municipality within the same county within one year after receipt of the first residence permit; otherwise the first municipality is the municipality of assignment (algorithm based on the Danish Refugee Council's statistics on temporary housing).
    登记库： BEF, Danish Refugee Council administrative statistics
    工作论文 · Section III.D
  • Instrument: number of placed co-nationals 移民身份与来源地
    Number of immigrants from the individual's source country placed by the authorities in the individual's municipality of assignment in year t, for t = -7, ..., 0 (0 = year of immigration), i.e. initial and past inflows of placed co-nationals.
    登记库： BEF (100 per cent sample of immigrants)
    工作论文 · Table A.I Part B
  • Education attained (pre-immigration) 教育与考试成绩
    Dummies from the education code of highest degree attained: no degree = 0-9 years, high school = 10-12 years, professional = 13+ years, plus unknown education.
    登记库： Survey-based register on immigrants' pre-immigration education, Integrated pupil register
    工作论文 · Table A.I Part A
  • Local unemployment rate 失业与福利金
    Unemployment rate within a radius of DKK 60 (approx. USD 10) of transport cost around the largest post office in the municipality, constructed by Local Government Studies.
    登记库： Unemployment register (Statistics Denmark), Ministry of Transport cost statistics
    工作论文 · Table A.I Part B
  • Municipality characteristics (right-wing votes, county jobs, social housing) 地理与社区
    % right-wing votes: Liberal plus Conservative votes as a share of Liberal, Conservative, Social Democratic and Socialist People's Party votes at the latest municipal election; % county jobs: persons employed in the municipality as a share of county employment; % social housing: social housing dwellings for all-year residence as a share of all such dwellings.
    登记库： Election statistics, RAS, Buildings and housing statistics
    工作论文 · Table A.I Part B

Breaking Bad: How Health Shocks Prompt Crime

Steffen Andersen, Elin Colmsjö, Gianpaolo Parise and Kim Peijnenburg · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2026 · 个人

利用丹麦登记库中癌症确诊时点可视为外生这一点，表明健康冲击会持续提高犯罪的概率，初次犯罪和再犯均是如此。患者以非法收入弥补损失的合法收入，并且由于存活概率下降，面临的预期惩罚成本更低；能够缓冲收入损失的福利项目会削弱这一效应。

Offence types are classified as economic/non-economic and as property/sexual/violent (the latter following Statistics Denmark's system), covering 4,732,529 crimes 1980-2018.

    Logit of dying within 5 years, estimated on people aged 18-62 in 1980-2013 (diagnosed plus up to ten exactly matched controls per case) with cancer-type indicators (14 types plus multiple), age polynomial interactions, post-cancer, gender and marriage controls, separately for 1980-1992, 1993-2003 and 2004-2013. The decline is predicted probability minus the counterfactual with no diagnosis. Low survival means an above-median decline within gender (also split by quintile).

  • Exact-matched controls for survival estimation 样本界定与时间
    For each diagnosed individual, controls who in the year before diagnosis share age, marital status and gender and are in the same income ventile and years-of-education quintile. Up to ten controls with the smallest difference in total income are kept; unmatched observations are dropped.

  • Change in municipal welfare generosity (2007 reform) 失业与福利金
    Percentage change in labour income plus transfers in post-diagnosis years relative to the five-year pre-diagnosis average, regressed on municipality fixed effects, age fixed effects, a cubic in pre-diagnosis income rank and year effects, separately pre-reform (1987-2006) and post-reform (2007-2018). People diagnosed 2004-2006 are excluded. The generosity change is the difference between post- and pre-reform municipality effects.

Christian Dustmann, Rasmus Landersø and Lars Højsgaard Andersen · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2024 · 个人

The Effects of DNA Databases on the Deterrence and Detection of Offenders

Anne Sofie Tegner Anker, Jennifer L. Doleac and Rasmus Landersø · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2021 · 个人

丹麦 DNA 数据库的大幅扩容使一年内的再犯率最多下降 42%，并提高了再犯者被查获的概率，这意味着查获概率每提高 1%，犯罪减少 2% 以上。被录入数据库的罪犯也更可能就业、就学并生活在稳定的家庭中。

数据
Central Charge Register (crime date, charge date, crime type), Danish Central DNA Database person-specific section (DNA registration records), Conviction records (crime registers), Full-population registers on demographics, labour market and family links
关键变量
  • 处理：罪犯被录入 DNA 数据库
  • 工具变量：在 2005 年 5 月 DNA 数据库扩容之后被指控（甜甜圈断点回归，剔除 2005 年 6–9 月）
  • 驱动变量：距 2005 年 5 月之前／10 月之后的月数
  • 结果变量：被指控后一年、两年和三年内的定罪（全部犯罪及分犯罪类型）
  • 查获与威慑：按指控是在案发三周以后还是三周以内提出进行划分
  • 次要结果变量：就业、教育、婚姻
时期
指控发生于 2003 年 6 月–2007 年 9 月（剔除 2005 年 6–9 月），并追踪其后的结果变量
样本
38,674 人，共 66,911 条指控观测值 因触犯刑法典或武器法而被指控、此前被指控不超过 10 次、居住在丹麦的 18–30 岁男性。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • DNA registration (treatment) 犯罪
    Indicator that the charged offender appears in the person-specific section of the Central DNA Database, merged to the charge register via personal identification and record numbers.
    登记库： Central DNA Database (person-specific section), Charge register
    工作论文 · Section 5.1
  • Post-reform charge instrument and donut window 样本界定与时间
    Sampling window +/-24 months around the 2005 reform, excluding June-September of the reform year; placebo samples shift the reform to e.g. 2002. Robustness caps on number of prior charges at max 5, 10 or 15.
    登记库： Central Crime Register
    代码： +/-24 months; donut June-September 2005
    在线附录 · Table A-2 and placebo table notes
  • Charge-level analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    Charges for offenses against the Penal Code or Weapons Act (excluding traffic offenses, small-scale drug possession, Health Code and Tax Law violations) against Danish-resident males aged 18-30 at the charge with at most 10 previous charges; one charge per person per day; unit of observation is the charge.
    登记库： Charge register, Population register
    工作论文 · Section 5.1, footnotes 12 and 14
  • Recidivism: subsequent convictions 犯罪
    Convictions for crimes committed after the sample charge, counted from the day after the charge, within one, two and three years; coded as a binary (at least one conviction) and as a count top-coded at 10 convictions per follow-up year. Measured for all crime and separately for violence, property, sexual, other penal (incl. serious drug offenses) and Weapons Act violations.
    登记库： Conviction register, Charge register
    工作论文 · Section 5.2, footnote 16
  • Fast vs. slow charges (deterrence vs. detection) 犯罪
    Solved fast = time from crime date to charge < 3 weeks; solved slowly = >= 3 weeks. Clearance rates computed from all charges and all reported crimes in 2005, excluding heavily reported but rarely solved types such as bicycle theft (charged <10% of the time). Robustness uses a 2-week cutoff (share of crimes solved within 2 weeks: 0.572 overall, 0.520 property, 0.670 violent).
    登记库： Central Crime Register; National Police reported crime
    代码： fast < 3 weeks; slow >= 3 weeks
    在线附录 · Table A-13 notes; Table A-15 notes (2-week cutoff)
  • Crime categories 犯罪
    Mapping of charge types to analysis categories. Sexual (Penal Code): incest, rape, pedophilia, voyeurism/flashing, other sexual violations. Violence: violence against public servant, disturbance of public peace, murder/manslaughter (incl. attempted), simple violence, major violence, threats, other violent assaults. Property: fraud, arson, theft, burglary, robbery, vandalism, other property crime. Other (penal): crimes against/as a public servant, drug smuggling or sales, obstruction of justice, restraining orders, other penal code crimes. Weapon: Weapons/Arms Act violations (explosives, firearms, knives). Not categorized: Traffic Act violations (accidents and speeding, traffic accidents with alcohol, drunk driving, other traffic), Drug Act possession/sales, other special acts (smuggling, construction, health, social fraud).
    登记库： Central Crime Register (charges)
    在线附录 · Table A-1
  • Labor market attachment 就业与劳动力状态
    Cumulated time in employment, education/training and unemployment over years 1-4 after the initial charge.
    登记库： IDA / labour market registers
    在线附录 · Table A-3, panel B
  • Family stability outcomes 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Married; same partner; living with child and the child's mother, measured 1, 2 and 3 years after charge.
    登记库： Population register (BEF)
    在线附录 · Table A-3, panel C
  • Covariates 样本界定与时间

Child's Gender, Young Fathers' Crime, and Spillover Effects in Criminal Behavior

Christian Dustmann and Rasmus Landersø · Journal of Political Economy, 2021 · 个人

以头胎子女的性别作为丹麦年轻父亲的自然实验。与生女儿相比，生儿子会降低父亲此后的犯罪行为，而且这种下降会外溢到父亲的同伴，并在日后外溢到子女身上，由此既识别出直接的养育反应，也识别出犯罪中的网络效应。

数据
Birth register (child's gender, parent links), Population register (BEF) for demographics and family links, Central Police Register crime data (charges and convictions), Victim register (from 2001), Income, education and occupation registers, Residential register with neighbourhood classification
关键变量
  • 结果变量：年轻父亲的犯罪定罪与指控
  • 处理：头胎是儿子还是女儿
  • 溢出结果变量：父亲所在社区男性同伴的犯罪
  • 同伴群体：同一社区内与父亲年龄相差 ±3 岁以内的男性
  • 结果变量：社区内的犯罪受害情况
时期
1991–2004 年出生的儿童；犯罪数据自 1990 年起
样本
2,803 名 20 岁及以下初为人父者；2,114 个社区中的 101,132 名男性同伴 1991 年至 2004 年间在 20 岁及以下生育第一个孩子的丹麦男性，以及其所在社区的男性同伴。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Crime (convictions and charges) 犯罪
    Charges or convictions for offences against the criminal code from the Central Police Register, excluding traffic offences; convictions (court rulings of guilt) are the preferred measure. Charges and convictions are dated by the date the crime was committed (exact crime dates available from 1990); records are observed even after deletion from the individual's criminal record.
    登记库： Central Police Register (crime register)
    论文正文 · Section II.A and footnote 7
  • Crime categories 犯罪
    Property crime: theft, fencing, aggravated vandalism, fraud, burglary, forgery, economic crimes. Violent crime: simple violence (assault), severe or life-threatening violence, threats, violence against or obstructing a public servant, failure to help a person in danger, coercion, attempted murder or homicide. Other crime: drug possession and sale, possession of weapons/explosives, false testimony, sexual crimes.
    登记库： Central Police Register
    论文正文 · Footnote 8; online Table A1 (code breakdown, not read)
  • Young first-time father sample / treatment 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Males who father their first child at age 20 or younger, children born 1991-2004 (birth and demographic registers), with information on both parents from the birth for up to 5 subsequent years, matched uniquely to a neighbourhood; treatment is the first child being a son. Fathers in neighbourhoods with more than one young father having a first child in the same year are excluded.
    登记库： Birth register, BEF
    论文正文 · Section II.B and footnote 9
  • Neighbourhood 地理与社区
    Neighbourhoods follow the classification documented in Damm and Schultz-Nielsen (2008), constructed in 2004, linked to individuals through anonymised home address identifiers in the residential register; the largest and smallest 5% of neighbourhoods are excluded from most analyses.
    登记库： Residential register, BEF
    论文正文 · Section II.B
  • Peer group and peer crime 犯罪
    Peers are all males within +/-3 years of the focal father's age living in the father's neighbourhood on January 1 of the year the child is born (alternatively all males aged 14-25 at the birth), regardless of later moves; the father and his family members are excluded. Peer crime is their convictions/charges.
    登记库： Residential register, BEF, Central Police Register
    论文正文 · Section II.B; footnote 5
  • Neighbourhood victimisation 犯罪
    Based on individuals who report having been the victim of a crime (register available from 2001); victim sample includes all individuals living in the father's neighbourhood at the time of the birth, counting the number of victims in each neighbourhood.
    登记库： Victim register
    论文正文 · Section II.B (victim sample) and footnote 10

Birth Order and Delinquency: Evidence from Denmark and Florida

Sanni Breining, Joseph Doyle, David N. Figlio, Krzysztof Karbownik and Jeffrey Roth · Journal of Labor Economics, 2020 · 个人

在丹麦和佛罗里达，排行第二的男孩都比其头胎哥哥明显更可能在学校受到纪律处分并进入刑事司法系统。证据表明，机制在于父母对后出生子女的时间投入减少，而不是出生时健康状况或社区的差异。

数据
Medical Birth Register (MFR), Population register with parent and sibling links (BEF), Central Crime Register (convictions, sentences, incarceration), School registers (9th grade exit exam grades), Register of Daycare Institutions, National Patient Register (LPR) and Psychiatric Central Register, Parental education, employment, earnings and maternity leave registers, Florida birth records linked to school and juvenile justice records
关键变量
  • 结果变量：16 岁前和 21 岁前被刑事定罪；被判处监禁；被收监
  • 处理：排行第二的男孩与头胎男孩相比（兄弟姐妹固定效应）
  • 结果变量：九年级毕业考试的阅读和数学成绩
  • 机制：母亲的休假与就业、1–3 岁时的日托入托、入学年龄、10 岁前的精神科诊断
  • 控制变量：父母年龄、教育、就业、家庭收入、移民身份
时期
丹麦 1981–1990 年出生队列；佛罗里达 1994–2002 年出生者
样本
丹麦：60,550 个家庭中的 121,100 名儿童（头胎和二胎男孩）；丹麦全体人口中 1981–1990 年的单胎出生为 448,979 例 有两个及以上同父子女的丹麦家庭，比较 1981–1990 年出生的头胎男孩和二胎男孩（另有佛罗里达的对比样本）。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Criminal conviction by age 16 / 21 犯罪
    Indicator (x100) for having any criminal conviction by age 16, and by age 21, from the Criminal Registers; convictions observable from age 15 (age of criminal responsibility). Traffic offences are excluded; crime outcomes cover convictions for violent, property and special offences.
    登记库： Danish Criminal Registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; footnote 20; Table 3 notes
  • Prison sentence / incarceration by age 16 / 21 犯罪
    More severe crime measures: indicator for ever having been issued a suspended prison sentence, and for an implemented (unsuspended) imprisonment sentence (incarceration), by age 16 and by age 21. Traffic offences excluded.
    登记库： Danish Criminal Registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; footnote 20; Figure 1 notes
  • Violent, property and special crime convictions 犯罪
    Convictions by age 21 split by crime type: violent (e.g. manslaughter, rape, death threats), property (e.g. forgery, arson, burglary) and special offences (e.g. drug offences, illegal weapon possession, human trafficking). Denmark birth cohorts 1981-1990.
    登记库： Danish Criminal Registers
    工作论文 · Section 5.1; Table 3
  • 9th grade exit exam grades 教育与考试成绩
    Ninth grade exit exam grades in reading and math from the School Registers, based on assessments by the student's teacher and an external reviewer; standardized to mean zero and unit SD within each cohort.
    登记库： School Registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.1
  • Psychiatric diagnoses by age 10 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicator for having received, by age 10, a diagnosis at a Danish hospital of a disorder of psychological development, or a behavioural and emotional disorder (e.g. ADHD), from the National Patient Registry and Psychiatric Central Registry.
    登记库： LPR, Psychiatric Central Register
    代码： ICD-10 F80-F89 (psychological development); ICD-10 F90-F98 (behavioural and emotional)
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, footnote 5
  • Daycare enrolment ages 1-3 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Enrolment in out-of-home daycare at ages 1, 2 and 3, from the Register of Daycare Institutions (type and place of daycare observed yearly 1995-2008).
    登记库： Register of Daycare Institutions
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; Table A2
  • Maternal employment after birth 就业与劳动力状态
    Mother's employment in each of years 0-10 after the child's birth: any employment, and full-time employment defined as employed at least 200 days in a year. Days of maternity leave also used as an outcome.
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; Figure 4
  • Birth order sample (second-born boys) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Birth order from the Birth Register (1960-2010 births) using exact birth dates and parent links; twins excluded; sample is the first two children of families with two or more children, restricted to full biological siblings (same mother and father) with a second-born boy (boy-boy and girl-boy families). Main crime sample is birth cohorts 1981-1990.
    登记库： MFR, Population register
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1 and 3.3; Table 3
  • Parental controls measured before birth 劳动收入与收入
    Maternal and paternal employment and family income are measured in the year before birth; missing parental education/employment (about 9-10 percent) are mean-imputed with a missing indicator.

Rasmus Landersø, Helena Skyt Nielsen and Marianne Simonsen · Economic Journal, 2017 · 个人

出生日期恰在入学截止日之后的儿童，入学时间晚了近一年。入学年龄较大会降低低龄阶段的犯罪，对男孩尤其明显；其作用在于使犯罪—年龄曲线发生平移，而非永久性地减少犯罪，这与隔离效应（incapacitation）和成熟度渠道相一致。

Population register with exact birth dates and parent links (BEF), Criminal charge register (charges for property, violence and other crimes, with dates), Birth records: birth weight, gestational length, APGAR score (likely Medical Birth Register, MFR; not named in paper), Education registers (age in 8th grade as proxy for school starting age), Parental education and labour market registers

  • 工具变量/驱动变量：出生日期相对于 1 月 1 日截止日的位置（±30 天）
  • 异质性：性别；犯罪类型（财产犯罪、暴力犯罪、其他）

1981 年年中至 1993 年年中出生的儿童
样本
15 岁时分别为 48,546 名和 50,383 名儿童（两个性别组），出生于 12 月或 1 月（表 1） 1981 年 12 月至 1993 年 1 月间在 12 月或 1 月出生的丹麦儿童（主带宽为 1 月 1 日前后 ±30 天）。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Crime at a given age 犯罪

    登记库： Danish crime registers (charges)
    工作论文 · Section 3.1 and footnote 17
  • Crime at or before a given age 犯罪
    Accumulated indicator for having been charged with a crime at or before a given age (from age 15), keeping track of earlier incidences; also number of crimes for the intensive margin. Outcomes aligned by age are measured exactly at the birthday.
    登记库： Danish crime registers (charges)
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1 and 3.3
  • Crime type (property, violence, other) 犯罪
    Three broad categories: property crime (most frequently shoplifting, burglary, vandalism), violent crime (ordinary and aggravated assault, threats, violence towards public servants) and residual other crime (dominated by traffic-related crime such as driving without a licence, then drug or weapon crime).
    登记库： Danish crime registers (charges)
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, Table 1 and footnote 19
  • School starting age (old-for-grade) 教育与考试成绩
    Timing of school start is not observed for these cohorts, so age in 8th grade is used as an approximation; SSA is modelled as a binary indicator for school starting age 7.6 versus 6.6 (old-for-grade), with robustness to a continuous measure. Validated with exact ages at all grade levels observed from 2007 onwards.
    登记库： Education registers
    工作论文 · Sections 2 and 3.2; Table A2
  • Birth-date discontinuity instrument and bandwidth 样本界定与时间
    Instrument is being born after the January 1 cut-off (January=1); main sample uses children born within +/-30 days of January 1, cohorts born mid-1981 to mid-1993, controlling for a flexible function of distance in days to the cut-off and cohort fixed effects. Covariates are centred on cut-off dates, comparing January year t with December year t-1.
    登记库： Population register (exact birth dates)
    工作论文 · Sections 2 and 3, Section 3.3
  • Birth outcomes (APGAR, birth weight, gestation) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Child birth weight, gestational length and APGAR score (0-10, based on appearance, pulse, grimace, activity, respiration) used as background controls; register not named in the paper.
    登记库： Birth records (register not named)
    工作论文 · Section 3.3 and footnote 21
  • Parental background 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Parents' education and labour market outcomes measured one year prior to the child's birth, aligned to cut-off (e.g. children born Dec 1981 or Jan 1982 use parental characteristics from 1980); also mother's age at first birth.
    登记库： Parental education and labour market registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.3 and footnotes 16, 22

N. Meltem Daysal, Hui Ding, Maya Rossin-Slater and Hannes Schwandt · American Economic Review, 2026 · 个人

研究表明，弟弟妹妹在婴儿期因呼吸系统疾病住院的频率是其哥哥姐姐当年的两到三倍，原因是学龄前儿童把疾病带回家。结合出生次序与呼吸系统疾病流行程度的地区差异，研究发现生命早期的暴露会降低弟弟妹妹日后的劳动收入和受教育程度，并使慢性呼吸系统健康和心理健康状况恶化。

Thorbjørn Sejr Guul and Søren Albeck Nielsen · Journal of Public Economics, 2026 · 个人

研究丹麦的一项改革：八年级成绩低于某一门槛的学生被认定为尚未准备好接受高中教育，并在一年后重新评估。文章用模糊断点回归比较成绩恰好低于和恰好高于门槛的学生。被贴上“未准备好”标签的学生提高了初中毕业成绩，也更有可能完成高中学业并进入中学后教育，主要途径是更加努力和减少兼职工作，且幸福感未受损害。

数据
Educational readiness assessments (uddannelsesparathedsvurdering, UPV) and other anonymised education data from STIL, Statistics Denmark register data used to follow students' later education (registers not named in the abstract or the university summary), National well-being survey of students in Years 8 and 9, National reading tests in Year 8
关键变量
  • 驱动变量：八年级平均成绩相对于准备度门槛 4 分的位置
  • 处理：被认定为在学业上“未准备好”接受高中教育，并于次年重新评估
  • 结果变量：初中毕业（九年级）考试成绩
  • 结果变量：评估后五年内完成高中学业和进入中学后教育
  • 机制：尽责性和幸福感（问卷调查）、兼职工作、学校和父母的投入
时期
准备度评估于 2015 年引入；学生在八年级评估之后最多被追踪五年（所阅资料未说明队列年份）
样本
所查资料中未注明 平均成绩接近学业准备度门槛 4 分的丹麦八年级学生。 来源（摘要）

  • Declared 'not ready' for upper secondary education (GPA threshold) 教育与考试成绩
    A policy reform in Denmark introduced a GPA threshold for academic readiness for upper secondary education 1.5 years before the end of middle school. Students near the threshold received similar information about their academic performance, but those just below it were labeled 'not ready' and offered a second chance through reevaluation the following year. Estimated with a fuzzy regression discontinuity design.

Childhood Health Shocks and the Intergenerational Transmission of Inequality

Tine M. Eriksen, Amanda P. Gaulke, Niels Skipper, Jannet Svensson and Peter R. Thingholm · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2026 · 个人

利用儿童期 1 型糖尿病发病的准随机性，估计一种慢性但可治疗的健康冲击对 30 岁时劳动力市场结果的影响，将确诊儿童与同一天出生的匹配儿童进行比较。确诊儿童的劳动收入低约 14%，就业概率低 8.7 个百分点。因果森林显示，父母收入较高、母亲受教育程度较高的儿童所受的损失小得多，部分原因在于更好的疾病管理和学校教育。

数据
National Patient Registry (Landspatientregisteret): type 1 diabetes diagnoses via ICD-8 and ICD-10 codes, all children diagnosed since 1976, DanDiabKids (Danish Registry of Childhood and Adolescent Diabetes): date of diagnosis and clinical measures from annual pediatric clinic visits, since 1996, Statistics Denmark population registers: age, sex, immigrant or descendant status, birth order, siblings and parent-child links, Income and education registers for children and parents (income from 1980), Health care use around diagnosis: hospital admissions, general practitioner visits and pharmacy claims
关键变量
  • 处理：18 岁之前确诊 1 型糖尿病
  • 对照组：五名出生日期和性别完全相同、30 岁之前未确诊的匹配儿童
  • 结果变量：30 岁时的劳动力市场收入
  • 结果变量：30 岁时的就业（劳动收入为正）
  • 异质性：父母收入四分位、父母教育和年龄（因果森林）
  • 机制：HbA1c、因酮症酸中毒或昏迷住院、晚期并发症、受教育程度
时期
出生队列 1977–1987 年；确诊 1986–2004 年；结果变量在 30 岁时测量
样本
1,810 名确诊 1 型糖尿病的儿童和 9,050 名匹配的对照儿童（第 3 节和表 1）；主回归中 10,418 个观测值（表 3） 1977–1987 年出生、在 1986 至 2004 年间于 18 岁之前确诊 1 型糖尿病的丹麦本国出生者，每人匹配五名出生日期和性别相同的未确诊儿童。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Childhood-onset type 1 diabetes 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    All children diagnosed with T1D in Denmark since 1976 are identified through the National Patient Registry (Landspatientregisteret) through ICD-10 codes and before that ICD-8 codes. Since 1996 clinical information is recorded in DanDiabKids, which covers all Danish children and adolescents with T1D seen at pediatric endocrinology clinics and provides the exact date of diagnosis and clinical characteristics from annual follow-up visits. Treatment is an indicator for being diagnosed with T1D before age 18; mean age at onset is 11.8 years.
    登记库： National Patient Registry (LPR), DanDiabKids
    代码： ICD-8 and ICD-10 diabetes codes (specific codes not listed in the paper); diagnosis before age 18
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Data and descriptive statistics); Section 4, equation (1)
  • Analysis sample and matched comparison group 样本界定与时间
    Cohorts born 1977 to 1987, restricted to native Danes, diagnosed from 1986 to 2004 (other background characteristics are only available from 1986). 1,810 children are diagnosed with T1D before they turn 18. For each, five comparison children who had not been diagnosed with T1D before their 30th birthday are matched on the exact date of birth and sex (9,050 individuals). Parental characteristics are measured before the child's birth.
    登记库： Population registers (Statistics Denmark), National Patient Registry (LPR)
    代码： Born 1977-1987; diagnosed 1986-2004; 1:5 match on exact date of birth and sex
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Data and descriptive statistics); Table 1
  • Employment at age 30 就业与劳动力状态
    Indicator for having any positive labor market income at age 30.
    登记库： Income registers
    代码： Labor income > 0 at age 30
    工作论文 · Section 4, equation (1); footnote 6; notes to Table 3
  • Labor market income at age 30 and parental income 劳动收入与收入
    Labor market income in DKK measured at age 30; as a robustness check labor income is defined as the average of labor income at ages 29, 30 and 31. Parental income is measured in the year prior to the child's birth and entered as quartiles; because income data only go back to 1980, about one third of observations have missing parental income.
    登记库： Income registers
    工作论文 · Section 3; Section 5, footnote 8
  • Diabetes-related acute conditions and late complications 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Among individuals with diabetes: probability of having been admitted to hospital for diabetes-related acute conditions (diabetic ketoacidosis or hypoglycemic coma), outcome mean 0.36; probability of having been diagnosed with any late complication by age 30, outcome mean 0.49; glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c), outcome mean 8.2, with lower values indicating better disease management.
    登记库： National Patient Registry (LPR), DanDiabKids
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Figures A2, A4 and A5 notes

Background Matters, but Not Whether Parents Are Immigrants: Outcomes of Children Born in Denmark

Mathias Fjællegaard Jensen and Alan Manning · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2025 · 个人

在丹麦出生、父母为移民的子女，与父母为丹麦出生者的子女相比，劳动收入更低、失业更多、受教育更少、领取的转移支付更多、被定罪也更多。但在控制父母的社会经济特征之后，他们的表现与后者持平甚至略好，可见这些差距反映的是贫困的家庭背景，而不是父母的移民身份。

数据
Danish register data linking children to parents (Statistics Denmark, 1980–2017), Income and earnings registers (annual labour income incl. self-employment, transfers), Monthly employment register (hours, hourly wages, from 2008), Education registers (incl. survey-based registration of foreign education of immigrants), Criminal justice registers (convictions, prison sentences, dropped charges / not-guilty verdicts), Occupation codes (ISCO88)
关键变量
  • 分组：出生在丹麦境外的父母人数（0、1、2；格陵兰／法罗群岛）
  • 结果变量：30 岁时的劳动收入与失业
  • 结果变量：公共转移支付、30 岁前完成的教育程度
  • 结果变量：刑事定罪、监禁判决、被撤销的指控
  • 控制变量：子女童年时期父母的收入、失业年数、职业和教育
时期
1980–2017
样本
396,417 名子女（表 1 合计）；其中父母均为丹麦出生者 362,460 人，父母均为移民 10,399 人，父母一方为移民 20,908 人，父母一方来自格陵兰／法罗群岛 2,650 人 1980–1987 年出生在丹麦、父母双方信息均已知的全部子女，追踪至 30 岁。 来源
调查
Foreign-education survey
变量如何定义（11）
  • Child sample 样本界定与时间
    Everyone born in Denmark 1980-1987 with both parents known in BEF and known parental origin. Observed in the year they turn 30, kept only if fully liable to pay taxes in Denmark (AKM register) and resident in Denmark (BEF). Children missing any outcome or control are dropped (missing parental occupation and education allowed), as are children whose parents were not in the population at birth.
    登记库： BEF, AKM
    在线附录 · Online Appendix OA.1
  • First-generation locals (parental birthplace groups) 移民身份与来源地
    Groups based on the parents' country of birth in BEF: two parents born in Denmark (reference), two parents born outside Denmark, one parent born in Denmark and one abroad, and at least one parent born in Greenland or the Faroe Islands. Origin regions: Middle East = MENAP+MENAT (incl. some North African countries, Israel, Turkey, Pakistan, Afghanistan); Europe split into Nordics, EU-15 ex. Nordic (incl. UK), EU-13 (incl. Cyprus) and non-EU (incl. Yugoslavia).
    登记库： BEF
    代码： Country list per region in Online Appendix Table OA.1
    在线附录 · Online Appendix OA.1 and Table OA.1; paper Section II.A fn. 4
  • Low-income origin 移民身份与来源地
    A first-generation local is 'low income origin' if at least one parent comes from a country whose 1980 GDP per capita (World Bank, supplemented with UN data) was below 4,000 USD at 2022 prices. Parents with only continent observed are assigned by the majority in that continent.
    登记库： BEF, World Bank WDI NY.GDP.PCAP.CD
    代码： 1980 GDP per capita < 4,000 USD (2022 levels)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix OA.1
  • Annual labour market income (earnings at 30) 劳动收入与收入
    Aggregate labour market income including wage income and profits from self-employment in the year the child turns 30, in 2013 prices (CPI-deflated). Also used as an income rank, IHS and log.
    登记库： IND
    在线附录 · Online Appendix OA.1; paper Section III
  • Hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Hourly wage from monthly hours and monthly earnings for employees in the monthly register (available from 2008; self-employed excluded), in 2013 prices. Jobs are excluded if the hourly wage is above 5,000 or below 30 DKK, annual hours are above 3,500 or below 7.4, or total wages are above 10,000,000 or below 1,000 DKK.
    登记库： IDAN
    在线附录 · Online Appendix OA.1
  • Unemployment 失业与福利金
    Not working for at least half of the year and not being retired (child at age 30; parents' years of unemployment counted over the child's first 21 years).

  • Transfers / public benefits 失业与福利金
    Yearly sum of all transfers primarily financed by government institutions, including all unemployment benefits, child benefits, housing support, student benefits and all public pensions, in 2013 prices.
    登记库： IND
    在线附录 · Online Appendix OA.1; paper fn. 6
  • Prison sentence by 30 犯罪
    Indicator equal to one if the child has ever been sentenced to prison, suspended or unsuspended, by the end of the year in which they turn 30.
    登记库： KRAF

  • Guilty and dropped/not-guilty charges 犯罪
    Counts by end of the year turning 30 of guilty charges and of charges dropped without conditions or ending in a not-guilty verdict (following the Danish Institute for Human Rights 2022). Charges dropped with conditions (e.g. payment of a fine) count as guilty. Traffic Law (Faerdselsloven) offences are excluded. The share dropped/not guilty is computed among those with at least one charge.
    登记库： KRSI, KRKO, KRAF

    登记库： IND, AKM, UDDA, BEF

Genetic and Socioeconomic Achievement Gaps in Elementary School

Mikkel Aagaard Houmark, Victor Ronda, Esben Agerbo, Preben Bo Mortensen and Michael Rosholm · Economic Journal, 2025 · 个人

研究表明，按教育程度多基因评分划分的学业成绩差距与按社会经济地位（SES）划分的差距一样大，并且在小学阶段不断扩大，但仅见于低 SES 儿童。对社区和学校的选择解释了部分 SES 差距，却完全不能解释遗传差距；后者与尽责性和学习环境有关。

数据
iPSYCH2015 case-cohort genotype sample (neonatal blood spots from the Danish National Biobank), Danish national tests (reading and mathematics, grades 2–8), Population registers with parent-child links (BEF), Parental income registers (IND), Parental education registers (UDDA), Psychiatric diagnoses of parents (patient registers), School and neighbourhood identifiers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：标准化的全国阅读测试成绩（2、4、6、8 年级）；数学测试（3、6、8 年级）
  • 核心解释变量：教育程度多基因评分（EA PGS）
  • 核心解释变量：由父母收入和教育构建的 SES 指数
  • 兄弟姐妹固定效应：PGS 的家庭内部变异
  • 中介变量：社区和学校分选
时期
1994–2008 年出生；全国测试自 2010 年起
样本
40,136 人、87,917 个阅读测试结果（24,062 名精神疾病病例，16,074 名随机对照）；兄弟姐妹样本 2,705 人 1994–2008 年出生、在 2 年级至 8 年级之间至少完成一次全国测试、已做基因分型的 iPSYCH 欧洲血统儿童。 来源
变量如何定义（11）
  • National reading test score 教育与考试成绩
    Danish national (adaptive, Rasch-scored) reading tests in grades 2, 4, 6 and 8: each of the three profile areas (text comprehension, language comprehension, decoding) is standardised by school year, averaged, and the average re-standardised to mean 0, SD 1. Repeated tests of the same subject-grade are dropped (first test kept by test time).
    登记库： Danish national tests
    代码： FAGID 0102, 0104, 0106, 0108 = reading grades 2, 4, 6, 8; outcome variable ztheta
    工作论文 · Section 3.2; Results (for replication).do
  • National mathematics test score 教育与考试成绩
    Mathematics national tests in grades 3 and 6 and, from 2018, grade 8, constructed in a similar fashion to the reading score.
    登记库： Danish national tests
    代码： FAGID 0203, 0206, 0208 = mathematics grades 3, 6, 8
    复制代码 · Results (for replication).do; IZA DP 15418 Section 3.2
  • Parental years of education 教育与考试成绩
    Mother's and father's highest education category converted to years of schooling.
    登记库： UDDA
    代码： mhighestedu/fhighestedu: 10,15 -> 10 years; 20,25,30,35 -> 13; 40 -> 15; 50,60 -> 16; 65 -> 18; 70 -> 21
    复制代码 · Results (for replication).do, 'Prepare covariates'
  • Family disposable income in early childhood 劳动收入与收入
    Mother's and father's disposable income deflated by CPI (2015=100), averaged over child ages 1-7, summed across parents and logged (set to 0 if negative).
    登记库： IND
    代码： disp_income_m_1..7, disp_income_f_1..7; famdinc18 = momdispinc18 + daddispinc18
    复制代码 · Results (for replication).do
  • SES rank / SES index 劳动收入与收入
    Families are ranked in percentiles (one observation per child) on the sum of parents' years of education and on log family disposable income; the two percentile ranks are summed and re-ranked into percentiles scaled to 0-0.99 (ses_rank), and the SES index is this rank standardised to mean 0, SD 1 within the sample.
    登记库： IND, UDDA
    代码： xtile famedu_rank, faminc_rank nq(100); famses_rank; ses_std = std(ses_rank)
    复制代码 · Results (for replication).do; IZA DP 15418 Section 3.4
  • Parental psychiatric diagnosis 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicators for the mother and father ever having received a psychiatric diagnosis (based on the date of the parent's first psychiatric diagnosis in the parental psychiatry file); an additional indicator flags a diagnosis by the child's birth year.
    登记库： Psychiatric patient registers (parentalpsych file)
    代码： mpsych_date, fpsych_date -> mmh_ever, fmh_ever, mmh_age0, fmh_age0
    复制代码 · Results (for replication).do
  • Risk index / low-SES indicator 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Sum of four risk indicators: both parents with 10 years of education; family disposable income in the bottom birth-cohort quintile; either parent ever with a psychiatric diagnosis; family not intact. ses2 groups risk 0-1 vs 2-4.
    登记库： IND, UDDA, BEF
    代码： risk1..risk4; fdinc2 = xtile(famdinc18, n(5)) by yearborn
    复制代码 · Results (for replication).do
  • Sibling sample / family fixed effect 样本界定与时间
    Families defined by the mother-father ID pair (full siblings); the sibling sample includes children with at least one full sibling observed on the same test.
    登记库： BEF
    代码： fef = group(pnrm pnrf)
    复制代码 · Results (for replication).do
  • European descent sample restriction 移民身份与来源地
    Keeps children of European genetic ancestry (non_european==0) or, if missing, those whose own and both parents' region of birth is Denmark or Europe; required because the EA GWAS uses European-descent samples.
    登记库： BEF, iPSYCH2015
    代码： non_european; region_birth, region_birth_m, region_birth_f in {Denmark, Europe}
    复制代码 · Results (for replication).do, top
  • School quality (teacher-based) 教育与考试成绩
    Following Gensowski et al. (2020), teachers are linked to schools; school-by-year averages of teacher high-school GPA, age, experience, tenure, sick-leave share and share of the previous ten years unemployed are used to predict school national test scores, and the predictions are used to rank schools by teacher quality.
    登记库： Population, institution and workplace registers, Danish national tests
    代码： schoolqlt3 (merged by INSTNR, skoleaar)
    工作论文 · Section 3.6
  • School absence 教育与考试成绩
    Total fraction of school days absent, including all absence regardless of reason, from the absence registries.
    登记库： School absence register (fravaer)
    工作论文 · Section 3.6

The Impact of the Level and Timing of Parental Resources on Child Development and Intergenerational Mobility

Sadegh Eshaghnia, James J. Heckman and Rasmus Landersø · Journal of Labor Economics, 2025 · 个人

利用涵盖父母完整收入史的丹麦登记库，把父母一生资源的水平与这些资源在子女童年期间到来的时点区分开来。一生资源的多寡远比收入何时到来重要；基于较短收入窗口估计的传统代际弹性，会对流动性给出误导性的刻画。

数据
Population register with family links (BEF), Education register (UDDA), Income, assets and transfers register (IND), Sentencing register (KRAF), Incarceration register (KRIN), Danish Household Expenditure Survey, Danish Longitudinal Survey of Children (DALSC), 9th-grade national leaving exam scores
关键变量
  • 结果变量：子女 30–35 岁时的收入（IGE）
  • 结果变量：35 岁前的受教育年限
  • 结果变量：35 岁前是否有过刑事定罪
  • 结果变量：16 岁时的数学考试成绩和 11 岁时的语言测试成绩
  • 解释变量：按子女年龄划分的父母收入/资源的水平与时点（一生收入与单一时点收入对比）
时期
1980–2019
样本
约 100,000 名儿童及其家庭（105,953 人；IGE 双对数样本为 98,686 人） 1981 年和 1982 年出生并与父母相连接的子女，本人及父母均为非迁移者；另加用于考试成绩分析的 1995–1997 年出生队列，以及 DALSC 中 1995 年出生的儿童。 来源
调查
Expenditure Survey, DALSC
变量如何定义（9）
  • Parental wage income 劳动收入与收入
    Pre-tax taxable wage earnings plus other wage-type income such as fringe benefits and stock options; parental resources are the sum of mother's and father's amounts irrespective of marital status, measured at each age of the child.
    登记库： IND
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, measure 1
  • Disposable income 劳动收入与收入
    Total personal income (wage income, business and self-employment income, capital income, public transfer income, property income and other non-classifiable personal income) plus the rental value of own home for owner-occupiers, minus taxes and interest expenses. Spouses' or cohabitees' resources pooled where appropriate.
    登记库： IND
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, measure 2 and footnote 18
  • Expected lifetime wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Expected present value at age t of future disposable income (adjusted for unrealized housing capital gains) discounted with a subjective stochastic discount factor (beta = 0.96), where expectations condition on an estimated information set (gender, education level, employment status, cohabitation, number of children, quartiles of mean income, mean consumption, consumption growth and consumption SD, homeownership, and interactions).
    登记库： IND, UDDA, BEF, Danish Household Expenditure Survey
    工作论文 · Sections 2.1, 3.2 measure 3 and 3.3
  • Imputed household consumption 财富、负债与消费
    Household consumption predicted from register disposable income and assets and liabilities in t and t-1 by a random forest (number of trees by 5-fold cross-validation) trained on the Danish Household Expenditure Survey (1997+); adult-equivalent using the OECD equivalence scale.
    登记库： IND, Danish Household Expenditure Survey
    工作论文 · Appendix A.1, 'Danish Household Expenditure Survey'
  • Years of education by age 35 教育与考试成绩
    Minimum number of years it takes to complete the highest degree obtained by age 35.
    登记库： UDDA
    工作论文 · Section 3.1
  • Participation in crime by age 35 犯罪
    Indicator for appearing in the crime registers (criminal convictions from the sentencing register KRAF) by age 35, regardless of offence type. Appendix D.2 splits into violent, property (e.g. forgery, arson, burglary, theft, shoplifting, embezzlement, fraud, extortion, robbery, tax fraud, vandalism) and other crimes (all except violent, property and traffic), measured by ages 20, 25 and 30.
    登记库： KRAF, KRIN
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, footnote 17; Appendix A.1; Appendix D.2
  • Math test score at age 16 教育与考试成绩
    Mathematics grade at the 9th-grade national leaving exam for all children born 1995-1997, standardised to mean 0 and SD 1.
    登记库： UDFK
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; Appendix A.1-A.2
  • Language test score at age 11 教育与考试成绩
    Language development test at age 11 from the Danish Longitudinal Survey of Children (children born 15 Sept-31 Oct 1995, 2007 wave), standardised to mean 0 and SD 1.
    登记库： DALSC
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; Appendix A.1 'DALSC'
  • IGE sample (1981-1982 cohorts) 样本界定与时间
    Children born 1981-1982 linked to parents, with neither child nor parents having migrated (105,953); child resources averaged over ages 30-35; for log-log IGE, zero/negative average income and incomes more than 4 SD from the mean dropped (100,344) and children with fewer than three observations dropped (98,686).
    登记库： BEF, IND

Attendance Boundary Policies and the Limits to Combating School Segregation

Andreas Bjerre-Nielsen and Mikkel Høst Gandil · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2024 · 个人

利用覆盖丹麦全体儿童的地址层面数据以及学校学区边界随时间的变动。家庭会抵制被重新划入社会经济地位较低的学校，资源充裕的家庭尤甚，因此把边界改划向高度弱势的学校几乎不会改变这些学校的学生构成。

数据
Register data on the universe of Danish children (Statistics Denmark), School attendance boundary data with boundary changes over time
关键变量
  • 处理：因学区边界变动，某一居住区域被重新划入另一所学校
  • 结果变量：在被划定的学校入学（或不服从划定）
  • 异质性：家庭的社会经济资源
  • 新学校学生的社会经济构成
时期
所查资料中未注明
样本
所查资料中未注明 居住区域受学区边界变动影响的丹麦儿童（全体）。 来源（摘要）
变量如何定义（6）
  • Household SES index 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Population rank (uniform on the unit interval) of the first principal component of four household variables: INC = highest market-income rank among adults in the household; LCE = any adult has completed a long-cycle education; NE = any adult has no education beyond primary school or no registered education; EMP = any adult is employed. With z-scored inputs, SES = 0.62 INC + 0.38 LCE - 0.44 NE + 0.53 EMP (47 percent of variance explained).
    登记库： Statistics Denmark registers (income, education, employment)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A (Construction of SES index), equation (1)
  • School SES (average school SES) 教育与考试成绩

一场针对婴儿猝死综合征的全国性宣传运动，主要借助覆盖所有家庭的护士家访来开展；基于全体人口出生数据的断点回归显示，它使婴儿死亡率下降 17%。低出生体重儿和早产儿的效应要大 11 至 14 倍，且效应集中在社会经济地位较低的家庭。

The scale and nature of neighborhood effects on children

Stephen B. Billings, Mark Hoekstra and Gabriel Pons Rotger · Journal of Public Economics, 2024 · 个人

利用哥本哈根把急需住房的家庭准随机分配到社会住房单元的做法，考察哪些社区特征对儿童重要，以及这些特征在怎样的地理尺度上起作用。社区质量根据所分配住房单元步行 2 至 15 分钟范围内全部邻居的登记数据构建。对教育（以及发表版中的劳动收入）的影响很大，但范围非常局部，而对持有毒品的影响则在更大的尺度上起作用；社区的失业和教育状况比社区收入更能预测结果。

数据
Statistics Denmark administrative registers (cited as the Statistics Denmark database of administrative records; individual registers are not named): residential location and family structure of all Copenhagen residents, gender, immigration history and ethnicity, Register information on employment/unemployment, social assistance, disposable income and education of family members and neighbours, Criminal charges (Penal Code offences and possession of narcotic drugs), Health records: mortality, doctor visits and contacts with psychiatric treatment and care, Municipality of Copenhagen social-housing allocation records for urgent-need households (first housing offers), 2009–2014, OpenStreetMap route network (walking times between addresses) and Boliga property-sale listings (hedonic house-price measure) — non-register sources
关键变量
  • 处理：首次获得提供的社会住房单元所在社区的质量（邻居的收入、失业、教育以及一个综合指数），在步行 2、5、10 和 15 分钟范围内测量
  • 结果变量：进入高中教育
  • 结果变量：因触犯《刑法典》被指控；因持有麻醉毒品被指控（16 岁以后）
  • 结果变量：首次获得住房提供后四年内与精神科治疗和照护有过任何接触
  • 控制变量：分配的年份和月份、家庭规模、特殊需要申请
  • 异质性：性别、少数族裔/多数族裔、与原住所的距离
时期
住房分配发生于 2009–2014 年；结果变量追踪至 2020 年底（工作论文版本）
样本
1,171 名被分配到社会住房的儿童（NBER 工作论文版本的表 1）；步行 15 分钟范围内平均有 24,198 名邻居 2009–2014 年从哥本哈根市政府（Municipality of Copenhagen）获得首次社会住房提供的急需住房家庭中的学龄儿童（0–8 年级）。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Quasi-random social housing assignment (first offer to urgent-need households) 样本界定与时间
    Every third social housing unit that becomes vacant in Copenhagen is reserved by the municipality for households with 'urgent needs'. When a reserved unit is ready, the allocation program queues applicants whose household size and composition match the apartment and selects the application with the oldest referral date; neighbour characteristics and applicant preferences play no role. The first offer is used as the assigned unit (63% accept it). Units in local areas with more than 40% adult unemployment on January 1 are ineligible that year. Main sample: 1,171 children provided housing in 2009-2014.
    登记库： Municipality of Copenhagen social housing allocation records, Statistics Denmark administrative registers (not named individually)
    代码： Every third vacant unit; first offer; assignment years 2009-2014; 40% local-area adult unemployment ineligibility threshold; compliance 63%
    工作论文 · Sections 'Denmark Social Housing Policy' and 'Data'
  • Neighbourhood boundary by walking time 地理与社区
    For each social housing apartment address, all residential addresses within 3 km bird's-eye distance are identified and the OpenStreetMap route network is used to compute the walking time of the nearest path between each address and the apartment. Neighbourhoods are the residents within 2, 5, 10 and 15 minutes' walk (every minute from 1 to 15 in the figures), averaging 527, 2,835, 10,930 and 24,198 neighbours respectively.
    登记库： Residential addresses of all Copenhagen residents (Statistics Denmark), OpenStreetMap
    代码： 3 km radius; walking-time cut-offs 2, 5, 10, 15 minutes
    工作论文 · Footnote 7 and Results section
  • Neighbourhood quality (income, unemployment, education and summary index) 地理与社区
    Neighbourhood averages of the family attributes defined in Table 1: family income (average rank, 0-100, in disposable income among families of similar composition in the five years before assignment), family unemployment (average unemployment rate of family members aged 18 or older in the five years before assignment) and family education (average years of schooling of family members aged 25 or older). All are measured immediately before the household's assignment and scaled to mean zero and standard deviation one; the summary index combines the three (unemployment sign reversed) following Anderson (2008).
    登记库： Income, employment and education registers (Statistics Denmark; not named individually)
    代码： Standardised to mean 0, SD 1; five-year pre-assignment window; age cut-offs 18+ (unemployment) and 25+ (education)
    工作论文 · Section 'Measurement of neighborhood quality'; Table 1 and Table 2 notes
  • Education enrollment 教育与考试成绩
    Indicator that the child was enrolled in upper secondary education between the date of the first social housing offer and January 1, 2021.
    登记库： Education register (Statistics Denmark; not named)
    工作论文 · Table 1 notes
  • Crime and possession of narcotic drugs 犯罪
    Crime: the child was charged for offences against the Danish Penal Code after the first social housing assignment and after age 16 (described in the text as violent or property crime, excluding drug and technical offences). Possession of narcotic drugs: the child was charged for possession of narcotic drugs after the first offer of social housing and after age 16. Family crime and family drug possession are the same charges for at least one family member in the five years before assignment.
    登记库： Criminal charges register (Statistics Denmark; not named)
    代码： Charges after age 16 and after first offer; five-year pre-assignment window for family measures
    工作论文 · Table 1 notes; Data section

Neighbourhood Gangs, Crime Spillovers and Teenage Motherhood

Christian Dustmann, Mikkel Mertz and Anna Okatenko · Economic Journal, 2023 · 个人

利用 1986 至 1998 年间难民被随机分配到各市镇这一安排。分配所在社区的帮派犯罪提高了男孩在 19 岁前犯罪的概率和女孩少女生育的概率，并带来持久后果：在 19 至 28 岁，男性更多处于非经济活动状态，女性劳动收入更低、领取福利更多。

数据
Immigration register, Annual population registers (BEF), Central Police Register (criminal charges and convictions), Education registers (including survey-based register of immigrants' education), Income registers and register-based labour force statistics (RAS), National Patient Register (abortions)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：少女生育（15–18 岁期间生育子女）；男孩的青少年犯罪定罪
  • 处理：分配当年所在市镇 15–25 岁男性的团伙（帮派）犯罪定罪率
  • 识别：1986–1998 年分散安置政策下难民被准随机分配到各市镇
  • 长期结果变量：劳动收入、就业、教育
时期
难民分配为 1986–1998 年；人口登记库为 1980–2019 年
样本
8,172 名被分配的难民儿童；少女生育估计样本中有 3,792 名女孩 来自八个难民来源国、1986 至 1998 年间在 0–14 岁时被分配到丹麦各市镇的难民儿童，逐年观测至 19 岁。 来源
调查
Foreign-education survey
变量如何定义（9）
  • Convictions (guilty cases) 犯罪
    Judicial decisions 1980-2018 from the conviction register; for each person-case (journr) the final decision is kept (appeals), and a case counts as guilty unless the decision type is acquittal or dismissal. Offences are classified by 7-digit offence code into violent/sexual, property, drug, other and traffic, and traffic offences are dropped; the date of the offence comes from the charge register.
    登记库： KRAF (conviction register), KRSI (charge register)
    代码： AFG_AFGTYP3 in 514, 411, 412, 413, 414 = acquitted/dismissed (else guilty); AFG_GER7: sexual and violent 1110505-1180705 and 1210501-1292520; property 1304505-1398590; drug 1435505-1440505 and 3210505-3210510; other 1410303-1430740, 1445705-1485720, 3410505-3410509, 3610105-3870505 (residual non-missing also other); traffic 2110005-2610180 (dropped)
    复制代码 · do/build/clean/convictions.do
  • Group (gang) crime conviction 犯罪
    A conviction for a gang-type offence in a case where more than one person is convicted (gang_crime_3 requires at least three). Gang-type offences are non-sexual violence, arson/robbery-type property offences, drug offences and weapons offences; a case is gang-type if anyone in the case is convicted of a gang-type offence.
    登记库： KRAF
    代码： gang type: 2-digit AFG_GER7 (floor(ger7/100000)) == 12; 4-digit (floor(ger7/1000)) in 1312, 1339, 1380, 1390, 1435, 1440, 3410; 7-digit in 1366505, 1445750, 1445777-1445782, 3210510; gang_crime = N convicted in journr > 1 & gang type
    复制代码 · do/build/clean/convictions.do
  • Municipal youth (gang) crime conviction rate 犯罪
    Per municipality and year: number of male residents aged 15-25 (calendar year minus birth year between 15 and 26) with at least one conviction (resp. gang-crime conviction) for an offence committed that year at age above 14 and below 27, divided by the number of such male residents, times 100. Offences from 2017 onward or before 1980 are dropped.
    登记库： KRAF, KRSI, BEF
    代码： sh_g (gang), sh_nc (overall); KOEN==1 for men; KOM municipality
    复制代码 · do/build/prepare/kom_year_n_criminals.do
  • Assigned refugee (dispersal-policy sample) 移民身份与来源地
    Immigrants arriving 1986-1998 from refugee-sending countries (Balkan origins excluded as covered by a different placement policy), with some countries restricted by arrival year; the household head at immigration is identified via father, mother (if under 18) or spouse links, and individuals arriving more than a year after the household head, or with a gap of more than one year between immigration and first appearance in the registers, are dropped.
    登记库： BEF, Immigration register (date of immigration)
    代码： IELAND: Iraq 5436; Iran 5438 (arrival>=1980); Vietnam 5468, 5488; Sri Lanka 5418 (>=1984); stateless Lebanon 5103, 5456, 5473; Ethiopia 5214 (<1991); Afghanistan 5404; Somalia 5289 (>=1989); keep refugee_ieland<=8
    复制代码 · do/build/prepare/assigned_refugees.do
  • Assignment municipality 地理与社区
    The first municipality (KOM) in which the household head at assignment is observed in the population registers after immigration; children assigned to a different municipality than their household head are dropped, and Copenhagen assignment is KOM 101.
    登记库： BEF
    代码： first_kom = kom[1]; copenhagen = KOM 101
    复制代码 · do/build/prepare/assigned_refugees.do; sample_girls_15_20_at_assignment.do
  • Teenage motherhood 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Date of first birth is the earliest birth date among children linked to the woman through the mother ID (PNRM) in the population registers; teenage motherhood (mother_1518) equals 1 if the first birth occurs at age at least 14 and below 19 (commented 'had a child by age 19'). For girls aged 15-20 at assignment, motherhood within 4 years of assignment is used, dropping those whose first birth is within 280 days of immigration.
    登记库： BEF
    代码： PNRM (mother ID); mother_1518 = (date_first_birth - date_birth)/365.25 in [14,19)
    复制代码 · do/build/clean/pnr_date_first_two_births.do; do/build/prepare/kids_by_age.do; sample_girls_15_20_at_assignment.do
  • Abortion 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicator for an abortion diagnosis in the National Patient Register 1980-2014 (medical, other, unspecified and failed attempted abortion), attached to refugee girls.
    登记库： LPR
    代码： ICD-10 (DIAG first 4 chars) DO04, DO05, DO06, DO07
    复制代码 · do/build/prepare/abortion.do
  • Labour market status (employed / unemployed / not in labour force) 就业与劳动力状态
    Primary labour market status in the last week of November from RAS, with code schemes varying by year.
    登记库： RAS
    代码： 1981-1993 ARBSTIL: employed 11-39, unemployed 40, NILF 50-92 (1990+ keep NOVPRIO==1); 1994-1995 NYARB: employed 11-39, unemployed 40, NILF 41-400; 1996-2007 SOCSTIL_KODE: employed 115-199, unemployed 200, NILF 201-400; 2008-2015 SOC_STATUS_KODE (PRIMAER_STATUS_KODE==1): employed 110-138, 611, 612, unemployed 200, NILF 311-517
    复制代码 · do/build/clean/pool_ras_for_lm_status.do
  • Long-run income and education outcomes 劳动收入与收入
    For assigned refugee children 1987-2018, income outcomes are taken from the income register over the full year and education from the education registers (measured in October of the year prior), with employment taken from RAS for November of the previous year.
    登记库： IND, UDDA, UDDANY, RAS
    代码： IND: PERINDKIALT_13, LOENMV_13, ERHVERVSINDK_13, STIP, OFF_OVERFORSEL_13, NETOVSKUD_13; UDDA: HFAUDD; RAS ARBSTIL 11-37 employed, 40 unemployed (pre-1994)
    复制代码 · do/build/prepare/Refugee_income.do

Replication package

Intergenerational Spillover Effects of Language Training for Refugees

Mette Foged, Linea Hasager, Giovanni Peri, Jacob Nielsen Arendt and Iben Bolvig · Journal of Public Economics, 2023 · 个人

追踪受 1999 年丹麦改善语言培训的改革影响的难民的子女。处理组父母的子女取得了更好的教育结果，表明语言培训带来的融入收益会延续到下一代。

数据
Danish administrative registers from Statistics Denmark on refugees' asylum/admission dates and parent–child links, Lower secondary school completion and final exam records, Criminal conviction records (property, violent, narcotics crime), Earnings, occupation (ISCO), disposable income, marriage and fertility registers for parents
关键变量
  • 驱动变量：父母获准居留（获批庇护）的日期相对于 1999 年 1 月 1 日的位置（Integration Act 语言培训改革）
  • 结果变量：18 岁前完成初中学业并参加毕业考试
  • 结果变量：15 至 18 岁之间的刑事定罪
  • 父母的结果变量：年劳动收入、从事复杂工作、可支配收入、定罪
时期
1990–2001 年出生的儿童，追踪至 2019 年；父母的结果变量为 1999–2016 年
样本
6,467 名儿童；5,197 名成年父母 1990–2001 年出生、父母中至少一方在 1999 年 1 月 1 日前后的四年窗口内在丹麦获批庇护、并在小学学龄之前或期间抵达的儿童。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Treatment / running variable: parent's admission date 移民身份与来源地
    A child is treated if the first parent was granted refugee status (admission date) on or after 1 January 1999, when the Integration Act's language training applied. The running variable is days between the admission date and the cutoff; specifications using the father's admission date are also reported.
    登记库： Danish administrative registers (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section IV (eq. 1)
  • Child sample 样本界定与时间
    Children born 1990-2001 with at least one parent granted asylum in Denmark within a four-year window around 1 January 1999. Children were born in the first three years after the reform or were of pre-school or primary-school age on arrival. They are followed to age 18, through 2019; 6,467 children with parents born 1948-1982.
    登记库： Danish administrative registers (parent-child links)
    工作论文 · Section III (Data), footnote 8
  • Lower secondary completion and final exam 教育与考试成绩
    Two indicators: the child completed lower secondary (compulsory) school by age 18 (before turning 19), and the child took the final exams marking the end of lower secondary school. Exemption from the exams, e.g. for low language proficiency, is possible.
    登记库： Education registers
    工作论文 · Section III, footnote 9; Section V, Table 3
  • Child criminal convictions ages 15-18 犯罪
    Indicator for any criminal conviction between ages 15 and 18, and separate indicators for property, violent and narcotics crime.
    登记库： Criminal conviction records
    工作论文 · Section III; Table 3
  • Complex job (parents) 职业与职位层级
    Indicator for working in an occupation from managers (ISCO 1) to services and sales workers (ISCO 5), jobs that require some schooling and technical knowledge, or literacy and good communication skills.
    登记库： Occupation register
    代码： ISCO major groups 1-5 = complex
    工作论文 · Section III (Data)
  • Parental earnings and disposable income 劳动收入与收入
    Annual gross earnings in year-2000 prices converted to USD at 6.6 DKK/USD. Disposable income includes public transfers net of taxes, deflated to year-2000 USD.
    登记库： Income registers
    工作论文 · Section III and III.A
  • Parental marriage and fertility 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator for marrying a Danish citizen, and total number of children born after admission.
    登记库： Population/family registers
    工作论文 · Section III (Data)

Spillover Effects of Early-Life Medical Interventions

N. Meltem Daysal, Marianne Simonsen, Mircea Trandafir and Sanni Breining · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2022 · 个人

对极低出生体重新生儿的额外医疗救治（借助一个出生体重门槛加以识别）不仅改善了被救治婴儿本人的状况，也改善了其哥哥姐姐的结果，后者在学校表现更好。家庭资源和父母投入的时间会随孩子的健康状况而调整。

数据
Medical Birth Register (MFR): birth weight, gestational age, parity, Parent and sibling links (BEF), 9th-grade exam test score register (reading and math), Education/enrollment registers, Prescription drug register (antidepressant use, from 1995), Health registers for diagnoses (intellectual disability, ADHD) and mortality, Income and labour market registers for parents
关键变量
  • 驱动变量：焦点儿童的出生体重相对于 1,500 克 VLBW 临界值
  • 结果变量：兄弟姐妹九年级阅读和数学的标准化考试成绩
  • 结果变量：兄弟姐妹到 19 岁时是否在义务教育之后继续就读，以及高中类别
  • 机制：焦点儿童的死亡率和心理健康；母亲的抗抑郁药使用；父母的收入、就业、工作天数
时期
焦点儿童出生于 1982–1993 年；考试成绩为 2001–2010 年
样本
5,827 个兄弟姐妹观测值（3,677 名焦点儿童的兄弟姐妹） 1982–1993 年出生、出生体重在 1,300 至 1,700 克之间的丹麦儿童的（同母）兄弟姐妹。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • VLBW treatment / running variable 样本界定与时间
    Focal child's birth weight (bw) centred at 1,500 grams; treatment indicator vlbw = 1 if birth weight < 1,500 g; local linear RD with separate slopes on each side and triangular weights 1-|bw-1500|/bandwidth.
    登记库： MFR
    代码： vlbw = (bw < 1500); f1 = (bw-1500)*vlbw; f2 = (bw-1500)*(1-vlbw)
    复制代码 · 09 Final data preparation and analyses.do, lines ~568-574
  • 9th-grade exam grades (Danish oral, math written) 教育与考试成绩
    Grades from the 9th-grade school-leaving exams (proeveform 'Prøvefag 2002-2006' or 'Bundne prøvefag', not teacher 'Standpunkt' marks) in Danish oral (Mundtlig) and Mathematics written/problem-solving/skills; set to missing for cohorts born before 1986 or after 1997. In indices, non-test outcomes are standardized by birth year.
    登记库： UDFK
    代码： UDFK2013: GRUNDSKOLEFAG in ('Dansk','Matematik'); FAGDISCIPLIN 'Mundtlig' (Danish) / 'Skriftlig','Matematisk problemløsning','Matematiske færdigheder' (math); proeveform in ('Prøvefag 2002-2006','Bundne prøvefag')
    复制代码 · 00 NICU.sas, lines ~2125-2205; 02 Adding outcomes.sas lines ~671-676

    Ongoing education (IGUDD) from the education registers mapped to DST audit groups; ac_track = enrolled in general upper secondary (gymnasium) at any age 14-19; voc_track = enrolled in vocational education at ages 14-19; ac_track_at_18 = gymnasium enrollment at age 18; enrolled_beyond = ac_track or voc_track.
    登记库： UDDA
    代码： IGUDD -> udd2011_l1l2_k (igfsp_kort); gym = 2015,2016,2017,2018,2539,2551; vocational = 3039,3040,3042,3044,3046,3048,3049,3050,3520,3539,3553,3554,3555,3558,3560,3575,3580,3585,3590; higher = 4025,4039,4059,4090,5010,5020,5030,5039,5059,5090,6025,6030,6035,6039,6059,6080,6090
    复制代码 · 06e Adding educ track rev.sas, lines ~128-217; 09 do-file line 674
  • Parental days worked (intensive labour supply) 工作时间
    Annual change in cumulative labour market experience ERHVER (measured in 1/1000 years) converted to days: dif_erhverv/(1000/260); person-years with negative changes (e.g., stays abroad) dropped; measured 0-15 years after the child's birth.
    登记库： IDA (persondata)

    复制代码 · 06 Adding parental labor outcomes rev.sas, lines ~470-705
  • Parental employment (extensive margin) 就业与劳动力状态
    Indicator equal to 1 if the annual change in cumulative experience ERHVER is non-zero in the year, 0 if zero.
    登记库： IDA (persondata)
