Child's Gender, Young Fathers' Crime, and Spillover Effects in Criminal Behavior

Christian Dustmann and Rasmus Landersø · Journal of Political Economy, 2021 · 个人

以头胎子女的性别作为丹麦年轻父亲的自然实验。与生女儿相比，生儿子会降低父亲此后的犯罪行为，而且这种下降会外溢到父亲的同伴，并在日后外溢到子女身上，由此既识别出直接的养育反应，也识别出犯罪中的网络效应。

数据
Birth register (child's gender, parent links), Population register (BEF) for demographics and family links, Central Police Register crime data (charges and convictions), Victim register (from 2001), Income, education and occupation registers, Residential register with neighbourhood classification
关键变量
  • 结果变量：年轻父亲的犯罪定罪与指控
  • 处理：头胎是儿子还是女儿
  • 溢出结果变量：父亲所在社区男性同伴的犯罪
  • 同伴群体：同一社区内与父亲年龄相差 ±3 岁以内的男性
  • 结果变量：社区内的犯罪受害情况
时期
1991–2004 年出生的儿童；犯罪数据自 1990 年起
样本
2,803 名 20 岁及以下初为人父者；2,114 个社区中的 101,132 名男性同伴 1991 年至 2004 年间在 20 岁及以下生育第一个孩子的丹麦男性，以及其所在社区的男性同伴。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Crime (convictions and charges) 犯罪
    Charges or convictions for offences against the criminal code from the Central Police Register, excluding traffic offences; convictions (court rulings of guilt) are the preferred measure. Charges and convictions are dated by the date the crime was committed (exact crime dates available from 1990); records are observed even after deletion from the individual's criminal record.
    登记库： Central Police Register (crime register)
    论文正文 · Section II.A and footnote 7
  • Crime categories 犯罪
    Property crime: theft, fencing, aggravated vandalism, fraud, burglary, forgery, economic crimes. Violent crime: simple violence (assault), severe or life-threatening violence, threats, violence against or obstructing a public servant, failure to help a person in danger, coercion, attempted murder or homicide. Other crime: drug possession and sale, possession of weapons/explosives, false testimony, sexual crimes.
    登记库： Central Police Register
    论文正文 · Footnote 8; online Table A1 (code breakdown, not read)
  • Young first-time father sample / treatment 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Males who father their first child at age 20 or younger, children born 1991-2004 (birth and demographic registers), with information on both parents from the birth for up to 5 subsequent years, matched uniquely to a neighbourhood; treatment is the first child being a son. Fathers in neighbourhoods with more than one young father having a first child in the same year are excluded.
    登记库： Birth register, BEF
    论文正文 · Section II.B and footnote 9
  • Neighbourhood 地理与社区
    Neighbourhoods follow the classification documented in Damm and Schultz-Nielsen (2008), constructed in 2004, linked to individuals through anonymised home address identifiers in the residential register; the largest and smallest 5% of neighbourhoods are excluded from most analyses.
    登记库： Residential register, BEF
    论文正文 · Section II.B
  • Peer group and peer crime 犯罪
    Peers are all males within +/-3 years of the focal father's age living in the father's neighbourhood on January 1 of the year the child is born (alternatively all males aged 14-25 at the birth), regardless of later moves; the father and his family members are excluded. Peer crime is their convictions/charges.
    登记库： Residential register, BEF, Central Police Register
    论文正文 · Section II.B; footnote 5
  • Neighbourhood victimisation 犯罪
    Based on individuals who report having been the victim of a crime (register available from 2001); victim sample includes all individuals living in the father's neighbourhood at the time of the birth, counting the number of victims in each neighbourhood.
    登记库： Victim register
    论文正文 · Section II.B (victim sample) and footnote 10

Education, Birth Order and Family Size

Jesper Bagger, Javier A. Birchenall, Hani Mansour and Sergio Urzúa · Economic Journal, 2021 · 个人

构建了一个包含出生次序偏好和人力资本成本差异的父母投资模型，由此得到广义的数量—质量权衡。丹麦行政数据证实了模型的预测：在任一给定的出生次序上，家庭规模较小的孩子受教育更多；即便考虑了出生次序，孩子的平均受教育程度也随家庭规模扩大而下降。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), 1980–2006, with mother-child links, Precise date of birth from Statistics Denmark (to identify twin/multiple births)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：受教育年限（2006 年测量）
  • 核心解释变量：出生次序与家庭规模
  • 工具变量：最后一胎为双胞胎（第 2、第 3 或第 4 胎为双胞胎）
  • 控制变量：父母教育、性别、年龄
时期
1980–2006 年（结果变量于 2006 年测量）
样本
581,159 个家庭中的 1,256,031 名子女（剔除独生子女家庭） 2006 年年龄为 25–41 岁、其母亲在 1980–2006 年间在世且出现在 IDA 中的个人，所在家庭已完成生育，兄弟姐妹按同母界定。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Years of education 教育与考试成绩
    Highest completed education in 2006 from the IDA person files (8-digit HFFSP code), mapped to years of education using the first two digits per Table A.1 (e.g. 10 = primary: 7 years if born 1958 or earlier, 9 years if born 1959 or later; 20/25 = high school 12; 35 = vocational 12; 40 = short further 14; 50 = medium-length further 16; 60 = Bachelor 15; 65 = Master 18; 70 = PhD 20; 90 = unknown, missing).
    登记库： IDA
    代码： HFFSP 2-digit: 10->7/9, 15,17->10, 20->12, 25->12, 30->10, 35->12, 40->14, 50->16, 60->15, 65->18, 70->20, 90->missing
    工作论文 · Appendix C and Table A.1
  • Family size and siblings 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Siblings are children born to the same mother (families defined by mother's identity, via the IDA pointer to mother's person ID); family size is the number of siblings born to the same mother, recorded before individual-level selection. Families with children born after 1991 (any child aged 0-14 residing at mother's address in 2006) are excluded so family size reflects completed fertility.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 4 and Appendix C (fn. 29)
  • Birth order 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Order of birth of each child within the mother's family, identified using precise date of birth obtained from Statistics Denmark and merged onto IDA (69.4% of IDA individuals matched, unmatched mostly older cohorts).
    登记库： IDA, Date-of-birth data (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Appendix C and footnote 22
  • Twin (multiple) birth instrument 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Multiple births identified from precise dates of birth (24,186 twin sets, 217 triplets, 5 quadruplets); twin observations themselves are dropped, retaining an indicator for a twin birth in the family and its order. Family size is instrumented with twins at the second, third or fourth birth in respective samples, and with twins at last birth.
    登记库： IDA, Date-of-birth data (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Appendix C (fn. 25) and Section 5
  • Analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    Individuals aged 25-41 in 2006 linked to a mother alive, aged 15-70 and present in IDA during 1980-2006. Excludes families with mother younger than 17 or older than 49 at birth, missing education for any member, non-twin siblings born less than seven months apart, unknown or different fathers, children born after 1991, and single-child families; 1,256,031 individuals in 581,159 families.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 4 (fn. 15) and Appendix C
  • Parental income measures 劳动收入与收入
    Parental income measures are trimmed by recoding observations in the 1st and 99th percentiles as missing; mother's education measured in the last year she appears in the data.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Appendix C

Home Prices, Fertility, and Early-Life Health Outcomes

N. Meltem Daysal, Michael Lovenheim, Nikolaj Siersbæk and David N. Wasser · Journal of Public Economics, 2021 · 个人

对 20 至 44 岁的丹麦房主而言，房价上涨 100,000 克朗会使生育概率提高约 2.35%。出生结果也有所改善，但主要是因为生育者的构成发生了变化；对儿童出生后头五年的健康则没有影响。

数据
Medical Birth Register (MFR), National Patient Register (LPR), State's Sales and Valuation Registry (public property valuations and sales prices), Population register (BEF) and other registers for demographics, education, household income and partner status
关键变量
  • 处理：滞后一期的估计住房价值一年变动（公共评估值按当地成交价比率调整）
  • 结果变量：是否生育的指示变量
  • 结果变量：出生体重、低出生体重、极低出生体重、早产
  • 结果变量：出生后第一年及 1–5 岁期间的住院、急诊就诊和住院天数
  • 比较组：租房者
时期
1992–2011 年（生育分析为 1995–2006 年）
样本
198,435 名女性的 1,105,559 个观测值（125,903 次生育） 在 1993 至 2004 年间首次成为房主、购房时年龄在 18 至 42 岁之间的 20–44 岁女性。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Estimated home value 财富、负债与消费
    The public valuation of the home times the owner's share, multiplied by the mean ratio of sale price to public valuation among homes sold in the same year, municipality, housing type and valuation-quartile cluster (a SPAR-type index); woman's and partner's shares are summed. The value is fixed to the first house the woman is observed buying, and is in 100,000 DKK at 2006 prices (CPI-deflated).
    登记库： State's Sales and Valuation Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3, equation (1)
  • Once-lagged one-year home price change 财富、负债与消费
    One-year change in estimated home value, lagged one year relative to the fertility outcome. Public valuations were made in January of the prior year until end-2003 and in October of the prior year afterwards. Homes whose valuation rose by more than 50% in a year, and the 1st and 99th percentiles of the lagged change, are excluded.
    登记库： State's Sales and Valuation Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3 and 3.1, footnote 13
  • Housing sample restrictions 样本界定与时间
    Residential houses and apartments in clusters with at least five sales; only normal sales between individuals (no intra-family sales). Excluded: negative valuations or sale prices, multiple addresses at the same location, and sales above 300% or below 40% of the public valuation.
    登记库： State's Sales and Valuation Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, Appendix Table A-1
  • Potential first-time homeowner women 样本界定与时间
    Women not homeowners at the beginning of 1992-1993 who became homeowners between 1993 and 2004 at ages 18-42; owning means the woman, her partner or both own the home. Women whose partner bought before the couple formed, who moved out of the new home within the year, or who have incomplete income or home data are dropped, leaving women aged 20-44 observed 1995-2006.
    登记库： Population Registry, State's Sales and Valuation Registry
    工作论文 · Section 1 footnote 2; Section 3.1
  • Low / very low birth weight, prematurity 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    From the Birth Registry for live births: low birth weight is below 2,500 grams, very low birth weight below 1,500 grams, and premature is gestational age under 37 completed weeks; birth weight is also used continuously.
    登记库： Medical Birth Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3
  • Hospital admissions, inpatient days and ER visits 医疗服务利用
    Indicators for any hospital admission and any ER visit in the first year of life and at ages 1-5, plus the number of days hospitalised and ER visits in the first five years. Inpatient days exclude the childbirth admission and the following four days.
    登记库： National Patient Register
    工作论文 · Section 3, footnote 12
  • Giving birth / conception timing 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator for giving birth in the year, from the Birth Registry. In a robustness check, the conception date is computed from gestational length and birth date, the price change is scaled by the fraction of the year before conception, and non-mothers get randomly assigned birth months.
    登记库： Medical Birth Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3; Section 4 robustness
  • Imputed household consumption 财富、负债与消费
    Household consumption imputed from income and year-to-year wealth changes following Browning and Leth-Petersen (2003).
    登记库： Danish income and wealth registers
    工作论文 · Section 5 (credit constraints)

Paul Bingley, Lorenzo Cappellari and Konstantinos Tatsiramos · Economic Journal, 2021 · 个人

在考虑生命周期动态的前提下，将丹麦人口中兄弟姐妹在持久劳动收入、教育和失业方面的相关性分解为家庭成分和社区成分。家庭是主导因素；社区背景在职业生涯早期影响劳动收入和失业的相关性，但很快消退。

数据
Civil registration system / population register with parent links (BEF), Central person register address histories (parish of residence), Education register / national pupil database (school at age 15), Annual earnings from tax-based income registers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：税前年劳动收入（劳动收入对数的残差），1984–2011 年
  • 分组：兄弟（家庭）、15 岁时的同校同学、15 岁时的同堂区邻居
  • 参数：生命周期内的兄弟、同校同伴和邻居相关系数
时期
1960–1983 年出生的男性；劳动收入为 1984–2011 年
样本
695,960 名男性；10,930,859 个劳动收入观测值（122,652 对兄弟，380,948 名无配对兄弟的个体） 1960–1983 年出生的丹麦男性（拥有相同法定父母的长子和次子，另加无配对兄弟的个体和同龄同伴），并与其 15 岁时的同校同学和同堂区邻居相关联。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Residual log annual earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Pre-tax annual labour earnings 1984-2011 in 2005 prices; zero-earnings observations excluded, a quarter of a percentile trimmed from each tail of the annual distribution, and at least three consecutive earnings observations required. Residuals from regressing log real gross annual earnings on year dummies and a quadratic age trend by two-year birth cohort group.
    登记库： Tax-based income registers (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 2 (Eq. 1) and Section 3.1
  • Brother pairs 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    First and second sons (born 1960-1983) of sampled fathers who share both legal parents from registration at birth and are not adopted; son birth order determined irrespective of daughters. Excludes sons also observed as fathers and brothers born less than 12 months or more than 12 years apart (122,652 pairs); singletons kept.
    登记库： Civil registration system (CPR) / population register
    工作论文 · Section 3.1 and footnote 10
  • Schoolmates at age 15 教育与考试成绩
    Males born in the same calendar year enrolled in the same school on 31 October of the calendar year they turn 15 (normally 9th grade), from the national pupil database (covers grade 8 and above from August 1973). Pupils at schools exclusively for special educational needs are excluded.
    登记库： Education register / national pupil database
    工作论文 · Section 3.1 and footnotes 11, 13, 14
  • Parish neighbours at age 15 地理与社区
    Neighbourhood defined as parish of residence (available from 1973) from the central person register address data on 31 October of the calendar year the male turns 15; neighbours are males born in the same year living in the same parish (2,123 parishes).
    登记库： Central person register (CPR addresses)
    工作论文 · Section 3.1 and footnote 12
  • Cohort grouping 样本界定与时间
    Data grouped into two-year birth cohorts (1960-61 to 1982-83) with age imputed from the first year of birth; each cohort observed from age 24 for at least 6 years and up to 28 years.
    登记库： Population register, Income registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, Table 1

样本

变量如何定义（5）
  • Third-born sibling disability (treatment) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicator D = 1 if the third-born child is observed disabled, in Denmark from disabilities recorded in the medical (patient) registries, with the main treatment being disability first observed by age five (alternatively between ages five and ten). Most common Danish by-age-five disabilities: asthma (41%), congenital malformations of the musculoskeletal system (20%), congenital malformations of the circulatory system (10%); diagnosis code lists are not given.
    登记库： Danish medical patient register
    工作论文 · Section 2 (Data) and Eq. (1)
  • 9th grade exit exam GPA 教育与考试成绩

  • Birth order / exposure (second vs first born) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户

  • Disability type and severity 健康结果、诊断与死亡

  • Parental background controls 家庭关系、生育与家庭户

覆盖全部个人贷款的逐笔贷款记录显示，财务困境具有很强的代际持续性：父母违约的子女自身违约的可能性要高得多，这一相关性在成年早期就已出现，且不能由收入或教育来解释。

数据
Loan register from the Danish Tax Agency (SKAT): all personal loan accounts with default status (60+ days late), Population register (BEF) for parent-child links, Income-tax register and other administrative registers on labour market history, income and wealth, Credit bureau bad-payer files (Experian, Debitor Registret), 2009 snapshot, Survey of 1,748 individuals on risk willingness, patience and impulsivity (2014)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：子女个人贷款违约（逾期 60 天以上）
  • 关键解释变量：父母的违约状态
  • 来自问卷调查的偏好度量（风险承担意愿、耐心、冲动性）

时期
2004–2011
样本
28,027,610 个父母—子女—年份观测值，涉及 2,501,088 人 2004–2011 年间所有 18–45 岁且至少有一位父母在世的丹麦人，按父母—子女—年份单元组织。 来源
调查
Preferences survey 2014
变量如何定义（9）
  • Loan default (financial trouble) 财富、负债与消费
    An individual is in default if at least one interest-bearing personal loan is at least 60 days late with payments at the end of the year, as reported by banks and other financial intermediaries to the Danish Tax Agency (SKAT); annual data 2004-2011 covering all loan accounts. Mortgage loans are supplied in separate files; loan type is otherwise not observed.
    登记库： SKAT loan register
    工作论文 · Section 3.1 and footnote 2; Figure 1 notes
  • Default by loan size 财富、负债与消费
    Alternative severity measures defining default at defaulted loan levels exceeding DKK 0, 10,000, 50,000 and 100,000 (the defaulted amount may reflect several smaller loans).
    登记库： SKAT loan register
    工作论文 · Figure notes (Panel B, defaulting at loan levels)
  • Bad-payer file registration 财富、负债与消费
    Recorded in the bad-payer files of credit bureaus Experian or Debitor Registret (snapshot of persons registered in 2009); people can be recorded after at least three reminders and a warning letter, for at most five years per missing payment.
    登记库： Experian bad-payer file, Debitor Registret
    工作论文 · Section 3.1 and footnote 3
  • Parent-child sample 样本界定与时间
    All individuals aged 18-45 in 2004-2011 with at least one living parent, linked via CPR to parents in the population register; unit of observation is the parent-child-year cell (separate child-mother and child-father observations; new partners of divorced parents ignored).
    登记库： Population register, SKAT loan register
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Unemployment shock (event study) 失业与福利金
    Unemployment spell of at least three months in event year 2007, 2008 or 2009 for individuals employed with no unemployment spells in the five preceding years, aged 18-38 at t-5; controls are similar individuals without a shock in t. Amounts index-adjusted to 2009-DKK within cohort.
    登记库： Income register, Unemployment histories (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Unemployment event analysis)
  • Liquidity constraint indicator / financial wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Financial wealth = stocks + bonds + bank deposits; indicator for having financial assets at end of year below one month's worth of average disposable income over the five years preceding the shock year.
    登记库： Income and wealth registers (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Figure 8 notes
  • Historical parental asset path (instrument) 财富、负债与消费
    Ratio of parental financial assets to average disposable income for each year 1987-1996; parents are assigned to behavioural types by within-cohort decile of the average asset-income ratio over the ten years, used to instrument parental default in 2011.
    登记库： Income and wealth registers (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Historical financial behavior of parents)
  • Middle-school GPA decile 教育与考试成绩

    登记库： Education registers (grades)
    工作论文 · Section 3.2 and Figure on GPA deciles
  • Survey preference measures 其他
    January 2014 telephone survey of 1,748 individuals asking respondents to place themselves and both parents on a 1-10 scale for risk willingness, patience and impulsivity; linked to register data.
    登记库： 2014 survey linked to registers
    工作论文 · Section 4 (survey), Figure 11

1930–1957 年出生队列；结果变量为 1980–2012 年；子女出生于 1955–1987 年
样本
1,640,214 个观测值（在丹麦出生且教区代码有效者）；到 1960 年已设有经批准学前教育机构的市镇中 880,708 个观测值，归并为 3,862 个市镇 × 出生年份单元 1930–1957 年在丹麦出生、出生教区有效且在 1980 年之后被观测到的个人，重点关注曾设有经批准学前教育机构的 138 个市镇。 来源
变量如何定义（14）
  • Preschool exposure at age 3 样本界定与时间
    Indicator equal to one for birth cohorts that had at least one government-approved preschool in their municipality of birth at age 3, using the year of government approval from archival lists of all approved preschools (Skjernbaek, nine editions 1921-1960); municipality of birth is assumed to be the early-childhood municipality.
    登记库： Archival preschool lists (Skjernbaek), Parish of birth (population register), DigDag
    工作论文 · Sections 2 (Data on preschools) and 3, eq. (1)
  • Nurse Home Visiting (NHV) exposure in birth year 样本界定与时间
    Indicator for an approved NHV program in the municipality in the birth year, based on DNBH approval dates 1937-1949 from the Danish National Archives (approval required sufficient nurse coverage). For 28 municipalities without an NHV program by 1949, treatment year is assigned from Skjernbaek lists (year of previous publication if listed, otherwise never treated).
    登记库： Danish National Board of Health (DNBH) archival records, Skjernbaek lists
    工作论文 · Section 2 (NHV data)
  • Municipality of birth from parish of birth 地理与社区
    Births are registered at parish level; parish of birth is mapped to 1930-1960 municipalities using DigDag. Individuals with invalid or undocumented parish codes, post-1970 municipality coding, registration by religious minorities, or hospital births are dropped (about 90 percent of Danish-born have a valid parish of birth).
    登记库： Population register (parish of birth), DigDag
    工作论文 · Section 2, Sample construction and selection, footnote 15
  • Years of schooling and more than compulsory schooling at age 50 教育与考试成绩
    Years of schooling at age 50 adding up schooling across educational programs, and an indicator for having more than nine years of compulsory schooling at age 50.
    登记库： Education register (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Log average wage income ages 30-60 劳动收入与收入
    Natural log of average wage income (in 2012 prices) over all ages between 30 and 60 observable in the 1980-2012 register data.
    登记库： Income register (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Human capital index 教育与考试成绩
    Equally weighted average of years of schooling at 50, more-than-compulsory indicator and log average wage income 30-60, each standardized by the mean and SD of the control group (municipality-by-cohort cells without an approved preschool by age 3 in the 138 ever-implementing municipalities).
    登记库： Education register, Income register
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Survival beyond age 65 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicator for surviving past age 65, with data left-censored so that all individuals enter the risk period at age 50 (outcome data start in 1980). Supplementary outcomes include hospital care utilization (e.g. nights in hospital ages 55-64) and diagnoses of cardiovascular disease, heart disease, diabetes and cancer; specific diagnosis codes are not given in the main text.
    登记库： Population/death registers, National Patient Register
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Second-generation education by age 25 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Main second-generation analysis uses firstborn children of mothers born 1935-1957; robustness uses all children of these mothers; cells by mother's municipality x birth year.
    登记库： Population register parent links; education register
    在线附录 · Table A6 notes
  • Alternative adult income measures 劳动收入与收入
    Robustness income outcomes (municipality x birth-year cells): average age 30-60 wage income in levels; log present discounted value of age 30-60 wage income (following Chetty et al. 2011); log average age 30-60 total income; log average age 49-51 wage income; indicator for any positive wage income at ages 49-51.
    登记库： Income registers
    在线附录 · Table A2 and notes
  • Hospital nights ages 45-54 and 55-64 医疗服务利用
    Number of nights spent in hospital over age ranges 45-54 and 55-64 (first generation), analysed at municipality x birth-year cell level.
    登记库： National Patient Register
    在线附录 · Table A4
  • Adult diagnoses (cardiovascular, heart, diabetes, cancer) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicators for diagnoses of cardiovascular disease, heart disease, diabetes and cancer (first generation); code lists not given in this appendix (follows Hjort, Solvsten and Wust 2017).
    登记库： National Patient Register
    在线附录 · Table A4
  • Female fertility outcomes 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    For females born 1935-1957 in the 138 municipalities with an approved preschool by 1960: no children, number of children, age at first birth, and father ever missing in child's birth record ('Dad Ever Miss.').
    登记库： Population register / Fertility database (parent-child links)
    在线附录 · Table A5
  • Preschool enrollment rate (first stage) 教育与考试成绩
    Share of children aged 3-7 enrolled in preschool: enrollment counts per preschool from the nine years of preschool book publications, interpolated to every year and aggregated to municipality x year, divided by number of survivors past age four; urban municipalities, 1940-1950 (1940 first year all living 7-year-olds observed, since birth data start 1933). (Table A11 title says aged 3-6; its notes say 3-7.)

Birth Order and Delinquency: Evidence from Denmark and Florida

Sanni Breining, Joseph Doyle, David N. Figlio, Krzysztof Karbownik and Jeffrey Roth · Journal of Labor Economics, 2020 · 个人

在丹麦和佛罗里达，排行第二的男孩都比其头胎哥哥明显更可能在学校受到纪律处分并进入刑事司法系统。证据表明，机制在于父母对后出生子女的时间投入减少，而不是出生时健康状况或社区的差异。

数据
Medical Birth Register (MFR), Population register with parent and sibling links (BEF), Central Crime Register (convictions, sentences, incarceration), School registers (9th grade exit exam grades), Register of Daycare Institutions, National Patient Register (LPR) and Psychiatric Central Register, Parental education, employment, earnings and maternity leave registers, Florida birth records linked to school and juvenile justice records
关键变量
  • 结果变量：16 岁前和 21 岁前被刑事定罪；被判处监禁；被收监
  • 处理：排行第二的男孩与头胎男孩相比（兄弟姐妹固定效应）
  • 结果变量：九年级毕业考试的阅读和数学成绩
  • 机制：母亲的休假与就业、1–3 岁时的日托入托、入学年龄、10 岁前的精神科诊断
  • 控制变量：父母年龄、教育、就业、家庭收入、移民身份
时期
丹麦 1981–1990 年出生队列；佛罗里达 1994–2002 年出生者
样本
丹麦：60,550 个家庭中的 121,100 名儿童（头胎和二胎男孩）；丹麦全体人口中 1981–1990 年的单胎出生为 448,979 例 有两个及以上同父子女的丹麦家庭，比较 1981–1990 年出生的头胎男孩和二胎男孩（另有佛罗里达的对比样本）。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Criminal conviction by age 16 / 21 犯罪
    Indicator (x100) for having any criminal conviction by age 16, and by age 21, from the Criminal Registers; convictions observable from age 15 (age of criminal responsibility). Traffic offences are excluded; crime outcomes cover convictions for violent, property and special offences.
    登记库： Danish Criminal Registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; footnote 20; Table 3 notes
  • Prison sentence / incarceration by age 16 / 21 犯罪
    More severe crime measures: indicator for ever having been issued a suspended prison sentence, and for an implemented (unsuspended) imprisonment sentence (incarceration), by age 16 and by age 21. Traffic offences excluded.
    登记库： Danish Criminal Registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; footnote 20; Figure 1 notes
  • Violent, property and special crime convictions 犯罪
    Convictions by age 21 split by crime type: violent (e.g. manslaughter, rape, death threats), property (e.g. forgery, arson, burglary) and special offences (e.g. drug offences, illegal weapon possession, human trafficking). Denmark birth cohorts 1981-1990.
    登记库： Danish Criminal Registers
    工作论文 · Section 5.1; Table 3
  • 9th grade exit exam grades 教育与考试成绩
    Ninth grade exit exam grades in reading and math from the School Registers, based on assessments by the student's teacher and an external reviewer; standardized to mean zero and unit SD within each cohort.
    登记库： School Registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.1
  • Psychiatric diagnoses by age 10 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicator for having received, by age 10, a diagnosis at a Danish hospital of a disorder of psychological development, or a behavioural and emotional disorder (e.g. ADHD), from the National Patient Registry and Psychiatric Central Registry.
    登记库： LPR, Psychiatric Central Register
    代码： ICD-10 F80-F89 (psychological development); ICD-10 F90-F98 (behavioural and emotional)
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, footnote 5
  • Daycare enrolment ages 1-3 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Enrolment in out-of-home daycare at ages 1, 2 and 3, from the Register of Daycare Institutions (type and place of daycare observed yearly 1995-2008).
    登记库： Register of Daycare Institutions
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; Table A2
  • Maternal employment after birth 就业与劳动力状态
    Mother's employment in each of years 0-10 after the child's birth: any employment, and full-time employment defined as employed at least 200 days in a year. Days of maternity leave also used as an outcome.
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; Figure 4
  • Birth order sample (second-born boys) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Birth order from the Birth Register (1960-2010 births) using exact birth dates and parent links; twins excluded; sample is the first two children of families with two or more children, restricted to full biological siblings (same mother and father) with a second-born boy (boy-boy and girl-boy families). Main crime sample is birth cohorts 1981-1990.
    登记库： MFR, Population register
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1 and 3.3; Table 3
  • Parental controls measured before birth 劳动收入与收入
    Maternal and paternal employment and family income are measured in the year before birth; missing parental education/employment (about 9-10 percent) are mean-imputed with a missing indicator.
    工作论文 · Footnotes 19 and 21

Correlation of Brothers' Earnings and Intergenerational Transmission

Paul Bingley and Lorenzo Cappellari · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2019 · 个人

将丹麦兄弟之间的劳动收入相关性分解为由父亲劳动收入解释的部分，以及由其他共同的家庭和社区因素造成的部分。在处理了永久性劳动收入和生命周期偏误之后，代际传递在兄弟相似性中所占的份额，比简单的父子弹性所显示的更大。

数据
Civil registration system / population register with parent-child links (BEF), Income Statistics Register (IND): annual pre-tax labour earnings from tax returns
关键变量
  • 结果变量：年度税前劳动收入（所有工作的合计），25–60 岁
  • 家庭结构：父亲／长子／次子三人组
  • 生命周期：每 3 年一组的出生队列分组和年龄
时期
1980–2014
样本
101,077 个家庭中的 303,231 名男性；5,488,445 个劳动收入观测值 1935–1961 年出生的丹麦父亲及其同母所生的长子和次子（1959–1985 年出生），至少有连续五个为正的劳动收入观测值。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Annual labour earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Annual pre-tax labour earnings from income tax returns, summed over all employments in the year, 1980-2014, deflated to 2012 DKK with a year-specific index (earn/R*6768). In code: IDA person variable lonind for 1980-2009, corloen for 2010-2011 and from the IND register for 2012-2014; negative values recoded to 0.
    登记库： IDA (idaperson), IND, Income Statistics Register
    代码： lonind (IDA person 1980-2009); corloen (2010-2014)
    复制代码 · triplet-data-creation-20160706.do ('collect earnings histories'); IZA DP10761 Section III
  • Earnings sample trimming and age window 样本界定与时间
    Person-year observations kept at (cohort-central) ages 25-60; missing and non-positive earnings dropped; the lower and upper 0.5% of earnings dropped by family member type (father, son 1, son 2) and year; individuals must have at least 5 consecutive years of earnings observations.
    登记库： IDA, IND
    复制代码 · inspection.do ('EARNINGS TRIMMINGS', consecutive-observation block)
  • Father/first-son/second-son triads 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Fathers born 1935-1961 (code frame 1935-1969) with two sons by the same mother, linked through the fertility database (ftdb2010, father pnrf and mother pnrm) restricted to madopt=='1'; twins/multiple births dropped; only sons of the same mother-father match as the father's first son kept; sons who are themselves fathers in the sample are dropped; families whose triplet birth order is inconsistent with population birth order are purged; fathers younger than 18 (216 months) at first son's birth dropped; brother spacing must be 12-144 months; first sons born 1959-1985, second sons 1962-1985.
    登记库： BEF/fodselsdata, Fertility database (ftdb2010)
    代码： koen=='1' (male); madopt=='1'; birth order border 0=father,1=son1,2=son2
    复制代码 · triplet-data-creation-20160706.do; inspection.do; IZA DP10761 Section III
  • 3-year birth cohort groups 样本界定与时间
    Individuals are grouped into 3-year birth cohorts (central years 1936, 1939, ..., 1984), with the cohort's central birth year used to compute age (ageco = year - cohort).
    登记库： BEF
    复制代码 · inspection.do
  • Years of schooling (own and father's) 教育与考试成绩
    Years of completed education computed as int(HFPRIA/12) from the latest available education register record (1980-2009), recoding 0-7 to 7 and 18-21 to 18; father's schooling linked through the fertility database father identifier.
    登记库： UDDA, Fertility database (ftdb2010)
    代码： hfpria; educ=int(hfpria/12), recode 0/7=7, 18/21=18
    复制代码 · data-creation-triplet-education.do
  • Sibling birth-order counts 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Numbers of older/younger brothers and sisters with the same father and with the same father-mother pair, computed over all children of the father (twins ordered randomly), for robustness to sibling composition.
    登记库： fodselsdata, Fertility database (ftdb2010)
    代码： nobsf, nybsf, nobsfm, nybsfm, nossf, nyssf, nossfm, nyssfm
    复制代码 · triplet-data-creation-20160706.do ('find all siblings')

Replication package

Spillovers in Education Choice

Juanna Schrøter Joensen and Helena Skyt Nielsen · Journal of Public Economics, 2018 · 个人

利用丹麦高中的一项试点：该试点降低了部分入学队列选修高级数学的代价。兄姐选修高级数学会提高弟妹也选修高级数学的概率，溢出效应的大小取决于兄弟姐妹的性别构成。

数据
Danish administrative registers on high school enrolment, course packages and completion (Statistics Denmark education registers), Parent and sibling links from population registers, Parental education and income registers, Earnings registers (younger siblings' earnings at ages 30–35)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：弟妹在高中选择高级数学—科学课程组合
  • 内生解释变量：兄姐是否选择高级数学—科学课程
  • 工具变量：兄姐就读的高中意外引入了试点方案（PilotIntro）
  • 结果变量：弟妹 30 岁时的大学/STEM 教育以及 30–35 岁时的对数劳动收入
  • 控制变量：父母的教育和收入、郡固定效应和入学队列固定效应
时期
高中入学队列为 1984–1987 年（兄姐）和 1988–1991 年（弟妹，主样本）；登记数据自 1980 年起
样本
7,786 对兄弟姐妹（年龄相近的主样本）；年龄差 < 10 岁的更宽样本为 17,691 对兄弟姐妹 1984–1987 年进入学术型高中并在三年内毕业的兄姐，与 1988–1991 年进入高中、年龄差不超过 4 岁的弟妹配对。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Advanced math-science choice (MathScience) 教育与考试成绩
    Indicator that the student chose a high-school course package combining advanced math and advanced science. In traditional schools the only such package was advanced math, advanced physics and intermediate chemistry; pilot schools also offered advanced math, advanced chemistry and intermediate physics. The choice is made at the end of the first high-school year.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark education registers
    工作论文 · Section 2
  • PilotIntro / PilotSchool instrument 教育与考试成绩
    PilotIntro = 1 if the (older sibling) enrolled in a high school that unexpectedly introduced the pilot scheme after the student's enrolment but before the advanced-course choice (cohorts entering 1984-87). PilotSchool = 1 if the school had adopted the pilot before the student's enrolment.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark education registers
    工作论文 · Section 2, Table 1
  • Sibling-pair sample 样本界定与时间
    Older siblings entering academic high school 1984-87 who graduated in three years, paired with a younger sibling who entered after 1987 and graduated in three years. The main sample has younger-sibling cohorts 1988-91 and an age gap of at most 4 years; the wider sample has cohorts 1988-97 and a gap of at most 10 years.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark population and education registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.1; Appendix Table B1
  • Parental education and income controls 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Mutually exclusive indicators for the mother's and father's highest completed education, plus their gross income as observed at the end of the year before the child started high school (when the child was 15).
    登记库： Statistics Denmark administrative registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.1-3.2
  • STEM field education 教育与考试成绩
    Indicator that the highest completed education is in a STEM field, following the National Science Foundation definition (math, engineering, natural and technical sciences, and some social and life sciences). It is used for parents and for younger siblings' education at age 30.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark education registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.2; notes to Tables 6-7
  • Long college degree at age 30 教育与考试成绩
    Indicator that the younger sibling's highest completed education at age 30 is more than a 4-year college degree (also interacted with STEM field).
    登记库： Statistics Denmark education registers
    工作论文 · Table 7
  • Earnings at ages 30-35 劳动收入与收入
    Log annual earnings of the younger sibling at ages 30-35, in real 1989 DKK.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark income registers
    工作论文 · Section 5 (Table 7); Appendix A Figure A1 note

Parental Responses to Child Support Obligations: Evidence from Administrative Data

Maya Rossin-Slater and Miriam Wüst · Journal of Public Economics, 2018 · 个人

利用丹麦子女抚养费标准随父亲收入变化而出现的断点，估计更高的抚养费义务如何影响已分居的父母。文章记录了父亲的收入、其后的家庭组建以及父母居住安排等方面的反应。

数据
Danish administrative registers on children born 1985–2008 linked to parents and siblings (population/family registers), Income and tax records including tax-deductible child support payments, Labour market registers (employment, earnings, disability insurance, early retirement), Birth records (fertility through 2010), Education registers, Danish Longitudinal Survey of Children (DALSC) and Children and Youth in Denmark (CYD) survey (descriptive, supplementary)
关键变量
  • 处理：父亲的平均子女抚养费义务（依据丹麦子女抚养费指导标准表）
  • 识别变异：子女抚养费指导标准中的收入门槛（模拟工具变量）
  • 结果变量：父亲每年支付的子女抚养费
  • 结果变量：父亲与子女共同居住（实际监护）
  • 结果变量：分居后父母双方的生育和劳动供给
时期
1998–2010 年（分居年份为 1999–2008 年）
样本
73,303 名父亲（71,575 名不重复的母亲） 1998–2010 年每年均可观测到的父亲，他们在 1999–2008 年间与最年长子女的母亲分居（或在未同居的情况下有了第一个孩子），有一到两个 18 岁以下的子女，且分居当年的收入接近指导标准的前三个门槛。 来源
调查
Children and Youth in Denmark, DALSC
变量如何定义（8）
  • Separation year 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    The year in which the father no longer resides with his oldest child's mother, or the year he has a first child while not living with the child's mother. The sample is restricted to separation years 1999-2008.
    登记库： Danish administrative population/family registers
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Analysis Sample)
  • Analysis sample of fathers 样本界定与时间
    Fathers observed in the registers every year 1998-2010 who either were married to or cohabiting with their oldest child's mother at childbirth (or in 1998 for children born earlier), or had a first child 1999-2008 while not married to or cohabiting with the mother. Also required: separation in 1999-2008, one or two children under 18 at separation, and separation-year income in a 100,000 DKK window around the first three schedule thresholds (175,000-505,000 DKK). The result is 73,303 fathers, one observation each.
    登记库： Danish administrative registers
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Analysis Sample), footnotes 17-18
  • Child support obligation (actual average) 税收与税率
    The father's annual obligation from the Danish child support guideline (normal amount plus extra amount per child, plus a supplement of 25-300% of the normal amount above income thresholds). It is a step function of current gross income and the number of biological children under 18, including new children. It is averaged over all post-separation years and expressed in thousands of real 2000 DKK.
    登记库： Danish income registers
    工作论文 · Section 2; Section 5, equation (2)
  • Predicted (simulated) child support obligation 税收与税率
    Instrument: the obligation in each post-separation year computed from the father's separation-year gross income and his 'original' children still under 18, so children ageing out are counted but new children and post-separation income changes are ignored. It is averaged over the post-separation period.
    登记库： Danish income registers
    工作论文 · Section 5 (Simulated IV Method), equation (3)
  • Child support payment 劳动收入与收入
    Tax-deductible annual child support payments by non-custodial fathers as reported to the tax authorities, so only payments above the non-deductible extra amount are observed. Formal and voluntary payments cannot be distinguished.
    登记库： Danish income/tax registers
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Outcomes)
  • Father-child co-residence 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator that the father shares a residence address with the child in any year after separation, based on one address per person per year. It captures sole-father and some joint physical custody but understates joint custody.
    登记库： Danish population register (addresses)
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Outcomes)
  • Post-separation fertility 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Whether the mother or father has an additional child after separation, measured from the universe of birth records through 2010 and split by birth within or outside a new partnership.
    登记库： Birth records
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Outcomes); Section 6.3
  • Labour force participation / NILF 就业与劳动力状态
    Fraction of post-separation years in which the father has any positive labour income, and the proportion of years not in the labour force. NILF is split by disability leave (Social Disability Pension), retirement including early retirement (Post-Employment Wage program, ages 60-64), and means-tested welfare.
    登记库： Danish labour market registers
    工作论文 · Section 6.4, Table 6, footnote 29

Born with a Silver Spoon? Danish Evidence on Wealth Inequality in Childhood

Simon Halphen Boserup, Wojciech Kopczuk and Claus Thustrup Kreiner · Economic Journal, 2018 · 个人

第三方报送的儿童财富记录显示，童年时期的财富不平等程度与成年人中一样高，顶端份额主要由父母和祖父母的转移所推动。18 岁时的财富能够预测成年后的财富，代际财富相关性在很小的年龄就已存在。

数据
Individual wealth data from tax return records (Danish Tax Agency SKAT, via Statistics Denmark), Population register with parent identifiers (BEF), Education and income registers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：子女成年后（45 岁）的财富及财富排名
  • 关键解释变量：童年财富（18 岁）与父母财富排名
  • 推断的生前赠与和遗产（在赠与税免税额处的聚束）
  • 资产组合构成（存款、证券、房地产、债务）
时期
1983–2011
样本
混合截面：每个一岁年龄组平均接近 65 万个观测值；面板回归：36,102 个观测值 2000–2011 年间所有 1–40 岁且父母在世的个人（混合截面），以及 1965 年出生队列中父母双方在 2011 年均在世者构成的面板，追踪期为 1983–2011 年。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Net wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Value of assets minus liabilities measured on the last day of the year from administrative tax return records (SKAT), 1983-2011; mostly third-party reported by banks and financial institutions. Assets include deposits, stocks, bonds, real estate and deposited mortgages; liabilities include bank debt, mortgage credit debt, card debt, student debt, debt to municipalities, unpaid taxes, etc. Pension funds are not included; self-reported items (cars, boats, etc.) are excluded after the 1996 abolition of the wealth tax.
    登记库： SKAT wealth records (via Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 2 (Data)
  • Real estate valuation 财富、负债与消费
    Public (tax-assessed) values of real estate are adjusted upwards each year using the average relative difference between selling price and public value of real estate traded that year, following Leth-Petersen (2010).
    登记库： SKAT wealth records
    工作论文 · Section 2, footnote 6
  • Portfolio components 财富、负债与消费
    From 1995 onwards complete portfolio information on bonds, stocks, cash in banks, real estate, mortgage loans and the sum of other loans; childhood holdings summarised as bank deposits, securities and real estate.
    登记库： SKAT wealth records
    工作论文 · Sections 2 and 3.1
  • Wealth percentile rank 财富、负债与消费
    Percentile rank computed within child age-year specific wealth distributions (parents ranked on total parental wealth observed at the same time); ties, notably zero wealth among young children, are randomly broken. Adult outcome is the child's rank at age 45 (27 years after age 18).
    登记库： SKAT wealth records, Population register (parent links)
    工作论文 · Section 3.3, footnote 11; Section 3.4
  • Inferred wealth transfers (residual) 财富、负债与消费
    For each child, wealth at a given age minus the present value of earnings up to that age (real interest rates 0%, 3%, 6%), censored at zero, as a lower bound on transfers received.
    登记库： SKAT wealth records, Income registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, Table 1
  • Gift-tax bunching measure 税收与税率
    First time an individual (ages 1-12) has positive wealth, wealth at that point treated as the transfer; distance to the gift-tax basic allowance (DKK 58,700 in 2011) and to twice that amount (two donors) is plotted to look for bunching.
    登记库： SKAT wealth records
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, Figure 6
  • PCD and PD samples 样本界定与时间
    PCD: pooled cross-section of all individuals aged 1-40 in 2000-2011 with parents alive (parent IDs registered for Danes born from 1960). PD: panel of the 1965 birth cohort with both parents alive in 2011, followed 1983-2011 (ages 18-46). Monetary values deflated by CPI (2011 prices).
    登记库： Population register (parent links), SKAT wealth records
    工作论文 · Section 2; Tables A1-A2

Universal Investment in Infants and Long-Run Health: Evidence from Denmark's 1937 Home Visiting Program

Jonas Hjort, Mikkel Sølvsten and Miriam Wüst · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2017 · 个人

利用 1937 年普惠性婴儿家访计划在各市镇的分批推行，并在登记库中追踪受处理的出生队列直至中年。受处理者在 45 至 64 岁之间的存活率更高，住院夜数更少，心血管疾病更少，这与生命早期的营养和疾病环境对成年健康具有“编程”作用的观点相一致。

  • 控制变量：市镇和出生队列固定效应、1937 年以前的市镇特征

876,912 人，归并为 20,078 个市镇 × 出生队列 × 处理状态单元 1935–1949 年在丹麦出生、非医院分娩、存活并在丹麦居住至 45 岁的个人，与出生市镇相匹配。 来源

School Starting Age and the Crime-Age Profile

Rasmus Landersø, Helena Skyt Nielsen and Marianne Simonsen · Economic Journal, 2017 · 个人

出生日期恰在入学截止日之后的儿童，入学时间晚了近一年。入学年龄较大会降低低龄阶段的犯罪，对男孩尤其明显；其作用在于使犯罪—年龄曲线发生平移，而非永久性地减少犯罪，这与隔离效应（incapacitation）和成熟度渠道相一致。

数据
Population register with exact birth dates and parent links (BEF), Criminal charge register (charges for property, violence and other crimes, with dates), Birth records: birth weight, gestational length, APGAR score (likely Medical Birth Register, MFR; not named in paper), Education registers (age in 8th grade as proxy for school starting age), Parental education and labour market registers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：在某一年龄 / 在某一年龄及之前受到刑事指控（自 15 岁起）
  • 处理：入学年龄（7.6 岁对 6.6 岁）
  • 工具变量/驱动变量：出生日期相对于 1 月 1 日截止日的位置（±30 天）
  • 异质性：性别；犯罪类型（财产犯罪、暴力犯罪、其他）
时期
1981 年年中至 1993 年年中出生的儿童
样本
15 岁时分别为 48,546 名和 50,383 名儿童（两个性别组），出生于 12 月或 1 月（表 1） 1981 年 12 月至 1993 年 1 月间在 12 月或 1 月出生的丹麦儿童（主带宽为 1 月 1 日前后 ±30 天）。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Crime at a given age 犯罪
    Indicator for being charged with a crime between one birthday and the next (memoryless measure), from age 15 onwards. Charges rather than convictions are used to gain three additional years of data; results are robust to using convictions.
    登记库： Danish crime registers (charges)
    工作论文 · Section 3.1 and footnote 17
  • Crime at or before a given age 犯罪
    Accumulated indicator for having been charged with a crime at or before a given age (from age 15), keeping track of earlier incidences; also number of crimes for the intensive margin. Outcomes aligned by age are measured exactly at the birthday.
    登记库： Danish crime registers (charges)
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1 and 3.3
  • Crime type (property, violence, other) 犯罪
    Three broad categories: property crime (most frequently shoplifting, burglary, vandalism), violent crime (ordinary and aggravated assault, threats, violence towards public servants) and residual other crime (dominated by traffic-related crime such as driving without a licence, then drug or weapon crime).
    登记库： Danish crime registers (charges)
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, Table 1 and footnote 19
  • School starting age (old-for-grade) 教育与考试成绩
    Timing of school start is not observed for these cohorts, so age in 8th grade is used as an approximation; SSA is modelled as a binary indicator for school starting age 7.6 versus 6.6 (old-for-grade), with robustness to a continuous measure. Validated with exact ages at all grade levels observed from 2007 onwards.
    登记库： Education registers
    工作论文 · Sections 2 and 3.2; Table A2
  • Birth-date discontinuity instrument and bandwidth 样本界定与时间
    Instrument is being born after the January 1 cut-off (January=1); main sample uses children born within +/-30 days of January 1, cohorts born mid-1981 to mid-1993, controlling for a flexible function of distance in days to the cut-off and cohort fixed effects. Covariates are centred on cut-off dates, comparing January year t with December year t-1.
    登记库： Population register (exact birth dates)
    工作论文 · Sections 2 and 3, Section 3.3
  • Birth outcomes (APGAR, birth weight, gestation) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Child birth weight, gestational length and APGAR score (0-10, based on appearance, pulse, grimace, activity, respiration) used as background controls; register not named in the paper.
    登记库： Birth records (register not named)
    工作论文 · Section 3.3 and footnote 21
  • Parental background 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Parents' education and labour market outcomes measured one year prior to the child's birth, aligned to cut-off (e.g. children born Dec 1981 or Jan 1982 use parental characteristics from 1980); also mother's age at first birth.
    登记库： Parental education and labour market registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.3 and footnotes 16, 22

Happy Doctor Makes Happy Baby? Incentivizing Physicians Improves Quality of Prenatal Care

Vibeke Myrup Jensen · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2014 · 个人

利用 1987 年的一项改革：该改革把哥本哈根市全科医生的合同从纯按人头付费改为丹麦其他地区采用的按人头付费与按服务项目付费相结合的混合合同；作者在双重差分设计中将当地的头胎婴儿与周边哥本哈根郡（Copenhagen County）的头胎婴儿进行比较。母亲在按人头付费合同下怀孕的婴儿出生体重更低、早产更多、Apgar 评分更低。这些效应主要来自较年轻的母亲。

数据
Birth records (medical records) for a 15% random sample of firstborn infants born 1982–1992: birth date, birth weight, gestation, Apgar scores, mother's age and previous stillbirths (the working paper does not name the register), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Statistics Denmark: parental education, earnings, occupation, marital status, country of birth; GP income via workplace identifiers, Municipality of residence (treatment and control areas), GP service records for a 5% sample of women, 1997–1999 (descriptive table on prenatal services only)
关键变量
  • 处理：在纯按人头付费的全科医生合同下怀孕（1987 年 10 月 1 日改革前的哥本哈根市）
  • 对照组：哥本哈根郡（Copenhagen County），当地全科医生始终采用按人头付费与按服务项目付费相结合的混合合同
  • 结果变量：出生体重、低出生体重（低于 2,500 g）、早产（第 37 周之前）、胎儿生长
  • 结果变量：1 分钟和 5 分钟 Apgar 评分等于 10
  • 异质性：母亲年龄（26 岁及以下与 26 岁以上）
  • 控制变量：父母的受教育程度、收入、婚姻状况和族裔；市镇固定效应
时期
出生于 1982–1992 年（改革日期为 1987 年 10 月 1 日）
样本
出生体重回归中 9,239 名头胎婴儿，Apgar 评分回归中 9,272 名（工作论文表 3） 1982–1992 年出生、母亲居住在哥本哈根市（Copenhagen、Frederiksberg、Taarnby 和 Dragoer 四个市镇）或哥本哈根郡（Copenhagen County）相邻市镇的头胎婴儿，取自头胎婴儿的 15% 随机样本。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Treatment and control areas and periods 样本界定与时间
    Treatment area is Copenhagen city (municipalities of Copenhagen, Frederiksberg, Taarnby and Dragoer), where GPs shifted on 1 October 1987 from pure capitation to the mixed contract used elsewhere in Denmark (one third capitation, two thirds fee-for-service). The control area is the adjacent municipalities of Copenhagen County. The policy dummy equals one for the period when Copenhagen city GPs were on capitation contracts; periods are defined by date of conception and date of birth (conceived and born 1982-1987 versus 1988-1992).
    登记库： Birth records (medical records; register not named in the working paper), Municipality of residence
    代码： Reform date 1 October 1987; birth years 1982-1992
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1, 5.1 and 7.2 (incl. footnote 7)
  • Firstborn sample and parental link 样本界定与时间
    Medical records from a 15% random sample of firstborn infants born 1982-1992, with exact birth date, infant health measures and information on the mother such as age and previous stillbirths. Infant records are matched by unique social security numbers to parental background (educational attainment, earnings, occupation, marital status, country of birth, birth date) from the Integrated Database for Labour Market Research maintained by Statistics Denmark.
    登记库： Birth records (medical records; register not named in the working paper), IDA
    代码： 15% random sample; firstborns only; birth years 1982-1992
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Low birth weight, preterm birth and foetal growth 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Birth weight is observed in ten-gram intervals; low birth weight is a dummy using the WHO threshold of 2,500 grams. Gestation is measured in weeks and converted into a binary for preterm birth using the WHO definition of less than 37 full weeks. Foetal growth is birth weight in grams divided by weeks of gestation.
    登记库： Birth records (medical records; register not named in the working paper)
    代码： Low birth weight: below 2500 gram; preterm: born before 37th week
    工作论文 · Section 4.1; Table 1 notes
  • Apgar score (one and five minutes) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    The APGAR score sums five criteria (Appearance, Pulse, Grimace, Activity, Respiration), each scored zero, one or two, evaluated one and five minutes after birth. Both measures are converted into dummies equal to one for the best possible health condition (score equal to 10).
    登记库： Birth records (medical records; register not named in the working paper)

利用丹麦行政数据研究再培训如何影响劳动者抵御劳动力市场冲击的韧性，把作者关于受伤后人力资本投资的研究延伸到如下问题：哪些劳动者会进行技能重塑，以及当工作岗位消失时技能重塑如何保护劳动收入。

数据

  • 结果变量：抗抑郁药使用及其他心理健康指标
  • 结果变量：伴侣的劳动力市场和健康结果
  • 结果变量：受伤劳动者的劳动收入和就业

1995–2017 年（工伤事故为 1998–2017 年）
样本
2,915 起工伤事件（男性技工）；2,103 名稳定伴侣 持有职业教育学位、在造成收入能力永久性损失的身体性工伤事故发生前三年全职就业的男性技工，及其伴侣。 来源

Reskilling = participation in higher education by year +10.

Instrumental Variables with Unordered Treatments: Theory and Evidence from Returns to Fields of Study

Eskil Heinesen, Christian Hvid, Lars Kirkebøen, Edwin Leuven and Magne Mogstad · Journal of Labor Economics, 2026 · 个人

证明识别无序处理（例如学科专业）的回报所需的假设具有可检验的含义，并刻画了这些假设不成立时的偏误。利用丹麦和挪威的录取分数线与申请者的志愿排序，文章发现在剔除违反假设的专业之后，各专业的回报在两国之间高度相关。

数据
Danish administrative data on all applications to post-secondary education 1994–2002 (coordinated admission system), Population register and other registers (background, completed field of study, annual earnings), Norwegian post-secondary application data 1998–2004 linked to registers (comparison country)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：申请八年后的年劳动收入（工资、自雇收入以及替代收入的转移支付）
  • 处理：完成的学科专业（九个专业大类）
  • 工具变量：申请分数恰好高于或低于首选专业的录取分数线
  • 根据申请者志愿排序确定的首选专业和次优专业
时期
1994–2002 年的申请（丹麦），结果变量在申请八年后测量
样本
所查资料中未注明 首次申请丹麦中学后教育、此前未取得中学后教育学位的申请者，他们至少申请了两个专业大类，首选专业设有录取分数线，并在八年内完成了某一专业的学业（并与挪威申请者作平行分析）。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Annual earnings eight years after application 劳动收入与收入
    Annual earnings eight years after the first observed application: wage income, self-employment income and transfers replacing such income (short-term sickness pay, paid parental leave), excluding unemployment benefits; deflated by CPI (base 2011) and converted to 1,000s of USD at 2010-2016 average rates (5.9 DKK per USD).
    登记库： Income registers
    工作论文 · Section 5.2 'Data and descriptive statistics'
  • Completed field of study (nine broad fields) 教育与考试成绩
    Field of the post-secondary degree completed within eight years of application, aggregating detailed fields into nine broad fields (Medicine, Law, Technology, Other Health, Humanities, Teaching, Social Science, Business, Science) following Kirkeboen et al. (2016), except that Technology covers integrated, vocational/professional short- and long-cycle degrees (mostly computer science and engineering) and Science covers open-ended bachelor programmes in sciences plus agriculture, forestry and aquaculture.
    登记库： Education register
    工作论文 · Section 5.2; Figure 3
  • Admission-cutoff instrument (Denmark) 教育与考试成绩
    z = 1[GPA > Q1] + 1[Std <= GPA <= Q1] x Offer, where Q1 and Std are the Quota 1 and standby GPA thresholds of the preferred field; at GPA exactly equal to a threshold the offer is treated as random conditional on age (and on applying for standby). Applicants rank up to 8 programmes; where several programmes in the preferred broad field are listed, the lowest cutoff is used.
    登记库： Coordinated admission system (KOT) applications
    工作论文 · Appendix E 'Specification of instrument'; Section 5.2
  • Preferred and next-best field 教育与考试成绩
    Defined from the local ranking on the application list around the admission cutoff: the preferred field is the one ranked just above the next-best field, where the applicant's score is near the preferred field's cutoff; fixed effects for preferred-field x next-best-field combinations are included.
    登记库： Coordinated admission system (KOT) applications
    工作论文 · Section 5.1 and Section 6
  • Applicant sample 样本界定与时间
    All applications to post-secondary education 1994-2002 (Denmark; Norway 1998-2004); first observed application kept; those already holding a post-secondary degree excluded; restricted to those who completed a field within eight years and who applied to at least two broad fields with the most-preferred field having an admission cutoff.
    登记库： Coordinated admission system (KOT) applications, BEF
    工作论文 · Section 5.2
  • Application score (high-school GPA) 教育与考试成绩
    High-school GPA over all subjects of the study programme, recorded to one decimal on the 13-point scale (0-13, omitting 1, 2, 4, 12); used as the running variable, controlled linearly on each side of the cutoff.
    登记库： Coordinated admission system (KOT) applications
    工作论文 · Appendix E 'Danish admission institutions'; Section 6

Frederik Almar, Benjamin Friedrich, Ana Reynoso, Bastian Schulz and Rune Vejlin · Journal of Labor Economics, 2026 · 个人

依据毕业生的起薪和工资增长，把丹麦细分的教育项目划分为不同的“志向类型”。尽管按传统教育层次衡量的婚姻匹配看起来没有变化，按教育志向的同质婚配却已大幅上升；1980 年以来家庭收入不平等的上升中，婚姻市场贡献了 40% 以上。

数据
Population register with partner links (BEF), Education register with four-digit ISCED programme codes (UDDA), Employment register with hourly wages (IDAN), Income register (IND), Danish Labour Force Survey (LFS/AKU), 2000–2018, Employment register for hours, part-time/full-time (RAS)
关键变量
  • 分类：根据教育项目层面的起薪和工资增长划分的教育“志向类型”（约 1,800 个教育项目）
  • 结果变量：按志向类型的婚姻匹配（同质婚配）
  • 结果变量：家庭劳动收入不平等
  • 工资度量：按教育项目计算的残差化对数小时工资
  • LFS 工作属性：工时、晚间/周末/在家工作
时期
1980–2018
样本
平均每年 3,031,511 名 19–60 岁的个人；每年 1,800,866 名处于伴侣关系中的个人 1980–2018 年居住在丹麦的全部 19–60 岁个人，伴侣定义为已婚或同居的异性伴侣。 来源
调查
Labour Force Survey (AKU)
变量如何定义（12）
  • Residualised log hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Hourly wage in the primary job held in the last week of November (IDAN), ranking job types H, 3, A, S, M and keeping the highest; variable TIMELON before 2008 and SMAL_TIMELOEN from 2008. Log hourly wages are regressed on year dummies (base 2000) and education-specific experience profiles, and the year coefficients are subtracted. Hours underlying the wage are contractual (pre-2008 in four bins).
    登记库： IDAN, IND, IDAP
    代码： TIMELON (<2008), SMAL_TIMELOEN (>=2008); JOB_TYPE rank H,3,A,S,M; reg log_wage ib2000.aar i.educ_eika#c.erhverv_akk_new
    复制代码 · Data/Gen_sample1_new/Make analysis sample 1.do; IZA DP 17814 Online Appendix A.1 fn. 35 and A.2
  • Final educational programme 教育与考试成绩
    Highest completed education (HFAUDD, four-digit Danish ISCED/audd code, about 1,800 programmes) measured at age 35, or at the oldest observed age if the person is not observed at 35; graduation year from HF_VFRA. Grades 7-9 pooled as 9th grade; 9th grade (1109) and 10th grade (1110) split into 5 sub-programmes by region of graduation (regions 81-85); old pre-1980 high-school code mapped to the new one.
    登记库： UDDA
    代码： HFAUDD, HF_VFRA; 1109 and 1110 split by region 81-85; 1097 mapped to 1198
    复制代码 · Make analysis sample 1.do ('final education'); kmeans ambition types.do; Online Appendix A.2 'Education', 'Educational programs'
  • Programme starting wage (w0) and wage growth (g) 教育与考试成绩
    For each individual graduating in 1980 or later: w0 = mean residualised log hourly wage in years 1-5 after graduation; w1 = mean in years 9-11. Programme-level values average across graduates observed in both windows, excluding those with individual wage growth exp(w1-w0)-1 at or above the 99th percentile; programme growth g = exp(mean w1 - mean w0) - 1.
    登记库： IDAN, UDDA
    复制代码 · Make analysis sample 1.do ('peer wage growth'); Online Appendix A.2 'Starting wages and growth'
  • Educational ambition type 教育与考试成绩
    Programmes are clustered by k-means on (programme starting wage, programme wage growth), with k = 3, 4 or 5 (seed 1234), both in raw and standardised versions; the four-type classification gives the (low/high w0) x (low/high g) ambition types.

“Not ready” as a productive wake-up call: Do second chances improve human capital investments?

Thorbjørn Sejr Guul and Søren Albeck Nielsen · Journal of Public Economics, 2026 · 个人

研究丹麦的一项改革：八年级成绩低于某一门槛的学生被认定为尚未准备好接受高中教育，并在一年后重新评估。文章用模糊断点回归比较成绩恰好低于和恰好高于门槛的学生。被贴上“未准备好”标签的学生提高了初中毕业成绩，也更有可能完成高中学业并进入中学后教育，主要途径是更加努力和减少兼职工作，且幸福感未受损害。

数据
Educational readiness assessments (uddannelsesparathedsvurdering, UPV) and other anonymised education data from STIL, Statistics Denmark register data used to follow students' later education (registers not named in the abstract or the university summary), National well-being survey of students in Years 8 and 9, National reading tests in Year 8
关键变量
  • 驱动变量：八年级平均成绩相对于准备度门槛 4 分的位置
  • 处理：被认定为在学业上“未准备好”接受高中教育，并于次年重新评估
  • 结果变量：初中毕业（九年级）考试成绩
  • 结果变量：评估后五年内完成高中学业和进入中学后教育
  • 机制：尽责性和幸福感（问卷调查）、兼职工作、学校和父母的投入
时期
准备度评估于 2015 年引入；学生在八年级评估之后最多被追踪五年（所阅资料未说明队列年份）
样本
所查资料中未注明 平均成绩接近学业准备度门槛 4 分的丹麦八年级学生。 来源（摘要）
变量如何定义（1）
  • Declared 'not ready' for upper secondary education (GPA threshold) 教育与考试成绩
    A policy reform in Denmark introduced a GPA threshold for academic readiness for upper secondary education 1.5 years before the end of middle school. Students near the threshold received similar information about their academic performance, but those just below it were labeled 'not ready' and offered a second chance through reevaluation the following year. Estimated with a fuzzy regression discontinuity design.
    登记库： Educational readiness assessment (UPV) data
    已发表论文 · Abstract (full text not accessible; abstract read from the OpenAlex record of DOI 10.1016/j.jpubeco.2025.105563)

Changing Tracks: Human Capital Investment after Loss of Ability

Anders Humlum, Jakob R. Munch and Pernille Plato · American Economic Review, 2025 · 个人

利用丹麦行政数据中准随机发生的工伤事故，表明受伤劳动者会入读建立在其原有培训基础之上的学士学位项目。利用不同学位可衔接（stackable）程度的差异，研究发现高等教育使受伤劳动者从领取残疾福利转向全职工作，工资比受伤前高 25%，而技能重塑补贴的回报足以四倍覆盖其成本。

数据
Industrial Injury Register (Arbejdsskaderegisteret) / workers' compensation claims from AES, National Patient Register (LPR), Health Insurance Register (Sygesikringsregisteret), Prescription Drug Database (LMDB), Education Register (UDDA), Course Participant Register (VEUV), Danish Register for Evaluation of Marginalization (DREAM), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), linked to O*NET, Population register (BEF/POP)
关键变量
  • 处理：造成收入能力损失的工伤事故（与匹配的未受伤劳动者相比）
  • 结果变量：正规学位及课程的入读与完成情况
  • 结果变量：劳动收入、工时与职业（任务内容）
  • 结果变量：残疾福利及其他社会转移支付
  • 严重程度：评定的收入能力损失与人身损伤程度
时期
1995–2017 年（工伤索赔为 1998–2017 年）
样本
14,481 起工伤事件（14,369 名不同个人）；其中持有职业教育学位且可进入高等教育的劳动者为 4,568 起事件（4,528 人） 遭遇经认定的身体性工伤事故且收入能力损失为正的丹麦全职就业劳动者（不含军人），与匹配的未受伤劳动者相比较。 来源

  • Work accident causing loss of earning capacity (treatment) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Work accidents recorded by the Labour Market Insurance (AES) that caused a loss of earning capacity, restricted to physical (not psychological) injuries, non-military workers, and workers with full-time employment in each of the three years before the accident. An injury qualifies for compensation if personal impairment exceeds 5% or earning capacity loss exceeds 15%.
    登记库： Industrial Injury Register (Arbejdsskaderegisteret, AES), IDA

Temporary injuries = accidents AES assesses did not cause permanent loss of earning capacity or personal impairment. Non-injured controls are assigned the injury year of their matched injured worker.

Permanent Residency and Refugee Immigrants' Skill Investment

Jacob Nielsen Arendt, Christian Dustmann and Hyejin Ku · Journal of Labor Economics, 2025 · 个人

丹麦的一项改革提高了难民获得永久居留权所须满足的就业和语言要求。改革非但没有鼓励投资，反而降低了总体就业，语言水平也几乎没有变化，因为改革前前景较差的难民在要求看似遥不可及时减少了努力。

数据
Population, income, education and immigration registers linked via the Central Person Registry, Danish language test results, Employment in annual full-time equivalents (register data)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：以全职当量计的年就业量
  • 结果变量：通过中级或更高级别的丹麦语考试
  • 处理：2004 年 1–10 月获得临时居留（受 2007 年永久居留改革影响）与 2003 年 1–10 月获得者相比
  • 异质性：改革前的就业或语言表现类型
  • 时间：获得临时居留以来的年数（YSR 1–7）
时期
2003–2004 年居留队列，自获得临时居留起追踪七年（至 2011 年）
样本
767 名不同个人；5,122 个人年观测值 2002 年 2 月 28 日之后申请庇护、并在 2003 年 1–10 月（对照组）或 2004 年 1–10 月（处理组）获得临时居留的 18–64 岁难民。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Annual employment in full-time equivalents 就业与劳动力状态
    Employment in annual full-time equivalents (FTE = 1 for a full year of work), from a register variable recording cumulative employment in a calendar year, observed for everyone in Denmark on 1 January. For YSR = 1 only, FTE can exceed 1 because the cumulative variable includes work in the year residency was granted.
    登记库： Income registers, CPR
    论文正文 · Section 5 'Data on Refugee Immigrants' and footnote 17
  • Danish language proficiency 教育与考试成绩
    Indicator for having passed the standard Danish language test at the intermediate or higher level (test levels: basic, intermediate, high); observed from YSR = 1; passing is treated as absorbing, so the person counts as proficient at that level in all later periods.
    登记库： Danish language test results
    论文正文 · Section 4, footnote 13; Section 5
  • Treatment and control cohorts 样本界定与时间
    Refugees who applied for asylum after 28 February 2002 and were aged 18-64 when granted temporary residency; treatment = temporary residency granted January-October 2004 (exposed to the 1 May 2007 permanent-residency reform), control = January-October 2003.
    登记库： Immigration registers, BEF
    论文正文 · Sections 2, 4 and 5
  • Years since residency (YSR) 样本界定与时间
    For persons granted temporary residency during year y, YSR = 1 is year y+1 (first full calendar year with employment observed as of 1 January), followed for seven years (YSR 1-7).
    登记库： Immigration registers
    论文正文 · Section 4 and Section 5
  • Pre-reform employment performance type 就业与劳动力状态
    HIGH if cumulative employment by YSR = 2 is above 0.75 FTE, otherwise LOW (20% HIGH, 80% LOW). The reform's requirement is 2.5 FTE of cumulative employment.
    登记库： Income registers
    论文正文 · Section 5, 'Classifying workers into performance types'
  • Pre-reform language performance type 教育与考试成绩
    HIGH if the person had passed the Danish language test at the intermediate level or higher by YSR = 2 (about 16%), otherwise LOW; combined with employment type into LOW/LOW, LOW/HIGH, etc.
    登记库： Danish language test results
    论文正文 · Section 5, 'Classifying workers into performance types'
  • Matched native comparison group 样本界定与时间
    Danish natives selected by propensity-score matching to treated (control) refugees on YSR = 1 employment (2005 for treated, 2004 for control), age, gender, being single, having any children and county of residence (initial assignment county for refugees), used in a triple-difference check for the 2009 recession.
    登记库： BEF, Income registers
    论文正文 · Section 6.3 'Comparison with natives'

Genetic and Socioeconomic Achievement Gaps in Elementary School

Mikkel Aagaard Houmark, Victor Ronda, Esben Agerbo, Preben Bo Mortensen and Michael Rosholm · Economic Journal, 2025 · 个人

研究表明，按教育程度多基因评分划分的学业成绩差距与按社会经济地位（SES）划分的差距一样大，并且在小学阶段不断扩大，但仅见于低 SES 儿童。对社区和学校的选择解释了部分 SES 差距，却完全不能解释遗传差距；后者与尽责性和学习环境有关。

数据
iPSYCH2015 case-cohort genotype sample (neonatal blood spots from the Danish National Biobank), Danish national tests (reading and mathematics, grades 2–8), Population registers with parent-child links (BEF), Parental income registers (IND), Parental education registers (UDDA), Psychiatric diagnoses of parents (patient registers), School and neighbourhood identifiers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：标准化的全国阅读测试成绩（2、4、6、8 年级）；数学测试（3、6、8 年级）
  • 核心解释变量：教育程度多基因评分（EA PGS）
  • 核心解释变量：由父母收入和教育构建的 SES 指数
  • 兄弟姐妹固定效应：PGS 的家庭内部变异
  • 中介变量：社区和学校分选
时期
1994–2008 年出生；全国测试自 2010 年起
样本
40,136 人、87,917 个阅读测试结果（24,062 名精神疾病病例，16,074 名随机对照）；兄弟姐妹样本 2,705 人 1994–2008 年出生、在 2 年级至 8 年级之间至少完成一次全国测试、已做基因分型的 iPSYCH 欧洲血统儿童。 来源
变量如何定义（11）
  • National reading test score 教育与考试成绩
    Danish national (adaptive, Rasch-scored) reading tests in grades 2, 4, 6 and 8: each of the three profile areas (text comprehension, language comprehension, decoding) is standardised by school year, averaged, and the average re-standardised to mean 0, SD 1. Repeated tests of the same subject-grade are dropped (first test kept by test time).
    登记库： Danish national tests
    代码： FAGID 0102, 0104, 0106, 0108 = reading grades 2, 4, 6, 8; outcome variable ztheta
    工作论文 · Section 3.2; Results (for replication).do
  • National mathematics test score 教育与考试成绩
    Mathematics national tests in grades 3 and 6 and, from 2018, grade 8, constructed in a similar fashion to the reading score.
    登记库： Danish national tests
    代码： FAGID 0203, 0206, 0208 = mathematics grades 3, 6, 8

  • Parental years of education 教育与考试成绩
    Mother's and father's highest education category converted to years of schooling.
    登记库： UDDA
    代码： mhighestedu/fhighestedu: 10,15 -> 10 years; 20,25,30,35 -> 13; 40 -> 15; 50,60 -> 16; 65 -> 18; 70 -> 21
    复制代码 · Results (for replication).do, 'Prepare covariates'
  • Family disposable income in early childhood 劳动收入与收入
    Mother's and father's disposable income deflated by CPI (2015=100), averaged over child ages 1-7, summed across parents and logged (set to 0 if negative).
    登记库： IND
    代码： disp_income_m_1..7, disp_income_f_1..7; famdinc18 = momdispinc18 + daddispinc18
    复制代码 · Results (for replication).do
  • SES rank / SES index 劳动收入与收入

The scale and nature of neighborhood effects on children

Stephen B. Billings, Mark Hoekstra and Gabriel Pons Rotger · Journal of Public Economics, 2024 · 个人

利用哥本哈根把急需住房的家庭准随机分配到社会住房单元的做法，考察哪些社区特征对儿童重要，以及这些特征在怎样的地理尺度上起作用。社区质量根据所分配住房单元步行 2 至 15 分钟范围内全部邻居的登记数据构建。对教育（以及发表版中的劳动收入）的影响很大，但范围非常局部，而对持有毒品的影响则在更大的尺度上起作用；社区的失业和教育状况比社区收入更能预测结果。

数据
Statistics Denmark administrative registers (cited as the Statistics Denmark database of administrative records; individual registers are not named): residential location and family structure of all Copenhagen residents, gender, immigration history and ethnicity, Register information on employment/unemployment, social assistance, disposable income and education of family members and neighbours, Criminal charges (Penal Code offences and possession of narcotic drugs), Health records: mortality, doctor visits and contacts with psychiatric treatment and care, Municipality of Copenhagen social-housing allocation records for urgent-need households (first housing offers), 2009–2014, OpenStreetMap route network (walking times between addresses) and Boliga property-sale listings (hedonic house-price measure) — non-register sources
关键变量
  • 处理：首次获得提供的社会住房单元所在社区的质量（邻居的收入、失业、教育以及一个综合指数），在步行 2、5、10 和 15 分钟范围内测量
  • 结果变量：进入高中教育
  • 结果变量：因触犯《刑法典》被指控；因持有麻醉毒品被指控（16 岁以后）
  • 结果变量：首次获得住房提供后四年内与精神科治疗和照护有过任何接触
  • 控制变量：分配的年份和月份、家庭规模、特殊需要申请
  • 异质性：性别、少数族裔/多数族裔、与原住所的距离
时期
住房分配发生于 2009–2014 年；结果变量追踪至 2020 年底（工作论文版本）
样本
1,171 名被分配到社会住房的儿童（NBER 工作论文版本的表 1）；步行 15 分钟范围内平均有 24,198 名邻居 2009–2014 年从哥本哈根市政府（Municipality of Copenhagen）获得首次社会住房提供的急需住房家庭中的学龄儿童（0–8 年级）。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Quasi-random social housing assignment (first offer to urgent-need households) 样本界定与时间
    Every third social housing unit that becomes vacant in Copenhagen is reserved by the municipality for households with 'urgent needs'. When a reserved unit is ready, the allocation program queues applicants whose household size and composition match the apartment and selects the application with the oldest referral date; neighbour characteristics and applicant preferences play no role. The first offer is used as the assigned unit (63% accept it). Units in local areas with more than 40% adult unemployment on January 1 are ineligible that year. Main sample: 1,171 children provided housing in 2009-2014.
    登记库： Municipality of Copenhagen social housing allocation records, Statistics Denmark administrative registers (not named individually)
    代码： Every third vacant unit; first offer; assignment years 2009-2014; 40% local-area adult unemployment ineligibility threshold; compliance 63%
    工作论文 · Sections 'Denmark Social Housing Policy' and 'Data'
  • Neighbourhood boundary by walking time 地理与社区
    For each social housing apartment address, all residential addresses within 3 km bird's-eye distance are identified and the OpenStreetMap route network is used to compute the walking time of the nearest path between each address and the apartment. Neighbourhoods are the residents within 2, 5, 10 and 15 minutes' walk (every minute from 1 to 15 in the figures), averaging 527, 2,835, 10,930 and 24,198 neighbours respectively.
    登记库： Residential addresses of all Copenhagen residents (Statistics Denmark), OpenStreetMap
    代码： 3 km radius; walking-time cut-offs 2, 5, 10, 15 minutes
    工作论文 · Footnote 7 and Results section
  • Neighbourhood quality (income, unemployment, education and summary index) 地理与社区
    Neighbourhood averages of the family attributes defined in Table 1: family income (average rank, 0-100, in disposable income among families of similar composition in the five years before assignment), family unemployment (average unemployment rate of family members aged 18 or older in the five years before assignment) and family education (average years of schooling of family members aged 25 or older). All are measured immediately before the household's assignment and scaled to mean zero and standard deviation one; the summary index combines the three (unemployment sign reversed) following Anderson (2008).
    登记库： Income, employment and education registers (Statistics Denmark; not named individually)
    代码： Standardised to mean 0, SD 1; five-year pre-assignment window; age cut-offs 18+ (unemployment) and 25+ (education)
    工作论文 · Section 'Measurement of neighborhood quality'; Table 1 and Table 2 notes
  • Education enrollment 教育与考试成绩
    Indicator that the child was enrolled in upper secondary education between the date of the first social housing offer and January 1, 2021.
    登记库： Education register (Statistics Denmark; not named)
    工作论文 · Table 1 notes
  • Crime and possession of narcotic drugs 犯罪
    Crime: the child was charged for offences against the Danish Penal Code after the first social housing assignment and after age 16 (described in the text as violent or property crime, excluding drug and technical offences). Possession of narcotic drugs: the child was charged for possession of narcotic drugs after the first offer of social housing and after age 16. Family crime and family drug possession are the same charges for at least one family member in the five years before assignment.
    登记库： Criminal charges register (Statistics Denmark; not named)
    代码： Charges after age 16 and after first offer; five-year pre-assignment window for family measures
    工作论文 · Table 1 notes; Data section

构建了一个包含出生次序偏好和人力资本成本差异的父母投资模型，由此得到广义的数量—质量权衡。丹麦行政数据证实了模型的预测：在任一给定的出生次序上，家庭规模较小的孩子受教育更多；即便考虑了出生次序，孩子的平均受教育程度也随家庭规模扩大而下降。

  • 控制变量：父母教育、性别、年龄

1980–2006 年（结果变量于 2006 年测量）
样本
581,159 个家庭中的 1,256,031 名子女（剔除独生子女家庭） 2006 年年龄为 25–41 岁、其母亲在 1980–2006 年间在世且出现在 IDA 中的个人，所在家庭已完成生育，兄弟姐妹按同母界定。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Years of education 教育与考试成绩
    Highest completed education in 2006 from the IDA person files (8-digit HFFSP code), mapped to years of education using the first two digits per Table A.1 (e.g. 10 = primary: 7 years if born 1958 or earlier, 9 years if born 1959 or later; 20/25 = high school 12; 35 = vocational 12; 40 = short further 14; 50 = medium-length further 16; 60 = Bachelor 15; 65 = Master 18; 70 = PhD 20; 90 = unknown, missing).
    登记库： IDA
    代码： HFFSP 2-digit: 10->7/9, 15,17->10, 20->12, 25->12, 30->10, 35->12, 40->14, 50->16, 60->15, 65->18, 70->20, 90->missing
    工作论文 · Appendix C and Table A.1
  • Family size and siblings 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Siblings are children born to the same mother (families defined by mother's identity, via the IDA pointer to mother's person ID); family size is the number of siblings born to the same mother, recorded before individual-level selection. Families with children born after 1991 (any child aged 0-14 residing at mother's address in 2006) are excluded so family size reflects completed fertility.
    登记库： IDA

  • Birth order 家庭关系、生育与家庭户

    登记库： IDA, Date-of-birth data (Statistics Denmark)

  • Twin (multiple) birth instrument 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Multiple births identified from precise dates of birth (24,186 twin sets, 217 triplets, 5 quadruplets); twin observations themselves are dropped, retaining an indicator for a twin birth in the family and its order. Family size is instrumented with twins at the second, third or fourth birth in respective samples, and with twins at last birth.
    登记库： IDA, Date-of-birth data (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Appendix C (fn. 25) and Section 5
  • Analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    Individuals aged 25-41 in 2006 linked to a mother alive, aged 15-70 and present in IDA during 1980-2006. Excludes families with mother younger than 17 or older than 49 at birth, missing education for any member, non-twin siblings born less than seven months apart, unknown or different fathers, children born after 1991, and single-child families; 1,256,031 individuals in 581,159 families.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 4 (fn. 15) and Appendix C
  • Parental income measures 劳动收入与收入
    Parental income measures are trimmed by recoding observations in the 1st and 99th percentiles as missing; mother's education measured in the last year she appears in the data.
    登记库： IDA
