Anne Ardila Brenøe and Ulf Zölitz · Journal of Labor Economics, 2020 · 个人

利用丹麦高中内部不同届别之间女性同伴比例的偶然波动。女性同伴比例越高，女性入读 STEM 专业并毕业的概率越低，男性则越高，从而扩大了 STEM 领域的性别差距。

数据
Student/education registers with high school, track and cohort identifiers (UDDA), Population register with parental links (BEF), Parental income and education registers (IND, UDDA), Earnings and employment registers, Occupation codes (STEM occupations), Fertility from population/birth registers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：大学 STEM 专业的入读与完成（ISCED 领域 05、06、07）
  • 处理：数学方向同校同届学生中女性同伴的比例
  • 识别：校内跨届别的变异（学校和届别固定效应）
  • 长期结果变量：STEM 职业、36 岁时的劳动收入、性别工资差距、生育
时期
1980–1994 年高中入学；结果变量最长追踪至入学后 20 年
样本
127 所学校的 182,211 名学生（1,877 个学校—届别观测值） 1980 至 1994 年间进入丹麦普通高中数学方向的全部学生，不含届别规模极小或非典型的学校。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • STEM enrolment and completion 教育与考试成绩
    Enrolment: indicator for ever having been enrolled in a STEM study at college level or higher. Completion: field of the highest obtained degree is STEM. STEM = ISCED fields Natural Sciences, Mathematics and Statistics (05), ICT (06), and Engineering, Manufacturing and Construction (07); split into subfields Biology, Math and Physics, ICT and Engineering, and a fourth group.
    登记库： Education registers
    代码： ISCED-F 2013 fields 05, 06, 07; comparison fields ISCED 091 (health), 01 (education), 02 (arts/humanities), 031 (social sciences), 04 (business/law)
    工作论文 · Section II.D outcome description and footnote 21
  • Proportion of female peers 教育与考试成绩
    Share of female students in the student's high school math-track cohort at high school entry, constructed at the cohort-school-track level and excluding the student (leave-one-out).
    登记库： Student registers
    工作论文 · Section II.C
  • Math-track high school sample 样本界定与时间
    All students entering the math track of general (academic) high school 1980-1994; excludes students missing gender/age, students not aged 14-19 at entry, schools where under 95 percent of a cohort is aged 14-19, school-cohorts with fewer than 10 students, and schools not admitting students for at least four consecutive years.
    登记库： Student registers
    工作论文 · Section II.B
  • STEM occupation 职业与职位层级
    Indicator for working in a high-skilled STEM occupation for at least half the years observed in 11-15 and 16-20 years after high school entry.
    代码： DISCO (Danish ISCO) codes 21, 25, 31, 35
    工作论文 · Footnote 22; Table 7 notes
  • Earnings percentile rank 劳动收入与收入
    Average of the individual's annual labour earnings percentile over a five-year period (11-15 and 16-20 years after high school entry), with percentiles computed by year of birth and age using the entire Danish population as reference; earnings in 2015 DKK.
    工作论文 · Table 7 notes; Table 1 notes
  • Fertility by age 36 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Number of children by age 36, and timing of first child.
    工作论文 · Section V; Table 8

What Is the Added Value of Preschool for Poor Children? Long-Term and Intergenerational Impacts and Interactions with an Infant Health Intervention

Maya Rossin-Slater and Miriam Wüst · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2020 · 个人

1933 年至 1960 年间，面向低收入家庭儿童的学前教育的可及性提高了成年后的教育、劳动收入和活过 65 岁的概率，而且受益女性的子女到 25 岁时获得了更多教育。婴儿期接触护士家访计划会降低学前教育的附加价值，因此这两项计划是部分替代关系。

数据
Archival data on all approved Danish preschools 1933–1960 (establishment and approval year, slots), Nurse Home Visiting program implementation dates by municipality, Statistical Commune Data Archive (elections and censuses) for municipality controls, Municipal live births and infant deaths, DigDag historical administrative geography (parish-municipality mapping), Administrative population register data 1980–2012 (education, earnings, survival, hospital admissions, diagnoses), Mother-child links (Danish Civil Registration System)
关键变量
  • 处理：3 岁时出生市镇设有经批准的学前教育机构
  • 交互项：是否接触婴儿期护士家访计划（Nurse Home Visiting program）
  • 结果变量：50 岁前后的教育和劳动收入
  • 结果变量：活过 65 岁、住院、诊断
  • 代际结果变量：最年长子女到 25 岁时的受教育程度
  • 控制变量：市镇和出生年份固定效应、郡 × 年份趋势、市镇特征
时期
1930–1957 年出生队列；结果变量为 1980–2012 年；子女出生于 1955–1987 年
样本
1,640,214 个观测值（在丹麦出生且教区代码有效者）；到 1960 年已设有经批准学前教育机构的市镇中 880,708 个观测值，归并为 3,862 个市镇 × 出生年份单元 1930–1957 年在丹麦出生、出生教区有效且在 1980 年之后被观测到的个人，重点关注曾设有经批准学前教育机构的 138 个市镇。 来源
变量如何定义（14）
  • Preschool exposure at age 3 样本界定与时间
    Indicator equal to one for birth cohorts that had at least one government-approved preschool in their municipality of birth at age 3, using the year of government approval from archival lists of all approved preschools (Skjernbaek, nine editions 1921-1960); municipality of birth is assumed to be the early-childhood municipality.
    登记库： Archival preschool lists (Skjernbaek), Parish of birth (population register), DigDag
    工作论文 · Sections 2 (Data on preschools) and 3, eq. (1)
  • Nurse Home Visiting (NHV) exposure in birth year 样本界定与时间
    Indicator for an approved NHV program in the municipality in the birth year, based on DNBH approval dates 1937-1949 from the Danish National Archives (approval required sufficient nurse coverage). For 28 municipalities without an NHV program by 1949, treatment year is assigned from Skjernbaek lists (year of previous publication if listed, otherwise never treated).
    登记库： Danish National Board of Health (DNBH) archival records, Skjernbaek lists
    工作论文 · Section 2 (NHV data)
  • Municipality of birth from parish of birth 地理与社区
    Births are registered at parish level; parish of birth is mapped to 1930-1960 municipalities using DigDag. Individuals with invalid or undocumented parish codes, post-1970 municipality coding, registration by religious minorities, or hospital births are dropped (about 90 percent of Danish-born have a valid parish of birth).
    登记库： Population register (parish of birth), DigDag
    工作论文 · Section 2, Sample construction and selection, footnote 15
  • Years of schooling and more than compulsory schooling at age 50 教育与考试成绩
    Years of schooling at age 50 adding up schooling across educational programs, and an indicator for having more than nine years of compulsory schooling at age 50.
    登记库： Education register (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Log average wage income ages 30-60 劳动收入与收入
    Natural log of average wage income (in 2012 prices) over all ages between 30 and 60 observable in the 1980-2012 register data.
    登记库： Income register (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Human capital index 教育与考试成绩
    Equally weighted average of years of schooling at 50, more-than-compulsory indicator and log average wage income 30-60, each standardized by the mean and SD of the control group (municipality-by-cohort cells without an approved preschool by age 3 in the 138 ever-implementing municipalities).
    登记库： Education register, Income register
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Survival beyond age 65 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicator for surviving past age 65, with data left-censored so that all individuals enter the risk period at age 50 (outcome data start in 1980). Supplementary outcomes include hospital care utilization (e.g. nights in hospital ages 55-64) and diagnoses of cardiovascular disease, heart disease, diabetes and cancer; specific diagnosis codes are not given in the main text.
    登记库： Population/death registers, National Patient Register
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Second-generation education by age 25 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Main second-generation analysis uses firstborn children of mothers born 1935-1957; robustness uses all children of these mothers; cells by mother's municipality x birth year.
    登记库： Population register parent links; education register
    在线附录 · Table A6 notes
  • Alternative adult income measures 劳动收入与收入
    Robustness income outcomes (municipality x birth-year cells): average age 30-60 wage income in levels; log present discounted value of age 30-60 wage income (following Chetty et al. 2011); log average age 30-60 total income; log average age 49-51 wage income; indicator for any positive wage income at ages 49-51.
    登记库： Income registers
    在线附录 · Table A2 and notes
  • Hospital nights ages 45-54 and 55-64 医疗服务利用
    Number of nights spent in hospital over age ranges 45-54 and 55-64 (first generation), analysed at municipality x birth-year cell level.
    登记库： National Patient Register
    在线附录 · Table A4
  • Adult diagnoses (cardiovascular, heart, diabetes, cancer) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicators for diagnoses of cardiovascular disease, heart disease, diabetes and cancer (first generation); code lists not given in this appendix (follows Hjort, Solvsten and Wust 2017).
    登记库： National Patient Register
    在线附录 · Table A4
  • Female fertility outcomes 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    For females born 1935-1957 in the 138 municipalities with an approved preschool by 1960: no children, number of children, age at first birth, and father ever missing in child's birth record ('Dad Ever Miss.').
    登记库： Population register / Fertility database (parent-child links)
    在线附录 · Table A5
  • Preschool enrollment rate (first stage) 教育与考试成绩
    Share of children aged 3-7 enrolled in preschool: enrollment counts per preschool from the nine years of preschool book publications, interpolated to every year and aggregated to municipality x year, divided by number of survivors past age four; urban municipalities, 1940-1950 (1940 first year all living 7-year-olds observed, since birth data start 1933). (Table A11 title says aged 3-6; its notes say 3-7.)
    登记库： Archival preschool records; municipal births and infant deaths

  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    138 municipalities that ever had an approved preschool by 1960; individuals born 1935-1957; robustness drops cohorts born 1950-1957 in 28 municipalities lacking precise NHV initiation information, and drops NHV-treated observations in the bottom 1st percentile of the human capital index.
    登记库： Population register; archival records

利用丹麦的征兵抽签估计服兵役对日后结果的影响。服兵役推迟了教育和进入劳动力市场的时间；论文量化了服役者因此在受教育年限和劳动收入上的损失。

数据
Danish Defence military register (Armed Forces Day draft records: IQ test, eligibility, height, lottery number), Earnings from employer reports to tax authorities (income registers), Education registers (UDDA), Central Crime Register, National hospital discharge register (LPR), Medical Birth Register (MFR) birth weight, Population register (BEF)
关键变量

  • 处理：服兵役
  • 工具变量：征兵抽签号码低于门槛值
  • 异质性：认知能力（征兵委员会 IQ 测试）
  • 机制：受教育年限、就业、医疗服务使用、犯罪
时期
1976–1983 年出生队列；25–35 岁时的劳动收入
样本
152,269 名劳动收入无缺失的男性（兵役登记库涵盖 155,570 名适合服役的应征者） 1976–1983 年出生、被判定适合服兵役并在国防日（Armed Forces Day）抽取征兵抽签号码的丹麦男性。 来源
变量如何定义（11）
  • Annual labour income 劳动收入与收入
    Annual labour income from employment and self-employment, including sickness benefits and paternity leave benefits, from employer reports to the tax authorities (sum over all employments in the calendar year); excludes occupational pension contributions and study grants/loans. Measured at ages 25-35 and used in logs (zeros drop out); sensitivity measure excludes sickness and leave benefits.
    登记库： Employer income reports to tax authorities
    工作论文 · Section III (Data), footnotes 14, 16
  • Drafted (lottery instrument) 样本界定与时间
    Among men judged fit for service at the Armed Forces Day who drew a lottery number (1 to 36,000), 'drafted' means drawing a number below the Army's announced cutoff, regardless of whether they served. Military register covers 155,570 fit conscripts in birth cohorts 1976-1983.
    登记库： Danish Defence military register
    工作论文 · Sections II-III
  • Military service (served) 样本界定与时间
    Men who start military service aged 18-24, regardless of whether drafted; those who serve without being drafted are volunteers.
    登记库： Danish Defence military register
    工作论文 · Section II
  • Cognitive ability (draft board IQ test) 教育与考试成绩
    Armed Forces Day IQ test score: number of correct answers out of 78 items; used to split the sample into ability quartiles.
    登记库： Danish Defence military register
    工作论文 · Section II, footnote 10
  • Years of schooling 教育与考试成绩
    Years of schooling imputed from Statistics Denmark's highest completed education, based on enrolment and qualifications reported by educational institutions.
    登记库： Education registers
    工作论文 · Section III
  • Unemployment (UI receipt share) 失业与福利金
    Proportion of the year during which unemployment insurance benefits were received, at age 26; social assistance recipients are not counted as unemployed.
    工作论文 · Section V, Table 9 panel A, footnote 18
  • Bank holdings 财富、负债与消费
    Bank assets minus bank debt at age 26 from financial institution reports to the tax authorities; mortgage debt and stocks/bonds excluded.
    登记库： Tax authority financial reports
    工作论文 · Section V, Table 9 panel B, footnote 19
  • Criminal conviction from age 25 犯罪
    Indicator for having been convicted of any type of crime, excluding traffic offences, from age 25, from the Central Crime Register; pre-conscription values used as controls.
    登记库： Central Crime Register
    工作论文 · Section V, Table 9 panel C
  • Hospitalization, psychiatric diagnosis, psychiatric medication, addiction treatment 医疗服务利用
    Any admission to somatic or psychiatric hospitals including same-day patients (national hospital discharge register); psychiatric diagnoses and addiction treatment from the hospital discharge register; purchase of GP-prescribed mental-health medicine from the Danish Medicines Agency.
    登记库： LPR, Danish Medicines Agency prescription data
    工作论文 · Section V, Table 9 panels D-G, footnote 22
  • Immigrant / native Dane 移民身份与来源地

    登记库： BEF

  • Out-of-home care / single-parent family 家庭关系、生育与家庭户

Labor Supply and Optimization Frictions: Evidence from the Danish Student Labor Market

Jakob Egholt Søgaard · Journal of Public Economics, 2019 · 个人

丹麦学生的年劳动收入一旦超过某一门槛，就会失去部分助学金。登记数据显示，门槛下方存在聚束，而且随着学生对这一规则的经验增加而加强；可见优化摩擦掩盖了一个远高于观测到的反应的结构弹性。

数据
Danish administrative registers for the full population (education, earnings, benefits, demographics), Annual income tax returns, Monthly student benefit (SU) take-up records from the Student Benefit Administration, Monthly payroll records of earnings and hours (BFL/eIndkomst), from 2008
关键变量
  • 结果变量：年劳动收入相对于学生补助收入上限的位置（聚束）
  • 激励：超过个人收入上限后助学金逐步取消（退还）所形成的拐点/缺口
  • 模拟的个人边际税率和补助递减率
  • 月度劳动收入和补助领取（调整的时点）
时期
2006–2011 年（月度劳动收入自 2008 年起）
样本
每年约 75,000 个观测值（核心样本平均每年 75,500 人） 18–35 岁、在高等教育阶段注册就读、完全有资格领取学生补助且劳动收入为正（每年高于 DKK 8,000）的个人。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Core student sample 样本界定与时间
    Individuals aged 18-35 enrolled in tertiary education, fully eligible for student benefits (SU), and with positive labour earnings, defined as earned income above DKK 8,000 per year. This gives about 75,500 observations per year, 2006-2011.
    登记库： Danish administrative registers (education, tax returns), Student Benefit Administration records
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, Table 2
  • Income counted against the SU income limit 劳动收入与收入
    Labour income (net of labour market contribution), transfers other than student benefits, and capital income, except certain types of stock income. All amounts are scaled to 2018 levels using the official wage indexation of student benefits.
    登记库： Tax returns
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, footnote 4
  • Individual income limit 失业与福利金
    The baseline income limit is 12 times the monthly basic amount (DKK 7,700, 2018 levels; about DKK 93,000 annually) and rises by DKK 11,600 for each month of benefits not taken up. It is computed from monthly benefit take-up records of the Student Benefit Administration.
    登记库： Student Benefit Administration records
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, Figure 1 notes; Appendix C
  • Effective marginal tax / phase-out rate 税收与税率
    Marginal income tax of 42% above a personal allowance of DKK 49,900. Benefits are phased out at 50% for the first DKK 11,600 above the individual income limit and at 100% beyond that, so the effective marginal rate jumps from 42% to 72% at the baseline limit under optimal take-up. If the payback exceeds DKK 9,200, the whole payback rises by 7% (a notch). The 2009 reform raised the baseline limit by 24% and the phase-out rate from 52% to 62%.
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, footnotes 5 and 11, Figure 2
  • Excess income and predicted payback 劳动收入与收入
    Total earned income from tax records minus the individual income limit; positive amounts translate into payback of benefits. Predicted end-of-year benefits (initial payout minus predicted payback) match reported benefits within DKK 2 for 97.9% of the core sample.
    登记库： Tax returns, Student Benefit Administration records
    工作论文 · Section 4.3; Appendix C, Table C.I
  • Study-related job 部门与行业
    All jobs not in wholesale (NACE 46), retail (47), postal service (53), hotels and restaurants (55, 56), cleaning (81), elderly, social and childcare (87, 88), or sports and amusement facilities (93).
    登记库： Monthly earnings records (employer/firm link)
    代码： NACE 46, 47, 53, 55, 56, 81, 87, 88, 93 = not study-related
    工作论文 · Table 3, note e
  • Monthly earnings and hours 工作时间
    Monthly records of earnings and hours worked for all wage earners, available from 2008 and used for average weekly hours and the within-person variability of monthly earnings.
    登记库： Monthly payroll records (from 2008)
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, Table 3, Appendix Figure A.II
  • Student experience 教育与考试成绩
    Number of years enrolled in tertiary education between 2004 and 2007 (that is, over the previous four years).
    登记库： Education registers
    工作论文 · Table 3 note a; Appendix Figure A.VI

Spillovers in Education Choice

Juanna Schrøter Joensen and Helena Skyt Nielsen · Journal of Public Economics, 2018 · 个人

利用丹麦高中的一项试点：该试点降低了部分入学队列选修高级数学的代价。兄姐选修高级数学会提高弟妹也选修高级数学的概率，溢出效应的大小取决于兄弟姐妹的性别构成。

数据
Danish administrative registers on high school enrolment, course packages and completion (Statistics Denmark education registers), Parent and sibling links from population registers, Parental education and income registers, Earnings registers (younger siblings' earnings at ages 30–35)
关键变量

  • 内生解释变量：兄姐是否选择高级数学—科学课程
  • 工具变量：兄姐就读的高中意外引入了试点方案（PilotIntro）
  • 结果变量：弟妹 30 岁时的大学/STEM 教育以及 30–35 岁时的对数劳动收入
  • 控制变量：父母的教育和收入、郡固定效应和入学队列固定效应
时期
高中入学队列为 1984–1987 年（兄姐）和 1988–1991 年（弟妹，主样本）；登记数据自 1980 年起
样本
7,786 对兄弟姐妹（年龄相近的主样本）；年龄差 < 10 岁的更宽样本为 17,691 对兄弟姐妹 1984–1987 年进入学术型高中并在三年内毕业的兄姐，与 1988–1991 年进入高中、年龄差不超过 4 岁的弟妹配对。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Advanced math-science choice (MathScience) 教育与考试成绩
    Indicator that the student chose a high-school course package combining advanced math and advanced science.   • PilotIntro / PilotSchool instrument 教育与考试成绩
    PilotIntro = 1 if the (older sibling) enrolled in a high school that unexpectedly introduced the pilot scheme after the student's enrolment but before the advanced-course choice (cohorts entering 1984-87). PilotSchool = 1 if the school had adopted the pilot before the student's enrolment.

  • Sibling-pair sample 样本界定与时间
    Older siblings entering academic high school 1984-87 who graduated in three years, paired with a younger sibling who entered after 1987 and graduated in three years.   • Parental education and income controls 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Mutually exclusive indicators for the mother's and father's highest completed education, plus their gross income as observed at the end of the year before the child started high school (when the child was 15).
    登记库： Statistics Denmark administrative registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.1-3.2
  • STEM field education 教育与考试成绩
    Indicator that the highest completed education is in a STEM field, following the National Science Foundation definition (math, engineering, natural and technical sciences, and some social and life sciences). It is used for parents and for younger siblings' education at age 30.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark education registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.2; notes to Tables 6-7
  • Long college degree at age 30 教育与考试成绩

    登记库： Statistics Denmark education registers
    工作论文 · Table 7
  • Earnings at ages 30-35 劳动收入与收入
    Log annual earnings of the younger sibling at ages 30-35, in real 1989 DKK.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark income registers

Paul Bingley and Alessandro Martinello · Journal of Labor Economics, 2017 · 个人

将丹麦受访者在调查中报告的收入和受教育程度与登记库中的相同变量相关联。调查收入和受教育程度的测量误差彼此相关且是非经典的，因此标准的修正方法失效；论文量化了由此给教育回报等线性估计量带来的偏误。

数据

关键变量
  • 待验证变量：调查报告的年收入与登记库收入的对比
  • 待验证变量：调查报告的受教育程度与登记库受教育程度的对比
  • 估计对象：教育回报的 OLS 和 IV 估计量中的测量误差偏误
时期
所查资料中未注明
样本

School Starting Age and the Crime-Age Profile

Rasmus Landersø, Helena Skyt Nielsen and Marianne Simonsen · Economic Journal, 2017 · 个人

出生日期恰在入学截止日之后的儿童，入学时间晚了近一年。入学年龄较大会降低低龄阶段的犯罪，对男孩尤其明显；其作用在于使犯罪—年龄曲线发生平移，而非永久性地减少犯罪，这与隔离效应（incapacitation）和成熟度渠道相一致。

数据
Population register with exact birth dates and parent links (BEF), Criminal charge register (charges for property, violence and other crimes, with dates), Birth records: birth weight, gestational length, APGAR score (likely Medical Birth Register, MFR; not named in paper), Education registers (age in 8th grade as proxy for school starting age), Parental education and labour market registers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：在某一年龄 / 在某一年龄及之前受到刑事指控（自 15 岁起）
  • 处理：入学年龄（7.6 岁对 6.6 岁）
  • 工具变量/驱动变量：出生日期相对于 1 月 1 日截止日的位置（±30 天）
  • 异质性：性别；犯罪类型（财产犯罪、暴力犯罪、其他）
时期
1981 年年中至 1993 年年中出生的儿童
样本
15 岁时分别为 48,546 名和 50,383 名儿童（两个性别组），出生于 12 月或 1 月（表 1） 1981 年 12 月至 1993 年 1 月间在 12 月或 1 月出生的丹麦儿童（主带宽为 1 月 1 日前后 ±30 天）。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Crime at a given age 犯罪
    Indicator for being charged with a crime between one birthday and the next (memoryless measure), from age 15 onwards. Charges rather than convictions are used to gain three additional years of data; results are robust to using convictions.
    登记库： Danish crime registers (charges)
    工作论文 · Section 3.1 and footnote 17
  • Crime at or before a given age 犯罪
    Accumulated indicator for having been charged with a crime at or before a given age (from age 15), keeping track of earlier incidences; also number of crimes for the intensive margin. Outcomes aligned by age are measured exactly at the birthday.
    登记库： Danish crime registers (charges)
    工作论文 · Sections 3.1 and 3.3
  • Crime type (property, violence, other) 犯罪
    Three broad categories: property crime (most frequently shoplifting, burglary, vandalism), violent crime (ordinary and aggravated assault, threats, violence towards public servants) and residual other crime (dominated by traffic-related crime such as driving without a licence, then drug or weapon crime).
    登记库： Danish crime registers (charges)
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, Table 1 and footnote 19
  • School starting age (old-for-grade) 教育与考试成绩
    Timing of school start is not observed for these cohorts, so age in 8th grade is used as an approximation; SSA is modelled as a binary indicator for school starting age 7.6 versus 6.6 (old-for-grade), with robustness to a continuous measure. Validated with exact ages at all grade levels observed from 2007 onwards.
    登记库： Education registers
    工作论文 · Sections 2 and 3.2; Table A2
  • Birth-date discontinuity instrument and bandwidth 样本界定与时间
    Instrument is being born after the January 1 cut-off (January=1); main sample uses children born within +/-30 days of January 1, cohorts born mid-1981 to mid-1993, controlling for a flexible function of distance in days to the cut-off and cohort fixed effects. Covariates are centred on cut-off dates, comparing January year t with December year t-1.
    登记库： Population register (exact birth dates)
    工作论文 · Sections 2 and 3, Section 3.3
  • Birth outcomes (APGAR, birth weight, gestation) 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Child birth weight, gestational length and APGAR score (0-10, based on appearance, pulse, grimace, activity, respiration) used as background controls; register not named in the paper.
    登记库： Birth records (register not named)
    工作论文 · Section 3.3 and footnote 21
  • Parental background 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Parents' education and labour market outcomes measured one year prior to the child's birth, aligned to cut-off (e.g. children born Dec 1981 or Jan 1982 use parental characteristics from 1980); also mother's age at first birth.
    登记库： Parental education and labour market registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.3 and footnotes 16, 22

样本

变量如何定义（8）
  • Advanced high school math (treatment) 教育与考试成绩

    工作论文 · Sections 3.1 and 4.1; Table 3
  • High school GPA 教育与考试成绩

  • College graduation and field of major 教育与考试成绩

    登记库： Labour market registers (Statistics Denmark)

    工作论文 · Section 5, footnote 21; Table 6
  • Private-sector employment and industry 部门与行业

    登记库： Labour market registers (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 5; Table 6
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间

利用丹麦出生队列的长期登记记录，估计一个包含对匹配质量的学习过程的结婚、离婚和再婚动态模型。配偶双方的教育在产生婚姻剩余上是互补的，教育使婚姻更稳定，教育提高男性在剩余中所占的份额，而离婚成本在婚姻的早期和晚期都很高。

数据
Population register with marital and cohabitation histories (BEF), Education registers (UDDA), completed education at age 46
关键变量

  • 核心变量：46 岁时已完成的教育组别（高中及以下、职业教育、大学）

  • 结构模型参数：匹配质量、婚姻收益、离婚成本
时期
1980–2006 年（20 至 46 岁）
样本
61,780 人（31,835 名男性和 29,945 名女性） 1960 年出生于丹麦、1980–2006 年居住记录完整且 20 岁时未婚的全部男性和女性。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • 1960 birth cohort panel 样本界定与时间
    All men and women born in 1960 followed annually 1980-2006 (ages 20-46); individuals must have a Danish address in every year (complete marital history), and those already married at age 20 are excluded, leaving 61,780 individuals.
    登记库： BEF
    工作论文 · Section 2 (The sample)
  • Completed education at age 46 教育与考试成绩
    Three groups based on completed education at age 46: high school or less, vocational education, and college (some college or more).

    工作论文 · Section 2.1
  • Cohabitation (Statistics Denmark definition) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户

    登记库： BEF
    工作论文 · Section 2.2.1
  • Marital states and transitions 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Yearly states: single never married, single previously married, or married (characterised by own and spouse's marital history, spouse's education and type, and marriage duration). Divorced persons are assumed single for at least one year before remarrying; direct marriage-to-marriage moves (2.3%) have the first year of the new marriage recoded as singlehood.
    登记库： BEF
    工作论文 · Sections 4.2 (Likelihood function)
  • Marriage duration (divorce cost) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Fixed cost of divorce parameterised with ten dummies for marital duration of 1, 2, ..., 9 and 10 or more years.
    登记库： BEF

1988 年的一项改革提高了来自较高收入家庭的丹麦学生的助学金。约 1,000 美元的额外资助使入学率提高约 1.35 个百分点，这一反应与信贷约束较轻而非紧约束的情形相符。

数据
Register-based dataset covering the entire Danish population, 1983–2005 (Statistics Denmark), Educational event histories (education registers), 1973–2005, High school GPA records, Parental income used for student-aid means-testing (tax records), Parental liquid assets from wealth/tax records
关键变量
  • 结果变量：高中毕业后一年内进入大学
  • 处理：个人有资格获得的助学金（占全额学生助学金的比例）
  • 变异来源：1988 年丹麦学生助学金改革，以及带拐点的、按家庭经济状况核定的资助标准
  • 驱动／排序变量：父母（社会）收入百分位
  • 借贷约束的代理变量：父母流动性资产偏低

1983–2005 年（人口登记库数据）；高中毕业队列为 1983–1990 年，估计使用 1985 年和 1988–1990 年队列
样本
最终选定样本为 108,933 名高中毕业生；主要 probit 估计使用 54,843 个观测值（1985 年、1988–1990 年队列） 1983–1990 年间在 19–20 岁毕业于普通学术型高中的丹麦毕业生，且 GPA 和父母信息可观测。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • College enrollment within one year 教育与考试成绩
    Indicator for accumulated enrollment in any college (short-, medium- or long-cycle higher education) by one year after high school graduation, taken from educational event histories 1973-2005; one-year horizon chosen so pre-reform cohorts decided before the reform was announced.
    登记库： Educational event histories (education registers)
    论文正文 · Section II; Section V.B and Table 3
  • Social income (means-test income X) 劳动收入与收入
    Pre-reform means-testing measure X = mother's taxable income + father's taxable income - a x number of siblings below the age limit + f(parents' wealth); in 1985 a = 16,600 DKK and f(W) = 0.1(W-447,700)1[W>447,700] + 0.15(W-895,400)1[W>895,400] + 0.25(W-1,492,100)1[W>1,492,100]. Since social income no longer exists in the registers after 1988, a best post-reform analogue is computed accounting for wealth and number of siblings; analyses use the social income percentile within cohort.
    登记库： Tax/income registers
    论文正文 · Section II eq. (1) and footnotes 6, 12; Section IV end
  • Counterfactual pre-reform stipend (S_pre) 失业与福利金
    Stipend the individual would be eligible for under the 1985 rule: compute X, find its quantile within the current cohort, take the corresponding quantile of X in the pre-reform cohort, and apply the 1985 grant schedule (maximum stipend if X < DKK 156,400, none if X > DKK 256,200 in 1985). Stipend measured as four years of grant.
    登记库： Tax/income registers
    论文正文 · Section II footnote 6; Section II procedure steps (1)-(4) and footnote 13
  • Low parental liquid assets indicator 财富、负债与消费
    Basic indicator D1 = 1 if parents' liquid assets at time of high school graduation fall short of one month's income; extreme indicator D2 = 1 if below two months' income. Liquid assets are all non-housing assets: cash, shares, bonds, mortgage deeds and other assets; children of self-employed parents (liquid assets not registered) are set to D1 = D2 = 0.
    登记库： Wealth/tax records
    论文正文 · Section V.B, Tables 4-6
  • Analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    High school graduates from the ordinary (academic) high school track in 1985-1990 (assets not observed before 1985) who graduate at 'normal' ages 19-20, with observed GPA, non-missing parental income and education, excluding those with divorced parents at graduation; the 1986 and 1987 cohorts are dropped because of anticipation of the reform and an earlier change in the means-testing age limit.     登记库： Population register, Education registers
    论文正文 · Section V.A, Table 2; Section V.B
  • High school GPA 教育与考试成绩

    登记库： High school GPA records

Educational Ambition, Marital Sorting, and Inequality

Frederik Almar, Benjamin Friedrich, Ana Reynoso, Bastian Schulz and Rune Vejlin · Journal of Labor Economics, 2026 · 个人

依据毕业生的起薪和工资增长，把丹麦细分的教育项目划分为不同的“志向类型”。尽管按传统教育层次衡量的婚姻匹配看起来没有变化，按教育志向的同质婚配却已大幅上升；1980 年以来家庭收入不平等的上升中，婚姻市场贡献了 40% 以上。

数据
Population register with partner links (BEF), Education register with four-digit ISCED programme codes (UDDA), Employment register with hourly wages (IDAN), Income register (IND), Danish Labour Force Survey (LFS/AKU), 2000–2018, Employment register for hours, part-time/full-time (RAS)
关键变量
  • 分类：根据教育项目层面的起薪和工资增长划分的教育“志向类型”（约 1,800 个教育项目）
  • 结果变量：按志向类型的婚姻匹配（同质婚配）
  • 结果变量：家庭劳动收入不平等
  • 工资度量：按教育项目计算的残差化对数小时工资
  • LFS 工作属性：工时、晚间/周末/在家工作
时期
1980–2018
样本
平均每年 3,031,511 名 19–60 岁的个人；每年 1,800,866 名处于伴侣关系中的个人 1980–2018 年居住在丹麦的全部 19–60 岁个人，伴侣定义为已婚或同居的异性伴侣。 来源
调查
Labour Force Survey (AKU)
变量如何定义（12）
  • Residualised log hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Hourly wage in the primary job held in the last week of November (IDAN), ranking job types H, 3, A, S, M and keeping the highest; variable TIMELON before 2008 and SMAL_TIMELOEN from 2008. Log hourly wages are regressed on year dummies (base 2000) and education-specific experience profiles, and the year coefficients are subtracted. Hours underlying the wage are contractual (pre-2008 in four bins).
    登记库： IDAN, IND, IDAP
    代码： TIMELON (<2008), SMAL_TIMELOEN (>=2008); JOB_TYPE rank H,3,A,S,M; reg log_wage ib2000.aar i.educ_eika#c.erhverv_akk_new
    复制代码 · Data/Gen_sample1_new/Make analysis sample 1.do; IZA DP 17814 Online Appendix A.1 fn. 35 and A.2
  • Final educational programme 教育与考试成绩
    Highest completed education (HFAUDD, four-digit Danish ISCED/audd code, about 1,800 programmes) measured at age 35, or at the oldest observed age if the person is not observed at 35; graduation year from HF_VFRA. Grades 7-9 pooled as 9th grade; 9th grade (1109) and 10th grade (1110) split into 5 sub-programmes by region of graduation (regions 81-85); old pre-1980 high-school code mapped to the new one.
    登记库： UDDA
    代码： HFAUDD, HF_VFRA; 1109 and 1110 split by region 81-85; 1097 mapped to 1198
    复制代码 · Make analysis sample 1.do ('final education'); kmeans ambition types.do; Online Appendix A.2 'Education', 'Educational programs'
  • Programme starting wage (w0) and wage growth (g) 教育与考试成绩
    For each individual graduating in 1980 or later: w0 = mean residualised log hourly wage in years 1-5 after graduation; w1 = mean in years 9-11. Programme-level values average across graduates observed in both windows, excluding those with individual wage growth exp(w1-w0)-1 at or above the 99th percentile; programme growth g = exp(mean w1 - mean w0) - 1.
    登记库： IDAN, UDDA
    复制代码 · Make analysis sample 1.do ('peer wage growth'); Online Appendix A.2 'Starting wages and growth'
  • Educational ambition type 教育与考试成绩
    Programmes are clustered by k-means on (programme starting wage, programme wage growth), with k = 3, 4 or 5 (seed 1234), both in raw and standardised versions; the four-type classification gives the (low/high w0) x (low/high g) ambition types.
    登记库： IDAN, UDDA
    代码： cluster kmeans wage_start_mean_ambition wage_growth_ambition, k(4) s(kr(1234))
    复制代码 · Data/Gen_kmeans ambition types/kmeans ambition types.do
  • Couples (married and cohabiting) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Relationship = married (CIVST = 'G') or with a cohabitation partner id (FAELLE_NR non-missing); couple id is the man's PNR, linked through AEGTE_NR (spouse) or FAELLE_NR (cohabitant). Only couples where both partners are observed and both are aged 19-60 are kept.
    登记库： BEF, PERSONER
    代码： CIVST == "G"; AEGTE_NR; FAELLE_NR
    复制代码 · kmeans ambition types.do, 'Define marital status' and 'Make couple ID'
  • Programme-outcome estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    All persons living in Denmark at end of year 1980-2018 aged 19-60, irrespective of marital status (about 3.0 million per year); persons with missing education (2.6%) excluded.
    登记库： BEF, PERSONER, UDDA
    代码： keep if age>=19 & age<=60
    复制代码 · Make analysis sample 1.do; paper Section 2 (IZA DP 17814)
  • Region of graduation 地理与社区
    Residence municipality (BOPAEL_KOM_KODE) mapped from pre-2007 to post-2007 municipalities using each person's modal 2005-to-2006 transition, then grouped into the five regions 81-85 by municipality code lists; region in the graduation year (or first observed year) is used.
    登记库： BEF
    代码： BOPAEL_KOM_KODE; region 81 (Nordjylland) ... 85 (Sjaelland) via inlist() of municipality codes
    复制代码 · Data/Gen_regions/region codes.do; Make analysis sample 1.do
  • Full-time / part-time and part-time penalty 工作时间
    Full-time from RAS: at least 32 hours per week (threshold 30 hours in 1980-1992 and 27 hours in 1993-2007). Part-time penalty = ratio of w1 (wage in years 9-11 after graduation) of full-time workers to that of part-time workers, by programme.
    登记库： RAS
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Table 1 description) and footnotes 14-15
  • LFS 'super full-time' and irregular hours 工作时间
    From LFS (AKU, 2000-2018): sft = 1 if usual weekly hours >= 38, or = 37 combined with evening, night, Saturday, Sunday or home work (answer 1 or 2) or overtime as reason (hourreas = 16); evening/night/weekend defined only when shiftwk = 3. Programme averages use yfactor weights for programmes with >= 50 (or 100) LFS observations; hwactual = 99 dropped.
    登记库： AKU, RAS
    代码： hwusual >= 38; evenwk/nightwk/satwk/sunwk/homewk in 1,2; shiftwk == 3; hourreas == 16
    复制代码 · Results/fig_A1/LFS_clustering_prep_BF_dropmissing.do
  • Lifetime earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Sum over 30 years after graduation of deflated log annual earned income ERHVERVSINDK_13 (employment plus self-employment income), year effects (base 2000) removed, for graduates observed for all 30 years; averaged by programme.
    登记库： IND
    代码： ERHVERVSINDK_13

  • Wealth at age 50 财富、负债与消费
    Average net wealth at age 50 by programme, excluding pension assets, deflated to 2000 prices.
    登记库： IND
    工作论文 · Section 3, footnote 16
  • Ever manager 职业与职位层级
    Fraction of a programme's graduates who reach a managerial position, i.e. hold a corresponding occupational code for at least two consecutive years.
    登记库： RAS, AKM

Sick of Your Poor Neighborhood? Quasi-Experimental Evidence on Neighborhood Effects on Health

Linea Hasager and Mia Jørgensen · Journal of Public Economics, 2026 · 个人

利用 1986 至 1998 年难民在丹麦各社区间的准随机分散安置。被安置在低收入社区的难民在 8 至 15 年后罹患生活方式相关疾病的风险高出 12%，其驱动因素是邻居和当地环境，而非医疗可及性、族裔网络或劳动力市场结果。

数据
National Patient Register (LPR), Health Insurance Register (SYSI, SSSY), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), Income register (IND), Population register (BEF) and address/mobility registers (BEFBOP, BEFADR), Migration register (VNDS), Criminal convictions register (KRAF), O*NET occupational data merged via occupation codes
关键变量
  • 处理：在 1986–1998 年难民分散安置政策（Refugee Spatial Dispersal Policy）下被分配到收入处于最低三分之一而非最高三分之一的堂区（以社区家庭可支配收入中位数衡量）
  • 结果变量：移民后 2–15 年和 8–15 年内确诊生活方式相关疾病（循环系统疾病、营养/代谢疾病、COPD、髋关节病、酒精相关疾病）
  • 结果变量：精神障碍诊断
  • 机制：医疗可及性、就业和劳动收入、邻居特征
时期
1985–2017 年（难民于 1986–1998 年抵达）
样本
21,965 名难民 来自九个难民来源国、抵达时年龄为 18–64 岁、于 1986–1998 年抵达丹麦并在分散安置政策下被分配到某一市镇的难民（不含家庭团聚的配偶）。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Lifestyle-related disease diagnosis 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicator for any primary or secondary hospital diagnosis (inpatient or outpatient, National Patient Register; ICD-8 before 1994, ICD-10 after) within 2-15 years, or within 8-15 years, after immigration in one of: circulatory diseases (hypertension, ischaemic heart diseases, pulmonary diseases, other heart disease, cerebrovascular and arterial diseases), nutritional/endocrine/metabolic diseases (diabetes type I and II, obesity, elevated cholesterol), COPD, hip arthrosis, and alcohol-related diseases. Exact code grouping is in Online Appendix Section B (not accessed).
    登记库： LPR
    工作论文 · Section I (data), footnotes 17-19
  • Mental disorder diagnosis 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Indicator for a hospital diagnosis 2-15 or 8-15 years after immigration of mental and behavioural disorders due to psychoactive substance use; schizophrenia, schizotypal and delusional disorders; mood (affective) disorders; neurotic, stress-related and somatoform disorders; behavioural syndromes associated with physiological disturbances; and disorders of adult personality and behaviour.
    登记库： LPR
    工作论文 · Section I, footnote 20
  • Neighbourhood income group (parish) 地理与社区
    Neighbourhood = parish (alternatives: municipality, apartment building). Each year, neighbourhoods are ranked by median household disposable income per adult household member (Income Register, CPI-deflated to 2000) and split into thirds: bottom (below 33rd percentile), middle (34th-66th), top (67th-100th); groups are recomputed every year for all neighbourhoods.
    登记库： IND, BEF
    工作论文 · Section I, footnote 25
  • Assignment neighbourhood 地理与社区
    Neighbourhood of the refugee's address on 1 January in the year after immigration, to capture permanent resettlement rather than temporary accommodation.
    登记库： BEFBOP, BEFADR
    工作论文 · Section II (identification), p. ~14
  • Refugee (dispersal policy) sample 移民身份与来源地
    Immigrants arriving 1986-1998 from Afghanistan, Ethiopia, Iran, Iraq, Lebanon, Palestine (stateless), Sri Lanka and Vietnam (1986-1998) or Somalia (1989-1998), aged 18-64 at arrival; former Yugoslavs excluded; excludes those married at arrival to a non-refugee partner or to a refugee partner who arrived earlier (family reunification).
    登记库： VNDS, BEF
    工作论文 · Section I, footnotes 14-16
  • Employment as fraction of full working year 就业与劳动力状态
    Fraction of a full-time working year employed: 1 if full-time employee during the whole year, less than one for part-time or part-year employment.
    登记库： IDA, IND
    工作论文 · Section I (labour market outcomes)
  • Annual gross earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Annual gross earnings from tax returns in the Income Register, CPI-deflated to 2000 and converted to USD at the 27 March 2020 exchange rate.
    登记库： IND
    工作论文 · Section I
  • Occupational task content 职业与职位层级
    Ratio of communication and cognitive tasks to manual tasks from O*NET, merged via ISCO occupation codes, for those employed at the end of November each year.
    登记库： IDA, O*NET
    工作论文 · Section I
  • GP and psychologist visits 医疗服务利用
    Number of visits to general practitioners and psychologists (no diagnosis codes available in these data).
    登记库： SYSI, SSSY
    工作论文 · Section I, footnote 23

Childhood Health Shocks and the Intergenerational Transmission of Inequality

Tine M. Eriksen, Amanda P. Gaulke, Niels Skipper, Jannet Svensson and Peter R. Thingholm · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2026 · 个人

利用儿童期 1 型糖尿病发病的准随机性，估计一种慢性但可治疗的健康冲击对 30 岁时劳动力市场结果的影响，将确诊儿童与同一天出生的匹配儿童进行比较。确诊儿童的劳动收入低约 14%，就业概率低 8.7 个百分点。因果森林显示，父母收入较高、母亲受教育程度较高的儿童所受的损失小得多，部分原因在于更好的疾病管理和学校教育。

数据
National Patient Registry (Landspatientregisteret): type 1 diabetes diagnoses via ICD-8 and ICD-10 codes, all children diagnosed since 1976, DanDiabKids (Danish Registry of Childhood and Adolescent Diabetes): date of diagnosis and clinical measures from annual pediatric clinic visits, since 1996, Statistics Denmark population registers: age, sex, immigrant or descendant status, birth order, siblings and parent-child links, Income and education registers for children and parents (income from 1980), Health care use around diagnosis: hospital admissions, general practitioner visits and pharmacy claims
关键变量
  • 处理：18 岁之前确诊 1 型糖尿病
  • 对照组：五名出生日期和性别完全相同、30 岁之前未确诊的匹配儿童
  • 结果变量：30 岁时的劳动力市场收入
  • 结果变量：30 岁时的就业（劳动收入为正）
  • 异质性：父母收入四分位、父母教育和年龄（因果森林）
  • 机制：HbA1c、因酮症酸中毒或昏迷住院、晚期并发症、受教育程度
时期
出生队列 1977–1987 年；确诊 1986–2004 年；结果变量在 30 岁时测量
样本
1,810 名确诊 1 型糖尿病的儿童和 9,050 名匹配的对照儿童（第 3 节和表 1）；主回归中 10,418 个观测值（表 3） 1977–1987 年出生、在 1986 至 2004 年间于 18 岁之前确诊 1 型糖尿病的丹麦本国出生者，每人匹配五名出生日期和性别相同的未确诊儿童。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Childhood-onset type 1 diabetes 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    All children diagnosed with T1D in Denmark since 1976 are identified through the National Patient Registry (Landspatientregisteret) through ICD-10 codes and before that ICD-8 codes. Since 1996 clinical information is recorded in DanDiabKids, which covers all Danish children and adolescents with T1D seen at pediatric endocrinology clinics and provides the exact date of diagnosis and clinical characteristics from annual follow-up visits. Treatment is an indicator for being diagnosed with T1D before age 18; mean age at onset is 11.8 years.
    登记库： National Patient Registry (LPR), DanDiabKids
    代码： ICD-8 and ICD-10 diabetes codes (specific codes not listed in the paper); diagnosis before age 18
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Data and descriptive statistics); Section 4, equation (1)
  • Analysis sample and matched comparison group 样本界定与时间
    Cohorts born 1977 to 1987, restricted to native Danes, diagnosed from 1986 to 2004 (other background characteristics are only available from 1986). 1,810 children are diagnosed with T1D before they turn 18. For each, five comparison children who had not been diagnosed with T1D before their 30th birthday are matched on the exact date of birth and sex (9,050 individuals). Parental characteristics are measured before the child's birth.
    登记库： Population registers (Statistics Denmark), National Patient Registry (LPR)
    代码： Born 1977-1987; diagnosed 1986-2004; 1:5 match on exact date of birth and sex
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Data and descriptive statistics); Table 1
  • Employment at age 30 就业与劳动力状态
    Indicator for having any positive labor market income at age 30.
    登记库： Income registers
    代码： Labor income > 0 at age 30
    工作论文 · Section 4, equation (1); footnote 6; notes to Table 3
  • Labor market income at age 30 and parental income 劳动收入与收入
    Labor market income in DKK measured at age 30; as a robustness check labor income is defined as the average of labor income at ages 29, 30 and 31. Parental income is measured in the year prior to the child's birth and entered as quartiles; because income data only go back to 1980, about one third of observations have missing parental income.
    登记库： Income registers
    工作论文 · Section 3; Section 5, footnote 8
  • Diabetes-related acute conditions and late complications 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    Among individuals with diabetes: probability of having been admitted to hospital for diabetes-related acute conditions (diabetic ketoacidosis or hypoglycemic coma), outcome mean 0.36; probability of having been diagnosed with any late complication by age 30, outcome mean 0.49; glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c), outcome mean 8.2, with lower values indicating better disease management.
    登记库： National Patient Registry (LPR), DanDiabKids
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Figures A2, A4 and A5 notes

Managing Inequality: Manager-Specific Wage Premiums and Selection in the Managerial Labor Market

Alex Xi He and Daniel le Maire · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2025 · 个人 + 企业

构建了覆盖丹麦全体人口的经理—企业—工人匹配数据集，用以估计经理对工资的影响。在企业间工资不平等中，经理特定的工资溢价几乎与企业溢价同样重要，且与生产率无关；支付高工资的经理在企业被收购后更有可能被替换。

数据
Matched employer-employee data covering all Danish workers and firms (IDA), Occupation codes used to identify managers, Firm balance sheet data for private-sector firms (FIRE), Mergers and acquisitions identified from firm and establishment identifiers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：工人的对数工资
  • 关键估计量：经理特定的工资溢价（由工人和经理的流动识别的经理固定效应）
  • 比较：企业特定的工资溢价
  • 事件：企业被收购和经理更换
  • 异质性：行业集中度（HHI）
时期
1995–2011 年（据 2019 年工作论文的幻灯片）
样本
所查资料中未注明 覆盖丹麦全体人口的经理—企业—工人匹配面板；2019 年工作论文版本中的收购样本包含约 3,700 起私营部门收购。 来源（摘要）
变量如何定义（8）
  • Manager identification 职业与职位层级
    A worker is a manager if their ISCO-88 occupation is 1200-1399 or their job position code is top management (pstill 31); a manager status is carried forward within an establishment in years where it has no identified manager. If no manager is found, the top earner (or anyone in the top 5% of earners) is flagged when not in a non-managerial ISCO>=2000 occupation, earns at least 1.6 times the average of co-workers, or earns more than 1.5 times the second-highest earner; further fallbacks assign the top earner with a unique occupation/position earning >1.3 times the second highest.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： isco 1200-1399; PSTILL==31 (top manager), PSTILL 32 exception; ratio = lonind*(n-1)/(wagebill-lonind) >= 1.6; lonind/second-highest > 1.5
    复制代码 · clean_manager.do
  • Top manager per firm-year 职业与职位层级
    Among identified managers, one manager per establishment-year is kept by successively preferring ISCO 1210 (CEOs), then pstill 31, managers with longer tenure in the establishment, and higher within-establishment earnings rank; only managers observed in at least two firms are retained (mobility needed for identification), establishments that were acquisition targets are excluded, and at the firm (CVR) level the manager of the largest establishment is used.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： isco==1210; pstill==31; target_cumu>=1 dropped
    复制代码 · clean_manager.do
  • Log hourly wage (AKM outcome) 劳动收入与收入
    Log of the IDA hourly wage, deflated to constant prices; when the hourly wage is zero it is replaced by annual labour income divided by 1800. Observations with missing firm ID, labour income <=1, missing education or experience, or unemployment degree above 500 are dropped; firms whose maximum employment is 5 or fewer are excluded.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： timelon; lonind; replace timelon=lonind/1800 if timelon==0; arledgr (unemployment degree) >500 dropped; maxemp<=5 dropped
    复制代码 · AKM_merger_cvrnr.do
  • Mergers and acquisitions 企业特征与生产率
    M&As are identified from establishment (workplace) IDs changing firm (CVR) IDs: a firm-year is a merger if its establishments were owned by more than one distinct firm in the previous year (ignoring spurious ownership changes where an establishment's firm ID reverts); the acquirer is the establishment whose firm ID is unchanged, and targets are establishments whose previous-year firm ID differs when the firm also has an acquirer.
    登记库： IDA, IDAS
    代码： lbnr (establishment), cvrnr (firm); merger = nvals(cvrnr_prevyear)>1 within cvrnr-year; acquirer: cvrnr==cvrnr_prevyear; target: cvrnr!=cvrnr_prevyear & nacquirer>0
    复制代码 · clean_merger.do
  • Firm spinouts and exits 企业特征与生产率
    Share of a firm's workers in establishments that move to a different firm ID next year (spinout) or disappear next year before 2011 (exit).
    登记库： IDA
    代码： spinout = cvrnr_nextyear!=cvrnr; exit = cvrnr_nextyear missing & year<2011
    复制代码 · clean_merger.do
  • Education groups 教育与考试成绩
    Four education groups from the first two digits of the highest completed education code: basic (<=25), vocational (35), short/medium higher (40-50), long higher (>=60).
    登记库： IDA, UDDA
    代码： max_educ = int(HFFSP/1e6): <=25 basic; 35 vocational; 40-50; >=60
    复制代码 · AKM_merger_cvrnr.do; clean_merger.do
  • Firm industry 部门与行业
    Establishment industry is the modal worker industry code if held by more than 50% of workers; firm industry (127- and 36-group) is assigned only if at least 70% of the firm's workers share it, otherwise missing.
    登记库： IDA
    代码： persbrc mapped to pb07, ind127, ind36; thresholds 0.5 (establishment) and 0.7 (firm)
    复制代码 · clean_merger.do
  • Hiring and firing rates 企业特征与生产率
    Hiring rate = workers whose firm ID differs from the previous year divided by lagged firm employment; firing rate = workers whose firm ID differs next year divided by current employment.
    登记库： IDA
    复制代码 · AKM_merger_cvrnr.do

The Physician-Patient Match and Health Inequality

Ida Lykke Kristiansen and Sophie Yanying Sheng · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2025 · 个人

利用登记库中父母的教育程度来度量全科医生童年时期的社会经济地位。社会经济地位低的患者若匹配到背景相近的全科医生，死亡率大幅降低，而社会经济地位高的患者不受影响；通过更密集的诊疗、更好地发现慢性病以及更好的依从性，死亡率的社会经济梯度缩小了四分之一。

数据
National Health Service Register: patient-to-GP clinic assignment, Service Provider Registry (physician IDs), Cause of Death Register, National Health Insurance Service Registry: visits, services, reimbursements, Hospital/patient data and first-line treatments for chronic conditions, Education registers and parent links (BEF/UDDA) for patient SES and physicians' parental education
关键变量
  • 处理：诊所关闭后被分配给社会经济地位低（按父母教育程度衡量）的医生
  • 结果变量：患者死亡率与死因
  • 结果变量：慢性病（CVC、癌症、糖尿病、COPD）的发现／治疗
  • 结果变量：医疗服务利用（就诊次数、每次就诊的服务项目数、报销金额）
  • 患者社会经济地位：最高完成学历（primary school = 社会经济地位低）
时期
1995–2019 年（诊所关闭发生于 1999–2016 年）
样本

Background Matters, but Not Whether Parents Are Immigrants: Outcomes of Children Born in Denmark

Mathias Fjællegaard Jensen and Alan Manning · AEJ: Applied Economics, 2025 · 个人

在丹麦出生、父母为移民的子女，与父母为丹麦出生者的子女相比，劳动收入更低、失业更多、受教育更少、领取的转移支付更多、被定罪也更多。但在控制父母的社会经济特征之后，他们的表现与后者持平甚至略好，可见这些差距反映的是贫困的家庭背景，而不是父母的移民身份。

数据
Danish register data linking children to parents (Statistics Denmark, 1980–2017), Income and earnings registers (annual labour income incl. self-employment, transfers), Monthly employment register (hours, hourly wages, from 2008), Education registers (incl. survey-based registration of foreign education of immigrants), Criminal justice registers (convictions, prison sentences, dropped charges / not-guilty verdicts), Occupation codes (ISCO88)
关键变量
  • 分组：出生在丹麦境外的父母人数（0、1、2；格陵兰／法罗群岛）
  • 结果变量：30 岁时的劳动收入与失业
  • 结果变量：公共转移支付、30 岁前完成的教育程度
  • 结果变量：刑事定罪、监禁判决、被撤销的指控
  • 控制变量：子女童年时期父母的收入、失业年数、职业和教育
时期
1980–2017
样本
396,417 名子女（表 1 合计）；其中父母均为丹麦出生者 362,460 人，父母均为移民 10,399 人，父母一方为移民 20,908 人，父母一方来自格陵兰／法罗群岛 2,650 人 1980–1987 年出生在丹麦、父母双方信息均已知的全部子女，追踪至 30 岁。 来源
调查
Foreign-education survey
变量如何定义（11）
  • Child sample 样本界定与时间
    Everyone born in Denmark 1980-1987 with both parents known in BEF and known parental origin. Observed in the year they turn 30, kept only if fully liable to pay taxes in Denmark (AKM register) and resident in Denmark (BEF). Children missing any outcome or control are dropped (missing parental occupation and education allowed), as are children whose parents were not in the population at birth.
    登记库： BEF, AKM

    Groups based on the parents' country of birth in BEF: two parents born in Denmark (reference), two parents born outside Denmark, one parent born in Denmark and one abroad, and at least one parent born in Greenland or the Faroe Islands. Origin regions: Middle East = MENAP+MENAT (incl. some North African countries, Israel, Turkey, Pakistan, Afghanistan); Europe split into Nordics, EU-15 ex. Nordic (incl. UK), EU-13 (incl. Cyprus) and non-EU (incl. Yugoslavia).
    登记库： BEF

    A first-generation local is 'low income origin' if at least one parent comes from a country whose 1980 GDP per capita (World Bank, supplemented with UN data) was below 4,000 USD at 2022 prices. Parents with only continent observed are assigned by the majority in that continent.

  • Annual labour market income (earnings at 30) 劳动收入与收入
    Aggregate labour market income including wage income and profits from self-employment in the year the child turns 30, in 2013 prices (CPI-deflated). Also used as an income rank, IHS and log.

    Hourly wage from monthly hours and monthly earnings for employees in the monthly register (available from 2008; self-employed excluded), in 2013 prices. Jobs are excluded if the hourly wage is above 5,000 or below 30 DKK, annual hours are above 3,500 or below 7.4, or total wages are above 10,000,000 or below 1,000 DKK.

Mikkel Aagaard Houmark, Victor Ronda, Esben Agerbo, Preben Bo Mortensen and Michael Rosholm · Economic Journal, 2025 · 个人

研究表明，按教育程度多基因评分划分的学业成绩差距与按社会经济地位（SES）划分的差距一样大，并且在小学阶段不断扩大，但仅见于低 SES 儿童。对社区和学校的选择解释了部分 SES 差距，却完全不能解释遗传差距；后者与尽责性和学习环境有关。

数据
iPSYCH2015 case-cohort genotype sample (neonatal blood spots from the Danish National Biobank), Danish national tests (reading and mathematics, grades 2–8), Population registers with parent-child links (BEF), Parental income registers (IND), Parental education registers (UDDA), Psychiatric diagnoses of parents (patient registers), School and neighbourhood identifiers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：标准化的全国阅读测试成绩（2、4、6、8 年级）；数学测试（3、6、8 年级）
  • 核心解释变量：教育程度多基因评分（EA PGS）
  • 核心解释变量：由父母收入和教育构建的 SES 指数
  • 兄弟姐妹固定效应：PGS 的家庭内部变异
  • 中介变量：社区和学校分选

1994–2008 年出生；全国测试自 2010 年起
样本
40,136 人、87,917 个阅读测试结果（24,062 名精神疾病病例，16,074 名随机对照）；兄弟姐妹样本 2,705 人 1994–2008 年出生、在 2 年级至 8 年级之间至少完成一次全国测试、已做基因分型的 iPSYCH 欧洲血统儿童。 来源
变量如何定义（11）

Repeated tests of the same subject-grade are dropped (first test kept by test time).

  • Parental years of education 教育与考试成绩

  • SES rank / SES index 劳动收入与收入
    Families are ranked in percentiles (one observation per child) on the sum of parents' years of education and on log family disposable income; the two percentile ranks are summed and re-ranked into percentiles scaled to 0-0.99 (ses_rank), and the SES index is this rank standardised to mean 0, SD 1 within the sample.

Population register with family links (BEF), Education register (UDDA), Income, assets and transfers register (IND), Sentencing register (KRAF), Incarceration register (KRIN), Danish Household Expenditure Survey, Danish Longitudinal Survey of Children (DALSC), 9th-grade national leaving exam scores

  • 结果变量：16 岁时的数学考试成绩和 11 岁时的语言测试成绩

1980–2019
样本
约 100,000 名儿童及其家庭（105,953 人；IGE 双对数样本为 98,686 人） 1981 年和 1982 年出生并与父母相连接的子女，本人及父母均为非迁移者；另加用于考试成绩分析的 1995–1997 年出生队列，以及 DALSC 中 1995 年出生的儿童。 来源

Expenditure Survey, DALSC
变量如何定义（9）
  • Parental wage income 劳动收入与收入
    Pre-tax taxable wage earnings plus other wage-type income such as fringe benefits and stock options; parental resources are the sum of mother's and father's amounts irrespective of marital status, measured at each age of the child.

  • Disposable income 劳动收入与收入
    Total personal income (wage income, business and self-employment income, capital income, public transfer income, property income and other non-classifiable personal income) plus the rental value of own home for owner-occupiers, minus taxes and interest expenses. Spouses' or cohabitees' resources pooled where appropriate.
    登记库： IND
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, measure 2 and footnote 18
  • Expected lifetime wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Expected present value at age t of future disposable income (adjusted for unrealized housing capital gains) discounted with a subjective stochastic discount factor (beta = 0.96), where expectations condition on an estimated information set (gender, education level, employment status, cohabitation, number of children, quartiles of mean income, mean consumption, consumption growth and consumption SD, homeownership, and interactions).

    Household consumption predicted from register disposable income and assets and liabilities in t and t-1 by a random forest (number of trees by 5-fold cross-validation) trained on the Danish Household Expenditure Survey (1997+); adult-equivalent using the OECD equivalence scale.

Appendix D.2 splits into violent, property (e.g. forgery, arson, burglary, theft, shoplifting, embezzlement, fraud, extortion, robbery, tax fraud, vandalism) and other crimes (all except violent, property and traffic), measured by ages 20, 25 and 30.

138,384 个观测值（上限 DD）和 520,452 个观测值（夫妻 DD，夫妻与夫妻比较） 1989 年改革前处于财富分布前 1% 的丹麦家庭（上限 DD）或处于前 5% 的已婚夫妻（夫妻 DD）构成的平衡面板。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Household (tax unit) and married status 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Household id is the family id when the person's spouse id equals the cohabitation partner id and civil status is in the married range (up to 2007, from FAIN); from 2008 from BEF using spouse id = partner id and civil status G or P. Persons not so linked form their own household. Only persons aged 20+ are kept and wealth is summed within household.
    登记库： FAIN, BEF
    代码： FAIN (<=2007): aegtefaelle_id == c_faelle_id, c_status 2-5, hhid = c_familie_id; BEF (>=2008): aegte_id == efalle, civst in {G, P}; alder >= 20
    复制代码 · Empirical Analysis/DD_make_hh_ids.do
  • Household taxable wealth (outcome) 财富、负债与消费
    Household net taxable wealth = sum over household members aged 20+ of the wealth variable FORM from the income-tax register (INDH); outcome is log(FORM). Portfolio shares use INDK components: equity share = listed stocks / total assets, housing share = (mortgage deeds + real estate value) / total assets.
    登记库： INDH, INDK
    代码： FORM (INDH); share_tx_equities = KURSAKT/QAKTIVF; share_tx_housing = (KURSPANT+KOEJD)/QAKTIVF; other INDK fields: FORMSK, LOFTFORM, QPASSIV, PRIGALD, KONTANT, KURSOBL, INDESTPI
    复制代码 · Empirical Analysis/DD_base_data.do, section 1
  • Wealth tax exemption threshold and marginal wealth tax 税收与税率
    Annual exemption threshold (allowance) by year; for couples it equals 2 x single allowance, except 1989-1992 when couples' allowance uses a separate married allowance x 2. Household marginal wealth tax rate tau_it = statutory rate if FORM exceeds the household allowance, else 0. Bunching analysis uses distance b = FORM - allowance, deflated, in DKK 20,000 bins from -540,000 to 540,000.
    登记库： INDH
    代码： Allowance (DKK): 1980-81 1,000,000; 1982 1,083,000; 1983 1,158,900; 1984 1,204,900; 1985 1,229,200; 1986 1,253,500; 1987 1,278,700; 1988 1,329,900; 1989 1,383,600; 1990 1,424,500; 1991 1,452,700; 1992 1,482,100; 1993 1,534,500; 1994 1,580,500; 1995 1,592,000; 1996 2,400,000; married: 1989-90 811,500x2, 1991 1,249,600x2, 1992-96 2x single
    复制代码 · Empirical Analysis/DD_base_data.do section 2.2; bunching_base_data.do
  • Ceiling DD treatment (unbound by tax ceiling) 税收与税率
    X = wealth tax actually paid (FORMSK) / theoretical wealth tax ((FORM - allowance) x tax rate). Treatment: household in top 1% of the wealth distribution with X > 0.99 in every pre-reform year of the window (e.g. 1982-1988), i.e. not bound by the tax ceiling; control: top 1% with X < 0.80 (bound by ceiling). Households above the 99.99th percentile excluded. In the panel, status is re-coded post-reform using X, LOFTFORM > 0 and wealth relative to allowance.
    登记库： INDK, INDH, FAIN
    代码： treatmt_2e_X80: X > .99 and top1 in 1982-1988; control_2e_X80: X < .80 and top1; drop form_pctile > .9999
    复制代码 · Empirical Analysis/DD_balance_and_treatment_status.do section 3.4; DD_base_data.do section 2.3
  • Couples DD treatment 税收与税率
    Treatment: married households with wealth between the (single) allowance and 2 x allowance in each pre-reform year (1988 and earlier years depending on window), which became exempt when the couples' threshold doubled in 1989; controls: (c1) singles with wealth in the same band, (c4) married couples in the top 5% with wealth below the allowance, or (c5) singles with wealth between allowance/2 and allowance.
    登记库： INDH, FAIN
    代码： treatmt_c1*: married & allowance <= FORM <= 2*allowance; control_c1*: unmarried, same band; control_c4*: married & FORM < allowance & top5; control_c5*: unmarried & allowance/2 <= FORM <= allowance

  • Balanced panel 1980-1996 样本界定与时间
    Households (persons 20+ aggregated by household id) observed with strictly positive aggregate wealth FORM in all 17 years 1980-1996.
    登记库： INDH, FAIN
    代码： drop if form <= 0 | missing; keep if _N == 17 (balanced_1980_96)

    Household flagged as self-employed if business profit (NETOVSKUD_GL) is nonzero; a broader 'ext' flag also uses nonzero values of EGNKAPVK, UDLFKURS, UDLIND2 or UDLIND3 (foreign/business-related components).

Time Discounting and Wealth Inequality

Thomas Epper, Ernst Fehr, Helga Fehr-Duda, Claus Thustrup Kreiner, David Dreyer Lassen, Søren Leth-Petersen and Gregers Nytoft Rasmussen · American Economic Review, 2020 · 个人

将有真实激励的时间贴现实验与登记库中一大批丹麦中年人样本的财富状况相链接。有耐心的人在财富分布中的位置明显更高，在控制教育、收入轨迹、学校成绩、初始财富和父母财富、信贷约束以及风险偏好之后，这一关联依然存在，表明储蓄行为是其中的渠道。

数据
Incentivised online convex time budget experiment (February 2015) linked on CPR, Income and wealth registers based on third-party reports (1980–2015), Population register (BEF) for sampling and demographics, Education and family registers, Survey of time discounting for the 1952–1955 cohorts at ages 18–21
关键变量
  • 结果变量：个人在净财富分布中的百分位排名
  • 主要解释变量：实验测得的耐心程度（时间贴现）
  • 控制变量：教育、收入、父母财富、风险态度
  • 异质性：受信贷约束者与不受约束者
时期
实验于 2015 年进行；登记数据为 1980–2015 年（财富排名追踪 2001–2015 年）
样本
3,620 名实验参与者（受邀 27,613 人）；1952–1955 年出生队列中的 2,548 名调查对象 1973–1983 年出生、七岁时居住在哥本哈根市镇并完成在线实验的丹麦人。 来源
调查
Time-discounting experiment
变量如何定义（10）
  • Net wealth 财富、负债与消费
    In the respondent vs non-respondent comparison (2015 values), wealth = real estate, deposits, stocks, bonds, mortgage deeds in deposit, cars and pension accounts minus all debt except debt to private persons; tax-assessed housing values adjusted by the average ratio of market prices to tax-assessed values among traded houses of the same property class, location and price range. Robustness variants: market-adjusted housing; adding car stock (available from 2014); adding pension wealth; household-level wealth; liquid financial wealth only (stocks, bonds, deposits).
    登记库： Third-party reported wealth registers (SKAT/Statistics Denmark)
    代码： Car and pension wealth only available from 2014
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Table A5 notes; Table A10
  • Wealth percentile rank 财富、负债与消费
    Within cohort x year percentile rank in the sample; robustness versions use averages over 2013-2015, 2011-2015 and 2009-2015, and household-level wealth.
    登记库： Wealth registers
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Figure A10 notes; Table A11
  • Credit-constrained indicator 财富、负债与消费
    Holding liquid assets worth less than one month's disposable income (measured in 2014 and over 2001-2015).
    登记库： Third-party reported wealth and income registers
    代码： Liquid assets < 1/12 of annual disposable income
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Figure A8 notes
  • Marginal interest rate (interest on marginal liquidity) 财富、负债与消费
    From tax-authority loan-level data: interest rate per loan r = interest paid in 2014 / (0.5 x (balance end-2013 + balance end-2014)); only non-mortgage loans, minimum denominator DKK 1,000, rates censored at the 5th and 95th percentiles. For respondents with loan accounts the marginal rate is the highest loan-specific rate; for respondents with only deposit accounts it is the smallest account-specific deposit rate. Distribution: p5 0.00, p25 0.97, p50 6.25, p75 12.73 percent.
    登记库： Danish Tax Agency (SKAT) account-level loan and deposit data, 2013-2014
    代码： Non-mortgage loans; denominator >= DKK 1,000; censored p5/p95
    在线附录 · Online Appendix C.4; Table A8
  • Stock market return 财富、负债与消费
    (Dividend income + realised capital gains/losses during the year) / market value of stocks, averaged over 2008-2014; plus an indicator for owning stocks during the period.
    登记库： Tax-based income and wealth registers
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Table 2 col. 7 discussion)
  • Parental wealth / initial wealth deciles 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Parental wealth decile = parents' position in the parental wealth distribution measured within the respondent's cohort when the respondent was 18; initial wealth decile = own position in the within-cohort wealth distribution at age 18.
    登记库： Wealth register, Population register (parent links)
    工作论文 · Table 2 notes; Figure 3 notes
  • Income controls 劳动收入与收入
    Gross income = annual income excluding capital income (DKK).
    登记库： Income register
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Table A5 notes
  • Experiment sample 样本界定与时间
    3,620 respondents (3,552 with controls) with full register variables; robustness subsamples: both parents alive (2,367); in labour force every year and never unemployed 2011-2015 (2,265); stable relationship status 2011-2015 (2,704); socioeconomic status never indicating poor health 2008-2015 (3,030). Inverse probability weights based on respondents vs invited non-respondents or vs population, using education-year dummies, income deciles, income growth, parental wealth, wealth at age 18, age, gender, single and dependent-children dummies.
    登记库： Population register (BEF); income, wealth and education registers
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Tables A5, A10, A11
  • Patience index 其他
    Patience groups by tertiles of the non-parametric patience measure with cut-offs Low [0.0,0.5], Medium [0.5,0.8], High [0.8,1.0]. Survey alternative (follow-up of 2,096 respondents) uses the 1973 Danish Longitudinal Survey of Youth job-profile question: average salary from start (low), low salary first two years then high (medium), very low salary first four years then very high (high).
    登记库： Online experiment linked on CPR
    代码： Cut-offs 0.5 and 0.8
    在线附录 · Online Appendix Figures A8-A10
  • Years of education 教育与考试成绩
    Robustness replaces years-of-schooling indicators with indicators for 59 general educational subject groups (e.g. comparative literature studies, economics, physics).
    登记库： Education register
    代码： 59 educational groups

Tax Evasion and Inequality

Annette Alstadsæter, Niels Johannesen and Gabriel Zucman · American Economic Review, 2019 · 个人

将泄露的离岸账户数据（HSBC Switzerland、Panama Papers）和税收特赦记录与斯堪的纳维亚的财富登记库相匹配。逃税随财富急剧上升：最富有的 0.01% 逃掉了约四分之一的应纳税款，这使测得的顶层财富份额明显上升。

数据
Leaked HSBC Switzerland client list (Swiss Leaks, 2007) matched to tax records in Denmark, Norway and Sweden, Panama Papers / Mossack Fonseca leak matched to Norwegian and Swedish wealth data (not Denmark), Tax amnesty voluntary disclosures in Norway and Sweden, Population-wide administrative wealth and income tax records for Norway, Sweden and Denmark, Danish stratified random tax audits by SKAT (tax years 2008, 2010, 2012), National accounts household wealth totals
关键变量
  • 结果变量：按财富组别划分的逃税额（占应纳税款的比重）
  • 排序变量：家庭净财富，含推算的养老金财富
  • 指示变量：持有未申报的 HSBC 账户／Panama Papers 空壳公司／参加税收特赦
  • 结果变量（事件研究）：特赦后的申报财富和申报收入
  • 随机稽查查出的逃税（境内逃税）
时期
HSBC 泄露数据为 2006–2007 年；税收特赦自 2006 年起；丹麦随机稽查针对 2008、2010、2012 纳税年度
样本
520 个 HSBC 家庭；165 个 Panama Papers 家庭；挪威 1,422 名、瑞典 6,811 名参加特赦的纳税人；18,985 名被随机稽查的丹麦纳税人 出现在离岸泄露数据或税收特赦中的斯堪的纳维亚家庭，按其在全体人口财富分布中的位置排序，并结合丹麦的随机稽查数据。 来源
变量如何定义（4）
  • Household (unit of analysis) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    A household is either a single person aged 20 or above or a married couple, in both cases with dependent children if any; fractiles are defined relative to the total number of households, including those not liable to wealth tax.
    登记库： Administrative wealth and income records
    在线附录 · Online Appendix A.1.2
  • Household net wealth (ranking variable) 财富、负债与消费
    100% of national-accounts household wealth at market value distributed to households: all non-financial and financial assets minus debts, including funded pensions, excluding durables and valuables. Pension wealth imputed (40% to wage earners pro rata wage income, 60% to retirees pro rata pension income); unlisted equity imputed by capitalizing unlisted dividends and non-corporate business assets by capitalizing business income. Danish distribution taken from Jakobsen et al. (2018), based on individual wealth records.
    登记库： Danish individual wealth records, National accounts
    工作论文 · Section 3.2; Online Appendix A and D
  • HSBC undeclared account holder 税收与税率
    Households who owned at least one account at HSBC Switzerland (including via shell companies with identified beneficial owners), declared themselves taxable in Scandinavia in 2006 and could be matched to a tax return (2006/2007 records); non-residents excluded; for Denmark all matched households are treated as evaders (about 95% of matched Danish accounts were undeclared).
    登记库： Leaked HSBC list (Danish tax authority version), Tax returns
    工作论文 · Section 3.1.1, footnotes 13-16; Online Appendix E
  • Random-audit detected evasion 税收与税率
    SKAT stratified random audits for tax years 2008, 2010 and 2012 (18,985 taxpayers; self-employed and complex returns oversampled), every line item examined; main results include all errors; deliberate evaders are those rated 0-2 on SKAT's 0-6 compliance scale. Evasion rate = taxes evaded / (taxes paid + taxes evaded) by wealth group, weighted by audit weights.
    登记库： SKAT random audit data
    代码： SKAT compliance rating 0-2 = deliberate evasion
    在线附录 · Section 4 (Random Audit Data); Online Appendix H.1-H.2

Correlation of Brothers' Earnings and Intergenerational Transmission

Paul Bingley and Lorenzo Cappellari · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2019 · 个人

将丹麦兄弟之间的劳动收入相关性分解为由父亲劳动收入解释的部分，以及由其他共同的家庭和社区因素造成的部分。在处理了永久性劳动收入和生命周期偏误之后，代际传递在兄弟相似性中所占的份额，比简单的父子弹性所显示的更大。

数据
Civil registration system / population register with parent-child links (BEF), Income Statistics Register (IND): annual pre-tax labour earnings from tax returns
关键变量
  • 结果变量：年度税前劳动收入（所有工作的合计），25–60 岁
  • 家庭结构：父亲／长子／次子三人组
  • 生命周期：每 3 年一组的出生队列分组和年龄
时期
1980–2014
样本
101,077 个家庭中的 303,231 名男性；5,488,445 个劳动收入观测值 1935–1961 年出生的丹麦父亲及其同母所生的长子和次子（1959–1985 年出生），至少有连续五个为正的劳动收入观测值。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Annual labour earnings 劳动收入与收入
    Annual pre-tax labour earnings from income tax returns, summed over all employments in the year, 1980-2014, deflated to 2012 DKK with a year-specific index (earn/R*6768). In code: IDA person variable lonind for 1980-2009, corloen for 2010-2011 and from the IND register for 2012-2014; negative values recoded to 0.
    登记库： IDA (idaperson), IND, Income Statistics Register
    代码： lonind (IDA person 1980-2009); corloen (2010-2014)
    复制代码 · triplet-data-creation-20160706.do ('collect earnings histories'); IZA DP10761 Section III
  • Earnings sample trimming and age window 样本界定与时间
    Person-year observations kept at (cohort-central) ages 25-60; missing and non-positive earnings dropped; the lower and upper 0.5% of earnings dropped by family member type (father, son 1, son 2) and year; individuals must have at least 5 consecutive years of earnings observations.
    登记库： IDA, IND
    复制代码 · inspection.do ('EARNINGS TRIMMINGS', consecutive-observation block)
  • Father/first-son/second-son triads 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Fathers born 1935-1961 (code frame 1935-1969) with two sons by the same mother, linked through the fertility database (ftdb2010, father pnrf and mother pnrm) restricted to madopt=='1'; twins/multiple births dropped; only sons of the same mother-father match as the father's first son kept; sons who are themselves fathers in the sample are dropped; families whose triplet birth order is inconsistent with population birth order are purged; fathers younger than 18 (216 months) at first son's birth dropped; brother spacing must be 12-144 months; first sons born 1959-1985, second sons 1962-1985.
    登记库： BEF/fodselsdata, Fertility database (ftdb2010)
    代码： koen=='1' (male); madopt=='1'; birth order border 0=father,1=son1,2=son2
    复制代码 · triplet-data-creation-20160706.do; inspection.do; IZA DP10761 Section III
  • 3-year birth cohort groups 样本界定与时间
    Individuals are grouped into 3-year birth cohorts (central years 1936, 1939, ..., 1984), with the cohort's central birth year used to compute age (ageco = year - cohort).
    登记库： BEF
    复制代码 · inspection.do
  • Years of schooling (own and father's) 教育与考试成绩
    Years of completed education computed as int(HFPRIA/12) from the latest available education register record (1980-2009), recoding 0-7 to 7 and 18-21 to 18; father's schooling linked through the fertility database father identifier.
    登记库： UDDA, Fertility database (ftdb2010)
    代码： hfpria; educ=int(hfpria/12), recode 0/7=7, 18/21=18
    复制代码 · data-creation-triplet-education.do
  • Sibling birth-order counts 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Numbers of older/younger brothers and sisters with the same father and with the same father-mother pair, computed over all children of the father (twins ordered randomly), for robustness to sibling composition.
    登记库： fodselsdata, Fertility database (ftdb2010)
    代码： nobsf, nybsf, nobsfm, nybsfm, nossf, nyssf, nossfm, nyssfm
