Born with a Silver Spoon? Danish Evidence on Wealth Inequality in Childhood

Simon Halphen Boserup, Wojciech Kopczuk and Claus Thustrup Kreiner · Economic Journal, 2018 · 个人

第三方报送的儿童财富记录显示，童年时期的财富不平等程度与成年人中一样高，顶端份额主要由父母和祖父母的转移所推动。18 岁时的财富能够预测成年后的财富，代际财富相关性在很小的年龄就已存在。

数据
Individual wealth data from tax return records (Danish Tax Agency SKAT, via Statistics Denmark), Population register with parent identifiers (BEF), Education and income registers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：子女成年后（45 岁）的财富及财富排名
  • 关键解释变量：童年财富（18 岁）与父母财富排名
  • 推断的生前赠与和遗产（在赠与税免税额处的聚束）
  • 资产组合构成（存款、证券、房地产、债务）
时期
1983–2011
样本
混合截面：每个一岁年龄组平均接近 65 万个观测值；面板回归：36,102 个观测值 2000–2011 年间所有 1–40 岁且父母在世的个人（混合截面），以及 1965 年出生队列中父母双方在 2011 年均在世者构成的面板，追踪期为 1983–2011 年。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Net wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Value of assets minus liabilities measured on the last day of the year from administrative tax return records (SKAT), 1983-2011; mostly third-party reported by banks and financial institutions. Assets include deposits, stocks, bonds, real estate and deposited mortgages; liabilities include bank debt, mortgage credit debt, card debt, student debt, debt to municipalities, unpaid taxes, etc. Pension funds are not included; self-reported items (cars, boats, etc.) are excluded after the 1996 abolition of the wealth tax.
    登记库： SKAT wealth records (via Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 2 (Data)
  • Real estate valuation 财富、负债与消费
    Public (tax-assessed) values of real estate are adjusted upwards each year using the average relative difference between selling price and public value of real estate traded that year, following Leth-Petersen (2010).
    登记库： SKAT wealth records
    工作论文 · Section 2, footnote 6
  • Portfolio components 财富、负债与消费
    From 1995 onwards complete portfolio information on bonds, stocks, cash in banks, real estate, mortgage loans and the sum of other loans; childhood holdings summarised as bank deposits, securities and real estate.
    登记库： SKAT wealth records
    工作论文 · Sections 2 and 3.1
  • Wealth percentile rank 财富、负债与消费
    Percentile rank computed within child age-year specific wealth distributions (parents ranked on total parental wealth observed at the same time); ties, notably zero wealth among young children, are randomly broken. Adult outcome is the child's rank at age 45 (27 years after age 18).
    登记库： SKAT wealth records, Population register (parent links)
    工作论文 · Section 3.3, footnote 11; Section 3.4
  • Inferred wealth transfers (residual) 财富、负债与消费
    For each child, wealth at a given age minus the present value of earnings up to that age (real interest rates 0%, 3%, 6%), censored at zero, as a lower bound on transfers received.
    登记库： SKAT wealth records, Income registers
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, Table 1
  • Gift-tax bunching measure 税收与税率
    First time an individual (ages 1-12) has positive wealth, wealth at that point treated as the transfer; distance to the gift-tax basic allowance (DKK 58,700 in 2011) and to twice that amount (two donors) is plotted to look for bunching.
    登记库： SKAT wealth records
    工作论文 · Section 3.2, Figure 6
  • PCD and PD samples 样本界定与时间
    PCD: pooled cross-section of all individuals aged 1-40 in 2000-2011 with parents alive (parent IDs registered for Danes born from 1960). PD: panel of the 1965 birth cohort with both parents alive in 2011, followed 1983-2011 (ages 18-46). Monetary values deflated by CPI (2011 prices).
    登记库： Population register (parent links), SKAT wealth records
    工作论文 · Section 2; Tables A1-A2

Wage Dispersion and Decentralization of Wage Bargaining

Christian M. Dahl, Daniel le Maire and Jakob R. Munch · Journal of Labor Economics, 2013 · 个人 + 企业

利用丹麦 1990 年代工资谈判由集中谈判转向企业层面谈判这一变化。与部门层面谈判相比，适用企业层面谈判的工人获得工资溢价，技能回报更高，工资离散程度也更大。

数据
Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA), matched employer-employee data, Income register (tax files), Supplementary Pension Fund (ATP) contributions for hours worked, DA/LO bargaining-segment classification by NACE industry and DISCO occupation (Confederation of Danish Employers)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：小时工资的对数（劳动收入加强制性养老金缴款，除以工时）
  • 处理：工资决定制度（标准工资率制、最低工资制、最低薪酬制、企业层面谈判）
  • 结果变量：工资离散度（分位数回归）和技能回报
  • 控制变量：性别、子女、婚姻、移民身份、教育、工作经验、工作场所规模、行业×年份虚拟变量
  • 工人固定效应；工资决定制度随时间的变化
时期
1992–2001
样本
约 114 万个工人—年观测值（1,137,367） 36 个 DA/LO 谈判领域中年龄 25–65 岁的私营部门全职工人的 30% 随机样本，所在工作场所至少有五名雇员。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Hourly wage rate 劳动收入与收入
    Sum of total labour income (from tax files in the Income Register) and mandatory pension fund payments, divided by the total number of hours worked in the year (ATP-imputed); observations with unobserved wage, wage flagged by Statistics Denmark as low precision, or in the top or bottom half percentile are discarded.
    登记库： IND, IDA, ATP
    工作论文 · Section 4 (pp. 13-14)
  • Annual hours (ATP-based) 工作时间
    Imputed from the worker's ATP contribution group: no payment for 0-9 weekly hours, 1/3 of full-time payment for 9-18, 2/3 for 18-27, and full payment for 27+; workers paying full-time ATP are assigned hours corresponding to the standard 37-hour week. Overtime not captured.
    登记库： ATP
    工作论文 · Section 4 (p. 13)
  • Bargaining segment / wage-setting system 部门与行业
    Workers are allocated to 36 DA/LO bargaining segments using six-digit NACE industry and four-digit DISCO (ISCO-88) occupation codes, as DA and LO do (about 85% of DA/LO employment); each segment's yearly system is classified as standard-rate (normallønssystemet), minimum-wage (minimallønssystemet), minimum-pay (mindstebetalingssystemet) or firm-level bargaining (uden lønsats).
    登记库： IDA, DA/LO bargaining segment classification
    代码： NACE 6-digit x DISCO 4-digit (segment list not given)
    工作论文 · Section 2 (p. 10) and Section 4 (p. 12)
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Full-time workers aged 25-65 employed in one of the DA/LO bargaining segments, 1992-2001, excluding scholarship recipients in ordinary education, plants with fewer than five employees, and observations with unreliable/extreme wages; a 30% random sample is drawn (about 1.14 million worker-years).
    登记库： IDA, IND
    工作论文 · Section 4 (p. 14)
  • Education groups 教育与考试成绩
    Unskilled (high school or equivalent or less), vocational education (final stage of secondary education preparing for direct labour market entry), short-term higher education and long-term higher education, from the Danish education code corresponding to ISCED (higher education = ISCED 5 and 6).
    登记库： UDDA
    代码： ISCED 5-6 = higher education
    工作论文 · Section 4 and footnote 4
  • Labour market experience 就业与劳动力状态
    Actual labour market experience accumulated since 1964.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 4 (p. 13)
  • Plant size and workforce composition 企业特征与生产率
    Plant size defined as the number of employees, plus variables measuring the labour force composition at plant level; regressions also include 25 industry dummies interacted with year dummies.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 4 (p. 13)

Unemployment Insurance, Wage Dynamics and Inequality Over the Life Cycle

Paul Bingley, Lorenzo Cappellari and Niels Westergård-Nielsen · Economic Journal, 2013 · 个人

对丹麦男性生命周期内工资的持久性和暂时性动态建模，并允许这些动态因是否加入失业保险而不同。参保与较低的工资不平等和较弱的冲击持续性相关；论文还量化了与非成员相比，失业保险成员避免了多少生命周期工资不平等。

数据
Administrative register data on the Danish labour force (Statistics Denmark): annual labour earnings and hours-derived hourly wages, UI fund membership contributions reported to tax authorities, Mandatory pension contributions (ATP) for year of labour market entry
关键变量
  • 结果变量：税前小时工资的对数（持久性成分与暂时性成分）
  • 核心解释变量：失业保险基金成员身份
  • 潜在劳动力市场经验
  • 出生队列（1943–1973 年，共 31 个队列）
时期
1980–2003
样本
约 810,000 人，约 1250 万个人年观测值 年龄 21–55 岁、1943–1973 年出生的丹麦男性私营部门全职雇员，至少有连续五个有效工资观测值。 来源
变量如何定义（4）
  • Gross hourly wage 劳动收入与收入
    Calculated by Statistics Denmark as annual labour earnings (reported by employers to the tax authorities) divided by hours worked, where hours are an annual average derived by Statistics Denmark from mandatory pension (ATP) contributions adjusted for contribution rates by sector and collective agreement. Zero wages dropped, bottom and top 0.5% trimmed per year, observations below minimum wage dropped.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark administrative registers, ATP
    工作论文 · Section 4 and footnote 13
  • UI fund membership 失业与福利金
    Annual dummy for UI fund membership, observed from tax-deductible UI fund membership contributions reported annually by the funds to the tax authorities.
    登记库： Tax records
    工作论文 · Section 4
  • 潜在劳动力市场经验 就业与劳动力状态
    Years since entering the labour market, where year of entry is observed from the first mandatory pension (ATP) contribution; ATP was introduced in 1964, so entry is censored at 1964.
    登记库： ATP
    工作论文 · Section 4
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Men aged 21-55, full-time private-sector employees, 1980-2003, birth cohorts 1943-1973 (31 single-year cohorts; each observed at least ten years). Individuals must have valid wage observations for at least five consecutive years.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark administrative registers
    工作论文 · Section 4

政治经济学

选民对移民的反应。

Refugee Migration and Electoral Outcomes

Christian Dustmann, Kristine Vasiljeva and Anna Piil Damm · Review of Economic Studies, 2019 · 个人

利用准随机的难民分散安置政策发现，难民安置提高了反移民政党在农村市镇的得票率，而在最大的城市市镇则降低了其得票率。在难民相对于本国出生者人数较少的地方，以及安置后犯罪上升的地方，效应最强。

数据
Population register (BEF) to identify refugees and municipality of initial placement, Income, education, labour force and socio-economic registers for 1985 municipality characteristics, Statistics Denmark municipal and parliamentary election results, Danish National Election Survey (DNES) 1990–98
关键变量
  • 结果变量：反移民政党（进步党 Progress Party、丹麦人民党 Danish People's Party）得票率的变化
  • 处理：累计分配难民占市镇人口的比重（以 1986 年为基期）
  • 变异来源：丹麦空间分散安置政策（Danish Spatial Dispersal Policy）在 1986–98 年对难民的分配
  • 异质性：城市市镇与农村市镇
  • 控制变量：1985 年的市镇特征
时期
难民分配为 1986–1998 年；议会选举为 1990–98 年，市镇选举为 1989–97 年
样本
275 个市镇（议会选举为 550 个观测值）；1986–98 年共分配 76,673 名难民 1986–98 年难民分散安置政策期间，在各选举周期被观测到的全部 275 个丹麦市镇。 来源
调查
National Election Study
变量如何定义（6）
  • Allocated refugees 移民身份与来源地
    Refugees received in 1986-1998 who initially received a permanent residence permit, from Lebanon, Iran, Iraq, Somalia, Sri Lanka, Vietnam, Afghanistan, Ethiopia, or without citizenship; municipality of initial placement identified from the population register. Refugees from former Yugoslavia (special 1993 policy) and family-reunified spouses/children arriving more than 12 months after the refugee are excluded.
    登记库： BEF (population register)
    论文正文 · Sections 2.4-2.5, footnotes 19-20
  • Refugee share (treatment) 移民身份与来源地
    Cumulative number of refugees allocated to the municipality from 1986 until the year preceding each election, divided by the municipal population at the beginning of 1986; regressor is its change between consecutive election years (RS_it).
    登记库： BEF
    论文正文 · Section 2.4 and Section 3.2, eq. (3.1)
  • Vote share changes by party group 其他
    Percentage-point change in municipal vote shares between election years t-1 and t (1989-98: three parliamentary and three municipal elections) for anti-immigration parties (Progress Party and Danish People's Party), centre-right, centre-left and small centre parties; seat shares also computed.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark election results
    论文正文 · Sections 2.1 and 3.2, Table 1
  • Urban municipality 地理与社区
    Municipalities above the 95th percentile of municipal population size are labelled urban.
    登记库： BEF
    论文正文 · Introduction
  • Share of rich (1985 municipal control) 劳动收入与收入
    Share of adults whose disposable income as a household member is above 50% of the Danish median (one of several 1985 municipal characteristics with immigrant share, mean log gross earnings, crime rate, church-tax payers, unemployment rate, tertiary education share, immigrant welfare dependency).
    登记库： Income registers, Population, education, labour force and socio-economic registers
    论文正文 · Section 2.4, footnote 22
  • Non-employment 就业与劳动力状态
    Being unemployed or not in the labour force at ages 18-65.
    登记库： Labour force registers
    论文正文 · Section 2, footnote 23

宏观经济与预期

用丹麦微观数据构建的分解账户、预期和企业定价研究。

Disaggregated Economic Accounts

Asger Lau Andersen, Kilian Huber, Niels Johannesen, Ludwig Straub and Emil Toft Vestergaard · Quarterly Journal of Economics, 2026 · 个人 + 企业

构建一套国民账户体系，将其细分为地区 × 行业的消费者单元、生产者单元、政府和世界其他地区之间的双边资金流，并利用银行交易数据和登记库在丹麦加以实现。支出存在本地偏向和城市偏向；当财政转移支付投向那些支出会流向高失业单元的单元时，对 GDP 的提升更大。

数据
Danske Bank geo-coded transaction-level data (about 20% of Danish adult consumers), 2018–2019, Government tax and income registers (labour compensation, mixed income, interest, dividends, transfers), Employment registers linking adults to industry of main employment and region, Danish national accounts (SNA positions, input-output tables), 2018, CrediWire producer-to-producer transactions (about 5 million), Firm-level export and import data for manufacturing firms
关键变量
  • 结果变量：单元对单元的双边流量（消费支出、劳动收入和利润收入、税收、转移支付、中间品贸易）
  • 单位：消费者单元（主要就业行业 × 居住地区）
  • 单位：生产者单元（工作场所的行业 × 地区）
  • 衍生指标：国内支出份额、引力、城市偏向和支出强度等度量
时期
2018 年（消费支出为 2018–2019 年）
样本
约 2,700 个消费者单元和约 2,600 个生产者单元；约 4300 万个条目 丹麦全体成年人和生产性工作场所，按地区 × 行业单元分组，消费支出根据 Danske Bank 客户测算。 来源
变量如何定义（9）
  • Consumer cell (region x industry of main employment) 地理与社区
    Every adult is assigned to a region by home address at the start of 2018 (BEF), one per each of 98 municipalities, and to an industry by the NACE code of the establishment responsible for the largest part of 2018 labour income (AKM), mapped from six-digit NACE to 24 work industries. Cells with fewer than 3 individuals or establishments are censored.
    登记库： BEF, AKM
    代码： six-digit NACE mapped to 24 DEA work industries (Table A.I); 98 municipalities
    工作论文 · Appendix D; Section II
  • Non-working consumer industries 就业与劳动力状态
    Adults without labour income are assigned to 'retired' if older than 65, 'students' if they receive a government stipend, 'long-term unemployed' if they receive unemployment or cash benefits (fully benefit-dependent with no labour income all year), and otherwise 'out of workforce'.
    登记库： BEF, IND
    工作论文 · Appendix D; footnote 5
  • Producer cell (establishment region x industry) 企业特征与生产率
    Firm establishments are assigned to 2,646 producer cells by region and production industry using the employment registers; 24 work industries plus 3 housing industries without employees (private landlords, owner-occupied housing, government-owned housing).
    登记库： BFL, IDAN
    工作论文 · Appendix D; Section II
  • Labour compensation flows 劳动收入与收入
    Total annual labour compensation per individual including employer pension contributions, from IND and INPI, aggregated to consumer x producer cells and scaled by 1.01 to SNA D.1. Compensation from foreign producers (IND) scaled by 1.47; payments by Danish producers in BFL to persons not in BEF are treated as foreign employees and scaled by 1.14.
    登记库： IND, INPI, BFL, BEF
    代码： SNA D.1; scale factors 1.01, 1.47, 1.14
    工作论文 · Appendix I
  • Mixed income, dividends and owner-occupied housing surplus 劳动收入与收入
    Mixed income links sole-proprietorship establishments in IDAN (including municipality) to owners' mixed income. Dividends (SNA D.42) are allocated to consumer cells in proportion to stock dividend income in IND and to producer cells in proportion to accounting income. Owner-occupied housing surplus (B.2G) = imputed rental values in IND scaled by 0.67.
    登记库： IDAN, IND
    代码： SNA B.3g, D.42, B.2G; scale 0.67
    工作论文 · Appendix J
  • Government benefits to consumers 失业与福利金
    Social benefits (SNA D.62) = all government income transfers plus private pension payouts from IND, scaled by 1.03. Other current transfers (D.7) allocated by BEF population shares; pension entitlement adjustment (D.8) from IND and INPI contributions net of payouts.
    登记库： IND, INPI, BEF
    代码： SNA D.62, D.7, D.8; scale 1.03
    工作论文 · Appendix K
  • Disaggregated consumer spending 财富、负债与消费
    Danske Bank customers (main account at Danske Bank and at least one spending transaction per month in 2018-2019) assigned home region monthly from bank address records and industry from the employer paying the largest share of annual income. Merchant region from geocoded transaction-string addresses and industry from an MCC-to-ISIC/NACE crosswalk; cash withdrawals allocated in proportion to in-person card payments.
    登记库： Danske Bank transactions
    代码： MCC to ISIC/NACE crosswalk
    工作论文 · Section III.A; Appendix E.A-E.C
  • Manual labour share and cell characteristics 职业与职位层级
    Individual does manual labour if main occupation (AKM) is manual trades, operator and assembly, transportation, other manual labour or military. Cell averages also of university degree (UDDA), total debt, liquid financial assets (deposits, stocks, bonds, fund shares) and illiquid assets (FORMGELD).
    登记库： AKM, UDDA, FORMGELD
    工作论文 · Appendix M
  • Establishment output for IO disaggregation 企业特征与生产率
    Firm output is distributed across a firm's establishments using within-firm labour compensation shares, then aggregated to 173 subindustries combining the 117-industry national IO table and DEA industries; intermediate flows are split proportional to output shares.
    登记库： NIO1-NIO3 (statbank)
    代码： 117 NA industries; 173 subindustries
    工作论文 · Appendix N.A

Beliefs About the Economy Are Excessively Sensitive to Household-Level Shocks: Evidence from Linked Survey and Administrative Data

Dmitry Taubinsky, Luigi Butera, Matteo Saccarola and Chen Lian · Quarterly Journal of Economics, 2026 · 个人

将丹麦统计局（Statistics Denmark）的消费者预期调查与登记库相链接，表明人们对通货膨胀的预测和回溯估计会随其自身近期和预期的收入变化强烈地反向变动，幅度远大于实际通货膨胀的相应变动。这一模式偏离了贝叶斯理性预期，而与情感线索回忆（affect-cued recall）相一致，即个人遭遇的坏事会引发悲观的回忆。

数据
Danish Consumer Expectations Survey (Statistics Denmark Omnibus), linked on CPR, Tax registers from SKAT: income, liquid assets, net wealth, taxes (IND, formue), Civil Registration System / Population register (CPR/BEF), Education register (UDDA), National Patient Register (LPR), emergency room visits 1994–2018
关键变量
  • 结果变量：通货膨胀的预测与回溯估计（定性和定量）
  • 解释变量：家庭对数名义收入的近期变化（t-1 对 t-2）
  • 解释变量：未来家庭收入变化及预期的家庭财务状况
  • 冲击：调查当月家庭成员急诊就诊
  • 基准：已实现的通货膨胀
时期
2012–2019 年（稳健性检验自 2008 年起；人口登记库自 1991 年起）
样本
35050 份可用答卷（来自 55171 名 25–60 岁调查受访者） 2012–2019 年 Danish Consumer Expectations Survey 中 25–60 岁、没有大额自雇收入且回答完整的受访者，与行政数据相链接。 来源
调查
Consumer Expectations Survey
变量如何定义（8）
  • Household total income 劳动收入与收入
    Yearly total income before taxes and labour market contributions, including labour income, public transfers, property income and most other taxable income attributable to the individual (excludes imputed rental value, pension contributions to employer schemes and lottery winnings). Household value is the average of the two spouses' values if a spouse is present in CPR, otherwise the individual value.
    登记库： IND, BEF
    代码： PERINDKIALT_13 (income); spouse via E_FAELLE_ID
    复制代码 · code_dstserver/code_epinion/2_build_registries.do; NBER WP w32664 Section 1.2 and footnote 6
  • Household labour income 劳动收入与收入
    Total taxable wage income, benefits, bonuses, severance pay and value of stock options, averaged across spouses as for total income.
    登记库： IND
    代码： LOENMV_13 (income_work)
    复制代码 · code_dstserver/code_epinion/2_build_registries.do; NBER WP w32664 Section 1.2
  • Recent and future household income change 劳动收入与收入
    For a respondent interviewed in any month of year t, recent change = log nominal household income in t-1 minus t-2; future change = log income in t+1 minus t-1. Changes are trimmed at the 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles.
    登记库： IND
    代码： Log_Income_HH_L1L2, Log_Income_HH_F1L1; winsor2 cut(2.5 97.5) trim
    复制代码 · code_dstserver/analysis/A1c_sample_restrictions.do; NBER WP w32664 Section 1.3
  • Liquid assets and net wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Liquid assets follow Andersen et al. (2020): total value of bank deposits, stocks and bonds reported by financial institutions to SKAT. Net wealth is SKAT's tax-purpose measure of net household assets excluding non-deposited cash and foreign assets, with real estate at tax-assessed values; both averaged across spouses and used as asinh changes.
    登记库： IND
    工作论文 · Section 1.2 and footnote 7
  • Self-employment exclusion 样本界定与时间
    Exclude respondents if self-employment income exceeds one fourth of household income (in absolute value) in any year from t-4 to t+1 around the interview.
    登记库： IND
    代码： abs(Income_selfemp_HH)/abs(Income_HH) > .25 for timestamps L4..F1
    复制代码 · code_dstserver/analysis/A1c_sample_restrictions.do; NBER WP footnote 11
  • Main survey sample 样本界定与时间
    Monthly survey respondents 2012-2019 (backcast analyses 2013-2019) aged 25-60, excluding high self-employment income, missing key survey answers (Do not know, refused or forecast >100 pp) and missing registry variables, after trimming income changes and inflation answers at 2.5/97.5 percentiles.
    登记库： BEF, IND, UDDA
    代码： Age<25 | Age>60 dropped
    复制代码 · code_dstserver/analysis/A1c_sample_restrictions.do; NBER WP Section 1.3
  • Family emergency room visit in survey month 医疗服务利用
    Indicator equal to one if any household member (household identifier from BEF) visited the emergency room in the calendar month of the interview. An ER visit is an acute outpatient hospital contact in the NPR (recorded as patient type ER before 2014, acute outpatient from 2014). Respondents with more than 7 family ER visits over 2008-2018 are dropped.
    登记库： LPR, BEF
    代码： has_now_visit_fam; ERvisit_count_surveysample_fam <= 7
    复制代码 · code_dstserver/analysis/A9_healthregs.do; NBER WP Online Appendix A.1 (Emergency Room Visits Data) and ER table notes
  • Highest education (ISCED) 教育与考试成绩
    HFAUDD from UDDA mapped via an ISCED crosswalk to single-digit ISCED 2011 levels 1-6; code 9 (not known) set to missing.
    登记库： UDDA

Financial Frictions: Micro versus Macro Volatility

Renato Faccini, Seungcheol Lee, Ralph Luetticke, Morten O. Ravn and Tobias Renkin · American Economic Review, 2026 · 个人

把丹麦家庭与其主要往来银行的利率相链接，度量家庭层面的消费信贷利差，并将其与推算的消费和财富动态联系起来。利差越高，负债家庭和低财富家庭的消费越低，消费对收入也越敏感，因此消费对收入的平均反应是逆周期的。一个按丹麦数据校准、含银行部门的 HANK 模型表明，银行杠杆率较低会降低总体波动，但可能在家庭层面提高波动并降低福利。

数据
Statistics Denmark annual register data, 2003–2018: age, sex, education, household characteristics, income and wealth compiled from administrative and income tax return data, Tax-return reports of end-of-year balances on every bank account (deposits and bank loans), linking households to their banks, Danmarks Nationalbank MFI statistics microdata: bank-reported average loan and deposit interest rates, merged at Statistics Denmark, Danish National Accounts and aggregate MFI balance-sheet data (model calibration targets)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：推算的家庭消费（收入减养老金缴费再减净资产变化）
  • 结果变量：转入零净财富状态
  • 核心解释变量：家庭层面的消费信贷利差（主要贷款银行的贷款利率减去主要存款银行的存款利率）
  • 核心解释变量：残差化的家庭税后收入
  • 异质性：以中位数收入的周数计的净财富分组
时期
2003–2018
样本
17,984,847 个家庭—年份观测值（表 1）；2007 年 2,145,397 个家庭，2012 年 2,316,459 个，2017 年 2,395,008 个（附录表 A1） 2003–2018 年的丹麦家庭，剔除有自雇成员或有大额经营收入的家庭、当年或上一年发生住房交易的家庭、推算消费为负的家庭，以及处于财富或收入分布最高和最低 1% 的家庭。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Imputed household consumption 财富、负债与消费
    Following Crawley and Kuchler (2023): C_it = Y^L_it + Y^F_it - P_it - (A_i,t+1 - A_it), where Y^L is after-tax labor income net of transfers, Y^F is after-tax financial income, P is contributions to privately administered pension schemes and A_it is beginning-of-period net assets. The net worth measure used for imputation includes portfolio wealth, bank deposits and bank debt reported in tax return data (and some large durables such as cars) but excludes net housing wealth, pension wealth and business wealth. Capital income excludes unrealized capital gains but includes realized gains on certain securities. Deflated by the consumer price index.
    登记库： Income and wealth tax return data (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： C = Y^L + Y^F - P - (A_t+1 - A_t)
    工作论文 · Empirical section, subsection A 'Data and Measurements' (headed I.A in the accepted manuscript, cited as Section II in its text), equation (1) and footnote 4
  • Household-specific consumer credit spread (RS_it) 财富、负债与消费
    Households report end-of-calendar-year balances on all bank accounts to the tax authorities. A household's primary bank connections for loans and for deposits are the banks in which it has the largest end-of-year balance. The spread is the loan rate at the primary loan bank minus the return on deposits at the primary deposit bank, using the averages of the rates the banks applied during year t; for households without loans the loan rate of the primary deposit bank is used. Bank loans include credit card debt, overdrafts, bank loans and student loans. Rates of Mortgage Credit Institutions are not in the MFI data, so the spread refers to non-mortgage debt.
    登记库： Tax-reported bank account balances, Danmarks Nationalbank MFI statistics microdata
    工作论文 · Empirical section, subsection A 'Data and Measurements' (headed I.A in the accepted manuscript, cited as Section II in its text)
  • Net wealth and the zero-net-wealth state 财富、负债与消费
    Net wealth is the value of assets (housing, bank deposits, financial investments such as shares and bonds) minus liabilities (any form of bank or mortgage debt), excluding business and pension assets. Net wealth bins are defined in weeks of median income. A household is in the zero-net-wealth state when its net assets are within plus/minus two weeks of median household income (in 2007); 8.7 percent of households are in this state.
    登记库： Wealth tax return data (Statistics Denmark)
    代码： |net wealth| <= 2 weeks of median household income
    工作论文 · Empirical section, subsections A-B (headed I in the accepted manuscript); notes to Figures 2-3 and Table 1
  • Household sample selection 样本界定与时间
    Annual register data for 2003-2018. Excluded: households with self-employed members or with substantial income from private businesses; households involved in a housing transaction in the current or previous year; households with negative imputed consumption; households in the bottom and top one percent of the wealth or income distribution; and the first observation for each household. About 18 million household-year observations remain.
    代码： Top and bottom 1% of wealth or income dropped; housing transaction in t or t-1 dropped
    工作论文 · Empirical section, subsection A 'Data and Measurements' (headed I.A in the accepted manuscript, cited as Section II in its text)
  • Residualised household income 劳动收入与收入
    Real household after-tax income; consumption and income are residualised by regressing the log on household and time fixed effects and on household characteristics: age of household head, household size, number and age of children, and household head education.
    登记库： Income tax return data (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Empirical section, subsection B (headed I.B in the accepted manuscript), equations (2) and (3)

Consumption Heterogeneity: Micro Drivers and Macro Implications

Edmund Crawley and Andreas Kuchler · AEJ: Macroeconomics, 2023 · 个人

采用一种能够修正以往基于登记数据的估计中偏误的方法，估计丹麦各类家庭的边际消费倾向。流动性财富是边际消费倾向（MPC）最主要的预测因素，作者还利用估计出的异质性量化丹麦和美国的货币政策传导。

数据
Tax-authority income records (household after-tax and transfer income), Tax-reported wealth data: bank deposits, loans, bond and stock holdings, mortgages (year-end balances), Private pension contribution records, Civil Registration System (CPR) family/household links, Mortgage reset data (amount resetting over the following year)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：推算的家庭支出（收入减去养老金缴款，再减去非住房净资产的变动）
  • 冲击：户主的税后家庭收入的未预期（残差）变动
  • 异质性：流动性财富（银行存款）五分位
  • 异质性：未对冲利率敞口（Unhedged Interest Rate Exposure，URE）和净名义头寸（Net Nominal Position，NNP）
时期
2003–2015
样本
2004 至 2015 年的 770 万个观测值 2008 年户主年龄在 30–55 岁的丹麦家庭，不包括企业主、有住房交易的家庭，以及收入和收入变动处于最高/最低 1% 的家庭。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Household definition and head 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Households have one or two adults; two cohabiting adults are one household if (i) married or in a registered partnership, (ii) have at least one common child in the Civil Registration System, or (iii) are of opposite sex, age difference of 15 years or less, not closely related and with no other adults present. Children under 25, never married and childless belong to the parents' family. The head is the highest earner over the 13-year sample period.
    登记库： Civil Registration System (CPR) family links
    工作论文 · Section 4.1, footnotes 26-27
  • Imputed household expenditure 财富、负债与消费
    C = Y - P - dNW: after-tax income (all labor and capital income, excluding capital gains) minus contributions to privately administered pension schemes minus the change in non-pension, non-housing net worth between 31 December of t-1 and t. Households in housing-transaction years and with more than trivial business income are excluded; equity holders are assumed to hold a diversified stock index; household-years with negative imputed expenditure (about 3 percent) are discarded.
    登记库： Tax-authority income records, Tax-reported wealth data, Private pension contribution records
    工作论文 · Section 4.2
  • Unexpected income change 劳动收入与收入
    After dropping the top and bottom 1 percent of household after-tax-and-transfer income, income is normalized by average household income over the period and regressed on dummies for age, year, highest education, marital status, homeowner status and number of children plus age interactions with education, marital and homeowner status; the year-to-year change in the residual is the unexpected income change, trimming the top and bottom 1 percent. Expenditure residuals are constructed the same way.
    登记库： Tax-authority income records, Education register, Population register
    工作论文 · Sections 4.1 and 4.2
  • Estimation sample 样本界定与时间
    Households whose head is aged 30-55 in 2008 (to exclude young/old whose income growth is likely anticipated and whose income variance is non-constant). Out-of-sample exposures allocated to seven bins: young (<30) heads, old (>55) heads, pension funds (incl. children's savings accounts), government, non-financial corporates, financials, rest of the world.
    登记库： CPR household links
    代码： head age 30-55 in 2008
    在线附录 · Online Appendix E and G
  • Liquid wealth quintiles 财富、负债与消费
    Households are assigned to quantiles by their mean level of liquid wealth (or income, etc.) over the sample period (long-term quintiles); liquid wealth is the end-of-year balance, averaged in real terms over 2009-2015 in descriptive comparisons.
    登记库： Tax-reported wealth data
    在线附录 · Online Appendix E.1 and Table F.1 notes
  • Unhedged Interest Rate Exposure (URE) 财富、负债与消费
    Household URE = annual savings (after-tax income minus imputed expenditure) plus maturing assets minus maturing liabilities. Maturing assets: all bank deposits (assumed floating) plus 20% of securities (5-year maturity assumed). Maturing liabilities: all bank debt (assumed floating), mortgage debt contractually due to reset its interest rate in the coming 12 months (counted at half weight since the new rate applies half the year; voluntary refinancing excluded), and other liabilities with an assumed 5-year maturity. Non-household sectors' maturity calibrated to 3.65 years so economy-wide URE sums to zero.
    登记库： Tax-reported wealth data, Mortgage reset data (Danmarks Nationalbank)
    代码： securities 20%; mortgage resets within 12 months
    在线附录 · Online Appendix H.1-H.2
  • Net Nominal Position (NNP) 财富、负债与消费
    Household NNP = financial assets minus liabilities, averaged over 2009-2015 and deflated by CPI. Assets: bank deposits plus market value of securities excluding shares. Liabilities: all debt to financial institutions (including credit card debt), publicly administered student debt, tax debt and other debt to government bodies, as reported to the tax authorities by financial institutions. Other sectors from national financial accounts: net assets in currency and deposits, securities other than shares, loans, and trade credits/other accounts receivable-payable.
    登记库： Tax-reported wealth data, Danmarks Nationalbank financial accounts
    在线附录 · Online Appendix H.1-H.2
  • Nondurable consumption proxy 财富、负债与消费
    Imputed expenditure adjusted using registry data on household car purchases to proxy nondurable consumption (details in online appendix G, not in this file).
    登记库： Car purchase registry data

将丹麦全部住房抵押贷款与借款人的登记数据相匹配，研究只付息贷款上完全可预期的本金摊还的开始。当分期还款额的增幅相当于收入的 9% 时，消费下降相当于收入的 3% 并维持在低位；未能平滑消费的情况集中在杠杆率高、很可能申请不到新的只付息贷款的借款人中。

数据
Mortgage registry: loan-level data on the universe of Danish mortgages reported by mortgage institutions to Danmarks Nationalbank (from 2009), Income and wealth registers (IND/FORMUE): household income, bank deposits, stocks, bonds, pensions, debts, Population/household registers (BEF): family composition, residence, Imputed household consumption from income and wealth registers

抵押贷款登记库 2009–2018 年；只付息（IO）贷款发放于 2003–2007 年、到期于 2013–2017 年
样本
46,025 个家庭—年度观测值（基准回归）；8,813 个开始摊还本金的家庭 持有 2003–2007 年发放、只付息（IO）期在 2013–2017 年届满的只付息住房抵押贷款并保留原贷款的丹麦家庭，不包括自雇者和住房买卖者。 来源

  • Expiring interest-only loan sample / treatment year 样本界定与时间
    Households with a mortgage loan taken in year t-10 that started with an interest-only (IO) period lasting at least 9 years (IO length = years between IO start and end dates in REAL) and that survives from t-1 to t; treatment year is when the IO period expires; event time = year - treatment year. Households with any self-employed member, non-tax-liable members, or a property purchase/sale/ownership change in event years -1 to 1 are dropped.

The scale and nature of neighborhood effects on children

Stephen B. Billings, Mark Hoekstra and Gabriel Pons Rotger · Journal of Public Economics, 2024 · 个人

利用哥本哈根把急需住房的家庭准随机分配到社会住房单元的做法，考察哪些社区特征对儿童重要，以及这些特征在怎样的地理尺度上起作用。社区质量根据所分配住房单元步行 2 至 15 分钟范围内全部邻居的登记数据构建。对教育（以及发表版中的劳动收入）的影响很大，但范围非常局部，而对持有毒品的影响则在更大的尺度上起作用；社区的失业和教育状况比社区收入更能预测结果。

数据
Statistics Denmark administrative registers (cited as the Statistics Denmark database of administrative records; individual registers are not named): residential location and family structure of all Copenhagen residents, gender, immigration history and ethnicity, Register information on employment/unemployment, social assistance, disposable income and education of family members and neighbours, Criminal charges (Penal Code offences and possession of narcotic drugs), Health records: mortality, doctor visits and contacts with psychiatric treatment and care, Municipality of Copenhagen social-housing allocation records for urgent-need households (first housing offers), 2009–2014, OpenStreetMap route network (walking times between addresses) and Boliga property-sale listings (hedonic house-price measure) — non-register sources
关键变量
  • 处理：首次获得提供的社会住房单元所在社区的质量（邻居的收入、失业、教育以及一个综合指数），在步行 2、5、10 和 15 分钟范围内测量
  • 结果变量：进入高中教育
  • 结果变量：因触犯《刑法典》被指控；因持有麻醉毒品被指控（16 岁以后）
  • 结果变量：首次获得住房提供后四年内与精神科治疗和照护有过任何接触
  • 控制变量：分配的年份和月份、家庭规模、特殊需要申请
  • 异质性：性别、少数族裔/多数族裔、与原住所的距离
时期
住房分配发生于 2009–2014 年；结果变量追踪至 2020 年底（工作论文版本）
样本
1,171 名被分配到社会住房的儿童（NBER 工作论文版本的表 1）；步行 15 分钟范围内平均有 24,198 名邻居 2009–2014 年从哥本哈根市政府（Municipality of Copenhagen）获得首次社会住房提供的急需住房家庭中的学龄儿童（0–8 年级）。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Quasi-random social housing assignment (first offer to urgent-need households) 样本界定与时间
    Every third social housing unit that becomes vacant in Copenhagen is reserved by the municipality for households with 'urgent needs'. When a reserved unit is ready, the allocation program queues applicants whose household size and composition match the apartment and selects the application with the oldest referral date; neighbour characteristics and applicant preferences play no role. The first offer is used as the assigned unit (63% accept it). Units in local areas with more than 40% adult unemployment on January 1 are ineligible that year. Main sample: 1,171 children provided housing in 2009-2014.
    登记库： Municipality of Copenhagen social housing allocation records, Statistics Denmark administrative registers (not named individually)
    代码： Every third vacant unit; first offer; assignment years 2009-2014; 40% local-area adult unemployment ineligibility threshold; compliance 63%
    工作论文 · Sections 'Denmark Social Housing Policy' and 'Data'
  • Neighbourhood boundary by walking time 地理与社区
    For each social housing apartment address, all residential addresses within 3 km bird's-eye distance are identified and the OpenStreetMap route network is used to compute the walking time of the nearest path between each address and the apartment. Neighbourhoods are the residents within 2, 5, 10 and 15 minutes' walk (every minute from 1 to 15 in the figures), averaging 527, 2,835, 10,930 and 24,198 neighbours respectively.
    登记库： Residential addresses of all Copenhagen residents (Statistics Denmark), OpenStreetMap
    代码： 3 km radius; walking-time cut-offs 2, 5, 10, 15 minutes
    工作论文 · Footnote 7 and Results section
  • Neighbourhood quality (income, unemployment, education and summary index) 地理与社区
    Neighbourhood averages of the family attributes defined in Table 1: family income (average rank, 0-100, in disposable income among families of similar composition in the five years before assignment), family unemployment (average unemployment rate of family members aged 18 or older in the five years before assignment) and family education (average years of schooling of family members aged 25 or older). All are measured immediately before the household's assignment and scaled to mean zero and standard deviation one; the summary index combines the three (unemployment sign reversed) following Anderson (2008).
    登记库： Income, employment and education registers (Statistics Denmark; not named individually)
    代码： Standardised to mean 0, SD 1; five-year pre-assignment window; age cut-offs 18+ (unemployment) and 25+ (education)
    工作论文 · Section 'Measurement of neighborhood quality'; Table 1 and Table 2 notes
  • Education enrollment 教育与考试成绩
    Indicator that the child was enrolled in upper secondary education between the date of the first social housing offer and January 1, 2021.
    登记库： Education register (Statistics Denmark; not named)
    工作论文 · Table 1 notes
  • Crime and possession of narcotic drugs 犯罪
    Crime: the child was charged for offences against the Danish Penal Code after the first social housing assignment and after age 16 (described in the text as violent or property crime, excluding drug and technical offences). Possession of narcotic drugs: the child was charged for possession of narcotic drugs after the first offer of social housing and after age 16. Family crime and family drug possession are the same charges for at least one family member in the five years before assignment.

Reference Dependence in the Housing Market

Steffen Andersen, Cristian Badarinza, Lu Liu, Julie Marx and Tarun Ramadorai · American Economic Review, 2022 · 个人

将丹麦的住房挂牌与交易数据同业主的登记数据相结合，估计一个包含损失厌恶和融资约束的挂牌与出售决策结构模型。家庭从相对于原始购买价的收益中获得效用，赋予损失的权重约为收益的 2.5 倍，这有助于解释房价与成交量的同向变动。

数据
Property ownership and transaction register from SKAT and the Building and Housing Register (BBR), 1992–2016, Tax-assessed property values (SKAT), Property listings data from RealView, 2008–2016, Loan-level mortgage data from Danmarks Nationalbank, 2009–2016, Civil Registration System (CPR/BEF) for demographics and household links, Income and wealth records from SKAT (IND/formue)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：挂牌决策以及相对于特征价格估值的挂牌溢价
  • 主要解释变量：相对于原始购买价（参照点）的潜在收益或损失
  • 相对于首付约束的潜在房屋净值
  • 由特征价格模型得到的预期房屋价值
  • 结构参数：损失厌恶
时期
2009–2016 年（交易数据自 1992 年起）
样本
214,103 条挂牌（191,507 个不同家庭，178,933 处不同房产）；住房存量为 807,345 处房产的 5,538,052 个观测值 2009 至 2016 年间丹麦自住住房的挂牌记录，包括已售出的和已撤回的，并与住房抵押贷款和家庭财务状况相匹配。 来源
变量如何定义（10）
  • Hedonic expected house value 财富、负债与消费
    ln(P_it) regressed on time x municipality effects, apartment indicator, and property characteristics: ln(lot size), ln(interior size), number of rooms, bathrooms, showers, unoccupied-at-sale dummy, ln(building age), rural dummy, historic-building dummy, ln(distance to nearest major city), all interacted with the apartment indicator, plus a third-order polynomial of the previous-year (biennial) SKAT tax-assessed value. R2 = 0.88 on sold listings (N = 114,303). Variants add repeat-sales residuals and lagged renovation deductions.
    登记库： BBR/BOL, EJVK, EJSA, EJMT
    在线附录 · Online Appendix C.1; Figure L.4 notes; E
  • Listing premium 财富、负债与消费
    l = ln(L) - predicted ln(P), where L is the initial listing price and predicted ln(P) is from the hedonic model.
    登记库： RealView, SKAT, BBR
    论文正文 · Section 4.1
  • Potential gain (vs reference price) 财富、负债与消费
    G = predicted ln(P) - ln(R), where R is the nominal original purchase price of the property; measurable only for properties bought in 1992 or later.
    登记库： SKAT property transactions, BBR
    论文正文 · Sections 3.5 and 4.1
  • Potential home equity 财富、负债与消费
    H = predicted ln(P) - ln(M), where M is the outstanding mortgage balance reported by the household's mortgage bank that year (multiple mortgages on a property summed; LTV and rate weighted); sellers with H < 20% are classed as potentially facing a binding down-payment constraint.
    登记库： Danmarks Nationalbank mortgage data
    论文正文 · Sections 3.3 and 4.1
  • Listings sample 样本界定与时间
    From 615,040 RealView listings of owner-occupied housing (excluding cooperative housing): drop unmatched in registers (-107,679), no reference price i.e. purchased before 1992 (-144,962), owner ID not uniquely determined (-71,876), non-household buyer i.e. government/company/organization (-10,382), foreclosures (-6,416), extreme prices (<100,000 DKK or >20,000,000 DKK in 2015 prices, or flagged extreme by Statistics Denmark; -5,499), owner ID not found, missing lot size or hedonic characteristics, listing date before previous purchase date, intra-family/special-circumstance sales, missing listing price; then drop summer houses (-24,098) and professional investors owning more than 3 properties (-18,312). Final: 214,103 listings 2009-2016 (172,225 with mortgage, 41,878 without), 191,507 households, 178,933 properties; 70.4% sold, 29.6% retracted. Extensive-margin stock sample: 5,538,052 observations of 807,345 properties.
    登记库： RealView listings, EJSA, EJER, EJVK, BBR/BOL, REAL, BEF
    代码： price bounds 100,000-20,000,000 DKK (2015 prices); >3 properties = investor
    在线附录 · Online Appendix C.5 and Table L.1
  • Household 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Households consist of one or two adults and any children below age 25 living at the same address, linked via the CPR family identification number; individual income and wealth are aggregated to the household. Household education = average years of education across all adults in the household; household age = average age in the household. The seller is the owner (CPR) at the beginning of the year of the transaction.
    登记库： CPR/BEF, UDDA, IND, EJER
    代码： children <25
    在线附录 · Online Appendix C.1, C.4 (fn 5), Figure L.29 notes
  • Mortgage balance and loan-to-value 财富、负债与消费
    Danmarks Nationalbank loan-level mortgage data (via Finance Denmark), annual 2009-2016, covering all mortgage banks: principal, outstanding balance, LTV and interest rate, with borrower CPR and property number. Multiple mortgages on a property are summed, with balance-weighted average interest rate and LTV.
    登记库： REAL (Boligfinansiering)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix C.3
  • Renovation tax deductions (BoligJob) 财富、负债与消费
    Proxy for maintenance/renovation: claimed BoligJob ('Boligjobordningen') tax deductions for labour costs of service work in the home, available from 2011, aggregated by household and linked to the seller; maximum 15,000 DKK per adult 2011-2015, then 12,000 DKK for maintenance/renovation and 6,000 DKK for other services (2016-2018). Used as 1-year lag (2012-2016) and 3- and 5-year cumulative lags.
    登记库： INDSLUT (Servicebidragsregister)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix E.3.1
  • Liquid and net financial assets 财富、负债与消费
    Liquid financial assets = cash, stocks and bonds; net financial assets = liquid financial assets minus short-term non-mortgage liabilities (mainly unsecured debt). Used as household controls with age and education length.
    登记库： IND (SKAT income and wealth records)
    在线附录 · Online Appendix K.1
  • Share of apartments and row houses (IV) 地理与社区
    Instrument: share of apartments and row houses (as defined in the BBR) listed in a given sub-market (municipality), capturing homogeneity of the housing stock.
    登记库： BBR
    在线附录 · Online Appendix (IV section; Figure L.14)

Do People Respond to the Mortgage Interest Deduction? Quasi-Experimental Evidence from Denmark

Jonathan Gruber, Amalie Sofie Jensen and Henrik Kleven · AEJ: Economic Policy, 2021 · 个人

一项重大改革大幅削减了中高收入家庭的住房抵押贷款利息抵扣，其对住房自有率的影响被精确地估计为零。不过，改革确实降低了所购住房的面积和价格，减少了家庭负债，并压低了均衡房价。

数据
Income tax records (incomes, taxes, deductible interest expenses), Housing register (homeownership, property characteristics, home size), Tax authority property value appraisals (for imputed rent and wealth tax), Population registers with spouse/cohabitant and child links
关键变量
  • 政策：1987 年税制改革，降低了适用最高税率的纳税人的住房抵押贷款利息抵扣价值
  • 处理：最高税级纳税人与最高税级以下／中间税级／最低税级各组的比较（双重差分）
  • 结果变量：住房自有
  • 结果变量：住房面积（平方米）与住房价值
  • 结果变量：可抵扣利息支出总额（债务）
  • 对税后留存率（1−τ）的弹性
时期
1980–2011 年（主面板为 1980–1996 年）
样本
约 4000 万个个人—年份观测值；住房自有主回归中有 34,440,869 个观测值（以最高税级以下群体为对照组） 由 1980–1996 年每年均有观测的 20–80 岁丹麦人构成的半平衡面板，剔除与父母同住的子女。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Homeownership (household-based) 财富、负债与消费
    Baseline measure from housing records (living in an owner-occupied home) validated against the tax-record measure based on housing wealth available from 1987, for the population above age 20; housing-register measure is slightly lower in level because it misses owners not residing in their owned property. A variant uses only 'clean' cases (defined in main text).
    登记库： Housing register (BBR); tax records (housing wealth, from 1987)
    在线附录 · Figure A.I notes
  • Home size 财富、负债与消费
    Area of the house in square metres used for habitation, from the housing register.
    登记库： Housing register
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Home value 财富、负债与消费
    Appraisal of the property by the Danish Tax Authorities made for assessing imputed rental income and taxable wealth.
    登记库： Tax authority property appraisals
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Total deductible interest expenses 财富、负债与消费
    Interest paid on mortgage debt, consumer debt and other loans (all deductible), for homeowners; mortgage interest cannot be separated over the whole period.
    登记库： Income tax records
    工作论文 · Section 3.2
  • Household tax bracket / treatment status 税收与税率
    A taxpayer is assigned to the top bracket if she or her spouse is in the top bracket, to the middle bracket if either is in the middle and neither in the top, and to the bottom bracket if both are in the bottom. Treated are those in the top bracket in every year 1984-1986; controls are in the middle or bottom bracket in every year 1984-1986.
    登记库： Income tax records, Population register spouse links
    工作论文 · Section 4
  • Net-of-tax interest rate 税收与税率
    (1 - tau) R, where tau is the marginal tax rate on negative capital income; the 1987 reform set this rate to 51 percent in all brackets (pre-reform top about 73, middle 62, bottom 48 percent in the average municipality), raising the net-of-tax rate by 81 percent for the top group, 29 percent for the middle and reducing it 6 percent for the bottom.
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, Figure 1
  • Semi-balanced panel 1980-1996 样本界定与时间
    Individuals observed in every year 1980-1996 while aged 20-80 (entering at 20, leaving after 80), giving 7 pre-reform and 10 post-reform years; about 40 million person-years.
    登记库： Population register
    工作论文 · Sections 3.2 and 4
  • Long-run balanced panel 1980-2011 样本界定与时间
    Very-long-run home size analysis uses a balanced panel of individuals observed in all years 1980-2011 (vs. main semi-balanced panel 1980-1996). Pre-trend robustness: group-specific linear trends estimated on 1983-1986 and residualized out.
    登记库： Housing register; population register

Home Prices, Fertility, and Early-Life Health Outcomes

N. Meltem Daysal, Michael Lovenheim, Nikolaj Siersbæk and David N. Wasser · Journal of Public Economics, 2021 · 个人

对 20 至 44 岁的丹麦房主而言，房价上涨 100,000 克朗会使生育概率提高约 2.35%。出生结果也有所改善，但主要是因为生育者的构成发生了变化；对儿童出生后头五年的健康则没有影响。

数据
Medical Birth Register (MFR), National Patient Register (LPR), State's Sales and Valuation Registry (public property valuations and sales prices), Population register (BEF) and other registers for demographics, education, household income and partner status
关键变量
  • 处理：滞后一期的估计住房价值一年变动（公共评估值按当地成交价比率调整）
  • 结果变量：是否生育的指示变量
  • 结果变量：出生体重、低出生体重、极低出生体重、早产
  • 结果变量：出生后第一年及 1–5 岁期间的住院、急诊就诊和住院天数
  • 比较组：租房者
时期
1992–2011 年（生育分析为 1995–2006 年）
样本
198,435 名女性的 1,105,559 个观测值（125,903 次生育） 在 1993 至 2004 年间首次成为房主、购房时年龄在 18 至 42 岁之间的 20–44 岁女性。 来源
变量如何定义（8）
  • Estimated home value 财富、负债与消费
    The public valuation of the home times the owner's share, multiplied by the mean ratio of sale price to public valuation among homes sold in the same year, municipality, housing type and valuation-quartile cluster (a SPAR-type index); woman's and partner's shares are summed. The value is fixed to the first house the woman is observed buying, and is in 100,000 DKK at 2006 prices (CPI-deflated).
    登记库： State's Sales and Valuation Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3, equation (1)
  • Once-lagged one-year home price change 财富、负债与消费
    One-year change in estimated home value, lagged one year relative to the fertility outcome. Public valuations were made in January of the prior year until end-2003 and in October of the prior year afterwards. Homes whose valuation rose by more than 50% in a year, and the 1st and 99th percentiles of the lagged change, are excluded.
    登记库： State's Sales and Valuation Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3 and 3.1, footnote 13
  • Housing sample restrictions 样本界定与时间
    Residential houses and apartments in clusters with at least five sales; only normal sales between individuals (no intra-family sales). Excluded: negative valuations or sale prices, multiple addresses at the same location, and sales above 300% or below 40% of the public valuation.
    登记库： State's Sales and Valuation Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, Appendix Table A-1
  • Potential first-time homeowner women 样本界定与时间
    Women not homeowners at the beginning of 1992-1993 who became homeowners between 1993 and 2004 at ages 18-42; owning means the woman, her partner or both own the home. Women whose partner bought before the couple formed, who moved out of the new home within the year, or who have incomplete income or home data are dropped, leaving women aged 20-44 observed 1995-2006.
    登记库： Population Registry, State's Sales and Valuation Registry
    工作论文 · Section 1 footnote 2; Section 3.1
  • Low / very low birth weight, prematurity 健康结果、诊断与死亡
    From the Birth Registry for live births: low birth weight is below 2,500 grams, very low birth weight below 1,500 grams, and premature is gestational age under 37 completed weeks; birth weight is also used continuously.
    登记库： Medical Birth Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3
  • Hospital admissions, inpatient days and ER visits 医疗服务利用
    Indicators for any hospital admission and any ER visit in the first year of life and at ages 1-5, plus the number of days hospitalised and ER visits in the first five years. Inpatient days exclude the childbirth admission and the following four days.
    登记库： National Patient Register
    工作论文 · Section 3, footnote 12
  • Giving birth / conception timing 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator for giving birth in the year, from the Birth Registry. In a robustness check, the conception date is computed from gestational length and birth date, the price change is scaled by the fraction of the year before conception, and non-mothers get randomly assigned birth months.
    登记库： Medical Birth Registry
    工作论文 · Section 3; Section 4 robustness
  • Imputed household consumption 财富、负债与消费
    Household consumption imputed from income and year-to-year wealth changes following Browning and Leth-Petersen (2003).
    登记库： Danish income and wealth registers
    工作论文 · Section 5 (credit constraints)

Gender Differences in Negotiation: Evidence from Real Estate Transactions

Steffen Andersen, Julie Marx, Kasper Meisner Nielsen and Lise Vesterlund · Economic Journal, 2021 · 个人

在丹麦的房地产交易中，男性看似比女性拿到更好的价格，但在更好地控制房产价值后差距缩小，在重复销售样本和继承房产样本中则消失。价格差异反映的是男性和女性需求的房产不同，而非谈判上的差异。

数据
Property transactions from the Danish Tax and Customs Administration (SKAT), Housing register (BBR), Civil Registration System (CPR), Income and tax-assessed property values from SKAT, Education registers (Ministry of Education), Integrated Database for Labour Market Research (IDA) employment status, Cause-of-Death Register (Danish National Board of Health)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：住宅或公寓的实际成交价格
  • 核心解释变量：单身买方／卖方的性别
  • 控制变量：税务评估的房产价值、BBR 房产特征、房产固定效应（重复销售）
  • 遗产出售：独生子女从已故父母处继承的房产
时期
1994–2013
样本
337,685 笔房地产交易（重复销售样本 97,216 笔；遗产出售样本中有 13,953 处继承的住宅和公寓） 1994–2013 年丹麦住宅和公寓的非关联方公平交易，买方和卖方为单身女性或单身男性。 来源
变量如何定义（10）
  • Buyer and seller identification 样本界定与时间
    Buyers are the owners of the property (per BBR owner records) on January 1 in the year after the transaction; sellers are the owners on January 1 in the year of the transaction. If the sales agreement is signed in year t but ownership is transferred in t+1, buyers are the owners on January 1 of t+2, conditional on no registered trades during t+1.
    登记库： BBR, SKAT property transactions (Statstidende), CPR
    在线附录 · Appendix A, Data sources (and footnote 1)
  • Transaction sample restrictions 样本界定与时间
    All property transactions 1994-2013 restricted to single-family houses and apartments bought and sold by individuals; drops transactions flagged by Statistics Denmark as involving price clauses or extreme prices, rented-out properties, properties traded more than once within a year, transactions within a household or between parents and children, households buying or selling more than three properties in a year, and agents outside ages 18-65. Cottages, farms and cooperative housing are excluded.
    登记库： SKAT property transactions, BBR, CPR
    在线附录 · Appendix A, Sample selection; paper Section 2
  • Stable household / single man / single woman 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Households use the Statistics Denmark household ID: one or two adults plus children under 25 living with them; three types are couples (married, registered and cohabiting partners), single women and single men. A household must be stable: constant number of adults in the transaction year and the year after, no divorce from two years before to one year after the transaction, and no adult member lost to death within one year before or after.
    登记库： CPR, BEF (Statistics Denmark household ID)
    在线附录 · Appendix A, Sample selection and Variable definition
  • Transaction price (outcome) 财富、负债与消费
    Log of the realised transaction price in thousand year-2015 DKK, from property transactions announced in the Danish Gazette (Statstidende) as received by SKAT.
    登记库： SKAT property transactions (Statstidende)
    在线附录 · Appendix A, Variable definition
  • Tax-assessed property value 财富、负债与消费
    SKAT's assessment of the property's value if sold (basis for property value tax and municipal land tax), carried out every other year and regulated by local house price growth in non-assessment years; the paper uses the assessed value in the year prior to the transaction, entered as log of thousand year-2015 DKK.
    登记库： SKAT
    在线附录 · Appendix A, Data sources and Variable definition; paper Section 2
  • Employment status (employed / self-employed / retired / unemployed) 就业与劳动力状态
    IDA status classified at end of November each year: employed if the majority of personal income is from paid employment, self-employed if the majority is from self-employment, retired if outside the labour market with the majority of income from private or public pensions, and unemployed otherwise. Household variables are shares of adult members (0, 0.5 or 1), measured in November of the year before the transaction.
    登记库： IDA
    工作论文 · Section 2 (data source 6); Appendix A Variable definition
  • Household income and net wealth 劳动收入与收入
    Household totals of total income and net wealth (third-party reported to SKAT) in million year-2015 DKK, measured December 31 of the year before the transaction and winsorised at the 1st and 99th percentiles.
    登记库： SKAT income and wealth records
    工作论文 · Table 1 note; Appendix A Variable definition
  • First-time buyer / out-of-town buyer 财富、负债与消费
    First-time buyer: no member of the buyer household has previously owned real estate. Out-of-town buyer: the household buys property in a municipality it did not previously live in.
    登记库： BBR, CPR
    在线附录 · Appendix A, Variable definition
  • Death sales 样本界定与时间
    Household terminations (death of the only member of a one-person household: single, widowed or divorced) of individuals owning real estate at death, identified by linking the Cause-of-Death Register to CPR; restricted to decedents with exactly one child (the beneficiary, linked via CPR) and to sales of the property within 1.5 years of the death, applying all full-sample selection criteria (13,953 death sales).
    登记库： Cause-of-Death Register, CPR, SKAT property transactions
    在线附录 · Appendix A, Death data; paper Section 4
  • School-age children 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Indicator for having children aged 5 to 15 (not necessarily living in the household), interacted with the transaction quarter following Harding, Rosenthal and Sirmans (2003).
    登记库： CPR

Housing Wealth and Consumption: A Micro Panel Study

Martin Browning, Mette Gørtz and Søren Leth-Petersen · Economic Journal, 2013 · 个人

利用基于登记库推算的消费以及 1987 至 1996 年繁荣与萧条期间的房价变化，检验住房财富是否驱动支出。对大多数家庭而言，消费对未预期到的房价变化没有反应；反应仅限于年轻家庭，这与抵押品效应而非财富效应相一致。

数据
Administrative income and wealth (tax) registers for a 10% random sample of the Danish population aged 16+, House price / housing wealth information from registers
关键变量
  • 结果变量：推算的家庭总支出（可支配收入减去净财富变化）
  • 核心解释变量：房价／住房财富的未预期变化
  • 异质性：年龄、自有住房者与租房者、信贷约束（1992–93 年住房抵押贷款改革允许以房屋净值借款）
  • 家庭可支配收入
时期
1987–1996
样本
所查资料中未注明 取自丹麦 16 岁及以上人口的 10% 随机样本、在整个期间内始终为自有住房者或始终为租房者的已婚或同居的稳定伴侣。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Imputed household total expenditure 财富、负债与消费
    Household disposable after-tax income minus the change in net financial wealth from t-1 to t, following Browning and Leth-Petersen (2003); deflated to 1990 prices. Possible only up to 1996 because wealth-tax register data end after the wealth tax was abolished in 1997.
    登记库： Income and wealth tax registers (10% sample)
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Expenditure imputation), eq. (1), footnote 1
  • Household disposable income 劳动收入与收入
    Gross income including interest income, housing transfers and dividends, minus taxes on income, taxes on shares, surplus on owner-occupied housing and tax-exempted interest expenses (labour, transfer and capital income net of personal taxes).
    登记库： Income tax registers
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Expenditure imputation)
  • Net wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Financial assets (market value of shares, bank deposits, market value of bonds and securities) minus debt (mortgage debt, bank debt etc.).
    登记库： Wealth tax registers
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Expenditure imputation)
  • Municipal house prices and house price innovations 地理与社区
    Average sales prices of traded single-family houses by municipality (275 municipalities), 1985-2001, collected by the tax authorities. Log municipal price modelled as an AR process with municipality effects, average house size (square metres, rooms) and year effects, estimated by system GMM; the predicted change is the expected price change and the residual is the house price innovation.
    登记库： Tax authority house sales statistics (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 4 (House prices); Section 5 (house price process); Appendix 1
  • Analysis sample 样本界定与时间
    10% random sample of the Danish population aged 16+, 1987-1996; married or cohabiting stable couples who were either home owners or renters throughout; split before and after the 1992-93 mortgage/collateral and tax reforms.
    登记库： Income and wealth tax registers (10% sample)
    工作论文 · Section 4 (Data); Abstract
  • Liquidity constraint 财富、负债与消费
    Liquidity-constrained households have liquid funds (cash and bonds) below 1.5 months of disposable income; high-liquidity households have liquid funds above half a year's disposable income. Mortgage sensitivity measured by mortgage debt / house value.
    登记库： Income and wealth tax registers
    工作论文 · Section 6 (credit constraints) and robustness section

Are Homeowners Really More Unemployed?

Jakob Roland Munch, Michael Rosholm and Michael Svarer · Economic Journal, 2006 · 个人

检验 Oswald 假说，即住房自有会提高失业。丹麦的自有住房者地域流动性较低，但他们在本地找到工作的速度更快，因此总体上失业持续期更短。住房自有并不会提高总体失业。

数据
Administrative register data on unemployment spells for a 2.5% random sample of the Danish population, Regional unemployment measure from the Institute for Local Government Studies (1987–2000)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：失业持续时间（周）
  • 结果变量：退出去向（在本地找到新工作、在另一通勤区就业、其他状态）
  • 关键解释变量：是否自有住房的指示变量
  • 控制变量：年龄、性别、子女、家庭类型、移民身份、教育、失业保险基金成员身份及替代率
时期
1997–2000
样本
18,992 人，共 52,738 段失业期 丹麦人口 2.5% 随机样本中 19–66 岁个人在 1997–2000 年全部失业期的流量样本。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Unemployment spell inflow sample 样本界定与时间
    Flow sample of all unemployment spells in 1997-2000 for individuals in a 2.5% random sample of the Danish population, restricted to inflow into unemployment of workers aged 19-66; spell duration measured in weeks (18,992 persons, 52,738 spells).
    登记库： Administrative registers (2.5% random population sample)
    工作论文 · Section 3 (Data and the Danish labour and housing markets), pp. 9-10
  • Exit destination 失业与福利金
    Destination after an unemployment spell: new job in the local labour market, new job in another commuting area, or other states than employment and unemployment. A worker is geographically mobile if he or she gets a job and moves to another commuting area up to 8 weeks before and 52 weeks after the start of the job spell (exact moving dates known).
    登记库： Administrative registers
    工作论文 · Section 3, p. 9
  • Commuting areas (local labour markets) 地理与社区
    Local labour markets are commuting areas built from geographically connected municipalities such that the internal migration rate is 50% higher than the external migration rate (Andersen 2000); the 275 municipalities are merged into 51 commuting areas.
    登记库： Administrative registers
    工作论文 · Section 3, p. 9
  • Regional unemployment rate 地理与社区
    Measure constructed by the Institute for Local Government Studies (AKF): unemployment rate in an area around each municipality, defined by how far a resident can commute without a daily commuting cost exceeding DKK 60 (1987 prices); available 1987-2000.
    登记库： Institute for Local Government Studies regional unemployment data
    工作论文 · Section 3.1, p. 10
  • Home ownership 财富、负债与消费
    Indicator for being a home owner (living in owner-occupied housing) versus renting (private rental, social or cooperative housing).
    登记库： Administrative registers
    工作论文 · Section 2-3, pp. 8-10
  • UI fund membership and replacement rate 失业与福利金
    Indicator for membership of an unemployment insurance fund and, for members, the UI replacement rate; other controls are age, gender, number of dependent children aged 0-17, two-adult household, immigrant from a non-OECD country, municipality size and education.
    登记库： Administrative registers
    工作论文 · Section 3, p. 10

Rent Control and Unemployment Duration

Michael Svarer, Michael Rosholm and Jakob Roland Munch · Journal of Public Economics, 2005 · 个人

利用丹麦关于失业期和住房的登记数据，研究居住在租金管制住房中是否影响找到工作。住在租金管制住房中的失业者脱离失业的比率较低，这与租金管制降低地域流动性的看法一致。

数据
10% random sample of the Danish adult population from administrative registers (Statistics Denmark), Housing unit characteristics for dwellings occupied by the sample, Weekly labour market event histories, Danish Tax Authorities 1999 hedonic model for owner-occupied housing (to predict uncontrolled rent)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：以周计的失业持续时间（在本地或全国劳动力市场找到工作而退出失业）
  • 解释变量：租金管制收益的十分位（预测的无管制租金减去实际租金），随时间变化
  • 流动性：找到工作并迁往 51 个通勤区中的另一个
  • 住房保有类型：私人租赁住房与其他
时期
1997–2000
样本
14,645 人，共 31,966 段失业期 取自丹麦成年人口 10% 随机样本的 1997–2000 年失业期流入样本（IZA DP 842 工作论文版本）。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Unemployment duration and exit destination 失业与福利金
    Flow sample of unemployment spells starting 1997-2000, from weekly labour-market event histories; duration measured in weeks, with destination employment recorded. Temporary layoffs (return to the previous employer, about 40% of spells) are treated as right-censored, as are exits to states outside the labour market.
    登记库： 10% sample of Danish adult population (Statistics Denmark registers)
    工作论文 · Section 4.1 'Unemployment spells and geographical mobility'
  • Local labour market (commuting area) 地理与社区
    Local labour markets are groups of municipalities between which the internal migration rate is 50% higher than the external migration rate (Andersen 2000), giving 51 commuting areas in Denmark.
    登记库： Population registers
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Geographically mobile job finding 地理与社区
    An unemployed worker is geographically mobile if he or she gets a job and moves to another commuting area within the window from 8 weeks before to 52 weeks after the start of the job spell; otherwise a job exit is local.
    登记库： Population registers, Weekly event histories
    工作论文 · Section 4.1
  • Rent control benefit and decile of rent control degree 财富、负债与消费
    Rent control benefit = predicted uncontrolled rent minus actual rent; uncontrolled rent from the Danish Tax Authorities' 1999 hedonic model for owner-occupied housing (sales 1996-1999, dwelling traits, more than 50,000 geographic areas) times an estimate of user cost; missing actual rents (about 50% of units) imputed by Heckman two-step. The regressor is the decile of the rent control degree (benefit / uncontrolled rent), using 1999 decile limits applied to 1997, 1998 and 2000; time-varying across housing units via moving dates.
    登记库： Housing unit characteristics (Statistics Denmark), DTA 1999 hedonic model
    工作论文 · Section 4.2 'The rent control benefit'
  • Replacement rate 失业与福利金
    Ratio of UI benefits received to the most recent wage.
    登记库： Statistics Denmark registers
    工作论文 · Section 4.3 'Explanatory variables'
  • Private rental housing tenure 地理与社区
    Housing market split into owner-occupied (51%), co-operative (6%), public rental (19%) and private rental (18%); analysis concerns private rental units, where rents are regulated except in dwellings built after 1991.
    登记库： Housing unit characteristics (Statistics Denmark)
    工作论文 · Section 3 'The Danish private rental housing market'

如何用登记数据构造变量，例如消费。

Subjective Earnings Risk

Andrew Caplin, Victoria Gregory, Eungik Lee, Søren Leth-Petersen and Johan Sæverud · Review of Economic Studies, 2026 · 个人

提出一种把辞职和被解雇的可能性考虑在内的劳动收入风险调查工具，面向丹麦劳动者实施，并与其登记库中的劳动收入历史相链接。工作转换是主观风险的主要来源；即使在控制人口特征和工作履历之后，主观风险仍比传统的基于登记数据的估计小许多倍，这有助于解释为什么许多人只持有很少的流动资产。

数据
Copenhagen Life Panel (CLP) survey, January 2021 wave, linked on CPR number, Income-tax register earnings (IND), Monthly employer-employee match and earnings data (BFL/eIndkomst), Demographic, education, household composition and household wealth registers
关键变量
  • 调查：留任、辞职和被裁员的主观概率
  • 调查：以每种工作转换为条件的主观劳动收入分布
  • 基准：2021 年实际发生的工作转换、未就业时间和劳动收入增长（行政数据）
  • 权重：基于 2020 年行政数据的调查参与模型得到的总体权重
时期
调查于 2021 年 1 月进行；行政数据截至 2022 年
样本
10,942 名在职受访者（总样本为 14,683 名 20–65 岁受访者） Copenhagen Life Panel 中在 2021 年 1 月调查时处于就业状态的 20–65 岁受访者。 来源
调查
Copenhagen Life Panel
变量如何定义（10）
  • Main monthly employer (BFL) 就业与劳动力状态
    From monthly eIndkomst job records (BFL), each person-month is assigned the job with the most paid hours (AJO_LOENTIMER) as the primary employer; its CVR number, wage and hours are kept. Month and year come from the job start date field AJO_JOB_START_DATO.
    登记库： BFL
    代码： AJO_CVR_NR_FRA_PROD_JOB, AJO_SMALT_LOENBELOEB, AJO_LOENTIMER, AJO_JOB_START_DATO; primary job = max(AJO_LOENTIMER) within pnr-year-month
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_c_monthly_data.R
  • Stayer (same employer Dec 2020 to Dec 2021) 就业与劳动力状态
    Among workers with an employer and monthly wage above 2,000 DKK in December 2020, stay=1 if the main employer in December 2021 is the same as in December 2020, else 0. Sample restricted to ages 20-65 and 2020 annual BFL earnings of at least 24,000 DKK.
    登记库： BFL
    代码： wage>2000 in Dec 2020; employer_g == F12.employer_g; sum_earnings>=24000
    复制代码 · script/analysis/fig4/preprocess_fig4a.do; paper Figure 4 note
  • Months out of work after separation 失业与福利金
    A separation is a month in which the worker has a main employer with monthly wage above 2,000 DKK and next month's employer differs; only the first separation per person is used. Time out of work = months until a different non-missing employer appears (capped at 24) minus one, so job-to-job moves count as 0 and returns to the same employer are not reemployment. The paper describes separations in 2020; the posted do-file's window (date<=24 from Dec 2018) covers Dec 2018-Dec 2019.
    登记库： BFL
    代码： jan_sep = employer_g != F1employer_g; reemp = first k with F`k'employer_g != employer_g & non-missing; gap = reemp-1; cap 24
    复制代码 · script/analysis/fig4/preprocess_fig4b.do; paper Section 3.2 and Figure 4 note
  • Annual earnings (register) 劳动收入与收入
    Annual earnings are wage income LOENMV_13 from the income register (IND); self-employment income is NETOVSKUD_13 kept separately. Realized earnings growth 2020-2021 is ln(earnings_2021*100/102) - ln(earnings_2020), dropping observations with earnings below 24,000 DKK in either year and trimming at the 1st/99th percentile.
    登记库： IND
    代码： LOENMV_13 (earnings), NETOVSKUD_13 (self-employment income); threshold 24,000 DKK; deflator 100/102; winsor2 trim 1/99
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_b_annual_data.R; script/analysis/fig7/preprocess_fig7.do; paper Figure 6 note
  • Net wealth and liquid wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Net wealth = (KOEJD + BANKAKT + KURSAKT + OBLAKT + PANTAKT) - (BANKGAELD + GAELD_TIL_OFF + OBLGAELD + PANTGAELD), missing public debt set to 0. Liquid wealth = BANKAKT + KURSAKT + OBLAKT + PANTAKT. Pension wealth is the sum of PF_FORMUE across contracts in PENSFORM.
    登记库： IND, PENSFORM
    代码： KOEJD, BANKAKT, KURSAKT, OBLAKT, PANTAKT, BANKGAELD, GAELD_TIL_OFF, OBLGAELD, PANTGAELD; PF_FORMUE
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_b_annual_data.R
  • Monthly UI, cash benefits and retirement transfers 失业与福利金
    From ILME monthly non-employee e-income records, amounts across A/B income fields are summed per person-month and classified by the income-type code of the largest payment: UI if VMO_INDK_ART codes 2,5,8,16,104; cash benefits if type code 6 or art codes 40,41,43,84,87; retirement if art codes 6,9,10,13,20,24,25,44,45,74,83,86,113,115.
    登记库： ILME
    代码： VMO_INDKOMST_ART_KODE UI: 2,5,8,16,104; CB: VMO_INDKOMST_TYPE_KODE 6 or ART 40,41,43,84,87; Retirement ART: 6,9,10,13,20,24,25,44,45,74,83,86,113,115
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_c_monthly_data.R
  • Public vs private sector 部门与行业
    Main job (highest LOENTIMER in IDAN per year) is public if ARB_SEKTORKODE is non-missing and not 99, and recoded private if ARB_SEKTORKODE is in 18, 28, 89, 81, 58, 48, 42, 52. Industry groups come from DB07 ranges of ARB_HOVED_BRA_DB07 (e.g. >=840000 public services, 850000 teaching, 860000 health).
    登记库： IDAN
    代码： ARB_SEKTORKODE private: 18,28,89,81,58,48,42,52; ARB_HOVED_BRA_DB07 6-digit DB07 ranges
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_b_annual_data.R
  • Occupation group 职业与职位层级
    Main job's DISCO_KODE first digit mapped to 9 groups (1 management, 2 high knowledge, 3 medium knowledge, 4 office, 5 sales/services, 6 farming, 7 craft, 8 skilled, 9 unskilled); military (DISCO below 100000) dropped. Tenure = year - ANSAAR.
    登记库： IDAN
    代码： DISCO_KODE first digit 1-9; DISCO_KODE<100000 excluded; ANSAAR
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_b_annual_data.R
  • Education level 教育与考试成绩
    Highest completed education HFAUDD (latest available year) mapped through the audd format's H1 level: 10 elementary; 20, 25 high school; 30, 35 vocational; 40, 50, 60 bachelor; 65, 70 master.
    登记库： UDDA
    代码： HFAUDD via uddan_2014_audd H1: 10; 20,25; 30,35; 40,50,60; 65,70
    复制代码 · script/cleaning/1_b_annual_data.R
  • Population survey weights 样本界定与时间
    Inverse predicted propensity scores from a probability model of survey participation estimated on 2020 administrative data on the demographics of Danes active in the labour market.

Instrumental Variables with Unordered Treatments: Theory and Evidence from Returns to Fields of Study

Eskil Heinesen, Christian Hvid, Lars Kirkebøen, Edwin Leuven and Magne Mogstad · Journal of Labor Economics, 2026 · 个人

证明识别无序处理（例如学科专业）的回报所需的假设具有可检验的含义，并刻画了这些假设不成立时的偏误。利用丹麦和挪威的录取分数线与申请者的志愿排序，文章发现在剔除违反假设的专业之后，各专业的回报在两国之间高度相关。

数据
Danish administrative data on all applications to post-secondary education 1994–2002 (coordinated admission system), Population register and other registers (background, completed field of study, annual earnings), Norwegian post-secondary application data 1998–2004 linked to registers (comparison country)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：申请八年后的年劳动收入（工资、自雇收入以及替代收入的转移支付）
  • 处理：完成的学科专业（九个专业大类）
  • 工具变量：申请分数恰好高于或低于首选专业的录取分数线
  • 根据申请者志愿排序确定的首选专业和次优专业
时期
1994–2002 年的申请（丹麦），结果变量在申请八年后测量
样本
所查资料中未注明 首次申请丹麦中学后教育、此前未取得中学后教育学位的申请者，他们至少申请了两个专业大类，首选专业设有录取分数线，并在八年内完成了某一专业的学业（并与挪威申请者作平行分析）。 来源
变量如何定义（6）
  • Annual earnings eight years after application 劳动收入与收入
    Annual earnings eight years after the first observed application: wage income, self-employment income and transfers replacing such income (short-term sickness pay, paid parental leave), excluding unemployment benefits; deflated by CPI (base 2011) and converted to 1,000s of USD at 2010-2016 average rates (5.9 DKK per USD).
    登记库： Income registers
    工作论文 · Section 5.2 'Data and descriptive statistics'
  • Completed field of study (nine broad fields) 教育与考试成绩
    Field of the post-secondary degree completed within eight years of application, aggregating detailed fields into nine broad fields (Medicine, Law, Technology, Other Health, Humanities, Teaching, Social Science, Business, Science) following Kirkeboen et al. (2016), except that Technology covers integrated, vocational/professional short- and long-cycle degrees (mostly computer science and engineering) and Science covers open-ended bachelor programmes in sciences plus agriculture, forestry and aquaculture.
    登记库： Education register
    工作论文 · Section 5.2; Figure 3
  • Admission-cutoff instrument (Denmark) 教育与考试成绩
    z = 1[GPA > Q1] + 1[Std <= GPA <= Q1] x Offer, where Q1 and Std are the Quota 1 and standby GPA thresholds of the preferred field; at GPA exactly equal to a threshold the offer is treated as random conditional on age (and on applying for standby). Applicants rank up to 8 programmes; where several programmes in the preferred broad field are listed, the lowest cutoff is used.
    登记库： Coordinated admission system (KOT) applications
    工作论文 · Appendix E 'Specification of instrument'; Section 5.2
  • Preferred and next-best field 教育与考试成绩
    Defined from the local ranking on the application list around the admission cutoff: the preferred field is the one ranked just above the next-best field, where the applicant's score is near the preferred field's cutoff; fixed effects for preferred-field x next-best-field combinations are included.
    登记库： Coordinated admission system (KOT) applications
    工作论文 · Section 5.1 and Section 6
  • Applicant sample 样本界定与时间
    All applications to post-secondary education 1994-2002 (Denmark; Norway 1998-2004); first observed application kept; those already holding a post-secondary degree excluded; restricted to those who completed a field within eight years and who applied to at least two broad fields with the most-preferred field having an admission cutoff.
    登记库： Coordinated admission system (KOT) applications, BEF
    工作论文 · Section 5.2
  • Application score (high-school GPA) 教育与考试成绩
    High-school GPA over all subjects of the study programme, recorded to one decimal on the 13-point scale (0-13, omitting 1, 2, 4, 12); used as the running variable, controlled linearly on each side of the cutoff.
    登记库： Coordinated admission system (KOT) applications
    工作论文 · Appendix E 'Danish admission institutions'; Section 6
