Katrine Jakobsen and Jakob Egholt Søgaard · Journal of Public Economics, 2022 · 个人

指出利用税制改革估计应税收入弹性的标准做法会因均值回归以及收入分布不同位置上收入趋势的分化而产生偏误，并提出一种利用改革时点把行为反应与这些趋势区分开来的方法，应用于丹麦的税制改革。

数据
Danish administrative registers for the full population since 1980 (labour market history, education, earnings, demographics), Third-party reported income tax records, Simulated marginal tax rates from an extended Danish tax simulator (Kleven and Schultz 2014 model)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：四年期内应税收入（宽口径收入、个人收入、劳动收入）的变化
  • 处理：2004 年和 2009–10 年丹麦税制改革带来的对数税后留存率（net-of-tax rate）的预测变化
  • 收入区间虚拟变量，用于刻画收入分布不同位置上的趋势差异
  • 验证：收入分布中未受改革影响部分的收入趋势
时期
数据自 1980 年起；主要分析为 1999–2012 年（2004 年改革：改革前时期 1999–2003 年，改革时期 2003–2007 年；2009–10 年改革：改革前时期 2004–2008 年，改革时期 2008–2012 年）；1987 年和 1994 年改革见附录
样本
每个时期超过 2,000,000 人（2004 年改革的改革前时期和改革时期分别为 2,240,332 人和 2,295,922 人；2009–10 年改革分别为 2,097,862 人和 2,240,833 人） 在每个四年期内出现在税收数据中且收入为正、期初个人收入高于 DKK 200,000（2004 年改革）或 DKK 250,000（2009–10 年改革）的个人，约占丹麦成年人口的一半。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Labour market income (LI) 劳动收入与收入
    Salary, wages, honoraria, fees, bonuses, fringe benefits and business earnings, as defined in the Danish income tax system.
    登记库： Danish tax records
    论文正文 · Section 3.1, Table 1
  • Broad income (BI) 劳动收入与收入
    Labour market income plus transfers, certain pension payouts and received alimony; it equals personal income before deductions.
    登记库： Danish tax records
    论文正文 · Table 1; Fig. 3 notes
  • Personal income (PI) 劳动收入与收入
    Broad income minus the labour market contribution and certain pension contributions (employer-administered annuity pension contributions were fully deductible until 2010, then capped at DKK 100,000 for expiring annuities). PI is the main outcome and initial-income concept, and responses are also shown with and without pension contributions.
    登记库： Danish tax records
    论文正文 · Table 1; Section 3.1; footnote 21
  • Taxable income (TI) 劳动收入与收入
    Personal income plus capital income (interest, rental and business capital income minus interest on debt) minus itemized deductions (commuting, union fees, unemployment insurance contributions, other work expenses, charitable donations, paid alimony). Stock income is taxed separately.
    登记库： Danish tax records
    论文正文 · Table 1
  • Simulated marginal tax rate / predicted change in log net-of-tax rate 税收与税率
    Marginal tax rates are imputed with an extension of the Kleven and Schultz (2014) Danish tax simulator, as the increase in total household taxes from an incremental increase in labour income. The predicted change compares rates under the period-t and t-1 tax systems, holding income and characteristics fixed at their t-k levels (k = 1 baseline).
    登记库： Danish tax records
    论文正文 · Section 2 (eq. 5); Section 3.3
  • Reform and pre-reform period samples 样本界定与时间
    Four-year periods: 2004-08 (pre) and 2008-12 (reform) for the 2009-10 reform; initial years 1999 and 2003 for the 2004 reform. Individuals present in tax data with positive income over the period, and initial personal income above DKK 250,000 (2009-10 reform) or DKK 200,000 (2004 reform) at 2019 levels deflated by tax-code wage indexes.
    登记库： Danish tax records
    论文正文 · Section 3.3, Table 3
  • Initial income bin dummies 劳动收入与收入
    Fifty dummies for initial personal income measured at the start of each period (e.g. 2004 or 2008). The DKK 300,000 bin is omitted, so coefficients measure income-growth trend differentials relative to that bin.
    登记库： Danish tax records

近 3900 万个汽车保有状态转换观测值 1996–2008 年丹麦全部家庭以及私人拥有的全部汽车。 来源
变量如何定义（7）
  • Car types (green/brown x heavy/light) 其他
    Cars are split by whether weight is above or below the median for the car's vintage cohort, then within each half by whether fuel efficiency is above (green) or below (brown) the median, giving four types; attributes are averaged within type. Cars are grouped into 25 age groups from new to 24+ years (cars over 22 years dropped from estimation).
    登记库： Car ownership register (Statistics Denmark)

  • Household types 家庭关系、生育与家庭户

    登记库： Demographic and income registers

  • High work distance 地理与社区
    Based on the Danish tax deduction for travel distance to work, which applies only to full-time workers living more than 12 km (each way) from their workplace; households with the deduction are classed as high work distance (slightly under half of Danes).
    登记库： Tax records (commuting deduction)
    工作论文 · Appendix F.1 (Household types)
  • Kilometres driven 其他
    Driving measured from odometer readings recorded at mandatory vehicle inspections, which occur biannually from car age 4 (ages 4, 6, 8, 10, ...).
    登记库： Vehicle inspection odometer data
    工作论文 · Appendix F.1 and footnote 32
  • Scrappage 其他
    Scrappage is not observed directly: a vehicle is defined as scrapped if an ownership spell ends and no other ownership spell ever begins afterwards (ownership register extract from September 2011, last sample year 2008, so at least about 3 years without an owner). Accidents are not observed.
    登记库： Car ownership register

  • New car registration tax 税收与税率
    T(P) = 1.25 x [tau1 x min(P, K) + tau2 x max(P - K, 0)], with 25% VAT on the price including tax; in 2008 K = DKK 81,000, tau1 = 105% and tau2 = 180%. Fuel prices are country averages from eof.dk.

Risk Attitudes, Sample Selection, and Attrition in a Longitudinal Field Experiment

Glenn W. Harrison, Morten I. Lau and Hong Il Yoo · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2020 · 个人

通过一项两轮田野实验检验风险偏好是否随时间保持稳定，样本为从民事登记系统（Civil Registry）中抽取的丹麦成年人。由于登记系统提供了拒绝邀请者的基本人口统计信息，且招募费是随机设定的，作者可以把风险选择与进入第一轮的选择以及第二轮之前的样本流失联合起来估计。忽略选择和流失会改变估计出的风险态度；对二者加以修正后，证据与风险偏好稳定相一致。

数据
Danish Civil Registration Office (CPR) random sample of 50,000 adults aged 18–75, with sex, age, residential location, marital status and immigrant status; 1,996 of them invited, Artefactual field experiment on risk attitudes: wave 1 in September–October 2009, wave 2 in April–October 2010 (collected by the authors), Post-experiment questionnaire for participants (self-reported household income)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：每位受试者每轮 40 次二元彩票选择，用于估计 EUT 和 RDU 下的风险偏好
  • 选择方程：全体受邀者是否参加第 1 轮，解释变量为登记系统中的年龄和性别、住所到酒店的距离以及招募费
  • 流失方程：是否参加第 2 轮，解释变量为年龄、性别、自报收入以及第 1 轮中的所得
  • 排除性约束：随机设定的固定招募费，300 或 500 克朗
时期
样本对 2009 年 1 月 1 日的成年人口具有代表性；实验于 2009 年 9 月 28 日–10 月 22 日和 2010 年 4 月–10 月进行
样本
第 1 轮 1,996 名受邀者（413 名参与者，1,583 名未参与者）；第 2 轮再次邀请 354 人（182 名参与者，172 名未参与者）；25,555 个选择观测值（表 1 和表 2 的注释） 从 Civil Registration Office 随机抽取并按地理区域分层的 18–75 岁丹麦人，受邀参加彩票选择实验；估计样本为全体受邀者，无论其是否参加。 来源
变量如何定义（4）
  • Invited sample from the Civil Registration Office 样本界定与时间
    A random sample of 50,000 Danes aged between 18 and 75, inclusive, was obtained from the Danish Civil Registration Office, with information on sex, age, residential location, marital status and whether the individual is an immigrant; the sample was drawn to be representative of the adult population as of 1 January 2009. It was stratified by geographic area and 1,996 invitations were sent; 413 took part between 28 September and 22 October 2009. The estimation sample is all 1,996 invitees. The authors note that the list of characteristics could be extended by merging at Statistics Denmark, which they did not do.
    登记库： Danish Civil Registration Office (CPR) extract
    代码： Age 18-75 inclusive; 50,000 drawn, 1,996 invited
    工作论文 · Section 2.A (Field Sampling Procedures) and footnote 14; Section 3.B (estimation sample)
  • Selection and attrition equation covariates 样本界定与时间
    The selection equation for wave 1 includes the recruitment fee indicator, home-to-hotel distance in miles and its square, and the subject's age and gender. The attrition equation for wave 2 includes actual earnings from the first experiment, age and gender, and self-reported income, which is only available for those who took part in the first experiment. Age groups: young = aged less than 30, middle = aged between 40 and 50, old = aged over 50; the omitted group is 30-39.
    登记库： Danish Civil Registration Office (CPR) extract
    代码： young < 30; middle 40-50; old > 50; omitted 30-39
    工作论文 · Section 3.B (discussion of Xn1 and Xn2); Table 1 panel B and notes; Table 2
  • Home-to-hotel distance 地理与社区
    Distance in miles between the invitee's home and the hotel meeting room where the wave 1 session was held, computed from geographical coordinates downloaded from Google Maps with a Stata command that measures the shortest curve between two locations on the earth's surface. Average distance was 10.2 miles for the 1,583 non-participants and 8.1 miles for the 413 participants.
    工作论文 · Section 2.A and footnote 16
  • Income groups (self-reported, participants only) 劳动收入与收入
    IncLow = household income in 2008 below 300,000 kroner; IncHigh = household income of 500,000 kroner or more. Self-reported in the experiment's questionnaire, not taken from registers.
    代码： IncLow: < 300,000 DKK; IncHigh: >= 500,000 DKK (household income, 2008)

Asset Integration and Attitudes toward Risk: Theory and Evidence

Steffen Andersen, James C. Cox, Glenn W. Harrison, Morten I. Lau, E. Elisabet Rutström and Vjollca Sadiraj · Review of Economics and Statistics, 2018 · 个人

考察人们在实验中选择彩票时，是否会把个人财富与所提供的奖金合并考虑。作者将丹麦成年人的彩票选择与每位受试者在登记库中的净财富相匹配，并在期望效用和等级依赖效用下估计允许部分资产整合的结构模型。完全资产整合被拒绝，并且在混合估计中赋予财富的权重接近于零，由此得到合理的风险溢价，也为收益校准悖论提供了一条出路。

数据
Statistics Denmark register data matched to the experimental subjects on CPR number (analysed remotely at Statistics Denmark), Danish Tax Authorities (SKAT) income and wealth records: third-party reported assets, liabilities and pensions as of 31 December 2014, Danish Civil Registration records: gender, date of birth, family links and marital history, Artefactual field experiment with binary lottery choices, February–March 2015 (collected by the authors)
关键变量
  • 结果变量：每位受试者对 60 组二元彩票对的选择（收益域）
  • 关键协变量：基于登记库的个人净财富，在零处截断
  • 估计对象：EUT 和 RDU 下的风险厌恶、财富的权重（资产整合程度）以及财富与实验收入之间的替代
  • 简约式检验中的控制变量：性别、年龄、婚姻状况、家庭规模、净收入、净财富的各组成部分
时期
实验于 2015 年 2 月–3 月进行；登记库财富以 2014 年 12 月 31 日为测量时点
样本
442 名实验受试者，共作出 26,520 次彩票选择（第 2 节和表 2）；与登记库中 1,455,772 名可比的丹麦人对照（第 2 节） 截至 2015 年 1 月居住在大哥本哈根地区、参加了彩票选择实验并与其登记记录相匹配的丹麦成年人。 来源
变量如何定义（4）
  • Net individual wealth 财富、负债与消费
    Total assets minus total liabilities of the individual subject. Total assets are the market value of domestic real estate, shares and mutual funds, bonds, assets deposited in domestic and foreign financial institutions, pensions and the value of automobiles. Total liabilities are the value of debt in domestic and foreign financial institutions and mortgages. Shares, bonds and pensions are reported by financial institutions as of 31 December 2014; real estate is estimated by Statistics Denmark as the market value on 31 December 2014; automobiles are valued by Statistics Denmark with a one-year lag. Excludes cash, yachts, paintings, equity in privately held companies and unlisted mutual funds, and human capital. All foreign assets and debt are self-reported to SKAT and are zero for every subject.
    登记库： Danish Tax Authorities (SKAT) income and wealth records, via Statistics Denmark
    代码： Valuation date 31 December 2014; automobiles with a one-year lag; values in 2015 DKK
    工作论文 · Section 2.B (Wealth Data); Table 1 and notes
  • Net wealth truncated at zero 财富、负债与消费
    For 21 of the 442 subjects (4.7%) measured net wealth is negative, reflecting assets that are not fully accounted for; for all calculations wealth is assumed not to be negative and is truncated to zero. Mean net wealth is 3,074,678 kroner (median 2,165,847); mean after truncation is 3,097,435 kroner.
    登记库： Danish Tax Authorities (SKAT) income and wealth records, via Statistics Denmark
    代码： Net wealth < 0 set to 0 (21 of 442 subjects)
    工作论文 · Section 2.B; Table 1
  • Experimental sample matched to registers 样本界定与时间
    442 individuals with experimental choice data and wealth data, representative of the adult Danish population residing in Greater Copenhagen as of January 2015; all experiments were run in February and March 2015. The authors had the CPR number of every subject; matching and all statistical analysis with the register data take place remotely at Statistics Denmark. Compared with 1,455,772 comparable Danes in the registers, the subjects differ significantly only in household size (1.4 vs 1.54) and income (434,085 vs 338,859 kroner per year).
    登记库： Danish Civil Registration records and SKAT tax records, via Statistics Denmark
    工作论文 · Section 2 (Data), opening paragraphs; Section 2.B
  • Individual and family data (demographic controls) 家庭关系、生育与家庭户
    Taken from the Danish Civil Registration records, which cover the entire population. Each record includes the personal identification number (CPR), name, gender, date of birth, the CPR numbers of nuclear family members (parents, siblings and children) and marital history (number of marriages, divorces and widowhoods). Used to identify the experimental subjects and to provide control variables such as age, gender and marital status.
    登记库： Danish Civil Registration records, via Statistics Denmark
    工作论文 · Section 2.B (Wealth Data)

Expenditure Survey

  • 工资总额（W），用于构造质量调整后的就业
  • 全职当量就业（N）
  • 劳动生产率：每名工人的增加值和每名质量调整工人的增加值
  • 矩：包含退出在内的企业增长率，以及生产率增长分解（企业内、企业间、交叉项、退出）
时期
1992–1997
样本
4,872 家企业的非平衡面板 1992 年已存在、雇员超过 20 人的全部丹麦私营企业，跟踪至 1997 年，不含此后进入的企业。 来源
变量如何定义（5）
  • Firm panel 样本界定与时间
    Unbalanced annual panel 1992-1997 of privately owned firms from the Danish Business Statistics Register: all firms existing in 1992 with more than 20 workers, followed over time; entrants after 1992 excluded (about 4,872 firms).
    登记库： Danish Business Statistics Register
    工作论文 · Section 2 (Danish Firm Data); Section 5 (Danish Firm Data)
  • Quality-adjusted employment 企业特征与生产率
    N* of firm j equals its total wage bill W_j divided by the economy-wide average wage per worker (sum of W over sum of N); for firms observed in several years the implied labour quality is averaged over time.
    登记库： Danish Business Statistics Register
    代码： N*_j = W_j / w, w = sum_j W_j / sum_j N_j
    工作论文 · Section 2, equation (1) and footnote 2
  • Labour productivity 企业特征与生产率
    Value added per worker (Y/N) and value added per quality-adjusted worker (Y/N*), with Y in DKK.
    登记库： Danish Business Statistics Register
    工作论文 · Section 2, Figure 1
  • Firm growth including exit 企业特征与生产率
    Firm growth rate in value added (dY/Y) where an exiting firm contributes an observation of -1.
    登记库： Danish Business Statistics Register
    工作论文 · Section 5, Table 2
  • Productivity growth decomposition 企业特征与生产率
    Growth in aggregate value added per worker decomposed following Foster, Haltiwanger and Krizan (2001) into within, between, cross, entry and exit terms, with firm employment shares as weights; no entry term because entrants are excluded.
    登记库： Danish Business Statistics Register
    代码： P_t = sum_e s_et p_et, p_et = Y_et/N_et, s_et = N_et/N_t
    工作论文 · Section 5, equation (19), Table 3
